**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |

```sql
    @HeatNo = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[AllocateBilletsToStacksByBilletNo]
    @HeatNo NVARCHAR(MAX)   -- comma separated billet numbers
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
	    ;WITH LayerUsage AS (
            SELECT s.ID,
                s.Number,
			    s.name,
                s.Capacity,
                COUNT(i.ID) AS Used,
                s.Capacity - COUNT(i.ID) AS Remaining
            FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl s
            LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i 
            ON s.ID = i.LocationID 
			--where i.LotNumber = @HeatNo
            GROUP BY s.ID, s.Number, s.Capacity,s.name
		    order by s.name OFFSET 0 ROWS
        ), OrderedInventory AS (
		    SELECT i.ID,i.lotnumber,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.sublotnumber) AS rn
            FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i
            WHERE i.LocationID IS NULL and LotNumber=@HeatNo 
        ), LayerSlots AS (
		    SELECT lu.name,
				lu.ID,
				lu.Number,
				lu.capacity,
				lu.Remaining,
				lu.Used,
				SUM(lu.Remaining) OVER (ORDER BY lu.name ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING ) AS CumRemaining
            FROM LayerUsage lu
            WHERE lu.Remaining > 0
		    order by lu.name OFFSET 0 ROWS 
        ), assign as (
		    SELECT MIN(ls.name) AS name,
				oi.id,
                MIN(ls.Number) AS LayerNumber,oi.LotNumber
            FROM OrderedInventory oi
            JOIN LayerSlots ls
			ON oi.rn <= ls.CumRemaining
			where oi.LotNumber=@HeatNo
            GROUP BY oi.id,oi.LotNumber
		), Final as (
		    select l.id as LocationID,a.ID
		    from assign a 
            left join LayerSlots l on l.Name=a.name 
		    where a.LotNumber = @HeatNo 
        )
		UPDATE i
			 SET i.LocationID = a.LocationID
		FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i
		JOIN Final a ON i.id = a.ID
		where i.lotnumber=@heatno

        --;WITH SplitBillets AS (
        --    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS BilletNo
        --    FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BilletNoList, ',')
        --),
        --TargetInventory AS (
        --    SELECT i.GUID,
        --           i.BilletNo,
        --           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.BilletNo) AS rn
        --    FROM Inventory i
        --    JOIN SplitBillets sb ON i.BilletNo = sb.BilletNo
        --    WHERE i.LocationID IS NULL
        --),
        --LayerUsage AS (
        --    SELECT s.LocationID,
        --           s.LayerNumber,
        --           s.Capacity,
        --           COUNT(i.GUID) AS Used,
        --           s.Capacity - COUNT(i.GUID) AS Remaining
        --    FROM Stack s
        --    LEFT JOIN Inventory i 
        --        ON s.LocationID = i.LocationID 
        --       AND s.LayerNumber = i.LayerNumber
        --    GROUP BY s.LocationID, s.LayerNumber, s.Capacity
        --),
        --LayerSlots AS (
        --    SELECT lu.LocationID,
        --           lu.LayerNumber,
        --           lu.Remaining,
        --           SUM(lu.Remaining) OVER (
        --               ORDER BY lu.LayerNumber, lu.LocationID 
        --               ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        --           ) AS CumRemaining
        --    FROM LayerUsage lu
        --    WHERE lu.Remaining > 0
        --),
        --Assign AS (
        --    SELECT ti.GUID,
        --           MIN(ls.LocationID) AS LocationID,
        --           MIN(ls.LayerNumber) AS LayerNumber
        --    FROM TargetInventory ti
        --    JOIN LayerSlots ls
        --      ON ti.rn <= ls.CumRemaining
        --    GROUP BY ti.GUID
        --)
        --UPDATE i
        --SET i.LocationID = a.LocationID,
        --    i.LayerNumber = a.LayerNumber
        --FROM Inventory i
        --JOIN Assign a ON i.GUID = a.GUID;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : AllocateBilletsToStacksByBilletNo | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[AllocateBilletsToStacksByBilletNo]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END;
```

## dbo.BilletsPosition_InFurnace_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** BilletsPosition_InFurnace_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-09-23 16:36:47  
**Modified On:** 2026-05-04 10:15:28  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @StartTime | datetime | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace_Usp]
    @StartTime = '2026-05-04 00:00:00';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana, Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 22-08-2025
-- Modified Date: 04-10-2025,--
-- Modified By: Mahesh Udar (line No 77 and comment line No 78),Mahesh Udar (Add line No 149 and 298)
-- Description:	1) To update and insert Position of and Billets in Furnace and Billets Position History
--				2) To update outward Location in Inventory
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace_Usp]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StartTime DateTime

AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE 
		@BilletNo VARCHAR(100),
		@HeatNo INT,
		@Grade VARCHAR(500),
		@PrevBilletNo VARCHAR(100),
		@PrevBilletPosition VARCHAR(100),
		@PrevHeatNo VARCHAR(100),
		@PrevGrade VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @Stackid varchar(36),@LocationID Varchar(36),@StackName varchar(Max),@LocationName Varchar(Max)
	BEGIN TRY
		---- Get Stack ID
		--DECLARE @STACKID VARCHAR(36) = (
		--	SELECT Stackid 
		--	FROM Xstudio_Xbatch_ChargingPlan_Mst_Tbl 
		--	WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = 'B9D1E5A0-32C0-4AEF-96FE-9C9AB1A3562A')

		---- Get next billet from stack
		--SELECT TOP 1 
		--	@HeatNo = LotNumber,
		--	@BilletNo = SublotNumber,
		--	@Grade = MaterialGrade
		--FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH (NOLOCK)
		--WHERE 
		--	ParentID IN (SELECT ID FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE name LIKE '%Billet%')
		--	AND LocationID IS NOT NULL
		--	AND LocationID IN (
		--		SELECT ID FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @STACKID
		--	)
		--	AND MaterialGrade = (
		--		SELECT TOP 1 GradeType 
		--		FROM Xstudio_Xbatch..XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH (NOLOCK)  
		--		WHERE ID = @STACKID 
		--		ORDER BY CreatedOn DESC
		--	)
		--	AND OutwardLocation IS NULL 
		--ORDER BY StackLocation DESC, SublotNumber DESC
		-----------------------Billet From Operator chrging HEat selection---------------------------------------------------
		;WITH Inventory AS
		(
			SELECT 
				t1.LotNumber,
				t1.SublotNumber,
				t1.MaterialGrade,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.LotNumber ORDER BY t1.SublotNumber) AS rn
			FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE 
				t1.ParentID IN (
					SELECT ID 
					FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH (NOLOCK) 
					WHERE name LIKE '%Billet%' AND [IsDeleted] = 0
				)
				AND t1.LocationID IS NOT NULL
				AND IsDeleted=0 AND movementtype = 'inward'
				--AND t1.OutwardLocation IS NULL
		)
		SELECT top 1
			@HeatNo=inv.LotNumber, 
			@BilletNo=inv.SublotNumber, 
			@Grade=inv.MaterialGrade
		FROM Inventory inv
		JOIN RM_Operator_HeatSelection t2 
			ON inv.LotNumber = t2.Heatno
		WHERE inv.rn <= t2.BilletQty
		ORDER BY inv.LotNumber, inv.rn;

		IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @HeatNo = NULL;
			SET @Grade = NULL;
			SET @BilletNo = 'N/A';
		END
		----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		-- Get previous billet
		SELECT TOP 1 @PrevBilletNo = Position1 
		FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0

		-- Compare if previous billet is not a gap
		IF (@PrevBilletNo NOT IN ('Heat Change Gap', 'Grade Change Gap'))
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 
				@PrevHeatNo = LotNumber,
				@PrevGrade = MaterialGrade 
			FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE SublotNumber = @PrevBilletNo

			IF (@HeatNo != @PrevHeatNo AND @Grade = @PrevGrade)
				SET @BilletNo = 'Heat Change Gap'

			IF (@HeatNo != @PrevHeatNo AND @Grade != @PrevGrade)
				SET @BilletNo = 'Grade Change Gap'
		END

		-- If previous was a heat gap, proceed with actual billet movement
		IF (@PrevBilletNo='Heat Change Gap' OR @PrevBilletNo IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @BilletNo=@BilletNo
		END

		-- Handle grade change gap
		IF (@PrevBilletNo = 'Grade Change Gap')
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 
				@PrevBilletPosition = 
					CASE 
						WHEN Position1 = 'Grade Change Gap' AND Position2 != 'Grade Change Gap' THEN 'Grade Change Gap1'
						WHEN Position1 = 'Grade Change Gap' AND Position2 = 'Grade Change Gap' THEN 'Grade Change Gap2'
					END
			FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace] WITH (NOLOCK)

			IF (@PrevBilletPosition = 'Grade Change Gap1')
			BEGIN
				SET @BilletNo = 'Grade Change Gap'
			END
			
		END

		----Insert BilletNo In Billet_NGConsumption_InFurnace Table----
		If (@BilletNo NOT IN ('Grade Change Gap','Heat Change Gap','N/A'))
		Begin
		INSERT INTO [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_NGConsumption_InFurnace] (BilletNo,InTime) VALUES (@BilletNo,@StartTime)
		End
		Exec XBatch_RM_BilletWiseNGConsumption
		-----

		IF(@BilletNo IS NOT NULL OR @BilletNo IN ('Grade Change Gap','Heat Change Gap'))
		Begin
		----

		--------Instert Into Invertory Table----
		  UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl 
					SET 
						OutwardLocation = 'BA4E547C-12D7-4758-B557-F7362E94D898',
						LocationID = '644D3057-FB48-4459-A96C-FCD906328D9F',
						OutwardDate =  GETDATE(),
						MovementType = 'Outward' 
					WHERE LotNumber = @HeatNo AND SublotNumber = @BilletNo
			-----
			-----Select StackID, StackName, Locationname for UpDate in Billet Transfer History----
			select @Stackid=(select ID from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=(select ParentID from XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=LocationID AND [IsDeleted] = 0) AND [IsDeleted] = 0),@LocationID=LocationID
			from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			where SublotNumber=@BilletNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0	

			set @StackName = (select Name from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=@Stackid AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
			Set @Locationname=(select name from XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=@LocationID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
			----

			---Insert in Billet Transfer History---
			insert into XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl(ID,ParentID,BilletNo,SubLotNo,RecievedDate,CurrentStatus,MaterialGrade,RecievedBy,InventoryID,StackID,LayerID,LocationAssignedDate,ActionBy)
			SELECT
				NewID(),
				ParentID,
				LotNumber,
				SublotNumber,
				Getdate(),
				'Outward',
				MaterialGrade,
				(select name from XBatch_OutwardLocation_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=OutwardLocation AND [IsDeleted] = 0),
				ID,
				(select name from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id= @stackid AND [IsDeleted] = 0),
				@LocationName,
				Getdate(),
				''
			FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			where SublotNumber=@BilletNo AND [ISDeleted] = 0
			-----
		END

		----Update Billet Position in BilletsPosition_InFurnace Table----
		UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace]
		SET
			--Position70 = Position69,
			--Position69 = Position68,
			--Position68 = Position67,
			--Position67 = Position66,
			--Position66 = Position65,
			Position65 = Position64,
			Position64 = Position63,
			Position63 = Position62,
			Position62 = Position61,
			Position61 = Position60,
			Position60 = Position59,
			Position59 = Position58,
			Position58 = Position57,
			Position57 = Position56,
			Position56 = Position55,
			Position55 = Position54,
			Position54 = Position53,
			Position53 = Position52,
			Position52 = Position51,
			Position51 = Position50,
			Position50 = Position49,
			Position49 = Position48,
			Position48 = Position47,
			Position47 = Position46,
			Position46 = Position45,
			Position45 = Position44,
			Position44 = Position43,
			Position43 = Position42,
			Position42 = Position41,
			Position41 = Position40,
			Position40 = Position39,
			Position39 = Position38,
			Position38 = Position37,
			Position37 = Position36,
			Position36 = Position35,
			Position35 = Position34,
			Position34 = Position33,
			Position33 = Position32,
			Position32 = Position31,
			Position31 = Position30,
			Position30 = Position29,
			Position29 = Position28,
			Position28 = Position27,
			Position27 = Position26,
			Position26 = Position25,
			Position25 = Position24,
			Position24 = Position23,
			Position23 = Position22,
			Position22 = Position21,
			Position21 = Position20,
			Position20 = Position19,
			Position19 = Position18,
			Position18 = Position17,
			Position17 = Position16,
			Position16 = Position15,
			Position15 = Position14,
			Position14 = Position13,
			Position13 = Position12,
			Position12 = Position11,
			Position11 = Position10,
			Position10 = Position9,
			Position9 = Position8,
			Position8 = Position7,
			Position7 = Position6,
			Position6 = Position5,
			Position5 = Position4,
			Position4 = Position3,
			Position3 = Position2,
			Position2 = Position1,
			Position1 = @BilletNo 
		------

		----For Insert BilletNo and Position in Billets_InFurnace_Tracking_Trn----
		Insert Into Billets_InFurnace_Tracking_Trn (BilletNo,BilletPosition,EntryDateTime,HeatNo,Grade)
		SELECT BilletNo,  CASE 
			WHEN BilletPosition = 'Position65' THEN 'Out of Furnace'
			ELSE BilletPosition
		END AS BilletPosition,
		@StartTime As Starttime,
		inv.LotNumber AS HeatNo,
		inv.MaterialGrade AS Grade 
		FROM (
			SELECT [Position1],[Position2], [Position3], [Position4], [Position5],[Position6], [Position7], [Position8], [Position9], [Position10],[Position11], [Position12], [Position13], [Position14], [Position15], [Position16], [Position17], [Position18], [Position19], [Position20],[Position21], [Position22], [Position23], [Position24], [Position25],[Position26], [Position27], [Position28], [Position29], [Position30],[Position31], [Position32], [Position33], [Position34], [Position35],[Position36], [Position37], [Position38], [Position39], [Position40],[Position41], [Position42], [Position43], [Position44], [Position45],[Position46], [Position47], [Position48], [Position49], [Position50],[Position51],[Position52], [Position53], [Position54], [Position55],[Position56], [Position57], [Position58], [Position59], [Position60],[Position61], [Position62], [Position63], [Position64], [Position65]
			--,[Position66], [Position67], [Position68], [Position69], [Position70]
			FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
		) AS p UNPIVOT (
			BilletNo FOR BilletPosition IN 
				([Position1],[Position2], [Position3], [Position4], [Position5],[Position6], [Position7], [Position8], [Position9], [Position10],[Position11], [Position12], [Position13], [Position14], [Position15], [Position16], [Position17], [Position18], [Position19], [Position20],[Position21], [Position22], [Position23], [Position24], [Position25],[Position26], [Position27], [Position28], [Position29], [Position30],[Position31], [Position32], [Position33], [Position34], [Position35],[Position36], [Position37], [Position38], [Position39], [Position40],[Position41], [Position42], [Position43], [Position44], [Position45],[Position46], [Position47], [Position48], [Position49], [Position50],[Position51],[Position52], [Position53], [Position54], [Position55],[Position56], [Position57], [Position58], [Position59], [Position60],[Position61], [Position62], [Position63], [Position64], [Position65]
				--,[Position66], [Position67], [Position68], [Position69], [Position70]
				)
		) AS unpvt 
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl inv WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON unpvt.BilletNo = inv.SublotNumber
		WHERE unpvt.BilletNo IS NOT NULL AND unpvt.BilletNo <> ''
		-----

		Declare @Position65 varchar(500)
		Select @Position65=Position65 from [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
		if(@Position65 not in ('Heat Change Gap','Grade Change Gap','N/A'))
		Begin

		---- Update outtime of Billets---
		IF Exists(Select 1 from [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_NGConsumption_InFurnace] With(Nolock) WHERE BilletNo=@Position65)
		Begin
		UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_NGConsumption_InFurnace] SET OutTime=@StartTime WHERE BilletNo=@Position65
		End
		------

			UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl 
			SET 
				OutwardLocation = '41564A24-7812-4F0A-B342-E82ABF01AA19',
				LocationID = '39B16EB9-F29D-4535-A1DD-314801FD5AB6',
				OutwardDate = GETDATE(),
				MovementType = 'Outward' 
			WHERE LotNumber = @HeatNo AND SublotNumber = @BilletNo

			select @Stackid=(select ID from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=(select ParentID from XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=LocationID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)),@LocationID=LocationID
			from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			where SublotNumber=@BilletNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0	

			set @StackName = (select Name from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=@Stackid AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
			Set @Locationname=(select name from XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=@LocationID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)

			insert into XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl(ID,ParentID,BilletNo,SubLotNo,RecievedDate,CurrentStatus,MaterialGrade,RecievedBy,InventoryID,StackID,LayerID,LocationAssignedDate,ActionBy)
			SELECT
				NewID(),
				ParentID,
				LotNumber,
				SublotNumber,
				Getdate(),
				'Outward',
				MaterialGrade,
				(select name from XBatch_OutwardLocation_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=OutwardLocation AND [IsDeleted] = 0),
				ID,
				(select name from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id= @stackid AND [IsDeleted] = 0),
				@LocationName,
				Getdate(),
				''
			FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) 
			where SublotNumber=@BilletNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0 

		end
	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : BilletsPosition_InFurnace_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.campaignplan_released_workflow_usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** campaignplan_released_workflow_usp  
**Created On:** 2026-04-22 08:15:43  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-22 08:15:43  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[campaignplan_released_workflow_usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
create PROC campaignplan_released_workflow_usp
as
begin

Declare @campaignID varchar(max),@startDate DATE,@enddate DATE,@size Decimal(10,4),@p_RecordId varchar(max)


Select @CampaignID=CampaignId,@StartDate=StartDate,@EndDate=EndDate,@size=size from XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst where id=@p_RecordId and IsDeleted=0;

-- 1. Temp table for Work Order data
DECLARE @WOTable TABLE (
    Quantity DECIMAL(18,2),
    MaterialName VARCHAR(MAX),
    Grade VARCHAR(500),
    SalesOrderName VARCHAR(MAX),
    SalesOrderID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    CustomerName VARCHAR(MAX),
    ItemNo VARCHAR(100),
    length  DECIMAL(10,2)
);

-- 2. Temp table for sales Order data
DECLARE @SOMapping TABLE (SONumber VARCHAR(MAX));

INSERT INTO @SOMapping (SONumber)
SELECT DISTINCT SONumber
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn
WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID --AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB'
AND SONumber IS NOT NULL AND IsDeleted = 0;

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 1: Insert into Sales Order Master (Using the generated IDs)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO XBATCH_SALES_ORDER_MST_TBL (Name, SalesOrderNumber, ParentID, ItemID, Quantity, UnitID, Status, PlannedStartDate, PlannedCompletionDate)
SELECT 
    T.SONumber, 
    T.SONumber,
    (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM xbatch_customer_mst_tbl WHERE Name = MAX(T.Customer) AND IsDeleted = 0),
    (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WHERE Name = MAX(T.MaterialNo) AND IsDeleted = 0),
    SUM(T.MaxQtytoRollMT), 
    '2095DF88-C3E3-4184-BA44-BBBB0696FF14', 
    'New', 
    @StartDate, 
    @EndDate
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
INNER JOIN @SOMapping M ON T.SONumber = M.SONumber
WHERE T.CampaignId = @CampaignID AND T.IsDeleted = 0
-- CRITICAL FIX: Only insert if SO Number does not exist in Master Table
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM XBATCH_SALES_ORDER_MST_TBL 
        WHERE SalesOrderNumber = T.SONumber AND IsDeleted = 0
    )
GROUP BY T.SONumber;

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BRANCH 1: RB (Reinforced Bar) - Grouping by Length
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName,Length)
SELECT SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT), MAX(MaterialNo),Length
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON T.MaterialNo = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0
WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) = 'RB' AND T.IsDeleted = 0
GROUP BY [Length]; 

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BRANCH 2: Wire Rod/Coil with SO (Linked via @SOMapping)
------------------         ---------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName, SalesOrderName, CustomerName, ItemNo,Length)
SELECT 
    T.MaxQtytoRollMT, 
    T.MaterialNo, 
    T.SONumber,  
    T.Customer,
    T.length,
    S.ID
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
INNER JOIN @SOMapping M ON T.SONumber = M.SONumber
LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl S ON T.MaterialNo = S.Name AND S.IsDeleted = 0
WHERE T.CampaignId = @CampaignID AND LEFT(T.MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB' AND T.IsDeleted = 0;

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BRANCH 3: WSO (No SO) - Grouping by Length
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName,Length)
SELECT SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT), MAX(M.ID),Length
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON T.MaterialNo = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0
WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND SONumber IS NULL AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB' AND T.IsDeleted = 0
GROUP BY [Length]; 

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FINAL STEP: Insert into Work Order Master
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO XBATCH_WORK_ORDER_MST_TBL (
    Quantity, UnitID, ItemID, Status, Equipment, ManufacturingOrderCategory, 
    ManufacturingOrderType, ProductionPlant, StorageLocation, MaterialName, 
    SalesOrder, SalesOrderName, Grade, MfgOrderPlannedStartDate, MfgOrderPlannedEndDate, CustomerName, campaignid,Size,Length
)
SELECT 
    W.Quantity, '2095DF88-C3E3-4184-BA44-BBBB0696FF14', M.ID, 'RM ProductionOrder Created', 'RM', 
    W.ItemNo, 'BR02', '7503', '2104', W.MaterialName, 
    W.SalesOrderName, 
    W.SalesOrderName, W.Grade, @StartDate, @EndDate, W.CustomerName, @p_RecordId,@size,W.length
FROM @WOTable W
LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON W.MaterialName = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0;


Update XMES_Production_Campaign_Tracking 
Set ReleasedDate=Getdate(),status='Released'
where isdeleted=0 and campaignid=@p_RecordId

End
```

## dbo.DelayEntry_EBTFilling_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** DelayEntry_EBTFilling_USP  
**Created On:** 2026-02-20 08:48:42  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-25 12:46:21  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @HeatNo | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[DelayEntry_EBTFilling_USP]
    @HeatNo = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[DelayEntry_EBTFilling_USP] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@HeatNo int
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;



	DECLARE @TotalDelayinMinutes DECIMAL(18,2),  @PowerOFFTimeMinute DECIMAL(18,2), @DelayinSeconds INT, @PowerOFFMinute DECIMAL(18,2);
	DECLARE @DSTARTTIME DATETIME, @DENDTIME DATETIME;
	DECLARE @Buffer DECIMAL(18,2)

	BEGIN TRY
	SELECT @Buffer=DurationInMinutes FROM XMES_SMS_Event_Process_Tracker_Mst  WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  Type='Delay' AND Name= 'EBT Filling' AND IsDeleted=0
	SELECT @TotalDelayinMinutes=SUM(CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND,StartTime, EndTime) AS DECIMAL(18,2))/60) FROM SMS_Delay_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo and Status in ('Bucket Charging','Tapping Delay')
	SELECT @DSTARTTIME=ENDTIME FROM SMS_Delay_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo and Status ='Tapping Delay'
	SELECT @PowerOFFTimeMinute=PowerOffTimeTotalSeconds FROM EAF_PER_HEAT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo
	SELECT @PowerOFFMinute=ISNULL(SUM(DelayInMinutes),0) FROM ShiftDelayEntry WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo and DelayType='D95E61A2-4F72-44E6-A786-C3EEA9393B4F'
	--SELECT @DelayInMinutes=@PowerOFFTimeMinute-@TotalDelayinMinutes, @DelayinSeconds=Cast((@PowerOFFTimeMinute-@TotalDelayinMinutes)*60 AS INT)
	SELECT  @DENDTIME=DATEADD(SECOND,Cast((@PowerOFFTimeMinute-(@TotalDelayinMinutes + @Buffer + @PowerOFFMinute))* 60 AS INT),@DSTARTTIME)

	IF (@PowerOFFTimeMinute-(@TotalDelayinMinutes + @PowerOFFMinute) > @Buffer)
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ID FROM ShiftDelayEntry WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND DelayType='6822012D-AEBA-4E48-9A73-80DC22408A85' AND DelaySubtypeid='503A11D7-15ED-414E-8FD4-E99839105DEF')
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO ShiftDelayEntry (ID,DelayStartTime,DelayEndTime,DelayType,DelaySubTypeid,HeatNo,AreaName,DelayAgency,Source) 
			VALUES (NEWID(), @DSTARTTIME, @DENDTIME, '6822012D-AEBA-4E48-9A73-80DC22408A85', '503A11D7-15ED-414E-8FD4-E99839105DEF', @HeatNo, 'SMS', 'DF8F06BE-B8AD-476D-9341-5BF56BAD36A5', 'T-SQL')		 
		END
	END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : DelayEntry_EBTFilling_USP | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[DelayEntry_EBTFilling_USP]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

```sql
CREATE   PROC [dbo].[errorfortest]
(
    @SYSTEMID VARCHAR(36),   
    @USERID VARCHAR(36),    
    @RECORDID VARCHAR(36),
    @STATUS VARCHAR(50)
)
as
Begin

    Declare @campaignid varchar(MAX)

    Select @campaignid=Campaignid from XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst where isdeleted=0 and Id=@RECORDID
   
   if exists (Select Top(1) CampaignId from XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn where isdeleted=0 and campaignid=@campaignid and Validation=0)
    BEGIN
   
            RAISERROR('Validation Failed: One or more records do not match the selected Product/Size. Please correct the highlighted red rows before releasing the campaign.', 18, 2);
   END

   ELSE
   BEGIN
        update Xmes_campaign_plan_MSt
        set status='Released'
        where campaignid=@campaignid
   END
END
```

## dbo.Get_Monthly_Bill_Details_Summary

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** Get_Monthly_Bill_Details_Summary  
**Created On:** 2025-08-11 08:34:01  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:02:02  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @MonthNumber | int | NO |  |
| @YearNumber | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Get_Monthly_Bill_Details_Summary]
    @MonthNumber = 0,
    @YearNumber = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Get_Monthly_Bill_Details_Summary]
    @MonthNumber INT = NULL,
    @YearNumber INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Default to current month and year if not provided
    IF @MonthNumber IS NULL SET @MonthNumber = MONTH(GETDATE());
    IF @YearNumber IS NULL SET @YearNumber = YEAR(GETDATE());

    DECLARE 
        @RateOffPeak FLOAT,
        @RateNightPeak FLOAT,
        @RateWeekdayDayPeak FLOAT,
        @RateWeekendDayPeak FLOAT;
    BEGIN TRY
        SELECT TOP 1
            @RateOffPeak = OffPeak,
            @RateNightPeak = NightPeak,
            @RateWeekdayDayPeak = WeekdayDayPeak,
            @RateWeekendDayPeak = WeekendDayPeak
        FROM [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Rate_Tbl_Mst]
        WHERE MonthNumber = @MonthNumber AND ISNULL(IsDeleted, 0) = 0
        ORDER BY CreatedOn DESC;

        SELECT
            DATENAME(MONTH, emr.EndDateTime) AS [Month],
            tm.RateBand AS [TOU_Code],
            CASE 
                WHEN tm.RateBand = 'OffPeak' THEN @RateOffPeak
                WHEN tm.RateBand = 'NightPeak' THEN @RateNightPeak
                WHEN tm.RateBand = 'WeekdayDayPeak' THEN @RateWeekdayDayPeak
                WHEN tm.RateBand = 'WeekendDayPeak' THEN @RateWeekendDayPeak
                ELSE 0
            END AS [RatePerUnit],
            SUM(emr.Consumption) AS [Consumption (KWH)],
            SUM(emr.Consumption * 
                CASE 
                    WHEN tm.RateBand = 'Off Peak' THEN @RateOffPeak
                    WHEN tm.RateBand = 'Night Peak' THEN @RateNightPeak
                    WHEN tm.RateBand = 'Weekday Day Peak' THEN @RateWeekdayDayPeak
                    WHEN tm.RateBand = 'Weekend Days Peak' THEN @RateWeekendDayPeak
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS [Charge]
        FROM [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Reading] emr
        INNER JOIN [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Timing] tm
            ON CAST(emr.EndDateTime AS TIME) BETWEEN tm.FromTime AND tm.ToTime
            AND (
                tm.DayOfWeek = 'All Days' OR
                (tm.DayOfWeek = 'Sunday To Thursday' AND DATENAME(WEEKDAY, emr.EndDateTime) IN ('Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday')) OR
                (tm.DayOfWeek = 'Friday To Saturday' AND DATENAME(WEEKDAY, emr.EndDateTime) IN ('Friday', 'Saturday'))
            )
        WHERE MONTH(emr.EndDateTime) = @MonthNumber
          AND YEAR(emr.EndDateTime) = @YearNumber
        GROUP BY DATENAME(MONTH, emr.EndDateTime), tm.RateBand
        ORDER BY DATENAME(MONTH, emr.EndDateTime), tm.RateBand;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Get_Monthly_Bill_Details_Summary | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[Get_Monthly_Bill_Details_Summary]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	    RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.HeatChargeMixConsumption

**Schema:** dbo

| @HeatNo | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[HeatChargeMixConsumption]
    @HeatNo = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROC [dbo].[HeatChargeMixConsumption] --1504455--1600123
 @HeatNo int
 As
 BEGIN
    SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    /*----Variable Declaration---*/
    DECLARE @Bin3Name VARCHAR(200);
    DECLARE @Bin4Name VARCHAR(200);
    DECLARE @BinName VARCHAR(200);
    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @GradeID VARCHAR(36);
    DECLARE @userID VARCHAR(36);
    DECLARE @tbl AS table ([ParentID] VARCHAR(36), [RawMaterialName] VARCHAR(500), [MaterialID] VARCHAR(36), [UOMID] VARCHAR(36), [LotNumber] VARCHAR(200), [Price] float, [EntityName] VARCHAR(200), [AttributeName] VARCHAR(200), [Unit] VARCHAR(200), [Material] VARCHAR(200), [MaterialCode] VARCHAR(200));
	DECLARE @tbl1 AS TABLE ([Value] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Name] VARCHAR(500), [Price] FLOAT)
    BEGIN TRY
        /*---Set user ID of XMES--*/
        SET @userID = 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358';

        /*--Get Grade ID for TBD--*/
        SELECT @GradeID = [ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'TBD';

        /*--Set Query to get material ID and quantity--*/
        INSERT INTO @tbl 
		SELECT CMMt.[id], CMMT.[RawMaterialName], [materialid], CMMT.[unitid], MIMT.[LotNumber], MIMT.[Price]/*, [entityids], [attributeids]*/, EMT.[Name] AS [entityName]
			, AMT.[Name] AS [AttributeName], MUMT.[Name] AS [UnitName], MMT.[Name] AS [MaterialName], MMT.[Number]
		FROM [dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Mapping_Mst_Tbl] AS CMMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
		LEFT JOIN [XStudio_configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Entities_Mst_tbl] AS EMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON EMT.[ID] IN (SELECT * FROM STRING_SPLIT(CMMT.[EntityIDs], ','))
		LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Attribute_mst_tbl] AS AMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON AMT.[ID] IN (SELECT * FROM STRING_SPLIT(CMMT.[AttributeIDs],',')) AND EMT.[ID] = AMT.[ParentID]
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] AS MUMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MUMT.[ID] = CMMT.[UnitID]
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[ID] = CMMT.[Materialid]
		LEFT JOIN (  SELECT [Lotnumber], [ParentID], [Price] FROM (
						SELECT [Lotnumber], [ParentID],[Quantity],[UOMID],[CreatedOn], ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ParentID] ORDER BY [createdOn]) AS num, [Price] 
						FROM [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] AS MIMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
						WHERE [isdeleted] = 0 AND [quantity] != 0
					) AS t WHERE [num] = 1) AS MIMT ON MIMT.[ParentID] = MMT.[ID]
		WHERE CMMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND CMMT.[Entityids] IS NOT NULL
		--SELECT(@SQL)
		INSERT INTO @tbl EXEC (@SQL)
	
		SELECT @SQL = 'SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING([Value], 0, CHARINDEX('':'', [Value])), 0) AS FLOAT), [Name], CAST(SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX('':'',[value]) + 1, LEN([Value])) AS FLOAT) FROM (SELECT ' + STRING_AGG(CAST('CONCAT(['+[AttributeName] + '],'':'',(['+[AttributeName]+'] * ('+CAST(ISNULL([Price], 0) AS VARCHAR(MAX))+') * 1000)) AS [' + [RawMaterialName] + ']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+' FROM ' + [EntityName] + ' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [EAFHeatNo] = '+ CAST(@heatNo AS VARCHAR(10))+') AS t UNPIVOT([Value] FOR [Name] IN ('+STRING_AGG(CAST('['+RawMaterialName+']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+')) AS unpvt' FROM @tbl WHERE [EntityName] IN ('SMS_EAF_Per_Heat_chargeMix') GROUP BY [EntityName];

		IF LEN(ISNULL(@SQL,'')) != 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SQL += ' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING([Value], 0, CHARINDEX('':'', [Value])), 0) AS FLOAT), [Name], CAST(SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX('':'',[value]) + 1, LEN([Value])) AS FLOAT) FROM (SELECT '+STRING_AGG(CAST('CONCAT(['+[AttributeName]+'],'':'','+CASE WHEN [AttributeName] = 'NgConsumption' THEN '((['+[AttributeName]+'] * 1.05) / 29.5) * ('+CAST(ISNULL([Price], 0) AS VARCHAR(MAX))+')' ELSE [AttributeName]+' * ('+CAST(ISNULL([Price], 0) AS VARCHAR(MAX))+') * 1000' END +') AS ['+ [RawMaterialName] +']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+' FROM '+ [EntityName] +' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = '+ CAST(@heatNo AS VARCHAR(10))+') AS t UNPIVOT([Value] FOR [Name] IN ('+STRING_AGG(CAST('['+RawMaterialName+']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+')) AS unpvt' 
			FROM @tbl AS t WHERE [EntityName] IN ('EAF_PER_HEAT') 
				AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE t1.[RawMaterialName] = t.[RawMaterialName] AND t1.[EntityName] != t.[EntityName])  
				AND [RawMaterialName] IN (SELECT [RawMaterialName] FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE [EntityName] IN ('EAF_Per_Heat') GROUP BY [RawMaterialName] HAVING COUNT([EntityName]) = 1 )
			GROUP BY [EntityName]
			--EXEC (@SQL)
		END

		IF LEN(ISNULL(@SQL,'')) != 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SQL += ' UNION ALL SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING([Value], 0, CHARINDEX('':'', [Value])), 0) AS FLOAT), [Name], CAST(SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX('':'',[value]) + 1, LEN([Value])) AS FLOAT) FROM (SELECT '+STRING_AGG(CAST('CONCAT(['+[AttributeName] + '],'':'',(['+[AttributeName]+'] * ('+CAST(ISNULL([Price], 0) AS VARCHAR(MAX))+') * 1000)) AS ['+ [RawMaterialName] +']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',') + ' FROM '+[EntityName]+' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatNo] = '+ CAST(@heatNo AS VARCHAR(10))+') AS t UNPIVOT([Value] FOR [Name] IN ('+STRING_AGG(CAST('['+[RawMaterialName]+']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+')) AS unpvt'
			FROM @tbl WHERE [EntityName] IN ('EAF_Manual_entry') 
			GROUP BY [EntityName], [Price]
			--EXEC (@SQL)
		END
		
		INSERT INTO @tbl1 EXEC (@SQL)
		/*--Add Material ID wise quantity--*/
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl]
		([ID], [ParentID], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [Source], [LotNumber], [SublotNumber], [Quantity], [UOMID], [MaterialID], [HeatNo], [GradeID], [DeclareQuantity], [Price])
		SELECT NEWID(),* FROM (
			SELECT DISTINCT [ParentID], @userID AS [Createdby], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [LotNumber], NULL AS [SubLotNumber], [Value] AS [Quantity1], [UOMID], [MaterialID], @HeatNo AS [HeatID], @GradeID AS [GradeID], [Value], t1.[Price]
			 FROM @tbl AS T JOIN @tbl1 AS t1 ON t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[Name]
			 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND t1.[HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND t1.[MaterialID] = T.[MaterialID] AND t1.[ParentID] = t.[ParentID])
		) AS t WHERE t.[Value] > 0;
   
    /*----Update Material ID---*/
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_tbl] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT [ParentID], @userID AS [Createdby], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [LotNumber], NULL AS [SubLotNumber], [Value] AS [Quantity1], [UOMID], [MaterialID], @HeatNo AS [HeatID], @GradeID AS [GradeID], [Value], t1.[Price], t.[RawMaterialName]
			 FROM @tbl AS T JOIN @tbl1 AS t1 ON t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[Name] WHERE [Value] > 0) AS t2 ON t1.[ParentID] = t2.[ParentID] AND t1.[isdeleted] = 0 AND t1.[heatNo] = @HeatNo AND t1.[MaterialID] != t2.[MaterialID] OR t1.[LotNumber] != t2.[LotNumber] OR t1.[Price] != t2.[Price] OR t1.[LotNumber] IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        UPDATE [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl] SET [MaterialID] = t1.[MaterialID], [LotNumber] = t1.[LotNumber], [Price] = t1.[Price] FROM (SELECT DISTINCT [ParentID], @userID AS [Createdby], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [LotNumber], NULL AS [SubLotNumber], [Value] AS [Quantity1], [UOMID], [MaterialID], @HeatNo AS [HeatID], @GradeID AS [GradeID], [Value], t1.[Price], t.[RawMaterialName]
			 FROM @tbl AS T JOIN @tbl1 AS t1 ON t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[Name] WHERE [Value] > 0) AS t1
        WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[ParentID] = t1.[ParentID] AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo 
            AND ([XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[MaterialID] != t1.[MaterialID] OR [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[LotNumber] != t1.[LotNumber] OR [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[Price] != t1.[Price] OR [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[LotNumber] IS NULL);
    END
  
    /*-----Material Inventory Quantity and Price-----*/
    UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = CASE WHEN [Quantity]  < ISNULL(t1.[Value] , 0) THEN 0 ELSE [Quantity] - ISNULL(t1.[Value] , 0) END
        , [AvailableQuantityPrice] = dbo.[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl].[Price] * (CASE WHEN [Quantity]  < ISNULL(t1.[Value] , 0) THEN 0 ELSE [Quantity] - ISNULL(t1.[Value] , 0) END)
        , [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT [ParentID], @userID AS [Createdby], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [LotNumber], NULL AS [SubLotNumber], [Value] AS [Quantity1], [UOMID], [MaterialID], @HeatNo AS [HeatID], @GradeID AS [GradeID], [Value], t1.[Price], t.[RawMaterialName]
			 FROM @tbl AS T JOIN @tbl1 AS t1 ON t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[Name] WHERE [Value] > 0) AS t1 
    WHERE t1.[LotNumber] = [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl].[LotNumber] AND [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl].[ParentID] = 
    t1.[MaterialID]
   
 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
  DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : HeatChargeMixConsumption | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
  DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
  EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[HeatChargeMixConsumption]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
  RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
 END CATCH
End
 

-- HeatChargeMixConsumption 1601214
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ladle_Life_Count_Each_Heat]
(
    @RecordId VARCHAR(36)   -- keep as VARCHAR(36) if your Id column is text/GUID string
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @ActiveLadle VARCHAR(30);
    DECLARE @LadleName   VARCHAR(50);
    BEGIN TRY
        -- Get active ladle for this heat/record
        SELECT TOP (1) 
               @ActiveLadle = [ActiveLadle]
        FROM dbo.LRF_Ladle_No_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK)
        WHERE IsDeleted = 0
          AND Id = @RecordId;

        IF @ActiveLadle IS NULL
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('No ActiveLadle found for RecordId %s (or row is deleted).', 16, 1, @RecordId);
            RETURN;
        END

        -- Build the ladle display name e.g. "Ladle 5"
        SET @LadleName = CONCAT('Ladle ', @ActiveLadle);


        UPDATE Life_Tracking
        SET CurrentLife = CurrentLife + 1
        WHERE Name= @LadleName
          AND IsDeleted = 0;

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('No Life_Tracking row found for "%s" (or row is deleted).', 16, 1, @LadleName);
            RETURN;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Ladle_Life_Count_Each_Heat | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[Ladle_Life_Count_Each_Heat]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	    RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

```sql
CREATE Proc [dbo].[MES_U_Delay_Merge]
 (
    @UserId VARCHAR(36),
    @SystemId VARCHAR(36),
    @RecordIds VARCHAR(max),
    @Status VARCHAR(36),
    @DataCollection NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
as
Begin
Declare  @MinStartTime datetime,@MaxEndTime datetime,@ID Varchar(36),@HeatCount int ,@HeatNo varchar(100) ,@ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max)
SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
 
--	set @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'[\','[{') set @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'\,\','},{') set @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'\','}')
-- -------------------------------------------For Fetch value from Work flow Edit----------------------------
--DECLARE @ParsedData TABLE ([Key] NVARCHAR(100), [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX));
--	IF ISJSON(@DataCollection) = 1
--		BEGIN
--		    INSERT INTO @ParsedData ([Key], [Value]) SELECT [Key], [Value] FROM OPENJSON(@DataCollection) WITH ( [Key] NVARCHAR(200) '$.Key', [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.Value' );
--			SELECT  @DelaySubtypeid =MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'DelaySubtypeid'   THEN  [Value] END)  FROM @ParsedData;
--		END
	
	  
SELECT  @HeatCount = COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo) ,@HeatNo=Max(HeatNo) ,@MinStartTime=min(DelayStartTime),@MaxEndTime=Max(delayendtime) FROM ShiftDelayEntry     WHERE ID IN ( SELECT value   FROM STRING_SPLIT(@RecordIds, ','));
 select @HeatCount
IF @HeatCount = 1
    BEGIN
	--select @ERROR_MSG='True'
	--RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	 update ShiftDelayEntry set IsDeleted=1 where id   in (SELECT value   FROM STRING_SPLIT(@RecordIds, ','));

	INSERT INTO ShiftDelayEntry ( delaystarttime, DelayEndTime,HeatNo,AreaName,ReportDate,SMSReportDate)
	VALUES (  @MinStartTime, @MaxEndTime,@HeatNo,'SMS',cast(@MinStartTime as date),cast(@MinStartTime as date));

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	 SELECT   @ERROR_MSG  =    'In your Selction total ' + CAST(@HeatCount AS VARCHAR(10)) +' Heat number';
	 RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END


END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Per_Heat_LadleNo_Conformation_usp] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@HeatNo int,
	@LadleNo varchar(500),
	@LRFConformed bit,
	@CCMConformed varchar(10),
	@TundishNo varchar(500) = Null
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		-- Insert statements for procedure here
		IF(@LRFConformed=1)
		BEGIN
		DECLARE @STARTTIME DATETIME
		SELECT @STARTTIME=STARTTIME FROM LRF_PER_HEAT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HEATID=@HeatNo ;
		   UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Per_Heat_LadleNo] SET LadleNoAtLRF=1,LadleNoAtLRFDatetime= @STARTTIME WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo AND LadleNo=@LadleNo;
		END

		IF(@CCMConformed='1' or @CCMConformed ='True')
		BEGIN
		
		SELECT @STARTTIME=STARTTIME FROM CCM_PER_HEAT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE HEATID=@HeatNo;
		   UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Per_Heat_LadleNo] SET LadleNoAtLRF=1 ,LadleNoAtCCMDatetime = @STARTTIME WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo AND LadleNo=@LadleNo;
		   UPDATE XMES_ActiveLife_Element_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Active', Source='T-SQL' ,LastUsedBatch=@HeatNo WHERE ElementNameID=@TundishNo AND IsDeleted=0;
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Per_Heat_LadleNo_Conformation_usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[Per_Heat_LadleNo_Conformation_usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

_No parameters_

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Quality_Spectro_IsLatestSample_Update_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 2025-12-27
-- Description:	Quality Spectro IsLatestSample Update
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Quality_Spectro_IsLatestSample_Update_Usp]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	UPDATE Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data SET IsLatestSample=0 WHERE CAST(ReceivedTime AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(GETDATE()-1 AS DATE) AND CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND IsLatestSample=1;

	UPDATE Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data Set IsLatestSample=1 WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM (SELECT ID, SampleType, HeatNo, ReportedTime, ReceivedTime, XMLCreatedon, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HeatNo ORDER BY ReceivedTime DESC) AS rn FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ISDeleted = 0 AND SampleType NOT IN ('PRODUCT') and CAST(ReceivedTime AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(GETDATE()-1 AS DATE) AND CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) ) t WHERE rn = 1)
	
	UPDATE Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data SET RRStatus='Entered', SAPStatus='Entered' WHERE IsLatestSample=1 AND RRStatus IS NULL

	UPDATE Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data SET InspOper=T2.Operation from 
	(Select (Case When SampleType in ('TS','TD') Then 'T' when SampleType like 'L%' Then 'L' when SampleType like 'F%' Then 'F' END) TYPE,ID from Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data as tt WITH(NOLOCK) ) AS T1
	JOIN (Select Operation,SampleType from MES_Quality_Configurator) AS T2 ON T1.type=T2.SampleType where Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data.ID=T1.ID AND InspOper IS NULL
END
```

## dbo.SAP_Posting_Data_ByHeat_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SAP_Posting_Data_ByHeat_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-30 13:58:22  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:07:36  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @HeatNo | nvarchar(50) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SAP_Posting_Data_ByHeat_Usp]
    @HeatNo = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/**********************************************************************************************
 Author:         Sagar Rana
 Create Date:    30-Oct-2025
 Modified Date:  30-Oct-2025
 Description:    To fetch Production and Consumption details by HeatNo and insert into SAP_Posting_Tbl
**********************************************************************************************/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SAP_Posting_Data_ByHeat_Usp]
(
    @HeatNo NVARCHAR(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        -- ===========================================
        -- 🔹 Validate: Check if HeatNo exists in WorkOrder Master
        -- ===========================================
        IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl W
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(W.HeatNo, ',') AS HS
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(HS.[value])) = @HeatNo
        )
        BEGIN
            PRINT 'No matching HeatNo found in WorkOrder Master. Skipping SAP_Posting_Tbl insertion.';
            RETURN;  -- Exit without inserting
        END

        -- ===========================================
        -- 🔹 Combine Production & Consumption Data
        -- ===========================================
        ;WITH PostingData AS
        (
            -- 🔹 Consumption Records
            SELECT 
                'Consumption' AS PostingType,
                W.WorkOrderNumber AS WorkOrderNo,
                C.HeatNo,
                'SMS' AS PlantCode,
                'ScrapYard' AS StorageLocation,
                C.MaterialID AS MaterialCode,
                MA.Name AS MaterialName,
                C.LotNumber AS BatchNo,
                C.Quantity,
                U.Name AS UOM,
                '261' AS MovementType,  -- Standard SAP for Consumption
                C.CreatedOn
            FROM XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl C
            INNER JOIN XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl W
                ON C.HeatNo IN (
                    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
                    FROM STRING_SPLIT(W.HeatNo, ',')
                )
               AND C.HeatNo = @HeatNo
            LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MA
                ON MA.ID = C.MaterialID AND MA.IsDeleted = 0
            LEFT JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl U
                ON U.ID = C.UOMID

            UNION ALL

            -- 🔹 Production Records
            SELECT 
                'Production' AS PostingType,
                W.WorkOrderNumber AS WorkOrderNo,
                P.HeatNo,
                'SMS' AS PlantCode,
                'BilletYard' AS StorageLocation,
                P.MaterialID AS MaterialCode,
                MA.Name AS MaterialName,
                P.SublotNumber AS BatchNo,
                P.Quantity,
                U.Name AS UOM,
                '101' AS MovementType,  -- Standard SAP for Production
                P.CreatedOn
            FROM XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl P
            INNER JOIN XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl W
                ON P.HeatNo IN (
                    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
                    FROM STRING_SPLIT(W.HeatNo, ',')
                )
               AND P.HeatNo = @HeatNo
            LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MA
                ON MA.ID = P.MaterialID AND MA.IsDeleted = 0
            LEFT JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl U
                ON U.ID = P.UOMID
			where Ma.name not like 'Billet%'

			 UNION ALL

            -- 🔹 Production Records
             SELECT 
                'Production' AS PostingType,
                W.WorkOrderNumber AS WorkOrderNo,
                P.HeatID,
                'SMS' AS PlantCode,
                'BilletYard' AS StorageLocation,
               concat('Billet_',p.CrossSection,'X',p.CrossSection) AS MaterialCode,
               concat('Billet_',p.CrossSection,'X',p.CrossSection) AS MaterialName,
                '' AS BatchNo,
                p.TotalProduction,
               'Ton' AS UOM,
                '101' AS MovementType,  -- Standard SAP for Production
                P.CreatedOn
            FROM CCM_Per_Heat P
            INNER JOIN XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl W
                ON P.Heatid IN (
                    SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
                    FROM STRING_SPLIT(W.HeatNo, ',')
                )
               AND P.Heatid = @HeatNo
        )

		
		        -- ===========================================
        -- 🔹 Insert into SAP_Posting_Tbl (if not duplicate)
        -- ===========================================
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[SAP_Posting_Tbl]
        (
            WorkOrderNo,
            HeatNo,
            PlantCode,
            StorageLocation,
            MaterialCode,
            BatchNo,
            Quantity,
            UOM,
            MovementType,
            PostingType,
            CreatedOn,
            PostingDate,
            SAP_Status
        )
        SELECT
            WorkOrderNo,
            HeatNo,
            PlantCode,
            StorageLocation,
            MaterialName as MaterialCode,
            BatchNo,
            Quantity,
            UOM,
            MovementType,
            PostingType,
            CreatedOn,
            CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AS PostingDate,
            'Pending' AS SAP_Status
        FROM PostingData
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM [dbo].[SAP_Posting_Tbl] S
            WHERE S.WorkOrderNo = PostingData.WorkOrderNo
              AND S.HeatNo = PostingData.HeatNo
              AND S.MaterialCode = PostingData.MaterialName
              AND S.PostingType = PostingData.PostingType
        );

    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE 
            @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX),
            @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(1000);

        SET @ERROR_MSG = 'SP: SAP_Posting_Data_ByHeat_Usp | Message: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE() 
                         + ' | Line: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());
        SET @ERROR_LINE = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());

        -- 🔹 Log error into central error log table
        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
             @Type = 'SQL-Error',
             @Action = '[dbo].[SAP_Posting_Data_ByHeat_Usp]',
             @Message = @ERROR_MSG,
             @StackTrace = @ERROR_LINE,
             @UserID = '',
             @HostAddress = '',
             @Info = '',
             @Source = 'T-SQL';

        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG, 16, 1);
    END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@StartTime DateTime=null,
	@EndTime  DateTime=null,
	@Status varchar(max)=null,
	@HeatNo int=null
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	Declare @DelayTypeID varchar(36),@AreaName varchar(36)='SMS', @DelaySubTypeID varchar(36),@DelayID Varchar(36)=NEWID(),@Reason Varchar(max),@Agency varchar(36)
	BEGIN TRY
		if(@Status='Bucket Charging')
		begin 
			set @DelaySubTypeID='8ECB8C08-B7A0-45AB-9BB3-4439C92BC684'
			set @DelayTypeID= '6822012D-AEBA-4E48-9A73-80DC22408A85'
			set @Reason=Null
			set @Agency ='DF8F06BE-B8AD-476D-9341-5BF56BAD36A5'
		end
		if(@Status='Setup Delay')
		begin 
	
			set @DelaySubTypeID='503A11D7-15ED-414E-8FD4-E99839105DEF'
			set @DelayTypeID= '6822012D-AEBA-4E48-9A73-80DC22408A85'
			set @Reason=Null
			set @Agency ='DF8F06BE-B8AD-476D-9341-5BF56BAD36A5'
		end
		if(@Status='Power On Delay')
		begin 
			set @DelaySubTypeID='269EEDCB-9E88-42DC-B61A-1E7233A7D00D'
			set @DelayTypeID= '36605E72-6128-44E0-B35D-CFEAE721A0AE'
			set @Reason = 'More power on time Due to low grade metallics'
			set @Agency ='DF8F06BE-B8AD-476D-9341-5BF56BAD36A5'
		end
		if(@Status='Tapping Delay')
		begin
	
			set @DelaySubTypeID= '6A6A9316-54B3-4009-873E-68C6E9903FA0';
			set @DelayTypeID= 'B48732B3-874A-4F90-BE8D-5CBA2DC5FD04'
			set @Reason=Null
			set @Agency ='DF8F06BE-B8AD-476D-9341-5BF56BAD36A5'
		end
		if(@Status='Power OFF Delay')
		begin 
			set @DelaySubTypeID='0C6D5D0B-1200-4C0F-83F6-1319E69D82B0'
			set @DelayTypeID= 'D95E61A2-4F72-44E6-A786-C3EEA9393B4F'
			set @Reason=Null
		end
		--if(@Status='EBT Filling')
		--begin 
		--	set @DelaySubTypeID='503A11D7-15ED-414E-8FD4-E99839105DEF'
		--	set @DelayTypeID= '6822012D-AEBA-4E48-9A73-80DC22408A85'
		--	set @Reason=Null
		--end

		if not exists (Select ID from ShiftDelayEntry WITH(NOLOCK) where HeatNo=@HeatNo and DelayEndTime=@EndTime and DelayStarttime=@StartTime AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND DelayType=@DelayTypeID AND DelaySubtypeid=@DelaySubTypeID)
		Begin

	
			Insert Into ShiftDelayEntry (ID,DelayStartTime,DelayEndTime,DelayType,DelaySubTypeid,HeatNo,AreaName,DelayReason,DelayAgency,Source) Values(@DelayID,@StartTime,@EndTime,@DelayTypeID,@DelaySubTypeID,@HeatNo,@AreaName,@Reason,@Agency,'T-SQL')
	
			INSERT INTO Agency_Wise_Delay (ParentID, Agency)
			SELECT @DelayID, ID FROM DelayAgency_Master With(Nolock)
			WHERE AreaName = 'SMS' AND IsDeleted=0	 
		End
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.SMS_AgencyWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SMS_AgencyWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-09-29 11:10:53  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:09:39  
**Parameter Count:** 3  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @Duration | decimal(18,2) | NO |  |
| @Agency | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SMS_AgencyWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp]
    @ID = '',
    @Duration = 0,
    @Agency = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SMS_AgencyWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp]
	@ID varchar(36),
	@Duration Decimal(18,2),
	@Agency varchar(36)

AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @AllowedDelay Decimal(18,2);
    DECLARE @ExistingTotal Decimal(18,2);
    BEGIN TRY
        -- Get the allowed delay from ShiftDelayEntry
        SELECT @AllowedDelay = DelayInMinutes
        FROM ShiftDelayEntry With(NoLock)
        WHERE ID = @ID AND IsDeleted=0;

        -- Get the current total duration from Agency_Wise_Delay for the given ParentID
        SELECT @ExistingTotal = ISNULL(SUM(Duration), 0)
        FROM Agency_Wise_Delay With(NoLock)
        WHERE ParentID = @ID AND IsDeleted=0 And Agency!=@Agency;

        -- Validate
        IF (@ExistingTotal + @Duration) > @AllowedDelay
        BEGIN
           Select Concat('Entered Duration ',(@ExistingTotal + @Duration),' Is More Then Actual Duration ',@AllowedDelay);
       
        END
    END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SMS_AgencyWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SMS_AgencyWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
   
END
```

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SMS_Data_list_View];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SMS_Data_list_View]
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @SRNo INT;
	DECLARE @subSrNo INT = 0; 
	DECLARE @SPName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @EXEC NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		--; WITH cte AS (
		--		SELECT 1 AS sr, '@transactionId' AS [name], @transactionid AS [value] )
		/*,*/;WITH cte1 AS (
			SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPname], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION] 
			FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
		)
		SELECT @SPName = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @EXEC = c.[SPname] /*+ ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ')*/ FROM cte1 AS c /*JOIN cte ON c.[ORDINAL_POSITION] = cte.[sr] GROUP BY c.[SPname]*/

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT NULL AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, 'SMS Data List', 'Entered', @Subsrno;

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT NULL AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, 'SMS Data List', 'Update no of heat tap, no of heat cast, today prod, avgpow, avgtaptotaptime, avgchargemixwt, avgtappingwt start', @Subsrno;

		UPDATE sms_data_dashboard
		SET
			NoofHeatTap = ISNULL(EAFSummary.NoOfHeatTap, 0),
			NoofHeatCast = ISNULL(CCMSummary.NoOfHeatCast, 0),
			TodayProduction = ISNULL(CCMPERDAY.TotalProduction, 0),
			AveragePower = ISNULL(CAST(EAFSummary.AvgPower AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0),
			AverageTaptoTapTime = 
				ISNULL(RIGHT('0' + CAST(CASE 
					WHEN ROUND((EAFSummary.AvgTapToTapTime - FLOOR(EAFSummary.AvgTapToTapTime)) * 60, 0) = 60 
						THEN FLOOR(EAFSummary.AvgTapToTapTime) + 1 
					ELSE FLOOR(EAFSummary.AvgTapToTapTime) 
				END AS VARCHAR), 2) + ':' +
				RIGHT('0' + CAST(CASE 
					WHEN ROUND((EAFSummary.AvgTapToTapTime - FLOOR(EAFSummary.AvgTapToTapTime)) * 60, 0) = 60 
						THEN 0 
					ELSE ROUND((EAFSummary.AvgTapToTapTime - FLOOR(EAFSummary.AvgTapToTapTime)) * 60, 0) 
				END AS VARCHAR), 2), '00:00'),
			AverageChargeMixWeight = ISNULL(CAST(EAFSummary.AvgChargeMix AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0),
			AverageTappingWeight = ISNULL(CAST(LRFSummary.TapWeight AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0)
		FROM (
			SELECT 
				COUNT(HeatID) AS NoOfHeatTap,
				AVG(PowerMWH) * 100 AS AvgPower,
				AVG(HeattimeTotalSeconds) AS AvgTapToTapTime,  -- decimal minutes
				AVG(TotalChargeWeightMT) AS AvgChargeMix
			FROM EAF_PER_HEAT WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE HeatReportDate = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND IsDeleted = 0
		) AS EAFSummary LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT 
				COUNT(HeatID) AS NoOfHeatCast
			FROM CCM_PER_HEAT WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE HeatReportDate = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
			AND IsDeleted = 0
		) AS CCMSummary ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT 
				AVG(LiquidMetalWeight) AS TapWeight
			FROM LRF_PER_HEAT WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE HeatReportDate = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
			AND IsDeleted = 0
		) AS LRFSummary ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT 
				top 1 TotalProduction AS TotalProduction
			FROM CCM_Summary_Day WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND [ReportDate] = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
			order by CreatedOn desc
		) AS CCMPERDAY ON 1 = 1;

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT NULL AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, 'SMS Data List', 'Update no of heat tap, no of heat cast, today prod, avgpow, avgtaptotaptime, avgchargemixwt, avgtappingwt End', @Subsrno;

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, 'SMS Data List', 'Completed', @Subsrno 
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SMS_Data_list_View | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SMS_Data_list_View]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
	
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SMS_DelayRemainingDuration_U_Usp]
	@MSTDelayID VARCHAR(36)=null,
	@AgencyID VARCHAR(36)=null

AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		IF(@MSTDelayID is not Null Or @MSTDelayID='')
		Begin
			UPDATE a
			SET a.RemainingDuration = 
				CASE 
					WHEN a.DelayInMinutes - ISNULL(e.TotalUsedDuration, 0) < 0 THEN 0
					ELSE a.DelayInMinutes - ISNULL(e.TotalUsedDuration, 0)
				END
			FROM ShiftDelayEntry a
			OUTER APPLY (
				SELECT SUM(Duration) AS TotalUsedDuration
				FROM Agency_Wise_Delay WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE ParentID = a.ID AND ParentID=@MSTDelayID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			) e WHERE ID=@MSTDelayID;
		End

		IF(@AgencyID is not Null Or @AgencyID='')
		Begin
			UPDATE a
			SET a.RemainingDuration = 
				CASE 
					WHEN a.Duration - ISNULL(e.TotalUsedDuration, 0) < 0 THEN 0
					ELSE a.Duration - ISNULL(e.TotalUsedDuration, 0)
				END
			FROM Agency_Wise_Delay a
			OUTER APPLY (
				SELECT SUM(Duration) AS TotalUsedDuration
				FROM Equipment_Wise_Delay WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE ParentID = a.ID and ParentID=@AgencyID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			) e WHERE ID=@AgencyID;
		End
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SMS_DelayRemainingDuration_U_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SMS_DelayRemainingDuration_U_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
End
```

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SMS_Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-08-30 15:11:17  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-10 17:13:06  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SMS_Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount_USP];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SMS_Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount_USP]
AS
BEGIN
    ---------------------------------------------------------
    -- Required SET options (company standard)
    ---------------------------------------------------------
    SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        ---------------------------------------------------------
        -- Drop temp table if exists
        ---------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BillSummary') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #BillSummary;

        ---------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 1: Build monthly summary (STABLE BUSINESS KEY)
        -- Key = FeederName + Year + MonthNumber
        ---------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT 
            d.FeederName,
            d.[Year],
            d.MonthNumber,
            DATENAME(MONTH, DATEFROMPARTS(d.[Year], d.MonthNumber, 1))
                + ' - ' + CAST(d.[Year] AS VARCHAR(4)) AS [Month],
            SUM(d.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,
            SUM(d.Charge) AS TotalCharge
        INTO #BillSummary
        FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details d WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE d.IsDeleted = 0
          AND d.FeederName IN ('Feeder132KVIC1','Feeder132KVIC2')
        GROUP BY
            d.FeederName,
            d.[Year],
            d.MonthNumber;

        ---------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 2: UPDATE existing rows
        ---------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE a
        SET
            a.TotalEngeryConsumptionCalculate = b.TotalConsumption,
            a.TotalEnergyCharge = b.TotalCharge,
            a.[Month] = b.[Month],
            a.ModifiedOn = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount a
        JOIN #BillSummary b
            ON a.FeederName = b.FeederName
           AND a.[Year] = b.[Year]
           AND a.MonthNumber = b.MonthNumber
        WHERE a.IsDeleted = 0;

        ---------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 3: INSERT missing rows
        ---------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount
        (
            FeederName,
            [Year],
            [Month],
            MonthNumber,
            TotalEngeryConsumptionCalculate,
            TotalEnergyCharge
        )
        SELECT
            b.FeederName,
            b.[Year],
            b.[Month],
            b.MonthNumber,
            b.TotalConsumption,
            b.TotalCharge
        FROM #BillSummary b
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount a WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE a.FeederName = b.FeederName
              AND a.[Year] = b.[Year]
              AND a.MonthNumber = b.MonthNumber
              AND a.IsDeleted = 0
        );

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        ---------------------------------------------------------
        -- Error handling (exact format requested)
        ---------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =
            'SP : SMS_Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount_USP | Messge : '
            + ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());

        DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) =
            CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());

        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP]
            @Type        = 'SQL-Error',
            @Action      = '[dbo].[SMS_Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount_USP]',
            @Message     = @ERROR_MSG,
            @StackTrace  = @ERROR_LINE,
            @UserID      = '',
            @HostAddress = '',
            @Info        = '',
            @Source      = 'T-SQL';

        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG, 16, 1);
    END CATCH
END;
```

| @Equipment | nvarchar(100) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
    @ID = '',
    @Duration = 0,
    @Equipment = '';
```

### Full Definition
