```sql
--<query.EXEC XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.SMS_AgencyWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp '<RECORD.hdn_ParentID_11114390>','<RECORD.num_Duration>','<RECORD.cmb_Agency>'>

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SMS_EquipmentWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp]
    @ID varchar(36),
	@Duration Decimal(18,2),
    @Equipment NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @AllowedDuration Decimal(18,2);
    DECLARE @ExistingTotal Decimal(18,2);
    BEGIN TRY
        -- Get the allowed duration from Agency_Wise_Delay
        SELECT @AllowedDuration = Duration
        FROM Agency_Wise_Delay With(NoLock)
        WHERE ID = @ID AND IsDeleted=0;

        -- Get the current total duration from Equipment_Wise_Delay for the given ParentID
        SELECT @ExistingTotal = ISNULL(SUM(Duration), 0)
        FROM Equipment_Wise_Delay With(NoLock)
        WHERE ParentID = @ID AND IsDeleted=0 and EquipmentName!=@Equipment;

        -- Validate
        IF (@ExistingTotal + @Duration) > @AllowedDuration
        BEGIN
             Select 'Entered Duration Is More Then Actual Duration';
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
	    DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SMS_EquipmentWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SMS_EquipmentWiseDelayDuration_Validation_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	    RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SMS_Ladle_Life_Tracking_Validation]
(
	@LadleID	VARCHAR(200),
	@HeatID			VARCHAR(200)
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
BEGIN TRY

    SET NOCOUNT ON;	  
	Declare @ActiveLadleName VARCHAR(200)
	-- Checking for already Ladle and Heat is there in Life Tracking Transaction for given Life and Heat
	SELECT @ActiveLadleName=LE.Name FROM [dbo].[XMES_Life_Element_Mst_Tbl] LE WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID=@LadleID

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Life_Tracking_Transaction_tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [LifeType] = @ActiveLadleName AND [HeatID] = @HeatID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
	BEGIN
		-- If ALready available then give Error Message
		SELECT ''+@ActiveLadleName+' Ladle Already use in '+@HeatID+' HeatID';
	END 
	

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
		
	DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SMS_Ladle_Life_Tracking_Validation | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	
	EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[SMS_Ladle_Life_Tracking_Validation]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

END CATCH
END;
```

## dbo.SMS_Reset_Life_Tracking_Status

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SMS_Reset_Life_Tracking_Status  
**Created On:** 2025-08-11 08:34:01  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-10 13:28:47  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @RecordID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SMS_Reset_Life_Tracking_Status]
    @RecordID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SMS_Reset_Life_Tracking_Status]
(
	@RecordID VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
BEGIN TRY

    SET NOCOUNT ON;	  
	
	
	-- Declare variable
	DECLARE @AlertPercentage		INT;
	DECLARE @Life					VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @LifeType				VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @HeatID					VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @CurrentLife			INT;
	DECLARE @ConsumePercentage		DECIMAL(18,2);



	SELECT @AlertPercentage = [AlertPercentage],@Life = [elementnameid] , @HeatID = LastUsedBatch FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XMES_Element_Life_Counter_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

	SELECT @LifeType = LET.Name FROM [dbo].[XMES_Life_Element_Mst_Tbl] LE WITH(NOLOCK)
	JOIN [dbo].[XMES_Element_Life_Counter_Trn_Tbl] LEC WITH(NOLOCK) ON LE.ID=LEC.ElementNameID
	JOIN [dbo].[XMES_Life_Element_Type_Mst_Tbl] LET WITH(NOLOCK) ON LE.ParentID=LET.ID AND LET.IsDeleted=0
	WHERE LE.ID=@Life

	INSERT INTO [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Life_Tracking_Transaction_tbl]([ID],[CurrentLife],[AlertPercentage],[ConsumePercentage],[Life],[LifeType],[EntryDateTime],[Remarks],HeatID)
	SELECT NEWID(),@CurrentLife,@AlertPercentage,@ConsumePercentage,@Life,@LifeType,GETDATE(),'Last Heat',@HeatID;


	--Update Current Life,ConsumedLifePercentage in Life Tracking Status Table
	UPDATE LTS SET [CurrentLife] = 0,[ConsumeLifepercentage] = 0.0,ModifiedOn = GETDATE() FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XMES_Element_Life_Counter_Trn_Tbl] LTS WHERE [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
	

	-- Insert in Life Tracking Transaction Table for transaction
	INSERT INTO [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Life_Tracking_Transaction_tbl]([ID],[CurrentLife],[AlertPercentage],[ConsumePercentage],[Life],[LifeType],[EntryDateTime],[Remarks],HeatID)
	SELECT NEWID(),0,@AlertPercentage,0.0,@Life,@LifeType,GETDATE(),'Life Reset',@HeatID;

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
		
	DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SMS_Reset_Life_Tracking_Status | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	
	EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[SMS_Reset_Life_Tracking_Status]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

END CATCH
END;
```

**Modified On:** 2025-12-09 15:38:49  
**Parameter Count:** 0

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[sp_All_DB_Differential_Backup];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
--/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_All_DB_Backup]    Script Date: 09-05-2023 12:51:40 ******/
--SET ANSI_NULLS ON
--GO
--SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
--GO

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_All_DB_Differential_Backup]
as
BEGIN

	DECLARE @name NVARCHAR(MAX),@fileName NVARCHAR(MAX)

	declare @Date varchar(20) =  replace(cast(getdate() as date),'-','_')--+'_'+datename(HOUR,getdate())

	declare @directory nvarchar(2000) = N'F:\Database Backup\Differential and Transaction Backup'
	
	declare @path nvarchar(2000)
	BEGIN TRY
		EXECUTE master.dbo.xp_create_subdir @directory
 
		DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR READ_ONLY FOR  
		SELECT name 
		FROM master.sys.databases 
		WHERE name in ('XStudio_Configuration','XStudio_Configuration_XBatch','XStudio_Configuration_Historian','XStudio_Configuration_Helpdesk','XStudio_Helpdesk','XStudio_Historian','XStudio_XBatch','XStudio_XBatch_Audit','XStudio_Helpdesk_Audit')
		AND state = 0 
		AND is_in_standby = 0

		OPEN db_cursor   
		FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @name   
 
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
		BEGIN   
		
			set @path = @directory + '\'+@name

			EXECUTE master.dbo.xp_create_subdir @path

			SET @fileName = @path + '\' + @name + '_Diff_' + @Date+'.BAK'  

			BACKUP DATABASE @name TO  DISK = @fileName with DIFFERENTIAL;
 
			FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @name   
		END   
 
		CLOSE db_cursor   
		DEALLOCATE db_cursor
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL','db_cursor') >= -1
		BEGIN 
			CLOSE db_cursor;
			DEALLOCATE db_cursor;
		END
```

```sql
--/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_All_DB_Backup]    Script Date: 09-05-2023 12:51:40 ******/
--SET ANSI_NULLS ON
--GO
--SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
--GO

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_All_DB_Full_Backup]
as
BEGIN

	dbcc traceon (3226)

	DECLARE @name NVARCHAR(MAX),
	        @fileName NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@@message varchar(255)

	DECLARE @DateTime VARCHAR(20) = 
    REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), GETDATE(), 120), '-', '_'), ':', '_')

	declare @Date varchar(20) = REPLACE(@DateTime, ' ', '_')

	declare @directory nvarchar(2000) = N'D:\Database Backup\Full Backup\'+@Date+''

	declare @path nvarchar(2000)
	BEGIN TRY
		EXECUTE master.dbo.xp_create_subdir @directory
 
		DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR READ_ONLY FOR  
		SELECT name 
		FROM master.sys.databases 
		WHERE name in ('XStudio_Configuration','XStudio_Configuration_XBatch','XStudio_Configuration_Historian','XStudio_Configuration_PIP','XStudio_PIP','XStudio_Historian','XStudio_XBatch','master','model','msdb','XStudio_CPIMS','XStudio_Configuration_CPIMS')
		AND state = 0 
		AND is_in_standby = 0

		OPEN db_cursor   
		FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @name   
 
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
		BEGIN   
		
			begin try

				set @path = @directory 

				SET @fileName = @path + '\' + @name + '_'+@Date+'.BAK'  

				print(@filename)

				BACKUP DATABASE @name TO DISK = @fileName WITH STATS=20, COMPRESSION
		
			end try

			begin catch
			
				set @@message = @name +  ' Database Backup Failed Because of ' + ERROR_MESSAGE()

				EXEC xp_logevent 60000, @@MESSAGE, informational;

			end catch

			FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @name  
		END   
 
		CLOSE db_cursor   
		DEALLOCATE db_cursor
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL','db_cursor') >= -1
		BEGIN 
			CLOSE db_cursor;
			DEALLOCATE db_cursor;
		END
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : sp_All_DB_Full_Backup | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[sp_All_DB_Full_Backup]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.sp_All_Historian_DB_Full_Backup

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** sp_All_Historian_DB_Full_Backup  
**Created On:** 2025-12-03 11:03:58  
**Modified On:** 2025-12-03 11:36:52  
**Parameter Count:** 5  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Mode | varchar(10) | NO |  |
| @RunDate | date | NO |  |
| @BackupRootPath | nvarchar(2000) | NO |  |
| @LookbackDays | int | NO |  |
| @ForceAll | bit | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[sp_All_Historian_DB_Full_Backup]
    @Mode = '',
    @RunDate = '2026-05-04',
    @BackupRootPath = '',
    @LookbackDays = 0,
    @ForceAll = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.sp_All_Historian_DB_Full_Backup
    @Mode           VARCHAR(10) = 'DAILY',
    @RunDate        DATE = NULL,
    @BackupRootPath NVARCHAR(2000) = N'F:\Database Backup\Historian Full Backup\',
    @LookbackDays   INT = 30,
    @ForceAll       BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DBCC TRACEON(3226);

    DECLARE @targetDate DATE,
            @pattern NVARCHAR(300),
            @name NVARCHAR(255),
            @fileName NVARCHAR(2000),
            @Message VARCHAR(1000),
            @logMsg NVARCHAR(2000),
            @dbDate DATE,
            @modeUp VARCHAR(10),
            @yy CHAR(2),
            @mm CHAR(2),
            @dd CHAR(2),
            @directory NVARCHAR(2000),
            @path NVARCHAR(2000);

    BEGIN TRY
        -- Normalize backup root path (ensure trailing slash)
        SET @directory = RTRIM(@BackupRootPath);
        IF RIGHT(@directory,1) <> '\' 
            SET @directory = @directory + '\';

        SET @path = @directory;

        -------------------------------------------------------
        -- DO NOT CREATE ANY DATE FOLDER (as per your request)
        -------------------------------------------------------
        EXEC master.dbo.xp_create_subdir @directory;   -- Only root folder

        -------------------------------------------------------
        -- Mode handling (DAILY / ALL)
        -------------------------------------------------------
        SET @modeUp = UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@Mode,''))));

        IF @modeUp = 'DAILY'
        BEGIN
            IF @RunDate IS NULL
                SET @targetDate = DATEADD(DAY,-1,CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));
            ELSE
                SET @targetDate = @RunDate;

            SET @yy = RIGHT('0' + CAST((DATEPART(YEAR,@targetDate)%100) AS VARCHAR(2)),2);
            SET @mm = RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(MONTH,@targetDate) AS VARCHAR(2)),2);
            SET @dd = RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(DAY,@targetDate) AS VARCHAR(2)),2);

            SET @pattern = CONCAT('XHS_History_',@yy,@mm,@dd,@dd);
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SET @pattern = 'XHS_History_%';
        END

        -------------------------------------------------------
        -- Cursor to fetch DB list
        -------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE db_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT name
        FROM master.sys.databases
        WHERE name LIKE @pattern
          AND state = 0
          AND is_in_standby = 0
        ORDER BY name DESC;

        OPEN db_cursor;
        FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @name;

        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            -- Parse date from DB name
            SET @dbDate = NULL;

            DECLARE @suffix VARCHAR(20) = SUBSTRING(@name, LEN('XHS_History_')+1, 8);

            IF LEN(@suffix) >= 6
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @yy2 CHAR(2) = SUBSTRING(@suffix,1,2),
                        @mm2 CHAR(2) = SUBSTRING(@suffix,3,2),
                        @dd2 CHAR(2) = SUBSTRING(@suffix,5,2),
                        @yearInt INT;

                BEGIN TRY SET @yearInt = CAST(@yy2 AS INT); END TRY BEGIN CATCH SET @yearInt=NULL END CATCH;
                IF @yearInt IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    IF @yearInt <= 50 SET @yearInt = 2000 + @yearInt ELSE SET @yearInt = 1900 + @yearInt;
                    BEGIN TRY SET @dbDate = CONVERT(DATE, CONCAT(@yearInt,'-',@mm2,'-',@dd2)); END TRY BEGIN CATCH SET @dbDate=NULL END CATCH;
                END
            END

            -- Skip logic (same as before)
            DECLARE @tryBackup BIT = 1;

            IF @modeUp='DAILY' AND @name<>@pattern SET @tryBackup=0;

            IF @tryBackup=1 AND @ForceAll=0 AND @LookbackDays>0 AND @modeUp<>'DAILY'
            BEGIN
                IF @dbDate IS NULL SET @tryBackup=0;
                ELSE IF @dbDate < DATEADD(DAY,-@LookbackDays,CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
                    SET @tryBackup=0;
            END

            IF @tryBackup=1 AND @dbDate IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS(
                    SELECT 1 FROM dbo.HistorianBackupLog
                    WHERE DatabaseName=@name AND BackupDate=@dbDate AND Success=1
                )
                    SET @tryBackup=0;
            END

            -- Backup
            IF @tryBackup=1
            BEGIN
                BEGIN TRY
                    SET @fileName = CONCAT(@path, @name, '.BAK');

                    PRINT CONCAT('Backing up: ',@name,' -> ',@fileName);
                    BACKUP DATABASE @name TO DISK=@fileName WITH STATS=20, COMPRESSION;

                    INSERT INTO dbo.HistorianBackupLog(DatabaseName,BackupRunDate,BackupPath,Success,Notes)
                    VALUES(@name,GETDATE(),@fileName,1,'Backup OK');

                END TRY
                BEGIN CATCH
                    SET @Message = ERROR_MESSAGE();
                    SET @logMsg = CONCAT('Backup failed for ',@name,' : ',ISNULL(@Message,''));

                    PRINT @logMsg;

                    INSERT INTO dbo.HistorianBackupLog(DatabaseName,BackupRunDate,BackupPath,Success,Notes)
                    VALUES(@name,GETDATE(),@path,0,@logMsg);

                    EXEC xp_logevent 60000, @logMsg, informational;
                END CATCH
            END
            ELSE
                PRINT CONCAT('Skipping: ',@name);

            FETCH NEXT FROM db_cursor INTO @name;
        END

        CLOSE db_cursor;
        DEALLOCATE db_cursor;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL','db_cursor') >= -1
        BEGIN CLOSE db_cursor; DEALLOCATE db_cursor; END

        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX),
                @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX);

        SET @ERROR_MSG = CONCAT('SP : sp_All_Historian_DB_Full_Backup | Messge : ', ERROR_MESSAGE(),' | Line : ', ERROR_LINE());
        SET @ERROR_LINE = ERROR_LINE();

        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP]
            @Type='SQL-Error',
            @Action='[dbo].[sp_All_Historian_DB_Full_Backup]',
            @Message=@ERROR_MSG,
            @StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,
            @UserID='',
            @HostAddress='',
            @Info='',
            @Source='T-SQL';

        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END;
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_Check_GradeTestMapping_Specifications]
(
    @recordid AS VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Grade_Characteristics_Mapping WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE id = @recordid 
              AND IsDeleted = 0
              AND (
                    AcceptableLowerLimit > AcceptableUpperLimit OR
                    AcceptableLowerLimit = AcceptableUpperLimit OR
                    AcceptableLowerLimit < 0 OR
                    AcceptableUpperLimit < 0
                  )
        )
        BEGIN
            Select 'Invalid specification limits: Check that lower limit is less than upper limit and both are non-negative.'
            RETURN;
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
	    
	    DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Sp_Check_GradeTestMapping_Specifications | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

	    RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

END
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Generate_CAPA_No]
(
    @ID  VARCHAR(36)=Null,
	@TransactionID VARCHAR(36),
	@AgencyID VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @NewCAPANo VARCHAR(20),
            @ExistingCAPANo VARCHAR(20),
            @AreaName VARCHAR(20);

    -- Get existing CAPA number for the record
	IF(@TransactionID is not Null and (@ID is Null or @ID=0))
	Begin
    SELECT @ExistingCAPANo = CAPANo
    FROM XStudio_XBatch..RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA With(NoLock)
    WHERE AgencyTransactionid = @TransactionID And Agency=@AgencyID;
	END
	IF(@ID is not Null Or @ID!=0)
	Begin
    SELECT @ExistingCAPANo = CAPANo
    FROM XStudio_XBatch..RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA with(nolock)
    WHERE ID=@ID;
	END

    -- If CAPANo already exists, just exit
    IF @ExistingCAPANo IS NOT NULL AND @ExistingCAPANo <> ''
    BEGIN
        RETURN; -- Exit SP silently
    END

    -- Generate new CAPA number (format: YYYYMM###)
    select @AreaName=AreaName from ShiftDelayEntry with(Nolock) where id =@TransactionID
    
	Select @NewCAPANo = @AreaName + '_' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) +
    RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(CAPANo, 3) AS INT)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR(3)), 3)
	FROM XStudio_XBatch..RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA With(Nolock)
	WHERE LEFT(CAPANo, LEN(@AreaName + '_' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112))) = 
      @AreaName + '_' + CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112);

    --SELECT 
    --    @NewCAPANo = @AreaName + '_' + CONVERT(CHAR(6), GETDATE(), 112) + 
    --                 RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(CAPANo, 3) AS INT)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR(3)), 3)
    --FROM XStudio_XBatch..RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA
    --WHERE LEFT(CAPANo, 6) = CONVERT(CHAR(6), GETDATE(), 112);

    -- Update CAPA number for this record
    UPDATE XStudio_XBatch..RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA
    SET CAPANo = @NewCAPANo
    WHERE ID = @ID;

    -- Update Agency_Wise_Delay CAPA field using the ParentID
    --UPDATE A
    --SET A.CAPA = @NewCAPANo
    --FROM XStudio_XBatch..Agency_Wise_Delay A
    --INNER JOIN XStudio_XBatch..RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA B ON A.ID = B.AgencyTransactionid
    --WHERE B.ID = @ID;
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana
-- Create date: 28-08-2025
-- Description:	Sp to Get Trend Dtaa based on Area & Tag Name
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_GET_AREAWISE_TAG_TREND]	 
	@Heatno INT,
	@Tagarea NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@SRNO INT
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	DECLARE @Area VARCHAR(25), @TagName VARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @StartTime VARCHAR(25), @EndTime VARCHAR(25);

	SELECT @area=Area,@TagName=MappedTag FROM Tag_Configuration WHERE Srno= @SRNO AND IsDeleted=0
	
	DECLARE @TagList TABLE (Area VARCHAR(25), TagName VARCHAR(MAX));

	IF((@Heatno is not Null AND  @Heatno != '' ) OR (@Tagarea is not null AND @Tagarea !=''))
	BEGIN
	IF (@SRNO IN (1,2,3,4))
	BEGIN
	SELECT @StartTime = HeatStart, @EndTime = EndTime FROM EAF_PER_HEAT WHERE HeatID = @Heatno AND IsDeleted = 0;
	IF(@StartTime IS NOT NULL AND @EndTime IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

	EXEC [Xstudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Retrieve_Tag_Full_Value_TestSSM_Usp]
			@StartTime = @StartTime,
			@EndTime = @EndTime,
			@TagName = @TagName;
	END
	END

	ELSE IF (@SRNO IN(5,6))
	BEGIN
	SELECT @StartTime = StartTime, @EndTime = EndTime FROM LRF_Per_Heat WHERE HeatID = @Heatno AND IsDeleted = 0;

	IF(@StartTime IS NOT NULL AND @EndTime IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	EXEC [Xstudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Retrieve_Tag_Full_Value_TestSSM_Usp]
			@StartTime = @StartTime,
			@EndTime = @EndTime,
			@TagName = @TagName;
	END
	END

	ELSE IF (@SRNO IN (7,8,9))
	BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 @StartTime = StartTime, @EndTime = EndTime FROM BilletsCastCount WHERE HeatID = @Heatno AND
	IsDeleted = 0;

	IF(@StartTime IS NOT NULL AND @EndTime IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	EXEC [Xstudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Retrieve_Tag_Full_Value_TestSSM_Usp]
			@StartTime = @StartTime,
			@EndTime = @EndTime,
			@TagName = @TagName;
	END
	END
	END
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Priyanka Makwana
-- Create date: 17-Nov-2025
-- Description:	Fetch CAPANO list From RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA
-- EXEC [SP_Get_CAPANO_SMS_RM] 'SMS'
-- EXEC [SP_Get_CAPANO_SMS_RM] 'RM'
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE SP_Get_CAPANO_SMS_RM
    @Type VARCHAR(10)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @Type = 'SMS'
        BEGIN
            SELECT CAPANO
            FROM RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA
            WHERE CAPANO LIKE 'SMS_%'
            ORDER BY CAPANO;
        END

        IF @Type = 'RM'
        BEGIN
            SELECT CAPANO
            FROM RMShiftDelayEntry_CAPA
            WHERE CAPANO LIKE 'RM_%'
            ORDER BY CAPANO;
        END
    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SP_Get_CAPANO_SMS_RM | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SP_Get_CAPANO_SMS_RM]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_Grade_Test_Mapping]
(
    @RecordId AS VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    DECLARE @GradeId AS VARCHAR(36),
            @TestId AS VARCHAR(36)
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT 
			@GradeId = GradeName,
			@TestId = TestName
		FROM Grade_Test_Mapping WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE id = @RecordId AND IsDeleted=0

		If  EXISTS(
			Select 1 
			from Grade_Characteristics_Mapping WITH(NOLOCK)
			where IsDeleted=0 AND ParentID=@RecordId
		)
		Begin
			Delete Grade_Characteristics_Mapping
			where isdeleted=0 AND ParentID=@RecordId
		End


		-- Insert only if NOT EXISTS (avoid duplicates)
		INSERT INTO Grade_Characteristics_Mapping (
			GradeName, TestName, CharacteristicName,
			AcceptableLowerLimit, AcceptableUpperLimit, ParentID
		)
		SELECT 
			@GradeId, @TestId, GC.CharacteristicName,
			40, 60, @RecordId
		FROM Grade_Characteristics GC WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE GC.IsDeleted = 0
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Sp_Grade_Test_Mapping | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[Sp_Grade_Test_Mapping]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.SP_ReCalculate_CCM_SMS_Block_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_ReCalculate_CCM_SMS_Block_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-09-15 14:19:46  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:11:44  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_ReCalculate_CCM_SMS_Block_USP]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Aditya Desai
-- Create date: 15/09/2025
-- Description:	Re Calculate Block Table According to given ReportDate.
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ReCalculate_CCM_SMS_Block_USP] --'2025-09-01'
	@ReportDate DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
BEGIN TRY
	
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF (@ReportDate IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @ReportDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()-1);
	END;

	DECLARE @StartDate	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndDate	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @TableName	VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Database	VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Query		NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @StartTime	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndTime	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @CCMID		VARCHAR(36);

	SET @StartDate	= FORMAT(@ReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00.000');
	
	SELECT TOP 1 @TableName= BEM.[Name],@Database=BDM.[Name]
	FROM [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Entities_Mst_Tbl] AS BEM WITH(NOLOCK)
	JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Databases_Mst_Tbl] AS BDM WITH(NOLOCK) ON BEM.[DatabaseName] = BDM.[Name] AND BDM.[IsDeleted] = 0
	WHERE BEM.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND BEM.[ParentID] = '0CD4A13A-DD4E-42BC-AEAB-813FF89E653A' AND BEM.[StartTime] <= @StartDate AND BEM.[EndTime] > @StartDate ;

	-- Truncate Block Table
	SET @Query = 'TRUNCATE TABLE [' + @Database + '].[dbo].[' + @TableName + '];';
	--print(@Query)
	EXEC sp_executesql @Query;

	DECLARE BilletsCursor CURSOR FOR
	SELECT [StartTime],[EndTime] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[BilletsCastCount] WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([StartTime] AS date) = @ReportDate ORDER BY [StartTime];

	OPEN BilletsCursor

	FETCH NEXT FROM BilletsCursor INTO @StartTime,@EndTime;

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		
		-- Call CCM_SMS Block Stored procedure for Calculate

		EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_CCM_SMS_Block_usp] @StartTime,@EndTime,'All','BF740CF1-17FF-4579-BECE-342EA6A59D3D';

		FETCH NEXT FROM BilletsCursor INTO @StartTime,@EndTime;
	END;

	CLOSE BilletsCursor;
	DEALLOCATE BilletsCursor;

	SELECT TOP 1 @CCMID = [ID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([StartTime] AS date) = @ReportDate ORDER BY [StartTime] DESC;

	-- Call Summary Calculate SP for Calculate Block

	EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Xstudio_Summary_CCM_Usp] @CCMID;

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
	IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL','BilletsCursor') >= -1
	BEGIN 
		CLOSE BilletsCursor;
		DEALLOCATE BilletsCursor;
	END

	DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : SP_ReCalculate_CCM_SMS_Block_USP | LINE No : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()) + '| MESSAGE : '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' | no :-'+CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_state());
	DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) 
	DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE()
	EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].  [SP_ReCalculate_CCM_SMS_Block_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MESSAGE,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID=''
	RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.SP_ReCalculate_LRF_SMS_Block_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_ReCalculate_LRF_SMS_Block_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-10-13 16:38:03  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-16 10:38:59  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_ReCalculate_LRF_SMS_Block_USP]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 13-Oct-2025
-- Description:	Re Calculate Block Table According to given ReportDate.
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ReCalculate_LRF_SMS_Block_USP] --'2025-09-01'
	@ReportDate DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @StartDate	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndDate	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @TableName	VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Database	VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Query		NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @StartTime	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndTime	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @LRFID		VARCHAR(36);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Set Reportdate--*/
		IF (@ReportDate IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @ReportDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()-1);
		END;

		/*--Set Start Date---*/
		SET @StartDate	= FORMAT(@ReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00.000');
	 
		/*--Get Table Name and Database name--*/
		SELECT TOP 1 @TableName = BEM.[Name], @Database = BDM.[Name]
		FROM [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Entities_Mst_Tbl] AS BEM WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Databases_Mst_Tbl] AS BDM WITH(NOLOCK)
		ON BEM.[DatabaseName] = BDM.[Name] AND BDM.[IsDeleted] = 0
		WHERE BEM.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND BEM.[StartTime] <= @StartDate AND BEM.[EndTime] > @StartDate 
			AND BEM.[ParentID] = (SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Entities_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Name] = 'LRF_SMS_Block' AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
			;
	
		-- Truncate Block Table
		SET @Query = 'TRUNCATE TABLE [' + @Database + '].[dbo].[' + @TableName + '];';
		--print(@Query)
		EXEC sp_executesql @Query;

		/*--Set Cursor to calculate Block--*/
		DECLARE BilletsCursor CURSOR FOR
			SELECT [StartTime],[EndTime] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[LRF_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([StartTime] AS date) = @ReportDate ORDER BY [StartTime];

		OPEN BilletsCursor

		FETCH NEXT FROM BilletsCursor INTO @StartTime,@EndTime;

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
		
			-- Call LRF_SMS Block Stored procedure for Calculate
			EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_LRF_SMS_Block_usp] @StartTime,@EndTime,'All','0A625385-4465-4C71-A91C-88743497DD3A'/*Ladle_Refining_Furnace*/;

			FETCH NEXT FROM BilletsCursor INTO @StartTime,@EndTime;
		END;

		CLOSE BilletsCursor;
		DEALLOCATE BilletsCursor;

		/*--Update LRF Per Heat As Per Block table data of LRF--*/
		SET @Query = 'UPDATE LPH SET
				LPH.[PowerONTime] = ISNULL(Main.[PowerOnTime],0),
				LPH.[ArcingTime] = ISNULL(Main.[ArcingTime],0),
				LPH.[ArgonConsumption] = ISNULL(Main.[ArgonConsumption],0),
				LPH.[PowerMWH] = ISNULL(Main.[LRFActualEnergy],0),
				LPH.[KWHPerTon] = ISNULL(Main.[KWHPerTon],0),
				LPH.[Lime] = ISNULL(Main.[Lime],0) + ISNULL(Main.[Lime1],0),
				LPH.[SiMnN] = ISNULL(Main.[SiMnn],0),
				LPH.[SiMn] = ISNULL(Main.[SiMn],0),
				LPH.[FeSi] = ISNULL(Main.[FeSi],0),
				LPH.[Dolo] = ISNULL(Main.[Dolo],0),
				LPH.[AutoAlloyAdditionLime] = ISNULL(Main.[Lime], 0) + ISNULL(Main.[Lime1], 0), 
				LPH.[AutoAlloyAdditionSiMn] = ISNULL(Main.[SiMn],0) + ISNULL(Main.[SiMnn], 0), 
				LPH.[AutoAlloyAdditionFeSi] = ISNULL(Main.[FeSi],0), 
				LPH.[AutoAlloyAdditionDolo] = ISNULL(Main.[Dolo],0) 
				FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[LRF_Per_Heat] AS LPH
				INNER JOIN [' + @Database + '].[dbo].[' + @TableName + '] AS Main 
				ON Main.StartTime = FORMAT(LPH.StartTime , ''dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AND Main.EndTime = FORMAT(LPH.EndTime, ''dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') 
				WHERE LPH.IsDeleted = 0;'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @Query;

		/*---Get Latest ID Of LRF--*/
		SELECT TOP 1 @LRFID = [ID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[LRF_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([StartTime] AS date) = @ReportDate ORDER BY [StartTime] DESC;

		-- Call Summary Calculate SP for Calculate Block
		EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Xstudio_Summary_LRF_Usp] @LRFID;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL','BilletsCursor') >= -1
		BEGIN 
			CLOSE BilletsCursor;
			DEALLOCATE BilletsCursor;
		END

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : SP_ReCalculate_LRF_SMS_Block_USP | LINE No : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()) + '| MESSAGE : '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' | no :-'+CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_state());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) 
		--DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE()
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].  [SP_ReCalculate_LRF_SMS_Block_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID=''
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.SP_ReCalculate_NG_Configuration_Block_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_ReCalculate_NG_Configuration_Block_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-10-29 14:56:51  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:12:00  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_ReCalculate_NG_Configuration_Block_USP]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 13-Oct-2025
-- Description:	Re Calculate Block Table According to given ReportDate.
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ReCalculate_NG_Configuration_Block_USP] --'2025-09-01'
	@ReportDate DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @StartDate	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndDate	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @TableName	VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Database	VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Query		NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @StartTime	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndTime	DATETIME;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Set Reportdate--*/
		IF (@ReportDate IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @ReportDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()-1);
		END;

		/*--Set Start Date---*/
		SET @StartDate	= FORMAT(@ReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00.000');
	 
		/*--Get Table Name and Database name--*/
		SELECT TOP 1 @TableName = BEM.[Name], @Database = BDM.[Name]
		FROM [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Entities_Mst_Tbl] AS BEM WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Databases_Mst_Tbl] AS BDM WITH(NOLOCK)
		ON BEM.[DatabaseName] = BDM.[Name] AND BDM.[IsDeleted] = 0
		WHERE BEM.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND BEM.[StartTime] <= @StartDate AND BEM.[EndTime] > @StartDate 
			AND BEM.[ParentID] = (SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Entities_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Name] = 'RM_NGConsumption_Report' AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
			;
	
		-- Delete Data From table
		SET @Query = ' DELETE FROM RM_NGConsumption WHERE [ReportDate] = @Reportdate;';
		--print(@Query)
		EXEC sp_executesql @Query,N'@ReportDate DATE',@ReportDate=@ReportDate;

		-- Truncate Block Table
		SET @Query = 'TRUNCATE TABLE [' + @Database + '].[dbo].[' + @TableName + '];';
		--print(@Query)
		EXEC sp_executesql @Query;

		/*--Set Cursor to calculate Block Hourly for RM NG Consumption--*/
		DECLARE BilletsCursor CURSOR FOR
		SELECT DATEADD(HH, [number], [startdate]) AS [startdate], DATEADD(HH, [number] + 1, [startdate]) AS [enddate] FROM (
			SELECT CAST(FORMAT(@ReportDate ,'dd-MMM-yyyy 00:00:00' ) AS DATETIME) AS [startdate]
		) AS t OUTER APPLY (
			SELECT DISTINCT [number] FROM [master].[dbo].[spt_values] 
			WHERE ([number] BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND CAST(@ReportDate AS DATE) < CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 
					OR ([number] BETWEEN 0 AND DATEPART(HH, GETDATE()) - 1) AND CAST(@ReportDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
		) AS t1 WHERE t.[startdate] <= GETDATE()
			
		OPEN BilletsCursor

		FETCH NEXT FROM BilletsCursor INTO @StartTime,@EndTime;

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN

			-- Call LRF_SMS Block Stored procedure for Calculate
			EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_RM_NGConsumption_Report_usp] @StartTime,@EndTime,'All','0728EBC6-7855-4EFE-ACBE-8D986A0DB1C7'/*Furnace*/;

			FETCH NEXT FROM BilletsCursor INTO @StartTime,@EndTime;
```

## dbo.SP_ReCalculate_RM_Furnace_Block_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_ReCalculate_RM_Furnace_Block_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-10-29 14:56:51  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:12:08  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_ReCalculate_RM_Furnace_Block_USP]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 13-Oct-2025
-- Description:	Re Calculate Block Table According to given ReportDate.
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ReCalculate_RM_Furnace_Block_USP] --'2025-09-01'
	@ReportDate DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @StartDate	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndDate	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @TableName	VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Database	VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Query		NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @StartTime	DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndTime	DATETIME;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Set Reportdate--*/
		IF (@ReportDate IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @ReportDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()-1);
		END;

		/*--Set Start Date---*/
		SET @StartDate	= FORMAT(@ReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00.000');
	 
		/*--Get Table Name and Database name--*/
		SELECT TOP 1 @TableName = BEM.[Name], @Database = BDM.[Name]
		FROM [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Entities_Mst_Tbl] AS BEM WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Databases_Mst_Tbl] AS BDM WITH(NOLOCK)
		ON BEM.[DatabaseName] = BDM.[Name] AND BDM.[IsDeleted] = 0
		WHERE BEM.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND BEM.[StartTime] <= @StartDate AND BEM.[EndTime] > @StartDate 
			AND BEM.[ParentID] = (SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Entities_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Name] = 'RM_Furnace_Logbook_Block' AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
			;
	
		-- Delete Data From table
		SET @Query = ' DELETE FROM RM_Furnace_Parameter WHERE [ReportDate] = @Reportdate;';
		--print(@Query)
		EXEC sp_executesql @Query,N'@ReportDate DATE',@ReportDate=@ReportDate;

		-- Truncate Block Table
		SET @Query = 'TRUNCATE TABLE [' + @Database + '].[dbo].[' + @TableName + '];';
		--print(@Query)
		EXEC sp_executesql @Query;

		/*--Set Cursor to calculate Block Hourly for RM furnace--*/
		DECLARE BilletsCursor CURSOR FOR
		SELECT DATEADD(HH, [number], [startdate]) AS [startdate], DATEADD(HH, [number] + 1, [startdate]) AS [enddate] FROM (
			SELECT CAST(FORMAT(@ReportDate ,'dd-MMM-yyyy 00:00:00' ) AS DATETIME) AS [startdate]
		) AS t OUTER APPLY (
			SELECT DISTINCT [number] FROM [master].[dbo].[spt_values] 
			WHERE ([number] BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND CAST(@ReportDate AS DATE) < CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 
					OR ([number] BETWEEN 0 AND DATEPART(HH, GETDATE()) - 1) AND CAST(@ReportDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
		) AS t1 WHERE t.[startdate] <= GETDATE()
			
		OPEN BilletsCursor

		FETCH NEXT FROM BilletsCursor INTO @StartTime,@EndTime;

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN

			-- Call LRF_SMS Block Stored procedure for Calculate
			EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_RM_Furnace_Logbook_Block_usp] @StartTime,@EndTime,'All','0728EBC6-7855-4EFE-ACBE-8D986A0DB1C7'/*Furnace*/;

			FETCH NEXT FROM BilletsCursor INTO @StartTime,@EndTime;
		END;

		CLOSE BilletsCursor;
		DEALLOCATE BilletsCursor;
				

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL','BilletsCursor') >= -1
		BEGIN 
			CLOSE BilletsCursor;
			DEALLOCATE BilletsCursor;
		END

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : SP_ReCalculate_RM_Furnace_Block_USP | LINE No : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()) + '| MESSAGE : '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' | no :-'+CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_state());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) 
		--DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE()
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].  [SP_ReCalculate_RM_Furnace_Block_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID=''
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana
-- Create date: 20-09-2025
-- Description:	Update Data in Todays Delay Datas
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RM_Delay_Data_Modify_By_Operator]
    @Reportdate VARCHAR(20),
	@Shift      VArchar(5),
    @Product    VARCHAR(40),
	@Section    VARCHAR(40),
    @Operator   VARCHAR(36),
    @ShiftManager VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    BEGIN TRY
        SET NOCOUNT ON;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- Force SQL Server to read as DD-MM-YYYY
        SET DATEFORMAT DMY;

        DECLARE @ReportDateConverted DATE = CONVERT(DATE, @Reportdate, 105); -- 105 = DD-MM-YYYY

        UPDATE ShiftDelayEntry
        SET RMProduct     = @Product,
	        RMSection     = @Section,
            OperatorName  = @Operator,
            ShiftManager  = @ShiftManager
        WHERE AreaName    = 'RM'
          AND IsDeleted   = 0
	      AND [Shift] = @Shift
          AND ReportDate= @ReportDateConverted;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =
            'SP : SP_RM_Delay_Data_Modify_By_Operator | Line No : '
            + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE())
            + ' | Message : ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
        DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		    EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SP_RM_Delay_Data_Modify_By_Operator]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG, 16, 1);
    END CATCH;
END
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sp_Sample_Characteristics_I_Values]
(
    @Recordid AS VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    DECLARE @GradeId AS varchar(36),
			@testId AS varchar(36);
	BEGIN TRY
		-- Step 1: Get GradeId for the provided RecordId
		SELECT @GradeId = Grade,
				@TestId=TestName
		FROM  EAF_LogSheet_Quantity
		WHERE ID = @Recordid;


		-- Step 2: Insert only those characteristics that are not already inserted for the same Grade
		INSERT INTO grade_FillSample_Data (
			ParentID,
			CharacteristicName,
			AcceptableLowerLimit,
			AcceptableUpperLimit,
			TestName,
			GradeName,
			Value)
  		 select
			@recordid,
			CharacteristicName,
			AcceptableLowerLimit,
			AcceptableUpperLimit,
			@testId,
			@GradeId,
			Null
		from Grade_Characteristics_Mapping 
		WHERE GradeName=@GradeId And TestName=@testId AND IsDeleted=0
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
	
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Sp_Sample_Characteristics_I_Values | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

 END
```

## dbo.SP_SMS_OEE_Daily_View

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_SMS_OEE_Daily_View  
**Created On:** 2026-04-28 13:32:48  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-28 14:01:38  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_SMS_OEE_Daily_View];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*==============================================================
SP Name : SP_SMS_OEE_Daily_View
Purpose : Return ALL DAY OEE data only (No Table Create / No Insert)
Use directly in Grafana:

EXEC dbo.SP_SMS_OEE_Daily_View
==============================================================*/

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SMS_OEE_Daily_View]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT top 30
        P.ReportDate,

        /* ---------------- Availability Inputs ---------------- */
        CAST(1440 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS PlannedMinute,

        ISNULL(CAst(D.TotalDelayMinute as decimal(18,2)),0) AS DelayMinute,

        CAST(1440 - ISNULL(D.TotalDelayMinute,0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS RunningMinute,

        CAST(
            ((1440 - ISNULL(D.TotalDelayMinute,0)) / 1440.0) * 100
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AvailabilityPercent,

        /* ---------------- Performance Inputs ---------------- */
        ISNULL(Perf.FTDTon,0) AS ActualTPH,

        CAST(89 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS TargetTPH,

        CAST(
            (ISNULL(Perf.FTDTon,0) / 89.0) * 100
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS PerformancePercent,

        /* ---------------- Quality Inputs ---------------- */
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS GoodTon,
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS TotalTon,
        CAST(100 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS QualityPercent,

        /* ---------------- Final OEE ---------------- */
        CAST(
            (
                ((1440 - ISNULL(D.TotalDelayMinute,0)) / 1440.0)
                *
                (ISNULL(Perf.FTDTon,0) / 89.0)
            ) * 100
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS OEEPercent,

        /* ---------------- Lowest Factor ---------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN (((1440 - ISNULL(D.TotalDelayMinute,0)) / 1440.0) * 100)
                 <= ((ISNULL(Perf.FTDTon,0) / 89.0) * 100)
            THEN 'Availability'
            ELSE 'Performance'
        END AS LowestFactor,

        /* ---------------- Main Reason ---------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN (((1440 - ISNULL(D.TotalDelayMinute,0)) / 1440.0) * 100)
                 <= ((ISNULL(Perf.FTDTon,0) / 89.0) * 100)
            THEN ISNULL(R.TopReason,'Delay Loss')
            ELSE 'Low TPH / Low Production'
        END AS MainReason,

        /* ---------------- Formula Columns ---------------- */
        '(1440-' + CAST(ISNULL(D.TotalDelayMinute,0) AS VARCHAR(30)) + ')/1440*100'
        AS AvailabilityFormula,

        CAST(ISNULL(Perf.FTDTon,0) AS VARCHAR(30)) + '/89*100'
        AS PerformanceFormula

    FROM dbo.SMS_Production_Summary_Day P

    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            dbo.FN_GET_ReportDate(DelayStartTime) AS ReportDate,
            SUM(DelayInSecond) / 60.0 AS TotalDelayMinute
        FROM dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
        WHERE AreaName = 'SMS'
          AND IsDeleted = 0
        GROUP BY dbo.FN_GET_ReportDate(DelayStartTime)
    ) D
        ON P.ReportDate = D.ReportDate

    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            ReportDate,
            FTDTon
        FROM dbo.SMS_Production_Summary
        WHERE Particulars = 'TPH (BL / Cycle time)'
          AND IsDeleted = 0
    ) Perf
        ON P.ReportDate = Perf.ReportDate

    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT X.ReportDate, X.TopReason
        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                dbo.FN_GET_ReportDate(DelayStartTime) AS ReportDate,
                DelayReason AS TopReason,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY dbo.FN_GET_ReportDate(DelayStartTime)
                    ORDER BY SUM(DelayInSecond) DESC
                ) AS RN
            FROM dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
            WHERE AreaName = 'SMS'
              AND IsDeleted = 0
            GROUP BY
                dbo.FN_GET_ReportDate(DelayStartTime),
                DelayReason
        ) X
        WHERE X.RN = 1
    ) R
        ON P.ReportDate = R.ReportDate

    WHERE P.IsDeleted = 0 and p.ReportDate <= cast(getdate() as date)

    ORDER BY P.ReportDate DESC;

END
```
