## dbo.SP_SMS_Producation_Summary

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_SMS_Producation_Summary  
**Created On:** 2025-09-04 08:21:08  
**Modified On:** 2026-05-04 13:12:17  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_SMS_Producation_Summary]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------------------
	Created By : Aditya Desai
	Created On : 04-Sep-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure to get Production Details Data

	Modified By : Nidhi Rana
	Modified On : 03-Oct-2025
	Desciption : Modification to add logic for Production missing data and Solve issues to correct data

	Modificed On : 04-May-2026 Description : Add shreededch1 +shreededch2 into pigiron, shreededch1_mtd + shreededch2_mtd into pigiron_mtd and remove shreededch1 + shreededch2 from scull and shreededch1_mtd + shreededch2_mtd from scull_mtd
-----------------------------*/
--select * from xstudio_configuration..xstudio_error_log_mst_Tbl order by createdon desc
--select * from SMS_Production_Summary where reportdate = '04-Jan-2026' and isdeleted = 0 order by ReportDate desc
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_SMS_Producation_Summary]  --'2025-12-25'
(
	--DECLARE 
	@ReportDate DATE =NULL --='04-Jan-2026'
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @BestDay	DATE;
	DECLARE @BestMonth	DATE;
	DECLARE @DayProduction FLOAT;
	DECLARE @HighestProduction FLOAT;
	DECLARE @Available FLOAT;
	DECLARE @LadleSequnce FLOAT;
	DECLARE @LadleDate DATE;
	DECLARE @highProd FLOAT;
	DECLARE @highProd_date DATE;
	DECLARE @dayProd FLOAT;
	DECLARE @dayProd_date DATE;
	DECLARE @avail FLOAT;
	DECLARE @AvailDate DATE;
	DECLARE @Ladleseq FLOAT;
	DECLARE @LadleseqDATE DATE;
	DECLARE @text NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
	DECLARE @EntryDate DATETIME;
	DECLARE @Reject FLOAT;
	DECLARE @RejectDate DATE;
	DECLARE @Rejection FLOAT;
	DECLARE @Shell_Life FLOAT;
	DECLARE @Shell_LifeDAte DATE;
	DECLARE @ShellLife FLOAT;
	DECLARE @LAdle_Life FLOAT;
	DECLARE @Ladle_LifeDate DATE;
	DECLARE @LadleLife FLOAT;
BEGIN TRY
	IF (@ReportDate IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @ReportDate = CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()-1);
	END;
	EXEC [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_BackCalculation_GLS_USP] @ReportDate;
	/*--Delete Data for reportdate--*/
	UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] SET [IsDeleted] = 1 WHERE [ReportDate] = @ReportDate and IsDeleted=0;

	/*--Update Reportdate in CCM if reportdate is null--*/
	UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] SET [ReportDate] = [HeatReportDate] WHERE [ReportDate] IS NULL;
	
	/*---Get data for report--*/
	;With EAF AS (
		SELECT [ReportDate]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[HeatID], 0) AS INT) AS [HeatID], CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[HeatID_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [HeatID_MTD]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[HBIDRICH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[HBIDRICH2], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [HBIDRI]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[HBIDRICH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[HBIDRICH2_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [HBIDRI_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[EndCutsCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[EndCutsCH2], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [EndCuts]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[EndCutsCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[EndCutsCH2_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [EndCuts_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[ScullCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[ScullCH2], 0) /*+ ISNULL([ShreeddedCH1], 0) + ISNULL([ShreeddedCH2], 0)*/ AS FLOAT) AS [Scull]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[ScullCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[ScullCH2_MTD], 0)  /*+ ISNULL([ShreeddedCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([ShreeddedCH2_MTD], 0)*/ AS FLOAT) AS [Scull_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ISNULL([ShreeddedCH1], 0) + ISNULL([ShreeddedCH2], 0), 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH2]*/0, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [PigIron]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ISNULL([ShreeddedCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([ShreeddedCH2_MTD], 0), 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH2_MTD]*/0, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [PigIron_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH2], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH1], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH2], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Ext]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH2_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH2_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH2_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Ext_MTD]
			, (/*ISNULL(ESD.[HBIDRICH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[HBIDRICH2], 0) +*/ ISNULL(ESD.[EndCutsCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[EndCutsCH2], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[ScullCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[ScullCH2], 0) + ISNULL([ShreeddedCH1], 0) + ISNULL([ShreeddedCH2], 0) /*+ ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH1]*/0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH2]*/0, 0) */+ ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH2], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH1], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH2], 0)) AS [TotalCharge]
			, (/*ISNULL(ESD.[HBIDRICH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[HBIDRICH2_MTD], 0) + */ISNULL(ESD.[EndCutsCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[EndCutsCH2_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[ScullCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[ScullCH2_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([ShreeddedCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([ShreeddedCH2_MTD], 0) /*+ ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH1_MTD]*/0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH2_MTD]*/0, 0) */+ ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH2_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH2_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH1_MTD], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2_MTD], 0)) AS [TotalCharge_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([PowerMWH], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [PowerMWH], CAST(ISNULL([PowerMWH_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [PowerMWH_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[totalElectrodeconsumption], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [EAF_Electrodes]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[totalElectrodeconsumption_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [EAF_Electrodes_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[NutcokeKgPerton], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Top_Carbon_EAF]
			, CAST(ISNULL(ESD.[NutcokeKgPerTon_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Top_Carbon_EAF_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([CarbonConsumption], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Carbon_Injection_EAF]
			, CAST(ISNULL([CarbonConsumption_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Carbon_Injection_EAF_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([OxygenConsumption], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Oxygen]
			, CAST(ISNULL([OxygenConsumption_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Oxygen_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([NGConsumption], 0) AS FLOAT) / 28.26 AS [NG]
			, CAST(ISNULL([NGConsumption_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) / 28.26 AS [NG_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionLime], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LimeEAF]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionLime_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LimeEAF_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([BIN1LimeConsumption] * 1000, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [BIN1LimeConsumption]
			, CAST(ISNULL([BIN1LimeConsumption_MTD] * 1000, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [BIN1LimeConsumption_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionDolo], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Dolime]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionDolo_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Dolime_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([BIN2DoloConsumption] * 1000, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [BIN2DoloConsumption]
			, CAST(ISNULL([BIN2DoloConsumption_MTD] * 1000, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [BIN2DoloConsumption_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionSiMn], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LadleAdditionSiMn]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionSiMn_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LadleAdditionSiMn_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionSiMnn], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LadleAdditionSiMnn]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionSiMnn_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LadleAdditionSiMnn_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionFeSi], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LadleAdditionFeSi]
			, CAST(ISNULL([LadleAdditionFeSi_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LadleAdditionFeSi_MTD]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(1440, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Cal_Time]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(1440 * DAY(@reportdate), 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Cal_Time_MTD]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(/*[Planned_Shutdown]*/0, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Planned_Shutdown]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(/*[Planned_Shutdown_MTD]*/0, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Planned_Shutdown_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(/*[Forced_shutdown]*/0, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Forced_Shutdown]
			, CAST(ISNULL(/*[Forced_shutdown_MTD]*/0, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Forced_Shutdown_MTD]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(1440, 0) - (/*[Planned_Shutdown] + [Forced_Shutdown]*/ 0) AS FLOAT) AS [total_time]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(1440 * DAY(@reportdate), 0) - (/*[Planned_Shutdown_MTD] + [Forced_Shutdown_MTD]*/ 0) AS FLOAT) AS [total_time_MTD]
			--, CAST(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_TTT], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Avg_TTT]
			--, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_TTT_MTD], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_TTT_MTD]
			, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PoweronTIme], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PoweronTIme]
			, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PoweronTIme_MTD], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PoweronTIme_MTD]
			, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PoweroffTIme], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PoweroffTIme]
			, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PoweroffTIme_MTD], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PoweroffTIme_MTD]
			, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PowerMW], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PowerMW]
			, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PowerMW_MTD], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PowerMW_MTD]
		FROM [EAF_Summary_Day] AS ESD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ReportDate] = @ReportDate AND [IsDeleted] = 0
	)
	, LRF AS (
		SELECT [Reportdate]
			, CAST(COALESCE(LSD.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight],LSD.[LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LiquidMetalWeight]
			, CAST(COALESCE(LSD.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight_MTD], LSD.[LiquidMetalWeight_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LiquidMetalWeight_MTD]
			, CAST(COALESCE(LSD.[Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight], LSD.[Avg_LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Avg_LiquidMetalWeight]
			, CAST(COALESCE(LSD.[Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight],LSD.[Avg_LiquidMetalWeight_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Avg_LiquidMetalWeight_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([PowerMWH], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [PowerMWH]
			, CAST(ISNULL([PowerMWH_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [PowerMWH_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(LSD.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LRF_Electrodes]
			, CAST(ISNULL(LSD.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [LRF_Electrodes_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([Carbon], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [CACLRF]
			, CAST(ISNULL([Carbon_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [CACLRF_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([Aluminium], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [ALingots]
			, CAST(ISNULL([ALuminium_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [ALingots_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(LSD.[FLourspar], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Flourspar]
			, CAST(ISNULL([Flourspar_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Flourspar_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(lsd.[Lime], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Lime]
			, CAST(ISNULL(lsd.[Lime_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Lime_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([SiMn], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [SiMn]
			, CAST(ISNULL([SiMn_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [SiMn_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([SiMnn], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [SiMnn]
			, CAST(ISNULL([SiMnn_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [SiMnn_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL([FeSi], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [FeSi]
			, CAST(ISNULL([FeSi_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [FeSi_MTD]
		FROM [LRF_Summary_Day] AS LSD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ReportDate] = @ReportDate AND [IsDeleted] = 0
	), CCM AS (
		SELECT [ReportDate]
			, CAST(ISNULL(CSD.[HeatID], 0) AS INT) AS [HeatID]
			, CAST(ISNULL(CSD.[HeatID_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [HeatID_MTD]
			, CAST(COALESCE(CSD.[ActualBilletweightton],[TotalProduction], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [TotalProduction]
			, CAST(COALESCE(CSD.[ActualBilletweightton_MTD],[TotalProduction_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [TotalProduction_MTD]
			, CAST(ISNULL(/*[TotalProduction_1]*/0, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [TotalProduction_1]
			, CAST(ISNULL(/*[TotalProduction_1_MTD]*/0, 0) AS FLOAT) AS [TotalProduction_1_MTD]
		FROM [CCM_Summary_Day] AS CSD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Reportdate] = @Reportdate AND [IsDeleted] = 0
	)
	, EAF_1 AS (
		SELECT t1.*
			, CAST(t2.TotalCharge + ColdDRI + HBIDRI AS FLOAT) AS [Totalcharge]
			, CAST(t2.TotalCharge_MTD + Colddri_mtd + HBIDRI_MTD AS FLOAT) AS totalcharge_mtd 
		FROM (
			SELECT @reportdate AS [Reportdate]
				, (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) = @Reportdate THEN CAST(ISNULL([CdriConsumption], 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END) )  AS [ColdDRI]
				, (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) = @Reportdate THEN CASE when  bin3name = bin4name AND bin3name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL([BIN3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([BIN4Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) WHEN bin3name!=bin4name AND BIN3Name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL([BIN3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) WHEN bin3name!=bin4name AND BIN4Name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL([BIN4Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 aS FLOAT) END ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END) )  AS [HBIDRI]
				, (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST([Reportdate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) <= (@Reportdate) THEN CAST(ISNULL([CdriConsumption], 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END)) AS [ColdDRI_MTD] 
				, (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST([Reportdate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) <= (@Reportdate) THEN CASE when  bin3name = bin4name AND bin3name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL([BIN3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([BIN4Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) WHEN bin3name!=bin4name AND BIN3Name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL([BIN3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) WHEN bin3name!=bin4name AND BIN4Name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL([BIN4Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 aS FLOAT) END ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END)) AS [HBIDRI_MTD] 
			FROM EAF_PER_HEAT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
			--SELECT @reportdate AS [Reportdate]
			--	, (SUM(CASE WHEN [BIN3Name] = 'cdri' AND [BIN4Name] = 'cdri' AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) = @Reportdate THEN CAST(ISNULL([Bin3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([Bin4Consumption], 0)+ ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END) )  AS [ColdDRI]
			--	, (SUM(CASE WHEN [BIN3Name] = 'cdri' AND [BIN4Name] = 'cdri' AND CAST([Reportdate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) <= (@Reportdate) THEN CAST(ISNULL([Bin3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([Bin4Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END)) AS [ColdDRI_MTD] 
			--FROM EAF_PER_HEAT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
			--SELECT  '12-Apr-2026' AS [Reportdate], ReportDate, case when BIN3Name = 'cdri' and BIN4Name = 'cdri' then 1 else 0 end, CAST(ISNULL([Bin3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([Bin4Consumption], 0)+ ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT), BIN3Name, BIN4Name
			--	, ((CASE WHEN [BIN3Name] = 'cdri' AND [BIN4Name] = 'cdri' AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) =  '12-Apr-2026' THEN CAST(ISNULL([Bin3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([Bin4Consumption], 0)+ ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END) )  AS [ColdDRI]
			--	, ((CASE WHEN [BIN3Name] = 'cdri' AND [BIN4Name] = 'cdri' AND CAST([Reportdate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day( '12-Apr-2026')) + 1,  '12-Apr-2026') AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) <= ( '12-Apr-2026') THEN CAST(ISNULL([Bin3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([Bin4Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRI], 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END)) AS [ColdDRI_MTD] 
			--FROM EAF_PER_HEAT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 and CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) >= dateadd(dd, -(day('12-Apr-2026')) +1, '12-Apr-2026') and CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) <= '12-Apr-2026'
		) AS t1 CROSS JOIN EAF AS t2
	), DLY AS (
		SELECT SUM([STD_Delay]) AS [STD_Delay]
			, SUM([STD_Delay_MTD]) AS [STD_Delay_MTD]
			, SUM([Opm]) AS [Opm]
			, SUM([Opm_MTD]) AS [Opm_MTD]
			, SUM([Elect]) AS [Elect]
			, SUM([Elect_MTD]) AS [Elect_MTD]
			, SUM([Mech]) AS [Mech]
			, SUM([Mech_MTD]) AS [Mech_MTD]
			, SUM([Trm]) AS [Trm]
			, SUM([Trm_MTD]) AS [Trm_MTD]
			, SUM([CRANE_MAINT]) AS [CRANE_MAINT]
			, SUM([CRANE_MAINT_MTD]) AS [CRANE_MAINT_MTD]
			, SUM([WTP_VMD_MRSS]) AS [WTP_VMD_MRSS]
			, SUM([WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD]) AS [WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD]
			, SUM([PPC_Commercial]) AS [PPC_Commercial]
			, SUM([PPC_Commercial_MTD]) AS [PPC_Commercial_MTD]
			, SUM([Total_Delays]) AS [Total_Delays]
			, SUM([Total_Delays_MTD]) AS [Total_Delays_MTD] 
		FROM ( 
			SELECT b.[Name] AS [Delay]
				/*standard delay*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'CFE8EF94-B52A-4F23-B160-DF04B7C339B5' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [STD_Delay]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'CFE8EF94-B52A-4F23-B160-DF04B7C339B5' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [STD_Delay_MTD]
				/*operation*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '3254B0D7-4DDB-4B79-9B46-73EEA2501AB3' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Opm]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '3254B0D7-4DDB-4B79-9B46-73EEA2501AB3' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Opm_MTD]
				/*electrical*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'AC934F3F-1DC4-4EEE-A69A-4F44635EC2DD' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Elect]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'AC934F3F-1DC4-4EEE-A69A-4F44635EC2DD' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Elect_MTD]
				/*mechanical*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '0198A42E-52A8-4DAA-AD53-2B50298397AA' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Mech]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '0198A42E-52A8-4DAA-AD53-2B50298397AA' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Mech_MTD]
				/*trm*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'FDA104D8-ADBC-42C9-A430-3E8B701D3648' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Trm]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'FDA104D8-ADBC-42C9-A430-3E8B701D3648' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Trm_MTD]
				/*CRANE MAINT*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'FCFF842C-1232-4EDF-B2D9-3533B3421594' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [CRANE_MAINT]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'FCFF842C-1232-4EDF-B2D9-3533B3421594' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [CRANE_MAINT_MTD]
				/*WTP/VMD/MRSS*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'A430E501-9682-4D58-A8BD-8ED2D6C5077A' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [WTP_VMD_MRSS]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'A430E501-9682-4D58-A8BD-8ED2D6C5077A' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD]
				/*PPC/Commercial*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'A92617E5-EFB8-4874-A307-FF54B5C0112B' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [PPC_Commercial]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'A92617E5-EFB8-4874-A307-FF54B5C0112B' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [PPC_Commercial_MTD]
				/*Total Delays + Std Delays*/
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] IN ('CFE8EF94-B52A-4F23-B160-DF04B7C339B5','3254B0D7-4DDB-4B79-9B46-73EEA2501AB3','AC934F3F-1DC4-4EEE-A69A-4F44635EC2DD','0198A42E-52A8-4DAA-AD53-2B50298397AA','FDA104D8-ADBC-42C9-A430-3E8B701D3648','FCFF842C-1232-4EDF-B2D9-3533B3421594','A430E501-9682-4D58-A8BD-8ED2D6C5077A','A92617E5-EFB8-4874-A307-FF54B5C0112B') AND sd.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Total_Delays]
				, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] IN ('CFE8EF94-B52A-4F23-B160-DF04B7C339B5','3254B0D7-4DDB-4B79-9B46-73EEA2501AB3','AC934F3F-1DC4-4EEE-A69A-4F44635EC2DD','0198A42E-52A8-4DAA-AD53-2B50298397AA','FDA104D8-ADBC-42C9-A430-3E8B701D3648','FCFF842C-1232-4EDF-B2D9-3533B3421594','A430E501-9682-4D58-A8BD-8ED2D6C5077A','A92617E5-EFB8-4874-A307-FF54B5C0112B') AND sd.[ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -DAY(@reportdate) +1, @reportdate) AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @reportdate THEN CAST(a.[Duration] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Total_Delays_MTD]
				FROM Agency_Wise_Delay AS a WITH(NOLOCK) 
				JOIN ShiftDelayEntry AS SD WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.[ParentID] = SD.[ID] 
				JOIN DelayAgency_Master AS b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.[Agency] = b.[ID] 
				WHERE a.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND SD.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND b.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND b.[AreaName] = 'SMS'
				GROUP BY b.[Name]) AS t
		), time_data AS (
			SELECT SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN t.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CAST(t.[Cal_time] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END, 0)) AS [Cal_time]
				, (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST([Reportdate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) <= (@Reportdate) THEN CAST(t.[Cal_time] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END)) AS [Cal_time_MTD]
				, @ReportDate AS [Reportdate] FROM (SELECT [Reportdate], CAST(ISNULL(HEST.[CalTimeinMinutes], 0) AS FLOAT) AS [Cal_time], ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ReportDate] ORDER BY [ModifiedOn] Desc) AS num FROM [Heat_End_Selection_Trn_Tbl] AS HEST WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HEST.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST(HEST.[ReportDate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST(HEST.[ReportDate] AS DATE) <= @ReportDate) As t WHERE num =1 

		), arcdly AS (
				SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.[SMSReportDate] = @Reportdate AND [DelayType] = 'Power On' THEN CAST([DelayInMinutes] AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18, 0)) AS Arcingdelayduration
					, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.[SMSReportDate] = @Reportdate AND [DelayType] in ('Power Off','Setup Delay','Tapping Delay') THEN CAST([DelayInMinutes] AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18, 0)) AS Totaldelayduration
					, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.[SMSReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND t.[SMSReportDate] <= @ReportDate AND [DelayType] = 'Power On' THEN CAST([DelayInMinutes] AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18, 0)) AS Arcingdelayduration_MTD
					, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.[SMSReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND t.[SMSReportDate] <= @ReportDate AND [DelayType] in ('Power Off','Setup Delay','Tapping Delay') THEN CAST([DelayInMinutes] AS FLOAT) ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(18, 0)) AS Totaldelayduration_MTD
					/*, delaytype*/, @ReportDate AS SMSReportDate FROM (
					SELECT t1.[DelayDuration], [DelayStartTime], [DelayEndTime], t1.[DelayInSecond], [DelayInMinutes], CAST([SMSReportDate] AS DATE) AS [SMSReportDate], t1.[DelayType] AS [delaytypeid], dtm.[ID], dtm.[DelayType] FROM (
						SELECT * FROM ShiftDelayEntry AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) 
						WHERE t1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST(t1.[SMSReportDate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST(t1.[SMSReportDate] AS DATE) <= @ReportDate 
							AND t1.[AreaName] = 'SMS'
					) AS t1 FULL JOIN (
						SELECT * FROM DelayTypeMST AS dtm WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE dtm.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND [AreaID] = 'SMS'
					) as dtm on t1.DelayType = dtm.ID
				) AS t WHERE DelayType IN ('Power On','Power Off','Setup Delay','Tapping Delay')
		), powoff AS (
			SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(sde.[SMSReportDate] AS DATE) = @ReportDate THEN CAST(sde.[DelayInMinutes] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END) AS FLOAT) AS [Planned_Shutdown], CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(sde.[SMSReportDate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@Reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST(sde.[SMSReportDate] AS DATE) <= @ReportDate THEN CAST(sde.[DelayInMinutes] AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(0 AS FLOAT) END) AS FLOAT) AS [Planned_Shutdown_MTD], @ReportDate AS ReportDate FROM ShiftDelayEntry AS sde WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE sde.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND sde.[AreaName] = 'SMS' AND CAST(sde.[SMSReportDate] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST(SDE.[SMSReportDate] AS DATE) <= @ReportDate AND sde.[DelaySubtypeid] IN (SELECT sdmt.[ID] FROM [DelaySubType_Master] AS sdmt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE sdmt.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND sdmt.[Name] = 'Planned Shutdown') AND sde.DelayType='D95E61A2-4F72-44E6-A786-C3EEA9393B4F'
		), PowCons AS (
			SELECT @ReportDate AS [Reportdate]
				, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN [ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CASE WHEN PCR.[SMSAuxwithoutO2] < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PCR.[SMSAuxWithoutO2] END ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT)  AS [SMSAuxWithoutO2]
				, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN [ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND [ReportDate] <= @ReportDate THEN CASE WHEN PCR.[SMSAuxwithoutO2] < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PCR.[SMSAuxWithoutO2] END ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) AS [SMSAuxWithoutO2_MTD], CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN [ReportDate] = @Reportdate THEN CASE WHEN PCR.[OxygenPlant4A] < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PCR.[OxygenPlant4A] END ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) AS [OxygenPlant4A], CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN [ReportDate] >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND [ReportDate] <= @ReportDate THEN CASE WHEN PCR.[OxygenPlant4A] < 0 THEN 0 ELSE PCR.[OxygenPlant4A] END ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) AS [OxygenPlant4A_MTD] FROM 
				(SELECT CAST([Entrydatetime] AS DATE) AS [ReportDate], [SMSAuxWithoutO2], [OxygenPlant4A] FROM [dbo].[Power_Consumption_Report] AS PCR WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CAST([EntryDateTime] AS DATE) >= DATEADD(dd, -(day(@reportdate)) + 1, @reportdate) AND CAST([EntryDateTime] AS DATE) <= @ReportDate) AS PCR
		)
		, Rawdata AS (
			SELECT [SR], [Particulars], [FTDTon], [FTDPercentage], [MTDTon], [MTDpercentage] FROM (
				SELECT 1 AS [Sr], 'Total SMS Heats Tap' AS [Particulars], [HeatID] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage], [HeatID_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] FROM EAF
				UNION 
				SELECT 2 AS [Sr], 'Liquid Metal' AS [Particulars], [LiquidMetalWeight] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage], [LiquidMetalWeight_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] FROM LRF
				UNION
				SELECT 3 AS [Sr], 'Heat Size (LM)' AS [Particulars], [Avg_LiquidMetalWeight] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage], [Avg_LiquidMetalWeight_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] FROM LRF
				UNION
				SELECT 4 AS [Sr], 'CCM Heats Cast' AS [Particulars], [HeatID] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage], [HeatID_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] FROM CCM
				UNION 
				SELECT 5 AS [Sr], 'Prime Production (12m)' AS [Particulars], [TotalProduction] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage], [TotalProduction_MTD], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] FROM CCM
				UNION
				SELECT 6 AS [Sr], 'Prime Production (6m)' AS [Particulars], [TotalProduction_1] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage], [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] FROM CCM
				UNION
				SELECT 7 AS [Sr], 'Total Prime Production' AS [Particulars], [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage], [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] FROM CCM
				UNION
				SELECT 8 AS [Sr], 'Liquid Metal Yield' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([LiquidMetalWeight] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([LiquidMetalWeight_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN LRF ON EAF_1.[reportdate] = LRF.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 9 AS [Sr], 'Caster Yield' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [LiquidMetalWeight] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) / CAST([LiquidMetalWeight] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN [LiquidMetalWeight_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] +[TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([LiquidMetalWeight_MTD] AS FLOAT)  * 100 END AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 10 AS [Sr], 'Charge to Billet Yield' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [Totalcharge] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN [totalcharge_mtd] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([TotalProduction_MTD]+[TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF_1.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 11 AS [Sr], 'HBI' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[Totalcharge] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([HBIDRI] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[Totalcharge] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDPercentage], CAST([HBIDRI] AS FLOAT) AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[totalcharge_mtd] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([HBIDRI_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[totalcharge_mtd] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [MTDPercentage], CAST([HBIDRI_MTD] AS FLOAT) AS [MTDTon] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF_1.[reportdate] = EAF.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 12 AS [Sr], 'PIG IRON/Pool Iron/Granshot' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([PigIron] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDPercentage],[PigIron] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([PigIron_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [MTDPercentage], [PigIron_MTD] AS [MTDTon] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF_1.[reportdate] = EAF.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 13 AS [Sr], 'Cold DRI' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([ColdDRI] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDPercentage], CAST([ColdDRI] AS FLOAT) AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([ColdDRI_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [MTDPercentage], [ColdDRI_MTD] AS [MTDTon] 
				FROM EAF_1
				UNION
				SELECT 14 AS [Sr], 'END CUTS (External+Internal)' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([EndCuts] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDPercentage],[EndCuts] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([EndCuts_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [MTDPercentage], [EndCuts_MTD] AS [MTDTon] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF_1.[reportdate] = EAF.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 15 AS [Sr], 'Skull (External+Internal)' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST([Scull] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDPercentage],[Scull] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST([Scull_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [MTDPercentage], [Scull_MTD] AS [MTdTon] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF_1.[reportdate] = EAF.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 16 AS [Sr], 'External Scrap'
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Ext] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [FTDPercentage],[Ext] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Ext_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) * 100 END AS [MTDPercentage], [Ext_MTD] AS [MTDTon]
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF_1.[reportdate] = EAF.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 17 AS [Sr], 'TOTAL CHARGE' AS [Particulars], NULL AS [FTDPercentage], [TotalCharge] AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage], [TotalCharge_MTD] AS [MTDTon] FROM EAF_1 
				UNION 
				SELECT 18 AS [Sr], 'EAF POWER' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0  AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([PowerMwh] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS float) * 1000 END AS [FTDTon]
					, [PowerMWH] * 1000 AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = CAST(0 AS FLOAT) THEN 0 ELSE CAST([PowerMWH_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS float) * 1000 END AS [MTDTon]
					, [PowerMWH_MTD] * 1000 AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 19 AS [Sr], 'LRF POWER' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([PowerMwh] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS float) * 1000 END AS [FTDTon], [PowerMWH] * 1000 AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([PowerMWH_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS float) * 1000 END AS [MTDTon]
					, [PowerMWH_MTD] * 1000 AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 20 AS [Sr], 'Aux Power' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([SMSAuxWithoutO2] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS float) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [SMSauxwithoutO2]  AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([SMSAuxWithoutO2_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS float) END AS [MTDTon]
					, [SMSAuxWithoutO2_MTD]  AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM PowCons FULL JOIN CCM ON PowCons.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 21 AS [Sr], 'O2 Power' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([OxygenPlant4A] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS float)  END AS [FTDTon]
					, [OxygenPlant4A]  AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([OxygenPlant4A_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS float)  END AS [MTDTon]
					, [OxygenPlant4A_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM PowCons FULL JOIN CCM ON PowCons.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 22 AS [Sr], 'TOTAL' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(EAF.[PowerMWH] + LRF.[PowerMWH] + PowCons.[SMSAuxWithoutO2] + [OxygenPlant4A] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS float)/* * 1000*/ END AS [FTDTon]
					, (EAF.[PowerMWH] + LRF.[PowerMWH] + [SMSAuxWithoutO2] + [OxygenPlant4A]) /** 1000 */AS FTDPercentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(EAF.[PowerMWH_MTD] + LRF.[PowerMWH_MTD] + [SMSAuxWithoutO2_MTD] + [OxygenPlant4A_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS float) /** 1000 */END AS [MTDTon]
					, (EAF.[PowerMWH_MTD] + LRF.[PowerMWH_MTD] + [SMSAuxWithoutO2_MTD] + [OxygenPlant4A_MTD]) /** 1000*/ AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN LRF ON EAF.[ReportDate] = LRF.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN PowCons ON PowCons.[ReportDate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 23 AS [Sr], 'EAF ELECTRODS' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Eaf_Electrodes] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [Eaf_Electrodes] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([EAF_Electrodes_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS MTDTon
					, [EAF_Electrodes_MTD] AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 24 AS [Sr], 'LRF ELECTRODS' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([LRf_Electrodes] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [LRF_Electrodes] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([LRF_Electrodes_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS MTDTon
					, [LRF_Electrodes_MTD] AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 25 AS [Sr], 'Top Carbon EAF' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Top_Carbon_EAF] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [Top_Carbon_EAF] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Top_Carbon_EAF_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS MTDTon
					, [Top_Carbon_EAF_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 26 AS [Sr], 'Carbon Injection EAF' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Carbon_Injection_EAF] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [Carbon_Injection_EAF] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Carbon_Injection_EAF_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, [Carbon_Injection_EAF_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 27 AS [Sr], 'CAC LRF' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([CACLRF] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [CACLRF] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([CACLRF_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, [CACLRF_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 28 AS [Sr], 'Oxygen' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Oxygen] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [Oxygen] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Oxygen_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, [Oxygen_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 29 AS [Sr], 'NG' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([NG] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon], [NG] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([NG_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, [NG_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 30 AS [Sr], 'Lime EAF' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([BIN1LimeConsumption] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [BIN1LimeConsumption] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([BIN1LimeConsumption_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS MTDTon
					, [BIN1LimeConsumption_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 31 AS [Sr], 'Dolime' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([BIN2DoloConsumption] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [BIN2DoloConsumption] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([BIN2DoloConsumption_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, [BIN2DoloConsumption_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 32 AS [Sr], 'Lime LRF (Tapping+LF)' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(ISNULL([Lime], 0) + ISNULL(EAF.[LimeEAF], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, ISNULL([Lime], 0) + ISNULL(EAF.[LimeEAF], 0) AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(ISNULL([Lime_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(EAF.[LimeEAF_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, ISNULL([Lime_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(EAF.[LimeEAF_MTD], 0) AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF.[ReportDate] = LRF.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 33 AS [Sr], 'Flourspar' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Flourspar] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [Flourspar] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([Flourspar_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, [Flourspar_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 34 AS [Sr], 'TOTAL SiMn' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMn], 0) + ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMnn], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[SiMn], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[SiMnn], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMn], 0) + ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMnn], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[SiMn], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[SiMnn], 0) AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMn_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMnn_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[SiMn_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[SiMnn_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMn_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMnn_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[SiMn_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[SiMnn_MTD], 0) AS MTD_Percentage
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN EAF ON LRF.[ReportDate] = EAF.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 35 AS [Sr], 'TOTAL FeSi' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionFeSi], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[FeSi], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionFeSi], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[FeSi], 0) AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST(ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionFeSi_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[FeSi_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, ISNULL(EAF.[LadleAdditionFeSi_MTD], 0) + ISNULL(LRF.[FeSi_MTD], 0) AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF.[ReportDate] = LRF.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 36 AS [Sr], 'AL ingots' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([ALingots] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon]
					, [ALingots] AS FTD_Percentage
					, CASE WHEN [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE CAST([ALingots_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon]
					, [ALingots_MTD] AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate]
				UNION
				SELECT 37 AS [Sr], 'Cal Time' AS [Particulars], [Cal_Time] AS [FTDTon], 100 AS FTD_Percentage, [Cal_Time_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 100 AS MTD_Percentage FROM time_data
				UNION
				SELECT 38 AS [Sr], 'Planned Shutdown' AS [Particulars], [Planned_Shutdown] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS FTD_Percentage, [Planned_Shutdown_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS MTD_Percentage FROM powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 39 AS [Sr], 'Forced Shutdown' AS [Particulars], [Forced_shutdown] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS FTD_Percentage, [Forced_Shutdown_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS MTD_Percentage FROM EAF
				UNION 
				SELECT 40 AS [Sr], 'Available Time (Cal TIme Planned SD)' AS [Particulars]
					, ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0)- (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0)+ ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown],0)) AS [FTDTon]
					, /*CASE WHEN [Cal_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ([Cal_time] - ([Planned_Shutdown] + [Forced_Shutdown]) / [Cal_time]) * 100 END*/ 100 AS FTD_Percentage
					, ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0)- (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)+ ISNULL([Forced_shutdown_MTD],0)) AS [MTDTon]
					, /*(CASE WHEN [Cal_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE([Cal_time_MTD] - ([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] + [Forced_shutdown_MTD]) / [Cal_time_MTD]) * 100 END*/ 100 AS MTD_Percentage FROM Powoff CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data
				UNION 
				SELECT 41 AS [Sr], 'Std Delay' AS [Particulars]
					, [STD_Delay] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([STD_Delay] AS FLOAT) / ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0)) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, [STD_Delay_MTD]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([STD_Delay_MTD] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 42 AS [Sr], 'Opm' AS [Particulars]
					, [Opm] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Opm] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, [Opm_MTD]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Opm_MTD] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 43 AS [Sr], 'ELECT' AS [Particulars]
					, [Elect] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Elect] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, [Elect_MTD]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Elect_MTD] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 44 AS [Sr], 'MECH' AS [Particulars]
					, [Mech] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Mech] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, [Mech_MTD]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Mech_MTD] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 45 AS [Sr], 'TRM' AS [Particulars]
					, [Trm] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Trm] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, [Trm_MTD]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Trm_MTD] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 46 AS [Sr], 'CRANE MAINT' AS [Particulars]
					, [CRANE_MAINT] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([CRANE_MAINT] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, [CRANE_MAINT_MTD]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([CRANE_MAINT_MTD] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 47 AS [Sr], 'WTP/VMD/MRSS' AS [Particulars]
					, [WTP_VMD_MRSS] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([WTP_VMD_MRSS] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, [WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 48 AS [Sr], 'PPC/Commercial' AS [Particulars]
					, [PPC_Commercial] AS [FTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([PPC_Commercial] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, [PPC_Commercial_MTD]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([PPC_Commercial_MTD] AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 49 AS [Sr], 'Total Delays + Std Delays' AS [Particulars]
					, IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0)) AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST(IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0)) AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration_MTD], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0))
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST(IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration_MTD], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0)) AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff CROSS JOIN arcdly 
				UNION 
				SELECT 50 AS [Sr], 'Availability (Net Time / Cal Time)' AS [Particulars]
					, (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0)) AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE (CAST((ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0)) AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) * 100) END AS FTD_Percentage
					, (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0)) AS [MTDTon]
					, CASE WHEN ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) = 0 THEN CAST(0 AS FLOAT) ELSE (CAST(ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0)) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0)) AS FLOAT) / (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) * 100) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff CROSS JOIN arcdly
				UNION 
				SELECT 51 AS [Sr], 'Power ON Time Delay / Planning Delay', [Arcingdelayduration] AS FTDTon, CASE WHEN ((ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0))) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST([Arcingdelayduration] AS FLOAT) / ((ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0))) * 100 END AS FTD_Percentage, [Arcingdelayduration_MTD] AS MTDTon, CASE WHEN (ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST([Arcingdelayduration_MTD] AS FLOAT )/ ((ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0))) *100 END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM arcdly CROSS JOIN DLY CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff
				UNION 
				SELECT 52 AS [Sr], 'TPH (BL / Cycle time)', (CASE WHEN ( ((CAST((ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0)) AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF.[HeatID] AS FLOAT)) / CAST(60 AS FLOAT)) ) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST([TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS FLOAT) / ((CAST((ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0)) AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF.[HeatID] AS FLOAT) ) / CAST(60 as float)) END) / CAST(EAF.[HeatID] AS FLOAT) AS FTDTon,NULL AS FTDPercentage
					, (CASE WHEN ( ((CAST((ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0)) AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF.[HeatID_MTD] AS FLOAT)) / CAST(60 AS FLOAT)) ) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST([TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS FLOAT) / ((CAST((ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0)) AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF.[HeatID_MTD] AS FLOAT) ) / CAST(60 as float)) END) / CAST(EAF.[HeatID_MTD] AS FLOAT) AS MTDTon,NULL AS MTDPercentage FROM CCM CROSS JOIN EAF CROSS JOIN DLY CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN powoff CROSS JOIN arcdly
				UNION 
				SELECT 53 AS [Sr], 'Cycle Time',CASE WHEN [HeatID] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST((ISNULL([Cal_time] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays], 0)) AS FLOAT) / CAST([HeatID] AS FLOAT) END AS FTDTon,NULL AS FTDPercentage,CASE WHEN [HeatID_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST((ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD] ,0) - (ISNULL([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] ,0) + ISNULL([Forced_Shutdown_MTD] ,0))) - IIF(ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0) = 0 , ISNULL([totaldelayduration], 0) ,ISNULL([Total_Delays_MTD], 0)) AS FLOAT) / CAST([HeatID_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS MTDTon,0.0 AS MTDPercentage FROM EAF CROSS JOIN time_data CROSS JOIN DLY CROSS JOIN powoff CROSS JOIN arcdly
				UNION 
				SELECT 54 AS [Sr], 'TTT (Calendar Time/Heat)' AS [Particulars], ROUND(CAST(ISNULL([Cal_time], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(ISNULL([HeatID], 0) AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDTon],NULL AS FTD_Percentage, ROUND(CAST(ISNULL([Cal_time_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(ISNULL([HeatID_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTDTon],NULL AS MTD_Percentage FROM time_data CROSS JOIN EAF
				UNION 
				SELECT 55 AS [Sr], 'Avg Power ON Time' AS [Particulars], [Avg_PoweronTIme] AS [FTDTon], NULL AS FTD_Percentage, [Avg_PoweronTIme_MTD] AS [MTDTon],NULL AS MTD_Percentage FROM EAF
				UNION 
				SELECT 56 AS [Sr], 'Avg Power OFF Time' AS [Particulars], [Avg_PoweroffTIme] AS [FTDTon], NULL AS FTD_Percentage, [Avg_PoweroffTIme_MTD] AS [MTDTon],NULL AS MTD_Percentage FROM EAF
				UNION 
				SELECT 57 AS [Sr], 'Avg Power Drawn' AS [Particulars], [Avg_PowerMW] AS [FTDTon], NULL AS FTD_Percentage, [Avg_PowerMW_MTD] AS [MTDTon],NULL AS MTD_Percentage FROM EAF
			) AS T 
		)
		INSERT INTO [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary]([EntryDateTime],[ReportDate],[Particulars],[Type],[UOM],[FTDPercentage],[FTDTon],[MTDPercentage],[MTDTon],[Source],[Reportdatetext])
		SELECT GETDATE(),@ReportDate, coalesce(rd.Particulars, PM.Particulars),PM.[Type],PM.UOM,ISNULL(RD.FTDPercentage,0.0) AS [FTDPercentage],ISNULL(RD.FTDTon,0.0) AS [FTDTon],ISNULL(RD.MTDPercentage,0.0) AS [MTDPercentage],ISNULL(RD.MTDTon,0.0) AS [MTDTon],'T-SQL',format(@ReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd') FROM RawData AS RD
		RIGHT JOIN [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Particulars_Masters] as PM WITH(NOLOCK) ON PM.Particulars = RD.Particulars AND PM.[IsDeleted] = 0
		ORDER BY PM.CreatedOn, [Sr]

		-- Calculating BestDay And BestMonth
		SELECT @BestDay = [ReportDate], @DayProduction = [FTDTon] FROM (
			SELECT TOP 1 [ReportDate], [FTDTon] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE [Particulars] = 'Total Prime Production' AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			ORDER BY [FTDTon] DESC
		) AS t;

		SELECT @BestMonth = [ReportDate], @HighestProduction = [MTDTon] FROM (
			SELECT TOP 1 [ReportDate], [MTDTon] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE [Particulars] = 'Total Prime Production' AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			ORDER BY [MTDTon] DESC
		) AS t;

		;WITH BestDayData AS (
			SELECT [Particulars],[FTDTon] AS BestDayValue,[ReportDate] AS BestDay FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE [ReportDate] = @BestDay
		),
			BestMonthData AS (
			select [Particulars],[MTDTon] as BestMonthValue,[ReportDate] AS BestMonth from [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK)
			where [ReportDate] = @BestMonth
		),
		BestValues AS (
			SELECT BD.[Particulars],BD.BestDayValue,BMD.BestMonthValue,BD.BestDay,BMD.BestMonth
			FROM BestDayData BD
			JOIN BestMonthData BMD ON BD.[Particulars] = BMD.[Particulars]
		)
		-- Update all rows for best day with best month values
		UPDATE SMS SET SMS.BestDay = BV.BestDayValue,SMS.BestMonth = BV.BestMonthValue,SMS.BestDayDate = BV.BestDay,SMS.BestMonthDate = BV.BestMonth
		FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] SMS
		LEFT JOIN BestValues BV ON SMS.Particulars = BV.Particulars
		WHERE SMS.IsDeleted = 0 and ReportDate = @ReportDate;

		/*---Get value for availabiltiy---*/
		; WITH CTE AS (
			SELECT [mtdton] FROM [SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Particulars] = 'Availability (Net Time / Cal Time)' AND [ReportDate] = @BestMonth
		), CTE1 AS (
			SELECT [Mtdton] FROM [SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Particulars] = 'Available Time (Cal Time Planned SD)' AND [ReportDate] = @BestMonth 
		) SELECT @Available = CAST(IIF (ISNULL(CTE1.[MTDTon], 0) = 0, 0, CAST(ISNULL(CTE.[MTDTon], 0) AS FLOAT) / CTE1.[MTDTon]) * 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) FROM CTE CROSS JOIN CTE1;

		/*--Get value for Ladle--*/
		SELECT @LadleSequnce = [LadleSequence], @LadleDate = [HeatReportDate] FROM (
			SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL([LadleSequence], 0) AS [LadleSequence], [HeatReportDate] FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY [LadleSequence] DESC
		) AS t;

		/*---Get data from highest production entry table---*/
		SELECT @EntryDate = [EntryDateTime], @highProd = [HighestProduction], @highProd_date = [HighestProductionDate], @dayProd = [DayProduction], @dayProd_date = [DayProductionDate], @avail = [Availability], @AvailDate = [AvailabilityDate], @Ladleseq = [LongestSequence], @LadleseqDATE = [LongestSequenceDate], @Reject = [Rejections]/*, @RejectDate = [RejectionDate]*/, @Shell_Life = [ShellLife]/*, @Shell_LifeDAte = [ShellLifeDate]*/, @LAdle_Life = [LadleLife]/*, @Ladle_LifeDate = [LadleLifeDate]*/ 
		FROM [dbo].[Highest_Production_Entry] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'NEW';
		SELECT @Rejection = 0, @ShellLife = 0, @LadleLife = 0
		--SELECT @HighestProduction , @highProd,@BestMonth, @highprod_date, @AvailDate , @Available , @avail, @DayProduction , @dayProd, @BestDay, @dayProd_date, @LadleSequnce , @Ladleseq, @LadleDate, @LadleseqDATE
		
		
		/*---When Highest value available for any factor of Highest Production entry---*/
		IF  (@HighestProduction > @highProd OR @BestMonth != @highprod_date) OR (@Available > @avail OR @BestMonth != @AvailDate ) OR (@DayProduction > @dayProd OR @BestDay != @dayProd_date) OR (@LadleSequnce > @Ladleseq OR @LadleDate != @LadleseqDATE)
		BEGIN
			IF @HighestProduction > @highProd OR @BestMonth != @highprod_date 
			BEGIN
				SELECT @highProd = @HighestProduction, @highProd_date = @BestMonth, @text = @text + ', HighestProduction';
			END
			IF @Available > @avail OR @BestMonth != @AvailDate 
			BEGIN
				SELECT @avail = @Available, @AvailDate = @BestMonth, @text = @text + ', Availability';
			END
			IF @DayProduction > @dayProd OR @BestDay != @dayProd_date
			BEGIN
				SELECT @dayProd = @DayProduction, @dayProd_date = @BestDay, @text = @text + ', DayProduction';
			END
			IF @LadleSequnce > @Ladleseq OR @LadleDate != @LadleseqDATE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Ladleseq = @LadleSequnce, @LadleseqDATE = @LadleDate, @text = @text + ', LongestSequence';
			END
			IF @Rejection > @Reject 
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Reject = @Rejection/*, @RejectDate = @RejectionDate*/, @text = @text + ', Rejections';
			END
			IF @ShellLife > @Shell_Life
			BEGIN
				SELECT @Shell_Life = @ShellLife/*, @Shell_LifeDate = @ShellLifeDate*/, @text = @text + ', ShellLife';
			END
			IF @LadleLife > @LAdle_Life
			BEGIN
				SELECT @LAdle_Life = @LadleLife/*, @Ladle_LifeDate = @LadleLifeDate*/, @text = @text + ', LadleLife';
			END
			--(SELECT [HighestProduction], [Availability], [DayProduction], [LongestSequence] FROM [dbo].[Highest_Production_Entry] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'New')
			UPDATE [dbo].[Highest_Production_Entry] SET [Status] = 'Entered' WHERE [Status] = 'New' AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
			
			
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[Highest_Production_Entry] ([ReportDate], [EntryDateTime], [HighestProduction], [HighestProductionDate], [DayProduction], [DayProductionDate], [Availability], [AvailabilityDate], [LongestSequence], [LongestSequenceDate], [Rejections]/*, [RejectionsDate]*/, [ShellLife]/*, [ShellLifeDate]*/, [LadleLife]/*, [LadleLifeDate]*/, [BestAspect], [Status], [Source])
			SELECT CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), GETDATE(), @highProd, @highProd_date, @dayProd, @dayProd_date, @avail, @AvailDate, @Ladleseq, @LadleseqDATE, @Reject/*, @rejectDate*/, @Shell_Life/*, @Shell_LifeDate*/, @LAdle_Life/*, @Ladle_LifeDate*/, RIGHT(@text, LEN(@text) - 2), 'New', 'T-SQL'
			FROM [dbo].[Highest_Production_Entry] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [EntryDateTime] = @EntryDate
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SP_SMS_Producation_Summary | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[SP_SMS_Producation_Summary]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

	END CATCH

END
```

```sql
    @HeatNo = '',
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Twinkle Patel
-- Create date: 12-09-2025
-- Description:	Splits Billets from CCM to Inventory
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Xbatch_SplitsBillets_From_CCM_To_Inventory]
	@HeatNo varchar(36)='',
	@ItemName Varchar(500)='',
	@MaterialGrade varchar(100)='',
	@Grade Varchar(500)=''
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	--delete from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl where LotNumber='1505207'
	DECLARE @Qty INT ;
	Declare @RecievedDate datetime;
	Declare @UOMID varchar(36);
	Declare @TotalProduction numeric(18,2);
	Declare @MaterialID Varchar(36);
	DEclare @InventoryID Varchar(36)
	DEclare @GradeID Varchar(36)
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT @MaterialID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@ItemName;
		SELECT @UOMID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]='Qty'
		SELECT @GradeID = [ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = @Grade;
		select @Qty=TotalBilletsCount,
		  @TotalProduction=TotalProduction,
		  @RecievedDate = Endtime
		from CCM_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) where heatid=@HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
	
		;WITH Numbers AS (
			SELECT TOP (@Qty) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n
			FROM sys.all_objects
		)

		insert into XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl(ID,ParentID,LotNumber,SublotNumber,GradeID,Quantity,UOMID,ReceivedDate,ItemSource,MaterialGrade,BilletReceivedBy,BilletLength)
		SELECT
			newid(),
			@MaterialID,
			@HeatNo AS heat_no,
			CONCAT(@HeatNo, '_', RIGHT('00' + CAST(n AS VARCHAR(3)), 2)) AS sublot_no,
			@Grade,
			1,
			@UOMID,
			@RecievedDate,
			'Receive',
			@MaterialGrade as materiaGrade,
			'CCM' as BilletReceivedBy,
			12 as BilletLength    
		FROM Numbers;
		WITH BilletsNo AS (
			SELECT TOP (@Qty) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n
			FROM sys.all_objects)

		INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl]
					([ID]
					,[HeatNo]
					,[CreatedBy]
					,[CreatedOn]
					,[Source]
					,[LotNumber]
					,[SublotNumber]
					,[Quantity]
					,[UOMID]
					,[MaterialID]
					,[GradeID])
			SELECT newid(),@HeatNo AS heat_no,'',@RecievedDate,'T-SQL',@HeatNo AS heat_no,CONCAT(@HeatNo, '_', RIGHT('00' + CAST(n AS VARCHAR(3)), 2)) AS sublot_no,1,@UOMID,@MaterialID,@GradeID   
			FROM BilletsNo;	

			insert into XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl(ID,ParentID,BilletNo,SubLotNo,RecievedDate,CurrentStatus,MaterialGrade,RecievedBy,InventoryID,BilletLength)
			SELECT
				NewID(),
				ParentID,
				LotNumber,
				SublotNumber,
				ReceivedDate,
				'Received',
				MaterialGrade,
				'CCM',
				ID,
				'12'	
			FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			where LotNumber=@HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SP_Xbatch_SplitsBillets_From_CCM_To_Inventory | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SP_Xbatch_SplitsBillets_From_CCM_To_Inventory]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
	
END
```

## dbo.SP_Xbatch_YMS_AssignBilletsToStack

**Schema:** dbo

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @GradeNo | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @StackID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @UserID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @HeatNo | varchar(50) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_Xbatch_YMS_AssignBilletsToStack]
    @GradeNo = '',
    @StackID = '',
    @UserID = '',
    @HeatNo = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Xbatch_YMS_AssignBilletsToStack]
   @GradeNo VARCHAR(36)='',   -- Start stack (Xbatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl.id)
    @StackID VARCHAR(36)='' ,
	@UserID VARCHAR(36)='',
	@HeatNo Varchar(50)=''
	-- Grade ID
    
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @ExistingGrade VARCHAR(50),
            @TotalCapacity INT,
            @UsedCapacity INT;
    BEGIN TRY
        -- Step 1: Collect stack info
        SELECT 
            @ExistingGrade =isnull( MAX(mi.MaterialGrade),0),
            @UsedCapacity = COUNT(mi.MaterialGrade),
            @TotalCapacity = SUM(r.Capacity)
        FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl r WITH(NOLOCK)
        LEFT JOIN Xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl mi WITH(NOLOCK) 
               ON mi.LocationID = r.ID
        WHERE r.ParentID = @StackID AND r.[IsDeleted] = 0 ;

        -- Step 2: Validation
        --IF @ExistingGrade IS NOT NULL AND @ExistingGrade <> @GradeNo
        --BEGIN
        --    RAISERROR('Stack already assigned to another grade', 16, 1);
        --    RETURN;
        --END

        IF @UsedCapacity >= @TotalCapacity
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('❌ Stack is already full', 16, 1);
            RETURN;
        END

        -- Step 3: Fill billets until stack is full
        while EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE MaterialGrade = @GradeNo and LotNumber=@HeatNo AND LocationID IS NULL AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
        BEGIN
	        print('In WHile Lopp')
            ;WITH NextFreeLayer AS (
                SELECT TOP 1 r.ID AS LayerID,r.Capacity, COUNT(mi.MaterialGrade) AS Used
                FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl r WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT JOIN Xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl mi WITH(NOLOCK) ON mi.LocationID = r.ID
                WHERE r.ParentID = @StackID AND r.[IsDeleted] = 0
                GROUP BY r.ID, r.Capacity,r.Number--,mi.SublotNumber
                HAVING COUNT(mi.MaterialGrade) < r.Capacity
                ORDER BY r.number--,mi.SublotNumber
            ),
		    NextBillet AS (
                SELECT TOP 1 mi.SublotNumber
                FROM Xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl mi WITH(NOLOCK)
                WHERE mi.MaterialGrade = @GradeNo and LotNumber=@HeatNo
                  AND mi.LocationID IS NULL AND [IsDeleted] = 0
                ORDER BY mi.SubLotNumber
            )
            UPDATE TOP (1) mi
            SET LocationID = nfl.LayerID,InwardDate=getdate(),InwardBy=@UserID,MovementType='Inward'
		    --select * 
            FROM  Xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl  mi
		    JOIN NextBillet nb ON mi.SublotNumber = nb.SublotNumber
            CROSS JOIN NextFreeLayer nfl
            WHERE mi.MaterialGrade = @GradeNo and mi.LotNumber=@HeatNo
              AND mi.LocationID IS NULL
		     -- order by mi.sublotnumber
		     --Update Grade in stack Table
		     Update XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl set GradeType = @GradeNo where id=@StackID
            -- Stop if no more free space in this stack
            IF NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl r WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT JOIN Xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl mi WITH(NOLOCK) ON mi.LocationID = r.ID
                WHERE r.ParentID = @StackID AND r.[IsDeleted] = 0
                GROUP BY r.ID, r.Capacity
                HAVING COUNT(mi.MaterialGrade) < r.Capacity
            )
                BREAK;
        END

        -- Step 4: If billets remain unallocated, just leave them
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE MaterialGrade = @GradeNo and LotNumber=@HeatNo AND LocationID IS NULL AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
        BEGIN
            PRINT '⚠️ Not all billets could be assigned. Remaining billets are unallocated.';
        END
	    --Stpe 5: Maintain History Table

	


	    --DEclare @BilletID Varchar(50), @FromLocation Varchar(50),@AssignedStack Varchar(50)
	    --	DECLARE BilletCursor CURSOR FOR
     --       SELECT ID, LocationID
     --       FROM Xbatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl
     --       WHERE MaterialGrade = @GradeNo and LotNumber=@HeatNo
     --         --AND HeatNo = @HeatNo
     --         AND LocationID IN (
     --               SELECT ID 
     --               FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl 
     --               WHERE ParentID = @StackID
     --         );

     --   OPEN BilletCursor;
     --   FETCH NEXT FROM BilletCursor INTO @BilletID, @FromLocation;

     --   WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
     --   BEGIN
     --       -- Find available layer in target stack
     --       Set @AssignedStack = (select ParentID from XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl where ID=@FromLocation) 

	    --	insert into XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl(ID,ParentID,BilletNo,SubLotNo,RecievedDate,CurrentStatus,MaterialGrade,RecievedBy,InventoryID)
	    --	SELECT
	    --		NewID(),
	    --		ParentID,
	    --		LotNumber,
	    --		SublotNumber,
	    --		ReceivedDate,
	    --		'Received',
	    --		MaterialGrade,
	    --		'CCM',
	    --		ID
	
	    --	FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl
	    --	where LotNumber=@HeatNo





        --   UPDATE XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl
        --        SET StackID = @AssignedStack,
				    --LayerID=@FromLocation,
        --            LocationAssignedDate = GETDATE(),
        --            LocationAssignBy = @UserID,
				    --CurrentStatus='Stacked',
				    --IsInward=1
        --        WHERE InventoryID = @BilletID
              

        --    FETCH NEXT FROM BilletCursor INTO @BilletID, @FromLocation;
        --END

        --CLOSE BilletCursor;
        --DEALLOCATE BilletCursor;

    END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
```
