## dbo.SP_XBatch_YMS_BilletsTransferSummary

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_XBatch_YMS_BilletsTransferSummary  
**Created On:** 2025-09-17 13:21:10  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:02:36  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_XBatch_YMS_BilletsTransferSummary];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:    
-- Create date: 
-- Description:  
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_XBatch_YMS_BilletsTransferSummary]
AS
BEGIN

					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET nocount ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        -- Insert statements for procedure here
        SELECT TOP (100) PERCENT [Name] as [Stack],
            totalcapacity [TotalCapacity],
            gradetype [Grade],
            totalbilletsinwards [TotalBilletInwards],
			TotalLayers [TotalLayers],
            totalcapacity - totalbilletsinwards AS [RemaingCapacity],
            totalbilletsoutward [TotalBilletOutwards],
            heatnos [HeatNo]
        FROM   (
            SELECT NAME,
                (SELECT Sum(capacity) AS Expr1
                FROM   dbo.xbatch_storage_rack_mst_tbl AS r WITH(NOLOCK)
                WHERE  ( parentid = s.id ) AND r.[IsDeleted] = 0)
                AS TotalCapacity,
                gradetype,
                (SELECT Count(i.id) AS Expr1
                FROM   dbo.xbatch_storage_rack_mst_tbl AS r WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN
                dbo.xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl AS i WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON i.locationid = r.id
                    AND i.materialgrade = s.gradetype
                    AND s.id=r.ParentID
                where movementtype = 'inward' AND r.[IsDeleted] = 0) AS TotalBilletsInwards,
                (SELECT Count(DIstinct name) AS Expr1
                FROM   dbo.xbatch_storage_rack_mst_tbl AS r WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN
                dbo.xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl AS i WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON i.locationid = r.id
                    AND i.materialgrade = s.gradetype
                    AND s.id=r.ParentID
                where movementtype = 'inward' AND r.[IsDeleted] = 0) AS TotalLayers,
                (SELECT Count(i.id) AS Expr1
                FROM   dbo.xbatch_storage_rack_mst_tbl AS r WITH(NOLOCK)
                LEFT OUTER JOIN
                dbo.xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl AS i WITH(NOLOCK)
                ON i.locationid = r.id
                    AND i.materialgrade = s.gradetype
                --  AND s.id=r.ParentID
                where movementtype = 'Outward' AND r.[IsDeleted] = 0) AS TotalBilletsOutward,
                Stuff((SELECT DISTINCT ',' + Cast(i.lotnumber AS VARCHAR(50))
                        FROM   dbo.xbatch_storage_rack_mst_tbl AS r WITH(NOLOCK)
                        LEFT OUTER JOIN
                        dbo.xbatch_material_inventory_mst_tbl AS i WITH(NOLOCK)
                        ON i.locationid = r.id
                            AND i.materialgrade = s.gradetype
                            AND s.id=r.ParentID and MovementType='inward'
                        WHERE r.[Isdeleted] = 0
                    FOR xml path(''), type).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') AS HeatNos
            FROM   dbo.xbatch_storage_area_mst_tbl AS s WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE  ( IsDeleted=0 and parentid = 'DC6EF45C-E82B-4B86-AF22-DB08AF77C4E6' )
        ) AS p
        ORDER  BY NAME
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
	    DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SP_XBatch_YMS_BilletsTransferSummary | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SP_XBatch_YMS_BilletsTransferSummary]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	    RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.SP_Xbatch_YMS_GenerateLayersForStack

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_Xbatch_YMS_GenerateLayersForStack  
**Created On:** 2025-09-11 07:53:13  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:14:02  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @StackID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_Xbatch_YMS_GenerateLayersForStack]
    @StackID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Xbatch_YMS_GenerateLayersForStack]
    @StackID varchar(36)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @StartCapacity INT,
            @Decrement INT,
            @MinCapacity INT,
            @CurrentCapacity INT,
            @LayerNum INT = 1,
			@LayerName Varchar(36),
			@StackName varchar(Max),
			@Parentid varchar(36)
    BEGIN TRY
        -- Get configuration for this stack
        SELECT top 1 @StartCapacity = StartCapacity,
               @Decrement = DecrementValue,
               @MinCapacity = MinCapacity
        FROM LayerConfiguration WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0;
     --   print @StartCapacity
	    --Print @Decrement
	    --Print @MinCapacity
	    --set @StackID = '8F1248AD-8102-462B-8351-A0B1CF141DE3'
	    Select @StackName=Name from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=@StackID and ParentID='DC6EF45C-E82B-4B86-AF22-DB08AF77C4E6' AND [IsDeleted] = 0

	    select @Parentid=Parentid from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where ID=@StackID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
	
        -- Initialize capacity
        SET @CurrentCapacity = @StartCapacity;
	    Set @LayerName= @StackName + '_L'

        -- Clear existing layers (optional: only if you want fresh insert each time)
        DELETE FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @StackID;

        -- Loop to generate layers
	    If @Parentid='DC6EF45C-E82B-4B86-AF22-DB08AF77C4E6'
	    BEGIN
            WHILE @CurrentCapacity >= @MinCapacity 
            BEGIN
		        --print 'insert'
                INSERT INTO XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl(parentid, Number, Capacity,Name,IsEnabled)
                VALUES (@StackID, @LayerNum, @CurrentCapacity,@LayerName+convert(varchar,@LayerNum),'true');
		        --select @StackID, @LayerNum, @CurrentCapacity,@LayerName+convert(varchar,@LayerNum),'true'
                SET @CurrentCapacity = @CurrentCapacity - @Decrement;
                SET @LayerNum = @LayerNum + 1;
            END
	    END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
	    DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SP_Xbatch_YMS_GenerateLayersForStack | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SP_Xbatch_YMS_GenerateLayersForStack]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	    RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END;
--select * from XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl order by CreatedOn desc
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Xbatch_YMS_U_OutwardLocation]
	@ID varchar(36),
	@Userid varchar(36)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	Declare @HeatNo varchar(36),@GradeNo varchar(36),@Stackid varchar(36),@LocationID Varchar(36),@StackName varchar(Max),@LocationName Varchar(Max)
	BEGIN TRY
		select @HeatNo=LotNumber,@GradeNo=MaterialGrade,@Stackid=(select ID from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=(select ParentID from XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=LocationID AND [IsDeleted] = 0) AND [IsDeleted] = 0),@LocationID=LocationID
		from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl
		where id=@ID AND [IsDeleted] = 0

		set @StackName = (select Name from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=@Stackid AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
		Set @Locationname=(select name from XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=@LocationID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)



		insert into XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl(ID,ParentID,BilletNo,SubLotNo,RecievedDate,CurrentStatus,MaterialGrade,RecievedBy,InventoryID,StackID,LayerID,LocationAssignedDate,ActionBy)
		SELECT
			NewID(),
			ParentID,
			LotNumber,
			SublotNumber,
			Getdate(),
			'Outward',
			MaterialGrade,
			@LocationName,
			ID,
			(select name from XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id= @stackid AND [IsDeleted] = 0),
			(select name from XBatch_OutwardLocation_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id=OutwardLocation AND [IsDeleted] = 0),
			Getdate(),
			(select name from XStudio_Configuration..XStudio_User_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) where id= @UserID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
			
		FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
		where LotNumber=@HeatNo and MaterialGrade=@GradeNo and ID=@ID AND [IsDeleted] = 0

		UPdate XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl set MovementType='outward',LocationID=NULL,OutwardDate=Getdate(),Outwardby=@Userid,Quantity=0 where id=@ID
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SP_Xbatch_YMS_U_OutwardLocation | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[SP_Xbatch_YMS_U_OutwardLocation]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.sp_Xstudio_XMES_RM_CampaignPlan_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** sp_Xstudio_XMES_RM_CampaignPlan_USP  
**Created On:** 2026-04-03 09:45:14  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-04 12:07:05  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @recordid | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[sp_Xstudio_XMES_RM_CampaignPlan_USP]
    @recordid = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_Xstudio_XMES_RM_CampaignPlan_USP]
(
    @recordid as varchar(36)
)
as
BEGIN

  

  UPDATE XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst 
  set MaxNoOfBundles= 
   (select  SUM(MaxNoOfBundles) from XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn where IsDeleted=0 and CampaignId IS NULL),
   MinNoOfBundles=(select  SUM(MinNoOfBundles) from XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn where IsDeleted=0 and CampaignId IS NULL)
   ,
   MinQtytoRollMT=(select  SUM(MinQtytoRollMT) from XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn
     where IsDeleted=0 and CampaignId IS NULL),
   MaxQtytoRollMT=(select  SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT)from XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn  where IsDeleted=0 and CampaignId IS NULL),
   Status='Released'
     WHERE CampaignId IS NULL 
  AND isdeleted = 0;




  UPDATE XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn
  SET CampaignId = (
      SELECT 'CP' + CAST(COUNT(CampaignId) + 1 AS VARCHAR(10)) + '_' + FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'ddMMyyyy') 
      FROM XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst WITH (NOLOCK) 
      WHERE isdeleted = 0 AND CAST(createdon as DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
)
WHERE CampaignId IS NULL 
  AND isdeleted = 0;

END
```

## dbo.SP_YMS_StoarageCapacityDetails_With_TotalHeatNo

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** SP_YMS_StoarageCapacityDetails_With_TotalHeatNo  
**Created On:** 2025-09-11 07:53:09  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:14:30  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[SP_YMS_StoarageCapacityDetails_With_TotalHeatNo];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Twinkle Patel
-- Create date: 05-09-2025
-- Description: Display Total Stack Capacity against Total HeatNo
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_YMS_StoarageCapacityDetails_With_TotalHeatNo] --'Stack A'
--@Stack varchar(50)
	
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	DECLARE @cols NVARCHAR(MAX), @sql NVARCHAR(MAX);
    BEGIN TRY
        -- 1. Collect dynamic layer list (from "Number" = layer no)
        SELECT @cols = STUFF((
            SELECT ', [L' + CAST(Number AS VARCHAR) + ']'
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT Number
                FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
                WHERE ParentID IN (
                    SELECT sr.id 
                    FROM XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl sr WITH(NOLOCK)
                    JOIN XBatch_Store_Mst_Tbl s WITH(NOLOCK) ON s.id = sr.ParentID
                    WHERE s.name = 'Billet Yard Storage' AND sr.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND s.[IsDeleted] = 0
                 ) AND [IsDeleted] = 0
            ) t
            ORDER BY Number   -- ✅ allowed now because inside derived table
            FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')
        ,1,2,'');

        -- 2. Build SQL with pivot
        SET @sql = '
        ;WITH Summary AS (
            SELECT stackname,subarea,TotalStackCapacity,Remaining,TotalHeat,totalbillet,
                   ''<a class="LinkColor" href="../XBatch/ControlRoom/EDIT_Page_YMS_Shift_Update_Billet_Location?LID=''+CAST(ID AS VARCHAR)+''&TotalBillet=''+CAST(UpdateLocation AS VARCHAR)+''" target="top">''+CAST(UpdateLocation AS VARCHAR)+''</a>'' updatelocation,
                   number, ID
            FROM (
                SELECT stackname,subarea,TotalStackCapacity,
                       COUNT(DISTINCT LotNumber) TotalHeat,
                       COUNT(mi.id) totalbillet,
                       (SELECT COUNT(SublotNumber)
                        FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl
                        WHERE LocationID IS NULL 
                          AND GradeID = (SELECT ID FROM XStudio_Xbatch..XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl WHERE Name=''Okay'')
                       ) UpdateLocation,
                       storage.id,
                       storage.TotalStackCapacity - COUNT(mi.id) Remaining,
                       number
                FROM (
                    SELECT s.name AreaName, s.capacity TotalAreaCapacity, sa.Number,
                           sr.name StackName, sa.Capacity TotalStackCapacity, sa.name SubArea, sa.id
                    FROM XBatch_Store_Mst_Tbl s
                    LEFT JOIN XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl sr ON sr.ParentID = s.id
                    LEFT JOIN XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl sa ON sa.ParentID = sr.id
                    WHERE s.name = ''Billet Yard Storage'' 
                ) AS storage
                LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl mi ON mi.LocationID = storage.id
                GROUP BY StackName, subarea, TotalStackCapacity, storage.ID, number
            ) Final
        ),
        Final AS (
            SELECT StackName, ''L''+CAST(Number AS VARCHAR) LayerName, ''Capacity'' AS Metric, ISNULL(TotalStackCapacity,0) Value FROM Summary
            UNION ALL
            SELECT StackName, ''L''+CAST(Number AS VARCHAR), ''TotalHeat'', ISNULL(TotalHeat,0) FROM Summary
            UNION ALL
            SELECT StackName, ''L''+CAST(Number AS VARCHAR), ''Remaining'', ISNULL(Remaining,0) FROM Summary
            UNION ALL
            SELECT StackName, ''L''+CAST(Number AS VARCHAR), ''TotalBilletsInStack'', SUM(totalbillet) OVER (PARTITION BY id) FROM Summary
        )
        SELECT StackName, Metric, '+@cols+'
        FROM Final
        PIVOT (
            MAX(Value) FOR LayerName IN ('+@cols+')
        ) p
        ORDER BY StackName, 
                 CASE Metric 
                    WHEN ''Capacity'' THEN 1
                    WHEN ''TotalBilletsInStack'' THEN 2
                    WHEN ''Remaining'' THEN 3
                    WHEN ''TotalHeat'' THEN 4
                    ELSE 99
                 END;
        ';

        -- 3. Execute
        EXEC sp_executesql @sql;
			
	    --select stackname,subarea,TotalStackCapacity,Remaining,TotalHeat,totalbillet,'<a class="LinkColor" href="../XBatch/ControlRoom/EDIT_Page_YMS_Shift_Update_Billet_Location?LID='+ID+'&TotalBillet='+convert(varchar,UpdateLocation)+'" target="top">'+convert(varchar,[UpdateLocation])+'</a>' updatelocation 
	    --from (
	    --select stackname,subarea,TotalStackCapacity,Count(distinct LotNumber) TotalHeat,Count(mi.id) totalbillet ,(select  convert(int,Count(SublotNumber)) [TotalBillet]
	    --from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl
	    --where LocationID IS null and GradeID = (select ID from XStudio_Xbatch..XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl where Name='Okay')
	    -- )UpdateLocation,Storage.id,Storage.TotalStackCapacity - count(mi.id) Remaining
	    --from (
	    --	select s.name AreaName,s.capacity TotalAreaCapacity,sr.name StackName,sa.Capacity TotalStackCapacity,sa.name subarea,sa.id
	    --	from XBatch_Store_Mst_Tbl s left join
	    --		XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl sr on sr.parentid = s.id left join
	    --		XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl sa on sa.ParentID = sr.id 
	    --		where s.name='Billet Yard Storage'
	    --		--order by sr.name

	    --		) as Storage Left join
	    --		XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl mi on mi.LocationID=Storage.id
	    --		group by StackName,subarea,TotalStackCapacity,storage.ID
			
	    --		) Final
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
	    DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : SP_YMS_StoarageCapacityDetails_With_TotalHeatNo | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

	    RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
```

## dbo.sp_YMS_U_Location_Heatwise

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** sp_YMS_U_Location_Heatwise  
**Created On:** 2025-09-11 07:53:00  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:14:37  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @HeatNo | varchar(50) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[sp_YMS_U_Location_Heatwise]
    @HeatNo = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Twinkle Patel
-- Create date: 08-09-2025
-- Description:	Update Location stack wise and Heat Wise
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_YMS_U_Location_Heatwise]
	@HeatNo Varchar(50) ='B50002'
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	BEGIN TRY
		--Total Layer Usage Details
		;WITH LayerUsage AS (
			SELECT s.ID,
				   s.Number,
				   s.name,
				   s.Capacity,
				   COUNT(i.ID) AS Used,
				   s.Capacity - COUNT(i.ID) AS Remaining
			FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl s WITH(NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i WITH(NOLOCK)
				ON s.ID = i.LocationID 
				where i.LotNumber = @HeatNo AND s.[IsDeleted] = 0
			GROUP BY s.ID, s.Number, s.Capacity,s.name
			  order by s.name OFFSET 0 ROWS
			),
			OrderedInventory AS (
				SELECT i.ID,i.lotnumber,
					   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.sublotnumber) AS rn
				FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE i.LocationID IS NULL and LotNumber=@HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			),
			LayerSlots AS (
				SELECT lu.name,
					lu.ID,
					lu.Number,
					lu.capacity,
					lu.Remaining,
					lu.Used,
					SUM(lu.Remaining) OVER (ORDER BY lu.name ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS CumRemaining
				FROM LayerUsage lu
				WHERE lu.Remaining > 0
				order by lu.name OFFSET 0 ROWS
			)
			,
			assign as (
				SELECT MIN(ls.name) AS name,
				   oi.id,
                   MIN(ls.Number) AS LayerNumber
				FROM OrderedInventory oi
				JOIN LayerSlots ls
				ON oi.rn <= ls.CumRemaining
				where oi.LotNumber=@HeatNo
				GROUP BY oi.id--,ls.name
				--order by Name
			),
			Final as (
				select l.id as LocationID,a.ID
				from assign a left join
				LayerSlots l on l.Name=a.name 
			)
			select a.*,i.*
			FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN Final a ON i.id = a.ID
			where i.lotnumber=@heatno

			--UPDATE i
			--	 SET i.LocationID = a.LocationID
			--	FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i
			--	JOIN Final a ON i.id = a.ID
			--	where i.lotnumber=@heatno
	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
	    DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : sp_YMS_U_Location_Heatwise | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
	    EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[sp_YMS_U_Location_Heatwise]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	    RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.Tag_Trend

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** Tag_Trend  
**Created On:** 2025-11-08 10:53:54  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-08 10:53:54  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @TagName | varchar(200) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Tag_Trend]
    @TagName = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[Tag_Trend]
    @TagName VARCHAR(200)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @SplitTags TABLE (TagName VARCHAR(200));

    INSERT INTO @SplitTags
    SELECT TRIM(value)
    FROM STRING_SPLIT(@TagName, ',');

    -- Enable specified tags
    UPDATE TC
    SET TC.IsEnable = 1
    FROM dbo.Tag_Configuration TC
    INNER JOIN @SplitTags ST 
        ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(TC.Name))) = UPPER(ST.TagName)
    WHERE TC.IsDeleted = 0;

    -- Disable others that are currently enabled
    UPDATE TC
    SET TC.IsEnable = 0
    FROM dbo.Tag_Configuration TC
    WHERE 
        TC.IsDeleted = 0
        AND TC.IsEnable = 1
        AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(TC.Name))) NOT IN (
            SELECT UPPER(TagName) FROM @SplitTags
        );
END


--exec dbo.Tag_Trend @TagName = 'consumption'
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE test_usp(@id varchar(36), @name VARCHAR(300))
as 
begin
	;with cte AS (SELECT 1 AS sr, '@Id' AS name, @id AS value UNION SELECT 2 AS sr, '@Name' as Name, @name AS value )
	, cte1 AS (SELECT 'EXEC '+DB_NAME()+'.'+OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID)+'.'+OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS SPname, PARAMETER_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.SPECIFIC_NAME = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
	)
	SELECT c.SPname+' '+STRING_AGG(PARAMETER_NAME+'='+CASE WHEN cte.value IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE ''''+cte.value+'''' END,', ') from cte1 AS c join cte on c.ORDINAL_POSITION = cte.sr GROUP BY c.SPname
end
```

## dbo.usp_Quality_Spectro_BuildWideForSample

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** usp_Quality_Spectro_BuildWideForSample  
**Created On:** 2025-11-05 14:45:05  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-13 11:21:26  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @SampleID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[usp_Quality_Spectro_BuildWideForSample]
    @SampleID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Quality_Spectro_BuildWideForSample]
  @SampleID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
  -- Remove any existing wide row for this sample
  DELETE dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data WHERE SampleID = @SampleID;
 
    ;WITH MeanOnly AS
    (
        SELECT
            R.SampleID,
            R.Element,
            R.ResultValue
        FROM dbo.Quality_Spectro_Result R WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE R.SampleID   = @SampleID
          AND R.ResultType = 'Conc'
          AND R.StatType   = 'Mean'   -- 🔑 ONLY MEAN
    )
    INSERT dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data
    (
        ID,
        SampleID,
        HeatNo,
        SampleName,
        ReportedTime,
        MethodName,
        Instrument,
        SampleType,
        ReceivedTime,
        XMLCreatedon,

        C, Mn, Si, P, S, Cr, Ni, Mo, Cu, Al,
        [As], B, Ca, Co, Nb, Pb, Sn, Ti, V, W,Ce,
        MnPerSi,MnPerS,Ceq, N2,N2PPM, Ag, Bi, Fe, Sb, Ta, Zr,

        Chemist,
        Grade,
        [Status],
        CreatedOn,
		CreatedBy
    )
    SELECT
        NEWID(),
        S.ID,
        S.HeatNo,
        S.SampleName,
        S.XMLCreatedAt,
        S.MethodName,
        S.Instrument,
        S.SampleType,
        S.SampleReceivedTime,
        S.XMLCreatedAt,

        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'C'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Mn' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Si' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'P'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'S'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Cr' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Ni' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Mo' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Cu' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Al' THEN M.ResultValue END),

        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'As' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'B'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Ca' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Co' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Nb' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Pb' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Sn' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Ti' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'V'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'W'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
		MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Ce'  THEN M.ResultValue END),

		MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element='Mn/Si'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
		MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element='Mn/S'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
		MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element='C eq'  THEN M.ResultValue END),
		MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element IN ('N','N2PPM') THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element IN ('N','N2PPM') THEN isnull(M.ResultValue,0) *10000 END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Ag' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Bi' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Fe' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Sb' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Ta' THEN M.ResultValue END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN M.Element = 'Zr' THEN M.ResultValue END),

        S.OperatorName,
        REPLACE(REPLACE(S.MethodName,'Fe-10_',''),'Fe-10',''),
        'Entered',
        GETDATE(),
		'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358'
    FROM dbo.Quality_Spectro_Sample S WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN MeanOnly M
        ON M.SampleID = S.ID
    WHERE S.ID = @SampleID
    GROUP BY
        S.ID,
        S.HeatNo,
        S.SampleName,
        S.XMLCreatedAt,
        S.MethodName,
        S.Instrument,
        S.OperatorName,
        S.SampleType,
        S.SampleReceivedTime;
END
```

## dbo.usp_Quality_Spectro_Cleanup

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** usp_Quality_Spectro_Cleanup  
**Created On:** 2025-12-17 16:31:46  
**Modified On:** 2025-12-17 16:45:52  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @BufferDays | int | NO |  |
| @Source | varchar(50) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[usp_Quality_Spectro_Cleanup]
    @BufferDays = 0,
    @Source = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Quality_Spectro_Cleanup]
(
    @BufferDays INT = 7,
    @Source     VARCHAR(50) = 'T-SQL'
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        /* =====================================================
           1. Soft delete RESULT rows
           ===================================================== */
        UPDATE R
            SET R.IsDeleted = 1,
                R.Source    = @Source
        FROM dbo.Quality_Spectro_Result R
        INNER JOIN dbo.Quality_Spectro_Sample S
            ON S.ID = R.SampleID
        WHERE ISNULL(R.IsDeleted,0) = 0
          AND S.XMLCreatedAt < DATEADD(DAY, -@BufferDays, GETDATE());

        /* =====================================================
           2. Soft delete SAMPLE rows
           ===================================================== */
        UPDATE dbo.Quality_Spectro_Sample
            SET IsDeleted = 1,
                Source    = @Source
        WHERE ISNULL(IsDeleted,0) = 0
          AND XMLCreatedAt < DATEADD(DAY, -@BufferDays, GETDATE());

        /* =====================================================
           3. Soft delete FILE rows
           ===================================================== */
        UPDATE dbo.Quality_Spectro_File
            SET IsDeleted = 1,
                Source    = @Source
        WHERE ISNULL(IsDeleted,0) = 0
          AND ImportedOn < DATEADD(DAY, -@BufferDays, GETDATE());

        COMMIT TRAN;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.usp_Quality_Spectro_IngestFromPath

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** usp_Quality_Spectro_IngestFromPath  
**Created On:** 2025-11-05 15:01:53  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-13 11:21:17  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @FullPath | nvarchar(4000) | NO |  |
| @Checksum | varchar(100) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[usp_Quality_Spectro_IngestFromPath]
    @FullPath = '',
    @Checksum = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Quality_Spectro_IngestFromPath]
  @FullPath  NVARCHAR(4000),
  @Checksum  VARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRAN;

    -- Idempotent: if fully processed, return
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Quality_Spectro_File WHERE Checksum=@Checksum AND IsProcessed=1)
    BEGIN
      COMMIT TRAN; RETURN;
    END;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- File row ensure / update
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @FileID VARCHAR(36);
    DECLARE @FileTbl TABLE (ID VARCHAR(36));

    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Quality_Spectro_File WHERE Checksum=@Checksum)
    BEGIN
      UPDATE dbo.Quality_Spectro_File
        SET ModifiedOn = GETDATE(),
            FilePath   = COALESCE(FilePath, @FullPath),
            DbSyncStatus = CASE
                              WHEN DbSyncStatus IS NULL THEN 'registered'
                              WHEN DbSyncStatus NOT LIKE '%registered%' THEN DbSyncStatus + ';registered'
                              ELSE DbSyncStatus END
      WHERE Checksum=@Checksum;

      SELECT @FileID = ID FROM dbo.Quality_Spectro_File WHERE Checksum=@Checksum;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
      INSERT dbo.Quality_Spectro_File (ID, FileName, FilePath, Checksum, ImportedOn, IsProcessed, DbSyncStatus, Source, CreatedOn)
      OUTPUT inserted.ID INTO @FileTbl(ID)
      VALUES (NEWID(),
              RIGHT(@FullPath, CHARINDEX('\', REVERSE(@FullPath)) - 1),
              @FullPath, @Checksum, GETDATE(), 0, 'registered', 'OES', GETDATE());
      SELECT @FileID = ID FROM @FileTbl;
    END

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Load XML
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @x XML;

    DECLARE @Blob TABLE (BulkColumn VARBINARY(MAX));
    DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX) =
      N'SELECT BulkColumn FROM OPENROWSET(BULK N''' +
      REPLACE(@FullPath, '''', '''''') + N''', SINGLE_BLOB) AS src;';

    BEGIN TRY
      INSERT INTO @Blob(BulkColumn) EXEC(@sql);
      SELECT @x = TRY_CAST(BulkColumn AS XML) FROM @Blob;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
      SET @x = NULL;
    END CATCH;

    IF @x IS NULL
    BEGIN
      UPDATE dbo.Quality_Spectro_File
        SET DbSyncStatus = COALESCE(DbSyncStatus + ';','') + 'xml_load_failed',
            ModifiedOn   = GETDATE()
      WHERE ID = @FileID;

      RAISERROR('XML not readable: %s', 16, 1, @FullPath);
    END

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Header parse
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE
      @SampleName       VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/@Name)[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @OperatorNameAttr VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/@OperatorName)[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @MethodName       VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/@MethodName)[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @MethodVersion    VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/@MethodVersion)[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @Instrument       VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/@Instrument)[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @InstrumentNumber VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/@InstrumentNumber)[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @XMLCreatedAt     DATETIME     = @x.value('(/SampleResults/@XMLCreationDateTime)[1]', 'datetime'),
	  @ReceivedTime     DATETIME     = @x.value('(//SampleResult/@RecalculationDateTime)[1]', 'datetime'),
	  @SampleType        VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/SampleIDs/SampleID[IDName="Sample ID"]/IDValue/text())[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @HeatNo           VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/SampleIDs/SampleID[IDName="Heat No."]/IDValue/text())[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @SamplePoint      VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/SampleIDs/SampleID[IDName="Sample Point"]/IDValue/text())[1]', 'varchar(100)'),
      @OperatorFromID   VARCHAR(100) = @x.value('(//SampleResult/SampleIDs/SampleID[IDName="Operator"]/IDValue/text())[1]', 'varchar(100)');

    DECLARE @OperatorName VARCHAR(100) = COALESCE(NULLIF(@OperatorFromID,''), NULLIF(@OperatorNameAttr,''), NULL);

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Insert sample record
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @SampleID VARCHAR(36);
    DECLARE @S TABLE (ID VARCHAR(36));
	DECLARE @CHEMIST VARCHAR(100) = (SELECT ISNULL(@OperatorName,RIGHT(@SampleName, CHARINDEX(' ', REVERSE(@SampleName) + ' ') - 1)));

    INSERT dbo.Quality_Spectro_Sample
      (ID, SampleName, FileID, XMLCreatedAt, HeatNo, SamplePoint, OperatorName, MethodName, MethodVersion, Instrument, InstrumentNumber, SampleType,SampleReceivedTime,CreatedOn)
    OUTPUT inserted.ID INTO @S(ID)
    VALUES (NEWID(), @SampleName, @FileID, @XMLCreatedAt, @HeatNo, @SamplePoint, @CHEMIST, @MethodName, @MethodVersion, @Instrument, @InstrumentNumber, @SampleType,@ReceivedTime,GETDATE());

    SELECT @SampleID = ID FROM @S;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Result Shredding (Safe numeric conversion)
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
       /* =====================================================
           MeasurementReplicates → REPORTED (replicate-level)
           ===================================================== */
        ;WITH ElemRaw AS
        (
            SELECT
                MR.value('@No','int') AS ReplicateNo,
                E.value('@ElementName','varchar(100)') AS ElementName,
                ER.value('(ResultValue/text())[1]','nvarchar(100)') AS ValueText,
                ER.value('@Unit','varchar(20)') AS Unit
            FROM @x.nodes('/SampleResults/SampleResult/MeasurementReplicates/MeasurementReplicate[@IsDeleted="No"]') R(MR)
            CROSS APPLY R.MR.nodes('Measurement/Elements/Element[@Type=("Element","Pseudo")]') X(E)
            CROSS APPLY X.E.nodes('ElementResult[@StatType="Reported"]') Y(ER)
        ),
        Elem AS
        (
            SELECT
                ReplicateNo,
                ElementName,
                TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,9),
                    NULLIF(
                        REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ValueText,'%',''),'<',''),'≤',''),',',''),'BDL',''),
                        ''
                    )
                ) AS ResultValue,
                Unit
            FROM ElemRaw
        )
        INSERT dbo.Quality_Spectro_Result
        (
            ID, LineName, SampleID, ReplicateNo,
            Element, ResultType, StatType,
            ResultValue, Unit,
            Status, MinLimit, MaxLimit, CreatedOn
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(), ElementName, @SampleID, ReplicateNo,
            ElementName, 'Conc', 'Reported',
            ResultValue, Unit,
            NULL, NULL, NULL, GETDATE()
        FROM Elem
        WHERE ResultValue IS NOT NULL;

        /* =====================================================
           MeasurementStatistics → MEAN (statistics-level)
           ===================================================== */
        ;WITH MeanRaw AS
        (
            SELECT
                E.value('@ElementName','varchar(100)') AS ElementName,
                ER.value('(ResultValue/text())[1]','nvarchar(100)') AS ValueText,
                ER.value('@Unit','varchar(20)') AS Unit
            FROM @x.nodes(
                '/SampleResults/SampleResult/MeasurementStatistics/Measurement/Elements/Element[@Type=("Element","Pseudo")]'
            ) X(E)
            CROSS APPLY X.E.nodes('ElementResult[@StatType="Mean"]') Y(ER)
        ),
        MeanElem AS
        (
            SELECT
                ElementName,
                TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,9),
                    NULLIF(
                        REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ValueText,'%',''),'<',''),'≤',''),',',''),'BDL',''),
                        ''
                    )
                ) AS ResultValue,
                Unit
            FROM MeanRaw
        )
        INSERT dbo.Quality_Spectro_Result
        (
            ID, LineName, SampleID, ReplicateNo,
            Element, ResultType, StatType,
            ResultValue, Unit,
            Status, MinLimit, MaxLimit, CreatedOn
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(), ElementName, @SampleID, -1,
            ElementName, 'Conc', 'Mean',
            ResultValue, Unit,
            NULL, NULL, NULL, GETDATE()
        FROM MeanElem
        WHERE ResultValue IS NOT NULL;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ✅ RESTORED: Wide row build
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    EXEC dbo.usp_Quality_Spectro_BuildWideForSample @SampleID;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Mark processed
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE dbo.Quality_Spectro_File
      SET IsProcessed = 1,
          DbSyncStatus = CASE WHEN DbSyncStatus IS NULL THEN 'ingested'
                              WHEN DbSyncStatus NOT LIKE '%ingested%' THEN DbSyncStatus + ';ingested'
                              ELSE DbSyncStatus END,
          ModifiedOn = GETDATE()
    WHERE ID = @FileID;

    COMMIT TRAN;
  END TRY
  BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
     DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
    RAISERROR(@msg, 16, 1);
  END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.usp_Quality_Spectro_RebuildWide

**Schema:** dbo

**Created On:** 2025-11-05 14:45:46  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:15:06  
**Parameter Count:** 4  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| @ToDate | datetime | NO |  |
| @HeatNo | varchar(100) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[usp_Quality_Spectro_RebuildWide]
    @SampleID = '',
    @FromDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @ToDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @HeatNo = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Quality_Spectro_RebuildWide]
  @SampleID  VARCHAR(36) = NULL,
  @FromDate  DATETIME   = NULL,
  @ToDate    DATETIME   = NULL,
  @HeatNo    VARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
  DECLARE @T TABLE (SampleID VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY);
 
  IF @SampleID IS NOT NULL
    INSERT @T SELECT @SampleID;
  ELSE
    INSERT @T (SampleID)
    SELECT S.ID
    FROM dbo.Quality_Spectro_Sample S WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE (@FromDate IS NULL OR S.XMLCreatedAt >= @FromDate)
      AND (@ToDate   IS NULL OR S.XMLCreatedAt <  @ToDate)
      AND (@HeatNo   IS NULL OR S.HeatNo = @HeatNo);
 
  DECLARE @sid VARCHAR(36);
  DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT SampleID FROM @T;
  OPEN cur;
  FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @sid;
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
      EXEC dbo.usp_Quality_Spectro_BuildWideForSample @sid;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
      -- keep going
    END CATCH
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @sid;
  END
  CLOSE cur; DEALLOCATE cur;
END
```

## dbo.usp_SMS_EAF_LRF_CCM_KPI_PerDate

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** usp_SMS_EAF_LRF_CCM_KPI_PerDate  
**Created On:** 2026-04-28 08:44:20  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-28 08:44:20  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[usp_SMS_EAF_LRF_CCM_KPI_PerDate];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- ============================================================
-- STORED PROCEDURE: usp_SMS_EAF_LRF_CCM_KPI_PerDate
-- PURPOSE : Returns ALL dashboard KPIs in ONE single table
--           grouped by HeatReportDate (daily aggregation)
-- SOURCE  : XStudio_Xbatch.dbo
--           └── XStudio_List_EAF_PER_HEAT_Vw   (EAF data)
--           └── XStudio_List_LRF_Per_Heat_Vw   (LRF data)
--           └── XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_Vw   (CCM data)
-- NOTES   : No date filter applied — returns full history
--           Each row = one calendar date
--           Single result set only
-- ============================================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_SMS_EAF_LRF_CCM_KPI_PerDate]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CTE 1 : EAF — daily aggregation
    --         Source: XStudio_List_EAF_PER_HEAT_Vw
    --         Join key exposed: HeatReportDate (for CCM join)
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    WITH CTE_EAF AS
    (
        SELECT
            CAST(HeatReportDate AS DATE)                                                            AS ReportDate,

            -- Production summary
            COUNT(*)                                                                                AS TotalHeats,
            CAST(SUM(LiquidMetalWeightTon)              AS DECIMAL(14,1))                           AS LM_Total_t,
            CAST(AVG(YieldPercentage)                   AS DECIMAL(10,2))                           AS LM_Yield_pct,

            -- Electricity
            CAST(AVG(PowerMWhPerTon * 1000)             AS DECIMAL(10,1))                           AS EAF_Power_kWh_pt,

            -- Materials per ton
            CAST(AVG(TotalLadleAdditionLime   * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0))  AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS EAF_Lime_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalLadleAdditionDoloinKg * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS EAF_Dolo_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalLadleAdditionFesiinKg * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS EAF_FeSi_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalLadleAdditionSiMninKg * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS EAF_SiMn_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(NutCokeKg)                                                          AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS EAF_NutCoke_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(CarbonConsumptionKg  * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0))      AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS EAF_Carbon_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(CokeInjectionKg      * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0))      AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS EAF_Coke_kgpt,

            -- Utilities per ton
            CAST(AVG(OxygenConsumptionNm3 * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0))      AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS EAF_O2_Nm3pt,
            CAST(AVG(NGConsumptionSm3     * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0))      AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS EAF_NG_Sm3pt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalElectrodeConsumption * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS EAF_Electrode_kgpt

        FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_EAF_PER_HEAT_Vw
        GROUP BY CAST(HeatReportDate AS DATE)
    ),

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CTE 2 : LRF — daily aggregation
    --         Source: XStudio_List_LRF_Per_Heat_Vw
    --         NOTE : Dashboard stat panel 105 queries
    --                XStudio_List_EAF_Per_Heat_Vw for GLS Yield
    --                (same view, different time column)
    --                Replicated here from EAF view on same date
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    CTE_LRF AS
    (
        SELECT
            CAST(Dateyyyymmdd AS DATE)                                                              AS ReportDate,

            -- Production summary (GLS = LRF output)
            CAST(SUM(LiquidMetalWeightTon)              AS DECIMAL(14,1))                           AS GLS_Total_t,

            -- Electricity
            CAST(AVG(KWHPerTon)                         AS DECIMAL(10,1))                           AS LRF_Power_kWh_pt,

            -- Materials per ton
            CAST(AVG(TotalLimeInKg     * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS LRF_Lime_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalDoloInKg     * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,3))  AS LRF_Dolo_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalAluminiuminKg * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS LRF_Al_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalFeSiInKg     * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,4))  AS LRF_FeSi_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalSiMninKg     * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,4))  AS LRF_SiMn_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalCarboninKg   * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,4))  AS LRF_Carbon_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(TotalFlourSparinKg * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS LRF_FlourSpar_kgpt,

            -- Utilities per ton
            CAST(AVG(
                (ISNULL(ElectrodeConsumption1Kg, 0)
               + ISNULL(ElectrodeConsumption2Kg, 0)
               + ISNULL(ElectrodeConsumption3Kg, 0)) * 1.0
               / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0))            AS DECIMAL(10,3))                      AS LRF_Electrode_kgpt,
            CAST(AVG(ArgonConsumptionNm3 * 1.0 / NULLIF(LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0)) AS DECIMAL(10,3)) AS LRF_Argon_Nm3pt

        FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_LRF_Per_Heat_Vw
        GROUP BY CAST(Dateyyyymmdd AS DATE)
    ),

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CTE 3 : CCM — daily aggregation + Billet Yield via JOIN
    --         Source : XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_Vw (CCM)
    --                  XStudio_List_EAF_Per_Heat_Vw (for LM weight)
    --         Billet Yield = AVG(BilletWeight / LM_Weight * 100)
    --         Joined on HeatNo (heat-level) then grouped by date
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    CTE_CCM AS
    (
        SELECT
            CAST(CCM.HeatReportDate AS DATE)                                                        AS ReportDate,

            -- Billet count
            CAST(SUM(CCM.TotalPostedBilletCount)         AS INT)                                    AS TotalBillets,

            -- Billet Yield % = per-heat ratio aggregated to day
            CAST(AVG(
                CAST(CCM.TotalPostedBilletWeightTon AS FLOAT) * 100.0
                / NULLIF(EAF.LiquidMetalWeightTon, 0))       AS DECIMAL(10,2))                      AS Billet_Yield_pct

        FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_Vw  CCM
        INNER JOIN XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_EAF_Per_Heat_Vw EAF
            ON CCM.HeatNo = EAF.HeatNo          -- heat-level join (mirrors Grafana panel 107)
        GROUP BY CAST(CCM.HeatReportDate AS DATE)
    ),

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- CTE 4 : GLS Yield — Dashboard panel 105 queries
    --         XStudio_List_EAF_Per_Heat_Vw filtered by
    --         Dateyyyymmdd (same data, different time column)
    --         Included as separate CTE to stay faithful to
    --         the original Grafana query intent
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    CTE_GLS_Yield AS
    (
        SELECT
            CAST(Dateyyyymmdd AS DATE)                                                              AS ReportDate,
            CAST(AVG(YieldPercentage) AS DECIMAL(10,2))                                             AS GLS_Yield_pct
        FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_EAF_Per_Heat_Vw
        GROUP BY CAST(Dateyyyymmdd AS DATE)
    )

    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- FINAL SELECT — single table output
    -- Driver  : CTE_EAF (has the most heats / widest date set)
    -- Strategy: LEFT JOIN all other CTEs so no EAF date is lost
    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        -- ── Date ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        E.ReportDate                        AS HeatReportDate,

        -- ── Production Summary ────────────────────────────────
        E.TotalHeats,
        E.LM_Total_t,
        E.LM_Yield_pct,
        L.GLS_Total_t,
        G.GLS_Yield_pct,
        C.TotalBillets,
        C.Billet_Yield_pct,

        -- ── EAF Electricity ───────────────────────────────────
        E.EAF_Power_kWh_pt,

        -- ── LRF Electricity ───────────────────────────────────
        L.LRF_Power_kWh_pt,

        -- ── EAF Materials per ton ─────────────────────────────
        E.EAF_Lime_kgpt,
        E.EAF_Dolo_kgpt,
        E.EAF_FeSi_kgpt,
        E.EAF_SiMn_kgpt,
        E.EAF_NutCoke_kgpt,
        E.EAF_Carbon_kgpt,
        E.EAF_Coke_kgpt,

        -- ── EAF Utilities per ton ─────────────────────────────
        E.EAF_O2_Nm3pt,
        E.EAF_NG_Sm3pt,
        E.EAF_Electrode_kgpt,

        -- ── LRF Materials per ton ─────────────────────────────
        L.LRF_Lime_kgpt,
        L.LRF_Dolo_kgpt,
        L.LRF_Al_kgpt,
        L.LRF_FeSi_kgpt,
        L.LRF_SiMn_kgpt,
        L.LRF_Carbon_kgpt,
        L.LRF_FlourSpar_kgpt,

        -- ── LRF Utilities per ton ─────────────────────────────
        L.LRF_Electrode_kgpt,
        L.LRF_Argon_Nm3pt

    FROM      CTE_EAF       E
    LEFT JOIN CTE_LRF       L ON E.ReportDate = L.ReportDate
    LEFT JOIN CTE_CCM       C ON E.ReportDate = C.ReportDate
    LEFT JOIN CTE_GLS_Yield G ON E.ReportDate = G.ReportDate

    ORDER BY E.ReportDate;

END;
```

## dbo.XBatch_Add_Default_Heat_start_end_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Add_Default_Heat_start_end_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-15 10:26:48  
**Modified On:** 2025-12-27 11:06:23  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Add_Default_Heat_start_end_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*---------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 15-Oct-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure add default entry of heat start and heat end 
------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Add_Default_Heat_start_end_Usp]
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @ReportDate DATE = GETDATE() - 1;
	DECLARE	@FirstHeat INT;
	DECLARE @LastHeat INT;
	DECLARE @UserID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @StartHeatTime DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndHeatTime DATETIME;
	DECLARE @CalTimeInMin FLOAT;
	DECLARE @CalTimeinSec FLOAT;
	
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Set Default User ID--*/
		SET @UserID = (SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_User_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [FullName] = 'XMES System');

		/*---Set First Heat No--*/
		SET @FirstHeat = (SELECT [LastHeatNo] + 1 FROM [SMS_Production_Summary_Day] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ReportDate] = DATEADD(DD, -1, @ReportDate) AND [IsDeleted] = 0);

		/*--Set Last Heat No--*/
		SET @LastHeat = (SELECT TOP (1) [HeatID] FROM [EAF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CAST([HeatStart] AS DATE) = @ReportDate AND [IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY [HeatStart] DESC);

		/*--Set Heat start for first heat and tap start for last heat---*/
		; WITH Heat AS (
			SELECT EAF.HeatID AS StartHeat, EAF.[HeatStart] AS [FirstHeatSTart] FROM EAF_PER_HEAT AS EAF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE EAF.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND EAF.[HeatID] = @FirstHeat
		), Heat1 AS 
		(
			SELECT EAF.HeatID AS LastHeat, EAF.[TapStart] AS [LastHeatTap] FROM EAF_PER_HEAT AS EAF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE EAF.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND EAF.[HeatID] = @LastHeat
		)
		, final AS(	
			SELECT StartHeat,[LastHeat], [FirstHeatSTart], [LastHeattap], DATEDIFF(second, [FirstHeatSTart], [LastHeatTap]) AS [durationinsec] FROM Heat cross join  heat1 
		)
		SELECT @StartHeatTime = [FirstHeatSTart], @EndHeatTime = [LastHeattap], @CalTimeInMin = ISNULL([durationinsec], 0) / 60, @CalTimeinSec = ISNULL([durationinsec], 0) FROM final;

		/*---Add Entry First and Last Heat of the day---*/
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[Heat_End_Selection_Trn_Tbl] ([ReportDate], [FirstHeatNo], [LastHeatNo], [FIrstHeatStartTime], [LastHeatTapTime], [CalTimeinMinutes], [CalTimeinSecond], [ModifiedBy], [ModifiedOn])
		VALUES (@ReportDate, @FirstHeat, @LastHeat, @StartHeatTime, @EndHeatTime, @CalTimeInMin, @calTimeinSec, @UserID, GETDATE());

		/*--Update Heat ReportDate---*/
		UPDATE [dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] SET [HeatReportDate] = @ReportDate WHERE [HeatID] BETWEEN @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat;

		UPDATE [dbo].[LRF_Per_Heat] SET [HeatReportDate] = @ReportDate WHERE [HeatID] BETWEEN @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat;

		UPDATE [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] SET [HeatReportDate] = @ReportDate WHERE [HeatID] BETWEEN @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat;

		/*---Update Last Heat--*/
		UPDATE [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary_Day] SET [LastHeatNo] = @LastHeat WHERE [ReportDate] = @ReportDate;

		
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Add_Default_Heat_start_end_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Add_Default_Heat_start_end_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID=@UserID,@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

```sql
/*---------------------------

------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Add_Heat_start_end_SPValidation_Usp]
(
	@ReportDate DATE,
	@FirstHeat INT,
	@LastHeat INT
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*---When First heat is not selected---*/
		IF @FirstHeat IS NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT 'Pleast Enter First Heat';
		END
		/*---When Last heat is not selected---*/
		IF @LastHeat IS NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT 'Please Enter Last Heat';
		END
		/*----When Entry of selected first heat and last heat already exist in table--*/
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Heat_End_Selection_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = @ReportDate AND [FirstHeatNo] = @FirstHeat AND [LastHeatNo] = @LastHeat)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 'First Heat and Last Heat already exist';
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Add_Heat_start_end_SPValidation_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
```

```sql
/*---------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 15-Oct-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure add entry of heat start and heat end 
------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Add_Heat_start_end_Usp]
(
	@ReportDate DATE,
	@FirstHeat INT,
	@LastHeat INT,
	@UserID VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*--Variable Declaration---*/
	DECLARE @StartHeatTime DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndHeatTime DATETIME; 
	DECLARE @CalTimeInMin FLOAT;
	DECLARe @CalTimeInSec FLOAT;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Set Heat start for first heat and tap start for last heat---*/
		; WITH Heat AS (
			SELECT EAF.HeatID AS StartHeat, EAF.[HeatStart] AS [FirstHeatSTart] FROM EAF_PER_HEAT AS EAF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE EAF.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND EAF.[HeatID] = @FirstHeat
		), Heat1 AS 
		(
			SELECT EAF.HeatID AS LastHeat, EAF.[TapStart] AS [LastHeatTap] FROM EAF_PER_HEAT AS EAF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE EAF.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND EAF.[HeatID] = @LastHeat
		)
		, final AS(	
			SELECT StartHeat,[LastHeat], [FirstHeatSTart], [LastHeattap], DATEDIFF(second, [FirstHeatSTart], [LastHeatTap]) AS [durationinsec] FROM Heat cross join  heat1 
		)
		SELECT @StartHeatTime = [FirstHeatSTart], @EndHeatTime = [LastHeattap], @CalTimeInMin = ISNULL([durationinsec], 0) / 60, @CalTimeinSec = ISNULL([durationinsec], 0) FROM final;

		/*---Add Entry First and Last Heat of the day---*/
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[Heat_End_Selection_Trn_Tbl] ([ReportDate], [FirstHeatNo], [LastHeatNo], [FIrstHeatStartTime], [LastHeatTapTime], [CalTimeinMinutes], [CalTimeinSecond], [ModifiedBy], [ModifiedOn])
		VALUES (@ReportDate, @FirstHeat, @LastHeat, @StartHeatTime, @EndHeatTime, @CalTimeInMin, @CalTimeInSec, @UserID, GETDATE());

		/*--Update Heat ReportDate---*/
		UPDATE [dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] SET [HeatReportDate] = @ReportDate WHERE [HeatID] BETWEEN @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat;

		UPDATE [dbo].[LRF_Per_Heat] SET [HeatReportDate] = @ReportDate WHERE [HeatID] BETWEEN @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat;

		UPDATE [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] SET [HeatReportDate] = @ReportDate WHERE [HeatID] BETWEEN @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat;

		/*---Update Last Heat--*/
		UPDATE [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary_Day] SET [LastHeatNo] = @LastHeat WHERE [ReportDate] = @ReportDate;

		/*--Recalculate EAF summary--*/
		EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_EAF_Usp] @ReportDate;

		/*--Recalculate LRF summary--*/
		EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_LRF_Usp] @ReportDate;

		/*--Recalculate CCM Summary--*/
		EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_CCM_Usp] @ReportDate;

		--EXEC [dbo].[XStudio_Historian_Day_SMS_Production_Usp] @ReportDate, NULL, NULL;

		/*--Recalculate SMS Production--*/
		EXEC [dbo].[SP_SMS_Producation_Summary] @ReportDate;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Add_Heat_start_end_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Add_Heat_start_end_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID=@UserID,@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_AllFurnacePosition_Billet_Deatils  
**Created On:** 2025-09-24 19:54:16  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:16:23  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_AllFurnacePosition_Billet_Deatils];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------------------
	Created By : Sagar Rana
	Modified On : 24-Sep-2025
	Description : Display Billet Data Which is current in Furnace 		
	
--------------------------------------*/
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_AllFurnacePosition_Billet_Deatils]
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        ;WITH Unpivoted AS (
            SELECT
                ISNULL(BilletNo, '') AS BilletNo,  -- keep empty billets
                Position
            FROM BilletsPosition_InFurnace
            UNPIVOT
            (
                BilletNo FOR Position IN (
                    Position1,Position2,Position3,Position4,Position5,Position6,Position7,Position8,
                    Position9,Position10,Position11,Position12,Position13,Position14,Position15,Position16,
                    Position17,Position18,Position19,Position20,Position21,Position22,Position23,Position24,
                    Position25,Position26,Position27,Position28,Position29,Position30,Position31,Position32,
                    Position33,Position34,Position35,Position36,Position37,Position38,Position39,Position40,
                    Position41,Position42,Position43,Position44,Position45,Position46,Position47,Position48,
                    Position49,Position50,Position51,Position52,Position53,Position54,Position55,Position56,
                    Position57,Position58,Position59,Position60,Position61,Position62,Position63,Position64
                )
            ) AS unpvt
        )
        , Position1Time AS
        (
            SELECT 
                BilletNo,
                MIN(EntryDateTime) AS Position1EntryDateTime,
                Grade,
                HeatNo
            FROM Billets_InFurnace_Tracking_Trn WITH(NOLOCK)
            WHERE IsDeleted = 0
              AND BilletPosition = 'Position1'
            GROUP BY BilletNo, Grade, HeatNo
        )
        SELECT
            p.Grade,
            p.HeatNo,
            u.BilletNo,
            u.Position AS BilletPosition,
            p.Position1EntryDateTime AS BilletChargingTime
        FROM Unpivoted u
        LEFT JOIN Position1Time p
        ON u.BilletNo = p.BilletNo
        ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(u.Position,'Position','') AS INT) desc;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_AllFurnacePosition_Billet_Deatils | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
        DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XBatch_AllFurnacePosition_Billet_Deatils]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END;
```

## dbo.XBatch_CCM_Heat_Average_SuperHeat

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_CCM_Heat_Average_SuperHeat  
**Created On:** 2026-05-06 13:33:00  
**Modified On:** 2026-05-07 09:01:48  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_CCM_Heat_Average_SuperHeat]
    @ID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------------------*/
-- Created by : Priyanka Makwana
-- Created on : 06-May-2026
-- Description : After save data of SuperHeat save in CCM Per Heat
-- Execute : EXEC [XBatch_CCM_Heat_Average_SuperHeat] '1602793'
/*--------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_CCM_Heat_Average_SuperHeat]
(
      @ID Varchar(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY

        DECLARE 
              @SuperHeat1 DECIMAL(18,2),
              @SuperHeat2 DECIMAL(18,2),
              @SuperHeat3 DECIMAL(18,2),
              @AverageSuperHeat DECIMAL(18,2),
			  @HeatID varchar(36);
   
           -- Get SuperHeat Values
        
        SELECT 
              @SuperHeat1 = ISNULL(SuperHeatTemp1,0),
              @SuperHeat2 = ISNULL(SuperHeatTemp2,0),
              @SuperHeat3 = ISNULL(SuperHeatTemp3,0),
			  @HeatID=HeatNo
        FROM CCM_Section_Strands
        WHERE ID = @ID;
  
          -- Calculate Average SuperHeat
       
        SELECT 
            @AverageSuperHeat =
            (
                (@SuperHeat1 + @SuperHeat2 + @SuperHeat3)
                /
                NULLIF(
                    (CASE WHEN @SuperHeat1 <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                     CASE WHEN @SuperHeat2 <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                     CASE WHEN @SuperHeat3 <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0
                )
            );
       
          -- Update CCM_Per_Heat   

        UPDATE CCM_Per_Heat
        SET SuperHeat = ISNULL(@AverageSuperHeat,0)
        WHERE HeatID = @HeatID;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : XBatch_CCM_Heat_Average_SuperHeat | Line : ' + CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR) + ' | Message : ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();

        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='SuperHeat SP',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace='',@UserID='', @HostAddress='', @Info='', @Source='T-SQL';RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH

END
```

```sql
    @PhaseID = '',
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 26-07-2023
-- Description:	Used to check material availbility and find connection for transfer the material
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Check_Material_Availibility_And_Connection_Usp] -- XBatch_Check_Material_Availibility_And_Connection_Usp '1108E68B-A208-475D-AAF4-20111B3D8DBF', '8196656D-EBFE-441B-9C79-8B3764EE1A1E'
	@PhaseID VARCHAR(36),
	@MaterialID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @PhaseGroupID VARCHAR(36), @PhaseQuantity DECIMAL(18,4);
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT @PhaseGroupID = ParentID, @PhaseQuantity = Quantity FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0;

		---------- Find equipment type id from phase id ----------
		DECLARE @EquipmentTypeID VARCHAR(36);
		SELECT @EquipmentTypeID = EquipmentTypeID FROM XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID = (SELECT ParentID FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID = (SELECT ParentID FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) Where ID = @PhaseID AND [IsDeleted] = 0) AND [IsDeleted] = 0);

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Material_Item_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ParentID = @MaterialID AND LocationType = 'Equipment' AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
		BEGIN
			-- TO DO : identify possible connection
			-- TO DO : check quanity

			DECLARE @Connection_Tbl AS TABLE(ID VARCHAR(36), SourceEquipmentID VARCHAR(36), DestinationEquipmentID VARCHAR(36), Status VARCHAR(15));

			INSERT INTO @Connection_Tbl
			SELECT ID, SourceEquipmentID, DestinationEquipmentID, Status FROM XBatch_Connection_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE SourceEquipmentID IN (SELECT LocationID FROM XBatch_Material_Item_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ParentID = @MaterialID AND LocationType = 'Equipment' AND [IsDeleted] = 0) AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

			IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @Connection_Tbl)
			BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @Connection_Tbl WHERE Status = 'Available')
				print('');
			END
		
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- To DO : allocate material in to equipment
			print('allocate '+CAST(@PhaseQuantity AS VARCHAR(100))+' material in to equipment type ');
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Check_Material_Availibility_And_Connection_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Check_Material_Availibility_And_Connection_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```
