## dbo.XBatch_Create_Batch_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Create_Batch_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:26  
**Modified On:** 2025-07-22 20:34:19  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @BatchID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Create_Batch_Usp]
    @BatchID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 16-Jun-2023
-- Description:	Called on after save logic of batch master and used to generate batch instance from recipe
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Create_Batch_Usp] -- [dbo].[XBatch_Create_Batch_Usp] '1D7DF28B-FAC0-499A-B3A9-2614D3A970B5'
	@BatchID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN TRY
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	---------- Batch related variable ----------
	DECLARE @RecipeID VARCHAR(36), @BatchQuantity DECIMAL(18,4), @UOMID VARCHAR(36);

	---------- Get recipe id and quantity from batch ----------
	SELECT @RecipeID = ParentID, @BatchQuantity = Quantity FROM XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl WHERE ID = @BatchID;

	---------- Recipe unit procedures cursor related variable ----------
	DECLARE @UnitProcedureID VARCHAR(36), @UnitProcedureName VARCHAR(100), @UnitProcedureSrNo INT, @UnitProcedurePosition VARCHAR(100);

	---------- Recipe unit procedures cursor ----------
	DECLARE UnitProcedure_Cursor CURSOR
	FOR
	SELECT ID, Name, SrNo, Position FROM XBatch_Recipe_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @RecipeID AND IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY SrNo
	
	OPEN UnitProcedure_Cursor;
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM UnitProcedure_Cursor INTO @UnitProcedureID, @UnitProcedureName, @UnitProcedureSrNo, @UnitProcedurePosition
	
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
		BEGIN
			
			DECLARE @BatchUnitProcedureID VARCHAR(36) = NEWID();

			---------- if not exists batch unit procedures then create it else update it ----------
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchID AND Name = @UnitProcedureName)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl (ID, Name, CreatedOn, ParentID, SrNo, OriginalID, Position)
				VALUES (@BatchUnitProcedureID, @UnitProcedureName, GETDATE(), @BatchID, @UnitProcedureSrNo, @UnitProcedureID, @UnitProcedurePosition);
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @BatchUnitProcedureID = ID FROM XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchID AND Name = @UnitProcedureName;
				UPDATE XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl SET ModifiedOn = GETDATE(), SrNo = @UnitProcedureSrNo, OriginalID = @UnitProcedureID, Position = @UnitProcedurePosition WHERE ParentID = @BatchID AND Name = @UnitProcedureName;
			END

			---------- Recipe operation cursor related variable ----------
			DECLARE @OperationID VARCHAR(36), @OperationName VARCHAR(100), @OperationEquipmentTypeID VARCHAR(36), @OperationOutputMaterialID VARCHAR(36), @OperationSrNo INT, @OperationPosition VARCHAR(100),@OperationOutputMaterialQuantity DECIMAL(18,4);

			---------- Recipe operation cursor ----------
			DECLARE Operation_Cursor CURSOR
			FOR
			SELECT ID, Name, EquipmentTypeID, OutputMaterialID, OutputMaterialQuantity, SrNo, Position FROM XBatch_Recipe_Operation_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @UnitProcedureID AND IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY SrNo	
			
			OPEN Operation_Cursor;
			
				FETCH NEXT FROM Operation_Cursor INTO @OperationID, @OperationName, @OperationEquipmentTypeID, @OperationOutputMaterialID, @OperationOutputMaterialQuantity, @OperationSrNo, @OperationPosition
			
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
				BEGIN

					DECLARE @BatchOperationID VARCHAR(36) = NEWID();
					DECLARE @OperationQuantity DECIMAL(18,4) = @OperationOutputMaterialQuantity * @BatchQuantity;

					---------- if not exists batch operations then create it else update it ----------
					IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchUnitProcedureID AND Name = @OperationName)
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl (ID, Name, CreatedOn, ParentID, EquipmentTypeID, OutputMaterialID, OutputMaterialQuantity, SrNo, Position, OriginalID)
						VALUES (@BatchOperationID, @OperationName, GETDATE(), @BatchUnitProcedureID, @OperationEquipmentTypeID, @OperationOutputMaterialID, @OperationQuantity, @OperationSrNo, @OperationPosition, @OperationID);
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SELECT @BatchOperationID = ID FROM XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchUnitProcedureID AND Name = @OperationName;
						UPDATE XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl SET ModifiedOn = GETDATE(), EquipmentTypeID = @OperationEquipmentTypeID, OutputMaterialID = @OperationOutputMaterialID, OutputMaterialQuantity = @OperationQuantity, SrNo = @OperationSrNo, Position = @OperationPosition, OriginalID = @OperationID WHERE ParentID = @BatchUnitProcedureID AND Name = @OperationName;
					END

					---------- if not exists batch bom then create it else update it ----------
					SELECT @UOMID = UnitID FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl where ID = @OperationOutputMaterialID;
					IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchID AND UnitProcedureID = @BatchUnitProcedureID AND OperationID = @BatchOperationID AND ItemID = @OperationOutputMaterialID)
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl(CreatedOn, ParentID, ItemID, Quantity, UOMID, UnitProcedureID, OperationID, SourceType) 
						VALUES (GETDATE(), @BatchID, @OperationOutputMaterialID, @OperationQuantity, @UOMID, @BatchUnitProcedureID, @BatchOperationID, 'Produce');
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						UPDATE XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl SET Quantity = @OperationQuantity, UOMID = @UOMID, SourceType = 'Produce' WHERE ParentID = @BatchID AND UnitProcedureID = @BatchUnitProcedureID AND OperationID = @BatchOperationID AND ItemID = @OperationOutputMaterialID;
					END

					---------- Recipe phase group cursor related variable ----------
					DECLARE @RecipePhaseGroupID VARCHAR(36), @RecipePhaseGroupName VARCHAR(100),@RecipePhaseGroupSrNo INT, @RecipePhaseGroupPosition VARCHAR(100);

					---------- Recipe phase group cursor ----------
					DECLARE PhaseGroup_Cursor CURSOR
					FOR
					SELECT ID, Name, SrNo, Position FROM XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @OperationID AND IsDeleted = 0
					
					OPEN PhaseGroup_Cursor;
					
						FETCH NEXT FROM PhaseGroup_Cursor INTO @RecipePhaseGroupID, @RecipePhaseGroupName, @RecipePhaseGroupSrNo, @RecipePhaseGroupPosition
					
						WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
						BEGIN
							
							DECLARE @BatchPhaseGroupID VARCHAR(36) = NEWID();

							---------- if not exists batch phase group then create it else update it ----------
							IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchOperationID AND Name = @RecipePhaseGroupName)
							BEGIN
								INSERT INTO XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl(ID, Name, CreatedOn, ParentID, SrNo, Position, OriginalID)
								VALUES (@BatchPhaseGroupID, @RecipePhaseGroupName, GETDATE(), @BatchOperationID, @RecipePhaseGroupSrNo, @RecipePhaseGroupPosition, @RecipePhaseGroupID);
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SELECT @BatchPhaseGroupID = ID FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchOperationID AND Name = @RecipePhaseGroupName;
								UPDATE XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl SET SrNo = @RecipePhaseGroupSrNo, Position = @RecipePhaseGroupPosition, OriginalID = @RecipePhaseGroupID WHERE ParentID = @BatchOperationID AND Name = @RecipePhaseGroupName;
							END

							---------- Recipe phase cursor related variable ----------
							DECLARE @RecipePhaseID VARCHAR(36), @RecipePhaseName VARCHAR(100), @RecipePhaseType VARCHAR(100), @RecipePhaseCapabilityID VARCHAR(36),
							@RecipePhaseMaterialID VARCHAR(36), @RecipeQuantity DECIMAL(18,4), @RecipePhaseSrNo INT, @RecipePhasePosition VARCHAR(100), @RecipePhaseTemplateID VARCHAR(36);

							---------- Recipe phase cursor ----------
							DECLARE Phase_Cursor CURSOR
							FOR
							SELECT ID, Name, Type, CapabilityID, MaterialID, Quantity, SrNo, Position, TemplateID FROM XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @RecipePhaseGroupID AND IsDeleted = 0
							
							OPEN Phase_Cursor;
							
								FETCH NEXT FROM Phase_Cursor INTO @RecipePhaseID, @RecipePhaseName, @RecipePhaseType, @RecipePhaseCapabilityID, @RecipePhaseMaterialID, @RecipeQuantity, @RecipePhaseSrNo, @RecipePhasePosition, @RecipePhaseTemplateID
							
								WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
								BEGIN

									DECLARE @BatchPhaseID VARCHAR(36) = NEWID();
									DECLARE @PhaseQuantity DECIMAL(18,4) = @RecipeQuantity * @BatchQuantity;

									---------- if not exists batch phase then create it else update it ----------
									IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchPhaseGroupID AND Name = @RecipePhaseName)
									BEGIN
										INSERT INTO XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl (ID, Name, CreatedOn, ParentID, Type, CapabilityID, MaterialID, Quantity, SrNo, Position, TemplateID, OriginalID) 
										VALUES (@BatchPhaseID, @RecipePhaseName, GETDATE(), @BatchPhaseGroupID, @RecipePhaseType, @RecipePhaseCapabilityID, @RecipePhaseMaterialID, @PhaseQuantity, @RecipePhaseSrNo, @RecipePhasePosition, @RecipePhaseTemplateID, @RecipePhaseID);
									END
									ELSE
									BEGIN
										SELECT @BatchPhaseID = ID FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchPhaseGroupID AND Name = @RecipePhaseName;
										UPDATE XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl SET Type = @RecipePhaseType, CapabilityID = @RecipePhaseCapabilityID, MaterialID = @RecipePhaseMaterialID, 
										Quantity = @PhaseQuantity, SrNo = @RecipePhaseSrNo, Position = @RecipePhasePosition, TemplateID = @RecipePhaseTemplateID, OriginalID = @RecipePhaseID WHERE ParentID = @BatchPhaseGroupID AND Name = @RecipePhaseName;
									END

									---------- if not exists batch bom then create it else update it ----------
									IF(@RecipePhaseType = 'Transfer')
									BEGIN
										SELECT @UOMID = UnitID FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl where ID = @RecipePhaseMaterialID;

										IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchID AND UnitProcedureID = @BatchUnitProcedureID AND OperationID = @BatchOperationID AND PhaseGroupID = @BatchPhaseGroupID AND PhaseID = @BatchPhaseID AND ItemID = @RecipePhaseMaterialID)
										BEGIN
											INSERT INTO XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl(CreatedOn, ParentID, ItemID, Quantity, UOMID, UnitProcedureID, OperationID, PhaseGroupID, PhaseID, SourceType) 
											VALUES (GETDATE(), @BatchID, @RecipePhaseMaterialID, @PhaseQuantity, @UOMID, @BatchUnitProcedureID, @BatchOperationID, @BatchPhaseGroupID, @BatchPhaseID, 'Consume');
										END
										ELSE
										BEGIN
											UPDATE XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl SET Quantity = @PhaseQuantity, UOMID = @UOMID, SourceType = 'Consume' WHERE ParentID = @BatchID AND UnitProcedureID = @BatchUnitProcedureID AND OperationID = @BatchOperationID AND PhaseGroupID = @BatchPhaseGroupID AND PhaseID = @BatchPhaseID AND ItemID = @RecipePhaseMaterialID;
										END
									END

									---------- Recipe phase parameter cursor related variable ----------
									DECLARE @RecipePhaseParameterID VARCHAR(36), @RecipePhaseParameterName VARCHAR(100), @RecipePhaseParameterValue VARCHAR(100), @RecipePhaseParameterDescription VARCHAR(MAX);

									---------- Recipe phase parameter cursor ----------
									DECLARE PhaseParameter_Cursor CURSOR
									FOR
									SELECT ID, Name, Value, Description FROM XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @RecipePhaseID AND IsDeleted = 0
									
									OPEN PhaseParameter_Cursor;
									
										FETCH NEXT FROM PhaseParameter_Cursor INTO @RecipePhaseParameterID, @RecipePhaseParameterName, @RecipePhaseParameterValue, @RecipePhaseParameterDescription
									
										WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
										BEGIN

											DECLARE @BatchPhaseParameterID VARCHAR(36) = NEWID();

											---------- if not exists batch phase parameter then create it else update it ----------
											IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchPhaseID AND Name = @RecipePhaseParameterName)
											BEGIN
												INSERT INTO XBatch_Batch_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl (ID, Name, CreatedOn, ParentID, Value, Description, OriginalID) 
												VALUES (@BatchPhaseParameterID, @RecipePhaseParameterName, GETDATE(), @BatchPhaseID, @RecipePhaseParameterValue, @RecipePhaseParameterDescription, @RecipePhaseParameterID);
											END
											ELSE
											BEGIN
												SELECT @BatchPhaseParameterID = ID FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @BatchPhaseID AND Name = @RecipePhaseParameterName;
												UPDATE XBatch_Batch_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl SET Value = @RecipePhaseParameterValue, Description = @RecipePhaseParameterDescription, OriginalID = @RecipePhaseParameterID WHERE ParentID = @BatchPhaseID AND Name = @RecipePhaseParameterName;
											END
											--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
											FETCH NEXT FROM PhaseParameter_Cursor INTO @RecipePhaseParameterID, @RecipePhaseParameterName, @RecipePhaseParameterValue, @RecipePhaseParameterDescription
										END
									
									CLOSE PhaseParameter_Cursor;
									DEALLOCATE PhaseParameter_Cursor;

									FETCH NEXT FROM Phase_Cursor INTO @RecipePhaseID, @RecipePhaseName, @RecipePhaseType, @RecipePhaseCapabilityID, @RecipePhaseMaterialID, @RecipeQuantity, @RecipePhaseSrNo, @RecipePhasePosition, @RecipePhaseTemplateID
								END
							
							CLOSE Phase_Cursor;
							DEALLOCATE Phase_Cursor;
							
							FETCH NEXT FROM PhaseGroup_Cursor INTO @RecipePhaseGroupID, @RecipePhaseGroupName, @RecipePhaseGroupSrNo, @RecipePhaseGroupPosition
						END
					
					CLOSE PhaseGroup_Cursor;
					DEALLOCATE PhaseGroup_Cursor;
					
					FETCH NEXT FROM Operation_Cursor INTO @OperationID, @OperationName, @OperationEquipmentTypeID, @OperationOutputMaterialID, @OperationOutputMaterialQuantity, @OperationSrNo, @OperationPosition
				END
			
			CLOSE Operation_Cursor;
			DEALLOCATE Operation_Cursor;

			
			FETCH NEXT FROM UnitProcedure_Cursor INTO @UnitProcedureID, @UnitProcedureName, @UnitProcedureSrNo, @UnitProcedurePosition
		END
	
	CLOSE UnitProcedure_Cursor;
	DEALLOCATE UnitProcedure_Cursor;
	
	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH 
		
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_Create_Batch_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)

END CATCH
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 18-july-2023
-- Description:	Called on after save logic of transfer connection and used to create default transfer capability and it's default parameter
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Create_Connection_Default_Transfer_Capability] -- XBatch_Create_Default_Transfer_Capability '58857C39-8048-4CFE-9074-7AFCCAE31DC5','C9710FC1-E4FF-4FDC-991A-A1B54F059E59'
	@ConnectionID VARCHAR(36),
	@UserID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Connection_Capability_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ParentID = @ConnectionID AND IsDeleted = 0)
		BEGIN

			DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(36) = NEWID();

			INSERT INTO XBatch_Connection_Capability_Mst_Tbl 
			([ID],[Name],[ParentID],[CreatedBy],[CreatedOn],[Source],[Description],[IsStart],[IsHold],[IsRestart],[IsAbort],[IsReset],[IsReady],[IsHeld],[IsRun],[IsDone],[IsInterlock],[IsAborted]) 
			VALUES
			(@ID, 'Transfer', @ConnectionID, @UserID, GETDATE(), 'System', 'Transfer', 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);

			INSERT INTO XBatch_Connection_Parameter_Mst_Tbl
			([Name],[ParentID],[CreatedBy],[CreatedOn],[Source],[Type],[Mode],[Description],[IsHistorize])
			VALUES
			('Quantity', @ID, @UserID, GETDATE(), 'System', 'Analog', 'I', 'Quantity', 1);
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
		
			DECLARE @CapabilityID VARCHAR(36);
			SELECT @CapabilityID = ID FROM XBatch_Connection_Capability_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ParentID = @ConnectionID AND IsDeleted = 0;

			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Connection_Parameter_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ParentID = @CapabilityID AND Name = 'Quantity' AND IsDeleted =0)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO XBatch_Connection_Parameter_Mst_Tbl
				([Name],[ParentID],[CreatedBy],[CreatedOn],[Source],[Type],[Mode],[Description],[IsHistorize])
				VALUES
				('Quantity', @CapabilityID, @UserID, GETDATE(), 'System', 'Analog', 'I', 'Quantity', 1);
			END
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Create_Connection_Default_Transfer_Capability | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Create_Connection_Default_Transfer_Capability]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-08-11 08:34:01  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-10 16:50:23  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP]
AS
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        SET DATEFIRST 7; -- Sunday = 1, Saturday = 7

        ---------------------------------------------------------
        -- Allowed feeders (ONLY THESE WILL BE PROCESSED)
        ---------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @AllowedFeeders TABLE (FeederName VARCHAR(100));
        INSERT INTO @AllowedFeeders VALUES
        ('Feeder132KVIC1'),
        ('Feeder132KVIC2');

        /*========================================================
          STEP 1: Readings + RateBand resolution
        ========================================================*/
        WITH ReadingData AS (
            SELECT
                r.FeederName,
                r.EndDateTime,
                r.Consumption,
                DATENAME(MONTH, r.EndDateTime) AS [Month],
                DATEPART(MONTH, r.EndDateTime) AS MonthNumber,
                DATEPART(YEAR,  r.EndDateTime) AS [Year],
                rbm.Name AS RateBand
            FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Reading r WITH (NOLOCK)

            JOIN @AllowedFeeders af
                ON af.FeederName = r.FeederName

            OUTER APPLY (
                SELECT TOP (1)
                    a.RateBand
                FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Timing a
                WHERE a.IsDeleted = 0
                  AND CAST(r.EndDateTime AS time) BETWEEN a.FromTime AND a.ToTime
                  AND (
                        a.DayOfWeek = 'All days'
                     OR (a.DayOfWeek = 'Friday & Saturday'
                            AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY, r.EndDateTime) IN (6,7))
                     OR (a.DayOfWeek = 'Sunday to Thursday'
                            AND DATEPART(WEEKDAY, r.EndDateTime) IN (1,2,3,4,5))
                      )
                ORDER BY a.FromTime DESC
            ) t

            JOIN dbo.Rate_Band_Master rbm
                ON rbm.ID = t.RateBand
               AND rbm.IsDeleted = 0

            WHERE r.Status = 'Calculated'
              AND r.IsDeleted = 0
        )

        /*========================================================
          STEP 2: Aggregate + Apply Rates
        ========================================================*/
        SELECT
            rd.FeederName,
            rd.[Month],
            rd.MonthNumber,
            rd.[Year],
            rd.RateBand AS TimeOfUse,
            SUM(rd.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,

            CAST(
                CASE rd.RateBand
                    WHEN 'Night-Peak Weekday'   THEN em.WeekdayNightPeak
                    WHEN 'Night-Peak Weekend'   THEN em.WeekendNightPeak
                    WHEN 'Off-Peak Morning'     THEN em.OffPeakMorning
                    WHEN 'Day-Peak Weekday'     THEN em.WeekdayDayPeak
                    WHEN 'Day-Peak Weekend'     THEN em.WeekendDayPeak
                    WHEN 'Off-Peak Afternoon'   THEN em.OffPeakAfternoon
                END / 1000.0
            AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS Rate,

            CAST(
                ROUND(
                    SUM(rd.Consumption) *
                    (
                        CASE rd.RateBand
                            WHEN 'Night-Peak Weekday'   THEN em.WeekdayNightPeak
                            WHEN 'Night-Peak Weekend'   THEN em.WeekendNightPeak
                            WHEN 'Off-Peak Morning'     THEN em.OffPeakMorning
                            WHEN 'Day-Peak Weekday'     THEN em.WeekdayDayPeak
                            WHEN 'Day-Peak Weekend'     THEN em.WeekendDayPeak
                            WHEN 'Off-Peak Afternoon'   THEN em.OffPeakAfternoon
                        END / 1000.0
                    ), 3)
            AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS Charge
        INTO #CombinedData
        FROM ReadingData rd
        JOIN dbo.Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Rate_Tbl_Mst em WITH (NOLOCK)
            ON em.Months = rd.[Month]
        GROUP BY
            rd.FeederName,
            rd.[Month],
            rd.MonthNumber,
            rd.[Year],
            rd.RateBand,
            em.WeekdayNightPeak,
            em.WeekendNightPeak,
            em.OffPeakMorning,
            em.WeekdayDayPeak,
            em.WeekendDayPeak,
            em.OffPeakAfternoon;

        /*========================================================
          STEP 3: Update bill detail
        ========================================================*/
        UPDATE b
        SET
            b.Consumption = c.TotalConsumption,
            b.Rate        = c.Rate,
            b.Charge      = c.Charge,
            b.ModifiedOn  = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details b
        JOIN #CombinedData c
            ON b.FeederName = c.FeederName
           AND b.MonthNumber = c.MonthNumber
           AND b.Year = c.Year
           AND b.TimeOfUse = c.TimeOfUse;

        /*========================================================
          STEP 4: Insert missing bill detail
        ========================================================*/
        INSERT INTO dbo.Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details
        (
            FeederName, [Month], MonthNumber, [Year],
            TimeOfUse, Consumption, Rate, Charge, Source
        )
        SELECT
            c.FeederName,
            c.[Month],
            c.MonthNumber,
            c.[Year],
            c.TimeOfUse,
            c.TotalConsumption,
            c.Rate,
            c.Charge,
            'T-SQL'
        FROM #CombinedData c
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details b
            WHERE b.FeederName = c.FeederName
              AND b.MonthNumber = c.MonthNumber
              AND b.Year = c.Year
              AND b.TimeOfUse = c.TimeOfUse
        );

        /*========================================================
          STEP 5: Mark readings completed (ONLY 2 feeders)
        ========================================================*/
        UPDATE r
        SET r.Status = 'Completed',
            r.Source = 'T-SQL'
        FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Reading r
        JOIN @AllowedFeeders af
            ON af.FeederName = r.FeederName
        WHERE r.Status = 'Calculated'
          AND r.IsDeleted = 0;

        /*========================================================
          STEP 6: Calculate bill amount
        ========================================================*/
        EXEC dbo.SMS_Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount_USP;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =
            'SP : XBatch_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP | Line : '
            + CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR) + ' | ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;
```

## dbo.XBatch_Electricity_Meter_Consumption_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Electricity_Meter_Consumption_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-08-11 08:34:01  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-16 15:05:21  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Electricity_Meter_Consumption_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------------
	Created By : Sagar Rana
	Created On : 31-Jul-2025
	Description : Implement procedure to pdate Electricity Meter Consumption data
-----------------------*/
--[XBatch_Power_Consumption_Usp] '11-jul-2025 00:00'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Electricity_Meter_Consumption_Usp]
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	BEGIN TRY
	

		UPDATE [Electricity_Meter_Reading]
		SET [Electricity_Meter_Reading].[Consumption] = Sub.[Consumption] , [Electricity_Meter_Reading].[Status]= 'Calculated',[Electricity_Meter_Reading].[FeederName]= case when FeederName not like '%Feeder%' then 'Feeder' +
    REPLACE(
        LEFT(
            SUBSTRING(FeederName, CHARINDEX(' ', FeederName) + 1, LEN(FeederName)),
            CASE
                WHEN FeederName LIKE '%MONTHLY%' THEN
                    CHARINDEX('MONTHLY',
                        SUBSTRING(FeederName, CHARINDEX(' ', FeederName) + 1, LEN(FeederName))
                    ) - 1
                WHEN FeederName LIKE '%DAILY%' THEN
                    CHARINDEX('DAILY',
                        SUBSTRING(FeederName, CHARINDEX(' ', FeederName) + 1, LEN(FeederName))
                    ) - 1
            END
        ),
        ' ',
        ''
    ) Else FeederName END,[Electricity_Meter_Reading].[Source]= 'T-SQL',ModifiedBy= '3ADE6546-3C9A-49C4-A001-234025F2F901',CreatedBy= '3ADE6546-3C9A-49C4-A001-234025F2F901'
		FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Reading] [Electricity_Meter_Reading]
		INNER JOIN (
		    SELECT 
		        [ID],
		        CASE 
		            WHEN LAG([Value]) OVER (PARTITION BY [FeederName] ORDER BY [EndDateTime]) IS NULL 
		                THEN 0
		            ELSE ISNULL([Value], 0) - ISNULL(LAG([Value]) OVER (PARTITION BY [FeederName] ORDER BY [EndDateTime]), 0)
		        END AS [Consumption]
		    FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Reading] WITH(NOLOCK)
		    WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
		) AS Sub 
		ON [Electricity_Meter_Reading].[ID] = Sub.[ID]
		WHERE [Electricity_Meter_Reading].[IsDeleted] = 0
		AND Status ='Entered';
		DECLARE @Entrydate DATE = (SELECT TOP 1 DATEADD(DD, -1, [EndDateTime]) FROM [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Reading] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Position] = 24 ORDER BY [EndDateTime] DESC);
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Reading] WHERE [Position] > 24 AND [EndDateTime] > @Entrydate;
		
		UPDATE [dbo].[Power_Consumption_LogSheet] SET [ReportDate] = t.[ReportDate], [Entrydatetime] = t.[Enddatetime], [Transformer132kv1] = [Feeder132KVIC1], [Transformer132kv2] = [Feeder132KVIC2], [Transformer15MVA] = [Feeder15MVA], [Transformer24MVA] = [Feeder24MVA], [Transformer33kv1] = [Feeder33KVIC1], [Transformer33kv2] = [Feeder33KVIC2], [EAF] = [FeederEAF], [LRF] = [FeederLRF], [RollingMill] = [FeederRollingMill], [WRM] = 0, [NGConsumptionSm3] = 0, [OxygenPlant4A] = 0, [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL' FROM (
			SELECT CAST([enddate] AS DATE) AS [ReportDate], MAX([enddatetime]) AS [Enddatetime], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder132KVIC1], 0)) AS [Feeder132KVIC1], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder132KVIC2], 0)) AS [Feeder132KVIC2], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder15MVA], 0)) AS [Feeder15MVA], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder24MVA], 0)) AS [Feeder24MVA], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder33KVIC1], 0)) AS [Feeder33KVIC1], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder33KVIC2], 0)) AS [feeder33KVIC2], SUM(ISNULL([FeederEAF], 0)) AS [FeederEAF], SUM(ISNULL([FeederLRF], 0)) AS [FeederLRF], SUM(ISNULL([FeederRollingMill], 0)) AS [FeederRollingMill] FROM (
				SELECT [FeederName], [Value], [enddate], [Enddatetime] FROM (
					SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [Enddate], [FeederName] ORDER BY [EnddateTime] DESC) AS num FROM (
						SELECT  [FeederName], CASE WHEN CAST([enddatetime] AS TIME) = '00:00:00' THEN CAST(DATEADD(dd, -1, [EndDateTime]) AS DATE) ELSE CAST([EndDateTime] AS DATE) END AS [enddate], [EndDateTime], [Value], [Position]/*, Consumption*/
						FROM [Electricity_Meter_Reading] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
					) AS t 
				) AS t WHERE num = 1 AND [Enddate] = @entryDate
			) AS t PIVOT (SUM([Value]) FOR [FeederName] IN ([Feeder132KVIC1], [Feeder132KVIC2], [Feeder15MVA], [Feeder24MVA], [Feeder33KVIC1], [Feeder33KVIC2], [FeederEAF], [FeederLRF], [FeederRollingMill])) As pvt
			GROUP BY [enddate]
		) AS t WHERE t.[Enddatetime] = [Power_Consumption_LogSheet].[EntryDateTime] and [Power_Consumption_LogSheet].[reportdate]= @entrydate;

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[Power_Consumption_LogSheet]([ReportDate], [EntryDateTime], [Transformer132kv1], [Transformer132kv2], [Transformer15MVA], [Transformer24MVA], [Transformer33kv1], [Transformer33kv2], [EAF], [LRF], [RollingMill], [WRM], [NGConsumptionSm3], [OxygenPlant4A], [Source])
		SELECT CAST([enddate] AS DATE) AS [ReportDate], [Enddatetime], [Feeder132KVIC1], [Feeder132KVIC2], [Feeder15MVA], [Feeder24MVA], [Feeder33KVIC1], [Feeder33KVIC2], [FeederEAF], [FeederLRF], [FeederRollingMill], 0, 0, 0, 'T-SQL'
		FROM (
			SELECT [enddate], MAX([Enddatetime]) AS [enddatetime], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder132KVIC1], 0)) AS [Feeder132KVIC1], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder132KVIC2], 0)) AS [Feeder132KVIC2], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder15MVA], 0)) AS [Feeder15MVA], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder24MVA], 0)) AS [Feeder24MVA], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder33KVIC1], 0)) AS [Feeder33KVIC1], SUM(ISNULL([Feeder33KVIC2], 0)) AS [feeder33KVIC2], SUM(ISNULL([FeederEAF], 0)) AS [FeederEAF], SUM(ISNULL([FeederLRF], 0)) AS [FeederLRF], SUM(ISNULL([FeederRollingMill], 0)) AS [FeederRollingMill] FROM (
				SELECT [FeederName], [Value], [enddate], [enddatetime] FROM (
					SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [Enddate], [FeederName] ORDER BY [EnddateTime] DESC) AS num FROM (
						SELECT  [FeederName], CASE WHEN CAST([enddatetime] AS TIME) = '00:00:00' THEN CAST(DATEADD(dd, -1, [EndDateTime]) AS DATE) ELSE CAST([EndDateTime] AS DATE) END AS [enddate], [EndDateTime], [Value], [Position]/*, Consumption*/
						FROM [Electricity_Meter_Reading] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 --AND CAST([EndDateTime] AS DATE) = @entryDate
					) AS t 
				) AS t WHERE num = 1 AND [Enddate] = @entryDate
			)AS t PIVOT (SUM([Value]) FOR [FeederName] IN ([Feeder132KVIC1], [Feeder132KVIC2], [Feeder15MVA], [Feeder24MVA], [Feeder33KVIC1], [Feeder33KVIC2], [FeederEAF], [FeederLRF], [FeederRollingMill])) As pvt
			GROUP BY [enddate]
		) AS t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Power_Consumption_LogSheet] AS PCL WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PCL.[EntryDateTime] = t.[enddatetime]);

		EXEC [XMES_Power_Consumption_report_Usp] @entrydate;

		EXEC [XMES_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP] @EntryDate;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_Electricity_Meter_Consumption_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Electricity_Meter_Consumption_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```


### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 19-Jun-2023
-- Description:	Used to bind default value of batch no control of batch master and used to generate batch number from prefix and number
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Generate_Next_Batch_No_Usp]
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @Prefix VARCHAR(100) = 'BATCH000';
	DECLARE @Number int = 0;

	DECLARE @PreviousBatchNo VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @CurrentBatchNo VARCHAR(100);

	SELECT Top 1 @PreviousBatchNo = BatchNumber FROM XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl order by BatchNumber desc
	
	IF(@PreviousBatchNo IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Prefix = SUBSTRING(@PreviousBatchNo,1, CHARINDEX('_', @PreviousBatchNo) - 1)
		SELECT @Number = SUBSTRING(@PreviousBatchNo, CHARINDEX('_', @PreviousBatchNo) + 1, LEN(@PreviousBatchNo))
	END
	
    -- return batch number
	SELECT CONCAT(@Prefix, '_', @Number+1);

	
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Generate_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_By_Equipment_Type_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Generate_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_By_Equipment_Type_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:26  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:17:21  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @PhaseID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @EquipmentTypeID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Generate_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_By_Equipment_Type_Usp]
    @PhaseID = '',
    @EquipmentTypeID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 19-06-2023
-- Description:	Called on after save logic of recipe phase master and used to generate recipe parameters based equipment type and capability if it's phase type is 'Process'
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Generate_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_By_Equipment_Type_Usp] -- XBatch_Generate_Recipe_Parameter_By_Equipment_Type_Usp 'A00CF008-7077-4513-A365-76C169A000BC','ebe2e3b8-58f9-43c2-aaf0-648c41d11b11' 
	@PhaseID VARCHAR(36),
	@EquipmentTypeID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN TRY
						SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @MaterialID VARCHAR(36);

	SELECT @MaterialID = MaterialID FROM XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Mst_Tbl WHERE ID = @PhaseID
	
	IF(@MaterialID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		print(@MaterialID);
		DECLARE @MaterialQuantity DECIMAL(18,4);

		SELECT @MaterialQuantity = Quantity FROM XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl WHERE MaterialID = @MaterialID

		IF(@MaterialQuantity IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @MaterialQuantity = Quantity FROM XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @MaterialID
		END

		IF(@MaterialQuantity IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Mst_Tbl SET Quantity = @MaterialQuantity WHERE ID = @PhaseID
		END
	END

	IF(@EquipmentTypeID IS NOT NULL AND @PhaseID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

		DECLARE @PhaseType VARCHAR(100);
		DECLARE @CapabilityID VARCHAR(100);
		SELECT @PhaseType = Type, @CapabilityID = CapabilityID FROM XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Mst_Tbl Where ID = @PhaseID;

		IF(@PhaseType = 'Process')
		BEGIN
			---------- Find equipment type name by it's id ----------
			DECLARE @EquipmentTypeName VARCHAR(100);
			SELECT @EquipmentTypeName = Name FROM Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = @EquipmentTypeID;

			---------- Prepare query to get parameters from particular equipment type parameter table ----------
			DECLARE @STREquipmentParameterQuery NVARCHAR(max);
			SET @STREquipmentParameterQuery = 'SELECT [Name], [Description] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + @EquipmentTypeName + '_Parameter_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ParentID = '''+@CapabilityID+'''';

			---------- Create parameter variable table and store parameters in it ----------
			DECLARE @Parameters AS TABLE(Name Varchar(100), Description VARCHAR(MAX));
			INSERT INTO @Parameters 
			EXEC(@STREquipmentParameterQuery);

			--SELECT * FROM @Parameters

			DECLARE @ParameterName VARCHAR(100), @ParameterDescription VARCHAR(MAX);

			---------- Equipmet type parameter cursor ----------
			DECLARE EquipmetTypeParameter_Cursor CURSOR
			FOR
			SELECT Name, Description FROM @Parameters
			
			OPEN EquipmetTypeParameter_Cursor;
			
				FETCH NEXT FROM EquipmetTypeParameter_Cursor INTO @ParameterName, @ParameterDescription
			
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
				BEGIN
					
					IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @PhaseID AND Name = @ParameterName AND IsDeleted = 0)
					BEGIN
						print('U');
						UPDATE XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl SET ModifiedOn = GETDATE(), Description = @ParameterDescription WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @PhaseID AND Name = @ParameterName);
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						print('I');
						INSERT INTO XBatch_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_Mst_Tbl (Name, ParentID, CreatedOn, Description) VALUES (@ParameterName, @PhaseID, GETDATE(), @ParameterDescription);
					END
				
					FETCH NEXT FROM EquipmetTypeParameter_Cursor INTO @ParameterName, @ParameterDescription
				END
			
			CLOSE EquipmetTypeParameter_Cursor;
			DEALLOCATE EquipmetTypeParameter_Cursor;
		
		END

	END

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH 
		
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_Generate_Recipe_Phase_Parameter_By_Equipment_Type_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)

END CATCH
```

## dbo.XBatch_Get_ActivePLCStaus_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Get_ActivePLCStaus_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-04 10:33:16  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:17:28  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Get_ActivePLCStaus_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------------------------*/
	--Created By : Nidhi Rana
	--Created On : 04-Oct-2025
	--Description : Get Active PLC Out of Total PLC
/*-----------------------------------------*/

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_ActivePLCStaus_Usp] 
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Set Query for Active PLC--*/
		SET @SQL = (
			SELECT 
				CONCAT('SELECT [', STRING_AGG([PLC], '],[') WITHIN GROUP( ORDER BY [sr]), '] FROM (
					', STRING_AGG( CAST(CONCAT('SELECT CONCAT(CAST(SUM([value]) AS INT), ''/'', CAST(COUNT([status]) AS INT)) AS [', [PLC], '] FROM (
						SELECT ', [selectList], ' FROM [', [TABLE_NAME], '] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
					) AS t UNPIVOT([Value] FOR [Status] IN (', [PivotList], ')) AS unpvt 
				) AS t', [sr]) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ' CROSS JOIN (
				' )) 
			FROM (
				SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN TABLE_NAME LIke 'EAF%' THEN 1 WHEN TABLE_NAME LIKE 'LRF%' THEN 2 WHEN TABLE_NAME LIKE 'CCM%' THEN 3 END AS INT) AS [sr]	
					, CONCAT('[', STRING_AGG(CAST([COLUMN_NAME] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'],['), ']') AS [PivotList]
					,  STRING_AGG(CAST(CONCAT('ISNULL([', [COLUMN_NAME],'], 0) AS [', [Column_Name],']') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ',') AS [selectList], [TAble_Name]
					, REPLACE([TABLE_NAME], '_SMS_Data','') AS [PLC] 
				FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
				WHERE [COLUMN_NAME] LIKE '%PLCStatus' AND [TABLE_NAME] LIKE '%_SMS_DATA'
				GROUP BY [TABLE_NAME]
			) AS t
			--ORDER  BY [sr]
		);

		--SELECT(@SQL)

		/*--Get Active PLC Staus--*/
		EXEC(@SQL)
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Get_ActivePLCStaus_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Get_ActivePLCStaus_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@SQL,@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Get_Batch_Equipment_Tag_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Get_Batch_Equipment_Tag_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:26  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:17:42  
**Parameter Count:** 0

_No parameters_

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Batch_Equipment_Tag_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 29-Jun-2023
-- Description:	Used to get batch tag list
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Batch_Equipment_Tag_Usp]
AS
BEGIN
						SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	---------- Return result table variable ----------
	DECLARE @EquipmentTag AS TABLE(ID VARCHAR(36), Name VARCHAR(100), ParentID VARCHAR(36), EquipmentID VARCHAR(36), Attribute VARCHAR(100), DataSourceID VARCHAR(36), 
	TagName VARCHAR(100), InstrumentTag VARCHAR(100), HHRange DECIMAL(18,4), HRange DECIMAL(18,4), LRange DECIMAL(18,4), LLRange DECIMAL(18,4), ColorGTHH VARCHAR(100),
	ColorBWHHH VARCHAR(100), ColorBWHL VARCHAR(100), ColorBWLLL VARCHAR(100), ColorLTLL VARCHAR(100), DocumentGTHH VARCHAR(8000), DocumentBWHHH VARCHAR(8000), 
	DocumentBWHL VARCHAR(8000), DocumentBWLLL VARCHAR(8000), DocumentLTLL VARCHAR(8000));

	---------- Prepare equipment tag list cursor ----------
	DECLARE @EquipmentTypeID VARCHAR(36), @EquipmentTypeName VARCHAR(100);

	DECLARE Equipment_Tag_Cursor CURSOR
	FOR
	SELECT ID, Name FROM Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsBatchingEntity = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0
	
	OPEN Equipment_Tag_Cursor;
		FETCH NEXT FROM Equipment_Tag_Cursor INTO @EquipmentTypeID, @EquipmentTypeName
		
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
		BEGIN

			---------- Prepare tag mapping query ----------
			DECLARE @strQuery NVARCHAR(MAX);
			SET @strQuery = 'SELECT ID, Name, ParentID, EquipmentID, Attribute, DataSourceID, TagName, InstrumentTag, HHRange, HRange, LRange, LLRange, ColorGTHH, ColorBWHHH, 
			ColorBWHL, ColorBWLLL, ColorLTLL, DocumentGTHH, DocumentBWHHH, DocumentBWHL, DocumentBWLLL, DocumentLTLL FROM '+ @EquipmentTypeName +'_Tag_Mapping_Tbl';

			---------- Store tag in to variable table ----------
			INSERT INTO @EquipmentTag
			EXEC(@strQuery);

			FETCH NEXT FROM Equipment_Tag_Cursor INTO @EquipmentTypeID, @EquipmentTypeName
		END
	
	CLOSE Equipment_Tag_Cursor;
	DEALLOCATE Equipment_Tag_Cursor;
   
   ---------- Return tag list ----------
   SELECT * FROM @EquipmentTag

END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 17-july-2023
-- Description:	Used to bind capability dropdown of recipe phase configuration by equipment type id and template id if phase type is 'Process'
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Capability_By_Type_And_Template_Usp] -- [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Capability_By_Type_And_Template_Usp] 'Text', '', '7AEF2BE4-2B4B-4CEF-A24B-AE2423D67489'
	@Type VARCHAR(10), -- Text, Value
	@EquipmentTypeID VARCHAR(36),
	@EquipmentTemplateID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrEquipmentCapabilityQuery NVARCHAR(MAX);

	IF(@EquipmentTypeID IS NULL OR @EquipmentTypeID = '')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @EquipmentTypeID = EquipmetTypeID FROM XStudio_Equipment_Mst_Vw Where TemplateID = @EquipmentTemplateID
	END

	IF(@Type = 'Text')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @StrEquipmentCapabilityQuery = 'SELECT [Name] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + Name + '_Capability_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ParentID = '''+@EquipmentTemplateID+'''' FROM  Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = @EquipmentTypeID;
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @StrEquipmentCapabilityQuery = 'SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + Name + '_Capability_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ParentID = '''+@EquipmentTemplateID+'''' FROM  Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = @EquipmentTypeID;
	END

	print(@StrEquipmentCapabilityQuery);
	EXEC(@StrEquipmentCapabilityQuery);

END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-12-26 17:18:00  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-24 17:50:29  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @heatNo | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp]
    @heatNo = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*---------------------------------*/
--Created By : Nidhi Rana
--Created On : 26-Dec-2025
--Description : Get shift delay entry for power off
/*----------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp](@heatNo INT)
AS
BEGIN
	/*----Variable Declaration---*/
	DECLARE @Str NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		IF  EXISTS (
			SELECT COUNT(*), [HeatID]
			FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime AS SPPE WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'EAF Power On' AND ([HeatID] = @HeatNo OR (@heatNo IS NULL AND [HeatID] IS NOT NULL))
			GROUP BY [HeatID] HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
			) 
		BEGIN
			SET @STR = (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(CONCAT('EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp] @HeatNo = ', [HeatID], ',@StartTime = ''', FORMAT([StartTime], 'dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff'), ''',@Endtime = ''', FORMAT([EndTime] , 'dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff'), ''' , @status = ''Power OFF Delay'' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),';' + CHAR(10)) FROM (
				SELECT [HeatID], [EndTime] AS [StartTime]
					, LEAD([StartTime]) OVER (PARTITION BY [heatId] ORDER BY [createdon]) AS [EndTime]
				FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime WITH(NOLOCK) 
					WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'EAF Power On' AND [HeatID] in (SELECT  [HeatID]
			FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime AS SPPE WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'EAF Power On' AND ([HeatID] = @heatNo OR (@heatNo IS NULL AND [HeatID] IS NOT NULL))
			GROUP BY [HeatID] HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
			) AS t WHERE [EndTime] IS NOT NULL);
			--SELECT @STR 
			EXEC (@STR)
		END
		IF  EXISTS (
			select SPPE.* from (
				SELECT SUM(SPPE.[DurationinSeconds]) AS DURATIONINSEC, [HeatID], [Status]
				FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime AS SPPE WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE SPPE.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'EAF Power On' AND ([HeatID] = @heatNo OR (@heatNo IS NULL AND [HeatID] IS NOT NULL))
				GROUP BY SPPE.[HeatID], [Status]
			) as sppe
			LEFT JOIN XMES_SMS_Event_Process_Tracker_Mst AS EPT WITH(NOLOCK) ON EPT.Name=Replace(SPPE.Status,'EAF Power On','Power On')  AND EPT.IsDeleted=0 AND EPT.Type='Delay'
			where SPPE.DURATIONINSEC>EPT.DurationInSeconds
			) 
		BEGIN
			SET @STR = (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(CONCAT('EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp] @HeatNo = ', [HeatID], ',@StartTime = ''', FORMAT([StartTime], 'dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff'), ''',@Endtime = ''', FORMAT([EndTime] , 'dd-MMM-yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff'), ''' , @status = ''Power ON Delay'' ') AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),';' + CHAR(10)) FROM (
				SELECT SPPE.[HeatID], DATEADD(SS, -([DURATIONINSEC] - [DurationinSeconds]), [EndTime]) AS [STARTTIME], [EndTime] FROM (
					SELECT SUM(SPPE.[DurationinSeconds]) AS DURATIONINSEC, [HeatID], [Status], MAX([EndTime]) AS [EndTime]
					FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime AS SPPE WITH(NOLOCK) 
					WHERE SPPE.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'EAF Power On' AND ([HeatID] = @heatNo OR (@heatNo IS NULL AND [HeatID] IS NOT NULL))
					GROUP BY SPPE.[HeatID], [Status]
				) AS sppe
				LEFT JOIN XMES_SMS_Event_Process_Tracker_Mst AS EPT WITH(NOLOCK) ON EPT.[Name] = SPPE.[Status] AND EPT.[IsDeleted] = 0
				WHERE SPPE.[DURATIONINSEC] > EPT.[DurationInSeconds]
			) AS t WHERE [EndTime] IS NOT NULL);
			--SELECT @STR 
			EXEC (@STR)
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)
	END CATCH
END

--XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp '1505344'
```

## dbo.XBatch_Get_Equipment_Template_Tag_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Get_Equipment_Template_Tag_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:26  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:17:51  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @EquipmentTypeID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @TemplateID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Equipment_Template_Tag_Usp]
    @EquipmentTypeID = '',
    @TemplateID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 21-Jun-2023
-- Description:	Used to get equipment template tag list
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Equipment_Template_Tag_Usp] --[dbo].[XBatch_Get_Equipment_Template_Tag_Usp] 'ac03d92e-5e06-4073-b202-33348249e866', 'FD2DAA01-812E-4C3D-B19A-7115C0E92C54'
	@EquipmentTypeID VARCHAR(36),
	@TemplateID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	---------- Get equipment type name by id ----------
    DECLARE @EquipmentTypeName VARCHAR(100), @EquipmentBatchClass VARCHAR(100);

	SELECT @EquipmentTypeName = Name, @EquipmentBatchClass = BatchingEquipmentClass FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl] WHERE ID = @EquipmentTypeID;

	---------- Get equipment template property details ----------
	DECLARE @EquipmentPropertiesQuery NVARCHAR(MAX), @StorageType VARCHAR(100), @IsHavingWeighingScale BIT, @WeighmentType VARCHAR(100), @FixWeightTag VARCHAR(100), @LevelTag VARCHAR(100), @LevelConversionType VARCHAR(100), 
	@Multiplier DECIMAL(18,4), @Offset DECIMAL(18,4), @LevelLookUpTable VARCHAR(100), @LevelFieldName VARCHAR(100), @WeightFieldName VARCHAR(100)

	SET @EquipmentPropertiesQuery = 'SELECT @StorageType = StorageType, @IsHavingWeighingScale = IsHavingWeighingScale, @WeighmentType = WeighmentType, @FixWeightTag = FixWeightTag, 
	@LevelTag = LevelTag, @LevelConversionType = LevelConversionType, @Multiplier = Multiplier, @Offset = Offset, @LevelLookUpTable = LevelLookUpTable, @LevelFieldName = LevelFieldName,
	@WeightFieldName = WeightFieldName FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + @EquipmentTypeName +'_Properties_Mst_Tbl] WHERE [ParentID] = @TemplateID AND [IsDeleted] = 0';

	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @EquipmentPropertiesQuery, N'@TemplateID VARCHAR(36), @StorageType VARCHAR(100) OUTPUT, @IsHavingWeighingScale BIT OUTPUT, @WeighmentType VARCHAR(100) OUTPUT, @FixWeightTag VARCHAR(100) OUTPUT, 
	@LevelTag VARCHAR(100) OUTPUT, @LevelConversionType VARCHAR(100) OUTPUT, @Multiplier DECIMAL(18,4) OUTPUT, @Offset DECIMAL(18,4) OUTPUT, @LevelLookUpTable VARCHAR(100) OUTPUT, 
	@LevelFieldName VARCHAR(100) OUTPUT, @WeightFieldName VARCHAR(100) OUTPUT', 
	@TemplateID, @StorageType = @StorageType OUTPUT,  @IsHavingWeighingScale = @IsHavingWeighingScale OUTPUT, @WeighmentType = @WeighmentType OUTPUT, @FixWeightTag = @FixWeightTag OUTPUT, 
	@LevelTag = @LevelTag OUTPUT, @LevelConversionType = @LevelConversionType OUTPUT, @Multiplier = @Multiplier OUTPUT, @Offset = @Offset OUTPUT, @LevelLookUpTable = @LevelLookUpTable OUTPUT, 
	@LevelFieldName = @LevelFieldName OUTPUT, @WeightFieldName = @WeightFieldName OUTPUT;

	---------- Prepare equipment template tag list ----------
	DECLARE @TemplateTagList AS TABLE (Name VARCHAR(36), Type VARCHAR(100));

	IF(@EquipmentBatchClass = 'Process')
	BEGIN

		---------- Prepare weighing scale tag ----------
		IF(@IsHavingWeighingScale = 1)
		BEGIN
			IF(@WeighmentType = 'Scale')
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES('FixWeightTag', 'Analog');
			END
			ELSE IF(@WeighmentType = 'Level')
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES('LevelTag', 'Analog');
			END
		END
		
		---------- Get equipment capability list from template id and store in to variable table ----------
		DECLARE @EquipmentCapability AS TABLE(ID VARCHAR(36), Name VARCHAR(100), EntryDateTime DATETIME, ReportDate DATE, IsProcessed BIT, Description VARCHAR(MAX), 
		IsStart BIT, IsHold BIT, IsRestart BIT, IsAbort BIT, IsReset BIT, IsReady BIT, IsHeld BIT, IsRun BIT, IsDone BIT, IsInterlock BIT, IsAborted BIT, InterlockValueType VARCHAR(100),
		ErrorCodeTag VARCHAR(100), ErrorLookUpTable VARCHAR(100), ErrorCodeField VARCHAR(100), ErrorDescriptionField VARCHAR(100));

		INSERT INTO @EquipmentCapability
		EXEC('SELECT ID, Name, EntryDateTime, ReportDate, IsProcessed, Description, 
		IsStart, IsHold, IsRestart, IsAbort, IsReset, IsReady, IsHeld, IsRun, IsDone, IsInterlock, IsAborted, InterlockValueType,
		ErrorCodeTag, ErrorLookUpTable, ErrorCodeField, ErrorDescriptionField FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + @EquipmentTypeName +'_Capability_Mst_Tbl] WHERE [ParentID] = ''' + @TemplateID + ''' AND [IsDeleted] = 0');

		---------- capability tag cursor variable ----------
		DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(36), @Name VARCHAR(100), @IsStart BIT, @IsHold BIT, @IsRestart BIT, @IsAbort BIT, @IsReset BIT, @IsReady BIT, @IsHeld BIT, @IsRun BIT, @IsDone BIT, 
		@IsInterlock BIT, @IsAborted BIT, @InterlockValueType VARCHAR(100), @ErrorCodeTag VARCHAR(100), @ErrorLookUpTable VARCHAR(100), @ErrorCodeField VARCHAR(100), 
		@ErrorDescriptionField VARCHAR(100);

		---------- capability tag cursor ----------
		DECLARE Capability_Tag_Cursor CURSOR
		FOR
		SELECT ID, Name, IsStart, IsHold, IsRestart, IsAbort, IsReset, IsReady, IsHeld, IsRun, IsDone, IsInterlock, IsAborted, InterlockValueType,
		ErrorCodeTag, ErrorLookUpTable, ErrorCodeField, ErrorDescriptionField FROM @EquipmentCapability
		
		OPEN Capability_Tag_Cursor;
			FETCH NEXT FROM Capability_Tag_Cursor INTO @ID, @Name, @IsStart, @IsHold, @IsRestart, @IsAbort, @IsReset, @IsReady, @IsHeld, @IsRun, @IsDone, @IsInterlock, @IsAborted, 
			@InterlockValueType, @ErrorCodeTag, @ErrorLookUpTable, @ErrorCodeField, @ErrorDescriptionField
		
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
			BEGIN

				IF(@IsStart = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsStart_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@IsHold = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsHold_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@IsRestart = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsRestart_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@IsAbort = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsAbort_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@IsReset = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsReset_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@IsReady = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsReady_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@IsHeld = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsHeld_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@IsRun = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsRun_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END
				
				IF(@IsDone = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsDone_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@IsInterlock = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsInterlock_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END
				
				IF(@IsAborted = 1)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_IsAborted_Tag', 'Discrete');
				END

				IF(@InterlockValueType = 'ErrorList')
				BEGIN
					
					---------- Get error list from capability id ----------
					DECLARE @ErrorList AS TABLE(ID VARCHAR(36), Name VARCHAR(100), Description VARCHAR(MAX), Type VARCHAR(100));

					DELETE FROM @ErrorList

					INSERT INTO @ErrorList
					EXEC('SELECT ID, Name, Description, Type FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + @EquipmentTypeName +'_Interlock_Error_Mst_Tbl] WHERE [ParentID] = ''' + @ID + ''' AND [IsDeleted] = 0');

					---------- Error list tag cursor variable ----------
					DECLARE @ErrorID VARCHAR(36), @ErrorName VARCHAR(100), @ErrorDescription VARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorType VARCHAR(100)

					---------- Prepare error list tag cursor ----------
					DECLARE ErroList_Tag_Cursor CURSOR
					FOR
					SELECT ID, Name, Description, Type FROM @ErrorList
					
					OPEN ErroList_Tag_Cursor;
						FETCH NEXT FROM ErroList_Tag_Cursor INTO @ErrorID, @ErrorName, @ErrorDescription, @ErrorType
					
						WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
						BEGIN
							
							INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_Error_' + @ErrorName + '_Tag', @ErrorType);

							FETCH NEXT FROM ErroList_Tag_Cursor INTO @ErrorID, @ErrorName, @ErrorDescription, @ErrorType
						END
					
					CLOSE ErroList_Tag_Cursor;
					DEALLOCATE ErroList_Tag_Cursor;

				END

				---------- Get parameter list from capability id ----------
				DECLARE @Parameter AS TABLE(ID VARCHAR(36), Name VARCHAR(100), Type VARCHAR(100), Mode VARCHAR(100), Description VARCHAR(MAX), IsHistorize BIT)

				DELETE FROM @Parameter

				INSERT INTO @Parameter
				EXEC('SELECT ID, Name, Type, Mode, Description, IsHistorize FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + @EquipmentTypeName +'_Parameter_Mst_Tbl] WHERE [ParentID] = ''' + @ID + ''' AND [IsDeleted] = 0');

				---------- Parameter tag cursor varibale ----------
				DECLARE @ParameterID VARCHAR(36), @ParameterName VARCHAR(100), @ParameterType VARCHAR(100), @ParameterMode VARCHAR(100), @ParameterDescription VARCHAR(MAX), @IsHistorize BIT
				
				---------- Prepare parameter tag cursor ----------
				DECLARE Parameter_Tag_Cursor CURSOR
				FOR
				SELECT ID, Name, Type, Mode, Description, IsHistorize FROM @Parameter
				
				OPEN Parameter_Tag_Cursor;
					FETCH NEXT FROM Parameter_Tag_Cursor INTO @ParameterID, @ParameterName, @ParameterType, @ParameterMode, @ParameterDescription, @IsHistorize
					
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
					BEGIN
						
						INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES(@Name + '_Parameter_' + @ParameterName + '_Tag', @ParameterType);

						FETCH NEXT FROM Parameter_Tag_Cursor INTO @ParameterID, @ParameterName, @ParameterType, @ParameterMode, @ParameterDescription, @IsHistorize
					END
				
				CLOSE Parameter_Tag_Cursor;
				DEALLOCATE Parameter_Tag_Cursor;

				FETCH NEXT FROM Capability_Tag_Cursor INTO @ID, @Name, @IsStart, @IsHold, @IsRestart, @IsAbort, @IsReset, @IsReady, @IsHeld, @IsRun, @IsDone, @IsInterlock, @IsAborted, 
				@InterlockValueType, @ErrorCodeTag, @ErrorLookUpTable, @ErrorCodeField, @ErrorDescriptionField
			END
		
		CLOSE Capability_Tag_Cursor;
		DEALLOCATE Capability_Tag_Cursor;

	END
	ELSE IF(@EquipmentBatchClass = 'Storage')
	BEGIN

		---------- Prepare weighing scale tag ----------
		IF(@StorageType = 'Single')
		BEGIN
			IF(@WeighmentType = 'Scale')
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES('FixWeightTag', 'Analog');
			END
			ELSE IF(@WeighmentType = 'Level')
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @TemplateTagList VALUES('LevelTag', 'Analog');
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT * FROM @TemplateTagList;
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Historian_Channels_By_Process_Cell_Usp]
	@ProcessCellID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT [ID] AS [DataSourceID], [Name] AS [DataSourceName] FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0  AND [IsEnable] = 1 
	AND [ParentID] = (SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Collector_Mst_Tbl] WHERE 
	[Name] = (SELECT [CollectorName] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Process_Cell_Mst_Tbl] WHERE ID = @ProcessCellID)) ORDER BY [Name]
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Historian_Tags_By_Type_DataSource_Usp]
	@TagType VARCHAR(100),
	@DataSourceID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT DISTINCT [Name] FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [TagType] = @TagType 
	AND [ParentID] IN(SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Group_Mst_Tbl] WHERE [ParentID] = @DataSourceID)
	ORDER BY NAME;

END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Get_Location_By_Grade_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Get_Location_By_Grade_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-09-15 13:38:02  
**Modified On:** 2025-10-29 14:56:52  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Type | varchar(10) | NO |  |
| @GradeNo | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Location_By_Grade_Usp]
    @Type = '',
    @GradeNo = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Twinkle Patel
-- Create date: 19-Jun-2023
-- Description:	Used to bind location dropdown of material items configuration and load location based on location type(equipment/store)
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Location_By_Grade_Usp] -- [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Location_By_Type_Usp] 'Value', 'Equipment'
	@Type Varchar(10)='', -- Text, Value
	@GradeNo Varchar(36)='' --Store,Equipment
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	BEGIN TRY
		IF(@Type = 'Text')
		BEGIN	
				
			select stackname + ' - ' + convert(varchar,sum(c)-sum(r)) + ' - ' + case when sum(r)=0 then 'No Grade Assign' else a end from (
			SELECT s.name AS StackName, SUM(r.Capacity)c,(select count(MaterialGrade) from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i WITH(NOLOCK) where i.LocationID = r.id and MaterialGrade = @GradeNo and IsDeleted=0 and movementtype = 'inward')r,@GradeNo a

			FROM XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl s WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl r WITH(NOLOCK) ON r.ParentID = s.ID and s.parentid='DC6EF45C-E82B-4B86-AF22-DB08AF77C4E6' and r.IsDeleted=0 And (s.GradeType =@GradeNo or s.GradeType is null)
			--LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl mi 
			Where s.IsDeleted=0
			GROUP BY s.name,r.id
			) as p
			group by StackName,a
			
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			select id from (
				SELECT s.id,s.name AS StackName, SUM(r.Capacity)c,(select count(MaterialGrade) from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl i WITH(NOLOCK) where i.LocationID = r.id and MaterialGrade = @GradeNo and IsDeleted=0 and movementtype = 'inward')r,@GradeNo a

				FROM XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl s WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl r WITH(NOLOCK) ON r.ParentID = s.ID and s.parentid='DC6EF45C-E82B-4B86-AF22-DB08AF77C4E6' and (s.GradeType =@GradeNo or s.GradeType is null)
				--LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl mi 
      
				GROUP BY s.name,r.id,s.id
			) as p
			group by StackName,a,id
			order by StackName
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Get_Location_By_Grade_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Get_Location_By_Grade_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Get_Location_By_Type_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Get_Location_By_Type_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:26  
**Modified On:** 2025-10-29 14:56:52  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Type | varchar(10) | NO |  |
| @LocationType | varchar(10) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Location_By_Type_Usp]
    @Type = '',
    @LocationType = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 19-Jun-2023
-- Description:	Used to bind location dropdown of material items configuration and load location based on location type(equipment/store)
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Location_By_Type_Usp] -- [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Location_By_Type_Usp] 'Value', 'Equipment'
	@Type Varchar(10), -- Text, Value
	@LocationType Varchar(10) --Store,Equipment
AS
BEGIN
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		IF(@LocationType = 'Store')
		BEGIN
			IF(@Type = 'Text')
			BEGIN
				SELECT CONCAT(sa.Name, '-', sr.Name) FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl sr WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl sa WITH(NOLOCK) ON sa.ID = sr.ParentID WHERE sr.IsDeleted = 0 AND sa.[IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY sr.Name
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT sr.ID FROM XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl sr WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN XBatch_Storage_Area_Mst_Tbl sa WITH(NOLOCK) ON sa.ID = sr.ParentID WHERE sr.IsDeleted = 0 AND sa.[IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY sr.Name
			END
		END
		ELSE IF(@LocationType = 'Equipment')
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @STREquipmentQuery NVARCHAR(MAX);
			IF(@Type = 'Text')
			BEGIN
			
				SELECT @STREquipmentQuery = 'SELECT Name FROM ('+ STUFF(( SELECT ' UNION ALL '+ 'SELECT [Name] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + Name + '_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0' FROM  Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY Name FOR XML PATH ('')), 1, 10, '') + ') AS T ORDER BY Name';

			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @STREquipmentQuery = 'SELECT ID FROM ('+ STUFF(( SELECT ' UNION ALL '+ 'SELECT [ID],[Name] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + Name + '_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0' FROM  Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY Name FOR XML PATH ('')), 1, 10, '') + ') AS T ORDER BY Name';
			END

			--print(@STREquipmentQuery);
			--EXEC('SELECT Name FROM ('+@STREquipmentQuery+') AS T ORDER BY Name');
			EXEC(@STREquipmentQuery);
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Get_Location_By_Type_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Get_Location_By_Type_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Get_Tag_Mapping_Entries_By_Page_Type_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Get_Tag_Mapping_Entries_By_Page_Type_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:26  
**Modified On:** 2025-07-22 20:34:19  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @PageType | varchar(100) | NO |  |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Tag_Mapping_Entries_By_Page_Type_Usp]
    @PageType = '',
    @ID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 07-08-2023
-- Description:	Used to load tag mapping page entries of connection/equipment
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Tag_Mapping_Entries_By_Page_Type_Usp]
	@PageType VARCHAR(100),
	@ID VARCHAR(36) -- EquipmentTypeID or ConnectionID
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF(LOWER(@PageType) = 'equipmenttype')
	BEGIN

		DECLARE @EquipmentType VARCHAR(100);
		SELECT @EquipmentType = Name FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ID;

		DECLARE @strQuery NVARCHAR(MAX) = 'SELECT TM.[ID], TM.[Name], [Type], [TagName], [DataSourceID], CM.Name AS [DataSourceName] FROM 
		[XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].['+@EquipmentType+'_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] TM WITH (NOLOCK) 
		LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] CM ON CM.[ID] = TM.[DataSourceID] 
		WHERE TM.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND [IsXBatchTag] = 1 ORDER BY TM.[Name];'

		EXEC(@strQuery);
	END
	ELSE IF(LOWER(@PageType) = 'connection')
	BEGIN
		--SELECT CPM.[ID], CPM.[Name], [Type], [TagName], [DataSourceID], CM.[Name] AS [DataSourceName] FROM 
		--[XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Connection_Parameter_Mst_Tbl] CPM WITH (NOLOCK) 
		--LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] CM ON CM.[ID] = CPM.[DataSourceID] 
		--WHERE CPM.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND CPM.[ParentID] IN(SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Connection_Capability_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE [ParentID] = @ID AND [IsDeleted] = 0) 
		--ORDER BY CPM.[Name];

		SELECT * FROM (
			SELECT CPM.[ID], CPM.[Name], [Type], [TagName], [DataSourceID], CM.[Name] AS [DataSourceName], 'parameter' AS [MappingType] FROM 
			[XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Connection_Parameter_Mst_Tbl] CPM WITH (NOLOCK) 
			LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] CM ON CM.[ID] = CPM.[DataSourceID] 
			WHERE CPM.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND 
			CPM.[ParentID] IN(
				SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Connection_Capability_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [ParentID] = @ID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			) 
			UNION ALL 
			SELECT CIE.[ID], CIE.[Name], [Type], [TagName], [DataSourceID], CM.[Name] AS [DataSourceName], 'interlock' AS [MappingType] FROM 
			[XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Connection_Interlock_Error_Mst_Tbl] CIE WITH (NOLOCK) 
			LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] CM ON CM.[ID] = CIE.[DataSourceID] 
			WHERE CIE.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND 
			CIE.[ParentID] IN(
				SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Connection_Capability_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [ParentID] = @ID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			)
		) AS T 
		ORDER BY Name
	END
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Get_Template_By_EquipmentType_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Get_Template_By_EquipmentType_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:26  
**Modified On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:26  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Type | varchar(10) | NO |  |
| @EquipmentTypeID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Template_By_EquipmentType_Usp]
    @Type = '',
    @EquipmentTypeID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya Dakoria
-- Create date: 17-july-2023
-- Description:	Used to bind equipment template dropdown of recipe phase configuration by equipment type id if equipment type id is null then load all the 'Process' template
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Template_By_EquipmentType_Usp] -- XBatch_Get_Template_By_EquipmentType_Usp 'Text', ''
	@Type VARCHAR(10), -- Text, Value
	@EquipmentTypeID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StrEquipmentTemplateQuery NVARCHAR(MAX);

	IF(@EquipmentTypeID IS NULL OR @EquipmentTypeID = '')
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @EquipmentTypeName VARCHAR(36);
		IF(@Type = 'Text')
		BEGIN

			DECLARE @EquipmentText AS TABLE(Name VARCHAR(36));

			DECLARE Equipment_Type_Cursor CURSOR
			FOR
			SELECT Name, ID FROM Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsBatchingEntity = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0 AND BatchingEquipmentClass = 'Process' ORDER BY Name
		
				OPEN Equipment_Type_Cursor;
				FETCH NEXT FROM Equipment_Type_Cursor INTO @EquipmentTypeName, @EquipmentTypeID
			
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
				BEGIN

					SELECT @StrEquipmentTemplateQuery = 'SELECT [Name] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + Name + '_Attribute_Tag_Template_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0' FROM  Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = @EquipmentTypeID;

					INSERT INTO @EquipmentText
					EXEC(@StrEquipmentTemplateQuery);

					FETCH NEXT FROM Equipment_Type_Cursor INTO @EquipmentTypeName, @EquipmentTypeID
				END
		
			CLOSE Equipment_Type_Cursor;
			DEALLOCATE Equipment_Type_Cursor;

			SELECT * FROM @EquipmentText

		END
		ELSE IF(@Type = 'Value')
		BEGIN

			DECLARE @EquipmentValue AS TABLE(ID VARCHAR(36));

			DECLARE Equipment_Type_Cursor CURSOR
			FOR
			SELECT Name, ID FROM Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsBatchingEntity = 1 AND IsDeleted = 0 AND BatchingEquipmentClass = 'Process' ORDER BY Name
		
				OPEN Equipment_Type_Cursor;
				FETCH NEXT FROM Equipment_Type_Cursor INTO @EquipmentTypeName, @EquipmentTypeID
			
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
				BEGIN

					SELECT @StrEquipmentTemplateQuery = 'SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + Name + '_Attribute_Tag_Template_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0' FROM  Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = @EquipmentTypeID;

					INSERT INTO @EquipmentValue
					EXEC(@StrEquipmentTemplateQuery);

					FETCH NEXT FROM Equipment_Type_Cursor INTO @EquipmentTypeName, @EquipmentTypeID
				END
		
			CLOSE Equipment_Type_Cursor;
			DEALLOCATE Equipment_Type_Cursor;

			SELECT * FROM @EquipmentValue
		END
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		IF(@Type = 'Text')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @StrEquipmentTemplateQuery = 'SELECT [Name] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + Name + '_Attribute_Tag_Template_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0' FROM  Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = @EquipmentTypeID;
			EXEC(@StrEquipmentTemplateQuery);
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @StrEquipmentTemplateQuery = 'SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[' + Name + '_Attribute_Tag_Template_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0' FROM  Equipment_Type_Mst_Tbl WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = @EquipmentTypeID;
			EXEC(@StrEquipmentTemplateQuery);
		END
	END
END
```
