## dbo.XBatch_GetRemaningHeat_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_GetRemaningHeat_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-10 14:23:23  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-23 14:00:22  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @type | bit | NO |  |
| @WOID | varchar(max) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_GetRemaningHeat_Usp]
    @type = 0,
    @WOID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 10-Oct-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure to get remaining heat or heat number 
-------------------------*/
  CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_GetRemaningHeat_Usp] @type BIT, @WOID VARCHAR(MAX)
  AS 
  BEGIN
  					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	BEGIN TRY

		DECLARE @grade varchar(MAX)

		Select @grade=grade from XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl where isdeleted=0 and id=(select ItemID from XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl
		where id=@WOID)

		IF @type = 0
		BEGIN
			/*---Get Remaining Heat---*/
			SELECT DISTINCT CAST(CONCAT([MaterialGrade], '-', [LotNumber], '-', [Billetqty]) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) FROM (
				SELECT [MaterialGrade], [LotNumber], COUNT([SublotNumber]) AS [NoOfSubLot], COUNT([SublotNumber]) - ISNULL((SELECT SUM([BilletQty]) FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[RM_Operator_HeatSelection] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Heatno] = [LotNumber]), 0) AS [Billetqty] FROM [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ParentID] IN 
				(SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND ([Name] LIKE '%BL%' or Name like '%billet_%')-- AND grade like'%'+@grade+'%'
				) 
					AND [LocationID] IS NOT NULL AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [MovementType] = 'inward'
				GROUP BY [MaterialGrade], [LotNumber]
			) AS t WHERE [Billetqty] BETWEEN 1 AND [NoOfSubLot]
		END 
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			/*---Get Remaining Heat Lot Number---*/
			SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST( [LotNumber] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',') FROM (
				SELECT [MaterialGrade], [LotNumber], COUNT([SublotNumber]) AS [NoOfSubLot], COUNT([SublotNumber]) - ISNULL((SELECT SUM([BilletQty]) 
				FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[RM_Operator_HeatSelection] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Heatno] = [LotNumber]), 0) AS [Billetqty] 
				FROM [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND
				[ParentID] IN (SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND ([Name] LIKE '%BL%' or Name like '%Billet%') --AND grade like'%'+@grade+'%'
				) 
					AND [LocationID] IS NOT NULL AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [MovementType] = 'inward' 
				GROUP BY [MaterialGrade], [LotNumber]
			) AS t WHERE [Billetqty] BETWEEN 1 AND [NoOfSubLot]
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_GetRemaningHeat_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_GetRemaningHeat_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
  END
```

## dbo.Xbatch_HEAT_Tracking

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** Xbatch_HEAT_Tracking  
**Created On:** 2025-08-21 18:41:56  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:18:18  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @p_filterCondition | varchar(200) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Xbatch_HEAT_Tracking]
    @p_filterCondition = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Xbatch_HEAT_Tracking](@p_filterCondition VARCHAR(200))
AS
begin
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		SET @SQL = N'
		SELECT * FROM (
	SELECT 
		-------EAF------

		  EAF.[HeatID] AS [ID]
		   ,EAF.[ReportDate]
		  ,EAF.[HeatID] AS [HeatID]
		  ,EAF.[SteelGrade]
		  ,Format(EAF.[HeatStart],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [HeatStart]
		  ,Format(EAF.[TapStart],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [TapStart]
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.HeatTimeMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) + '':'' + RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.HeatTimeSecond   AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS [TTTMinute]
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.PowerOnTimeMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) + '':'' +RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.PowerOnTimeSecond AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS [PowerONTimeMinute]
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.PowerOffTimeMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) + '':'' +RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.PowerOffTimeSecond AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS [PowerOffTimeMinute]
		  , RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(DATEDIFF_BIG(SECOND, eaf.StartTime, eaf.EndTime) / 60 AS VARCHAR), 2)+ '':'' +RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(DATEDIFF_BIG(SECOND, eaf.StartTime, eaf.EndTime) % 60 AS VARCHAR), 2) AS[TapTimeMinute]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[PowerMWH] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [PowerMWH]
		  ,EAF.[OxygenConsumption] AS [OxygenConsumptionNm3]
		  ,EAF.[NGConsumption] AS [NGConsumptionSm3]
		  ,EAF.[CarbonConsumption] AS [CarbonConsumptionkg]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[TotalChargeWeightMT]  AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [TotalChargeWeightMT]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[LiquidMetalWeight] AS DECIMAL(18,2))  AS [EAFLiquidMetalWeightTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[YieldPerHeat] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [YieldPerHeat]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BIN1LimeConsumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BIN1LimeConsumptionTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BIN2DoloConsumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS  [BIN2DoloConsumptionTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BIN3Consumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BIN3ConsumptionTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BIN4Consumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BIN4ConsumptionTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[CopexScrap] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [CopexScrapTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[HMS12] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [HMS12Ton]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[HMS1] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [HMS1Ton]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BundleLMS] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BundleLMSTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[EndCuts] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [EndCutsTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[Scull] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ScullTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[Briquette] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BriquetteTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[HBIDRI] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [HBIDRITon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[Shreedded] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ShreeddedTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[ChargeWeight] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ChargeWeightTon]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionLime] AS [LadleAdditionLimekg]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionDolo] AS [LadleAdditionDolokg]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMnn] AS [LadleAdditionSiMnnkg]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMn] AS [LadleAdditionSiMnkg]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionFeSi] AS [LadleAdditionFeSikg]
		  --,EAF.[Limepertonofsteel] 
		  --,EAF.[Dololimepertonofsteel]
		  --,EAF.[NGconsumptionpertonofsteel]
		  --,EAF.[PowerKWHPerTon]
		-------LRF-------
		  ,Format(LRF.[TreatmentStart],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [TreatmentStart]
		  ,Format(LRF.[TreatmentStop],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [TreatmentStop]
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(FLOOR(lrf.PowerONTime) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '':'' + RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST((lrf.PowerONTime - FLOOR(lrf.PowerONTime)) * 60 AS INT) AS VARCHAR), 2) AS [TreatmentTime]    
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(FLOOR(lrf.ArcingTime) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '':'' + RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST((lrf.ArcingTime - FLOOR(lrf.ArcingTime)) * 60 AS INT) AS VARCHAR), 2) AS [ArcingTime]
		  ,CAST(LRF.[ArgonConsumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ArgonConsumptionNm3]
		  ,LRF.[PowerMWH] AS [LRFPowerMWH]
		 -- , LRF.[TapTimeMinute]
		  --, LRF.[PowerONTime]
		  , CAST(LRF.[LiquidMetalWeight] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [LRFLiquidMetalWeightTon]
		  , LRF.[Lime] AS [LRFAddtionLimekg]
		  , LRF.[Dolo] AS [LRFAddtionDolokg]
		  , LRF.[FeSi] AS [LRFAddtionFeSikg]
		  , LRF.[SiMn] AS [LRFAddtionSiMnkg]
		  , LRF.[SiMnn] AS [LRFAddtionSiMnnkg]
		-------CCM-------
		  ,Format(CCM.[StartTime],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [LadleBottomOpenTime]
		  ,Format(CCM.[EndTime],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [LadleBottomCloseTime]
		 -- ,Format(CCM.[CastingStartTime],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [CastingStartTime]
		  ,CCM.[CrossSection]
		  ,CAST(CCM.[TotalProduction] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [TotalProductionTon]
		  ,CCM.[Status] AS [ArmPosition]
		  ,CAST(CCM.[ArmConsumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ArmConsumptionTon]
		  ,CCM.[TotalBilletsCount] AS [TotalBilletsCount]
		  ,CCM.[Strand1BilletCounter] AS [Strand1BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand1CastingSpeed] AS [Strand1CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD1OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand1OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand2BilletCounter] AS [Strand2BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand2CastingSpeed] AS [Strand2CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD2OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand2OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand3BilletCounter] AS [Strand3BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand3CastingSpeed] AS [Strand3CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD3OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand3OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand4BilletCounter] AS [Strand4BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand4CastingSpeed] AS [Strand4CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD4OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand4OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand5BilletCounter] AS [Strand5BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand5CastingSpeed] AS [Strand5CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD5OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand5OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand6BilletCounter] AS [Strand6BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand6CastingSpeed] AS [Strand6CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD6OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand6OscillationSpeedAvg]

	  FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] EAF WITH(NOLOCK)
	  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[LRF_Per_Heat] LRF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS LRF ON LRF.HeatID=EAF.HeatID 
	  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] CCM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS CCM ON CCM.HeatID=EAF.HeatID 
	  where EAF.IsDeleted=0  ) AS t '+CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(@p_filtercondition, '')) > 0 THEN ' WHERE ' + @p_filterCondition ELSE '' END+' 
	  order by [ID] Desc'
	  EXEC (@SQL)


	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Xbatch_HEAT_Tracking | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
```

```sql
/*-----------------------------------
	Created By : Sagar Rana
	Modified On : 24-Sep-2025
	Description : Throw error when ENtered Billet Qty is more than Total Billet Qty per Heat. 		
	
--------------------------------------*/
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Heatwise_BilletCount_SPvaildation_Usp] --30,32,'14567'
 (
	@TotalBillet INT,
	@EnteredBillets INT,
	@Heatno varchar(10)
)
 AS 
 BEGIN
 					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Openqty INT;
	--DECLARE @fdt VARCHAR(100) = convert(varchar,@Rollingdate,120);
	BEGIN TRY
		IF (@EnteredBillets > @TotalBillet)
        BEGIN
            SELECT 
                'Entered number of billets exceeds number present in yard.' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
                'There are only ' + CAST(@TotalBillet AS VARCHAR(10)) + 
                ' billets of Heat No: ' + @Heatno + ' in yard currently.' AS ValidationMessage;
        END
		
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_Heatwise_BilletCount_SPvaildation_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Heatwise_BilletCount_SPvaildation_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani 
-- Create date: 06-06-2025
-- Description:	Insert Customer Master
-- =============================================

CREATE   PROc [dbo].[XBatch_I_Customer_USP]
(
	@Name varchar(100), 
	@Address varchar(1000), 
	@City varchar(100), 
	@State varchar(100), 
	@County varchar(100), 
	@ZipCode int, 
	@ContactNumber1 varchar(100), 
	@ContactNumber2 varchar(100), 
	@EmailAddress1 varchar(200), 
	@EmailAddress2 varchar(200), 
	@Description varchar(1000), 
	@userID varchar(36) 
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIn TRY
		IF (@trancount=0)
		BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		ELSE 
		SAVE TRANSACTION Customer;

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Customer_Mst_Tbl]
				   ([ID]
				   ,[Name]
				   ,[CreatedBy]
				   ,[CreatedOn]
				   ,[Source]
				   ,[Address]
				   ,[City]
				   ,[State]
				   ,[County]
				   ,[ZipCode]
				   ,[ContactNumber1]
				   ,[ContactNumber2]
				   ,[EmailAddress1]
				   ,[EmailAddress2]
				   ,[Description])
			 VALUES
				   (NEWID()
				   ,@Name
				   ,@userID
				   ,GETDATE()
				   ,'T-SQL'
				   ,@Address
				   ,@City
				   ,@State
				   ,@County
				   ,@ZipCode
				   ,@ContactNumber1
				   ,@ContactNumber2
				   ,@EmailAddress1
				   ,@EmailAddress2
				   ,@Description
				   );
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
	BEGIn CATCh
		DECLARE @xstate int;
		select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Customer;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_I_Customer_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCh
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani 
-- Create date: 06-06-2025
-- Description:	Insert Formula Detials 
-- =============================================

CREATE   PROc [dbo].[XBatch_I_Formula_Details_USP]
(
	@FormulaName VARCHAR(100),
	@ItemNumber	Varchar(100),
	@Unit	Varchar(36),
	@Quantity	decimal(18,4),
	@QuantityType	Varchar(100),
	@Description	Varchar(max),
	@Isenabled	bit,
	@MinQuantity decimal(18,4),
	@MaxQuantity decimal(18,4),
	@UserID		varchar(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIn TRY
		IF (@trancount=0)
		BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		ELSE 
		SAVE TRANSACTION Formula_Dtl;

		DECLARE @FormulaID	VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @ItemID VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @UnitID	VARCHAR(36);

		SELECT @ItemID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Number]=@ItemNumber;

		SELECT @UnitID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Unit;

		SELECT @UnitID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@FormulaName;

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl]
			   ([ID]
			   ,[ParentID]
			   ,[CreatedBy]
			   ,[CreatedOn]
			   ,[Source]
			   ,[MaterialID]
			   ,[UnitID]
			   ,[Quantity]
			   ,[QuantityType]
			   ,[Description]
			   ,[IsEnabled]
			   ,[MinQuantity]
			   ,[MaxQuantity])
		 VALUES
			   (NEWID()
			   ,@FormulaID
			   ,@UserID
			   ,GETDATE()
			   ,'T-SQL'
			   ,@ItemID
			   ,@UnitID
			   ,@Quantity
			   ,@QuantityType
			   ,@Description
			   ,@Isenabled
			   ,@MinQuantity
			   ,@MaxQuantity
			   );
		
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
	BEGIn CATCh
		DECLARE @xstate int;
		select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Formula_Dtl;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_I_Formula_Details_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCh
END
```

**Procedure Name:** XBatch_I_Material_Consume_NoBOM_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-09-10 15:35:37  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-10 11:06:22  
**Parameter Count:** 9  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ItemName | varchar(100) | NO |  |
| @LotNumber | varchar(100) | NO |  |
| @SublotNumber | varchar(100) | NO |  |
| @Quantity | decimal(18,4) | NO |  |
| @UOMName | varchar(100) | NO |  |
| @Grade | varchar(100) | NO |  |
| @UserID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @HeatNo | int | NO |  |
| @ProduceItem | bit | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Consume_NoBOM_USP]
    @ItemName = '',
    @LotNumber = '',
    @SublotNumber = '',
    @Quantity = 0,
    @UOMName = '',
    @Grade = '',
    @UserID = '',
    @HeatNo = 0,
    @ProduceItem = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*------------------
	Created On : 10-Sep-3-2025
	Created By : Mahesh Udar
	Description : Insert Material Consume
-------------------*/
CREATE   PROC [dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Consume_NoBOM_USP]
(
	@ItemName VARCHAR(100),
	@LotNumber VARCHAR(100)=Null,
	@SublotNumber VARCHAR(100) = NULL,
	@Quantity DECIMAL(18,4),
	@UOMName VARCHAR(100),
	@Grade VARCHAR(100) = NULL,
	@UserID VARCHAR(36),
	@HeatNo int,
	@ProduceItem Bit=0
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON;

	

	BEGIN TRY

		BEGIN TRANSACTION Material_Consume;

		-- Declare variables
		DECLARE @MaterialID		VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @UOMID			VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @GradeID		VARCHAR(36) = NULL;
		DECLARE @Status			BIT;

		-- Load Material ID
		SELECT @MaterialID = [ID] 
		FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = @ItemName;

		-- Load UOM ID
		SELECT @UOMID = [ID] 
		FROM [XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = @UOMName;

		-- Load Grade ID if provided
		IF (@Grade IS NOT NULL AND @Grade != '')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @GradeID = [ID] 
			FROM [XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = @Grade;
		END

		---- Check available quantity
		--IF (@SublotNumber IS NULL OR @SublotNumber = '')
		--BEGIN
		--	IF ((SELECT [Quantity] 
		--		 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		--		 WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND
		--			   [LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND
		--			   [UOMID] = @UOMID AND
		--			   [GradeID] = @GradeID AND
		--			   [IsDeleted] = 0) >= @Quantity)
		--	BEGIN
		--		SET @Status = 0;
		--	END
		--	ELSE
		--	BEGIN
		--		SET @Status = 1;
		--	END
		--END
		--ELSE
		--BEGIN
		--	IF ((SELECT [Quantity] 
		--		 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		--		 WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND
		--			   [LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND
		--			   [SublotNumber] = @SublotNumber AND
		--			   [UOMID] = @UOMID AND
		--			   [GradeID] = @GradeID AND
		--			   [IsDeleted] = 0) >= @Quantity)
		--	BEGIN
		--		SET @Status = 0;
		--	END
		--	ELSE
		--	BEGIN
		--		SET @Status = 1;
		--	END
		--END

		---- Proceed if quantity is sufficient
		--IF (@Status = 0)

		If not Exists (Select 1 from [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl] where HeatNo=@HeatNo And MaterialID=@MaterialID)
		BEGIN
			-- Insert material consumption record
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl]
			(
				[ID],
				[ParentID],
				[CreatedBy],
				[CreatedOn],
				[Source],
				[LotNumber],
				[SublotNumber],
				[Quantity],
				[UOMID],
				[MaterialID],
				[HeatNo],
				[GradeID]
			)
			VALUES
			(
				NEWID(),
				NULL, -- No BOM
				@UserID,
				GETDATE(),
				'T-SQL',
				@LotNumber,
				@SublotNumber,
				@Quantity,
				@UOMID,
				@MaterialID,
				@HeatNo,
				@GradeID
				
			);
			END
			If(@ProduceItem=1)
			Begin
		
			-- Deduct from inventory
			IF (@SublotNumber IS NULL OR @SublotNumber = '')
			BEGIN
				UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl
				SET 
					[Quantity] = CASE WHEN [Quantity] < @Quantity THEN 0 ELSE [Quantity] - @Quantity END,
					[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
				WHERE 
					[ParentID] = @MaterialID AND
					[LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND
					[UOMID] = @UOMID AND					
					[IsDeleted] = 0;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl
				SET 
					[Quantity] = CASE WHEN [Quantity] < @Quantity THEN 0 ELSE [Quantity] - @Quantity END,
					[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
				WHERE 
					[ParentID] = @MaterialID AND
					[LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND
					[SublotNumber] = @SublotNumber AND
					[UOMID] = @UOMID AND
					[IsDeleted] = 0;
			END

		
		--END
		--ELSE
		--BEGIN
		--	DECLARE @Con_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = '"' + @ItemName + '" Required Quantity Not Available.';
		--	RAISERROR(@Con_MSG, 16, 1);
		END
		If Exists (Select 1 from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl with(nolock) Where Quantity=0 and IsDeleted=0)
		BEGIN
			Update XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET IsDeleted=1 Where Quantity=0 and IsDeleted=0
		END

		COMMIT TRANSACTION Material_Consume;
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH
		
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Material_Consume;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : XBatch_I_Material_Consume_NoBOM_USP | Line : ' + 
			CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR) + ' | Message : ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Consume_NoBOM_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG, 16, 1);
	END CATCH
END;
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani 
-- Create date: 26-06-2025
-- Description:	Material Consume
-- =============================================

CREATE     PROC [dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Consume_USP]
(
	@BOMID	Varchar(36),
	@ItemName VARCHAR(100),
	@LotNumber varchar(100),
	@SublotNumber varchar(100),
	@Quantity decimal(18,4),
	@UOMName varchar(100),
	@Grade varchar(100),

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIN TRY

		IF (@trancount=0)
			BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		ELSE 
			SAVE TRANSACTION Material_Consume;
		
		---------- Variable declaration ----------
		DECLARE @MaterialID			VARCHAR(36) = NULL;
		DECLARE @UOMID				VARCHAR(36) = NULL;
		DECLARE @GradeID			VARCHAR(36) = NULL;
		DECLARE	@Status				BIT;

		---------- Load material id from table using material name ----------
		SELECT @MaterialID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@ItemName;

		---------- Load unit of measurement id from table using unit of measurement name ----------
		SELECT @UOMID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@UOMName;

		---------- Load garde id from table using garde name ----------
		IF(@Grade IS NOT NULL OR @Grade != '')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @GradeID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Grade;
		END

		---------- Check available quantity ----------
		IF(@SublotNumber IS NULL OR @SublotNumber = '')
		BEGIN
			IF((SELECT [Quantity] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ParentID]=@MaterialID AND
				[LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND [UOMID] = @UOMID AND [GradeID] = @GradeID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)>=@Quantity)
			BEGIN
				SET @Status = 0;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Status = 1;
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF((SELECT [Quantity] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ParentID]=@MaterialID AND
				[LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND [SublotNumber]= @SublotNumber AND [UOMID] = @UOMID AND [GradeID] = @GradeID AND
				[IsDeleted] = 0)>=@Quantity)
			BEGIN
				SET @Status = 0;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Status = 1;
			END
		END

		---------- Validate BOM details ----------
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@BOMID)
		BEGIN
			IF(@Status=0)
			BEGIN

				---------- Insert item consumption entry in cons table ----------
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl]
				   ([ID]
				   ,[ParentID]
				   ,[CreatedBy]
				   ,[CreatedOn]
				   ,[Source]
				   ,[LotNumber]
				   ,[SublotNumber]
				   ,[Quantity]
				   ,[UOMID]
				   ,[GradeID])
			   VALUES
				   (NEWID()
				   ,@BOMID
				   ,@UserID
				   ,GETDATE()
				   ,'T-SQL'
				   ,@LotNumber
				   ,@SublotNumber
				   ,@Quantity
				   ,@UOMID
				   ,@GradeID);

				---------- Update actual quantity in batch BOM table ----------
				UPDATE XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl SET ActualQuantity = ISNULL(ActualQuantity, 0) + @Quantity WHERE ID = @BOMID;

				---------- Update quantity in inventory table ----------
				IF(@SublotNumber IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
						[Quantity] = ([Quantity] - @Quantity) ,
						[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE()
					WHERE [ParentID]=@MaterialID AND
						[LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND
						[UOMID] = @UOMID AND
						[GradeID] = @GradeID AND
						[IsDeleted] = 0;
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
						[Quantity] = ([Quantity] - @Quantity) ,
						[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE()
					WHERE [ParentID]=@MaterialID AND
						[LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND
						[SublotNumber]= @SublotNumber AND
						[UOMID] = @UOMID AND
						[GradeID] = @GradeID AND
						[IsDeleted] = 0;
				END

			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @Con_MSG VARCHAR(MAX)= '"'+@ItemName+'" Required Quanity Not Exist.'
				RAISERROR(@Con_MSG,16,1)
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @Con_MSG1 VARCHAR(MAX)= 'BOM Not Exist.';
			RAISERROR(@Con_MSG1,16,1);
		END

		COMMIT TRANSACTION;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH

		DECLARE @xstate int;
		select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Material_Consume;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_I_Material_Consume_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Consume_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

	END CATCH
ENd
```

### Parameters

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani 
-- Create date: 26-06-2025
-- Description:	Material Transfer Inventory
-- =============================================

CREATE     PROC [dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Inventory_Transfer_USP]
(
	@Name VARCHAR(100),
	@LotNumber varchar(100),
	@SublotNumber varchar(100),
	@Grade varchar(100),
	@Quantity decimal(18,4),
	@ToLocationType varchar(100),
	@ToLocation varchar(100),
	@FromLocationType varchar(100),
	@FromLocation varchar(100),
	@UserID VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIN TRY

		IF (@trancount=0)
			BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		ELSE 
			SAVE TRANSACTION Material_Transfer;

		---------- Variable declaration ----------
		DECLARE @GradeID		VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @IsExpired		bit;
		DECLARE @ExpiryDate		datetime;
		DECLARE @Vendor			varchar(100);
		DECLARE @PONumber		varchar(100);
		DECLARE @GRNNumber		varchar(100);
		DECLARE @InvoiceNumber	varchar(100);
		DECLARE @UOMID			varchar(36);
		DECLARE @Price			decimal(18,4);
		DECLARE @Description	varchar(1000);
		DECLARE @FromLocationID varchar(36);
		DECLARE @ToLocationID	varchar(36);
		DECLARE @MaterialID		varchar(36);
		DECLARE @ID				varchar(36);
		DECLARE @Current_Quantity		decimal(18,4);
		DECLARE @NsublotNumber	varchar(100);
		
		---------- Load material id from table using material name ----------
		SELECT @MaterialID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Name;
		
		---------- Load from location id from storage table or equipment view using from location name ----------
		IF(@FromLocationType='Store')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @FromLocationID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@FromLocation;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @FromLocationID=[ID] FROM [XStudio_Equipment_Mst_Vw] WHERE [EquipmentName]=@FromLocation;
		END

		---------- Load to location id from storage table or equipment view using to location name ----------
		IF(@ToLocationType='Store')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ToLocationID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@ToLocation;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @ToLocationID=[ID] FROM [XStudio_Equipment_Mst_Vw] WHERE [EquipmentName]=@ToLocation;
		END

		---------- Select source item details from table ----------
		SELECT 
			@ID = [ID],
			@GradeID = [GradeID],
			@IsExpired = [IsExpired],
			@ExpiryDate = ExpiryDate,
			@Vendor = [Vendor],
			@PONumber = [PONumber],
			@GRNNumber = [GRNNumber],
			@UOMID=[UOMID],
			@InvoiceNumber = [InvoiceNumber],
			@Price = [Price],
			@Current_Quantity=[Quantity],
			@Description = [Description]
		FROM [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] 
		WHERE 
			[LotNumber] = @LotNumber AND
			[SublotNumber]= @SublotNumber AND
			[LocationType] = @FromLocationType AND
			[LocationID]= @FromLocationID AND
			[ParentID] = @MaterialID AND
			[IsDeleted]=0;

		---------- Direct update location details if full quantity is being transfer ----------
		IF(@Current_Quantity = @Quantity)
		BEGIN
			
			UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
				[LocationID]=@ToLocation,
				[LocationType]=@ToLocationType ,
				[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),
				[ItemSource]='Transfer'
			WHERE [ID]=@ID;
		
		END

		---------- Valdiate available quantity and create sublot item of transfer quantity ----------
		ELSE IF(@Current_Quantity >= @Quantity)
		BEGIN
		
			---------- Update source item remaining quantity ----------
			UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
				[Quantity]=[Quantity]-@Quantity,
				[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE()					
			WHERE [ID]=@ID;	
		
			---------- Get new sublot number for split item quantity ----------
			SET @NsublotNumber= [dbo].[XBatch_Generate_SublotNumber_Fun](@name,@LotNumber,@SublotNumber);
			
			---------- Insert new item record with new sublot number ----------
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl]
				([ID]
				,[ParentID]
				,[CreatedBy]
				,[CreatedOn]
				,[Source]
				,[LotNumber]
				,[SublotNumber]
				,[GradeID]
				,[Quantity]
				,[UOMID]
				,[LocationType]
				,[LocationID]
				,[IsExpired]
				,[ExpiryDate]
				,[ReceivedDate]
				,[Vendor]
				,[PONumber]
				,[GRNNumber]
				,[InvoiceNumber]
				,[Price]
				,[Description]
				,[ItemSource])
			VALUES
				(NEWID()
				,@MaterialID
				,@UserID
				,GETDATE()
				,'T-SQL'
				,@LotNumber
				,@NsublotNumber
				,@GradeID
				,@Quantity
				,@UOMID
				,@TOLocationType
				,@TOLocationID
				,@IsExpired
				,@ExpiryDate
				,GETDATE()
				,@Vendor
				,@PONumber
				,@GRNNumber
				,@InvoiceNumber
				,@Price
				,@Description
				,'Transfer'
				);
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @Con_MSG VARCHAR(MAX)= '"'+@name+'" Required Quanity Not Exist.'
			RAISERROR(@Con_MSG,16,1)
		END
			
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;

	END TRY
	BEGIn CATCh

		DECLARE @xstate int;
		select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Material_Transfer;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_I_Material_Inventory_Transfer_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

	END CATCh
ENd
```

```sql
-- =============================================

 --[dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Produce_USP] 'F5D4B56A-D658-4086-9195-B47F21ECE98A','Cookie Dough','1751027971498','1751027971498_1',1000.0,'kg','Okay','C9710FC1-E4FF-4FDC-991A-A1B54F059E59'

(
	@HeatNo	int,
	@ItemName VARCHAR(100),
	@LotNumber varchar(100),
	@SublotNumber varchar(100),
	@Quantity decimal(18,4),
	@UOMName varchar(100),
	@Grade varchar(100),
	@UserID VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	--DECLARE @trancount INT;
	--SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIN TRY
	
		--IF (@trancount=0)
			BEGIN TRANSACTION Material_Produce;
		--ELSE 
		--	SAVE TRANSACTION Material_Produce;
		
		---------- Variable declaration ----------
		DECLARE @MaterialID		VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @UOMID			VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @GradeID		VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @OperationID	VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @materialGrade	VARCHAR(200);
		DECLARE @Plant			VARCHAR(200);
		DECLARE @WorkOrderID	 VARCHAR(36);
		
		---------- Load material id from table using material name ----------
		SELECT @MaterialID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@ItemName;
		
		---------- Load unit of measurement id from table using unit of measurement name ----------
		SELECT @UOMID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@UOMName;
				
		---------- Load garde id from table using garde name ----------
		IF(@Grade IS NOT NULL OR @Grade != '')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @GradeID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Grade;
		END

		SELECT @materialGrade = [SteelGrade], @WorkOrderID = [WorkOrder] FROM EAF_PER_HEAT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [HeatID] = @HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		--SELECT @plant = [Plant] FROM [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrderID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
			
		---------- Insert item production entry in prod table ----------
		INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl]
			([ID]
			,[HeatNo]
			,[CreatedBy]
			,[CreatedOn]
			,[Source]
			,[LotNumber]
			,[SublotNumber]
			,[Quantity]
			,[UOMID]
			,[MaterialID]
			,[GradeID])
		VALUES
			(NEWID()
			,@HeatNo
			,@UserID
			,GETDATE()
			,'T-SQL'
			,@LotNumber
			,@SublotNumber
			,@Quantity
			,@UOMID
			,@MaterialID
			,@GradeID);
			
		---------- Insert item production entry in live inventory table ----------
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl]
			([ID]
			,[ParentID]
			,[CreatedBy]
			,[CreatedOn]
			,[Source]
			,[LotNumber]
			,[SublotNumber]
			,[GradeID]
			,[Quantity]
			,[UOMID]
			,[LocationType]
			,[LocationID]
			,[IsExpired]
			,[ExpiryDate]
			,[ReceivedDate]
			,[Vendor]
			,[PONumber]
			,[GRNNumber]
			,[InvoiceNumber]
			,[Price]
			,[Description]
			,[OperationID]
			,[ItemSource]
			,[Remark]
			,[MaterialGrade]
			,[PlantName]
			)
		VALUES
			(NEWID()
			,@MaterialID
			,@UserID
			,GETDATE()
			,'T-SQL'
			,@LotNumber
			,@SublotNumber
			,@Grade
			,@Quantity
			,@UOMID
			,''--<LocationType, varchar(100),>
			,''--<LocationID, varchar(36),>
			,0--<IsExpired, bit,>
			,null--<ExpiryDate, date,>
			,GETDATE()--<ReceivedDate, datetime,>
			,''--<Vendor, varchar(100),>
			,''--<PONumber, varchar(100),>
			,''--<GRNNumber, varchar(100),>
			,''--<InvoiceNumber, varchar(100),>
			,null--<Price, decimal(18,4),>
			,null--<Description, varchar(1000),>
			,Null
			,'Produce'
			,''--<Remark, varchar(1000),>
			,@materialGrade
			,ISNULL(@Plant,'7502')
			)

		COMMIT TRANSACTION Material_Produce;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH

		--DECLARE @xstate int;
		--select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		--IF @xstate = -1
		--	ROLLBACK;
		--IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
		--	ROLLBACK;
		--IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Material_Produce;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_I_Material_Produce_NoBOM_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Produce_NoBOM_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

	END CATCh
ENd
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani 
-- Create date: 26-06-2025
-- Description:	Material Produce
-- =============================================

 --[dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Produce_USP] 'F5D4B56A-D658-4086-9195-B47F21ECE98A','Cookie Dough','1751027971498','1751027971498_1',1000.0,'kg','Okay','C9710FC1-E4FF-4FDC-991A-A1B54F059E59'

CREATE     PROC [dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Produce_USP]
(
	@BOMID	Varchar(36),
	@ItemName VARCHAR(100),
	@LotNumber varchar(100),
	@SublotNumber varchar(100),
	@Quantity decimal(18,4),
	@UOMName varchar(100),
	@Grade varchar(100),
	@UserID VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIN TRY

		IF (@trancount=0)
			BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		ELSE 
			SAVE TRANSACTION Material_Produce;
		
		---------- Variable declaration ----------
		DECLARE @MaterialID		VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @UOMID			VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @GradeID		VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @OperationID	VARCHAR(36);
		
		---------- Load material id from table using material name ----------
		SELECT @MaterialID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@ItemName;
		
		---------- Load unit of measurement id from table using unit of measurement name ----------
		SELECT @UOMID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@UOMName;
		
		---------- Load garde id from table using garde name ----------
		IF(@Grade IS NOT NULL OR @Grade != '')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @GradeID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Grade;
		END
		
		---------- Load operation id from bom table using BOM id ----------
		SELECT @OperationID=[OperationID] FROM [XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@BOMID;

		---------- Insert item production entry in prod table ----------
		INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl]
			([ID]
			,[ParentID]
			,[CreatedBy]
			,[CreatedOn]
			,[Source]
			,[LotNumber]
			,[SublotNumber]
			,[Quantity]
			,[UOMID]
			,[GradeID])
		VALUES
			(NEWID()
			,@BOMID
			,@UserID
			,GETDATE()
			,'T-SQL'
			,@LotNumber
			,@SublotNumber
			,@Quantity
			,@UOMID
			,@GradeID);
		
		---------- Update actual quantity in batch BOM table ----------
		UPDATE XBatch_Batch_BOM_Mst_Tbl SET ActualQuantity = @Quantity WHERE ID = @BOMID;
		
		---------- Insert item production entry in live inventory table ----------
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl]
			([ID]
			,[ParentID]
			,[CreatedBy]
			,[CreatedOn]
			,[Source]
			,[LotNumber]
			,[SublotNumber]
			,[GradeID]
			,[Quantity]
			,[UOMID]
			,[LocationType]
			,[LocationID]
			,[IsExpired]
			,[ExpiryDate]
			,[ReceivedDate]
			,[Vendor]
			,[PONumber]
			,[GRNNumber]
			,[InvoiceNumber]
			,[Price]
			,[Description]
			,[OperationID]
			,[ItemSource]
			,[Remark])
		VALUES
			(NEWID()
			,@MaterialID
			,@UserID
			,GETDATE()
			,'T-SQL'
			,@LotNumber
			,@SublotNumber
			,@GradeID
			,@Quantity
			,@UOMID
			,''--<LocationType, varchar(100),>
			,''--<LocationID, varchar(36),>
			,0--<IsExpired, bit,>
			,''--<ExpiryDate, date,>
			,''--<ReceivedDate, datetime,>
			,''--<Vendor, varchar(100),>
			,''--<PONumber, varchar(100),>
			,''--<GRNNumber, varchar(100),>
			,''--<InvoiceNumber, varchar(100),>
			,0--<Price, decimal(18,4),>
			,''--<Description, varchar(1000),>
			,@OperationID
			,'Produce'
			,''--<Remark, varchar(1000),>
			)

		COMMIT TRANSACTION;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH

		DECLARE @xstate int;
		select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Material_Produce;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_I_Material_Produce_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

	END CATCh
ENd
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani 
-- Create date: 06-06-2025
-- Description:	Insert Material Master
-- =============================================

CREATE   PROc [dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_USP]
(
	@Name				VARCHAR(100),
	@Type				VARCHAR(100),
	@Unit				VARCHAR(100),
	@Number				VARCHAR(100),
	@Stocktype			VARCHAR(100),
	@Quantity			DECIMAL(18,4),
	@Description		VARCHAR(MAX),
	@IsEnabled			BIT,
	@CanExpire			BIT,
	@ExpireDays			INT,
	@MinInventorylevel	DECIMAL(18,4),
	@MaxOrderSize		DECIMAL(18,4),
	@LotNumberFormat	VARCHAR(100),
	@SubLotNumberFormat	VARCHAR(100),
	@UserID				VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIn
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	BEGIn TRY
			DECLARE @TypeID	VARCHAR(36);
			DECLARE @UnitID	VARCHAR(36);

			SELECT @TypeID=[ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Type;

			SELECT @UnitID=[ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Unit;

			IF @IsEnabled IS NULL SET @IsEnabled = 0;
			IF @CanExpire IS NULL SET @CanExpire = 0;
			IF @Stocktype IS NULL SET @Stocktype = 'Bulk';


			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl]
           ([ID]
           ,[Name]
           ,[CreatedBy]
           ,[CreatedOn]
           ,[IsDeleted]
           ,[IsSystem]
           ,[Source]
           ,[TypeID]
           ,[UnitID]
           ,[Number]
           ,[StockType]
           ,[Quantity]
           ,[Description]
           ,[IsEnabled]
           ,[CanExpire]
           ,[ExpireDays]
           ,[MinInventoryLevel]
           ,[MaxOrderSize]
           ,[LotNumberFormat]
           ,[SubLotNumberFormat])
			VALUES
           (NEWID()
           ,@Name
		   ,@UserID
		   ,GETDATE()
           ,0
           ,0
           ,'T-SQL'
           ,@TypeID
           ,@UnitID
           ,@Number
           ,@Stocktype
           ,@Quantity
           ,@Description
           ,@IsEnabled
           ,@CanExpire
           ,@ExpireDays
           ,@MinInventorylevel
           ,@MaxOrderSize
           ,@LotNumberFormat
           ,@SubLotNumberFormat
		   );
		


	END TRY
	BEGIn CATCh
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_I_Material_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
        DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCh
ENd
```

## dbo.XBatch_I_Particular_Master_Trn_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_I_Particular_Master_Trn_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-10 14:21:05  
**Modified On:** 2025-10-11 10:43:43  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Reportdate | datetime | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_I_Particular_Master_Trn_Usp]
    @Reportdate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 10-Oct-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure to insert date wise particulars 
-----------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [XBatch_I_Particular_Master_Trn_Usp] 
(/*DECLARE */@Reportdate DATETIME /*= '2025-08-01 00:00:00.000'*/)
AS 
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRY
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [Particulars_Masters_Trn] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) = CAST(@Reportdate AS DATE) AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO [Particulars_Masters_Trn] ([ReportDate], [Particulars], [Type], [UOM], [SrNo]) 
			SELECT CAST(@Reportdate AS DATE) AS [ReportDate], PMT.[Particulars], PMT.[Type], PMT.[UOM], PMT.[SrNo] 
			FROM [Particulars_Masters] AS PMT WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE PMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND PMT.[Particulars] NOT IN ('Best Day Data','Best Month Data') 
				AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [Particulars_Masters_Trn] AS trn WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE trn.[ReportDate] = @Reportdate AND trn.[Particulars] = PMT.[Particulars] AND trn.[IsDeleted] = 0)
			ORDER BY PMT.[SrNo]
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH	
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_I_Particular_Master_Trn_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_I_Particular_Master_Trn_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

```sql
CREATE     PROc [dbo].[XBatch_I_SO_USP]
(
	@Name				varchar(100),
	@customerName		Varchar(100),
	@ItemNumber			varchar(100),
	@Quantity			decimal(18,4),
    @Unit				Varchar(100),
    @ReceivedDate		datetime,
	@ApprovedDate		datetime,
	@ApprovedBy			varchar(36),
	@CompletionDate		datetime,
	@Remarks			Varchar(1000),
	@SalesOrderNumber	Varchar(100),
	@UserID				varchar(36)
)
AS
BEGIn
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIn TRY
		IF (@trancount=0)
		BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		ELSE 
		SAVE TRANSACTION SO;

		DECLARE @ItemID Varchar(36)
		DECLARE @CustomerID	varchar(36)
		DECLARE @UnitID	Varchar(36)
		
		SELECT @ItemID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Number]=@ItemNumber;

		SELECT @CustomerID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Customer_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@customerName;

		SELECT @UnitID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Unit;

		

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl]
           ([ID]
           ,[Name]
           ,[ParentID]
           ,[CreatedBy]
           ,[CreatedOn]
           ,[Source]
           ,[ItemID]
           ,[Quantity]
           ,[UnitID]
           ,[ReceivedDate]
           ,[ApprovedDate]
           ,[ApprovedBy]
           ,[CompletionDate]
           ,[Remarks]
           ,[SalesOrderNumber])
     VALUES
           (NEWID()
           ,@Name
           ,@CustomerID
           ,@UserID
           ,GETDATE()
           ,'T-SQL'
           ,@ItemID
           ,@Quantity
           ,@UnitID
           ,@ReceivedDate
           ,@ApprovedDate
           ,@ApprovedBy
           ,@CompletionDate
           ,@Remarks
           ,@SalesOrderNumber
		   );

		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
	BEGIn CATCh
		DECLARE @xstate int;
		select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SO;
	
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_I_SO_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

END
```

## dbo.Xbatch_LastSevenDay_HEAT_Tracking

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** Xbatch_LastSevenDay_HEAT_Tracking  
**Created On:** 2025-09-24 17:29:39  
**Modified On:** 2026-06-23 18:42:22  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @p_filterCondition | varchar(200) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Xbatch_LastSevenDay_HEAT_Tracking]
    @p_filterCondition = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Xbatch_LastSevenDay_HEAT_Tracking](@p_filterCondition VARCHAR(200))
AS
begin
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY

		SET @SQL = N'
		SELECT * FROM (
	SELECT 
		-------EAF------

		  EAF.[HeatID] AS [ID], CCM.[workordernumber]
		   ,EAF.[ReportDate]
		  ,EAF.[HeatID] AS [HeatNo]
		  ,ISNULL(EAF.[SteelGrade], CCM.[Grade]) AS [SteelGrade]
		  ,Format(EAF.[HeatStart],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [HeatStart]
		  ,Format(EAF.[TapStart],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [TapStart]
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.HeatTimeMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) + '':'' + RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.HeatTimeSecond   AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS [TTTMinute]
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.PowerOnTimeMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) + '':'' +RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.PowerOnTimeSecond AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS [PowerONTimeMinute]
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.PowerOffTimeMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) + '':'' +RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST(eaf.PowerOffTimeSecond AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS [PowerOffTimeMinute]
		  , RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(DATEDIFF_BIG(SECOND, eaf.StartTime, eaf.EndTime) / 60 AS VARCHAR), 2)+ '':'' +RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(DATEDIFF_BIG(SECOND, eaf.StartTime, eaf.EndTime) % 60 AS VARCHAR), 2) AS[TapTimeMinute]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[PowerMWH] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [PowerMWH]
		  ,EAF.[OxygenConsumption] AS [OxygenConsumptionNm3]
		  ,EAF.[NGConsumption] AS [NGConsumptionSm3]
		  ,EAF.[CarbonConsumption] AS [CarbonConsumptionkg]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[TotalChargeWeightMT]  AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [TotalChargeWeightMT]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[LiquidMetalWeight] AS DECIMAL(18,2))  AS [EAFLiquidMetalWeightTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[YieldPerHeat] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [YieldPerHeat]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BIN1LimeConsumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BIN1LimeConsumptionTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BIN2DoloConsumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS  [BIN2DoloConsumptionTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BIN3Consumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BIN3ConsumptionTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BIN4Consumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BIN4ConsumptionTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[CopexScrap] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [CopexScrapTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[HMS12] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [HMS12Ton]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[HMS1] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [HMS1Ton]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[BundleLMS] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BundleLMSTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[EndCuts] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [EndCutsTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[Scull] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ScullTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[Briquette] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [BriquetteTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[HBIDRI] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [HBIDRITon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[Shreedded] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ShreeddedTon]
		  ,CAST(EAF.[ChargeWeight] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ChargeWeightTon]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionLime] AS [LadleAdditionLimekg]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionDolo] AS [LadleAdditionDolokg]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMnn] AS [LadleAdditionSiMnnkg]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMn] AS [LadleAdditionSiMnkg]
		  ,EAF.[LadleAdditionFeSi] AS [LadleAdditionFeSikg]
		  --,EAF.[Limepertonofsteel] 
		  --,EAF.[Dololimepertonofsteel]
		  --,EAF.[NGconsumptionpertonofsteel]
		  --,EAF.[PowerKWHPerTon]
		-------LRF-------
		  ,Format(LRF.[TreatmentStart],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [TreatmentStart]
		  ,Format(LRF.[TreatmentStop],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [TreatmentStop]
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(FLOOR(lrf.PowerONTime) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '':'' + RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST((lrf.PowerONTime - FLOOR(lrf.PowerONTime)) * 60 AS INT) AS VARCHAR), 2) AS [TreatmentTime]    
		  ,RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(FLOOR(lrf.ArcingTime) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '':'' + RIGHT(''0'' + CAST(CAST((lrf.ArcingTime - FLOOR(lrf.ArcingTime)) * 60 AS INT) AS VARCHAR), 2) AS [ArcingTime]
		  ,CAST(LRF.[ArgonConsumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ArgonConsumptionNm3]
		  ,LRF.[PowerMWH] AS [LRFPowerMWH]
		  ,CAST(LRF.[PurgingFlowLPM] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [PurgingFlowLPM]
		 -- , LRF.[TapTimeMinute]
		  --, LRF.[PowerONTime]
		  , CAST(LRF.[LiquidMetalWeight] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [LRFLiquidMetalWeightTon]
		  , LRF.[Lime] AS [LRFAddtionLimekg]
		  , LRF.[Dolo] AS [LRFAddtionDolokg]
		  , LRF.[FeSi] AS [LRFAddtionFeSikg]
		  , LRF.[SiMn] AS [LRFAddtionSiMnkg]
		  , LRF.[SiMnn] AS [LRFAddtionSiMnnkg]
		  , LRF.[Carbon] AS [LRFCarboninkg]
		  , LRF.[FlourSpar] AS [LRFFlourSparinkg]
		  , LRF.[Aluminium] AS [LRFAluminiuminkg]
		-------CCM-------
		  ,Format(CCM.[StartTime],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [LadleBottomOpenTime]
		  ,Format(CCM.[EndTime],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [LadleBottomCloseTime]
		 -- ,Format(CCM.[CastingStartTime],''dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss'') AS [CastingStartTime]
		  ,CCM.[CrossSection]
		  ,CAST(CCM.[TotalProduction] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [TotalProductionTon]
		  ,CCM.[Status] AS [ArmPosition]
		  ,CAST(CCM.[ArmConsumption] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [ArmConsumptionTon]
		  ,CCM.[TotalBilletsCount] AS [TotalBilletsCount]
		  ,CCM.[Strand1BilletCounter] AS [Strand1BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand1CastingSpeed] AS [Strand1CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD1OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand1OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand2BilletCounter] AS [Strand2BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand2CastingSpeed] AS [Strand2CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD2OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand2OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand3BilletCounter] AS [Strand3BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand3CastingSpeed] AS [Strand3CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD3OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand3OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand4BilletCounter] AS [Strand4BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand4CastingSpeed] AS [Strand4CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD4OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand4OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand5BilletCounter] AS [Strand5BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand5CastingSpeed] AS [Strand5CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD5OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand5OscillationSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[Strand6BilletCounter] AS [Strand6BilletCounter]
		  ,CCM.[Strand6CastingSpeed] AS [Strand6CastingSpeedAvg]
		  ,CCM.[STD6OSCSpeed]  AS [Strand6OscillationSpeedAvg]
		 -------Total Lime-------
		 ,(EAF.[BIN1LimeConsumption]+EAF.[LadleAdditionLime]+LRF.[Lime]) AS [TotalLimeConsumption]
		 -------Total Dolo-------
		 ,(EAF.[BIN2DoloConsumption]+EAF.[LadleAdditionDolo]+LRF.[Dolo]) AS [TotalDoloConsumption]
		 -------Total FeSi-------
		 ,(EAF.[LadleAdditionFeSi]+LRF.[FeSi]) AS [TotalFeSiConsumption]
		 -------Total FeSi-------
		 ,(EAF.[LadleAdditionSiMn]+LRF.[SiMn]) AS [TotalSiMnConsumption]

	  FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] EAF WITH(NOLOCK)
	  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[LRF_Per_Heat] LRF WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS LRF ON LRF.HeatID=EAF.HeatID 
	  LEFT JOIN (SELECT wom.[workordernumber],CCM.* FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] CCM WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.xbatch_work_order_mst_tbl as wom WITH(NOLOCK) ON CCM.[WorkORder] = wom.[ID] AND wom.[Isdeleted] = 0 WHERE ccm.[IsDeleted] = 0) AS CCM ON CCM.HeatID=EAF.HeatID 
	  where EAF.IsDeleted=0 and CAST(EAF.StartTime as date)>CAST(GETDATE()-60 as date)  ) AS t '+CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(@p_filtercondition, '')) > 0 THEN ' WHERE ' + @p_filterCondition ELSE '' END+' 
	  order by [ID] Desc'
	  EXEC (@SQL)

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Xbatch_LastSevenDay_HEAT_Tracking | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[Xbatch_LastSevenDay_HEAT_Tracking]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------
	Created By : Mahesh Udar
	Created On : 11-Sep-2025
	Description : Get Material Consumed Split
----------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Consumed_Split_Usp]
	@ID                VARCHAR(36),
	@UserID            VARCHAR(36),
	@HeatNo            INT,
	@FristLotNumber    VARCHAR(200),
	@Quantity          DECIMAL(18, 2),
	@MaterialID        VARCHAR(36),
	@UOMID             VARCHAR(36),
	@IsMulitLots       BIT,
	@SecondLotNumber   VARCHAR(200) = NULL,
	@SecondLotQuantity VARCHAR(200) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*---Variable Declaration---*/
	DECLARE @FristLotQuantity DECIMAL(18, 2),@GradeID1 VARCHAR(36),@GradeID2 VARCHAR(36),@UnitPrice1 DECIMAL(18, 2),@UnitPrice2 DECIMAL(18, 2);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*---Get GradeID and Unit Price for First lot---*/
		SELECT @GradeID1 = [GradeID], @UnitPrice1 = (ISNULL([AvailableQuantityPrice], [Price]) / [Quantity])
		FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND [LotNumber] = @FristLotNumber AND [UOMID] = @UOMID AND [IsDeleted] = 0; 

		/*---get GradeID and Unit Price for second lot---*/
		SELECT @GradeID2 = [GradeID], @UnitPrice2 = (ISNULL([AvailableQuantityPrice], [Price]) / [Quantity])
		FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND [LotNumber] = @SecondLotNumber AND [UOMID] = @UOMID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
	
		IF (@IsMulitLots = 0)
		BEGIN	
			-- Deduct from inventory for single lot
			UPDATE [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl]
			SET 
				[Quantity] = [Quantity] - @Quantity,
				[AvailableQuantityPrice] = @UnitPrice1 * ([Quantity] - @Quantity),
				[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
			WHERE 
				[ParentID] = @MaterialID AND
				[LotNumber] = @FristLotNumber AND
				[UOMID] = @UOMID AND
				[GradeID] = @GradeID1 AND
				[IsDeleted] = 0;

			-- Update consumption transaction record
			UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl]
			SET 
				[LotNumber] = @FristLotNumber,
				[Price] = @UnitPrice1 * @Quantity,
				[GradeID] = @GradeID1
			WHERE 
				[ID] = @ID AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo;
		END
		ELSE IF (@IsMulitLots = 1)
		BEGIN
			-- Calculate quantity for the first lot
			SET @FristLotQuantity = @Quantity - @SecondLotQuantity;

			-- Insert new consumption transaction for second lot
			INSERT INTO dbo.[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl] 
				([ID], [ParentID], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [Source], [LotNumber], [SublotNumber], [Quantity], [UOMID], [MaterialID], [HeatNo], [GradeID], [Price], [DeclareQuantity])
			VALUES 
				(NEWID(), NULL, @UserID, GETDATE(), 'T-SQL', @SecondLotNumber, NULL, @SecondLotQuantity, @UOMID, @MaterialID, @HeatNo,@GradeID2,(@UnitPrice2 * @SecondLotQuantity), @SecondLotQuantity);
				
			-- Deduct second lot from inventory
			UPDATE [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl]
			SET 
				[Quantity] = [Quantity] - @SecondLotQuantity,
				[AvailableQuantityPrice] = @UnitPrice2 * ([Quantity] - @SecondLotQuantity),
				[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
			WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND [LotNumber] = @SecondLotNumber AND [UOMID] = @UOMID AND [GradeID] = @GradeID2 AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

			-- Deduct first lot from inventory
			UPDATE [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl]
			SET 
				[Quantity] = [Quantity] - @FristLotQuantity,
				[AvailableQuantityPrice] = @UnitPrice1 * ([Quantity] - @FristLotQuantity),
				[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
			WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND [LotNumber] = @FristLotNumber AND [UOMID] = @UOMID AND [GradeID] = @GradeID1 AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

			-- Update existing consumption transaction for first lot
			UPDATE dbo.[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl]
			SET 
				[LotNumber] = @FristLotNumber,
				[GradeID] = @GradeID1,
				[Quantity] = @FristLotQuantity,
				[Price] = @UnitPrice1 * @FristLotQuantity
			WHERE 
				[ID] = @ID AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo;
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Material_Consumed_Split_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Consumed_Split_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Material_Consumed_Split_Validate_Usp

**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:19:02  
**Parameter Count:** 10  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |


### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------
	Created By : Mahesh Udar
	Created On : 11-Sep-2025
	Description : Get Material consumed Split Validate
------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Consumed_Split_Validate_Usp]
	@ID                VARCHAR(36),
	@UserID            VARCHAR(36),
	@HeatNo            INT,
	@FristLotNumber    VARCHAR(200),
	@Quantity          DECIMAL(18, 2),
	@MaterialID        VARCHAR(36),
	@UOMID             VARCHAR(36),
	@IsMulitLots       BIT,
	@SecondLotNumber   VARCHAR(200) = NULL,
	@SecondLotQuantity DECIMAL(18, 2) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @FristLotQuantity DECIMAL(18, 2);
	DECLARE @Message VARCHAR(1000);
	DECLARE @AvailableQuantity DECIMAL(18, 2);
	BEGIN TRY
		-- ================================================
		-- 🧠 Validation Block (like in Lot_Sublot_Validate_Usp)
		-- ================================================

		-- 1. Validate second lot quantity does not exceed total
		IF (@SecondLotQuantity > @Quantity AND @IsMulitLots = 1 AND @SecondLotQuantity IS NOT NULL AND @Quantity IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @Message = 'Second Lot Quantity cannot be greater than the Total Quantity.';
		END

		-- 2. Check if lot names are the same in multi-lot case
		IF (@Message IS NULL AND @IsMulitLots = 1 AND @FristLotNumber = @SecondLotNumber)
		BEGIN
			SET @Message = 'First Lot and Second Lot cannot have the same name in a split operation.';
		END

		-- 3. Validate available quantity in First Lot
		IF (@Message IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AvailableQuantity = Quantity
			FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE LotNumber = @FristLotNumber AND
				  ParentID = @MaterialID AND
				  UOMID = @UOMID AND
				  IsDeleted = 0;

			IF (@AvailableQuantity IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @Message = 'First Lot [' + @FristLotNumber + '] does not exist in inventory.';
			END
			ELSE IF (@IsMulitLots = 1 AND @SecondLotQuantity IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @FristLotQuantity = @Quantity - @SecondLotQuantity;

				IF (@FristLotQuantity > @AvailableQuantity)
				BEGIN
					SET @Message = 'You cannot consume more than available quantity in First Lot [' + @FristLotNumber + '].';
				END
			END
			ELSE IF (@IsMulitLots = 0 AND @Quantity > @AvailableQuantity)
			BEGIN
				SET @Message = 'You cannot consume more than available quantity in Lot [' + @FristLotNumber + '].';
			END
		END

		-- 4. Validate Second Lot (only if multi-lot and no error yet)
		IF (@Message IS NULL AND @IsMulitLots = 1 AND @SecondLotQuantity IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @AvailableQuantity = Quantity
			FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE LotNumber = @SecondLotNumber AND
				  ParentID = @MaterialID AND
				  UOMID = @UOMID AND
				  IsDeleted = 0;

			IF (@AvailableQuantity IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @Message = 'Second Lot [' + @SecondLotNumber + '] does not exist in inventory.';
			END
			ELSE IF (@SecondLotQuantity > @AvailableQuantity)
			BEGIN
				SET @Message = 'You cannot consume more than available quantity in Second Lot [' + @SecondLotNumber + '].';
			END
		END

		-- 🔚 Return validation message (if any)
		IF (@Message IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Message;
		
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Material_Consumed_Split_Validate_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Consumed_Split_Validate_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Material_Lot_Sublot_Validate_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Material_Lot_Sublot_Validate_Usp

**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:19:20

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |

| @Source | varchar(20) | NO |  |
| @AvailableQuantity | decimal(18,0) | NO |  |
| @Quantity | decimal(18,0) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql

    @ID = '',
    @LotNumber = '',
    @SubLotNumber = '',
    @Source = '',
    @AvailableQuantity = 0,
    @Quantity = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria
-- Create date: 02-jul-2025
-- Description:	Used to validate lot and sub lot number before save inventory, split, transfer, reclassify
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Lot_Sublot_Validate_Usp]
	@ID VARCHAR(100),
	@LotNumber VARCHAR(100),
	@SubLotNumber VARCHAR(100),
	@Source VARCHAR(20),
	@AvailableQuantity decimal = NULL,
	@Quantity decimal = NULL
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @Message VARCHAR(1000);

	BEGIN --- Lot sub lot validation logic

		IF(@Source = 'inventory' OR @Source = 'split')
		BEGIN
		
			---------- case : lot having sublot number ----------
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE LotNumber = @LotNumber AND SublotNumber IS NOT NULL AND IsDeleted = 0)
			BEGIN
				---------- case : sub lot is null ----------
				IF(@SubLotNumber IS NULL OR @SubLotNumber = '')
				BEGIN
					SET @Message = 'The lot having sublot number. So, kindly enter sublot number!';
				END

				---------- case : sub lot is null ----------
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF(@ID IS NULL OR @ID = '0')
					BEGIN
						SET @Message = CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl 
						WHERE LotNumber = @LotNumber AND SublotNumber = @SubLotNumber AND IsDeleted = 0) > 0) THEN 'Combination of lot and sublot is already exists! Kindly change it!' END
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @Message =  CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl 
						WHERE LotNumber = @LotNumber AND SublotNumber = @SubLotNumber AND IsDeleted = 0 AND ID != @ID) > 0) THEN 'Combination of lot and sublot is already exists! Kindly change it!' END
					END
				END
			END
			---------- case : lot having no sublot number ----------
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @Message =  CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl 
					WHERE LotNumber = @LotNumber AND IsDeleted = 0 AND ID != @ID) > 0) THEN 'Lot number is already exists!' END
			END

		END
	
	END

	BEGIN --- Quantity validation logic

		IF(@Message IS NULL)
		BEGIN

			IF(@Source = 'split' OR @Source = 'transfer')
			BEGIN
			
				IF(@Quantity > @AvailableQuantity)
				BEGIN
					SET @Message = 'You can''t ' + @Source + ' Quantity more than Available Quantity!';
				END
			END
		
		END

	END

	SELECT @Message
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Paras Patel
-- Create date: 23-06-2025
-- Description: Use this SP for split item inventory from X-Studio
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Split_Usp]
	@SourceItemId VARCHAR(36) = 'D8BAE549-F667-4810-B79A-DCD5D69417D5',
	@SplitItemId VARCHAR(36) = '32509903-2B50-48D4-A157-1C95E166374F',
	@SplitQuantity decimal(18,4) = 200
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @GradeID		VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @LocationType	VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @LocationID		VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @LocationName	VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @IsExpired		bit;
	DECLARE @ExpiryDate		datetime;
	DECLARE @ReceivedDate	datetime;
	DECLARE @Vendor			varchar(100);
	DECLARE @PONumber		varchar(100);
	DECLARE @GRNNumber		varchar(100);
	DECLARE @InvoiceNumber	varchar(100);
	DECLARE @Price			decimal(18,4);
	DECLARE @Description	varchar(1000);
	DECLARE @ItemSource		varchar(1000) = 'Split';
	
	-- Select source item details from table
	SELECT 
	@GradeID = GradeID,
	@LocationType = LocationType,
	@LocationID = LocationID,
	@LocationName = LocationName,
	@IsExpired = IsExpired,
	@ExpiryDate = ExpiryDate,
	@ReceivedDate = ReceivedDate,
	@Vendor = Vendor,
	@PONumber = PONumber,
	@GRNNumber = GRNNumber,
	@InvoiceNumber = InvoiceNumber,
	@Price = Price,
	@Description = Description	
	FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE [ID] = @SourceItemId

	-- Update source item remaining quantity
	UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
	Quantity = (Quantity - @SplitQuantity) 
	WHERE [ID] = @SourceItemId

	-- Update source item details in split item details
	UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
	GradeID = @GradeID,
	LocationType = @LocationType,
	LocationID = @LocationID,
	LocationName = @LocationName,
	IsExpired = @IsExpired,
	ExpiryDate = @ExpiryDate,
	ReceivedDate = @ReceivedDate,
	Vendor = @Vendor,
	PONumber = @PONumber,
	GRNNumber = @GRNNumber,
	InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber,
	Price = @Price,
	Description = @Description,
	ItemSource = @ItemSource
	WHERE [ID] = @SplitItemId

END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Paras Patel
-- Create date: 23-06-2023
-- Description: Used to call after save of material transfer, transfer row material from store to equipment
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Transfer_Usp]
	@SourceItemId VARCHAR(36) = 'D8BAE549-F667-4810-B79A-DCD5D69417D5',
	@TransfereItemId VARCHAR(36) = '32509903-2B50-48D4-A157-1C95E166374F'
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @SourceType		VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @SourceQuantity	decimal(18,4);
	DECLARE @GradeID		VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @IsExpired		bit;
	DECLARE @ExpiryDate		datetime;
	DECLARE @ReceivedDate	datetime;
	DECLARE @Vendor			varchar(100);
	DECLARE @PONumber		varchar(100);
	DECLARE @GRNNumber		varchar(100);
	DECLARE @InvoiceNumber	varchar(100);
	DECLARE @Price			decimal(18,4);
	DECLARE @Description	varchar(1000);
	DECLARE @ItemSource		varchar(1000);

	DECLARE @TransferType		VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @TransfereQuantity	decimal(18,4);
	DECLARE @TransferLotNumber VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @TransferSubLotNumber VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @TransferLocationID VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @TransferLocationName VARCHAR(100);

	SELECT @SourceType = LocationType, 
	@SourceQuantity = Quantity,
	@GradeID = GradeID,
	@IsExpired = IsExpired,
	@ExpiryDate = ExpiryDate,
	@ReceivedDate = ReceivedDate,
	@Vendor = Vendor,
	@PONumber = PONumber,
	@GRNNumber = GRNNumber,
	@InvoiceNumber = InvoiceNumber,
	@Price = Price,
	@Description = Description,
	@ItemSource = ItemSource
	FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE [ID] = @SourceItemId;

	SELECT @TransfereQuantity = Quantity, 
	@TransferType = LocationType, 
	@TransferLotNumber = LotNumber, 
	@TransferSubLotNumber = SublotNumber, 
	@TransferLocationID = LocationID,
	@TransferLocationName = LocationName
	FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE [ID] = @TransfereItemId;

	IF(@SourceType = 'Store' AND @TransferType = 'Store')
	BEGIN

		-- Update new location detils --
		UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET LocationID = @TransferLocationID, LocationName = @TransferLocationName WHERE [ID] = @SourceItemId;

		-- Delete new record --
		DELETE FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE [ID] = @TransfereItemId;

	END
	ELSE IF(@SourceType = 'Store' AND @TransferType = 'Equipment')
	BEGIN

		-- Update source item remaining quantity
		UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
		Quantity = (Quantity - @TransfereQuantity) 
		WHERE [ID] = @SourceItemId

		-- Update source item details in split item details
		UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
		GradeID = @GradeID,
		IsExpired = @IsExpired,
		ExpiryDate = @ExpiryDate,
		ReceivedDate = GETDATE(),				
		Vendor = @Vendor,
		PONumber = @PONumber,
		GRNNumber = @GRNNumber,
		InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber,
		Price = @Price,
		Description = @Description,
		ItemSource = 'Transfer'
		WHERE [ID] = @TransfereItemId

	END
	ELSE IF(@SourceType = 'Equipment' AND @TransferType = 'Store')
	BEGIN
		
		DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(36);
		SELECT @ID = ID FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl where LotNumber = @TransferLotNumber AND SublotNumber = @TransferSubLotNumber AND LocationID = @TransferLocationID AND ID != @TransfereItemId;

		---------- if transfer in existing store ----------
		IF(@ID IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN

			UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET Quantity = (Quantity + @SourceQuantity) WHERE [ID] = @ID

			-- Delete new record --
			DELETE FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE [ID] = @TransfereItemId;

			-- Delete source/equipment record --
			DELETE FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE [ID] = @SourceItemId;

		END

		---------- if transfer in new store ----------
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			
			UPDATE XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl SET 
			Quantity = @SourceQuantity,
			GradeID = @GradeID,
			IsExpired = @IsExpired,
			ExpiryDate = @ExpiryDate,
			ReceivedDate = GETDATE(),				
			Vendor = @Vendor,
			PONumber = @PONumber,
			GRNNumber = @GRNNumber,
			InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber,
			Price = @Price,
			Description = @Description,
			ItemSource = 'Transfer'
			WHERE [ID] = @TransfereItemId

			-- Delete source/equipment record --
			DELETE FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE [ID] = @SourceItemId;

		END
	END
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria
-- Create date: 11-04-2025
-- Description:	Get batch details based on type and parent id
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_MR_Get_Batch_Component_Detail_Usp] -- exec [dbo].[XBatch_Get_Batch_Details]  'phase','313FBB59-F44C-44B7-B992-74AAF74AA268'
	@Type VARCHAR(100),
	@TypeParentID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF(@Type = 'unitprocedure')
	BEGIN
		SELECT UPM.ID, SM.Name AS Status, UPM.Name, StartTime, EndTime, UnitID, UM.Name AS [UnitName] FROM XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl UPM
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl SM ON SM.ID = UPM.StatusID
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Unit_Mst_Tbl UM ON UM.ID = UPM.UnitID
		WHERE UPM.ParentID = @TypeParentID AND UPM.IsDeleted = 0
		Order by UPM.SrNo
	END
	ELSE IF(@Type = 'operation')
	BEGIN
		SELECT OM.ID, SM.Name AS Status, OM.Name, StartTime, EndTime, EquipmentID, EV.EquipmentName FROM XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl OM
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl SM ON SM.ID = OM.StatusID
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Equipment_Mst_Vw EV ON EV.ID = OM.EquipmentID
		WHERE OM.ParentID = @TypeParentID AND OM.IsDeleted = 0
		Order by OM.SrNo
	END
	ELSE IF(@Type = 'phasegroup')
	BEGIN
		SELECT PGM.ID, SM.Name AS Status, PGM.Name , StartTime, EndTime FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl PGM
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl SM ON SM.ID = PGM.StatusID
		WHERE PGM.ParentID = @TypeParentID AND PGM.IsDeleted = 0
		Order by PGM.SrNo
	END
	ELSE IF(@Type = 'phase')
	BEGIN
		SELECT PM.ID, SM.Name AS Status, PM.Name, StartTime, EndTime, Type, MaterialID, MM.Name AS [MaterialName], PM.Quantity, ActualQuantity FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl PM
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl SM ON SM.ID = PM.StatusID
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MM ON MM.ID = PM.MaterialID
		WHERE PM.ParentID = @TypeParentID AND PM.IsDeleted = 0
		Order by PM.SrNo
	END
	ELSE IF(@Type = 'unit_equipment')
	BEGIN
		SELECT UEMST.EquipmentID AS ID, EMST.EquipmentName AS Name FROM XBatch_Unit_Equipment_Mst_Tbl UEMST left JOIN 
		XBatch_Equipment_Mst_Vw EMST ON  EMST.ID = UEMST.EquipmentID AND EMST.EquipmetTypeID = UEMST.EquipmentTypeID
		WHERE UEMST.ParentID = @TypeParentID AND IsDeleted = 0
	END
END
```

```sql
	@BatchID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
```
