### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nirav.Patel
-- Create date: 08-07-2025
-- Description:	Get phase capability based on phaseId
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_MR_Get_Phase_Capability_Details_Usp] -- '1191FEC4-7F41-444B-B8FD-CA40AD3C96F1'
	@PhaseID VARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Query NVARCHAR(MAX)

	BEGIN TRY
		-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
		-- interfering with SELECT statements.
		SET NOCOUNT ON;

		DECLARE @TemplateID VARCHAR(36), @CapibilityID VARCHAR(36)

		SELECT @TemplateID = TemplateID, @CapibilityID  = CapabilityID FROM XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND ID = @PhaseID;

		IF @TemplateID IS NOT NULL AND @CapibilityID IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN

			DECLARE @TableName VARCHAR(MAX);

			SELECT @TableName = EquipmentTypeName + '_Capability_Mst_Tbl' FROM XBatch_Equipment_Mst_Vw WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE TemplateID = @TemplateID;

			IF @TableName IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @Query= 'SELECT * FROM '+ @TableName +' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ParentID = @TemplateID AND ID = @CapibilityID';
				EXEC sp_executesql @Query,  N'@TemplateID Varchar(36),@CapibilityID Varchar(36)' ,@TemplateID=@TemplateID, @CapibilityID = @CapibilityID
			END
			
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					RAISERROR('SP : XBatch_MR_Get_Phase_Capability_Details_Usp | Message: TableName is NULL ',16,1);
				END
		END

		ELSE
			BEGIN
				RAISERROR('SP : XBatch_MR_Get_Phase_Capability_Details_Usp | Message: TemplateID OR CapibilityID is NULL ',16,1);
			END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_MR_Get_Phase_Capability_Details_Usp | Line No : '+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)		
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_MR_Update_Batch_Component_Status_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_MR_Update_Batch_Component_Status_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:27  
**Modified On:** 2025-07-22 20:34:19  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @PhaseID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @Status | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_MR_Update_Batch_Component_Status_Usp]
    @PhaseID = '',
    @Status = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria, Vikesh.Ramani
-- Create date: 10-04-2025
-- Description:	Used to update batch execution status
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XBatch_MR_Update_Batch_Component_Status_Usp]
(	
	@PhaseID	VARCHAR(36),
	@Status	VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY

		DECLARE @Phase_GroupID	VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @Operation		VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE	@Unit_Procedure VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @BatchID		VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @Last_status	VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @StatusID		VARCHAR(36);

		SELECT @StatusID = ID FROM XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl WHERE Name = @Status;

		-------- UPDATE Batch Phase Group Status ----------------
		UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl] SET [StatusID]=@StatusID,[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@PhaseID;
		
		SELECT @Phase_GroupID=[ParentID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@PhaseID;
		SELECT @Operation=[ParentID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Phase_GroupID;
		SELECT @Unit_Procedure=[ParentID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Operation;
		SELECT @BatchID=[ParentID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl]  WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Unit_Procedure;
		
		SELECT @Last_status=[ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl]	WHERE [Name]='Completed' AND [IsDeleted]=0;
		
		IF(@StatusID <> @Last_status)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE 
					[dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl] 
					SET [StatusID]=@StatusID,
						[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() 
					WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Phase_GroupID; 

				UPDATE 
					[dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl] 
				SET [StatusID]=@StatusID,
					[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() 
				WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Operation;

				UPDATE 
					[dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl] 
				SET [StatusID]=@StatusID,
					[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() 
				WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Unit_Procedure;

				UPDATE 
					[dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl] 
				SET [StatusID]=@StatusID,
					[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() 
				WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@BatchID;

			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-------- UPDATE Batch Phase Group Status ----------------
				;WITH Phase as(
					SELECT [StatusID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Phase_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ParentID]=@Phase_GroupID
				)
				UPDATE 
					[dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl] 
				SET [StatusID]=(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Phase)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHASE WHERE [StatusID]=@Last_status) THEN @Last_status ELSE [StatusID] END),
					[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() 
				WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Phase_GroupID;

				-------- UPDATE Batch Operation Status ----------------
				;WITH Phase_Group as(
					SELECT [StatusID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ParentID]=@Operation
				)
				UPDATE 
					[dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl] 
				SET [StatusID]=(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Phase_Group)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Phase_Group WHERE [StatusID]=@Last_status) THEN @Last_status ELSE [StatusID] END),
					[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() 
				WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Operation;

				--IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Phase_Group_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ParentID]=@Operation AND [StatusID] != @Last_status)
				--BEGIN
				--	EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Produce_USP] 
				--END

				-------- UPDATE Batch Unit Procedure Status ----------------
				;WITH Operation as(
					SELECT [StatusID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Operation_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ParentID]=@Unit_Procedure
				)
				UPDATE 
					[dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl] 
				SET [StatusID]=(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Operation)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Operation WHERE [StatusID]=@Last_status) THEN @Last_status ELSE [StatusID] END),
					[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() 
				WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@Unit_Procedure;

				-------- UPDATE Batch MST Status ----------------
				;WITH Unit_Procedure as(
					SELECT [StatusID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Unit_Procedure_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ParentID]=@BatchID
				)
				UPDATE 
					[dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl] 
				SET [StatusID]=(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Unit_Procedure)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Unit_Procedure WHERE [StatusID]=@Last_status) THEN @Last_status ELSE [StatusID] END),
					[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE() 
				WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@BatchID;
			END

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_Get_Batch_MaterialList_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)

	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_MR_Update_Batch_Status_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_MR_Update_Batch_Status_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:27  
**Modified On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:27  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @BatchID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @Status | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_MR_Update_Batch_Status_Usp]
    @BatchID = '',
    @Status = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria
-- Create date: 10-04-2025
-- Description:	Used to update batch status
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_MR_Update_Batch_Status_Usp]
	@BatchID VARCHAR(36),
	@Status VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @StatusID		VARCHAR(36);
	SELECT @StatusID = ID FROM XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl WHERE Name = @Status;

	---------- Update status by id to batch master table ----------
	IF(@Status = 'Running')
	BEGIN
		---------- Get batch details ----------
		DECLARE @RecipeID VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @ProcessCellID VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @ScheduleStartTime DATETIME;
		DECLARE @Time_Batch VARCHAR(36);
		SELECT @RecipeID = ParentID, @ProcessCellID = ProcessCellID, @ScheduleStartTime = StartTime FROM [XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl] where [ID] = @BatchID AND [IsDeleted]=0;
		
		---------- Find recipe process time for set actual end time ----------
		DECLARE @RecipeProcessTime INT;
		SELECT @RecipeProcessTime = ProcessTime FROM XBatch_Recipe_Mst_Tbl where ID = @RecipeID;
		
		---------- Prepare actual starttime and endtime ----------
		DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME = GETDATE();
		DECLARE @EndTime DATETIME = DATEADD(MINUTE,@RecipeProcessTime,@StartTime);

		UPDATE [XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl] SET StatusID = @StatusID, ActualStartTime = GETDATE(), ActualEndTime = @EndTime WHERE ID = @BatchID;

		---------- Get Queue batch for shift time ----------

		SET @StartTime=@EndTime;
		DECLARE Batch_Time_update CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT [ID] FROM [XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [StartTime] > @ScheduleStartTime And [ProcessCellID] = @ProcessCellID AND [StatusID] = (SELECT [ID] FROM [XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Name] = 'Scheduled' AND [IsDeleted]=0) AND [IsDeleted]=0 ORDER BY [STARTTIME];

		OPEN Batch_Time_update;
		FETCH NEXT FROM Batch_Time_update INTO @Time_Batch;

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
		BEGIN
			SET @EndTime = DATEADD(MINUTE,@RecipeProcessTime,@StartTime);
			UPDATE [XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl] SET [StartTime]=@StartTime,[EndTime]=@EndTime WHERE [ID]=@Time_Batch;
			
			SET @StartTime = @EndTime;
			FETCH NEXT FROM Batch_Time_update INTO @Time_Batch;
		END
		CLOSE Batch_Time_update;
		DEALLOCATE Batch_Time_update;
		--TODO:: Update batch starttime and endtime of queue batch according
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl SET StatusID = @StatusID WHERE ID = @BatchID;
	END

	UPDATE PCMT SET CurrentBatchID=BMT.[ID],[NextAvailableTime]=BMT.[EndTime] 
	FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Process_Cell_Mst_Tbl] AS PCMT
	JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl] AS BMT ON BMT.[ProcessCellID]=PCMT.[ID]

END
```

```sql
/*--------------------------------*/
-- Created by : Priyanka Makwana
-- Created on : 05-May-2026
-- Description : OEE Dashboard Data
-- Execute : EXEC [XBatch_OEE_Dashboard_SP] 
/*--------------------------------*/
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_OEE_Dashboard_SP] 
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

     BEGIN TRY

        DECLARE @FromDate DATE = DATEADD(DAY, -60, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));
        DECLARE @ToDate   DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);

        ;WITH DelayData AS
        (
            SELECT 
                dbo.FN_GET_ReportDate(DelayStartTime) AS ReportDate,
                SUM(DelayInSecond) / 60.0 AS TotalDelayMinute
            FROM dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
            WHERE AreaName = 'SMS'
                AND IsDeleted = 0
                AND CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE) BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
            GROUP BY dbo.FN_GET_ReportDate(DelayStartTime)
        ),

        PerfData AS
        (
            SELECT 
                ReportDate,
                FTDTon
            FROM dbo.SMS_Production_Summary
            WHERE Particulars = 'TPH (BL / Cycle time)'
                AND IsDeleted = 0
                AND ReportDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        ),

        MainData AS
        (
            SELECT 
                p.ReportDate,

                ((1440 - ISNULL(d.TotalDelayMinute,0)) / 1440.0) * 100 
                    AS AvailabilityPercent,

                (ISNULL(perf.FTDTon,0) / 89.0) * 100 
                    AS PerformancePercent,

                100 AS QualityPercent,

                (
                    ((1440 - ISNULL(d.TotalDelayMinute,0)) / 1440.0)
                    *
                    (ISNULL(perf.FTDTon,0) / 89.0)
                ) * 100 AS OEEPercent

            FROM dbo.SMS_Production_Summary_Day p
            LEFT JOIN DelayData d 
                ON p.ReportDate = d.ReportDate

            LEFT JOIN PerfData perf 
                ON p.ReportDate = perf.ReportDate

            WHERE 
                p.IsDeleted = 0
                AND p.ReportDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate
        )

        SELECT 
            ReportDate AS [Time],
            AvailabilityPercent,
            PerformancePercent,
            QualityPercent,
            OEEPercent,

            AVG(AvailabilityPercent) OVER() AS AvgAvailability,
            AVG(PerformancePercent) OVER()  AS AvgPerformance,
            AVG(OEEPercent) OVER()          AS AvgOEE

        FROM MainData
        ORDER BY ReportDate;

	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : XBatch_OEE_Dashboard_SP | Line : ' + CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR) + ' | Message : ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();

        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='OEEDashboard SP',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace='',@UserID='', @HostAddress='', @Info='', @Source='T-SQL';RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH

END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Particular_Target_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Particular_Target_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-10 14:20:28  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:19:36  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @enddate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Particular_Target_Usp]
    @enddate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*------------------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 10-Oct-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure to get target data of the particular in Pivot
--------------------------------------*/

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Particular_Target_Usp]-- '07-OCt-2025'
(/*DECLARE */@enddate DATE /*= '07-Oct-2025'*/)
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @PivotLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SelectLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Set Pivot and Select Column List--*/
		SELECT @PivotLst = STUFF((SELECT ',[' + [Particulars] +']' FROM [dbo].[Particulars_Masters] AS PM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY [srNo] FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,'')
		SELECT @SelectLst = STUFF((SELECT ',ISNULL(SUM([' + [Particulars] +']), 0) AS ['+[Particulars]+' Target]' FROM [dbo].[Particulars_Masters] AS PM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Particulars] NOT IN ('Best Day Data', 'Best Month Data') ORDER BY [srNo] FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,'')
		--SELECT @PivotLst, @SelectLst 

		/*---Get Target Data--*/
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT '+@SelectLst+' FROM (SELECT [ReportDate], [Particulars], CASE WHEN [SrNo] BETWEEN 38 AND 52 THEN [Target] / 100 ELSE [Target] END AS [Target] FROM [Particulars_Masters_Trn] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = DATEADD(DD, -DAY(@EndDate) + 1, @EndDate)) AS t PIVOT (SUM([Target]) FOR [Particulars] IN ('+@PivotLst+')) AS pvt'
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL,N'@EndDate DATE', @Enddate;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Particular_Target_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Particular_Target_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@SQL,@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report  
**Created On:** 2025-07-14 12:58:40  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:02:51  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @PlantName | varchar(25) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report]
    @PlantName = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
	--Created By : Manish Nishad
	--Created On : 14-jul-2025
	--Description :Day Wise Summary Data of ERF, LRF & CCM
	--Exceution : - 
	        /*  EXEC[XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report] @PlantName = 'ERF'
	          EXEC[XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report] @PlantName = 'CCM'
		      EXEC[XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report] @PlantName = 'LRF' */

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report]
@PlantName VARCHAR(25)
AS
BEGIN

					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		IF(@PlantName = 'ERF')
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				B.[Name]As EquipmentName,
				cast ([HeatID] as int) as HeatID,
				[HeatTime],
				[PowerOnTime],
				[PowerOffTime],
				[NGConsumption],
				[OxygenConsumption],
				[PowerMWH],
				[ChargeWeight],
				isnull([CopexScrapCH1],[CopexScrapCH2]) As [CopexScrap],
				isnull([HMS12CH1],[HMS12CH2]) As [HMS12],
				isnull([ScullCH1],[ScullCH2]) As [Scull],
				isnull([EndCutsCH1],[EndCutsCH2]) As [EndCuts],
				isnull([BriquetteCH1],[BriquetteCH2])As [Briquette],
				isnull([BundleLMSCH1],[BundleLMSCH2]) As [BundleLMS],
				isnull([HBIDRICH1],[HBIDRICH2]) As [HBIDRI],
				isnull([HMS1CH1],[HMS1CH2]) As [HMS1],
				isnull([ShreeddedCH1],[ShreeddedCH2]) As [Shredded]	
			FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] A WITH(NOLOCK)
			Join  [dbo].[EAF_SMS_Mst_Tbl] B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.EquipmentID = B.ID
			WHERE CAST(A.[CreatedOn] AS DATE) =  CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND A.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND B.[IsDeleted] = 0
			ORDER BY A.[CreatedOn]   ;
		END

		/*IF(@PlantName = 'LRF')
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				EntryDatetime,
				ShiftName,
				HeatID
			FROM [Xstudio_Xneo].[dbo].LRF_SUMMARY2_Summary_Shift
			WHERE CAST(EntryDatetime AS DATE) =  CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
			ORDER BY EntryDatetime
		END */

		IF(@PlantName = 'CCM')
		BEGIN
			SELECT 	      
				B.[Name] as EquipmentName,
				[Argon],
				[TapToTapTime],
				[Strand1Zone1Flow],
				[Strand2Zone1Flow],
				[Strand3Zone1Flow],
				[Strand4Zone1Flow],
				[Strand5Zone1Flow],
				[Strand6Zone1Flow],
				[Strand1CastingSpeed],
				[Strand2CastingSpeed],
				[Strand3CastingSpeed],
				[Strand4CastingSpeed],
				[Strand5CastingSpeed],
				[Strand6CastingSpeed],
				Cast([Strand1BilletCounter] as int) As [Strand1BilletCounter],
				Cast([Strand2BilletCounter] as int) As [Strand2BilletCounter],
				Cast([Strand3BilletCounter] as int) As [Strand3BilletCounter],
				Cast([Strand4BilletCounter] as int) As [Strand4BilletCounter],
				Cast([Strand5BilletCounter] as int) As [Strand5BilletCounter],
				Cast([Strand6BilletCounter] as int) As [Strand6BilletCounter]
			FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_PER_SHIFT] A WITH(NOLOCK)
			Join [dbo].[CCM_Mst_Tbl] B WITH(NOLOCK) ON  A.EquipmentID = B.ID
			WHERE CAST(A.[CreatedOn] AS DATE) =  CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND A.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND B.[IsDeleted] = 0
			ORDER BY A.[CreatedOn];
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_PERDAY_Heat_Summary_Report]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBATCH_Production_Details_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBATCH_Production_Details_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-10 14:23:57  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:20:01  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @StartDate | date | NO |  |
| @EndDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBATCH_Production_Details_Usp]
    @StartDate = '2026-05-04',
    @EndDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
--XBATCH_Production_Details_Usp '05-Oct-2025','07-OCt-2025'
/*-----------------------------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 09-Oct-2025
	Description : Get Production Details
-----------------------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBATCH_Production_Details_Usp]
(
	--DECLARE 
	@StartDate DATE --= '03-Oct-2025'
	, @EndDate DATE --= '05-Oct-2025'
)
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @Particular NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @FtdtonLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SelLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @FtdPerLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @MtdTonLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @MtdPerLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @BestDay	DATE;
	DECLARE @BestMonth	DATE;
	DECLARE @BestDayLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @BestMonthLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tbl') IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN	
			DROP TABLE #Tbl;
		END
		CREATE TABLE #Tbl ([SR] INT, [Particular] VARCHAR(200), [BestDay] DECIMAL(18, 4), [BestMonth] DECIMAL(18, 4), [FTDTon] DECIMAL(18, 4), [FTDPercentage] DECIMAL(18, 4), [MTDTon] DECIMAL(18, 4), [MTDPercentage] DECIMAL(18, 4));

		/*--Store Production Details--*/
		; WITH EAF AS (
			SELECT * FROM (
				SELECT ESD.[ReportDate]
					, ISNULL(SUM([HeatID]) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS [HeatID_MTD] 
					, SUM(ISNULL([HBIDRICH1], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRICH2], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [HBIDRI_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH1]*/0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH2]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [PigIron_MTD]
					, ISNULL([ColdDRI_MTD], 0) AS [ColdDRI_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([EndCutsCH1], 0) + ISNULL([EndCutsCH2], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [EndCuts_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([ScullCH1], 0) + ISNULL([ScullCH2], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Scull_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH2], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH1], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Ext_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([HBIDRICH1], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRICH2], 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH1]*/0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH2]*/0, 0) + ISNULL([ColdDRI], 0) + ISNULL([EndCutsCH1], 0) + ISNULL([EndCutsCH2], 0) + ISNULL([ScullCH1], 0) + ISNULL([ScullCH2], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH2], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH1], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [TotalCharge_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([PowerMWH], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [PowerMWH_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[Aux]*/ 0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[O2]*/ 0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Aux_O2_Power_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[EAF_Electrodes]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [EAF_Electrodes_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[Carbon_EAF]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Top_Carbon_EAF_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([CarbonConsumption_MTD], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Carbon_Injection_EAF_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([OxygenConsumption_MTD], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Oxygen_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([NGConsumption_MTD], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [NG_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([LadleAdditionLime_MTD], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [LimeEAF_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([LadleAdditionDolo_MTD], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Dolime_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[Flourspar_MTD]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Flourspar_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[ALingots_MTD]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [ALingots_MTD]
					, ISNULL(1440 * DATEDIFF(dd, @StartDate, @EndDate), 0) AS [Cal_Time_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[Planned_Shutdown_MTD]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Planned_Shutdown_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[Forced_shutdown_MTD]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Forced_Shutdown_MTD]
					, ISNULL(1440 * DATEDIFF(dd, @startdate, @enddate), 0) - (SUM(ISNULL(/*[Planned_Shutdown_MTD]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) + SUM(ISNULL(/*[Forced_shutdown_MTD]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY ESD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS [total_time_MTD]
					, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_TTT_MTD], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_TTT_MTD]
					, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PoweronTIme_MTD], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PoweronTIme_MTD]
					, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PoweroffTIme_MTD], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PoweroffTIme_MTD]
					, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PowerMW_MTD], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PowerMW_MTD]
				FROM [EAF_Summary_Day] AS ESD WITH(NOLOCK)
				LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT [ReportDate], [ColdDRI], SUM([ColdDRI]) OVER (ORDER BY t.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [ColdDRI_MTD] FROM ( 
						SELECT CAST(EPH.[ReportDate] AS DATE) AS [ReportDate], SUM(ISNULL([BIN3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([BIN4Consumption], 0)) AS [ColdDRI]/*, SUM(ISNULL([BIN3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([BIN4Consumption], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY [Reportdate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [ColdDRI_MTD]*/
						FROM EAF_PER_HEAT AS EPH WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) >= @StartDate AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) <= @EndDate AND [BIN3Name] = 'cdri' AND [BIN4Name] = 'cdri'
						GROUP BY CAST(EPH.[ReportDate] AS DATE)
					) AS t
				) AS EPH ON EPH.[ReportDate] = ESD.[ReportDate]
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND ESD.[ReportDate] >= @StartDate AND ESD.[ReportDate] <= @EndDate
			) AS EAF WHERE [ReportDate] = @EndDate
		), EAF_1 AS (
			SELECT ESD.[ReportDate]
				, ISNULL([HeatID], 0) AS [HeatID]
				, ISNULL([HBIDRICH1], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRICH2], 0) AS [HBIDRI]
				, ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH1]*/0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH2]*/0, 0) AS [PigIron]
				, ISNULL([ColdDRI], 0) AS [ColdDRI]
				, ISNULL([EndCutsCH1], 0) + ISNULL([EndCutsCH2], 0) AS [EndCuts]
				, ISNULL([ScullCH1], 0) + ISNULL([ScullCH2], 0) AS [Scull]
				, ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH2], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH1], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0) AS [Ext]
				, ISNULL([HBIDRICH1], 0) + ISNULL([HBIDRICH2], 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH1]*/0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[PigIronCH2]*/0, 0) + ISNULL([ColdDRI], 0) + ISNULL([EndCutsCH1], 0) + ISNULL([EndCutsCH2], 0) + ISNULL([ScullCH1], 0) + ISNULL([ScullCH2], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH1], 0) + ISNULL(ESD.[CopexScrapCH2], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH1], 0) + ISNULL([BundleLMSCH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0) + ISNULL([HMS1CH1], 0) + ISNULL([HMS12CH2], 0) AS [TotalCharge]
				, ISNULL([PowerMWH], 0) AS [PowerMWH]
				, ISNULL(/*[Aux]*/ 0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[O2]*/ 0, 0) AS [Aux_O2_Power]
				, ISNULL(/*[EAF_Electrodes]*/0, 0) AS [EAF_Electrodes]
				, ISNULL(/*[Carbon_EAF_MTD]*/0, 0) AS [Top_Carbon_EAF]
				, ISNULL([CarbonConsumption], 0) AS [Carbon_Injection_EAF]
				, ISNULL([OxygenConsumption], 0) AS [Oxygen]
				, ISNULL([NGConsumption], 0) AS [NG]
				, ISNULL([LadleAdditionLime], 0) AS [LimeEAF]
				, ISNULL([LadleAdditionDolo], 0) AS [Dolime]
				, ISNULL(/*[Flourspar]*/0, 0) AS [Flourspar]
				, ISNULL(/*[ALingots]*/0, 0) AS [ALingots]
				, ISNULL(1440, 0) AS [Cal_Time]
				, ISNULL(/*[Planned_Shutdown]*/0, 0) AS [Planned_Shutdown]
				, ISNULL(/*[Forced_shutdown]*/0, 0) AS [Forced_Shutdown]
				, ISNULL(1440, 0) - (ISNULL(/*[Planned_Shutdown]*/0, 0) + ISNULL(/*[Forced_shutdown]*/0, 0)) AS [total_time]
				, ISNULL(esd.[Avg_TTT], 0) AS [Avg_TTT]
				, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PoweronTIme], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PoweronTIme]
				, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PoweroffTIme], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PoweroffTIme]
				, ROUND(ISNULL(esd.[Avg_PowerMW], 0) , 0) AS [Avg_PowerMW]
			FROM [EAF_Summary_Day] AS ESD WITH(NOLOCK)
			LEFT JOIN (
				SELECT [ReportDate], SUM(ISNULL([BIN3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([BIN4Consumption], 0)) AS [ColdDRI]/*, SUM(ISNULL([BIN3Consumption], 0) + ISNULL([BIN4Consumption], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY [Reportdate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [ColdDRI_MTD]*/
					FROM EAF_PER_HEAT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([ReportDate] AS DATE) = @EndDate AND [BIN3Name] = 'cdri' AND [BIN4Name] = 'cdri'
				GROUP BY [ReportDate]
			) AS EPH ON EPH.[ReportDate] = ESD.[ReportDate]
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND ESD.[ReportDate] = @EndDate
		), LRF AS (
			SELECT * FROM (
				SELECT [ReportDate]
					, SUM(ISNULL([LiquidMetalWeight], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY LSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [LiquidMetalWeight_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([Avg_LiquidMetalWeight], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY LSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Avg_LiquidMetalWeight_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([PowerMWH], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY LSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [PowerMWH_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[LRF_Electrodes]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY LSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [LRF_Electrodes_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[CACLRF_MTd]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY LSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [CACLRF_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(lsd.[Lime_MTD], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY LSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [Lime_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([SiMn_MTD], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY LSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [SiMn_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL([FeSi_MTD], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY LSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [FeSi_MTD]
				FROM [LRF_Summary_Day] AS LSD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] >= @StartDate AND [ReportDate] <= @EndDate 	
			) AS LRF WHERE [ReportDate] = @EndDate
		), LRF_1 AS (
			SELECT LSD.[ReportDate]
				, ISNULL([LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS [LiquidMetalWeight]
				, ISNULL([Avg_LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS [Avg_LiquidMetalWeight] 
				, ISNULL([PowerMWH], 0) AS [PowerMWH] 
				, ISNULL(/*[LRF_Electrodes]*/0, 0) AS [LRF_Electrodes]
				, ISNULL(/*[CACLRF]*/0, 0) AS [CACLRF]
				, ISNULL(lsd.[Lime], 0) AS [Lime]
				, ISNULL([SiMn], 0) AS [SiMn]
				, ISNULL([FeSi], 0) AS [FeSi]
			FROM [LRF_Summary_Day] AS LSD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = @EndDate
		), CCM AS (
			SELECT *
				, [TotalProduction_MTD] + [TotalProduction_1_MTD] AS [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] FROM (
				SELECT [ReportDate]
					, SUM(ISNULL([HeatID], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY CSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [HeatID_MTD] 
					, SUM(ISNULL([TotalProduction], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY CSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [TotalProduction_MTD]
					, SUM(ISNULL(/*[TotalProduction_1]*/0, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY CSD.[ReportDate] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS [TotalProduction_1_MTD]
				FROM [CCM_Summary_Day] AS CSD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] >= @StartDate AND [ReportDate] <= @EndDate
			) AS CSD WHERE [ReportDate] = @EndDate
		), CCM_1 AS (
			SELECT *
				, [TotalProduction] + [TotalProduction_1] AS [TotalPrimeProduction] FROM (
				SELECT CSD.[ReportDate]
					, ISNULL([HeatID], 0) AS [HeatID]
					, ISNULL([TotalProduction], 0) AS [TotalProduction]
					, ISNULL(/*[TotalProduction_1]*/0, 0) AS [TotalProduction_1]
				FROM [CCM_Summary_Day] AS CSD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = @EndDate
			) AS CSD
		), DLY AS (
				SELECT  SUM([STD_Delay]) AS [STD_Delay], SUM([STD_Delay_MTD]) AS [STD_Delay_MTD], SUM([Opm]) AS [Opm], SUM([Opm_MTD]) AS [Opm_MTD], SUM([Elect]) AS [Elect], SUM([Elect_MTD]) AS [Elect_MTD], SUM([Mech]) AS [Mech], SUM([Mech_MTD]) AS [Mech_MTD], SUM([Trm]) AS [Trm], SUM([Trm_MTD]) AS [Trm_MTD], SUM([CRANE_MAINT]) AS [CRANE_MAINT], SUM([CRANE_MAINT_MTD]) AS [CRANE_MAINT_MTD], SUM([WTP_VMD_MRSS]) AS [WTP_VMD_MRSS], SUM([WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD]) AS [WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD], SUM([PPC_Commercial]) AS [PPC_Commercial], SUM([PPC_Commercial_MTD]) AS [PPC_Commercial_MTD], SUM([Total_Delays]) AS [Total_Delays], SUM([Total_Delays_MTD]) AS [Total_Delays_MTD] FROM ( SELECT b.[Name] AS [Delay]
					/*standard delay*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '8911EDCB-52AB-4EF5-9535-1A9332C34997' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [STD_Delay]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '8911EDCB-52AB-4EF5-9535-1A9332C34997' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @startdate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [STD_Delay_MTD]
					/*operation*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '3254B0D7-4DDB-4B79-9B46-73EEA2501AB3' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Opm]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '3254B0D7-4DDB-4B79-9B46-73EEA2501AB3' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @startdate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Opm_MTD]
					/*electrical*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'AC934F3F-1DC4-4EEE-A69A-4F44635EC2DD' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Elect]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'AC934F3F-1DC4-4EEE-A69A-4F44635EC2DD' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @startdate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Elect_MTD]
					/*mechanical*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '0198A42E-52A8-4DAA-AD53-2B50298397AA' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Mech]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '0198A42E-52A8-4DAA-AD53-2B50298397AA' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @startdate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Mech_MTD]
					/*trm*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'E1E3907F-74BB-44AF-BA2C-4D90E10F2204' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Trm]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = 'E1E3907F-74BB-44AF-BA2C-4D90E10F2204' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @startdate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Trm_MTD]
					/*CRANE MAINT*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '3D49619E-47C1-4F2C-8CA2-CC1F7D8604F6' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [CRANE_MAINT]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '3D49619E-47C1-4F2C-8CA2-CC1F7D8604F6' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @startdate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [CRANE_MAINT_MTD]
					/*WTP/VMD/MRSS*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '0AB67FB7-11C4-454E-A4D4-451E313ADD29' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [WTP_VMD_MRSS]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '0AB67FB7-11C4-454E-A4D4-451E313ADD29' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @startdate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD]
					/*PPC/Commercial*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '198BCC03-A131-4729-92D0-B590E65DB38D' AND sd.[ReportDate] = @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [PPC_Commercial]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] = '198BCC03-A131-4729-92D0-B590E65DB38D' AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @startdate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [PPC_Commercial_MTD]
					/*Total Delays + Std Delays*/
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] IN ('8911EDCB-52AB-4EF5-9535-1A9332C34997','3254B0D7-4DDB-4B79-9B46-73EEA2501AB3','AC934F3F-1DC4-4EEE-A69A-4F44635EC2DD','0198A42E-52A8-4DAA-AD53-2B50298397AA','E1E3907F-74BB-44AF-BA2C-4D90E10F2204','3D49619E-47C1-4F2C-8CA2-CC1F7D8604F6','0AB67FB7-11C4-454E-A4D4-451E313ADD29','198BCC03-A131-4729-92D0-B590E65DB38D') AND sd.[ReportDate] = @StartDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Total_Delays]
					, SUM(ISNULL(CASE WHEN b.[ID] IN ('8911EDCB-52AB-4EF5-9535-1A9332C34997','3254B0D7-4DDB-4B79-9B46-73EEA2501AB3','AC934F3F-1DC4-4EEE-A69A-4F44635EC2DD','0198A42E-52A8-4DAA-AD53-2B50298397AA','E1E3907F-74BB-44AF-BA2C-4D90E10F2204','3D49619E-47C1-4F2C-8CA2-CC1F7D8604F6','0AB67FB7-11C4-454E-A4D4-451E313ADD29','198BCC03-A131-4729-92D0-B590E65DB38D') AND sd.[ReportDate] >= @StartDate AND Sd.[reportdate] <= @EndDate THEN a.[Duration] ELSE 0 END, 0)) AS [Total_Delays_MTD]
				FROM Agency_Wise_Delay AS a WITH(NOLOCK) 
				JOIN ShiftDelayEntry AS SD WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.[ParentID] = SD.[ID] 
				JOIN DelayAgency_Master AS b WITH(NOLOCK) ON a.[Agency] = b.[ID] 
				WHERE a.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND SD.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND b.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND b.[AreaName] = 'SMS'
				GROUP BY b.[Name]) AS t
			), BestValues AS (
				SELECT [Particulars],[BestDay] AS [BestDayValue], [BestMonth] AS [BestMonthValue] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE [ReportDate] = @EndDate AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			)
			INSERT INTO #Tbl
			SELECT [SR], T.[Particulars] AS [Particulars], CASE WHEN t.[Particulars] IN ('Liquid Metal Yield','Caster Yield','Charge To Billet Yield','HBI','PIG IRON/Pool Iron/Granshot','Cold DRI','END CUTS (External+Internal)','Skull (External+Internal)','External Scrap' ,'Availability (Net Time / Cal Time)') THEN PRT.[BestDayValue] / 100 ELSE [BestDayValue] END, CASE WHEN t.[Particulars] IN ('Liquid Metal Yield','Caster Yield','Charge To Billet Yield','HBI','PIG IRON/Pool Iron/Granshot','Cold DRI','END CUTS (External+Internal)','Skull (External+Internal)','External Scrap') THEN PRT.[BestMonthValue] / 100 ELSE [BestMonthValue] END, T.[FTDTon], T.[FTDPercentage], T.[MTDTon], T.[MTDPercentage]
			FROM (SELECT PRT.[SRNo], PRT.[Particulars], BST.[BestDayValue], BST.[BestMonthValue] FROM Particulars_Masters AS PRT WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN BestValues AS BST ON BST.[Particulars] = PRT.[Particulars] WHERE PRT.[IsDeleted] = 0 ) AS PRT
			RIGHT JOIN (
				SELECT 1 AS [SR], 'Total SMS Heats Tap' AS [Particulars], CAST(ROUND([HeatID], 0) AS INT) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage], CAST(ROUND([HeatID_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] 
				UNION
				SELECT 2 AS [SR], 'Liquid Metal' AS [Particulars], CAST(ROUND([LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS INT) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage], CAST(ROUND([LiquidMetalWeight_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 3 AS [SR], 'Heat Size (LM)' AS [Particulars], CAST(ROUND([Avg_LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS INT) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage], CAST(ROUND([Avg_LiquidMetalWeight_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 4 AS [SR], 'CCM Heats Cast' AS [Particulars], CAST(ROUND([HeatID], 0) AS INT) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage], CAST(ROUND([HeatID_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage]
				FROM CCM FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 5 AS [SR], 'Prime Production (12m)' AS [Particulars], CAST(ROUND([TotalProduction], 0) AS INT) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage], CAST(ROUND([TotalProduction_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM CCM FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 6 AS [SR], 'Prime Production (6m)' AS [Particulars], CAST(ROUND([TotalProduction_1], 0) AS INT) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage], CAST(ROUND([TotalProduction_1_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage] FROM CCM FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 7 AS [SR], 'Total Prime Production' AS [Particulars], CAST(ROUND([TotalPrimeProduction], 0) AS INT) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage], CAST(ROUND([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD], 0) AS INT) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage] FROM CCM FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 8 AS [SR], 'Liquid Metal Yield' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(EAF_1.[TotalCharge], 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ISNULL(LRF_1.[LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(ISNULL(EAF_1.[TotalCharge], 0) AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD], 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ISNULL(LRF.[LiquidMetalWeight_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(ISNULL(EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercemtage] 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN LRF ON EAF.[ReportDate] = LRF.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 9 AS [SR], 'Caster Yield' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(LRF_1.[LiquidMetalWeight], 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ISNULL(CCM_1.[TotalPrimeProduction], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(ISNULL(LRF_1.[LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(LRF.[LiquidMetalWeight_MTD], 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ISNULL(CCM.[TotalPrimeProduction_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(LRF.[LiquidMetalWeight_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage]
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 10 AS [SR], 'Charge To Billet Yield' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(EAF_1.[TotalCharge], 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ISNULL(CCM_1.[TotalPrimeProduction], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(ISNULL(EAF_1.[TotalCharge], 0) AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], NULL AS [FTDPercentage]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD], 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ISNULL(CCM.[TotalPrimeProduction_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) / CAST(ISNULL(EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD], 0) AS FLOAT) END, 1)  AS [MTDTon], NULL AS [MTDPercentage]
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 11 AS [SR], 'HBI' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([HBIDRI] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([HBIDRI] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([HBIDRI_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([HBIDRI_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 12 AS [SR], 'PIG IRON/Pool Iron/Granshot' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([PigIron] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([PigIron] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([PigIron_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([PigIron_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTDPercentage]
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 13 AS [SR], 'Cold DRI' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([ColdDRI] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge] AS FLOAT)  END AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([ColdDRI] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN [TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([ColdDRI_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([ColdDRI_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTDPercentage]
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 14 AS [SR], 'END CUTS (External+Internal)' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([EndCuts] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge] AS FLOAT)  END AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([EndCuts] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([EndCuts_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([EndCuts_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 15 AS [SR], 'Skull (External+Internal)' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Scull] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Scull] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Scull_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Scull_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTdPercentage] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF_1.[reportdate] = EAF.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 16 AS [SR], 'External Scrap' AS [Particulars]
					, CASE WHEN EAF_1.[TotalCharge] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([EXT] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF_1.[TotalCharge] AS FLOAT) END AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Ext] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, CASE WHEN EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Ext_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST(EAF.[TotalCharge_MTD] AS FLOAT) END AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Ext_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTdPercentage] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF_1.[reportdate] = EAF.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 17 AS [SR], 'TOTAL CHARGE' AS [Particulars], NULL AS [FTDTon], [TotalCharge] AS [FTDPercentage], NULL AS [MTDTon], [TotalCharge_MTD] AS [MTDPercentage] FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 18 AS [SR], 'EAF POWER' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([PowerMwh] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS float) * 1000 END, 0) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([PowerMWH] * 1000 AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([PowerMWH_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS float) * 1000 END, 0) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([PowerMWH_MTD] * 1000 AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM EAF_1 FULL JOIN EAF ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate] 
				UNION 
				SELECT 19 AS [SR], 'LRF POWER' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([PowerMwh] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS float) * 1000 END, 0) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([PowerMWH] * 1000 AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([PowerMWH_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS float) * 1000 END, 0) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([PowerMWH_MTD] * 1000 AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[REportDAte] FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM_1.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 20 AS [SR], 'Aux+O2 Power' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Aux_O2_Power] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS float) * 1000 END, 0) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Aux_O2_Power] * 1000 AS FLOAT), 0) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Aux_O2_Power_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS float) * 1000 END, 0) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Aux_O2_Power_MTD] * 1000 AS FLOAT), 0) AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 21 AS [SR], 'TOTAL' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(EAF_1.[PowerMWH] + LRF_1.[PowerMWH] + EAF_1.[Aux_O2_Power] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS float) * 1000 END, 0) AS [FTDTon]
					, ROUND(CAST(EAF_1.[PowerMWH] + LRF_1.[PowerMWH] + EAF_1.[Aux_O2_Power] * 1000 AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(EAF.[PowerMWH_MTD] + LRF.[PowerMWH_MTD] + EAF.[Aux_O2_Power_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS float) * 1000 END, 0) AS [MTDTon]
					, ROUND(CAST(EAF.[PowerMWH_MTD] + LRF.[PowerMWH_MTD] + EAF.[Aux_O2_Power_MTD] * 1000 AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN LRF ON EAF.[ReportDate] = LRF.[ReportDate] 
				FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[ReportDate] = CCM.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 22 AS [SR], 'EAF ELECTRODS' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Eaf_Electrodes] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 2) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Eaf_Electrodes] AS FLOAT), 2) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([EAF_Electrodes_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 2) AS MTDTon, ROUND(CAST([EAF_Electrodes_MTD] AS FLOAT), 2) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 23 AS [SR]
					, 'LRF ELECTRODS' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([LRf_Electrodes] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 2) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([LRF_Electrodes] AS FLOAT), 2) AS [FTDPercentage]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([LRF_Electrodes_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 2) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([LRF_Electrodes_MTD] AS FLOAT), 2) AS [MTDPercentage] 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 24 AS [SR], 'Top Carbon EAF' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Top_Carbon_EAF] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Top_Carbon_EAF] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Top_Carbon_EAF_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS MTDTon, ROUND(CAST([Top_Carbon_EAF_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 25 AS [SR], 'Carbon Injection EAF' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Carbon_Injection_EAF] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Carbon_Injection_EAF] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Carbon_Injection_EAF_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Carbon_Injection_EAF_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 26 AS [SR], 'CAC LRF' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([CACLRF] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([CACLRF] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([CACLRF_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([CACLRF_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 27 AS [SR], 'Oxygen' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Oxygen] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Oxygen] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Oxygen_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Oxygen_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 28 AS [SR], 'NG' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([NG] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([NG] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([NG_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([NG_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 29 AS [SR], 'Lime EAF' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([LimeEAF] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([LimeEAF] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([LimeEAF_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS MTDTon, ROUND(CAST([LimeEAF_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 30 AS [SR], 'Dolime' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Dolime] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Dolime] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Dolime_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Dolime_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 31 AS [SR], 'Lime LRF (Tapping+LF)' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Lime] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Lime] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Lime_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Lime_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 32 AS [SR], 'Flourspar' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Flourspar] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Flourspar] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([Flourspar_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([Flourspar_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 33 AS [SR], 'TOTAL SiMn' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([SiMn] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([SiMn] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([SiMn_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([SiMn_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 34 AS [SR], 'TOTAL FeSi' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([FeSi] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([FeSi] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([FeSi_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([FeSi_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM LRF FULL JOIN LRF_1 ON LRF.[ReportDate] = LRF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON LRF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 35 AS [SR], 'AL ingots' AS [Particulars]
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([ALingots] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [FTDTon], ROUND(CAST([ALingots] AS FLOAT), 0) AS FTDPercentage
					, ROUND(CASE WHEN [TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST([ALingots_MTD] AS FLOAT) / CAST([TotalPrimeProduction_MTD] AS FLOAT) END, 1) AS [MTDTon], ROUND(CAST([ALingots_MTD] AS FLOAT), 0) AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] FULL JOIN CCM ON EAF.[Reportdate] = CCM.[Reportdate] FULL JOIN CCM_1 ON CCM.[ReportDate] = CCM_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 36 AS [SR], 'Cal Time' AS [Particulars], [Cal_Time] AS [FTDTon], 100 / 100 AS FTDPercentage, [Cal_Time_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 100 / 100 AS MTDPercentage FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION
				SELECT 37 AS [SR], 'Planned Shutdown' AS [Particulars], [Planned_Shutdown] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS FTDPercentage, [Planned_Shutdown_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS MTDPercentage FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 38 AS [SR], 'Forced Shutdown' AS [Particulars], [Forced_shutdown] AS [FTDTon], 0.0 AS FTDPercentage, [Forced_Shutdown_MTD] AS [MTDTon], 0.0 AS MTDPercentage FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 39 AS [SR], 'Available Time (Cal TIme Planned SD)' AS [Particulars]
					, [Cal_time] - ([Planned_Shutdown] + [Forced_Shutdown]) AS [FTDTon], 100 / 100 AS FTDPercentage
					, [Cal_time_MTD] - ([Planned_Shutdown_MTD] + [Forced_shutdown_MTD]) AS [MTDTon], 100 / 100 AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 40 AS [SR], 'Std Delay' AS [Particulars]
					, [STD_Delay] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([STD_Delay] AS FLOAT) / [total_time]) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [STD_Delay_MTD] AS [MTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([STD_Delay_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD]) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 41 AS [SR], 'Opm' AS [Particulars], [Opm] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Opm] AS FLOAT) / [total_time]) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [Opm_MTD] AS [MTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Opm_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD]) END AS MTD_Percentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 42 AS [SR], 'ELECT' AS [Particulars]
					, [Elect] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Elect] AS FLOAT) / [total_time]) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [Elect_MTD] AS [MTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Elect_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD]) END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 43 AS [SR], 'MECH' AS [Particulars]
					, [Mech] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Mech] AS FLOAT) / [total_time]) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [Mech_MTD] AS [MTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Mech_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD]) END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 44 AS [SR], 'TRM' AS [Particulars]
					, [Trm] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Trm] AS FLOAT) / [total_time]) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [Trm_MTD] AS [MTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Trm_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD]) END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 45 AS [SR], 'CRANE MAINT' AS [Particulars]
					, [CRANE_MAINT] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([CRANE_MAINT] AS FLOAT) / [total_time] ) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [CRANE_MAINT_MTD] AS [MTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([CRANE_MAINT_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD] ) END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 46 AS [SR], 'WTP/VMD/MRSS' AS [Particulars]
					, [WTP_VMD_MRSS] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([WTP_VMD_MRSS] AS FLOAT) / [total_time] ) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([WTP_VMD_MRSS_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD] ) END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 47 AS [SR], 'PPC/Commercial' AS [Particulars]
					, [PPC_Commercial] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([PPC_Commercial] AS FLOAT) / [total_time] ) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [PPC_Commercial_MTD], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([PPC_Commercial_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD] ) END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 48 AS [SR], 'Total Delays + Std Delays' AS [Particulars]
					, [total_delays] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Total_Delays] AS FLOAT) / [total_time] ) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [Total_Delays_MTD] AS [MTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([Total_Delays_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD] ) END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate] 
				UNION 
				SELECT 49 AS [SR], 'Availability (Net Time / Cal Time)' AS [Particulars]
					, [total_time] - [total_delays] AS [FTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([total_time] - [total_delays] AS FLOAT) / [total_time] ) END AS FTDPercentage
					, [total_time_MTD] - [Total_Delays_MTD] AS [MTDTon], CASE WHEN [total_time_MTD] = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST([total_time_MTD] - [Total_Delays_MTD] AS FLOAT) / [total_time_MTD] ) END AS MTDPercentage 
				FROM DLY CROSS JOIN EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 50 AS [SR], 'Power ON Time Delay / Planning Delay',0.0 AS FTD_Percentage,0.0 AS MTD_Percentage,0.0 AS FTDTon,0.0 AS MTDTon
				UNION 
				SELECT 51 AS [SR], 'TPH (BL / Cycle time)',NULL AS FTD_Percentage,NULL AS MTD_Percentage,0.0 AS FTDTon,0.0 AS MTDTon
				UNION 
				SELECT 52 AS [SR], 'Cycle Time',NULL AS FTD_Percentage,NULL AS MTD_Percentage,0.0 AS FTDTon,0.0 AS MTDTon
				UNION 
				SELECT 53 AS [SR], 'TTT (Calendar Time/Heat)' AS [Particulars], [Avg_TTT] AS [FTDTon],NULL AS FTD_Percentage, [Avg_TTT_MTD] AS [MTDTon],NULL AS MTD_Percentage FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 54 AS [SR], 'Avg Power ON Time' AS [Particulars], [Avg_PoweronTIme] AS [FTDTon], NULL AS FTD_Percentage, [Avg_PoweronTIme_MTD] AS [MTDTon],NULL AS MTD_Percentage FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 55 AS [SR], 'Avg Power OFF Time' AS [Particulars], [Avg_PoweroffTIme] AS [FTDTon], NULL AS FTD_Percentage, [Avg_PoweroffTIme_MTD] AS [MTDTon],NULL AS MTD_Percentage FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				UNION 
				SELECT 56 AS [SR], 'Avg Power Drawn' AS [Particulars], [Avg_PowerMW] AS [FTDTon], NULL AS FTD_Percentage, [Avg_PowerMW_MTD] AS [MTDTon],NULL AS MTD_Percentage FROM EAF FULL JOIN EAF_1 ON EAF.[ReportDate] = EAF_1.[ReportDate]
				) AS T ON /*PRT.[SrNo] = T.[SR] AND*/ REPLACE(PRT.[Particulars], '_', '') = T.[Particulars] 
				

			--SELECT * FROM #Tbl ORDER BY [SR]

			/*---Set List of Pivot Columns and Select Columns---*/
			SELECT @Particular = STUFF((SELECT ',[' + [Particular] +']' FROM #Tbl ORDER BY [SR] FOR XML PATH('')), 1,1, '');

			SELECT @FtdTonLst = STUFF((SELECT ', SUM(ISNULL([' + [Particular] +'], 0)) AS [' + [Particular] + ' FTD Ton]' FROM #Tbl ORDER BY [SR] FOR XML PATH('')), 1,1, '')
			SELECT @SelLst = STUFF((SELECT ', BSTMnt.['+[Particular]+' BestMonth], BstDt.['+[Particular]+' BestDay], FTDTon.[' + [Particular] +' FTD Ton], FTDPer.['+[Particular]+' FTD Percentage], MTDTon.['+[Particular]+' MTD Ton], MTDPer.['+[Particular]+' MTD Percentage]' FROM #Tbl ORDER BY [SR] FOR XML PATH('')), 1,1, '')

			SET @BestDayLst = REPLACE(@FtdtonLst, 'FTD Ton', 'BestDay');
			SET @BestMonthLst = REPLACE(@FtdtonLst, 'FTD Ton', 'BestMonth');
			SET @FtdPerLst = REPLACE(REPLACE(@FtdtonLst,' FTDTon]',' FTDPer]'), ' FTD Ton]', ' FTD Percentage]');
			SET @MtdTonLst = REPLACE(REPLACE(@FTDTonLst, ' FTDTon]', ' MTDTon]'), ' FTD Ton]', ' MTD Ton]');
			SET @MTDPerLst = REPLACE(REPLACE(@FtdPerLst, ' FTDPer]', ' MTDPer]'), ' FTD Percentage]', ' MTD Percentage]');

			--SELECT @FTdtonLst, @FtdPerLst, @MtdTonLst, @MtdTonLst1, @BestDayLst1, @BestDayLst, @BestMonthLst1, @BestMonthLst

			/*---Get Production Details in Pivot Form--*/
			SET @SQL = 'SELECT '+@SelLst+'
			FROM (SELECT '+@BestDayLst+' FROM #Tbl PIVOT (SUM([BestDay]) FOR [Particular] IN ('+@Particular+')) AS pvt) AS BstDt
			CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@BestMonthLst+' FROM #Tbl PIVOT (SUM([BestMonth]) FOR [Particular] IN ('+@Particular+')) AS pvt) AS BstMnt
			CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@FtdTonLst+' FROM #Tbl PIVOT (SUM([FTDTon]) FOR [Particular] IN ('+@Particular+')) AS pvt) AS FTDTon 
			CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@FtdPerLst+' FROM #Tbl PIVOT (SUM([FTDPercentage]) FOR [Particular] IN ('+@Particular+')) AS pvt) AS FTDPer
			CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@MtdTonLst+' FROM #Tbl PIVOT (SUM([MTDTon]) FOR [Particular] IN ('+@Particular+')) AS pvt) AS MTDTon
			CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@MtdPerLst+' FROM #Tbl PIVOT (SUM([MTDPercentage]) FOR [Particular] IN ('+@Particular+')) AS pvt) AS MTDPer
			';
			--SELECT @SQL
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Production_Details_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Production_Details_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@SQL,@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

```sql
/*-------------------------
    Created By : Nidhi Rana
    Created On : 13-Oct-2025
    Description : Implement Procedure to recalculate Summary
--------------------------*/

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_CCM_Usp] 
(
    /*DECLARE */@StartDate DATE --= '2025-07-14';
)
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    /*--Variable Declaration--*/
    DECLARE @EndDate DATE   = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);
    DECLARE @CurrentDate DATE = @StartDate;
    DECLARE @ID VARCHAR(36);
    BEGIN TRY
        /*--ReCalculate Summary of CCM--*/
        WHILE @CurrentDate < @EndDate
        BEGIN
            /*--Get Latest ID of CCM--*/
            SELECT @ID = (SELECT TOP(1) [ID] FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([HeatReportDate] AS DATE) = @CurrentDate ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC);

            EXEC [dbo].[Xstudio_Summary_CCM_Usp] @Id = @ID, @DatabaseName = NULL, @EntityName = NULL;

            SET @CurrentDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDate);
        END
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_CCM_Usp | LINE No : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()) + '| MESSAGE : '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' | no :-'+CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_state());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].  [XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_CCM_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID=''
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Recipe_Operation_Quantity_Save_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-07-22 20:34:19  
**Modified On:** 2025-07-22 20:34:19  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @OperationID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @OutputMaterialID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Recipe_Operation_Quantity_Save_Usp]
    @OperationID = '',
    @OutputMaterialID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria
-- Create date: 09-JUL-2025
-- Description:	Used to set operation output material quantity after save of operation
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Recipe_Operation_Quantity_Save_Usp]
	@OperationID VARCHAR(36),
	@OutputMaterialID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	IF(@OutputMaterialID IS NOT NULL AND @OperationID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @MaterialQuantity DECIMAL(18,4);

		SELECT @MaterialQuantity = Quantity FROM XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @OutputMaterialID

		IF(@MaterialQuantity IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @MaterialQuantity = Quantity FROM XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl WHERE MaterialID = @OutputMaterialID
		END
		IF(@MaterialQuantity IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE XBatch_Recipe_Operation_Mst_Tbl SET OutputMaterialQuantity = @MaterialQuantity WHERE ID = @OperationID
		END
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			RAISERROR('BOM not configured for this output material!', 16,1);
		END
	END
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Recipe_Validate_BOM_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Recipe_Validate_BOM_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-07-22 20:34:19  
**Modified On:** 2025-08-11 08:34:01  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @MaterialID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Recipe_Validate_BOM_Usp]
    @MaterialID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria
-- Create date: 09-JUL-2025
-- Description:	Used to validate bom on before save of operation, phase, recipe
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_Recipe_Validate_BOM_Usp]
	@MaterialID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF(@MaterialID IS NOT NULL AND @MaterialID != '') 
	BEGIN


		DECLARE @MaterialQuantity DECIMAL(18,4) = NULL;

		SELECT @MaterialQuantity = Quantity FROM XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl WHERE ParentID = @MaterialID AND IsDeleted = 0 AND IsEnabled = 1

		IF(@MaterialQuantity IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT @MaterialQuantity = Quantity FROM XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl WHERE MaterialID = @MaterialID AND IsDeleted = 0 AND IsEnabled = 1
		END

		IF(@MaterialQuantity IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 'BOM not found for the selected material, Kindly define the BOM for the selected material!';
		END
	END

END
```
