## dbo.XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_SPValidation_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_SPValidation_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-07-05 10:51:15  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:20:20  
**Parameter Count:** 5  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @RollingPlanID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @HeatNo | varchar(50) | NO |  |
| @TotalQty | int | NO |  |
| @AssignQty | int | NO |  |
| @RequiredQty | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_SPValidation_Usp]
    @RollingPlanID = '',
    @HeatNo = '',
    @TotalQty = 0,
    @AssignQty = 0,
    @RequiredQty = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 04-Jul-2025
	Description : Validation to insert Billet Details
----------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_SPValidation_Usp]
(
	--DECLARE 
	@RollingPlanID VARCHAR(36)--='BF412B4D-7A0F-458D-9E8B-4EA07BFC3A9D'
	, @HeatNo VARCHAR(50)--='H0003'
	, @TotalQty INT--=3
	, @AssignQty INT--=1
	, @RequiredQty INT
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	DECLARE @PrevRollingID VARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @PrevStatus VARCHAR(50);
	DECLARE @RollingID VARCHAR(50);
	DECLARE @sequenceno INT;
	DECLARE @RollingDate DATE;
	DECLARE @MinRollingID VARCHAR(50);
	DECLARE @MinSequenceNo INT;
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT @RollingDate = [RollingDate], @RollingID = [RollingID], @sequenceno = [SequenceNo] FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @RollingPlanID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		--; with cte as (
		--		SELECT *,  MIN(CASE WHEN [Prevstatus] IS NULL OR [Prevstatus] IN ('In-Assignment', 'Released') THEN [num] END) OVER (ORDER BY [num], [SEquenceNo]) AS [Minnum]
		--FROM (
		--	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING([RollingID], CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID])) AS INT), [SequenceNo]) AS num
		--		, CAST([RollingDate] AS DATE) AS [RollingDate]
		--		, LAG([Status]) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING([RollingID], CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID])) AS INT)) AS PrevStatus
		--		, LAG([RollingID]) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING([RollingID], CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID])) AS INT)) AS [PrevRollingID]
		--		, LAG([sequenceno]) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING([RollingID], CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID])) AS INT)) AS PrevSequenceno
		--		, [RollingID], [Sequenceno], [Status] 
		--	FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK)
		--	WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
		--		AND [RollingDate] = @RollingDate
		--		AND [Status] != 'Draft'
		--	) AS t
		--	), cte1 as (
		--	SELECT * FROM cte CROSS APPLY (SELECT SequenceNo as [MinSequenceNo], RollingID AS [MinRollingPlanID] FROM cte WHERE Minnum = num) as t)
		--	SELECT  @PrevRollingID = [PrevRollingID], @PrevStatus = [PrevStatus], @MinRollingID = [MinRollingPlanID], @MinSequenceNo = [MinSequenceNo] FROM cte1 WHERE --[PrevStatus] != 'Finalized' AND [PrevStatus] != 'Release' AND
		--	[RollingID] = @RollingID AND [SequenceNo] = @sequenceno
		SELECT @PrevRollingID = [PrevRollingID], @PrevStatus = [PrevStatus], @MinRollingID = [MinRollingPlanID], @MinSequenceNo = [MinSequenceNo] FROM(
		SELECT *,  MIN(CASE WHEN [Prevstatus] IS NULL AND [Status] = 'Finalized' THEN [RollingID] WHEN [Prevstatus] IN ('In-Assignment') AND [Status] = 'Finalized' THEN [prevrollingID] END) OVER (ORDER BY [num], [SEquenceNo]) AS [MinRollingPlanID], MIN(CASE WHEN [Prevstatus] IS NULL AND [Status] = 'Finalized' THEN [SequenceNo] WHEN [Prevstatus] IN ('In-Assignment') AND [Status] = 'Finalized' THEN [prevsequenceno] END) OVER (ORDER BY [num], [SEquenceNo]) AS [MinSequenceNo]
		FROM (
			SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING([RollingID], CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID])) AS INT), [SequenceNo]) AS num
				, CAST([RollingDate] AS DATE) AS [RollingDate]
				, LAG([Status]) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING([RollingID], CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID])) AS INT)) AS PrevStatus
				, LAG([RollingID]) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING([RollingID], CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID])) AS INT)) AS [PrevRollingID]
				, LAG([sequenceno]) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING([RollingID], CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID])) AS INT)) AS PrevSequenceno
				, [RollingID], [Sequenceno], [Status] 
			FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
				AND [RollingDate] = @RollingDate
				AND [Status] NOT IN ('Draft','Released')
			) AS t )AS t1 WHERE --[PrevStatus] != 'Finalized' AND [PrevStatus] != 'Release' AND
			[RollingID] = @RollingID AND [SequenceNo] = @sequenceno
		IF @PrevStatus != 'Released' AND  @PrevStatus IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN 
			SELECT 'Please Release Rolling ID : '''+@MinRollingID+''' And SequenceNo : '+CAST(@MinSequenceNo AS VARCHAR(20))+'.';
		END
		ELSE IF @TotalQty < @AssignQty 
		BEGIN
			SELECT 'Assign Quantity of Billet must be Less than or equals Total Quantity.'; 
		END		 
		ELSE IF @RequiredQty < @AssignQty
		BEGIN
			SELECT 'Assigned Quantity more than Required Quantity.'
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_SPValidation_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_SPValidation_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```

### EXEC Template

```sql
    @HeatNo = '',
    @TotalQty = 0,
    @AssignQty = 0,
    @RequiredQty = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 04-Jul-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure to insert Billet Details in Charging Plan
----------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_Usp]
(
	@RollingPlanID VARCHAR(36)--='BF412B4D-7A0F-458D-9E8B-4EA07BFC3A9D'
	, @HeatNo VARCHAR(50)--='H0003'
	, @TotalQty INT--=3
	, @AssignQty INT--=1
	, @RequiredQty INT 
	/*DECLARE 
	@RollingPlanID VARCHAR(36)='BF412B4D-7A0F-458D-9E8B-4EA07BFC3A9D'
	, @HeatNo VARCHAR(50)='H0004'
	, @TotalQty INT=2
	, @AssignQty INT=2*/
)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	DECLARE @tbl AS TABLE([HeatNo] VARCHAR(50), [BilletNo] VARCHAR(100), [PO] VARCHAR(100), [Size] VARCHAR(200), [CurrentLocation] VARCHAR(200), [SequenceNo] INT IDENTITY(1,1), [RollingID] VARCHAR(100), [RollingDate] DATE, [MaterialID] VARCHAR(36), [BomID] VARCHAR(36), [BilletID] VARCHAR(36), [BLTNO] INT);
	DECLARE @validate_Tbl AS TABLE (ERRORMESSAGE NVARCHAR(MAX));
	DECLARE @MaxSeqNo INT;
	BEGIN TRY
		INSERT INTO @validate_Tbl 
		EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_SPValidation_Usp] @RollingPlanid, @HeatNo, @TotalQty, @AssignQty, @REquiredQty;
	
		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @validate_Tbl)
		BEGIN
			SET @MaxSeqNo = ISNULL((SELECT MAX([SequenceNo]) FROM [dbo].[RM_Charging_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [RollingID] IN (SELECT [RollingID] FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @RollingPlanID)), 0);
			PRINT(@MAxseqno)			
			
			INSERT INTO @tbl([HeatNo], [BilletNo], [PO], [Size], [CurrentLocation], [RollingID], [RollingDate], [MaterialID], [BOMID], [BilletID], [BLTNO])
			SELECT TOP(@AssignQty) BLT.[LotNumber] AS [HeatNo],BLT.[SublotNumber] AS [BilletNo], RP.[PONumber] AS PO, RP.[Size], 'Billet Storage' AS [CurrentLocation], RP.[RollingID] AS [RollingID], RP.[RollingDate] AS [RollingDate], MMT.[ID] AS [MaterialID], BLT.[BOMid], BLT.[ID], CAST(SUBSTRING(BLT.[SublotNumber], CHARINDEX('_', BLT.[SublotNumber])+ 1, LEN(BLT.[SublotNumber])) AS INT) AS [BLTNO]
			FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] AS RP WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON RP.[MaterialID] = MMT.[ID]
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl] AS FMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON FMT.[ParentID] = MMT.[ID]
			JOIN [dbo].[Billet_Inventory] AS BLT WITH(NOLOCK) ON BLT.[BOMid] = FMT.[ID]
			WHERE RP.[ID] = @RollingPlanID AND BLT.[LotNumber] = @HeatNo 
				AND RP.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND FMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND BLT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND ISNULL(BLT.[IsAllocated], 0) = 0
				 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[RM_Charging_Plan] AS RCP WITH(NOLOCK) 
							WHERE RCP.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND RCP.[RollingID] = RP.[RollingID] AND RCP.[BilletNo] = BLT.[SublotNumber] AND RCP.[SequenceNo] = CAST(SUBSTRING(BLT.[SublotNumber], CHARINDEX('_', BLT.[SublotNumber])+ 1, LEN(BLT.[SublotNumber])) AS INT))
			ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(BLT.[SublotNumber], CHARINDEX('_', BLT.[SublotNumber])+ 1, LEN(BLT.[SublotNumber])) AS INT);

			SELECT * FROM @tbl
		
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[RM_Charging_Plan]([HeatNo], [BilletNo], [PO], [Size], [CurrentLocation], [SequenceNo], [RollingID], [RollingDate], [MaterialId])
			SELECT TOP(@AssignQty)[HeatNo], [BilletNo], [PO], [Size], [CurrentLocation], @MaxSeqNo + [SequenceNo], [RollingID], [RollingDate], [MaterialID] FROM @tbl AS t1
			WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[RM_Charging_Plan] AS RCP WITH(NOLOCK) 
							WHERE RCP.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND RCP.[RollingID] = t1.[RollingID] AND RCP.[BilletNo] = t1.[BilletNo] AND RCP.[SequenceNo] = t1.[BLTNO])
			ORDER BY [BLTNO];
			UPDATE BLT SET [IsAllocated] = 1 FROM [dbo].[Billet_Inventory] AS BLT WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE t1.[HeatNo] = BLt.[LotNumber] AND t1.[BilletNo] = BLT.[SubLotNumber] AND t1.[BilletID] = BLT.[ID])

			UPDATE [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] SET [Status] = 'In-Assignment', [AssignedQty] = ISNULL([AssignedQty], 0) + ISNULL(@AssignQty , 0)  WHERE [ID] = @RollingPlanID ;--AND [RollingID] IN (SELECT [RollingID] FROM [dbo].[RM_Charging_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @RollingPlanID);
			UPDATE [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] SET [Status] = 'Released' WHERE [AssignedQty] = [ReleaseRollingQty] AND [ID] = @RollingPlanID ;--AND [RollingID] IN (SELECT [RollingID] FROM [dbo].[RM_Charging_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @RollingPlanID);
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END

-- Exec [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XBatch_RM_Billet_Assign_SPValidation_Usp] 'DE0D0AAE-3D11-4A32-89D6-E01917028D34','H0004','2','2'
--go
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 08-jul-2025
	Description : Update Location and Status per heat
------------------------*/
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_BilletInventoryView_Location_U_Usp]
(@HeatNo VARCHAR(50), @AssignQty INT, @TotalQty INT, @Location VARCHAR(500), @Material VARCHAR(200),@Grade VARCHAR(36))
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	DECLARE @GradeID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @LocationID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		SET @GradeID = (SELECT [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = @Grade);
		SET @LocationID = (SELECt [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Storage_Rack_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = @Location)
		UPDATE BLTI SET BLTI.[LocationName] = @Location, [LocationID] = @LocationID, BLTI.[GradeID] = @GradeID, [Grade] = @Grade, BLTI.[Status] = 'Recieved' FROM [dbo].[Billet_Inventory_View] AS BLTI  
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [LotNumber] = @HeatNo AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
		SELECT TOP(ISNULL(@AssignQty, 0)) CAST(RIGHT([SubLotNumber], LEN([SubLotNumber]) - CHARINDEX('_', [SubLotNumber])) AS INT) AS [Num], [ID], [Lotnumber],[SubLotNumber],[LocationName],[Status],[Grade] FROM [Billet_Inventory_View] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [LotNumber] = @HeatNo AND [Status] = 'Open') AS t where t.[ID] = BLTI.[ID] AND t.[LotNumber] = BLTI.[LotNumber] AND t.[SublotNumber] = BLTI.[SublotNumber] )
		--ORDER BY CAST(RIGHT([SubLotNumber], LEN([SubLotNumber]) - CHARINDEX('_', [SubLotNumber])) AS INT)
		
		
		SET @SQL = (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST([Query] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '; ') FROM (SELECT TOP(ISNULL(@AssignQty, 0)) CAST(RIGHT([SubLotNumber], LEN([SubLotNumber]) - CHARINDEX('_', [SubLotNumber])) AS INT) AS Num,'IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [LotNumber] = '''+[LotNumber]+''' AND [SubLotNumber] = '''+[SubLotNumber]+''' AND [ReceivedDate]) BEGIN EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_I_Material_Inventory_USP] '+
		CASE WHEN @Material IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + @Material + '''' END +','+
		CASE WHEN [Lotnumber] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [Lotnumber] + '''' END +','+
		CASE WHEN [SubLotNumber] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [SubLotNumber] + '''' END +','+
		CASE WHEN @Grade IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + @Grade + '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [Quantity] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE ''''+CAST([Quantity] AS VARCHAR(20))+'''' END +','+
		CASE WHEN [UOMID] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [UOMID] + '''' END+','+
		CASE WHEN [LocationType] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [LocationType] + '''' END +','+
		CASE WHEN @Location IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + @Location + '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [IsExpired] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + CAST([IsExpired] AS VARCHAR(10))+ '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [expirydate] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + CAST([expirydate] AS VARCHAR(20	))+ '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [ReceivedDate] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + CAST([ReceivedDate] AS VARCHAR(20))+ '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [Vendor] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [Vendor] + '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [PONumber] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [PONumber] + '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [GRNNumber] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [GRNNumber] + '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [InvoiceNumber] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [InvoiceNumber] + '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [Price] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + CAST([Price] AS VARCHAR(50))+ '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [Description] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [Description] + '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [OperationID] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [OperationID] + '''' END +','+
		CASE WHEN [Remark] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [Remark] + '''' END +','+ 
		CASE WHEN [MaterialGrade] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + [MaterialGrade] + '''' END +',NULL; END' AS Query
		FROM [Billet_Inventory_View] AS BLTI WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [LotNumber] = @HeatNo AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (
		SELECT TOP(ISNULL(@AssignQty, 0)) CAST(RIGHT([SubLotNumber], LEN([SubLotNumber]) - CHARINDEX('_', [SubLotNumber])) AS INT) AS [Num], [ID], [Lotnumber],[SubLotNumber],[LocationName],[Status],[Grade] FROM [Billet_Inventory_View] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [LotNumber] = @HeatNo) AS t where t.[ID] = BLTI.[ID] AND t.[LotNumber] = BLTI.[LotNumber] AND t.[SublotNumber] = BLTI.[SublotNumber])
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND t1.[LotNumber] = BLTI.[LotNumber] AND t1.[SubLotNumber] = BLTI.[SublotNumber])) AS t);
		--ORDER BY CAST(RIGHT([SubLotNumber], LEN([SubLotNumber]) - CHARINDEX('_', [SubLotNumber])) AS INT)
		Print(@SQL)
		EXEC (@SQL);
		--SELECT @HeatNo, @AssignQty, @TotalQty, @Location, @Material, @Grade
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_BilletInventoryView_Location_U_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_BilletInventoryView_Location_U_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)
	END CATCH
END

--update Billet_Inventory_View set Status = 'Open', LocationName = null where LocationName is not null


--select * from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl order by CreatedOn desc

--delete from XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl where  ID in ('16D71F6A-25E1-4E65-8C96-C00F1AE0B8AF','1B2CAB66-C894-42D0-B216-35E42C2C7862')
```

```sql
/*-----------------------

CREATE       PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_BilletInventoryView_SPValidation_Usp]
(@HeatNo VARCHAR(50), @AssignQty INT, @TotalQty INT)
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 17-11-2025
-- Description:	Pivot View Of Billets In Furnace
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE  Xbatch_RM_Billets_In_Furnace_Pivot_Usp
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT 
    PositionNo,
    PositionValue
FROM
(
    SELECT
        Position1, Position2, Position3, Position4, Position5,
        Position6, Position7, Position8, Position9, Position10,
        Position11, Position12, Position13, Position14, Position15,
        Position16, Position17, Position18, Position19, Position20,
        Position21, Position22, Position23, Position24, Position25,
        Position26, Position27, Position28, Position29, Position30,
        Position31, Position32, Position33, Position34, Position35,
        Position36, Position37, Position38, Position39, Position40,
        Position41, Position42, Position43, Position44, Position45,
        Position46, Position47, Position48, Position49, Position50,
        Position51, Position52, Position53, Position54, Position55,
        Position56, Position57, Position58, Position59, Position60,
        Position61, Position62, Position63, Position64,
        OutofFurnace,
        Position66, Position67, Position68, Position69, Position70
    FROM XStudio_List_BilletsPosition_InFurnace_Vw
) AS src
UNPIVOT
(
    PositionValue FOR PositionNo IN 
    (
        Position1, Position2, Position3, Position4, Position5,
        Position6, Position7, Position8, Position9, Position10,
        Position11, Position12, Position13, Position14, Position15,
        Position16, Position17, Position18, Position19, Position20,
        Position21, Position22, Position23, Position24, Position25,
        Position26, Position27, Position28, Position29, Position30,
        Position31, Position32, Position33, Position34, Position35,
        Position36, Position37, Position38, Position39, Position40,
        Position41, Position42, Position43, Position44, Position45,
        Position46, Position47, Position48, Position49, Position50,
        Position51, Position52, Position53, Position54, Position55,
        Position56, Position57, Position58, Position59, Position60,
        Position61, Position62, Position63, Position64,
        OutofFurnace,
        Position66, Position67, Position68, Position69, Position70
    )
) AS unp;
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 15-11-2025
-- Description:	Per Billets NGConsumption
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_BilletWiseNGConsumption] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	 BEGIN TRY

	Declare @StartDate DateTime, @EndDate DateTime,@BilletNo Varchar(36),@HID varchar(36),@BilletInCount int, @Val Decimal(18,4)

		SELECT TOP 1 @BilletNo=BilletNo,@EndDate=EntryDateTime FROM Billets_InFurnace_Tracking_Trn With(Nolock)
		Where BilletPosition='Position2'
		ORDER BY CreatedOn DESC

		SELECT TOP 1 @StartDate=EntryDateTime FROM Billets_InFurnace_Tracking_Trn With(Nolock)
		Where BilletPosition='Position1' and BilletNo=@BilletNo
		ORDER BY CreatedOn DESC

		--Select @StartDate, @EndDate, @BilletNo
		CREATE TABLE #Tag_condition ([TAGID] INT,[Condition] varchar(500),[ID] VARCHAR(36));
         SET @HID = NEWID();
         INSERT INTO #Tag_condition([TAGID], [Condition], [ID])
         SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, [TagNo]),NULL,@HID
         FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE Name='RF_NG_ACTUAL_DAY_CONSUMPTION';

         IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#CCM_SMS_Block_1') IS NOT NULL
         BEGIN
          DROP TABLE #CCM_SMS_Block_1;
         END
         CREATE TABLE #CCM_SMS_Block_1([TAGID] INT,[VAL] DECIMAL(18,2));
      
         INSERT INTO #CCM_SMS_Block_1
         EXEC [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Max_Sub_Max_Value_Usp] @StartDate,@EndDate,@HID;
         --SELECT TAGID,VAL FROM #CCM_SMS_Block_1
         
          TRUNCATE TABLE #Tag_condition;

		 SELECT @BilletInCount=count(BilletNo) FROM Billets_InFurnace_Tracking_Trn With(Nolock) Where EntryDateTime=@StartDate and BilletNo not in ('N/A','Heat Change Gap','Grade Change Gap')
		 --Select @BilletInCount

		SELECT @Val=Cast(Round((VAL/NULLIF(ISNULL(@BilletInCount,0),0))/29.5,4) As Decimal(18,4)) FROM #CCM_SMS_Block_1 With(Nolock)

		Update Billet_NGConsumption_InFurnace Set NGConsumption= ISNULL(NGConsumption, 0) + @val WHERE OutTime IS NULL
		Update Billet_NGConsumption_InFurnace Set Price=NGConsumption*(Select UnitPriceUSD from Price_Mst_Tbl Where ID='CB96723B-A609-4DD8-9BBD-8E9C0E83EAD8') WHERE OutTime IS NULL

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_BilletWiseNGConsumption | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_BilletWiseNGConsumption]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_RM_ItemsOfMaterial_In_Inventory_BOM_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_RM_ItemsOfMaterial_In_Inventory_BOM_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-07-04 14:28:30  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:21:00  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @IsGroupofSubLot | bit | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_ItemsOfMaterial_In_Inventory_BOM_Usp]
    @ID = '',
    @IsGroupofSubLot = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*------------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 03-Jul-2025
	Description : Get Items of Material Which are in BOM and Invetory
------------------------------*/

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_ItemsOfMaterial_In_Inventory_BOM_Usp]
(@ID VARCHAR(36), @IsGroupofSubLot BIT)
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		IF @IsGroupofSubLot = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT MMT1.[Name] AS [ItemType], MMT1.[Number] AS [ItemCode], MIMT.[LotNumber], MIMT.[SublotNumber], MIMT.[Quantity], UMT.[Name] AS [UOM], GRD.[Name] AS Grade
			FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] AS MIMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON MIMT.[ParentID] = MMT1.[ID]
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT [Name], [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] AS UMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS UMT ON UMT.[ID] = MIMT.[UOMID]
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT [ID], [Name] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS GRD ON GRD.[ID] = MIMT.[GradeID] 
			WHERE MMT1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MIMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 
			AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT FDT.[MaterialID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl] AS FMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[ID] = FMT.[ParentID]
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl] AS FDT WITH(NOLOCK) ON FMT.[Id] = FDT.[ParentID] 
			WHERE MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND FMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND FDT.[IsDeleted] = 0
				AND MMT.[id] IN (SELECT [Materialid] FROM [dbo].[RM_Sales_Order] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ID)
				) AS t WHERE t.[MaterialID] = MIMT.[ParentID])
				ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(MIMT.[SublotNumber], CHARINDEX('_', MIMT.[SublotNumber])+ 1, LEN(MIMT.[SublotNumber])) AS INT);
		END
		ELSE IF @IsGroupofSubLot = 1
		BEGIN
			SELECT MMT1.[Name] AS [ItemType], MMT1.[Number] AS [ItemCode], MIMT.[LotNumber] , COUNT(MIMT.[SublotNumber]) AS [NoOfSubLotNumber], MIMT.[Quantity], UMT.[Name] AS [UOM], GRD.[Name] AS Grade, @ID AS [RollingPlanID]
			FROM [dbo].[Billet_Inventory] AS MIMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON MIMT.[MaterialID] = MMT1.[ID]
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT [Name], [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] AS UMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS UMT ON UMT.[ID] = MIMT.[UOMID]
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT [ID], [Name] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS GRD ON GRD.[ID] = MIMT.[GradeID] 
			WHERE MMT1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MIMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND isnull([IsAllocated],0) = 0 
			AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT FDT.[MaterialID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl] AS FMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[ID] = FMT.[ParentID]
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl] AS FDT WITH(NOLOCK) ON FMT.[Id] = FDT.[ParentID] 
			WHERE MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND FMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND FDT.[IsDeleted] = 0
				AND MMT.[ID] IN (SELECT [MaterialID] FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ID)
				) AS t WHERE t.[MaterialID] = MIMT.[MaterialID])
			GROUP BY MMT1.[Name], MMT1.[Number], MIMT.[LotNumber], MIMT.[Quantity], UMT.[Name], GRD.[Name];
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT MMT1.[Name] AS [Material Name], MMT1.[Number] AS [Material Code], MIMT.[LotNumber] [Heat No], MIMT.[SublotNumber] AS [Billet No], MIMT.[Quantity], UMT.[Name] AS [UOM], GRD.[Name] AS Grade
			FROM [dbo].[Billet_Inventory] AS MIMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON MIMT.[MaterialID] = MMT1.[ID]
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT [Name], [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] AS UMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS UMT ON UMT.[ID] = MIMT.[UOMID]
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT [ID], [Name] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS GRD ON GRD.[ID] = MIMT.[GradeID] 
			WHERE MMT1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MIMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND isnull([IsAllocated],0) = 1
			AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT FDT.[MaterialID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl] AS FMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[ID] = FMT.[ParentID]
			JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl] AS FDT WITH(NOLOCK) ON FMT.[Id] = FDT.[ParentID] 
			WHERE MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND FMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND FDT.[IsDeleted] = 0
				AND MMT.[id] IN (SELECT [Materialid] FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ID)
				) AS t WHERE t.[MaterialID] = MIMT.[MaterialID])
			--GROUP BY MMT1.[Name], MMT1.[Number], MIMT.[LotNumber], MIMT.[Quantity], UMT.[Name], GRD.[Name];
		END

		;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_ItemsOfMaterial_In_Inventory_BOM_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_ItemsOfMaterial_In_Inventory_BOM_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_RM_Mill_Billet_DischargeTemp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_RM_Mill_Billet_DischargeTemp  
**Created On:** 2025-11-26 10:46:46  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-26 10:46:46  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @StartDate | datetime | NO |  |
| @EndDate | datetime | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Mill_Billet_DischargeTemp]
    @StartDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @EndDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		MAHESH UDAR
-- Create date: 26-11-2025
-- Description:	Discharge Temperature Per Billet
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE XBatch_RM_Mill_Billet_DischargeTemp
	@StartDate DateTime,
	@EndDate DateTime
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	 BEGIN TRY
    
	Declare @HID VARCHAR(36), @DischargeTemp Decimal(18,4)

	CREATE TABLE #Tag_condition ([TAGID] INT,[Condition] varchar(500),[ID] VARCHAR(36));
         SET @HID = NEWID();
         INSERT INTO #Tag_condition([TAGID], [Condition], [ID])
         SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, [TagNo]),NULL,@HID
         FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK)
          WHERE Name='RF_DISCHARGED_BILLET_TEMP_C_PRM';
	

		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#RM_Mill_DischargeTemp') IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
		DROP TABLE #RM_Mill_DischargeTemp;
		END
		CREATE TABLE #RM_Mill_DischargeTemp([TAGID] INT,[VAL] DECIMAL(18,2),[Count] INT);
		INSERT INTO #RM_Mill_DischargeTemp
		EXEC [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_MAX_Value_Usp] @StartDate,@EndDate,@HID;
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #RM_Mill_DischargeTemp)
		Begin
		Select @DischargeTemp=Val from #RM_Mill_DischargeTemp
		End

		TRUNCATE TABLE #Tag_condition;

		Declare @Position65 varchar(500)
		Select @Position65=Position65 from [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[BilletsPosition_InFurnace] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
		if(@Position65 not in ('Heat Change Gap','Grade Change Gap','No Billet'))
		Begin

		---- Update outtime of Billets---
		IF Exists(Select 1 from [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_NGConsumption_InFurnace] With(Nolock) WHERE BilletNo=@Position65)
		Begin
		UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_NGConsumption_InFurnace] SET DischargeTemp=@DischargeTemp WHERE BilletNo=@Position65
		End
		End
		------
		END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_Mill_Billet_DischargeTemp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_Mill_Billet_DischargeTemp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_RM_Rolling_Plan_Approval_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_RM_Rolling_Plan_Approval_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-07-01 16:23:39  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:21:12  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Plan_Approval_Usp]
    @ID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 01-Jul-2025 
	Description : Approve with Minimum sequence no of rolling date and when material is also available
					Throw Error when sequnece with draft status is not minimum sequnece and material is not available

	Modified On : 03-Jul-2025
	Description : Modification to get validation for minimum sequence for date and rolling id
--------------------------------------*/
CREATE       PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Plan_Approval_Usp]
(
	@ID VARCHAR(36)
)
 AS 
 BEGIN
 					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Material VARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @MaterialID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @sequenceno INT;
	DECLARE @RollingDate DATE;
	DECLARE @MinseqNo INT;
	DECLARE @RollingID VARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Error NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT @RollingID = RP.[RollingID], @MaterialID = MMT.[ID], @Material = MMT.[Name], @sequenceno = RP.[SequenceNo], @RollingDate = RP.[RollingDate] 
		FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] AS RP WITH(NOLOCK) 
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT [ID], [Name] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS MMT ON RP.[MaterialID] = MMT.[ID]
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT [ID], [MaterialGrade] FROM [dbo].[Steel_Grade_Master] AS SGM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS SGM ON RP.[MaterialGrade] = SGM.[ID]
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND RP.[ID] = @ID;
	--	SELECT @Material
		SET @MinseqNo = (SELECT MIN([SequenceNo]) FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [RollingDate] = @RollingDate AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [RollingID] = @RollingID AND [Status] = 'Draft');
		IF @sequenceno != @MinseqNo
		BEGIN
			SET @Error = ' Please Approve For Mininum Sequence No. '+CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX), @MinseqNo)+' Of Date '''+CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @RollingDate)+''' and Rolling ID '''+@RollingID+'''';			
			RAISERROR(@Error,16,1);
		END
		--ELSE IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @MaterialID)
		--BEGIN
		--	SET @Error = ' Material : '''+@Material+''' is not available ';
		--	RAISERROR(@Error,16,1);
		--END
		ELSE IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ParentID] = @MaterialID)
		BEGIN
			SET @Error = ' BOM of Material : '''+@Material+''' is not available ';
			RAISERROR(@Error,16,1);
		END
		ELSE IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ParentID] IN (SELECT FMT.[ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl] AS FMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE FMT.[IsDeleted] = 0  AND FMT.[ParentID] = @MaterialID))
		BEGIN
			SET @Error = ' BOM Items of Material : '''+@Material+''' are not available ';
			RAISERROR(@Error,16,1);
		END
		ELSE IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Recipe_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [MaterialID] = @MaterialID)
		BEGIN
			SET @Error = ' Recipe of Material : '''+@Material+''' is not available ';
			RAISERROR(@Error,16,1);
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] SET [Status] = 'Finalized' WHERE [Status] = 'Draft' AND [MaterialID] = @MaterialID AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([RollingDate] AS DATE)= @RollingDate AND [SequenceNo] = @sequenceno AND [RollingID] = @RollingID;
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_Rolling_Plan_Approval_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Plan_Approval_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR,16,1)
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_SPvaildation_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_SPvaildation_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-30 12:53:51  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:21:26  
**Parameter Count:** 7  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @SalesOrderNo | varchar(50) | NO |  |
| @RollingReleaseQty | int | NO |  |
| @SequenceNo | int | NO |  |
| @RollingDate | datetime | NO |  |
| @MaxSeqNo | int | NO |  |
| @MaxRollingID | varchar(max) | NO |  |
| @IsNewRollingId | bit | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_SPvaildation_Usp]
    @SalesOrderNo = '',
    @RollingReleaseQty = 0,
    @SequenceNo = 0,
    @RollingDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @MaxSeqNo = 0,
    @MaxRollingID = '',
    @IsNewRollingId = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Modified On : 30-Jun-2025
	Description : Throw error when RollingReleaseQty is more than OpenQty for current salesorder and same sequence no for selected date in rolling plan 		
	
	Modified On : 03-Jul-2025
	Description : Modification to add validation for finalized rolling id and same sequence no for date and rolling id
--------------------------------------*/
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_SPvaildation_Usp]
 (
	@SalesOrderNo VARCHAR(50),
	@RollingReleaseQty INT,
	@SequenceNo INT,
	@RollingDate DATETIME,
	@MaxSeqNo INT,
	@MaxRollingID VARCHAR(MAX),
	@IsNewRollingId BIT
)
 AS 
 BEGIN
 					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Openqty INT;
	--DECLARE @fdt VARCHAR(100) = convert(varchar,@Rollingdate,120);
	BEGIN TRY
		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [RollingDate] = @RollingDate AND [Status] = 'Finalized' AND [RollingID] = @MaxRollingID) AND (@IsNewRollingID = 0 AND @MaxRollingID != 'Rolling ID Does Not Exists')
		BEGIN
			SELECT 'Rolling ID '''+@MaxRollingID+''' Is Already Finalized';
		END
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[RM_Sales_Order] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE @RollingReleaseQty > [OpenQty] AND [PONumber] = @SalesOrderNo AND [Status] = 'Open' AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
		BEGIN
			/*---Get OpenQty---*/
			SET @OpenQty = (SELECT [OpenQty] FROM [dbo].[RM_Sales_Order] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [PONumber] = @SalesOrderNo AND [Status] = 'Open' AND [IsDeleted] = 0);

			/*---Raise Error When RollingReleaseQty Is Greater Then OpenQty----*/
			SELECT  'RollingReleaseQty ('+CAST(@RollingReleaseQty AS VARCHAR(MAX))+') cannot exceed OpenQty ('+CAST(@OpenQty AS VARCHAR(MAX))+').'
			--RAISERROR( 'RollingReleaseQty (%d) cannot exceed OpenQty (%d).',16, 1,@RollingReleaseQty, @OpenQty);
		END
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SequenceNo] = @SequenceNo AND [RollingDate] = @RollingDate AND [RollingID] = @MaxRollingID)
		BEGIN
			/*---Raise Error When Same Sequence No Already Exists in Rolling Plan----*/
			SELECT 'SequenceNo '+CAST(@Sequenceno AS VARCHAR(MAX))+' Is Already Exists For Date '''+CAST(@RollingDate AS VARCHAR(MAX))+''' AND For Rolling Plan ID : '''+@MaxRollingID+'''';
			--RAISERROR('SequenceNo %d Is Already Exists For Date %s',16,1,@Sequenceno, @fdt);
		END
		
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_SPvaildation_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_SPvaildation_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END

--delete from RM_Rolling_Plan where RollingID = 'Rolling ID Does Not Exists'

--exec xstudio_xbatch.dbo.XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_Usp 'S12357','2','1','2025-07-06','1','Rolling ID Does Not Exists','False'
--go
```

## dbo.XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_Usp

**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:21:36  
**Parameter Count:** 7  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @SalesOrderNo | varchar(50) | NO |  |
| @RollingReleaseQty | int | NO |  |
| @SequenceNo | int | NO |  |
| @RollingDate | datetime | NO |  |

| @MaxRollingID | varchar(200) | NO |  |
| @IsNewRollingID | bit | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_Usp]
    @SalesOrderNo = '',
    @RollingReleaseQty = 0,
    @SequenceNo = 0,
    @RollingDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @MaxSeqNo = 0,
    @MaxRollingID = '',
    @IsNewRollingID = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 30-Jun-2025
	Description : Update Open Qty and Rolling Qty in Sales Order and insert record in Rolling plan table If error not occurred with Rolling ID (with same or new rolling id as per pass isnewrollingid flag)

	Modified on : 01-Jul-2025
	Description : Solve issue not insert record of close status which is opened before update

	Modified On : 03-Jul-2025
	Description : Modification to set rolling id and sequence no as per Rolling ID
--------------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_Usp]
 (
	@SalesOrderNo VARCHAR(50),
	@RollingReleaseQty INT,
	@SequenceNo INT,
	@RollingDate DATETIME,
	@MaxSeqNo INT,
	@MaxRollingID VARCHAR(200),
	@IsNewRollingID BIT
)
 AS 
 BEGIN
 					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Openqty INT;
	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	DECLARE @validatetbl AS TABLE (ERRORMESSAGE NVARCHAR(MAX));
	DECLARE @Rollingid VARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @seqno INT;
	DECLARE @DraftRollingNo INT;
	DECLARE @FinalRollingNo INT;
	DECLARE @Error NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;
		--(CASE WHEN [SequenceNo] = 0 THEN NULL ELSE [SequenceNo] END)
		BEGIN TRANSACTION RollingProcess;

		INSERT INTO @validatetbl 
		EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_SPvaildation_Usp] @SalesOrderNo, @RollingReleaseQty, @SequenceNo, @RollingDate, @MaxSeqNo, @MaxRollingID, @IsNewROllingID;

		/*-----Compare RollingReleaseQty and OpenQty and check Same sequence exists or not in Rolling Plan----*/
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @validatetbl)
		BEGIN
			/*----Update OpenQty and ReleaseQty in Open Campaign------*/
			--SELECT
			UPDATE [dbo].[RM_Sales_Order]
			SET [OpenQty] = ISNULL([OpenQty], 0) - @RollingReleaseQty, [ReleaseQty] = ISNULL([ReleaseQty], 0) + @RollingReleaseQty
			--FROM [dbo].[RM_Open_Campaign] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [PONumber] = @SalesOrderNo AND [Status] = 'Open' AND [RollingQty] IS NOT NULL AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

			
			IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([RollingDate] AS DATE) = CAST(@RollingDate AS DATE) AND ([RollingID] = @MaxRollingID)) OR (@RollingDate IS NOT NULL AND @MaxRollingID != 'Rolling ID Does Not Exists')) AND NOT EXISTS(
	Select DISTINCT SUBSTRING([RollingID], 0, CHARINDEX('_', [Rollingid]))+'_'+ RIGHT('00'+CAST(Max(substring(RollingID,CHARINDEX('_',RollingID)+1,LEN(RollingID))) OVER(PARTITION BY [RollingDate] ORDER BY [RollingDate]) AS VARCHAR(MAX)), LEN(substring(RollingID,CHARINDEX('_',RollingID)+1,LEN(RollingID)))) as MaxSequenseNo
	from xstudio_xbatch.dbo.RM_Rolling_Plan AS RP1 WITH(NOLOCK) 
	where IsDeleted = 0 and RollingDate=@RollingDate ) 
			BEGIN
				
				SET @Rollingid = FORMAT(@RollingDAte, 'ddMMMyy_01')
				SET @seqno = 1;
			END
			ELSE IF @IsNewRollingID = 0  AND @MaxRollingID != 'Rolling ID Does Not Exists'
			BEGIN				
				SET @Rollingid = @MaxRollingID;				
				SET @seqno = @SequenceNo;				
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @DraftRollingNo =  (SELECT MAX(SUBSTRING([RollingID],CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID]))) FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] AS RP1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'Draft' AND CAST([RollingDate] AS DATE) = CAST(@RollingDate AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] AS RP2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([RollingDate] AS DATE) = CAST(@RollingDate AS DATE) AND CAST(RP1.[RollingDate] AS DATE) = CAST(RP2.[RollingDate] AS DATE) AND RP1.[RollingID] = RP2.[RollingID] AND RP2.[Status] = 'Finalized')
				)
				SET @FinalRollingNo = (SELECT MAX(SUBSTRING([RollingID],CHARINDEX('_',[RollingID])+1,LEN([RollingID]))) FROM [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CAST([RollingDate] AS DATE) = CAST(@RollingDate AS DATE) AND [Status] = 'Finalized')
				SELECT @DraftRollingNo,@FinalRollingNo
				IF (@DraftRollingNo IS NULL AND @FinalRollingNo IS NOT NULL) OR (@DraftRollingNo < @FinalRollingNo)
				BEGIN
					SET @Rollingid = FORMAT(@RollingDate, 'ddMMMyy_')+CASE WHEN LEN(@FinalRollingNo) < 2 THEN RIGHT('00'+CAST(@FinalRollingNo + 1 AS VARCHAR(MAX)),2) ELSE CAST(@FinalRollingNo + 1 AS VARCHAR(MAX)) END
					SELECT @FinalRollingNo + 1,CASE WHEN LEN(@FinalRollingNo) < 2 THEN RIGHT('00'+CAST(@FinalRollingNo + 1 AS VARCHAR(MAX)),2) ELSE CAST(@FinalRollingNo + 1 AS VARCHAR(MAX)) END
				END
				ELSE /*(@DraftRollingNo IS NOT NULL AND @FinalRollingNo IS NULL) OR (@DraftRollingNo > @FinalRollingNo)*/
				BEGIN
					SET @Rollingid = FORMAT(@RollingDate, 'ddMMMyy_')+CASE WHEN LEN(@DraftRollingNo) < 2 THEN RIGHT('00'+ CAST(@DraftRollingNo + 1 AS VARCHAR(MAX)), 2) ELSE CAST(@DraftRollingNo + 1 AS VARCHAR(MAX)) END
				END
			--	SET @Rollingid = SUBSTRING(@MaxRollingID, 0 ,CHARINDEX('_',@MaxRollingID))+'_'+CAST(MAX(SUBSTRING(@MAxRollingID,CHARINDEX('_',@MaxRollingID)+1,LEN(@MaxRollingID))) + 1 AS VARCHAR(MAX))
				--print 454
				SET @seqno = 1;
			END
			
			/*-----Insert Record in Rolling Plan----*/
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[RM_Rolling_Plan] ([PONumber], [Customer], [MaterialID], [Size], [MaterialGrade], [ReleaseRollingQty], [RollingDate], [Status], [SequenceNo], [RollingQty], [RollingID])
			SELECT [PONumber], [Customer], [MaterialID], [Size], [MaterialGrade], @RollingReleaseQty AS [ReleaseRollingQty] , @RollingDate AS [RollingDate], 'Draft' AS [Status], @seqno AS [SequenceNo], [RollingQty], @Rollingid 
			FROM [dbo].[RM_Sales_Order] AS ROC WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'Open' AND [PONumber] = @SalesOrderNo; 
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[RM_Sales_Order] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'Open' AND [RollingQty] IS NOT NULL AND [RollingQty] = [ReleaseQty] AND [PONumber] = @SalesOrderNo )
			BEGIN
				UPDATE [dbo].[RM_Sales_Order] SET [Status] = 'Close' WHERE [RollingQty] = [ReleaseQty] AND [RollingQty] IS NOT NULL AND [Status] = 'Open' AND [PONumber] = @SalesOrderNo;
			END
		END
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Error = [ErrorMessage] FROM @validatetbl; 
			RAISERROR(@Error,16,1);
		END
		Commit TRANSACTION RollingProcess;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @message VARCHAR(4000), @xstate INT;
		SELECT @error = ERROR_NUMBER(), @message = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION RollingProcess;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END



--exec xstudio_xbatch.dbo.XBatch_RM_Rolling_Process_Usp 'S12357','10','2','2025-07-04','2','04Jul25_02','True'
```

### Parameters

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_RM_SAP_Inventory_Billet_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 08-jul-2025
	Description : Get HeatNo wise No. of subLot for Data from Excel(Billet Inventory view)
---------------------*/

CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[XBatch_RM_SAP_Inventory_Billet_Usp]
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT [MaterialID]
			, MMT.[Name] AS [MaterialName], MMT.[Number] AS [MaterialCode]
			, [LotNumber] AS [HeatNo], COUNT([SublotNumber]) AS [TotalQty]
			, [Gradeid], MGMT.[Name] AS [Grade]
			, [UOMID], MUMT.[Name] AS [Unit], [Status]
		FROM [dbo].[Billet_Inventory_View] AS BLT WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON BLT.[MaterialID] = MMt.[ID]
		JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] AS MGMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON BLT.[GradeID] = MGMT.[ID]
		JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] AS MUMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON BLT.[UOMID] = MUMT.[ID]
		WHERE BLT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MGMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MUMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'Open'
		GROUP BY [MaterialID], MMT.[Name], MMT.[Number], [GradeID], MGMT.[Name], [UOMID], MUMT.[Name], [LotNumber], [Status]
		ORDER BY CAST(RIGHT([LotNumber], LEN([LotNumber]) - CHARINDEX('_',[LotNumber]) - 1) AS INT)
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_RM_SAP_Inventory_Billet_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_RM_SAP_Inventory_Billet_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_Rolling_ID_Changer

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_Rolling_ID_Changer

**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:21:55  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @RollingDate | varchar(50) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Rolling_ID_Changer]
    @RollingDate = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------------------
	Created On : 03-Jul-2025
	Description : Get Maximum Rolling ID
--------------------------------*/
CREATE Proc [dbo].[XBatch_Rolling_ID_Changer]
@RollingDate Varchar(50)
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	BEGIN TRY
	 ;WITH cte AS (
		SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING([RollingID], 0, CHARINDEX('_', [Rollingid]))+'_'+ RIGHT('00'+CAST(Max(substring(RollingID,CHARINDEX('_',RollingID)+1,LEN(RollingID))) OVER(PARTITION BY [RollingDate] ORDER BY [RollingDate]) AS VARCHAR(MAX)), LEN(SUBSTRING(RollingID,CHARINDEX('_',RollingID)+1,LEN(RollingID)))) AS MaxSequenseNo
		FROM xstudio_xbatch.dbo.RM_Rolling_Plan AS RP1 WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [RollingDate] = @RollingDate AND [Status] = 'Draft' 
		), cte1 AS (
			SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cte
		)SELECT CASE WHEN 0 != cnt  THEN (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM cte) ELSE 'Rolling ID Does Not Exists' END FROM cte1;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_Rolling_ID_Changer | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_Rolling_ID_Changer]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
 END

-- exec [XBatch_Rolling_ID_Changer] '02-Jul-2025'
```

## dbo.XBatch_SAP_Material_Prod_Cons_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_SAP_Material_Prod_Cons_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-31 14:29:48  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:22:02  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_SAP_Material_Prod_Cons_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*---------------------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 31-Oct-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure get Workorder wise Consumption and Production Quantity of Material
----------------------------------------*/

CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_SAP_Material_Prod_Cons_Usp]
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Prd_Lst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @PvtLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Prd_LSt1 NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @CNS_Lst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @CNS_Lst1 NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Final_Lst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		
		/*--Set Pivot List For Material Code---*/
		SET @PvtLst = (SELECT STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ',[' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END)) +']' FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
		AND [TypeID] IN (SELECT [ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND ([CanConsumed] = 1 AND [CanProduced] = 1) OR ([CanConsumed] != 1 AND [CanProduced] = 1) OR ([CanConsumed] = 1 AND [CanProduced] != 1)) FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,''));

		/*--Get Material List for Consumption--*/
		SET @Cns_Lst = (SELECT STUFF((
			SELECT DISTINCT ',ISNULL(SUM([' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+']), 0) AS ['+LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+'_Consumption]' 
			FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
				AND [TypeID] IN (SELECT ID FROM [XBatch_Material_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
					AND ([CanConsumed] = 1 AND [CanProduced] != 1) OR ([CanConsumed] = 1 AND [CanProduced] = 1)) 
			FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,''));

		/*--Get Material List for Production--*/
		SET @Prd_Lst = (SELECT STUFF(( 
			SELECT DISTINCT ',ISNULL(SUM([' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+']), 0) AS ['+LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+'_Production]' FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [TypeID] IN (SELECT ID FROM [XBatch_Material_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
					AND ([CanConsumed] != 1 AND [CanProduced] = 1) OR ([CanConsumed] = 1 AND [CanProduced] = 1))
			FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,''));

		/*---Get Select List for Only Production Material---*/
		SET @Prd_Lst1 = (
			SELECT STUFF(( 
			SELECT DISTINCT ',ISNULL(SUM([' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+'_Production]), 0) AS ['+REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END)),' ','_')+'_Production]' FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [TypeID] IN (SELECT ID FROM [XBatch_Material_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
					AND ([CanConsumed] != 1 AND [CanProduced] = 1))
		FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,''));
		--print (@prd_lst1)

		/*---Get Select List for Only Consumption Material--*/
		SET @CNS_Lst1 = (SELECT STUFF(( 
			SELECT DISTINCT ',ISNULL(SUM([' + LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+'_Consumption]), 0) AS ['+REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END)),' ','_')+'_Consumption]' FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [TypeID] IN (SELECT ID FROM [XBatch_Material_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
					AND ([CanConsumed] = 1 AND [CanProduced] != 1) )
			FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,''));
		--print(@cns_lst1)

		/*--Get Select List for Production and Consumption Material--*/
		SET @Final_Lst = (SELECT STUFF(( 
			SELECT DISTINCT ',ISNULL(SUM(['+LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+'_Production]), 0) AS ['+REPLACE([Number],' ','_')+'_Production], ISNULL(SUM(['+LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+'_Consumption]), 0) AS ['+LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Billet',[Number]) > 0 THEN SUBSTRING([Number], 0,CHARINDEX('_',[Number])) ELSE [Number] END))+'_Consumption]' 
			FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
				AND [TypeID] IN (SELECT ID FROM [XBatch_Material_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
					AND ([CanConsumed] = 1 AND [CanProduced] = 1) )
			FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,''));
		--print(@final_lst)

		/*--Get Final Query to get Workorder wise Consumed and Produced quantity of Material--*/
		SET @SQL = 'SELECT COALESCE(t1.[WorkOrderNo], t2.[WorkOrderNo],t3.[WorkOrderNo] ) AS [WorkOrderNo] 
						'+ CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(@Prd_Lst1, '')) != 0 THEN ',' + @Prd_LSt1 ELSE '' END +'
						'+ CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(@Final_Lst, '')) != 0 THEN ',' + @Final_Lst ELSE '' END +'
						'+ CASE WHEN LEN(ISNULL(@CNS_Lst1, '')) != 0 THEN ',' + @CNS_Lst1 ELSE '' END +'
						, ISNULL(SUM([TotalBilletProduction]), 0) as [TotalBilletProduction]
					FROM (
						SELECT [WorkOrderNo], '+@Prd_Lst+' FROM (
							SELECT [WorkOrderNo], CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(''Billet'',[MaterialCode]) > 0 THEN ''Billet'' ELSE [MaterialCode] END AS [MaterialCode], [Quantity], [PostingType] FROM [SAP_Posting_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [PostingType] = ''Production'' AND [IsDeleted] = 0
						) AS t 
						PIVOT (SUM([Quantity]) FOR [MaterialCode] IN ('+@PvtLst+')) AS pvt 
						GROUP BY [WorkOrderNo]
					) AS t1 FULL JOIN (
						SELECT [WorkOrderNo], '+@CNS_Lst+' FROM (
							SELECT [WorkOrderNo], CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(''Billet'',[MaterialCode]) > 0 THEN ''Billet'' ELSE [MaterialCode] END AS [MaterialCode], [Quantity], [PostingType] FROM [SAP_Posting_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [PostingType] = ''Consumption'' AND [IsDeleted] = 0
						) AS t 
						PIVOT (SUM([Quantity]) FOR [MaterialCode] IN ('+@PvtLst+')) AS pvt 
						GROUP BY [WorkOrderNo]
					) AS t2 ON t1.[WorkOrderNo] = t2.[WorkOrderNo]
					FULL JOIN (select distinct WorkOrderNo, heatno,  SUM(distinct TotalProduction) AS [TotalBilletProduction] from SAP_Posting_Tbl sp left join CCM_Per_Heat as t2 on sp.[HeatNo] = t2.HeatID where sp.IsDeleted = 0 GROUP BY [HeatNo],[WorkOrderNo]
) AS t3 ON t1.[WorkOrderNo] = t3.[WorkOrderNo]
					GROUP BY COALESCE(t1.[WorkOrderNo], t2.[WorkOrderNo],t3.[WorkOrderNo] )
					';
		print(@sql)
		EXEC(@SQL)
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_SAP_Material_Prod_Cons_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XBatch_SAP_Material_Prod_Cons_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@SQL,@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_ShiftWise_Heat_Summary

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_ShiftWise_Heat_Summary  
**Created On:** 2025-07-14 12:54:18  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:04:22  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @PlantName | varchar(25) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_ShiftWise_Heat_Summary]
    @PlantName = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
	--Created By : Priyanka Makwana
	--Created On : 11-jul-2025
	--Description : Shift Wise Summary Data of ERF, LRF & CCM
	--Exceution : EXEC[XBatch_ShiftWise_Heat_Summary] @PlantName = 'ERF'
	            --EXEC[XBatch_ShiftWise_Heat_Summary] @PlantName = 'LRF'
	            --EXEC[XBatch_ShiftWise_Heat_Summary] @PlantName = 'CCM'

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_ShiftWise_Heat_Summary]
@PlantName VARCHAR(25)
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
		IF(@PlantName = 'ERF')
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
			EntryDatetime,
			ShiftName,
			EAFHeatID,
			TotalBillets,
			NGConsumption,
			OxygenConsumption,
			PowerOnMin,
			PowerOffMin,
			TotalChargeWeight
		FROM [Xstudio_Xneo].[dbo].[EAF_S_Summary_Shift]  
		WHERE CAST(EntryDatetime AS DATE) =  CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
		ORDER BY EntryDatetime;
		END

IF(@PlantName = 'LRF')
BEGIN
	SELECT 
		EntryDatetime,
		ShiftName,
		HeatID
	FROM [Xstudio_Xneo].[dbo].LRF_SUMMARY2_Summary_Shift
	WHERE CAST(EntryDatetime AS DATE) =  CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
	ORDER BY EntryDatetime
END

IF(@PlantName = 'CCM')
BEGIN
	SELECT 
		EntryDatetime,
		ShiftName,
		CCMHEATID,
		BilletsPerHeat
	FROM [Xstudio_Xneo].[dbo].CCM_S_Summary_Shift
	WHERE CAST(EntryDatetime AS DATE) =  CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
	ORDER BY EntryDatetime
END
END
```

DECIMAL(18,4), [Dolo] DECIMAL(18,4), [Injection Carbon] DECIMAL(18,4), [Top Carbon] VARCHAR(50), [Electrode kg] DECIMAL(18,4), [E1] DECIMAL(18,4), [E2] DECIMAL(18,4), [E3] DECIMAL(18,4), [First Temp] VARCHAR(100), [Ladle Loss] VARCHAR(100), [Sec Wt] DECIMAL(18,4), [End Cut Short Length meter] DECIMAL(18,4), [End Cut] VARCHAR(100),  [Tundish Loss] DECIMAL(18,4), [Launder Loss] DECIMAL(18,4), [Scale Loss] DECIMAL(18,4), [Other] DECIMAL(18,4), [Liquid Metal Calc] DECIMAL(18,4), [Caster Yield] DECIMAL(18,4),[Yield (charge to LM)] DECIMAL(18,4), [Yield (Charge to BL)] VARCHAR(50));

```sql
        -- Insert into temp table

            CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)),

			CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)),

			CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)),

            TRY_CAST(CCM.[CasterYield] AS DECIMAL(18,4)),

            TRY_CAST(EAF.[YieldPerHeat] AS DECIMAL(18,4)),
             CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))

            
        FROM EAF_Per_Heat EAF 
        LEFT JOIN SMS_Shift_Operator_Incharge_Selection_Trn_Tbl SMS
            ON EAF.ReportDate = SMS.ReportDate
        LEFT JOIN XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_User_Mst_Tbl SIC
            ON SMS.ShiftInCharge = SIC.ID
        LEFT JOIN XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_User_Mst_Tbl EAFOP
            ON SMS.EAFOperator = EAFOP.ID
        LEFT JOIN XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_User_Mst_Tbl LRFOP
            ON SMS.LRFOperator = LRFOP.ID
        LEFT JOIN CCM_Per_Heat CCM
            ON CCM.HeatID = EAF.HeatID --AND EAF.ReportDate = CCM.ReportDate
        LEFT JOIN LRF_Per_Heat LRF
            ON EAF.HeatID = LRF.HeatID --AND EAF.ReportDate = LRF.ReportDate
		LEFT JOIN SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime PPE
			ON EAF.HeatID = PPE.HeatID
			AND CAST(EAF.ReportDate AS DATE) = CAST(PPE.ReportDate AS DATE)
			AND LTRIM(RTRIM(PPE.[Status])) = 'EAF Tapping'
        LEFT JOIN Heat_chemistry_Quality_Data HCQ
            ON EAF.HeatID = TRY_CAST(HCQ.HeatNo AS INT)
            AND TRY_CAST(HCQ.HeatNo AS INT) IS NOT NULL
            AND LEN(HCQ.HeatNo) = 7 AND IsLatestSample = 1
            AND CCM.ReportDate = HCQ.ReportDate
        LEFT JOIN CCM_Section_Strands CCSS
            ON EAF.HeatID = CCSS.HeatNo
        WHERE EAF.HeatID = @HeatID;

         --UPDATE existing records

            XMES.[ReportDate] = T.[Report Date],

            XMES.[Billet6mwt] = T.[6m billet wt],
            XMES.[TotalBillet] = T.[Total Billet],
            XMES.[Noof87mbillets] = T.[No of 8.7m billets],
            XMES.[Billets87mweight] = T.[8.7 m Billets weight],
            XMES.[LadleLoss] = T.[Ladle Loss],
            XMES.[SecWt] = T.[Sec Wt],
            XMES.[EndCutShortLength] = T.[End Cut Short Length meter],
            XMES.[EndCut] = T.[End Cut],
            XMES.[Tundishloss] = T.[Tundish Loss],
            XMES.[LaunderLoss] = T.[Launder Loss],
            XMES.[Scaleloss] = T.[Scale Loss],
            XMES.[Others] = T.[Other],
            XMES.[LiquidMetalCalc] = T.[Liquid Metal Calc],
            XMES.[CasterYield] = T.[Caster Yield],
            XMES.[YieldChargetoLM] = T.[Yield (charge to LM)],
            XMES.[YieldChargetoBL] = T.[Yield (Charge to BL)]
            
        FROM XBatch_MES_Heat_Tracking XMES
        INNER JOIN #temp T ON XMES.HeatNo = T.[Heat No];

        -- INSERT new records
        INSERT INTO XBatch_MES_Heat_Tracking
        (
            [ReportDate], [HeatNo], [SteelGrade], [Sequence], [ShiftManager], [Melter], [SetupTime], [TappingDuration], [ArcingOFFtime], [TPH], [TapEndTime], [EAFTTTTimeMMSS], [EAFPowerOnTimeMMSS],[PowerOFFtimechecker], [PowerDrawnAvg], [EAFHMS12Ton], [EAFBundleLMSTon], [Bundlewip],[BundleTotal], [RDcut], [RDcutWip], [RDcutTotal], [RMSEndCut], [RMSEndCutWIP], [RMSEndCutTotal], [EAFCopexScrapTon], [CopexscrapWIP], [CopexscrapTotal], [EAFSkullTon], [SkullWIP], [SkullTotal], [PDOScrap], [EAFBriquetteTon], [BriquetteWIP], [BriquetteTotal], [PigIron], [PigIronWIP], [PigIronTotal], [DRI], [DRIWIP], [DRITotal], [HBI], [HBIWIP], [HBITotal], [EAFTotalChargeWeightMT], [LMProdnasperOprn], [EnergyKWH], [AvgPowerDrawn], [ScrapTotal], [Totalo2], [NaturalGas], [EAFBin1LimeConsumptionTon], [EAFBin2DoloConsumptionTon], [EAFCarbonConsumptionKg], [TopCarbonkg], [Electrodekg], [Electrode1], [Electrode2], [Electrode3], [FirstTemp], [Tappingtemp], [TappingCarbon], [N2PPM], [TappingAlingot], [TappingLime], [Flourspar], [EAFLadleAdditionSiMnKg], [EAFLadleAdditionFeSiKg], [TappingHCFeCr], [LcFeCr], [HcFeCr], [LcFeMn], [Nutcoke], [Tappingothercarbon] ,[Gunningkg], [LRFElectrodes], [LFEngineer], [LRFPowerMWH], [LFHoldingTime], [MnRecovery], [SiRecovery], [CacKg], [Spar], [AlIngot], [LRFAdditionLimeKg], [LCC], [LRFAdditionDoloKg], [LRFAdditionSiMnKg], [LRFAdditionFeSiKg], [HCFeMn], [LRFLCFeMn], [LFinTemp], [LiftTemp], [TeemingStart], [TeemingEnd], [CastingTime], [Hour], [CCMTPH], [TundishT1], [TundishT2],[TundishT3], [AvgTemp], [Superheat], [NoofStrands], [Noof140mmBillets], [HotChargeBillets], [Noof130mm12m875mbillets], [Noof87mbillets],  [Billets87mweight],  [CutLength], [Billets103mtr], [Billet117mtr], [Tonnage12m875m], [Noof6mbillets], [Billet6mwt], [TotalBillet], [LadleLoss], [SecWt], [EndCutShortLength], [EndCut], [Tundishloss], [LaunderLoss], [Scaleloss], [Others], [LiquidMetalCalc], [CasterYield], [YieldChargetoLM], [YieldChargetoBL]
        )                                                                                           
        SELECT *
        FROM #temp T
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM XBatch_MES_Heat_Tracking XMES
            WHERE XMES.[HeatNo] = T.[Heat No]
        );


         -- SELECT * FROM #temp
        DROP TABLE #temp;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : XBatch_SMS_Heat_Tracking_Daily_Production_Data | Line : ' + CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR) + ' | Message : ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();

        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='HeatTracking SP',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace='',@UserID='', @HostAddress='', @Info='', @Source='T-SQL';RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH

END
```
