## dbo.XBatch_SMS_MES_Delay_Dashboard_SP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_SMS_MES_Delay_Dashboard_SP  
**Created On:** 2026-05-02 09:06:44  
**Modified On:** 2026-05-19 09:15:30  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_SMS_MES_Delay_Dashboard_SP];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------------------*/
-- Created by : Priyanka Makwana
-- Created on : 02-May-2026
-- Description : Dump all the SMS MES Delay Dashboard Data into Single table.
-- Execute : EXEC [XBatch_SMS_MES_Delay_Dashboard_SP] 
/*--------------------------------*/
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_SMS_MES_Delay_Dashboard_SP]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
    
    DECLARE @StartDate DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()),1,1)
    DECLARE @EndDate   DATE = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

    
    -- COMBINED TABLE


    CREATE TABLE #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName VARCHAR(100), TodayDate DATE, MTD_Start DATETIME, YTD_Start DATETIME, ReportDay DATE, StageDate DATE, EntryDate DATE, HeatDate DATE, ReportDate DATE, EventDate DATE, HeatNo VARCHAR(100), Grade VARCHAR(100), Category VARCHAR(500), Stage VARCHAR(100), HeatClass VARCHAR(100), MTD_DelayHours DECIMAL(18,2), YTD_DelayHours DECIMAL(18,2), Total_DelayHours DECIMAL(18,2), CycleTime_Actual DECIMAL(18,2), CycleTime_Target DECIMAL(18,2), DelayPercent DECIMAL(18,2), AvgPowerOnTime DECIMAL(18,2), TTT_CalendarTimePerHeat DECIMAL(18,2), HeatsPerDay DECIMAL(18,2), DelayEvents INT, HeatsWithDelay INT, TotalHeats INT,
        HeatsWithoutDelay INT, DelayedHeatsPct DECIMAL(18,2), TapToTapTime DECIMAL(18,2), ProductionTons DECIMAL(18,2), AvgDurationSeconds DECIMAL(18,2), DelayMin DECIMAL(18,2), DelayCount INT, DelayHours DECIMAL(18,2), CycleTimeMin DECIMAL(18,2), DelayPctOfCycle DECIMAL(18,2), AvgTon DECIMAL(18,2), Heats INT, EquipmentID VARCHAR(100), [Status] VARCHAR(500), DurationMMSS VARCHAR(100), DurationinMinutes DECIMAL(18,2), StateSequence INT, Details VARCHAR(MAX), StartTime DATETIME, EndTime DATETIME
    );


    -- RESULT SET 1 : KPI SUMMARY


    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        TodayDate,
        MTD_Start,
        YTD_Start,
        MTD_DelayHours,
        YTD_DelayHours,
        Total_DelayHours,
        CycleTime_Actual,
        CycleTime_Target,
        DelayPercent,
        AvgPowerOnTime,
        TTT_CalendarTimePerHeat,
        HeatsPerDay,
        DelayEvents,
        HeatsWithDelay,
        TotalHeats,
        HeatsWithoutDelay,
        DelayedHeatsPct
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 1 : KPI SUMMARY',

        CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE),
        @StartDate,
        @StartDate,

        ROUND(ISNULL((
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/3600.0
            FROM ShiftDelayEntry
            WHERE IsDeleted = 0
            AND AreaName = 'SMS'
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),2),

        ROUND(ISNULL((
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/3600.0
            FROM ShiftDelayEntry
            WHERE IsDeleted = 0
            AND AreaName = 'SMS'
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),2),

        ROUND(ISNULL((
            SELECT SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/3600.0
            FROM ShiftDelayEntry
            WHERE IsDeleted = 0
            AND AreaName = 'SMS'
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),2),

        ROUND(ISNULL((
            SELECT AVG(ISNULL(FTDton,0))
            FROM SMS_Production_Summary
            WHERE isdeleted = 0
            AND particulars = 'Cycle Time'
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),2),

        52,

        ROUND(ISNULL((
            SELECT AVG(ISNULL(FTDPercentage,0))
            FROM SMS_Production_Summary
            WHERE isdeleted = 0
            AND particulars = 'Total Delays + Std Delays'
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),2),

        ROUND(ISNULL((
            SELECT AVG(ISNULL(FTDTOn,0))
            FROM SMS_Production_Summary
            WHERE isdeleted = 0
            AND particulars = 'Avg Power ON Time'
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),2),

        ROUND(ISNULL((
            SELECT AVG(ISNULL(FTDTOn,0))
            FROM SMS_Production_Summary
            WHERE isdeleted = 0
            AND particulars = 'TTT (Calendar Time/Heat)'
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),2),

        ROUND(ISNULL((
            SELECT AVG(ISNULL(FTDTOn,0))
            FROM SMS_Production_Summary
            WHERE isdeleted = 0
            AND particulars = 'Total SMS Heats Tap'
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),2),

        ISNULL((
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
            WHERE CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),

        ISNULL((
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
            FROM ShiftDelayEntry
            WHERE IsDeleted = 0
            AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),

        ISNULL((
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
            FROM XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw
            WHERE CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
            BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        ),0),

        (
            ISNULL((
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                FROM XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw
                WHERE CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
                BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
            ),0)

            -

            ISNULL((
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                FROM ShiftDelayEntry
                WHERE IsDeleted = 0
                AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
                BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
            ),0)
        ),

        ROUND(
            CAST(
                100.0 *

                ISNULL((
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                    FROM ShiftDelayEntry
                    WHERE IsDeleted = 0
                    AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
                    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
                ),0)

                /

                NULLIF((
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                    FROM XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw
                    WHERE CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
                    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
                ),0)

            AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        ,2)

    -- RESULT SET 2 : DAILY TREND
    

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        ReportDay,
        DelayPercent,
        TapToTapTime,
        HeatsPerDay,
        ProductionTons
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 2 : DAILY TREND',

        CAST(ReportDate AS DATE),

        ROUND(AVG(ISNULL(
            CASE
                WHEN particulars = 'Total Delays + Std Delays'
                THEN FTDPercentage
            END,0)),2),

        ROUND(AVG(ISNULL(
            CASE
                WHEN particulars = 'TTT (Calendar Time/Heat)'
                THEN FTDTon
            END,0)),2),

        ROUND(AVG(ISNULL(
            CASE
                WHEN particulars = 'Total SMS Heats Tap'
                THEN FTDTon
            END,0)),2),

        ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(
            CASE
                WHEN particulars = 'Total Prime Production'
                THEN FTDTon
            END,0)),2)

    FROM SMS_Production_Summary

    WHERE isdeleted = 0
    AND CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

    GROUP BY CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)


   
    -- RESULT SET 3 : EAF STAGE TIMES
   

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        Stage,
        StageDate,
        AvgDurationSeconds
    )
       SELECT
        'RESULT SET 3 : EAF STAGE TIMES',
        'Scrap Charging',
        CAST(StartTime AS DATE),
        ROUND(AVG(ISNULL(Duration,0)),2)

    FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime

    WHERE status = 'EAF Roof Open For Fill Bucket Charging'
    AND CAST(StartTime AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

    GROUP BY CAST(StartTime AS DATE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 3 : EAF STAGE TIMES',
        'Power-On',
        CAST(ReportDate AS DATE),
        ROUND(AVG(ISNULL(PoweronTimeTotalSeconds,0)),2)

    FROM eaf_per_heat

    WHERE CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

    GROUP BY CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)

    
    -- RESULT SET 4 : DELAY BY TYPE
    

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        EntryDate,
        Category,
        DelayMin,
        DelayCount,
        DelayHours
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 4 : DELAY BY TYPE',

        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),

        ISNULL(DelayType_DelayType,'Uncategorized'),

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/60.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1)),

        COUNT(*),

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/3600.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1))

    FROM XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    WHERE CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        ISNULL(DelayType_DelayType,'Uncategorized');

    
    -- RESULT SET 5 : DELAY BY SUBTYPE
   

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        EntryDate,
        Category,
        DelayMin,
        DelayCount,
        DelayHours
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 5 : DELAY BY SUBTYPE',

        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),

        ISNULL(DelayType_DelayType,'Uncategorized'),

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/60.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1)),

        COUNT(*),

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/3600.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1))

    FROM XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    WHERE CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        ISNULL(DelayType_DelayType,'Uncategorized');

    
    -- RESULT SET 6 : DELAY BY AGENCY
    

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        EntryDate,
        Category,
        DelayMin,
        DelayCount,
        DelayHours
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 6 : DELAY BY AGENCY',

        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),

        ISNULL(DelayAgency_Name,'Uncategorized'),

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/60.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1)),

        COUNT(*),

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/3600.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1))

    FROM XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    WHERE CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        ISNULL(DelayAgency_Name,'Uncategorized');

    
    -- RESULT SET 7 : DELAY BY EQUIPMENT
   

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        EntryDate,
        Category,
        DelayMin,
        DelayCount,
        DelayHours
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 7 : DELAY BY EQUIPMENT',

        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),

        CASE
            WHEN (Equipment IS NULL OR Equipment = '')
             AND (SubEquipment IS NULL OR SubEquipment = '')
            THEN 'Uncategorized'

            WHEN (SubEquipment IS NULL OR SubEquipment = '')
            THEN Equipment

            ELSE Equipment + ' - ' + SubEquipment
        END,

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/60.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1)),

        COUNT(*),

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/3600.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1))

    FROM XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    WHERE CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),

        CASE
            WHEN (Equipment IS NULL OR Equipment = '')
             AND (SubEquipment IS NULL OR SubEquipment = '')
            THEN 'Uncategorized'

            WHEN (SubEquipment IS NULL OR SubEquipment = '')
            THEN Equipment

            ELSE Equipment + ' - ' + SubEquipment
        END;

    
    -- RESULT SET 8 : HEAT LEVEL CYCLE TIME VS DELAY
    

    WITH process_sum AS
    (
        SELECT
            HeatNo,
            MIN(CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)) AS HeatDate,
            CAST(SUM(DurationinMinutes) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS CycleTimeMin
        FROM XStudio_List_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_vw
        WHERE CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
        BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        GROUP BY HeatNo
    ),
    delay_sum AS
    (
        SELECT
            HeatNo,
            CAST(SUM(DATEDIFF(SECOND, DelayStartTime, DelayEndTime))/60.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS DelayMin,
            COUNT(*) AS DelayCount
        FROM XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
        WHERE CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)
        BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
        GROUP BY HeatNo
    )

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        HeatDate,
        HeatNo,
        CycleTimeMin,
        DelayMin,
        DelayCount,
        DelayPctOfCycle
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 8 : HEAT LEVEL CYCLE TIME VS DELAY',

        p.HeatDate,
        p.HeatNo,
        p.CycleTimeMin,

        ISNULL(d.DelayMin,0),

        ISNULL(d.DelayCount,0),

        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN p.CycleTimeMin > 0
                THEN ISNULL(d.DelayMin,0) * 100.0 / p.CycleTimeMin
                ELSE 0
            END
        AS DECIMAL(18,2))

    FROM process_sum p
    LEFT JOIN delay_sum d
    ON p.HeatNo = d.HeatNo
    WHERE CAST(p.HeatDate AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate


    
    -- RESULT SET 9 : ALL HEATS BY DELAY
    

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        EntryDate,
        HeatNo,
        DelayMin,
        DelayCount,
        Grade
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 9 : ALL HEATS BY DELAY',

        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),

        HeatNo,

        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond,0))/60.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1)),

        COUNT(*),

        ISNULL(MAX(Grade),'')

    FROM XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    WHERE HeatNo IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        HeatNo;

   
    -- RESULT SET 10 : GRADE VS DELAY
   

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        ReportDate,
        Grade,
        DelayMin,
        Heats
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 10 : GRADE VS DELAY',

        CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE),

        c.Grade,

        ROUND(
            ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(s.DelayInSecond,0))/60.0,0)
        ,2),

        COUNT(DISTINCT c.HeatNo)

    FROM XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw c

    LEFT JOIN XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw s
    ON s.HeatNo = c.HeatNo
    WHERE CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

    GROUP BY
        CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE),
        c.Grade;

    
    -- RESULT SET 11 : DELAYED VS NON-DELAYED HEAT QUALITY
    

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        ReportDate,
        HeatClass,
        AvgTon,
        Heats
    )
    
        SELECT
        'RESULT SET 11 : DELAYED VS NON-DELAYED HEAT QUALITY',

        CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE),

        CASE
            WHEN d.HeatNo IS NULL THEN 'No Delay'

            ELSE 'Delayed'
        END,

        ROUND(AVG(ISNULL(c.TotalPostedBilletWeightTon,0)),2),

        COUNT(*)

    FROM XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw c
   

    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT HeatNo
        FROM ShiftDelayEntry
        WHERE IsDeleted = 0
        
    ) d
    ON c.HeatNo = d.HeatNo
     WHERE CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

    GROUP BY
        CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE),

        CASE
            WHEN d.HeatNo IS NULL THEN 'No Delay'
            ELSE 'Delayed'
        END;

    
    -- RESULT SET 12 : PROCESS EVENT DETAIL
   

    INSERT INTO #FinalOutput
    (
        ResultSetName,
        HeatNo,
        EventDate,
        ReportDate,
        StartTime,
        EndTime,
        EquipmentID,
        [Status],
        DurationMMSS,
        DurationinMinutes,
        StateSequence,
        Details
    )
    SELECT
        'RESULT SET 12 : PROCESS EVENT DETAIL',

        vw.HeatNo,
        CAST(vw.ReportDate AS DATE),
        vw.ReportDate,
        vw.StartTime,
        vw.EndTime,
        vw.EquipmentID,
        vw.[Status],
        vw.DurationMMSS,
        vw.DurationinMinutes,
        vw.StateSequence,
        vw.Details

    FROM XStudio_List_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_vw vw
    WHERE CAST(vw.ReportDate AS DATE)
    BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

    
    -- FINAL OUTPUT
    

    SELECT *
    FROM #FinalOutput
    ORDER BY
        ISNULL(ReportDate,
        ISNULL(EntryDate,
        ISNULL(StageDate,
        ISNULL(HeatDate,
        ReportDay)))) DESC;

    DROP TABLE #FinalOutput;

    END TRY
    
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : XBatch_SMS_MES_Delay_Dashboard_SP | Line : ' + CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS VARCHAR) + ' | Message : ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();

        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='MES Delay Dashboard SP',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace='',@UserID='', @HostAddress='', @Info='', @Source='T-SQL';RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH

END
```

## dbo.XBatch_SMS_Production_Details_ForTheDay_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_SMS_Production_Details_ForTheDay_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-10-11 10:46:08  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-12 14:57:17  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 10-Oct-2025
	Description : Implement Procedure to get Production data Pivot
--------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_SMS_Production_Details_ForTheDay_Usp]-- '07-OCt-2025'
(/*DECLARE */@ReportDate DATE/* = '07-Oct-2025'--*/)
AS 
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	/*--Variable Declaration--*/
	DECLARE @PivotLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SelLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @BstdtLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @BstMntLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @FTDTonLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @FTDPerLSt NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @MTDTonLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @MTDPerLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	BEGIN TRY
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl') IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			DROP TABLE #tbl;
		END
		CREATE TABLE #Tbl ([Particulars] VARCHAR(MAX), [BestMonth] DECIMAL(18, 4), [BestDay] DECIMAL(18, 4), [FTDTon] DECIMAL(18, 4), [FTDPercentage] DECIMAL(18, 4), [MTDTon] DECIMAL(18, 4), [MTDPercentage] DECIMAL(18, 4));

		/*--Store FTD and MTD related data of Particular--*/
		INSERT INTO #Tbl
		SELECT SPS.[Particulars]
			, CASE WHEN PM.[SrNo] BETWEEN 8 AND 17 THEN CAST([BestMonth] AS FLOAT) / CAST(100.0 AS FLOAT) ELSE [BestMonth] END AS [BestMonth]
			, CASE WHEN PM.[SrNo] BETWEEN 8 AND 17 /*OR PM.[SrNo] = 51 */ THEN CAST([BestDay] AS FLOAT) / CAST(100.0 AS FLOAT) ELSE [BestDay] END AS [BestDay]
			, CASE WHEN PM.[SrNo] BETWEEN 8 AND 17 THEN CAST([FTDTon] AS FLOAT) / CAST(100.0 AS FLOAT) ELSE [FTDTon] END AS [FTDTon]
			, CASE WHEN PM.[SrNo] BETWEEN 38 AND 52 THEN CAST([FTDPercentage] AS FLOAT) / CAST(100.0 AS FLOAT) ELSE [FTDPercentage] END AS [FTDPercentage]
			, CASE WHEN PM.[SrNo] BETWEEN 8 AND 17 THEN CAST([MTDTon] AS FLOAT) / CAST(100.0 AS FLOAT) ELSE [MTDTon] END AS [MTDTon]
			, CASE WHEN PM.[SrNo] BETWEEN 38 AND 52 THEN CAST([MTDPercentage] AS FLOAT) / CAST(100.0 AS FLOAT) ELSE [MTDPercentage] END AS [MTDPercentage] 
		FROM [SMS_Production_Summary] as SPS WITH(NOLOCK) 
		JOIN [Particulars_Masters] AS PM WITH(NOLOCK) ON SPS.[Particulars] = PM.[Particulars]
		WHERE SPS.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND PM.[IsDeleted] = 0 
			AND SPS.[Particulars] NOT IN ('Best Day Data','Best Month Data') AND SPS.[ReportDate] = @ReportDate;
		--SELECT * FROM #Tbl
		/*--Set Pivot and Select Column List--*/
		SELECT @PivotLst = STUFF((SELECT ',[' + [Particulars] +']' FROM [dbo].[Particulars_Masters] AS PM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Particulars] NOT IN ('Best Day Data', 'Best Month Data') ORDER BY [srNo] FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,'');

		SELECT @SelLst = STUFF((SELECT ', BSTMnt.['+[Particulars]+' BestMonth], BstDt.['+[Particulars]+' BestDay], FTon.[' + [Particulars] +' FTD Ton], FPer.['+[Particulars]+' FTD Percentage], MTon.['+[Particulars]+' MTD Ton], MPer.['+[Particulars]+' MTD Percentage]' FROM [dbo].[Particulars_Masters] AS PM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Particulars] NOT IN ('Best Day Data', 'Best Month Data') ORDER BY [srNo] FOR XML PATH('')), 1,1, '')
		SELECT @BstdtLst = STUFF((SELECT ',ISNULL(SUM([' + [Particulars] +']), 0) AS ['+[Particulars]+' BestDay]' FROM [dbo].[Particulars_Masters] AS PM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Particulars] NOT IN ('Best Day Data','Best Month Data') ORDER BY [srNo] FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,'')
		--SELECT @PivotLst, @SelectLst 

		
		SET @BstMntLst = REPLACE(@BstdtLst, ' BestDay', ' BestMonth');
		
		SET @FTDTonLst = REPLACE(@BstdtLst, ' BestDay', ' FTD Ton');
		
		SET @FTDPerLSt = REPLACE(@BstdtLst, ' BestDay', ' FTD Percentage');
		
		SET @MTDTonLst = REPLACE(@BstdtLst, ' BestDay', ' MTD Ton');
	
		SET @MTDPerLst = REPLACE(@BstdtLst, ' BestDay', ' MTD Percentage');
	

		/*---Get Target Data--*/
		SET @SQL = '		
		SELECT '+@SelLst+'
		FROM (SELECT '+@BstdtLst+' FROM #tbl PIVOT (SUM([BestDay]) FOR [Particulars] IN ('+@PivotLst+')) AS pvt) AS bstdt
		CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@BstMntLst+' FROM #tbl PIVOT (SUM([BestMonth]) FOR [Particulars] IN ('+@PivotLst+')) AS pvt) AS bstmnt
		CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@FTDTonLst+' FROM #tbl PIVOT (SUM([FTDTon]) FOR [Particulars] IN ('+@PivotLst+')) AS pvt) AS Fton
		CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@FTDPerLSt+' FROM #tbl PIVOT (SUM([FTDPercentage]) FOR [Particulars] IN ('+@PivotLst+')) AS pvt) AS FPer
		CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@MTDTonLst+' FROM #tbl PIVOT (SUM([MTDTon]) FOR [Particulars] IN ('+@PivotLst+')) AS pvt) AS MTon
		CROSS JOIN (SELECT '+@MTDPerLst+' FROM #tbl PIVOT (SUM([MTDPercentage]) FOR [Particulars] IN ('+@PivotLst+')) AS pvt) AS MPer
		'
		--SELECT @SQL
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL,N'@ReportDate DATE', @ReportDate;
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl') IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			DROP TABLE #tbl;
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tbl') IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			DROP TABLE #tbl;
		END
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XBatch_SMS_Production_Details_ForTheDay_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XBatch_SMS_Production_Details_ForTheDay_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@SQL,@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END

    

--[XBatch_SMS_Production_Details_ForTheDay_Usp] '07-OCt-2025'
--[SP_SMS_Producation_Summary] '05-OCt-2025'
```

**Schema:** dbo

**Modified On:** 2025-11-25 15:19:25  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Xbatch_SMS_WorkOrder_Wise_Consumption_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 2025-11-25
-- Description:	Work Order Wise Consumption
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE Xbatch_SMS_WorkOrder_Wise_Consumption_Usp 
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
  
	-- EAF: Scrap & Bin consumptions to Material / Qty rows
    SELECT 
        WO.Name        AS WorkOrder,
        v.MaterialName AS Material,
        SUM(v.Qty)     AS Qty,
        v.Unit         AS Unit
    FROM Xstudio_xbatch..EAF_PER_HEAT EAF WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN Xstudio_xbatch..XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON EAF.WorkOrder = WO.ID 
       AND WO.IsDeleted = 0
    CROSS APPLY (VALUES
        ('Copex Scrap',           CopexScrap, 'Ton'),
        ('Bundle LMS',            BundleLMS, 'Ton'),
        ('HMS 1',                 HMS1, 'Ton'),
        ('HMS 1 2',                HMS12, 'Ton'),
        ('EndCuts',              EndCuts, 'Ton'),
        ('Scull',                Scull, 'Ton'),
        ('BIN 1 Lime Consumption',  BIN1LimeConsumption, 'Ton'),
        ('BIN 2 Dolo Consumption',  BIN2DoloConsumption, 'Ton'),
        ('BIN 3 Consumption',      BIN3Consumption, 'Ton'),
        ('BIN 4 Consumption',      BIN4Consumption, 'Ton'),
        ('Ladle Addition Dolo',    LadleAdditionDolo, 'Kg'),
        ('Ladle Addition Lime',    LadleAdditionLime, 'Kg'),
        ('Ladle Addition FeSi',    LadleAdditionFeSi, 'Kg'),
        ('Ladle Addition SiMn',    LadleAdditionSiMn, 'Kg'),
        ('Ladle Addition SiMnn',   LadleAdditionSiMnn, 'Kg')
    ) v(MaterialName, Qty, Unit)
	Where Qty>0
    GROUP BY WO.Name, v.MaterialName, v.Unit

-- LRF: Ladle additions to Material / Qty rows
	UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        WO.Name        AS WorkOrder,
        v.MaterialName AS Material,
        SUM(v.Qty)     AS Qty,
        v.Unit         AS Unit
    FROM Xstudio_xbatch..LRF_Per_Heat LRF WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN Xstudio_xbatch..XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON LRF.WorkOrder = WO.ID
       AND WO.IsDeleted = 0
    CROSS APPLY (VALUES
        ('Alloy Addition Lime',  Lime, 'Kg'),
        ('Alloy Addition Dolo',  Dolo, 'Kg'),
        ('Alloy Addition FeSi',  FeSi, 'Kg'),
        ('Alloy Addition SiMn',  SiMn, 'Kg'),
        ('Alloy Addition SiMnn', SiMnn, 'Kg')
    ) v(MaterialName, Qty, Unit)
	Where Qty>0
    GROUP BY WO.Name, v.MaterialName, v.Unit

END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani 
-- Create date: 06-06-2025
-- Description:	Update Formula Detials 
-- =============================================

CREATE     PROc [dbo].[XBatch_U_Formula_Details_USP]
(
	@ID	varchar(36),
	@FormulaName VARCHAR(100),
	@ItemNumber	Varchar(100),
	@Unit	Varchar(36),
	@Quantity	decimal(18,4),
	@QuantityType	Varchar(100),
	@Description	Varchar(max),
	@Isenabled	bit,
	@MinQuantity decimal(18,4),
	@MaxQuantity decimal(18,4),
	@UserID		varchar(36)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIn TRY
		IF (@trancount=0)
		BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		ELSE 
		SAVE TRANSACTION Formula_Dtl_U;

		DECLARE @FormulaID	VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @ItemID VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @UnitID	VARCHAR(36);

		SELECT @ItemID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Number]=@ItemNumber;

		SELECT @UnitID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Unit;

		SELECT @UnitID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@FormulaName;

		UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl]
		   SET [ParentID] = @FormulaID
			  ,[ModifiedBy] = @UserID
			  ,[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
			  ,[Source] = 'T-SQL'
			  ,[MaterialID] = @ItemID
			  ,[UnitID] = @UnitID
			  ,[Quantity] = @Quantity
			  ,[QuantityType] = @QuantityType
			  ,[Description] = @Description
			  ,[IsEnabled] = @IsEnabled
			  ,[MinQuantity] = @MinQuantity
			  ,[MaxQuantity] = @MaxQuantity
		 WHERE [ID] = @ID ;
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
	BEGIn CATCh
		DECLARE @xstate int;
		select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Formula_Dtl_U;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_U_Formula_Details_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCh
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani 
-- Create date: 06-06-2025
-- Description:	Update Material Master
-- =============================================

CREATE     PROc [dbo].[XBatch_U_Material_USP]
(
	@ID					VARCHAR(36),
	@Name				VARCHAR(100),
	@Type				VARCHAR(100),
	@Unit				VARCHAR(100),
	@Number				VARCHAR(100),
	@Stocktype			VARCHAR(100),
	@Quantity			DECIMAL(18,4),
	@Description		VARCHAR(MAX),
	@IsEnabled			BIT,
	@CanExpire			BIT,
	@ExpireDays			INT,
	@MinInventorylevel	DECIMAL(18,4),
	@MaxOrderSize		DECIMAL(18,4),
	@LotNumberFormat	VARCHAR(100),
	@SubLotNumberFormat	VARCHAR(100),
	@UserID				VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIn
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET XACT_ABORT ON

	DECLARE @trancount INT;
	SET @trancount = @@TRANCOUNT;

	BEGIn TRY
		IF (@trancount=0)
		BEGIN TRANSACTION 
		ELSE 
		SAVE TRANSACTION Materail_U;

		DECLARE @TypeID	VARCHAR(36);
		DECLARE @UnitID	VARCHAR(36);

		SELECT @TypeID=[ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Type_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Type;

		SELECT @UnitID=[ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]=@Unit;

		IF @IsEnabled IS NULL SET @IsEnabled = 0;
		IF @CanExpire IS NULL SET @CanExpire = 0;
		IF @Stocktype IS NULL SET @Stocktype = 'Bulk';


		UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl]
		SET [Name] = @Name
			,[ModifiedBy] = @UserID
			,[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
			,[Source] = 'T-SQL'
			,[TypeID] = @TypeID
			,[UnitID] = @UnitID
			,[Number] = @Number
			,[StockType] = @Stocktype
			,[Quantity] = @Quantity
			,[Description] = @Description
			,[IsEnabled] = @IsEnabled
			,[CanExpire] = @CanExpire
			,[ExpireDays] = @ExpireDays
			,[MinInventoryLevel] = @MinInventorylevel
			,[MaxOrderSize] = @MaxOrderSize
			,[LotNumberFormat] = @LotNumberFormat
			,[SubLotNumberFormat] = @SubLotNumberFormat
		WHERE [ID]=@ID;
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
	END TRY
	BEGIn CATCh
		DECLARE @xstate int;
		select @xstate = XACT_STATE();
		IF @xstate = -1
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount = 0
			ROLLBACK;
		IF @xstate = 1 and @trancount > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION Materail_U;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_U_Material_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCh
ENd
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Vikesh Ramani
```

## dbo.XBatch_WO_Create_Batch_AI_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_WO_Create_Batch_AI_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:27  
**Modified On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:27  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_WO_Create_Batch_AI_Usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_WO_Create_Batch_AI_Usp]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	
AS
BEGIN

BEGIN TRY
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	DECLARE @WOID			VARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @WO_Quantity	DECIMAL(18,2);
	DECLARE @RecipeID		VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @ProcessCellID	VARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @ProcessTime	INT;
	DECLARE @Position		VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @Version		VARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @UnitID			VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @PRO_Capacity	DECIMAL(18,2);
	DECLARE @Ava_Capacity	DECIMAL(18,2);
	DECLARE @remaining		INT;
	DECLARE @currentCapacity INT;
	DECLARE @CID			VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @closest		INT;
	DECLARE @closestID		varchar(36);
	DECLARE @index			INT;
	DECLARE @capacitycount	INT; 
	DECLARE @PID			VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @PCapacity		INT
	DECLARE @PSTIME			DATETIME;
	DECLARE @PETIME			DATETIME;
	DECLARE @BNAME			VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @ID				VARCHAR(36)

	TRUNCATE TABLE XBatch_AI_Batch_Mst_Tbl;
	 
	CREATE TABLE #capacities (id int Identity(1,1),[ProcessCellID] varchar(36), capacity int,[NextAvailableTime] Datetime);
	CREATE TABLE #result ([ProcessCellID] varchar(36),Capacity INT);
	
	DECLARE Work_order CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
	SELECT 
		STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),WO.[ID]),',') AS [WOID],SUM(Wo.[Quantity]) AS [WO_Quantity],RM.[ID] As [RecipeID],RM.[ProcessCellID],RM.[ProcessTime],RM.[Position],RM.[Version],MMT.[UnitID]
	From [dbo].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] AS WO WITH(NOLOCK)
	JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Recipe_Mst_Tbl] AS RM WITH(NOLOCK) On RM.[MaterialID]=WO.[ITEMID]
	JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[ID]=RM.[MaterialID]
 	WHERE WO.[Status]='New' AND WO.[IsDeleted]=0 AND RM.[IsDeleted]=0 AND MMT.[IsDeleted]=0
	GROUP BY RM.[ID],RM.[ProcessCellID],RM.[ProcessTime],RM.[Position],RM.[Version],MMT.[UnitID]

	OPEN Work_order;

	FETCH NEXT FROM Work_order INTO @WOID,@WO_Quantity,@RecipeID,@ProcessCellID,@ProcessTime,@Position,@Version,@UnitID;

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
	BEGIN

		TRUNCATE TABLE #capacities;
		TRUNCATE TABLE #result;

		 SET @remaining= @WO_Quantity;

		INSERT INTO #capacities ([ProcessCellID],[capacity],[NextAvailableTime])
		SELECT [ID],[Capacity],isnull([NextAvailableTime],GETDATE()) from XBatch_Process_Cell_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID IN(Select value from string_split(@ProcessCellID,',')) And Status='Available';
		
		SET @capacitycount = (select count(*) from #capacities);
		SET @index =1;

		while @remaining >= (select MAX(capacity) from #capacities)
		BEGIN
			SET @currentCapacity =NULL;
			SET @CID=NULL;
			select @currentCapacity=capacity,@CID=[ProcessCellID] from #capacities where id=@index;

			insert into #result values (@CID,@currentCapacity)
			set @remaining-=@currentCapacity

			SET @index +=1;

			IF @index > @capacitycount 
			BEGIN
				SET @index=1;
			END
		ENd
		IF(@remaining >0)
		BEGIn
			SET @closest = NULL;
			SET @closestID = NULL;
			SElect top 1 @closestID=[ProcessCellID],@closest=capacity
			FROM #capacities
			ORDER BY abs(capacity- @remaining);

			INSERT into #result values(@closestID,@remaining);
		ENd

		
		SET @PSTIME=NULL;
		SET @PETIME =NULL;
		SET @PID=NULL;
		SET @PCapacity=NULL;
		DECLARE Bactch_Create CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
		SELECT ProcessCellID,Capacity FROM #RESULT
		
		OPEN Bactch_Create;

		FETCH NEXT FROM Bactch_Create INTO @PID,@PCapacity;

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
		BEGIn
			
			--IF EXISTS(Select 1 FROM XBatch_AI_Batch_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ProcessCellID]=@PID)
			--BEGIN
			--	SET @PSTIME=(Select TOP 1 [EndTime] FROM [XBatch_AI_Batch_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ProcessCellID]=@PID ORDER BY [StartTime] DESC );
			--END
			--ELSE
			--BEGIn
			--	SET @PSTIME= ISNULL((SELECT [NextAvailableTime] FROM [XBatch_Process_Cell_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)WHERE [ID]=@PID AND [IsDeleted]=0),GETDATE());
			--END

			--SET @ID=NEWID()
			--SET @PETIME=DATEADD(MINUTE,@ProcessTime,@PSTIME);
			
			--SET @BNAME ='BATCH-'+Convert(varchar,DATEDIFF_BIG(MILLISECOND,'1970-01-01',SYSUTCDATETIME()));
			
			--INSERT INTO XBatch_AI_Batch_Mst_Tbl([ID],[Name],[ParentID],[BatchNumber],[BatchMode],[ProcessCellID],[Quantity],[QuantityUnitID],[StartTime],[EndTime],[StatusID],[Version],[Position])
			--SELECT @ID,@BNAME,@RecipeID,@BNAME,'Auto',@PID,@PCapacity,@UnitID,@PSTIME,@PETIME,(SELECT TOP 1 [ID] FROM [XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Name] = 'Scheduled' AND [IsDeleted]=0),@Version,@Position
			
			FETCH NEXT FROM Bactch_Create INTO @PID,@PCapacity;
		ENd
		CLOSE Bactch_Create;
		DEALLOCATE Bactch_Create;

		UPDATE XBatch_Process_Cell_Mst_Tbl SET ModifiedOn=GETDATE(),[Status]='Ocuppied'
		WHERE ID IN (SELECT ProcessCellID FROM #result);

		UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] SET [ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Status]='Ready'
		WHERE ID IN (SELECT [Value] FROM string_split(@WOID,','));

		FETCH NEXT FROM Work_order INTO @WOID,@WO_Quantity,@RecipeID,@ProcessCellID,@ProcessTime,@Position,@Version,@UnitID;
	END
	CLOSE Work_order;
	DEALLOCATE Work_order;

	
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL', 'Bactch_Create') >= -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE Bactch_Create;
			DEALLOCATE Bactch_Create;
		END	

		IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL', 'Work_order') >= -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE Work_order;
			DEALLOCATE Work_order;
		END	
		
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_Create_Batch_From_Manufacturing_Order_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)
    END CATCH

END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria
-- Create date: 10-04-2025
-- Description:	Used to generate batches from wo screen
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_WO_Create_Batch_Usp]
	@BatchList AS [dbo].[BatchToGenerate] READONLY,
	@UserID VARCHAR(36),
	@WorkOrderID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN TRY

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--SET XACT_ABORT ON;

	BEGIN TRANSACTION;
	---------- batch cursor related variable ----------
	DECLARE @BatchNumber VARCHAR(100), @ProcessCellID VARCHAR(36), @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME, @Quantity DECIMAL(18,2), 
	@QuantityUnitID VARCHAR(36), @RecipeID VARCHAR(36);

	DECLARE Batch_Cursor CURSOR
	FOR
	SELECT BatchNumber, ProcessCellID, StartTime, EndTime, Quantity, QuantityUnitID, RecipeID  FROM @BatchList
	
	OPEN Batch_Cursor;
	
		FETCH NEXT FROM Batch_Cursor INTO @BatchNumber, @ProcessCellID, @StartTime, @EndTime, @Quantity, @QuantityUnitID, @RecipeID
	
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
		BEGIN
			
			DECLARE @BatchID VARCHAR(36) = NEWID();
			DECLARE @StatusID VARCHAR(36);
			DECLARE @Version VARCHAR(100);
			DECLARE @Position VARCHAR(100);

			---------- Get scheduled status id from status master table ----------
			SELECT @StatusID = ID FROM XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl WHERE Name = 'Created'

			---------- Get version and position from recipe master table ----------
			SELECT @Version = Version, @Position = Position FROM XBatch_Recipe_Mst_Tbl WHERE ID = @RecipeID

			---------- Insert record to batch master table ----------
			INSERT INTO XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl 
				([ID],[Name],[ParentID],[CreatedBy],[CreatedOn],[Source],[BatchNumber],[BatchMode],[ProcessCellID]
				,[Quantity],[QuantityUnitID],[StartTime],[EndTime],[StatusID],[Version],[Position],[ApprovedBy],[ApprovedOn],[ScheduledBy],[ScheduledOn],[WorkOrderID]) 
			VALUES
				(@BatchID, @BatchNumber, @RecipeID, @UserID, GETDATE(), 'System', @BatchNumber, 'Manual', @ProcessCellID, 
				@Quantity, @QuantityUnitID, @StartTime, @EndTime,@StatusID, @Version, @Position, @UserID, GETDATE(), @UserID, GETDATE(), @WorkOrderID);
			
			---------- Generate entries of sub table from batch id ----------
			EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_Create_Batch_Usp] @BatchID;

			FETCH NEXT FROM Batch_Cursor INTO @BatchNumber, @ProcessCellID, @StartTime, @EndTime, @Quantity, @QuantityUnitID, @RecipeID
		END
	CLOSE Batch_Cursor;
	DEALLOCATE Batch_Cursor;

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH 
		
		ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_Schedule_Batch_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)

END CATCH
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria
-- Create date: 11-04-2025
-- Description:	Used to get already scheduled batch on given process cell
-- =============================================
CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_WO_Get_Process_Cell_Scheduled_Batch_Usp] --'78EC8915-B52D-48D4-B212-A46D30612234'
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@ProcessCellID varchar(36) 
AS
BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY

		DECLARE @StatusID VARCHAR(36);
		SELECT @StatusID = ID FROM XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl where Name = 'Completed'

        -- Fetch non-deleted batch records assigned to a specific process cell
        SELECT *,SM.Name as Status
        FROM XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl BM WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl SM  WITH(NOLOCK) On BM.StatusID=SM.ID
        WHERE BM.ProcessCellID = @ProcessCellID
        AND BM.IsDeleted = 0 AND StatusID != @StatusID

    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 
            'SP: XBatch_Get_Schedule_Batchs_To_ProcessCell_Usp | Line No: ' + 
            CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), ERROR_LINE()) + 
            ' | Message: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();

        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG, 16, 1);
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XBatch_WO_Get_Process_Cell_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XBatch_WO_Get_Process_Cell_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:27  
**Modified On:** 2025-06-25 15:29:27  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @WorkOrderID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XBatch_WO_Get_Process_Cell_Usp]
    @WorkOrderID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Divya.Dakoria
-- Create date: 11-04-2025
-- Description:	Used to get process cell for work order batch schedule
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XBatch_WO_Get_Process_Cell_Usp] --'A9FD2CCA-8ABA-4EDC-B58F-02CE0B6C132F'
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@WorkOrderID varchar(36) 
AS
BEGIN

BEGIN TRY
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

		-- Step 1: Preprocess and split ProcessCellIDs inside a CTE using CROSS APPLY
		WITH SplitProcessCell AS (
			SELECT 
				WO.ID AS WorkOrderID,
				SplitIDs.value AS ProcessCellID,
				RM.ProcessTime, RM.ID AS RecipeID
			FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN XBatch_Recipe_Mst_Tbl RM WITH(NOLOCK) ON WO.ITEMID = RM.MaterialID
			CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(RM.ProcessCellID, ',') AS SplitIDs
			WHERE WO.Status = 'NEW' AND WO.IsDeleted = 0 And WO.ID = @WorkOrderID
		)

		-- Step 2: Now do normal joins
		SELECT DISTINCT
			PCM.ID,
			PCM.Name,
			PCM.Capacity,
			PCM.MinCapacity,
			PCM.MaxCapacity,
			PCM.Status,
			UM.Name AS Unit,
			UM.ID AS UnitID,
			PCM.NextAvailableTime,
			SPC.ProcessTime,
			SPC.RecipeID,
			BM.Name As CurrentBatch
		FROM SplitProcessCell SPC
		JOIN XBatch_Process_Cell_Mst_Tbl PCM WITH(NOLOCK) ON PCM.ID = SPC.ProcessCellID
		JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl UM WITH(NOLOCK) ON UM.ID = PCM.UnitID
		LEFT JOIN XBatch_Batch_Mst_Tbl BM WITH(NOLOCK) ON BM.ID = PCM.CurrentBatchID

END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		
	DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XBatch_Create_Batch_From_Manufacturing_Order_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)
    END CATCH
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_AUTO_WO_AND_SO_CALCULATION]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Plant Varchar(300),
	@WorkOrder Varchar(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    DECLARE @Quantity Decimal(18,2),
			@RemainingTonnage Decimal(18,2),
			@ProductionTonnage Decimal(18,2),
			@ProgressTonnage Decimal(18,2),
			@SalesOrder Varchar(36),
			@WOProgressTonnage Decimal(18,2),
			@NewWO Varchar(36),
			@WONO VARCHAR(36),
			@EAFWONO Varchar(50),@LRFWONO Varchar(50),@CCMWONO Varchar(50);

	Select @EAFWONO=Concat('MES_',Format(Getdate(),'yyyyMMddHH_LS')),@LRFWONO=Concat('MES_',Format(Getdate(),'yyyyMMddHH_GLS')),@CCMWONO=Concat('MES_',Format(Getdate(),'yyyyMMddHH_BL'))

	IF(@Plant='CCM')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ProductionTonnage=SUM(ISNULL(ActualBilletWeightTon,TotalProduction)) From CCM_Per_Heat With(Nolock) Where WorkOrder=@WorkOrder;
	END
	IF(@Plant='LRF')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ProductionTonnage=SUM(ISNULL(CalcLiquidMetalWeight,LiquidMetalWeight)) From LRF_Per_Heat With(Nolock) Where WorkOrder=@WorkOrder;
	END
	IF(@Plant='EAF')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ProductionTonnage=SUM(ISNUll(CalcLiquidMetalWeight,LiquidMetalWeight)) From EAF_Per_Heat With(Nolock) Where WorkOrder=@WorkOrder;
	End
	IF(@WorkOrder is Not Null)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl set ProgressTonnage=ISNULL(@ProductionTonnage,0) Where ID=@WorkOrder

		SELECT @RemainingTonnage=RemainingTonnage,@ProgressTonnage=ProgressTonnage, @SalesOrder=SalesOrder From XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl With(Nolock) Where ID=@WorkOrder and IsDeleted=0;
		
		SELECT @WOProgressTonnage=SUM(ProgressTonnage) FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) Where SalesOrder=@SalesOrder and IsDeleted=0;

		IF (@SalesOrder IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl SET ProgressTonnage=@WOProgressTonnage Where ID=@SalesOrder;
		END
	END
	IF(@RemainingTonnage <= 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Completed', Source='T-SQL', ModifiedOn=GETDATE(),ModifiedBy='A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358',ActualCompletionDate=GETDATE() Where ID=@WorkOrder;

			IF Not EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='Released' and Equipment=@Plant and SalesOrder=@SalesOrder and IsDeleted=0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @NewWO=ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='Released' and Equipment=@Plant and SalesOrder=@SalesOrder and IsDeleted=0 ORDER BY MfgOrderScheduledStartDate ASC;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @NewWO=ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='Released' and Equipment=@Plant and IsDeleted=0 ORDER BY MfgOrderScheduledStartDate ASC;
			END
	END
	IF(@NewWO IS Not NULL)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Running', Source='T-SQL', ModifiedOn=GETDATE(), ModifiedBy='A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358' WHERE ID=@NewWO
			END
	--IF(@NewWO IS NULL)
	--BEGIN

	--	If(@Plant='EAF')
	--	Begin
	--		Set @WONO=Concat('MES_',Format(Getdate(),'yyyyMMddHH_LS'));
	--		INSERT INTO XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl (Equipment, ManufacturingOrderType, ItemID, MaterialName, ProductionPlant, MfgOrderPlannedStartDate, MfgOrderPlannedEndDate, Quantity, UnitID, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, Status,Source,WorkOrderNumber)
	--		SELECT MOC.Equipment, OrderType, ItemID, MMT.Name, '8502', CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE),CAST(EOMONTH(GETDATE()) AS DATE), MOC.Quantity, MOC.UnitID,'','',GETDATE(),'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358','Released','T-SQL',@EAFWONO FROM MES_Order_Configurator MOC WITH(NOLOCK)
	--		Join XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.ID=MOC.Itemid and MMT.IsDeleted=0
	--		WHERE Equipment='EAF';
	--	End
	--	IF(@Plant='LRF')
	--	Begin
	--		Set @WONO=Concat('MES_',Format(Getdate(),'yyyyMMddHH_GLS'));
	--		INSERT INTO XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl (Equipment, ManufacturingOrderType, ItemID, MaterialName, ProductionPlant, MfgOrderPlannedStartDate, MfgOrderPlannedEndDate, Quantity, UnitID, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, Status,Source,WorkOrderNumber)
	--		SELECT MOC.Equipment, OrderType, ItemID, MMT.Name, '8502', CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE),CAST(EOMONTH(GETDATE()) AS DATE), MOC.Quantity, MOC.UnitID,'','',GETDATE(),'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358','Released','T-SQL',@LRFWONO FROM MES_Order_Configurator MOC WITH(NOLOCK)
	--		Join XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.ID=MOC.Itemid and MMT.IsDeleted=0
	--		WHERE Equipment='LRF';
	--	End
	--	IF (@Plant='CCM')
	--	Begin
	--		Declare @SalesNo Varchar(100)
	--		Select @SalesNo=Concat('MES_',Format(Getdate(),'yyyyMMddHH')), @WONO=Concat('MES_',Format(Getdate(),'yyyyMMddHH_BL'));;
	--		Insert Into XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl (ParentID,Name,SalesOrderNumber,ItemID,Quantity,UnitID,ReleasedDate,ApprovedDate,ApprovedBy, PlannedCompletionDate, Status, CreatedOn, CreatedBy,Source)
	--		SELECT 'C2D3E8B6-E5E4-4E49-9AAB-7CFD410615D3', @SalesNo, @SalesNo, ItemID, MOC.Quantity, MOC.UnitID, GETDATE(), GETDATE(), 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358', CAST(EOMONTH(GETDATE()) AS DATE),'Released', GETDATE(), 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358','T-SQL' FROM MES_Order_Configurator MOC WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Equipment='CCM';
  
	--		INSERT INTO XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl (Equipment, ManufacturingOrderType, ItemID, MaterialName, ProductionPlant, MfgOrderPlannedStartDate, MfgOrderPlannedEndDate, Quantity, UnitID, SalesOrder, SalesOrderName, CreatedOn, CreatedBy, Status,Source,WorkOrderNumber)
	--		SELECT MOC.Equipment, OrderType, ItemID, MMT.Name, '8502', CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE),CAST(EOMONTH(GETDATE()) AS DATE), MOC.Quantity, MOC.UnitID,Case When Equipment='CCM' Then @SalesNo Else Null END,CASE WHEN Equipment='CCM' Then @SalesNo ELSE Null END,GETDATE(),'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358','Released','T-SQL',@CCMWONO FROM MES_Order_Configurator MOC WITH(NOLOCK)
	--		Join XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.ID=MOC.Itemid and MMT.IsDeleted=0
	--		WHERE Equipment='CCM';
	--	END
	--END
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 2025-12-16
-- Description:	To Calculate ProgressTonnage to Work order and Sales Order. To Auto Complete and Start Work Order.
-- =============================================
Create     PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_AUTO_WO_AND_SO_CALCULATION_old]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Plant Varchar(300),
	@WorkOrder Varchar(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    DECLARE @Quantity Decimal(18,2),
			@RemainingTonnage Decimal(18,2),
			@ProductionTonnage Decimal(18,2),
			@ProgressTonnage Decimal(18,2),
			@SalesOrder Varchar(36),
			@WOProgressTonnage Decimal(18,2),
			@NewWO Varchar(36)

	IF(@Plant='CCM')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ProductionTonnage=SUM(ISNULL(ActualBilletWeightTon,TotalProduction)) From CCM_Per_Heat With(Nolock) Where WorkOrder=@WorkOrder

		UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl set ProgressTonnage=ISNULL(@ProductionTonnage,0) Where ID=@WorkOrder

		SELECT @Quantity=Quantity, @RemainingTonnage=RemainingTonnage,@ProgressTonnage=ProgressTonnage, @SalesOrder=SalesOrder From XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl With(Nolock) Where ID=@WorkOrder
		SELECT @WOProgressTonnage=SUM(ProgressTonnage) FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) Where SalesOrder=@SalesOrder

		IF (@SalesOrder IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl SET ProgressTonnage=@WOProgressTonnage Where ID=@SalesOrder
		END

		IF(@RemainingTonnage <= 0)
		BEGIN
		UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Completed' Where ID=@WorkOrder
		
		SELECT TOP 1 @NewWO=ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='OnHold' and Equipment='CCM'
			
			IF(@NewWO IS Null)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @NewWO=ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='Released' and Equipment='CCM' ORDER BY MfgOrderPlannedStartDate ASC
			END
		
			IF(@NewWO IS Not Null)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Running' WHERE ID=@NewWO
			END
		END
	END

	IF(@Plant='LRF')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ProductionTonnage=SUM(ISNULL(CalcLiquidMetalWeight,LiquidMetalWeight)) From LRF_Per_Heat With(Nolock) Where WorkOrder=@WorkOrder

			UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl set ProgressTonnage=ISNULL(@ProductionTonnage,0) Where ID=@WorkOrder

		SELECT @Quantity=Quantity, @RemainingTonnage=RemainingTonnage,@ProgressTonnage=ProgressTonnage, @SalesOrder=SalesOrder From XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl With(Nolock) Where ID=@WorkOrder
		SELECT @WOProgressTonnage=SUM(ProgressTonnage) FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) Where SalesOrder=@SalesOrder

		UPDATE XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl SET ProgressTonnage=@WOProgressTonnage Where ID=@SalesOrder

		IF(@RemainingTonnage <= 0)
		BEGIN
		UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Completed' Where ID=@WorkOrder
		
		SELECT TOP 1 @NewWO=ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='OnHold' and Equipment='LRF'
			
			IF(@NewWO IS Null)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @NewWO=ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='Released' and Equipment='LRF' ORDER BY MfgOrderPlannedStartDate ASC
			END

			IF(@NewWO IS Not Null)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Running' WHERE ID=@NewWO
			END
		END
	END

	IF(@Plant='EAF')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @ProductionTonnage=SUM(ISNUll(CalcLiquidMetalWeight,LiquidMetalWeight)) From EAF_Per_Heat With(Nolock) Where WorkOrder=@WorkOrder

			UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl set ProgressTonnage=ISNULL(@ProductionTonnage,0) Where ID=@WorkOrder

		SELECT @Quantity=Quantity, @RemainingTonnage=RemainingTonnage,@ProgressTonnage=ProgressTonnage, @SalesOrder=SalesOrder From XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl With(Nolock) Where ID=@WorkOrder
		SELECT @WOProgressTonnage=SUM(ProgressTonnage) FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) Where SalesOrder=@SalesOrder

		UPDATE XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl SET ProgressTonnage=@WOProgressTonnage Where ID=@SalesOrder

		IF(@RemainingTonnage <= 0)
		BEGIN
		UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Completed' Where ID=@WorkOrder
		
		SELECT TOP 1 @NewWO=ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='OnHold' and Equipment='EAF'
			
			IF(@NewWO IS Null)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @NewWO=ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE  WO.STATUS='Released' and Equipment='EAF' ORDER BY MfgOrderPlannedStartDate ASC
			END

			IF(@NewWO IS Not Null)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Running' WHERE ID=@NewWO
			END
		END
	END
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 28-11-2025
-- Description:	To Recalculate Or BackCalculation Of LM(Liquid Metal) And GLS (Graded Liquid Metal) Base On Billet Weight
--select CalcLiquidMetalWeight,WorkOrder,HeatID as ht,* from LRF_Per_Heat where IsDeleted = 0 and heatid > 1507450 order by ht 
--[XMES_BackCalculation_GLS_Usp] 1507492
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_BackCalculation_GLS_Usp] --1602613
	@HeatNo INT

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	
	BEGIN TRY
	DECLARE @CalcLM DECIMAL(18,4),
	@MaterialGrade varchar(max), 
	@CCMBilletCount INT, 
	@ProdBilletCount INT,
	@ItemID VARCHAR(36),
	@ItemName varchar(40),
	@WorkorderID VARCHAR(36),
	@Workorder VARCHAR(40),
	@ladleloss DECIMAL(18,4),
	@Scaleloss DECIMAL(18,4)


	SET @WorkorderID = (SELECT TOP 1 WorkOrder FROM CCM_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0 ORDER BY CreatedOn DESC)
	SET @ItemID = (SELECT ItemID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID=@WorkorderID AND IsDeleted=0)
	SET @ItemName= (SELECT Name FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID=@ItemID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
	--select @WorkorderID, @ItemID, @ItemName
	--SET @ladleloss= (SELECT FD.Quantity from XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl as FM WITH(NOLOCK)
	--				JOIN XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl as FD WITH(NOLOCK) ON FD.ParentID=FM.ID and FD.IsDeleted=0
	--				JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl AS M WITH(NOLOCK) ON M.ID=FD.MaterialID and M.IsDeleted=0 
	--				--JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl AS U WITH(NOLOCK) ON U.id=FD.UnitID and u.IsDeleted=0
	--				where FM.ParentID = @ItemID and M.Name= 'Ladle Loss' AND FM.[IsDeleted] = 0)
	--SET @Scaleloss= (SELECT FD.Quantity/100.00 from XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl as FM WITH(NOLOCK)
	--				JOIN XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl as FD WITH(NOLOCK) ON FD.ParentID=FM.ID and FD.IsDeleted=0
	--				JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl AS M WITH(NOLOCK) ON M.ID=FD.MaterialID and M.IsDeleted=0 
	--				--JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl AS U WITH(NOLOCK) ON U.id=FD.UnitID and u.IsDeleted=0
	--				where FM.ParentID = @ItemID and M.Name= 'Scale loss' AND FM.[IsDeleted] = 0)
	SELECT @ladleloss= MAX(ISNULL(CASE WHEN M.[Name] = 'Ladle Loss' THEN FD.Quantity END, 0)), @Scaleloss=MAX(ISNULL(CASE WHEN M.[Name] = 'Scale loss' THEN FD.Quantity/100.00 END, 0)) from XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl as FM WITH(NOLOCK)
					JOIN XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl as FD WITH(NOLOCK) ON FD.ParentID=FM.ID and FD.IsDeleted=0
					JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl AS M WITH(NOLOCK) ON M.ID=FD.MaterialID and M.IsDeleted=0 
					--JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl AS U WITH(NOLOCK) ON U.id=FD.UnitID and u.IsDeleted=0
					where FM.ParentID = @ItemID and M.Name IN ('Ladle Loss','Scale Loss') AND FM.[IsDeleted] = 0;
--select @ladleloss, @Scaleloss
	---Formula for Calculate LM----
	SELECT @CalcLM=(ISNULL(ISNULL(ActualBilletWeightTon,TotalProduction),0) + (ISNULL(EndCutMeter,0) * ISNULL(SetWeightTon,0)) + ISNULL(TundishlossTon,0) + ISNULL(LaunderLossTon,0) + (isnull(@Scaleloss,0.002) * ISNULL(ISNULL(ActualBilletWeightTon,TotalProduction),0)) + ISNULL(OtherLossesTon,0) + isnull(@ladleloss,0.15)),@MaterialGrade=Grade
	--, @ItemName=(case when CrossSection=130 then 'Billet_130X130' When CrossSection=140 then 'Billet_140X140' When CrossSection=140 then 'Billet_150X150' end) 
	FROM CCM_PER_HEAT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

	IF(@CalcLM IS NOT NULL)
	----------- Update LM and GLS in EAF and LRF Per Heat Table & UpdateLiquidmetalweight in CCM----------
	BEGIN

		UPDATE CCM_Per_Heat SET ActualLiquidMetalWeight= @CalcLM WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0;

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT HEATID FROM EAF_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @EAFStartTime DATETIME=(SELECT StartTime FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ActualHeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0 AND Status='EAF Roof Open For Fill Bucket Charging')
		DECLARE @EAFEndTime DATETIME=(SELECT EndTime FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ActualHeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0 AND Status='EAF Tapping')

		INSERT INTO EAF_Per_Heat (HeatID, StartTime, EndTime, EquipmentID, Status, LiquidMetalWeight, CalcLiquidMetalWeight, Statusworkflow, Source, SAPworkflowStatus)
		SELECT @HeatNo, @EAFStartTime, @EAFEndTime, 'BCC64E43-7BF7-47FF-8A35-BCA3B6F4DAEB', 'HeatDataCapture', @CalcLM, @CalcLM, 'Entered', 'T-SQL', 'Entered'

		UPDATE EAF_Per_Heat SET Statusworkflow='Completed', Source='T-SQL' WHERE HEATID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		----------- Update LM and GLS in EAF and LRF Per Heat Table -----------
		UPDATE EAF_PER_HEAT SET CalcLiquidMetalWeight=@CalcLM, SAPworkflowStatus='Entered' WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo;
		UPDATE MES_SAP_Production_Trn_tbl SET QuantityinentryUnit = CalcLiquidMetalWeight FROM EAF_Per_Heat AS EAF WITH(NOLOCK) join MES_SAP_Production_Trn_tbl AS PRD
		ON CAST(EAF.[HeatID] AS VARCHAR(20)) = PRD.Batch WHERE PRD.Batch = CAST(@Heatno AS VARCHAR(20)) AND PRD.QuantityinentryUnit != EAF.CalcLiquidMetalWeight AND PRD.PostingMaterialType = 'LS' AND PRD.[SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered'
		UPDATE MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_tbl SET QuantityinentryUnit = CalcLiquidMetalWeight FROM EAF_Per_Heat AS EAF WITH(NOLOCK) join MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl AS CONS
		ON CAST(EAF.[HeatID] AS VARCHAR(20)) = CONS.Batch WHERE CONS.Batch = CAST(@Heatno AS VARCHAR(20)) AND CONS.QuantityinentryUnit != EAF.CalcLiquidMetalWeight AND CONS.PostingMaterialType = 'LS' AND CONS.[SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered'
	END

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT HEATID FROM LRF_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @LotNo VARCHAR(500), @userID VARCHAR(36) = 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358', @HeatReportDate DATE, @ReportDate VARCHAR(50);

		INSERT INTO LRF_Per_Heat (HeatID, StartTime, EndTime, EquipmentID, Status, LiquidMetalWeight, CalcLiquidMetalWeight, Source, SAPworkflowStatus)
		SELECT  @HeatNo, StartTime, EndTime, '0A625385-4465-4C71-A91C-88743497DD3A', 'LRF Start', @CalcLM, @CalcLM, 'T-SQL', 'Entered' FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE ActualHeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0 AND Status='LRF Arcing'

		SELECT  @LotNo = [LotNo], @HeatReportDate = [HeatReportDate] FROM (SELECT TOP 1 [HeatID], ISNULL([LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS [LiquidMetalWeight], CONCAT('LS_', CAST(HeatID AS INT)) AS [LotNo], [SteelGrade], [HeatReportDate] FROM [EAF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND HeatID=@HeatNo) AS t;
		
		IF(@CalcLM > 0) 
		BEGIN
			EXEC [XBatch_I_Material_Consume_NoBOM_USP] @Grade = 'TBD', @HeatNo = @HeatNo, @ItemName = 'LIQUID METAL', @LotNumber = @LotNo, @ProduceItem = 1, @Quantity = @CalcLM, @SublotNumber = NULL, @UOMName = 'ton',@UserID = @userID; 
		END
		SET @ReportDate=Format(@HeatReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd');	

		SELECT  @WorkOrder=WMT.ID from XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WMT WITH(NOLOCK)
		Join XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.ID=WMT.ItemID AND MMT.IsDeleted=0
		WHERE MMT.Grade=@MaterialGrade AND WMT.Equipment='LRF' AND Status IN ('Running','OnHold');

		UPDATE LRF_Per_Heat SET WorkFlowStatus='Completed', HeatReportDate=@HeatReportDate, ReportDate=@ReportDate, Grade=@MaterialGrade, WorkOrder=@WorkOrder, Source='T-SQL' WHERE HEATID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0
	END

	ELSE
	BEGIN
		----------- Update LM and GLS in EAF and LRF Per Heat Table -----------
		UPDATE LRF_PER_HEAT SET CalcLiquidMetalWeight=@CalcLM, SAPWorkflowStatus='Entered' WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo;
		UPDATE MES_SAP_Production_Trn_tbl SET QuantityinentryUnit = CalcLiquidMetalWeight FROM LRF_Per_Heat AS LRF WITH(NOLOCK) join MES_SAP_Production_Trn_tbl AS PRD
		ON CAST(LRF.[HeatID] AS VARCHAR(20)) = PRD.Batch WHERE PRD.Batch = CAST(@Heatno AS VARCHAR(20)) AND PRD.QuantityinentryUnit != LRF.CalcLiquidMetalWeight AND PRD.PostingMaterialType = 'GLS' AND PRD.[SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered'
		UPDATE MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_tbl SET QuantityinentryUnit = CalcLiquidMetalWeight FROM LRF_Per_Heat AS LRF WITH(NOLOCK) join MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl AS CONS
		ON CAST(LRF.[HeatID] AS VARCHAR(20)) = CONS.Batch WHERE CONS.Batch = CAST(@Heatno AS VARCHAR(20)) AND CONS.QuantityinentryUnit != LRF.CalcLiquidMetalWeight AND CONS.PostingMaterialType = 'GLS' AND CONS.[SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered'
		--select QuantityinentryUnit,* from MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl where batch = '1602613'
		--select QuantityinentryUnit,* from mes_sap_consumption_trn_tbl where batch = '1602613'
		
		--select SAPWorkflowStatus,CalcLiquidMetalWeight,* from LRF_Per_Heat where HeatID = 1602613
		--select SAPWorkflowStatus,CalcLiquidMetalWeight,* from EAF_Per_Heat where HeatID = 1602613
		----------- Update Quantity of Production and Consumption of LM and GLS -----------
		--UPDATE XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl SET Quantity=@CalcLM Where MaterialID in ('63565452-5C08-4734-8018-CEDD6DCB1818','5597C95C-3164-45BC-BF43-A8E7254B80AC') and HeatNo=@HeatNo;

		--UPDATE XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl SET Quantity=@CalcLM Where MaterialID in ('63565452-5C08-4734-8018-CEDD6DCB1818','5597C95C-3164-45BC-BF43-A8E7254B80AC') and HeatNo=@HeatNo;
		-------
	END
	END

	--SELECT @CCMBilletCount=TotalBilletsCount FROM CCM_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo

	--SELECT @ProdBilletCount=COUNT(SublotNumber) FROM XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE MaterialID in ('C56EF29E-7267-4B98-88DD-CB3BA0D4AC6A') and HeatNo=@HeatNo

	--IF(@CCMBilletCount!=@ProdBilletCount)
	--	BEGIN
	--		DELETE FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE LotNumber=@HeatNo AND ParentID ='C56EF29E-7267-4B98-88DD-CB3BA0D4AC6A'

	--		DELETE FROM XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo AND MaterialID ='C56EF29E-7267-4B98-88DD-CB3BA0D4AC6A'

	--		DELETE FROM XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl  WHERE BilletNo=@HeatNo AND ParentID ='C56EF29E-7267-4B98-88DD-CB3BA0D4AC6A'

	--		EXEC [dbo].[SP_Xbatch_SplitsBillets_From_CCM_To_Inventory]	@HeatNo =@HeatNo, @ItemName =@ItemName, @MaterialGrade =@MaterialGrade, @Grade ='TBD'
	--	END

	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Xbatch_BackCalculation_LM_USP | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[Xbatch_BackCalculation_LM_USP]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_BackCalculation_Validation_GLS_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_BackCalculation_Validation_GLS_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-12-19 16:02:24  
**Modified On:** 2025-12-19 16:30:14  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @HeatNo | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_BackCalculation_Validation_GLS_Usp]
    @HeatNo = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 28-11-2025
-- Description:	To Recalculate Or BackCalculation Of LM(Liquid Metal) And GLS (Graded Liquid Metal) Base On Billet Weight
--select CalcLiquidMetalWeight,WorkOrder,HeatID as ht,* from LRF_Per_Heat where IsDeleted = 0 and heatid > 1507450 order by ht 
--[XMES_BackCalculation_GLS_Usp] 1507492
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_BackCalculation_Validation_GLS_Usp]--1507490
	@HeatNo INT

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	
	BEGIN TRY
	DECLARE @CalcLM DECIMAL(18,4),
	@MaterialGrade varchar(max), 
	@CCMBilletCount INT, 
	@ProdBilletCount INT,
	@ItemID VARCHAR(36),
	@ItemName varchar(40),
	@WorkorderID VARCHAR(36),
	@Workorder VARCHAR(40),
	@ladleloss DECIMAL(18,4),
	@Scaleloss DECIMAL(18,4),
	@Error VARCHAR(MAX)


	SET @WorkorderID = (SELECT TOP 1 WorkOrder FROM CCM_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0 ORDER BY CreatedOn DESC)
	SET @ItemID = (SELECT ItemID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID=@WorkorderID AND IsDeleted=0)
	SET @ItemName= (SELECT Name FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID=@ItemID AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
	--select @WorkorderID, @ItemID, @ItemName
	--SET @ladleloss= (SELECT FD.Quantity from XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl as FM WITH(NOLOCK)
	--				JOIN XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl as FD WITH(NOLOCK) ON FD.ParentID=FM.ID and FD.IsDeleted=0
	--				JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl AS M WITH(NOLOCK) ON M.ID=FD.MaterialID and M.IsDeleted=0 
	--				--JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl AS U WITH(NOLOCK) ON U.id=FD.UnitID and u.IsDeleted=0
	--				where FM.ParentID = @ItemID and M.Name= 'Ladle Loss' AND FM.[IsDeleted] = 0)
	--SET @Scaleloss= (SELECT FD.Quantity/100.00 from XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl as FM WITH(NOLOCK)
	--				JOIN XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl as FD WITH(NOLOCK) ON FD.ParentID=FM.ID and FD.IsDeleted=0
	--				JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl AS M WITH(NOLOCK) ON M.ID=FD.MaterialID and M.IsDeleted=0 
	--				--JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl AS U WITH(NOLOCK) ON U.id=FD.UnitID and u.IsDeleted=0
	--				where FM.ParentID = @ItemID and M.Name= 'Scale loss' AND FM.[IsDeleted] = 0)
	SELECT @ladleloss= MAX(ISNULL(CASE WHEN M.[Name] = 'Ladle Loss' THEN FD.Quantity END, 0)), @Scaleloss=MAX(ISNULL(CASE WHEN M.[Name] = 'Scale loss' THEN FD.Quantity/100.00 END, 0)) from XBatch_Formula_Mst_Tbl as FM WITH(NOLOCK)
					JOIN XBatch_Formula_Dtl_Tbl as FD WITH(NOLOCK) ON FD.ParentID=FM.ID and FD.IsDeleted=0
					JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl AS M WITH(NOLOCK) ON M.ID=FD.MaterialID and M.IsDeleted=0 
					--JOIN XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl AS U WITH(NOLOCK) ON U.id=FD.UnitID and u.IsDeleted=0
					where FM.ParentID = @ItemID and M.Name IN ('Ladle Loss','Scale Loss') AND FM.[IsDeleted] = 0;

	IF @ladleloss IS NULL OR @Scaleloss IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SET ANSI_NULLS OFF;
		SET @Error = CONCAT('BOM is not defined for Material : ',@ItemName);
		RAISERROR(@Error,16,1);
	END
--select @ladleloss, @Scaleloss
	---Formula for Calculate LM----
	SELECT @CalcLM=(ISNULL(ISNULL(ActualBilletWeightTon,TotalProduction),0) + (ISNULL(EndCutMeter,0) * ISNULL(SetWeightTon,0)) + ISNULL(TundishlossTon,0) + ISNULL(LaunderLossTon,0) + (isnull(@Scaleloss,0) * ISNULL(ISNULL(ActualBilletWeightTon,TotalProduction),0)) + ISNULL(OtherLossesTon,0) + isnull(@ladleloss,0)),@MaterialGrade=Grade
	--, @ItemName=(case when CrossSection=130 then 'Billet_130X130' When CrossSection=140 then 'Billet_140X140' When CrossSection=140 then 'Billet_150X150' end) 
	FROM CCM_PER_HEAT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

	IF(@CalcLM IS NOT NULL)

	BEGIN
		----------- Update LM and GLS in EAF and LRF Per Heat Table -----------
		UPDATE EAF_PER_HEAT SET CalcLiquidMetalWeight=@CalcLM WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo;

		UPDATE LRF_PER_HEAT SET CalcLiquidMetalWeight=@CalcLM WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo;
		------
		----------- Update Quantity of Production and Consumption of LM and GLS -----------
		--UPDATE XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl SET Quantity=@CalcLM Where MaterialID in ('63565452-5C08-4734-8018-CEDD6DCB1818','5597C95C-3164-45BC-BF43-A8E7254B80AC') and HeatNo=@HeatNo;

		--UPDATE XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl SET Quantity=@CalcLM Where MaterialID in ('63565452-5C08-4734-8018-CEDD6DCB1818','5597C95C-3164-45BC-BF43-A8E7254B80AC') and HeatNo=@HeatNo;
		-------
	END

	--SELECT @CCMBilletCount=TotalBilletsCount FROM CCM_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo

	--SELECT @ProdBilletCount=COUNT(SublotNumber) FROM XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE MaterialID in ('C56EF29E-7267-4B98-88DD-CB3BA0D4AC6A') and HeatNo=@HeatNo

	--IF(@CCMBilletCount!=@ProdBilletCount)
	--	BEGIN
	--		DELETE FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WHERE LotNumber=@HeatNo AND ParentID ='C56EF29E-7267-4B98-88DD-CB3BA0D4AC6A'

	--		DELETE FROM XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo AND MaterialID ='C56EF29E-7267-4B98-88DD-CB3BA0D4AC6A'

	--		DELETE FROM XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl  WHERE BilletNo=@HeatNo AND ParentID ='C56EF29E-7267-4B98-88DD-CB3BA0D4AC6A'

	--		EXEC [dbo].[SP_Xbatch_SplitsBillets_From_CCM_To_Inventory]	@HeatNo =@HeatNo, @ItemName =@ItemName, @MaterialGrade =@MaterialGrade, @Grade ='TBD'
	--	END

	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_BackCalculation_Validation_GLS_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_BackCalculation_Validation_GLS_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		SET @ERROR_MSG = COALESCE(@Error, @ERROR_MSG);
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_BilletPosting_Validation_Usp]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@TotalBilletCount INT,
	@RemainingBilletCount INT,
	@HotBilletCount INT=NULL,
	@ColdBilletCount INT=NULL
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF(@RemainingBilletCount < ISNULL(@HotBilletCount,0)+ISNULL(@ColdBilletCount,0))
	BEGIN
        Select Concat('The remaining billets to be posted (',@RemainingBilletCount,') are less than the entered billets (',@HotBilletCount+@ColdBilletCount,')');
    END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_BilletPosting_Validation_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_BilletPosting_Validation_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_CampaignId_generation_usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_CampaignId_generation_usp  
**Created On:** 2026-03-31 13:16:26  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-31 16:22:38  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_CampaignId_generation_usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_CampaignId_generation_usp] 
AS 
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
    DECLARE @Campaignid AS VARCHAR(25),
            @count as integer;

 
    Set @count=01
 
    SELECT @Campaignid = 
        + 'CP' + CAST(@count as varchar(10)) + '_' +
        RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) +   
        RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) +  
        RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(4)), 2);
 
    INSERT INTO XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst (id,campaignId,date,Status)
    VALUES (newid(),@Campaignid,getdate(),'Entered');

 
END
```

## dbo.XMES_CREATE_BILLETNO_USP
