### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @EventID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_CREATE_BILLETNO_USP]
    @EventID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_CREATE_BILLETNO_USP]
(
    @EventID VARCHAR(36)
)
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- VARIABLES
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    DECLARE @HeatNo VARCHAR(100)
    DECLARE @TagName VARCHAR(500)
    DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME
    DECLARE @StrandNo VARCHAR(100)

    DECLARE @CurrentSequence INT
    DECLARE @NewSequence INT

    DECLARE @StrandCurrentSequence INT
    DECLARE @StrandNewSequence INT

    DECLARE @BilletNo VARCHAR(100)

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GET EVENT DETAILS
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT
        @TagName = Status,
        @StartTime = StartTime
    FROM Billet_Track_Per_Strand
    WHERE ID = @EventID

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- DETECT STRAND
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    IF @TagName LIKE '%STRAND%1%'
        SET @StrandNo = 'S1'

    ELSE IF @TagName LIKE '%STRAND%2%'
        SET @StrandNo = 'S2'

    ELSE IF @TagName LIKE '%STRAND%3%'
        SET @StrandNo = 'S3'

    ELSE IF @TagName LIKE '%STRAND%4%'
        SET @StrandNo = 'S4'

    ELSE IF @TagName LIKE '%STRAND%5%'
        SET @StrandNo = 'S5'

    ELSE IF @TagName LIKE '%STRAND%6%'
        SET @StrandNo = 'S6'

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GET ACTIVE HEAT
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT TOP 1
        @HeatNo = CAST(CAST(HeatID AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR(100))
    FROM BilletsCastCount
    WHERE WorkFlowStatus = 'Entered'
    AND ISNULL(IsDeleted,0)=0
    ORDER BY StartTime DESC

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GET GLOBAL HEAT SEQUENCE
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT TOP 1
        @CurrentSequence = ISNULL(CurrentSequence,0)
    FROM XMES_CCM_Billet_Sequence
    WHERE HeatNo = @HeatNo
    AND ISNULL(IsDeleted,0)=0
    ORDER BY CurrentSequence DESC

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- NEXT GLOBAL SEQUENCE
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    SET @NewSequence = ISNULL(@CurrentSequence,0) + 1

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GET STRAND SEQUENCE
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT TOP 1
        @StrandCurrentSequence = ISNULL(StrandSequence,0)
    FROM XMES_CCM_Billet_Sequence
    WHERE HeatNo = @HeatNo
    AND StrandNo = @StrandNo
    AND ISNULL(IsDeleted,0)=0
    ORDER BY StrandSequence DESC

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- NEXT STRAND SEQUENCE
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    SET @StrandNewSequence = ISNULL(@StrandCurrentSequence,0) + 1

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- INSERT SEQUENCE RECORD
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO XMES_CCM_Billet_Sequence
    (
        ID,
        HeatNo,
        StrandNo,
        CurrentSequence,
        StrandSequence,
        CreatedOn,
        IsDeleted,
        IsSystem
    )
    VALUES
    (
        NEWID(),
        @HeatNo,
        @StrandNo,
        @NewSequence,
        @StrandNewSequence,
        GETDATE(),
        0,
        0
    )

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GENERATE BILLET NUMBER
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    SET @BilletNo =
        @HeatNo + '_' +
        @StrandNo + '_' +
        RIGHT('00' + CAST(@NewSequence AS VARCHAR),2)

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- INSERT BILLET TRACKING
    ------------------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO XMES_Billet_Tracking_Per_Strand
    (
        ID,
        HeatNo,
        EventID,
        CreatedOn,
        IsDeleted,
        IsSystem,
        BilletNo,
        StrandNo,
        BilletSequence,
        StrandSequence,
        Status
    )
    VALUES
    (
        NEWID(),
        @HeatNo,
        @EventID,
        @StartTime,
        0,
        0,
        @BilletNo,
        @StrandNo,
        @NewSequence,
        @StrandNewSequence,
        'Billet Produced'
    )

END
```


### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE XMES_Dashboard_CCM_Live_USP
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    

    SELECT
        T1.STD1CastingSpeed,
        T1.STD2CastingSpeed,
        T1.STD3CastingSpeed,
        T1.STD4CastingSpeed,
        T1.STD5CastingSpeed,
        T1.STD6CastingSpeed,

        T1.STD1OSCSpeed,
        T1.STD2OSCSpeed,
        T1.STD3OSCSpeed,
        T1.STD4OSCSpeed,
        T1.STD5OSCSpeed,
        T1.STD6OSCSpeed,

        T1.STD1BilletCount,
        T1.STD2BilletCount,
        T1.STD3BilletCount,
        T1.STD4BilletCount,
        T1.STD5BilletCount,
        T1.STD6BilletCount,

        (ISNULL(T1.STD1BilletCount,0) +
         ISNULL(T1.STD2BilletCount,0) +
         ISNULL(T1.STD3BilletCount,0) +
         ISNULL(T1.STD4BilletCount,0) +
         ISNULL(T1.STD5BilletCount,0) +
         ISNULL(T1.STD6BilletCount,0)) AS TotalBillets,

        T1.CCMHEATID,
        T2.SteelGrade, 

        T1.TotalBilletWeight,
        T1.TotalCastTime,
        T1.TotalTPH,

        T1.Zone1WaterFlow,
        T1.Zone2WaterFlow,
        T1.Zone3WaterFlow,

        T1.TurretCastedWeight,

        T1.STD1Zone1WaterFlow,
        T1.STD1Zone2WaterFlow,
        T1.STD1Zone3WaterFlow,
        T1.STD2Zone1WaterFlow,
        T1.STD2Zone2WaterFlow,
        T1.STD2Zone3WaterFlow,
        T1.STD3Zone1WaterFlow,
        T1.STD3Zone2WaterFlow,
        T1.STD3Zone3WaterFlow,
        T1.STD4Zone1WaterFlow,
        T1.STD4Zone2WaterFlow,
        T1.STD4Zone3WaterFlow,
        T1.STD5Zone1WaterFlow,
        T1.STD5Zone2WaterFlow,
        T1.STD5Zone3WaterFlow,
        T1.STD6Zone1WaterFlow,
        T1.STD6Zone2WaterFlow,
        T1.STD6Zone3WaterFlow,

        CASE WHEN T1.STD1CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Strand1Status,
        CASE WHEN T1.STD2CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Strand2Status,
        CASE WHEN T1.STD3CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Strand3Status,
        CASE WHEN T1.STD4CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Strand4Status,
        CASE WHEN T1.STD5CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Strand5Status,
        CASE WHEN T1.STD6CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Strand6Status,

        (CASE WHEN T1.STD1CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
         CASE WHEN T1.STD2CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
         CASE WHEN T1.STD3CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
         CASE WHEN T1.STD4CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
         CASE WHEN T1.STD5CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END +
         CASE WHEN T1.STD6CastingSpeed = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS TotalStrandRunning,

        T1.MaterialSpecificWeight,
        T1.section,
		T1.section,
     cast(Strand1StraightnerPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Inlet1],
     cast(Strand2StraightnerPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Inlet2],
     cast(Strand3StraightnerPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Inlet3],
     cast(Strand4StraightnerPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Inlet4],
     cast(Strand5StraightnerPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Inlet5],
     cast(Strand6StraightnerPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Inlet6],
     cast(Strand1WithdrawalPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Outlet1],
     cast(Strand2WithdrawalPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Outlet2],
     cast(Strand3WithdrawalPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Outlet3],
     cast(Strand4WithdrawalPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Outlet4],
     cast(Strand5WithdrawalPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Outlet5],
     cast(Strand6WithdrawalPressure as decimal(18,2)) as [Outlet6],
	 CASE WHEN iSNULL(TotalRunningStrands,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 
     cast((((case when STD1CastingSpeed =0.00 then 0 else Strand1BilletSpecificWeight end
          + case when STD2CastingSpeed =0.00 then 0 else Strand2BilletSpecificWeight end
          + case when STD3CastingSpeed =0.00 then 0 else Strand3BilletSpecificWeight end
          + case when STD4CastingSpeed =0.00 then 0 else Strand4BilletSpecificWeight end
          + case when STD5CastingSpeed =0.00 then 0 else Strand5BilletSpecificWeight end
          + case when STD6CastingSpeed =0.00 then 0 else Strand6BilletSpecificWeight end)/10)/TotalRunningStrands )* TotalBillet as decimal(18,2)) end as [TotalBilletWeightinTon]

    FROM
        [XStudio_Xbatch].dbo.CCM_Data AS T1
    LEFT JOIN 
        [XSTUDIO_XBATCH].dbo.EAF_SMS_Data AS T2
        ON T1.CCMHEATID = T2.EAFHeatID  
END
```

**Modified On:** 2026-05-04 08:29:52  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Dashboard_EAF_Live_USP];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[XMES_Dashboard_EAF_Live_USP]
as
SELECT
  -- CurrentTTT in Minutes
  RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(CurrentTTTMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) + ':' + RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(CurrentTTTSec AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) AS CurrentTTT_MM,
  -- HeatTime in Minutes
  RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(CurrentTTTMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) + ':' + RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(CurrentTTTSec AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) AS HeatTime,
  EAFBriquette,
  EAFBundleorLMS,
  EAFConsumptionBin1,
  EAFConsumptionBin2,
  EAFConsumptionBin3,
  EAFConsumptionBin4,
  EAFConsumptionPrevBin1,
  EAFConsumptionPrevBin2,
  EAFConsumptionPrevBin3,
  EAFConsumptionPrevBin4,
  EAFCopexScrap,
  EAFEndCuts,
  EAFEnergyMWH,
  EAFHBIDRI,
  EAFHeatID,
  EAFHMS1,
  EAFHMS1and2,
  EAFScull,
  EAFShredded,
  EAFSpecificEnergy,
  NGConsumptionToday,
  NGConsumptionYesterday,
  Oxygenconsumptionnm3,
  steelgrade,
  FES1StackDust,
  FES2StackDust,
  -- PowerOffTime in Minutes
  RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(POffMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) + ':' + RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(POffSec AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) AS PowerOffTime_MM,
  -- PowerOnTime in Minutes
  RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(PonMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) + ':' + RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(PonSeconds AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) AS PowerOnTime_MM,
  -- PrevTTT in Minutes
  RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(PreviousTTTMinute AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) + ':' + RIGHT(
    '0' + CAST(CAST(PreviousTTTSec AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)),
    2
  ) AS PrevTTT_MM,
  TotalChargeWeight,
  EAFBIN1Name,
  EAFBIN2Name,
  EAFBIN3Name,
  EAFBIN4Name,
  TotalChargeMixWeight,
  -- Newly added fields
  BriquetteCH1,
  BriquetteCH2,
  BundleLMSCH1,
  BundleLMSCH2,
  CopexScrapCH1,
  CopexScrapCH2,
  EndCutsCH1,
  EndCutsCH2,
  HBIDRICH1,
  HBIDRICH2,
  HMS12CH1,
  HMS12CH2,
  HMS1CH1,
  HMS1CH2,
  ScullCH1,
  ScullCH2,
  BoosterFanStatus,
  HydraulicPump1Status,HydraulicPump2Status,HydraulicPump3Status,HydraulicPump4Status,recirculationpump1status,recirculationpump2status,
  IdFan1Status,
  IdFan2Status,
  IdFan3Status,
  IdFan4Status,
  ShreeddedCH1,
  ShreeddedCH2,
  Cast(PrimaryVoltageKv as Decimal(14,2)) as PrimaryVoltageKv,
  Carbonconsumptionkg,
  -- Total Delay for today (MM:SS)
  Delay.TotalDelay_MMSS,
  -- Specify Total Available Time (e.g., 24 hours = 1440 minutes)
  1440 AS TotalAvailableTime_Minutes,
  -- Total Delay Time in Minutes
  (
    CAST(CAST(Delay.DelayTimeMinute AS INT) AS INT) * 60 + CAST(CAST(Delay.DelayTimeSec AS INT) AS INT)
  ) / 60.0 AS TotalDelayTime_Minutes,
  -- Availability as Percentage, CAST to 2 decimal points
  CAST(
    (
      1 - (
        (
          CAST(CAST(Delay.DelayTimeMinute AS INT) AS INT) * 60 + CAST(CAST(Delay.DelayTimeSec AS INT) AS INT)
        ) / (1440 * 60.0)
      )
    ) * 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)
  ) AS Availability_Percentage,
  Prod.Productivity
FROM
  xstudio_xbatch.dbo.eaf_sms_data AS EAF
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
      CAST(SUM(DelayInSecond) / 60 AS VARCHAR) + ':' + RIGHT(
        '0' + CAST(SUM(DelayInSecond) % 60 AS VARCHAR),
        2
      ) AS TotalDelay_MMSS,
      SUM(DelayInSecond) / 60 AS DelayTimeMinute,
      SUM(DelayInSecond) % 60 AS DelayTimeSec
    FROM
      xstudio_xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
    WHERE
      AreaName = 'SMS'
      AND [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[FN_GET_ReportDate]([DelayStartTime]) >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
      AND IsDeleted = 0
  ) AS Delay
  CROSS JOIN (
    -- Productivity calculation from CCM_Data
    SELECT
      CAST((SUM(TotalTPH) / 89.00) * 100 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS Productivity
    FROM
      xstudio_xbatch.dbo.CCM_Data
  ) AS Prod;
```


### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE XMES_Dashboard_LRF_Live_USP
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT 
        LRF.LRFHeatID,
        EAF.steelgrade                          AS Grade,
        LRF.LRFLiquidSteelweight                AS Ladleweight,
        LRF.ArcingTime,
        LRF.ArgonFlow,
        LRF.MHSBoosterFanStatus, 
        LRF.BoosterFanStatus,
        LRF.HydraclauricPump1Status,
        LRF.HydraclauricPump2Status,
        LRF.HydraclauricPump3Status,
        LRF.RecirculationPumpStatus,
        LRF.PowerOnTime,
        LRF.PowerOffTime,
        LRF.TransformerTemperature,
        LRF.EnergyConsumption,
        LRF.LRFActualEnergy,
        LRF.LRFLime,
        LRF.LRFDolo,
        LRF.LRFSiMn,
        LRF.LRFFeSi,
        CAST(LRF.SpecificPower   AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS SpecificPower,
        CAST(LRF.PrimaryVoltage1 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS PrimaryVoltage1,
        CAST(LRF.PrimaryVoltage2 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS PrimaryVoltage2,
        CAST(LRF.PrimaryVoltage3 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS PrimaryVoltage3,
        CAST(LRF.PurgingFlow     AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS PurgingFlow,
        CAST(LRF.LRFActivePower  AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ActivePower,
        CAST(LRF.TransformerTap  AS INT)            AS TransformerTap,
        CAST(LRF.BoosterFanStatus AS INT)           AS BoosterFanStatus_Int,

        -- ✅ LRF Process Time (PowerOnTime + PowerOffTime)
        CAST(
            ISNULL(LRF.PowerOnTime, 0) + ISNULL(LRF.PowerOffTime, 0)
        AS DECIMAL(18,2))                          AS LRFProcessTime,

        -- ✅ FIXED: HeatNo = LRFHeatID, LadleNoAtLRF = integer ladle number
        CAST(
            (
                SELECT TOP 1 phl.LadleNoAtLRF
                FROM [XStudio_XBatch].dbo.Per_Heat_LadleNo AS phl
                WHERE phl.HeatNo = LRF.LRFHeatID
                ORDER BY phl.CreatedOn DESC
            )
        AS VARCHAR(20))                            AS ActiveLadlenumber

    FROM [XStudio_XBatch].dbo.LRF_SMS_Data AS LRF
    LEFT JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].dbo.EAF_SMS_Data AS EAF 
        ON EAF.EAFHeatID = LRF.LRFHeatID
    LEFT JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].dbo.LRF_Per_Heat AS lrfheat 
        ON lrfheat.HeatID = LRF.LRFHeatID
    WHERE 
        LRF.IsDeleted = 0 
        AND EAF.IsDeleted = 0;
END
```

## dbo.XMES_Delay_Split_Entry_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Delay_Split_Entry_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-04-22 18:06:03  
**Modified On:** 2026-05-04 16:37:56  
**Parameter Count:** 3  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @SplitDT | varchar(20) | NO |  |
| @Userid | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Delay_Split_Entry_Usp]
    @ID = '',
    @SplitDT = '',
    @Userid = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana
-- Create date: 22-Apr-2026
-- Description:	Delay Split Entry (Update + Insert)
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Delay_Split_Entry_Usp]
	@ID VARCHAR(36),
	@SplitDT varchar(20),
	@Userid Varchar(36)
AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE 
		@StartTime DATETIME,
		@EndTime DATETIME,
		@HeatNo VARCHAR(50),
		@AreaName VARCHAR(36) = 'SMS',
		@DelayID VARCHAR(36) = NEWID(),
		@SplitDateTime DATETIME;
		
		SET @SplitDateTime = CONVERT(DATETIME, @SplitDT, 105);

	BEGIN TRY

		BEGIN TRANSACTION;

		SELECT 
			@StartTime = DelayStartTime,
			@EndTime   = DelayEndTime,
			@HeatNo    = HeatNo
		FROM ShiftDelayEntry WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ID = @ID 
		  AND IsDeleted = 0;

		-- Update existing record (End = Split)
		UPDATE ShiftDelayEntry
		SET DelayEndTime = @SplitDateTime,ModifiedOn=GETDATE(),ModifiedBy=@Userid,Source='T-SQL' ,IsSplit=1
		WHERE ID = @ID;

		-- Insert new split record
		INSERT INTO ShiftDelayEntry (ID,DelayStartTime,DelayEndTime,HeatNo,AreaName,IsSplit,Source)
		VALUES (@DelayID,@SplitDateTime,@EndTime,@HeatNo,@AreaName,1,'T-SQL');
		--select @DelayID,@SplitDateTime,@EndTime,@HeatNo,@AreaName,1,'T-SQL'
		COMMIT TRANSACTION;

	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH

		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  
			'SP : XMES_Delay_Split_Entry_Usp | Messge : ' 
			+ ERROR_MESSAGE() 
			+ ' | Line : ' 
			+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());

		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
			@Type='SQL-Error', 
			@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Delay_Split_Entry_Usp]', 
			@Message=@ERROR_MSG,
			@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,
			@UserID='',
			@HostAddress='',
			@Info='',
			@Source='T-SQL';

		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);

	END CATCH

END
```

## dbo.XMES_Delay_Split_Validate_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Delay_Split_Validate_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-04-22 17:42:51  
**Modified On:** 2026-05-04 16:35:55  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @SplitDT | varchar(20) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Delay_Split_Validate_Usp]
    @ID = '',
    @SplitDT = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana
-- Create date: 22-Apr-2026
-- Description:	Get Delay Split Validate
-- =============================================
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Delay_Split_Validate_Usp]
	@ID varchar(36),
	@SplitDT varchar(20)

AS
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @DelayStartDateTime Datetime;
	DECLARE @DelayEndDateTime Datetime;
    DECLARE @SplitDateTime DATETIME;

SET @SplitDateTime = CONVERT(DATETIME, @SplitDT, 105);


    BEGIN TRY
        -- Get the allowed delay from ShiftDelayEntry
        SELECT @DelayStartDateTime = DelayStartTime,@DelayEndDateTime=DelayEndTime
        FROM ShiftDelayEntry With(NoLock)
        WHERE ID = @ID AND IsDeleted=0;

			-- select @DelayStartDateTime [First Delay Start time],@DelayEndDateTime [First Delay End time],@SplitDateTime as [Second delay Start time];
		 --if (@SplitDateTime <= @DelayStartDateTime)
		 --begin 
			--select @SplitDateTime,@DelayStartDateTime ,'date is smaller'
		 --END
		 -- if (@SplitDateTime >= @DelayEndDateTime)
		 --BEGIN
			--select @SplitDateTime , @DelayEndDateTime,'date is larger'
		 --END

      
        -- Validate If Splitdatetime Is 
	

        IF (@SplitDateTime <= @DelayStartDateTime or @SplitDateTime >= @DelayEndDateTime )
        BEGIN
           
		   SELECT CONCAT('Split Datetime Must Be Between ',CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), @DelayStartDateTime, 105), ' ', CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DelayStartDateTime, 108),' and ',CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), @DelayEndDateTime, 105), ' ',CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @DelayEndDateTime, 108));

        END
		--else
		--begin
		--	select 'OK'
		--END
    END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_Delay_Split_Validate_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_Delay_Split_Validate_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
   
END
```

```sql
	/*--Variable Declaration---*/

					SELECT NEWID(), '''+@NewID+''', ''T-SQL'', GETDATE(), '+@collst+'
					FROM [dbo].[XMES_Grade_Protocol_LRF_Parameters_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ParentID] = '''+@ID+'''';

		--PRINT(@Collst)

					FROM [dbo].[XMES_Grade_Protocol_CCM_Parameters_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ParentID] = '''+@ID+'''';
		--PRINT (@SQL)
		EXEC(@SQL)

		SET @ColLst = NULL

		SELECT @ColLst = STUFF(( SELECT ',[' + COLUMN_NAME + ']' FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'XMES_Grade_Protocol_Tapping_Additions_Mst_Tbl' AND [COLUMN_NAME] NOT IN ('ID','Source','CreatedOn','ParentID') FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,'');
		--PRINT(@Collst)

		SET @SQL = null;
		/*------Duplicate Entry in Grade protocol EAF Paramter mst tbl------*/
		SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Grade_Protocol_Tapping_Additions_Mst_Tbl] ([ID], [ParentID], [Source], [CreatedOn], '+@collst+')
					SELECT NEWID(), '''+@NewID+''', ''T-SQL'', GETDATE(), '+@collst+'
					FROM [dbo].[XMES_Grade_Protocol_Tapping_Additions_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ParentID] = '''+@ID+'''';
		--PRINT (@SQL)
		EXEC(@SQL)

		SET @ColLst = NULL
		/*----Get Column List for Grade Protocol Super Heat Master-----*/
		SELECT @ColLst = STUFF(( SELECT ',[' + COLUMN_NAME + ']' FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'XMES_Grade_Protocol_Super_Heat_Speed_Nozzle_Mst_Tbl' AND [COLUMN_NAME] NOT IN ('ID','Source','CreatedOn','ParentID') FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,'');
		--PRINT(@Collst)

		SET @SQL = NULL;
		/*------Duplicate Entry in Grade protocol Super heat mst tbl------*/
		SET @SQL = 'INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Grade_Protocol_Super_Heat_Speed_Nozzle_Mst_Tbl] ([ID], [ParentID], [Source], [CreatedOn], '+@collst+')
					SELECT NEWID(), '''+@NewID+''', ''T-SQL'', GETDATE(), '+@collst+'
					FROM [dbo].[XMES_Grade_Protocol_Super_Heat_Speed_Nozzle_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ParentID] = '''+@ID+'''';
		--PRINT (@SQL)

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
```

## dbo.XMES_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP  
**Created On:** 2026-02-12 15:13:14  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-30 15:09:12  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @EntryDAte | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP]
    @EntryDAte = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------*/
-- Created By : Nidhi Rana
-- Created On : 12-Feb-2026
-- Descrption : Implement Procedure to calcuation Rate Price
/*--------------------*/
CREATE   PROC [dbo].[XMES_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP] (@EntryDAte DATE)
AS 
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRY
        DECLARE @tbl AS TABLE ([FeederName] VARCHAR(100), [Year] INT, [RatebandName] VARCHAR(500), [ReportDate] DATE, [Consumption] DECIMAL(18,4), [Rate] DECIMAL(18,3), [RatePrice] DECIMAL(18, 3))
		 ;WITH cte AS (
            SELECT DATEPart(DW,DATEADD(HH, -1, [EndDateTime])) AS [Enddate], YEAR([EndDateTime]) AS yr, [Enddatetime], [ReportDate], [Consumption], [FeederName] 
            FROM Electricity_Meter_Reading WITH(NOLOCK) 
            WHERE [FeederName] IN ('Feeder132KVIC1','Feeder132KVIC2') AND [IsDeleted] = 0
        ), cte1 AS (
           SELECT [FromTime], [ToTime],[DayOfWeek], [Year], [EntryDatetime], EMT.[Weekdays], RBM.[Name] AS RateBAndName
           FROM Electricity_Meter_Timing AS EMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
           JOIN Rate_Band_Master AS RBM WITH(NOLOCK) ON EMT.[RateBand] = RBM.[ID] WHERE EMT.[IsDeleted] =0 AND RBM.[IsDeleted] = 0 --order by SrNo  
        ), cte2 AS (
            SELECT [Months], [Year], [Name], [value] FROM (
                SELECT [Months], [Year], ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [Year], [Months] ORDER BY [Entrydatetime] DESC) AS rn, [NightPeak],[OffPeak],[WeekdayDayPeak],[WeekendDayPeak]
                FROM dbo.Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Rate_Tbl_Mst WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
            ) AS t UNPIVOT ([VAlue] FOR [Name] IN ([NightPeak],[OffPeak],[WeekdayDayPeak],[WeekendDayPeak])) as unpvt 
            WHERE rn = 1
        ) 
        INSERT INTO @tbl([FeederName], [Year], [RatebandName], [ReportDate], [Consumption], [Rate], [RatePrice])
        SELECT t.*, CAST(cte2.[VAlue] AS FLOAT) / 1000 AS [Rate], [Consumption] * CAST(cte2.[VAlue] AS FLOAT) / 1000 AS [RatePrice] FROM (
            SELECT [FeederName], t.[Year], [RateBAndName]/*,DayOfWeek,FromTime,ToTime*/,[ReportDate]/*,EndDateTime*/,SUM([Consumption]) AS [Consumption]/*,SUM([VAlue]) AS [val]*/ 
            FROM cte OUTER APPLY (SELECT * FROM cte1) AS t
            WHERE t.[year] = cte.[yr] AND CAST(DATEADD(HH, -1, [EndDateTime]) AS TIME) BETWEEN [FromTime] AND [ToTime]
                AND [Enddate] IN (SELECT * FROM string_split([Weekdays],','))
            GROUP BY FeederName,t.[Year], [RateBAndName], [ReportDate]/*,DayOfWeek,FromTime,ToTime,EndDateTime*/
        ) AS t 
        LEFT JOIN cte2 ON [Months] = DATENAME([MONTH], [ReportDate]) AND cte2.[Year] = t.[Year] AND cte2.[Name] = REPLACE(REPLACE(t.[RateBAndName], '-',''),' ','')
        WHERE [ReportDate] = @EntryDAte
        ORDER BY 1,2,3,4;

        UPDATE [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details] SET [Charge] = t.[RatePRice], [Consumption] = t.[Consumption], [Rate] = t.[Rate], [ReportDate] = t.[ReportDate], [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE() FROM @tbl AS t 
        WHERE (t.[ReportDate] = [Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details].[ReportDate] OR [Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details].[ReportDate] IS NULL) AND [Month] = DATENAME(Month,t.[ReportDate]) AND [Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details].[Year] = t.[Year] AND [Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details].[FeederName] = t.[FeederName] AND [Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details].[Consumption] != t.[RatePrice];

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details]([CreatedOn], [Source], [Month], [ReportDate], [Charge], [Rate], [Consumption], [TimeOfUse], [Year], [MonthNumber], [FeederName])
        SELECT GETDATE(), 'T-SQL', DATENAME(Month, [ReportDate]), [ReportDate], [RatePrice], [Rate], [Consumption], [RatebandName], [Year], MONTH([ReportDate]), [FeederName] FROM @tbl AS t1 
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details] AS t WHERE t.[ReportDate] = t1.[ReportDate] AND t.[Year] = t1.[Year] AND t.[MonthNumber] = MONTH(t1.[ReportDate]) AND t.[FeederName] = t1.[FeederName])

        UPDATE [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount] SET [TotalEnergyCharge] = [charge], [TotalEngeryConsumptionCalculate] = [Consumption], [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
        FROM (SELECT [FeederName], [MonthNumber], [Month], [Year], FORMAT([ReportDate], 'MMM-yyyy') AS [MonthYear], SUM([charge]) AS [Charge], SUM([Consumption]) AS [Consumption] 
        FROM Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details WITH(NOLOCK) 
        GROUP BY [year], [MonthNumber], [Month], FORMAT([ReportDate], 'MMM-yyyy'), [FeederName]) AS BD WHERE BD.[MonthYear] = [Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[MonthYear] AND [Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[FeederName] = BD.[FeederName] 
			   
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount] ([FeederName], [CreatedOn], [Source], [Year], [Month], [MonthNumber], [MonthYear], [TotalEnergyCharge], [TotalEngeryConsumptionCalculate], [AccountNo], [DistributionSystemCharge], [SupplyServiceCharge])
        SELECT *, CASE WHEN [FeederName] = 'Feeder132KVIC1' THEN '08104267' WHEN [FeederName] = 'Feeder132KVIC2' THEN '08104268' END, '0.000', '4.167' FROM (
            SELECT [FeederName], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [YEAR], [Month], [MonthNumber], FORMAT([ReportDate], 'MMM-yyyy') AS [MonthYear], SUM([Charge]) AS [Charge], SUM([Consumption]) AS [Consumption]
            FROM [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Electricity_Bill_Details] AS t WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
            GROUP BY [year], [MonthNumber], [Month], FORMAT([ReportDate], 'MMM-yyyy'), [FeederName]
        ) AS t
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND t.[FeederName] = t1.[FeederName] AND t.[Year] = t1.[Year] AND t.[Month] = t1.[Month])
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XMES_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Electricity_Bill_Calculator_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_entry_for_RAW_Material_Consumption_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_entry_for_RAW_Material_Consumption_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-01-12 08:54:00  
**Modified On:** 2026-01-31 08:26:18  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_entry_for_RAW_Material_Consumption_Usp]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*------------------------*/
--Created By : Nidhi Rana
--Created On : 12-Jan-2026
--Description : Implement Procedure to insert entry of material quantity
/*------------------------*/

--EXEC XMES_entry_for_RAW_Material_Consumption_Usp '11-Jan-2026'

--select * from MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl where ReportDate = '11-Jan-2026' and IsDeleted = 0
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_entry_for_RAW_Material_Consumption_Usp](@ReportDate DATE = null)
AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @tbl AS TABLE ([ReportDate] DATE, [ParentID] VARCHAR(36), [Quantity] FLOAT, [UnitID] VARCHAR(36), [Price] FLOAT, [LotNumber] VARCHAR(200));
	DECLARE @WorkOrder VARCHAR(36), @OrderType VARCHAR(100), @WorkOrderNo VARCHAR(200);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--When Reportdate is null---*/
		SET @ReportDate = ISNULL(@ReportDate, GETDATE() - 1);

		/*------Get WorkOrder for Last heat------*/
		SET @WorkOrder = (SELECT TOP(1) [workOrder] FROM [dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatReportDate] = @ReportDate ORDER BY [HeatID]);

		SELECT @OrderType = [OrderType], @WorkOrderNo = [WorkOrderNumber] FROM  (SELECT [ManufacturingOrderType] AS [OrderType], [WorkOrderNumber] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrder ANd [IsDeleted] = 0) AS t;

		/*--When record already exist in table--*/
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = @ReportDate )
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl] SET [IsDeleted] = 1 WHERE [ReportDate] = @ReportDate AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
		END

		/*----Insert entry for material consumption---*/
		INSERT INTO @tbl([ReportDate], [ParentID], [Quantity], [UnitID], [Price], [LotNumber])
		SELECT COALESCE([reportdate], @reportdate), T1.[ID], ISNULL([quantity], 0), [Unitid], [Price], [LotNumber] FROM (
			SELECT [Materialid], [ID], [UnitID]  FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Mapping_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
		) AS t1 LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT [ReportDate],  SUM([Quantity]) AS quantity, SUM([Price]) AS [Price], [LotNumber], [MaterialID], [ParentID] FROM (
				SELECT TOP (1) [ReportDate], [FirstHeatNo], [LastHeatNo] FROM Heat_End_Selection_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = @ReportDate ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC
			) AS t1 JOIN (
				SELECT [UOMID], [HeatNo], [Quantity], [Price], [LotNumber], [MaterialID], [ParentID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE IsDeleted = 0
			) AS t2 ON t2.HeatNo BETWEEN t1.[FirstHeatNo] AND t1.[LastHeatNo]
			GROUP BY [ReportDate], [UOMID], [MaterialID], [LotNumber], [ParentID]
		) AS t2 ON t1.[Materialid] = t2.[MaterialID] and t1.[ID] = t2.[ParentID]

		/*----Insert in Raw Material Consumption---*/
		INSERT INTO MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl([ReportDate], [ParentID], [CapturedQuantity], [DeclaredQuantity], [Unit], [Source],[WorkOrder], [SAPWorkflowStatus], [Price], [LotNumber], [OrderType], [WorkOrderNo])
		SELECT [reportDate], [ParentID], [Quantity], [Quantity], [UnitID], 'T-SQL', @WorkOrder, 'Entered', [Price], [LotNumber], @OrderType, @WorkOrderNo FROM @tbl AS t1
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl] AS t2 WHERE t2.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND t2.[ReportDate] = t2.[ReportDate] AND t1.[UnitID] = t2.[Unit] AND t1.[ParentID] = t2.[ParentID] AND t2.[ReportDate] = @ReportDate); 
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : XMES_entry_for_RAW_Material_Consumption_Usp | LINE No : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()) + '| MESSAGE : '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' | no :-'+CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_state());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) 
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].  [XMES_entry_for_RAW_Material_Consumption_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID=''
	RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_Get_API_Transaction_Summary

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Get_API_Transaction_Summary  
**Created On:** 2025-12-24 10:42:43  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-02 13:21:26  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @APIType | varchar(300) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Get_API_Transaction_Summary]
    @APIType = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
--[XMES_Get_API_Transaction_Summary] 'UsageDecision'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Get_API_Transaction_Summary]
    @APIType VARCHAR(300) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;

    /*============================================================
      STEP 1: Base API log rows
    ============================================================*/
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TxnBase') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TxnBase;

    SELECT
        a.[TransactionID],
        a.[APIRequestID],
        a.[APIStatus],
        a.[CallerType],
        a.[CallerID],
        a.[EntityID],
        a.[RecordID],
        a.[CallerName],
        a.[Message],
        a.[CreatedOn],
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.[TransactionID] ORDER BY a.[CreatedOn] DESC) AS RN
    INTO #TxnBase
    FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] AS a WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE a.[CallerName] NOT IN ('API Parameter Mapping','API Test')
        --AND (TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, IIF(CAST(a.RecordID AS VARCHAR(MAX)) = '', NEWID(), a.recordID)) IS NOT NULL )--add--
        AND a.[IsDeleted] = 0
    ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC;

    /*============================================================
      STEP 2: One row per TransactionID
    ============================================================*/
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Txn') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Txn;

    SELECT
        b.[TransactionID],
        ac.[Name] AS APIName,
        MAX(b.[APIStatus]) AS [APIStatus],
        MAX(b.[CallerType]) AS [APISource],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'URL:%' THEN b.[CreatedOn] END) AS [RequestedDatetime],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[APIStatus] IN ('Success','Failed') THEN b.[CreatedOn] END) AS [ResponseDatetime],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'URL:%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'URL:', '')) END) AS [RequestURL],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'Body:%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'Body:', '')) END) AS [RequestBody],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'API Response Result:%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'API Response Result:', '')) END) AS [ResponseData],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'API Data Insertion Query :%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'API Data Insertion Query :-', '')) END) AS [ResponseDataInsertion],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'Error occurred in GetAPIResponse:%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'Error occurred in GetAPIResponse:-', '')) END) AS [ResponseError],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[RN] = 1 THEN b.[RecordID] END) AS [RecordID],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[RN] = 1 THEN b.[EntityID] END) AS [EntityID],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[RN] = 1 THEN b.[CallerID] END) AS [CallerID],
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.[RN] = 1 AND b.[CallerType] = 'LV' THEN b.[CallerName] END) AS [LVName]
    INTO #Txn
    FROM #TxnBase b
    JOIN XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch..XStudio_API_Request_Configuration_Mst_Tbl ac WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON ac.[ID] = b.[APIRequestID] AND ac.[IsDeleted] = 0
    GROUP BY b.[TransactionID], ac.[Name];

    /*============================================================
      STEP 3: Add output columns
    ============================================================*/
    ALTER TABLE #Txn
    ADD
        ResolvedEntityTable SYSNAME NULL,
        HostAddress         VARCHAR(200) NULL,
        ActionUserName      VARCHAR(200) NULL;

    /*============================================================
      STEP 4: Resolve Entity & Fetch Host/User
    ============================================================*/
    DECLARE
        @TransactionID   VARCHAR(36),
        @RecordID        VARCHAR(36),
        @EntityID        VARCHAR(36),
        @CallerID        VARCHAR(36),
        @CallerType      VARCHAR(50),
        @EntityTable     SYSNAME,
        @SQL             NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @HostAddress     VARCHAR(200),
        @ActionUserName  VARCHAR(200);

    DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT TransactionID, RecordID, EntityID, CallerID, APISource
        FROM #Txn;

    OPEN cur;
    FETCH NEXT FROM cur
        INTO @TransactionID, @RecordID, @EntityID, @CallerID, @CallerType;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

        SET @EntityTable = NULL;
        SET @HostAddress = NULL;
        SET @ActionUserName = NULL;

        IF @CallerType = 'Scheduler'
        BEGIN
            SELECT @EntityTable = [Name]
            FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_Entities_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)
            WHERE [ID] = @EntityID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
        END
        ELSE IF @CallerType = 'LV'
        BEGIN
            SELECT @EntityTable = e.[Name]
            FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_LV_Mst_Tbl] AS lv WITH (NOLOCK)
            JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_Entities_Mst_Tbl] AS e WITH (NOLOCK)
                ON e.[ID] = lv.[ParentID]
            WHERE lv.[ID] = @CallerID AND lv.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND e.[IsDeleted] = 0;
        END

        IF @EntityTable IS NOT NULL AND (@RecordID IS NOT NULL AND @RecordID != '')
        BEGIN
            SET @SQL = N'
                SELECT @Host = a.[HostAddress], @User = u.[FullName]
                FROM [xstudio_Xbatch].dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@EntityTable) + N' AS a WITH (NOLOCK)
                LEFT JOIN [xstudio_configuration_xbatch].dbo.[xstudio_user_mst_tbl] AS u WITH (NOLOCK)
                    ON u.[ID] = a.[ModifiedBy] AND u.[IsDeleted] = 0
                WHERE a.[ID] = @RecordID AND a.[IsDeleted] = 0;
            ';
            EXEC sp_executesql
                @SQL,
                N'@RecordID VARCHAR(36), @Host VARCHAR(200) OUTPUT, @User VARCHAR(200) OUTPUT',
                @RecordID = @RecordID,
                @Host = @HostAddress OUTPUT,
                @User = @ActionUserName OUTPUT;
        END

        UPDATE #Txn
        SET [ResolvedEntityTable] = @EntityTable,
            [HostAddress] = @HostAddress,
            [ActionUserName] = @ActionUserName
        WHERE TransactionID = @TransactionID;

        FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @TransactionID, @RecordID, @EntityID, @CallerID, @CallerType;
    END

    CLOSE cur;
    DEALLOCATE cur;

    /*============================================================
      FINAL OUTPUT
    ============================================================*/
    IF ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(@APIType)),'')  != ''
    BEGIN
        IF @APIType = 'WorkOrderCreation'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Production Order Create','Process Order Create')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'BatchCreation'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Batch Creation')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'BatchCharacteristics'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] = 'Batch Characteristics Posting'
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'Production'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Good Movement Production Posting')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'Consumption'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Good Movement Consumption Posting')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'ByProduct'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Good Movement By Product Posting')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'Reversal'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Good Movement Reversal')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'ResultRecording'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Result Recording')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'UsageDecision'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],
                [ResponseDatetime],
                [RequestURL],
                [RequestBody],
                [ResponseData],
                [ResponseDataInsertion],
                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Usage Decision')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
        ELSE IF @APIType = 'Inventory'
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                [TransactionID],
                [APIName],
                [APIStatus],
                [APISource],
                [RequestedDatetime],

                [ResponseError],
                [ResolvedEntityTable],
                [HostAddress],
                [ActionUserName],
                [LVName],
                [RecordID],
                [CallerID] AS [LVid],
                [EntityID]
            FROM #Txn
            WHERE [APIName] IN ('Get Inventory Status')
            ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
        END
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            [TransactionID],
            [APIName],
            [APIStatus],
            [APISource],

            [CallerID] AS [LVid],
            [EntityID]
        FROM #Txn
        ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
    END

    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
END
```

## dbo.XMES_heat_selection_usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_heat_selection_usp  
**Created On:** 2026-04-16 13:24:15  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-21 10:16:28  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_heat_selection_usp];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[XMES_heat_selection_usp]
as 
begin 
		
		Declare @campaignid varchar(max),
		        @Heatno Integer
				,@BilletCount Integer
	if exists (select Top(1) Campaignid from XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst where status='running' and isdeleted=0)
	Begin	
		select top (1) 
		M.CampaignId as CampaignId,
        ISNULL(CAST(C.heatno AS VARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS HeatNo,
        ISNULL(CAST(C.BilletQty AS VARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BilletQty,
       ISNULL(CAST(WO.WorkOrderNumber AS VARCHAR(MAX)), 'N/A') AS WorkOrderNumber,
       ISNULL(CAST(Cast(Wo.Length as decimal(10,2)) AS VARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS Length,
        ISNULL(CAST(M.Size AS VARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS Size
        ,ISNULL(CAST(p.Name AS VARCHAR(MAX)), 'N/A') AS ProductName
        ,ISNULL(CAST(MT.grade AS VARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS Grade,
		'0' as progress
		FROM Xmes_campaign_plan_mst AS M
		LEFT JOIN RM_Operator_HeatSelection AS C 
        ON M.Id = C.CampaignId AND C.isdeleted = 0
		inner join Product_Master as P on M.Productname=p.ID
		inner join XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl as Wo on Wo.CampaignId=M.ID
		inner join XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl as MT on WO.Materialname=MT.name

		WHERE M.status = 'Running' 
		 AND M.isdeleted = 0
		ORDER BY C.CreatedOn DESC
	END
	ELSE 
	Begin
		SELECT 
            'N/A' AS CampaignId,
            'N/A' AS HeatNo,
            'N/A' AS BilletQty,
            'N/A' AS WorkOrderNumber,
			'N/A' AS Length,
            'N/A' AS HeatNo,
            'N/A' AS ProductName,
            'N/A' AS Size,
			'N/A' AS Grade
	END
END
```

## dbo.XMES_I_API_Transaction_Summary

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_I_API_Transaction_Summary  
**Created On:** 2026-01-31 11:47:38  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-18 15:50:34  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @transactionid | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_I_API_Transaction_Summary]
    @transactionid = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
--select count(1), transactionid from XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch..XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl group by transactionid
--[XMES_Get_API_Transaction_Summary] 'UsageDecision'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_I_API_Transaction_Summary] @transactionid VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @type VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @SRNo INT;
	DECLARE @subSrNo INT = 0; 
	DECLARE @SPName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @EXEC NVARCHAR(MAX);
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;
	BEGIN TRY
		; WITH cte AS (
				SELECT 1 AS sr, '@transactionId' AS [name], @transactionid AS [value] )
		, cte1 AS (
			SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPname], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION] 
			FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
		)
		SELECT @SPName = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @EXEC = c.[SPname] + ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ') FROM cte1 AS c JOIN cte ON c.[ORDINAL_POSITION] = cte.[sr] GROUP BY c.[SPname]
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XStudio_Xbatch..XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid)
		BEGIN
			SET @type = 'BatchChar';
			SET @srNo = 2;					
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid )
		BEGIN
			SET @type = 'Production'
			SELECT @srno = CASE WHEN [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Hot Billet','Cold Billet') THEN 3 WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 4 ELSE 6 END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid;			
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XMES_SAP_CreateBatch_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [SAPTransactionID] = @transactionid)
		BEGIN
			SET @type = 'CreateBatch'
			SET @SrNo = 1;			
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid)
		BEGIN
			SET @type = 'Consumption'
			SELECT @SrNo = CASE WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 5 WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'LS' THEN 7 ELSE NULL END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid;
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid )
		BEGIN
			SET @type = 'ByProduct';
			SET @srno = 8;
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid )
		BEGIN
			SET @type = 'RR';
			SET @srno = 9;
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Xstudio_Xbatch.dbo.MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [SAPTransactionID] = @transactionid)
		BEGIN
			SET @type = 'UD'
			SELECT @srNo = CASE WHEN [MaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 10 WHEN [MaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' THEN 11 ELSE NULL END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid;
		END
		ELSE IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [SAPTransactionID] = @transactionid)
		BEGIN
			SET @type = 'PlantToPlantTransfer'
			SET @Srno = 12
		END
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Entered', @Subsrno;
		/*============================================================
		  STEP 1: Base API log rows
		============================================================*/
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TxnBase') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TxnBase;
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Store in #TxnBase Transactionid wise Latest Record Process Start', @Subsrno 
		SELECT
			a.[TransactionID],
			a.[APIRequestID],
			a.[APIStatus],
			a.[CallerType],
			a.[CallerID],
			a.[EntityID],
			a.[RecordID],
			a.[CallerName],
			a.[Message],
			a.[CreatedOn],
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.[TransactionID] ORDER BY a.[CreatedOn] DESC) AS RN
		INTO #TxnBase
		FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] AS a WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE a.[CallerName] NOT IN ('API Parameter Mapping','API Test') AND [TransactionID] = @transactionid
		--AND (TRY_CONVERT(uniqueidentifier, IIF(CAST(a.RecordID AS VARCHAR(MAX)) = '', NEWID(), a.recordID)) IS NOT NULL )--add--
		  AND a.[IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC;

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Store in #TxnBase Transactionid wise Latest Record Process End', @Subsrno;
		/*============================================================
		  STEP 2: One row per TransactionID
		============================================================*/
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Txn') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Txn;
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Store in #Txn One row per TransactionID From #TxnBase Process Start', @Subsrno;
		SELECT
			b.[TransactionID],
			ac.[Name] AS APIName,
			MAX(b.[APIStatus]) AS [APIStatus],
			MAX(b.[CallerType]) AS [APISource],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'URL:%' THEN b.[CreatedOn] END) AS [RequestedDatetime],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[APIStatus] IN ('Success','Failed') THEN b.[CreatedOn] END) AS [ResponseDatetime],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'URL:%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'URL:', '')) END) AS [RequestURL],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'Body:%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'Body:', '')) END) AS [RequestBody],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'API Response Result:%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'API Response Result:', '')) END) AS [ResponseData],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE 'API Data Insertion Query :%' THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(b.[Message], 'API Data Insertion Query :-', '')) END) AS [ResponseDataInsertion],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[Message] LIKE '%Error Message:%' THEN LTRIM(b.[Message]) END) AS [ResponseError],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[RN] = 1 THEN b.[RecordID] END) AS [RecordID],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[RN] = 1 THEN b.[EntityID] END) AS [EntityID],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[RN] = 1 THEN b.[CallerID] END) AS [CallerID],
			MAX(CASE WHEN b.[RN] = 1 AND b.[CallerType] = 'LV' THEN b.[CallerName] END) AS [LVName]
		INTO #Txn
		FROM #TxnBase b
		JOIN XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch..XStudio_API_Request_Configuration_Mst_Tbl ac WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ac.[ID] = b.[APIRequestID] AND ac.[IsDeleted] = 0
		GROUP BY b.[TransactionID], ac.[Name];
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Store in #Txn One row per TransactionID From #TxnBase Process End', @Subsrno

		/*============================================================
		  STEP 3: Add output columns
		============================================================*/
		ALTER TABLE #Txn
		ADD
			ResolvedEntityTable SYSNAME NULL,
			HostAddress         VARCHAR(200) NULL,
			ActionUserName      VARCHAR(200) NULL;

		/*============================================================
		  STEP 4: Resolve Entity & Fetch Host/User
		============================================================*/
		DECLARE        
			@RecordID VARCHAR(36),
			@EntityID VARCHAR(36),
			@CallerID VARCHAR(36),
			@CallerType VARCHAR(50),
			@EntityTable SYSNAME,
			@SQL NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@HostAddress VARCHAR(200),
			@ActionUserName VARCHAR(200);

		DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT RecordID, EntityID, CallerID, APISource
			FROM #Txn;
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Cursor Cur on #Txn Process Start', @Subsrno ;
		OPEN cur;
		FETCH NEXT FROM cur
			INTO  @RecordID, @EntityID, @CallerID, @CallerType;

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
        
			SET @EntityTable = NULL;
			SET @HostAddress = NULL;
			SET @ActionUserName = NULL;

			IF @CallerType = 'Scheduler'
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Set EntityName When Caller type scheduler in Cur Process Start', @Subsrno;
				SELECT @EntityTable = [Name]
				FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_Entities_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE [ID] = @EntityID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Set EntityName When Caller type scheduler in Cur Process End', @Subsrno ;
			END
			ELSE IF @CallerType = 'LV'
			BEGIN	
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Set EntityName When Caller type LV in Cur Process Start', @Subsrno ;
				SELECT @EntityTable = e.[Name]
				FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_LV_Mst_Tbl] AS lv WITH (NOLOCK)
				JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_Entities_Mst_Tbl] AS e WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON e.[ID] = lv.[ParentID]
				WHERE lv.[ID] = @CallerID AND lv.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND e.[IsDeleted] = 0;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Set EntityName When Caller type LV in Cur Process End', @Subsrno 
			END

			IF @EntityTable IS NOT NULL AND (@RecordID IS NOT NULL AND @RecordID != '')
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Set Host and Username When Entity and Recordid have value in Cur Process Start', @Subsrno 
				SET @SQL = N'
					SELECT @Host = a.[HostAddress], @User = u.[FullName]
					FROM [xstudio_Xbatch].dbo.' + QUOTENAME(@EntityTable) + N' AS a WITH (NOLOCK)
					LEFT JOIN [xstudio_configuration_xbatch].dbo.[xstudio_user_mst_tbl] AS u WITH (NOLOCK)
					ON u.[ID] = a.[ModifiedBy] AND u.[IsDeleted] = 0
					WHERE a.[ID] = @RecordID AND a.[IsDeleted] = 0;
				';           
				EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, N'@RecordID VARCHAR(36), @Host VARCHAR(200) OUTPUT, @User VARCHAR(200) OUTPUT', @RecordID = @RecordID, @Host = @HostAddress OUTPUT, @User = @ActionUserName OUTPUT; 
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Set Host and Username When Entity and Recordid have value in Cur Process End', @Subsrno 
			END
			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Update #Txn Entity, Host and Username in Cur Process Start', @Subsrno 
			UPDATE #Txn
			SET [ResolvedEntityTable] = @EntityTable, [HostAddress] = @HostAddress, [ActionUserName] = @ActionUserName
			WHERE TransactionID = @TransactionID;

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Update #Txn Entity, Host and Username in Cur Process End', @Subsrno 
			FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @RecordID, @EntityID, @CallerID, @CallerType;
		END

		CLOSE cur;
		DEALLOCATE cur;
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Cursor Cur on #Txn Process End', @Subsrno 

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Update API transaction Summary Fact Table Using #Txn Process Start', @Subsrno 
		UPDATE [dbo].[XMES_API_Transaction_Summary_Fact_Tbl] SET [RequestedDatetime] = t.[requesteddatetime], [ResponseDatetime] = t.[responsedatetime], [RequestURL] = t.[requestURL], [RequestBody] = t.[requestbody], [ResponseData] = t.[responsedata], [ResponseDataInsertion] = t.[responsedatainsertion], [ResponseError] = t.[responseerror], [ResolvedEntityTable] = t.[resolvedentitytable] FROM #txn AS t WHERE t.[recordid] = [dbo].[XMES_API_Transaction_Summary_Fact_Tbl].[RecordID] AND t.[CallerID] = [LVid] AND t.[TransactionID] = [dbo].[XMES_API_Transaction_Summary_Fact_Tbl].[TransactionID] AND [dbo].[XMES_API_Transaction_Summary_Fact_Tbl].[TransactionID]  = @transactionid
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubseqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Update API transaction Summary Fact Table Using #Txn Process End', @Subsrno 
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubseqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Insert API transaction Summary Fact Table Using #Txn Process Start', @Subsrno 
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_API_Transaction_Summary_Fact_Tbl]([TransactionID], [APIName], [APIStatus], [APISource], [RequestedDatetime], [ResponseDatetime], [RequestURL], [RequestBody], [ResponseData], [ResponseDataInsertion], [ResponseError], [ResolvedEntityTable], [HostAddress], [Source], [ActionUserName], [CreatedBy], [LVName], [RecordID], [LVid], [EntityID])
		SELECT
			[TransactionID],
			[APIName],
			[APIStatus],
			[APISource],
			[RequestedDatetime],
			[ResponseDatetime],
			[RequestURL],
			[RequestBody],
			[ResponseData],
			[ResponseDataInsertion],
			[ResponseError],
			[ResolvedEntityTable],
			[HostAddress],
			'T-SQL',
			[ActionUserName],
			(SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_User_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [FullName] = ISNULL(@ActionUserName, 'XMES System')),
			[LVName],
			[RecordID],
			[CallerID] AS [LVid],
			[EntityID]
		FROM #Txn as t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XMES_API_Transaction_Summary_Fact_Tbl] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE t.[RecordID] = t1.[RecordID] AND t.[CallerID] = t1.[LVid] and t.[TransactionID] = t1.[TransactionID] AND t1.[transactionid] = @transactionid)
		ORDER BY [ResponseDatetime] DESC;
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Insert API transaction Summary Fact Table Using #Txn Process End', @Subsrno 
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Completed', @Subsrno 
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([srNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @spname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @type, 'Error', @Subsrno 
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_I_API_Transaction_Summary] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_API_Transaction_Summary]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 07-May-2026
-- Description:	Individual Billets entry after Billet Cast count
-- =============================================


--SP : XMES_I_Billets_Tracking_Usp | Messge : Conversion failed when converting the varchar value '1602855.0000' to data type int.|38

--select * from xmes_billet_tracking_trn_tbl where heatno = 1602855
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_I_Billets_Tracking_Usp] --1602856.0000
	@HeatNo INT--,
	--@ItemName Varchar(500)='',
	--@MaterialGrade varchar(100)='',
	--@Grade Varchar(500)=''
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	Declare @RecievedDate datetime;
	Declare @UOMID varchar(36);
	Declare @MaterialID Varchar(36);
	DEclare @GradeID Varchar(36)
	DECLARE @ProcessStageID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @StatePositionID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @plant VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @StorageLocation VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Workorderid VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @BilletCount INT;
	DECLARE @BilletWeight DECIMAL(18,3);
	DECLARE @ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(40);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Get data from ccm---*/
		SELECT @Workorderid = [WorkOrder], @BilletCount = [TotalBilletsCount], @BilletWeight = [totalproduction], @recieveddate = [EndTime]
		FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo;

		/*--Get Unit ID for billet---*/
		SELECT @UOMID=[ID] FROM [XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [Name]='ton';
		SELECT @GradeID = [ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'TBD';

		/*--Get Material Id using workorder---*/
		SELECT @MaterialID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [ID] IN (SELECT [ItemID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @WorkORderID);

		/*--Get Plant, STorage Location and manufacturing order using WorkOrder ID--*/
		SELECT @Plant = [ProductionPlant],
				@StorageLocation = ISNULL([StorageLocation], '2103'),
				@ManufacturingOrder = [WorkOrderNumber]
		FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  
		WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*---Get StatePosition and ProcessStage---*/
		SELECT  @StatePositionID = SMT.[ID],  @ProcessStageID = PMT.[StageCode] 
		FROM [dbo].xmes_state_position_State_mst_tbl AS SMT WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN [dbo].[xmes_stage_position_mapping_mst_tbl] AS PMT WITH(NOLOCK)
		ON SMT.[ID] = PMT.[PositionType] 
		WHERE SMT.[Sequencenumber] = 1 AND SMT.[Isdeleted] = 0 AND PMT.[IsDeleted] = 0;

		----------Insert Billet trasaction detail---------
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Billet_Tracking_Trn_tbl]([Reportdate], [createdOn], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [HeatNo], [Batch], [BilletNo], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [StatePosition], [ProcessStage], [MaterialID], [QualityGradeID], [BilletWeight], [UOMID], [ManufacturingOrder], [BilletQuantity])
		SELECT CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AS [Reportdate], GETDATE(), 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), @HeatNo, NULL 
			--, LEFT(t.[LotNumber], CHARINDEX('_', t.[Lotnumber])-1) AS [HeatNo], t.[LotNumber] AS [Batch]
			, CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(20)) + '_' + RIGHT('00' + CAST([number] AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) as [BilletNo], @Plant
			, @StorageLocation, @StatePositionID, @ProcessStageID, @MaterialID, @GradeID
			, CAST(@BilletWeight /  CAST(@BilletCount AS FLOAT) AS FLOAT) AS [BilletWeight], @UOMID, @ManufacturingOrder, 1
		FROM (SELECT DISTINCT [number] FROM [master].dbo.spt_values WHERE [number] BETWEEN 1 AND @BilletCount) as t1
		;
		
		--/*----Individual Billets entry in Material Item Prod table----*/
		--INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl]
		--	([ID], [HeatNo],[CreatedOn], [Source], [LotNumber], [SublotNumber], [Quantity], [UOMID], [MaterialID], [GradeID])
		--SELECT newid(), [HeatNo], @RecievedDate, 'T-SQL', [Batch], [BilletNo], CAST(@BilletWeight /  CAST(@BilletCount AS FLOAT) AS FLOAT), [UOMID], [MaterialID], [QualityGradeID]
		--FROM [dbo].[XMES_Billet_Tracking_Trn_tbl] AS BT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE BT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatNo] = @Heatno;
		

			--insert into XBatch_Billets_Transfer_History_Tbl(ID,ParentID,BilletNo,SubLotNo,RecievedDate,CurrentStatus,MaterialGrade,RecievedBy,InventoryID,BilletLength)
			--SELECT
			--	NewID(),
			--	ParentID,
			--	LotNumber,
			--	SublotNumber,
			--	ReceivedDate,
			--	'Received',
			--	MaterialGrade,
			--	'CCM',
			--	ID,
			--	'12'	
			--FROM XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
			--where LotNumber=@HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_I_Billets_Tracking_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_Billets_Tracking_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		--RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
	
END
```
