## dbo.XMES_I_ByProduct_Trn_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_I_ByProduct_Trn_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-12-19 14:09:46  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-25 10:15:46  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @heatno | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_I_ByProduct_Trn_Usp]
    @heatno = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------------*/
-- Created By : Nidhi Rana
-- Created On : 19-Dec-2025
-- Description : Insert Record for CCM By Product for each day
/*----------------------*/

CREATE   PROC [dbo].[XMES_I_ByProduct_Trn_Usp]
(@heatno INT)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Plant VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @StorageLocation VARCHAR(50);
	DECLARE @ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(50);
	DECLARE @UomID VARCHAR(36);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*---Get Plant and ManufacturingOrder as per heatno---*/
		SELECT @Plant = [ProductionPlant], @ManufacturingOrder = [WorkOrderNumber] , @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation]
		FROM [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] IN(SELECT [WorkOrder] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] AS CCM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND CCM.[HeatID] = @heatno  );

		SELECT @UOMID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'Ton';
		
		/*-------------Insert SAP By Production For CCM----------*/
		INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl]([SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [QuantityInCount], [PostingMaterialType], [Saptransactionid])
		SELECT 'Entered','T-SQL', [HeatID], Grade1, MMT.[Number], @Plant, @StorageLocation, '531','TO', @ManufacturingOrder,CP.[QtyInTon],1,'BYPRODUCT',''
		FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
		JOIN (
			 SELECT [HeatID], [Material], [QtyinTon], [Grade] as Grade1 FROM (
				SELECT [HeatID], [Grade]
					, CAST(SUM(ISNULL([EndCutMeter],0)* ISNULL(SetWeightTon,0.175)) AS FLOAT) AS [ENDCUT_NA], CAST(SUM(ISNULL(cast(0.15 as decimal(18,4)), 0)) AS FLOAT) AS [SKULL LADLE]
					, CAST(SUM(ISNULL([TundishlossTon], 0)) + SUM(ISNULL([LaunderLosston], 0)) AS FLOAT) AS [SKULL TUNDISH], CAST(SUM(ISNULL([ScaleLossTon],0)) AS FLOAT) AS [CCM Scale] 
				FROM CCM_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0  AND [HeatID] = @heatno
				GROUP BY [HeatID], [Grade]
			) AS t 
			UNPIVOT ([QtyInTon] FOR [Material] IN ([ENDCUT_NA],[SKULL LADLE],[SKULL TUNDISH], [CCM Scale])) AS unpvt
		) AS CP ON MMT.[Name] = CP.[Material]
		WHERE MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 
			AND MMT.[TypeID] IN ('70B716B3-02DB-4D21-9DCC-A31807A4B6D5')
			AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl] AS BPT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE BPT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND BPT.[HeatNo] = CP.[HeatID] AND BPT.[Material] = MMT.[Number])
			AND CP.[QtyInTon] > 0;
			;

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl]
		([ID], [ParentID], [CreatedOn], [Source], [GradeID], [Quantity], [UOMID], [IsExpired], [ReceivedDate], [ItemSource], [MaterialGrade], [PlantName], [StorageLocation], [LotNumber]
		)
		SELECT NEWID(), MMT.[ID], GETDATE(), 'T-SQL', 'TBD', BPT.[QuantityInEntryUnit], @UomID, 0, GETDATE(), 'Produce', BPT.[Grade], [Plant], BPt.[StorageLocation], @heatNo
		FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN [dbo].[MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl] AS BPT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[Number] = BPT.[Material] WHERE MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MMT.[TypeID] IN ('70B716B3-02DB-4D21-9DCC-A31807A4B6D5') AND [HeatNo] = @heatno;
		
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_I_ByProduct_Trn_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_ByProduct_Trn_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_I_Particulars_for_BestData_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_I_Particulars_for_BestData_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-02-23 15:33:33  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-09 13:48:29  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @bestdaydate | date | NO |  |
| @bestMonthDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_I_Particulars_for_BestData_Usp]
    @bestdaydate = '2026-05-04',
    @bestMonthDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------*/
-- Created By : Nidhi Rana
-- Created On : 24-Feb-2026
-- Description : Implement Procedure to insert particulars for best data 
/*-----------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_I_Particulars_for_BestData_Usp](@bestdaydate DATE, @bestMonthDate DATE)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[SMS_Production_BestDay_BestMonth_Data]([SrNo], [BestDayDate], [BestMonthDate], [Particulars], [type], [UOM], [FTDTonBestDay], [FTDPercentageBestDay], [MTDTonBestDay], [MTDPercentageBestDay], [FTDTonBestMonth], [FTDPercentageBestMonth], [MTDTonBestMonth], [MTDPercentageBestMonth])
		SELECT DISTINCT PM.[Srno] AS sr, @bestdaydate, @bestMonthDate, PM.[Particulars], PM.[Type], PM.[UOM], SPS.[FTDTon], SPS.[FTDPercentage], SPS.[MTDTon], SPS.[MTDPercentage], SPS1.[FTDTon], SPS1.[FTDPercentage], SPS1.[MTDTon], SPS1.[MTDPercentage] FROM [dbo].[Particulars_Masters] AS PM WITH(NOLOCK)
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = @bestdayDAte) AS SPS ON PM.[Particulars] = SPS.[Particulars]
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = @bestMonthDate) AS SPS1 ON PM.[Particulars] = SPS1.[Particulars]
		WHERE PM.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND PM.[Particulars] NOT IN ('Best Day Data','Best Month Data')	
		ORDER BY sr

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_I_Particulars_for_BestData_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_Particulars_for_BestData_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END

--TRUNCATE TABLE [SMS_Production_BestDay_BestMonth_Data]
```

## dbo.XMES_I_PlantToPlantTransfer_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_I_PlantToPlantTransfer_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-04-28 14:34:10  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-29 08:45:11  
**Parameter Count:** 5  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @ToPlant | varchar(100) | NO |  |
| @ToStorageLocation | varchar(200) | NO |  |
| @quantityinCount | int | NO |  |
| @quantityInentryUnit | decimal(18,3) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_I_PlantToPlantTransfer_Usp]
    @ID = '',
    @ToPlant = '',
    @ToStorageLocation = '',
    @quantityinCount = 0,
    @quantityInentryUnit = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*---------------------------*/
---Created by : Nidhi Rana
---Created On : 28-Apr-2026
---Description : Entry of To Plant and to Storage Location in Plant to Plant transfer of cold billet from inventory
/*---------------------------*/

CREATE   PROC [dbo].[XMES_I_PlantToPlantTransfer_Usp]
(@ID VARCHAR(36), @ToPlant VARCHAR(100), @ToStorageLocation VARCHAR(200), @quantityinCount INT, @quantityInentryUnit DECIMAL(18,3))
AS 
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @material VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(40);
	DECLARE @Heatno INT;
	DECLARE @SalesOrder VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @SalesOrderitems VARCHAR(100);
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT @Material = MMT.[Name], @Heatno = SUBSTRING(MIMT.[LotNumber], 0, CHARINDEX('_',MIMT.[LotNumber])) FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] AS MIMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMt.[ID] = MIMT.[ParentID] WHERE MIMT.[ID] = @ID;

		SELECT @ManufacturingOrder = [workordernumber], @SalesOrder = [SalesOrder], @SalesOrderitems = [SalesOrderItem] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT [WorkOrder] FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Heatid] = @Heatno)

		INSERT INTO [DBO].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] (Material, Plant, StorageLocation, Batch, EntryUnit, QuantityInEntryUnit, ManufacturingOrder, GoodsMovementType, Supplier, Customer, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, IssgOrRcvgMaterial, IssgOrRcvgBatch, IssuingOrReceivingPlant, IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc, SAPPostingStatus, QuantityInCount, HeatNo, [PostingMaterialType], [CreatedOn], [Source])
		SELECT @Material, [PlantName], [StorageLocation], [LotNumber], 'TO', [Quantity], @ManufacturingOrder, '301', NULL, '100001', @SalesOrder, @SalesOrderitems, @material, [LotNumber], @ToPlant, @ToStorageLocation, 'Posted', [QuantityinCount], @Heatno, [PostingMaterialType], GETDATE(), 'T-SQL'
		FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_tbl] AS MI WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ID AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Hot Billet','Cold Billet') --AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] AS MIMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE MI.[ParentId] = MIMT.[ParentID] AND MI.[LotNumber] = MIMT.[LotNumber] AND MI.[PlantName] = @ToPlant AND [StorageLocation] = @ToStorageLocation)		
			
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_I_PlantToPlantTransfer_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_PlantToPlantTransfer_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';	
	END CATCH
END
```

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_I_SAP_Billet_Production_Trn  
**Created On:** 2025-12-13 11:17:09  
**Modified On:** 2026-05-16 22:05:43  
**Parameter Count:** 5  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @UserId | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @SystemId | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @RecordIds | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @Status | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @DataCollection | nvarchar(max) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_Billet_Production_Trn]
    @UserId = '',
    @SystemId = '',
    @RecordIds = '',
    @Status = '',
    @DataCollection = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana, Mahesh Udar, Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 12-12-2025
-- Change Date: 29-12-2025
-- Changes    : change Name of controls..
-- Description:	Insert Billet Posting Data into Transaction Table
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_Billet_Production_Trn]
(
    @UserId VARCHAR(36),
    @SystemId VARCHAR(36),
    @RecordIds VARCHAR(36),
    @Status VARCHAR(36),
    @DataCollection NVARCHAR(MAX)	
)
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY
	DECLARE @HeatNo INT,
			@WorkOrderid VARCHAR(40),
			@Grade VARCHAR(20),
			@PostingDate DateTime,
			--@PostingMaterialType VARCHAR(10), --(HOT/COLD)
			@Material VARCHAR(40),
			@Plant VARCHAR(40),
			@StorageLocation VARCHAR(40),
			@ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(40),
			@Billet1 VARCHAR(MAX), @Billet2 VARCHAR(MAX), @Billet3 VARCHAR(MAX), @Billet4 VARCHAR(MAX),
			@Billet1QTyinCount INT,@Billet1QTyinTon DECIMAL(18,3),
			@Billet2QTyinCount INT,@Billet2QTyinTon DECIMAL(18,3),
			@Billet3QTyinCount INT,@Billet3QTyinTon DECIMAL(18,3),
			@Billet4QTyinCount INT,@Billet4QTyinTon DECIMAL(18,3), 
			@CutLen1 DECIMAL(14,2), @CutLen2 DECIMAL(14,2), @CutLen3 DECIMAL(14,2), @CutLen4 DECIMAL(14,2), 
			@RemainingQtyinTon DECIMAL(18, 3), @RemainingQtyinCount INT, 
			@TotalPostedBilletCount INT, @TotalPostedBilletTon DECIMAL(18,3),
			@ActualBilletCount INt, @ActualBilletTon DECIMAL(18,3),
			@SAP1 VARCHAR(10), @SAP2 VARCHAR(10), @SAP3 VARCHAR(10), @SAP4 VARCHAR(10),
			@SalesOrderNo VARCHAR(100), @PostedBillet INT, @PostedBilletTon DECIMAL(18, 3),/* @SampleID VARCHAR(36),*/
			@EndCut DECIMAL(18,3), @SkullLadle DECIMAL(18,3), @SkullTundish DECIMAL(18,3), @CCMScale DECIMAL(18,3), @Customername VARCHAR(200), @CrossSection INT, @Setweight FLOAT, @SEqunece VARCHAR(50), @defuserID VARCHAR(36) = 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358',
			@ColorCode VARCHAR(100), @ProductionPlant VARCHAR(100), @SalesOrder VARCHAR(100), @SalesOrderItem VARCHAR(100),
			@Batch1 VARCHAR(100), @Batch2 VARCHAR(100), @Batch3 VARCHAR(100), @Batch4 VARCHAR(100), @MaterialID VARCHAR(36), @UOMID VARCHAR(36), @RecievedDate DATETIME;

	/*---Set Data Collection--*/
	SET @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'[\','[{') set @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'\,\','},{') set @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'\','}');

    DECLARE @ParsedData TABLE ([Key] NVARCHAR(100), [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX));
		SELECT @UOMID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'Ton';

		IF ISJSON(@DataCollection) = 1
		BEGIN
			/*--Store data of data collection---*/
		    INSERT INTO @ParsedData ([Key], [Value]) SELECT [Key], [Value] FROM OPENJSON(@DataCollection) WITH ( [Key] NVARCHAR(100) '$.Key', [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.Value' );	
	
			IF (@Status='Posted')
			BEGIN 		
				SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;
				/*---Get Billet data from data collection--*/
				SELECT 
					@HeatNo = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'HeatID' THEN [Value] END),
					@WorkOrderid = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'WorkOrder' THEN [Value] END),
					@Grade = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'Grade' THEN [Value] END),
					@ProductionPlant = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'ProductionPlant' THEN [Value] END),
					@Billet1QTyinCount = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'NoofBillets1' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS INT) END),
					@Billet2QTyinCount = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'NoofBillets2' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS INT) END),
					@Billet3QTyinCount = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'NoofBillets3' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS INT) END),
					@Billet4QTyinCount = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'NoofBillets4' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS INT) END),
					@RemainingQtyinTon =  MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'RemainingPostedBilletWeightTon' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
					@RemainingQtyinCount=  MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'RemainingPostedBilletCount' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS INT) END),
					@TotalPostedBilletCount = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'TotalPostedBilletCount' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS INT) END),
					@TotalPostedBilletTon = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'TotalPostedBilletWeightTon' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
					@ActualBilletCount = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'ActualBilletCount' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS INT) END),
					@ActualBilletTon = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'ActualBilletWeightTon' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
					@SAP1 = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'PostToSAP1' THEN IIF([value] = 'true', 'Posted', 'Entered') END),
					@SAP2 = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'PostToSAP2' THEN IIF([value] = 'true', 'Posted', 'Entered') END),
					@SAP3 = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'PostToSAP3' THEN IIF([value] = 'true', 'Posted', 'Entered') END),
					@SAP4= MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'PostToSAP4' THEN IIF([value] = 'true', 'Posted', 'Entered') END),
					@SalesOrderNo = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'SalesOrder' THEN [Value] END),
					@EndCut = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'EndCutMeter' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
					@SkullLadle = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'LaunderLossTon' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
					@SkullTundish = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'TundishlossTon' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
					@CCMScale = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'OtherLossesTon' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
					@Billet1 = MAX(CASE WHEN LEN(CASE WHEN [key] = 'BilletType1' THEN [Value] END) != 0 THEN [Value]  END)
						, @Billet1QTyinTon = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'CalcBilletsWeight1' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
						@Billet2 = MAX(CASE WHEN LEN(CASE WHEN [key] = 'BilletType2' THEN [Value] END) != 0 THEN [Value]  END)
						, @Billet2QTyinTon = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'CalcBilletsWeight2' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
						@Billet3 = MAX(CASE WHEN LEN(CASE WHEN [key] = 'BilletType3' THEN [Value] END) != 0 THEN [Value]  END)
						, @Billet3QTyinTon = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'CalcBilletsWeight3' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END),
						@Billet4 = MAX(CASE WHEN LEN(CASE WHEN [key] = 'BilletType4' THEN [Value] END) != 0 THEN [Value]  END)
						, @Billet4QTyinTon = MAX(CASE WHEN [key] = 'CalcBilletsWeight4' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END)
				FROM @ParsedData;
				SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
		 
				/*--Get Material using WorkOrder id--*/
				SELECT @Material = [Name], @ColorCode = [SAPColorCode], @MaterialID = [ID] FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT [ItemID] FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0) AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

				/*--Get Plant, STorage Location and manufacturing order using WorkOrder ID--*/
				SELECT @Plant = [ProductionPlant],
						@StorageLocation = ISNULL([StorageLocation], '2103'),
						@ManufacturingOrder = [WorkOrderNumber],
						@SalesOrder = [SalesOrder],
						@SalesOrderItem = [SalesOrderItem]
				FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  
				WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
							

				/*---Get Customer using Sales order ----*/
				SELECT @Customername = CMT.[Name] FROM XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl AS SOMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
				JOIN XBatch_Customer_Mst_Tbl AS CMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON CMT.[ID] = SOMT.[ParentID]
				WHERE SOMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND CMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND SOMT.[ID] = @SalesOrderNo

				/*--Set sampleID--*/
				--IF @Material LIKE 'BL_%'
				--BEGIN		
				--	SELECT @SampleID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				--	WHERE [ISDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS') AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX));	
				--END
				--ELSE IF @Material LIKE '%GLS%'
				--BEGIN
				--	SELECT @SampleID = [ID] FROM (
				--		SELECT [ID], [sampletype]
				--			, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [heatno] ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE([sampletype], 'L', '') AS INT) DESC) AS [num] 
				--		FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				--		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE 'L[0-9]%' AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
				--	) AS t WHERE [num] = 1
				--END
				--ELSE IF @Material LIKE '%Liquid Metal%'
				--BEGIN
				--	SELECT @SampleID = [ID] FROM (
				--		SELECT [ID], [sampletype]
				--			, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [heatno] ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE([sampletype], 'F', '') AS INT) DESC) AS [num] 
				--		FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				--		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE 'F[0-9]%' AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
				--	) AS t WHERE [num] = 1
				--END
				SET @TotalPostedBilletCount = IIF(@TotalPostedBilletCount = 0 , ISNULL(@Billet1QTyinCount, 0) + ISNULL(@Billet2QTyinCount, 0) + ISNULL(@Billet3QTyinCount, 0) + ISNULL(@Billet4QTyinCount, 0), @TotalPostedBilletCount)
				SET @TotalPostedBilletTon = IIF(@TotalPostedBilletTon = 0, ISNULL(@Billet1QTyinTon, 0) + ISNULL(@Billet2QTyinTon, 0) + ISNULL(@Billet3QTyinTon, 0) + ISNULL(@Billet4QTyinTon, 0), @TotalPostedBilletTon)
				SELECT  @CrossSection = [CrossSection], @Setweight = [SetWeightTon],@SEqunece = 'L' + CAST(ISNULL([LadleSequence], 0) AS VARCHAR(50)), @RecievedDate = [EndTime] FROM [dbo].[ccm_per_heat] WHERE [heatID] = @HeatNo AND [Isdeleted] = 0;
			--IF @ActualBilletCount != @RemainingQtyinCount OR @ActualBilletTon != @RemainingQtyinTon
			--BEGIN
				/*---Update billet data--*/
				SET @RemainingQtyinCount = @ActualBilletCount
				SET @RemainingQtyinTon = @ActualBilletTon
				UPDATE [CCM_Per_Heat] SET [RemainingPostedBilletCount] = @ActualBilletCount, [RemainingPostedBilletWeightTon] = @ActualBilletTon , [ActualBilletWeightTon] = @ActualBilletTon , [ActualBilletCount] = @ActualBilletCount, [EndCutMeter] = @EndCut, [LaunderLossTon] = @SkullLadle, [TundishlossTon] = @SkullTundish, [OtherLossesTon] = @CCMScale,[NoofBillets1]=@Billet1QTyinCount,[NoofBillets2]=@Billet2QTyinCount,[NoofBillets3]=@Billet3QTyinCount,[NoofBillets4]=@Billet4QTyinCount,[PostToSAP1]=IIF(@SAP1 = 'Posted', 1, 0),[PostToSAP2]=IIF(@SAP2 = 'Posted', 1, 0),[PostToSAP3]=IIF(@SAP3 = 'Posted', 1, 0),[PostToSAP4]=IIF(@SAP4 = 'Posted', 1, 0), [TotalPostedBilletCount] = @TotalPostedBilletCount, [TotalPostedBilletWeightTon] = @TotalPostedBilletTon, [SalesOrder] = @SalesOrderNo, [WorkOrder] = @WorkOrderid, [Grade] = @Grade, [Material] = @Material, [Customer] = @Customername, ProductionPlant=@ProductionPlant
				WHERE [ID] = @RecordIds AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			--END

			
			--DECLARE @LRFWorkOrderid VARCHAR(36);
			--DECLARE	@LRFGrade VARCHAR(20);
			
			--SELECT @LRFWorkOrderid = [WorkOrder] FROM [LRF_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo;
			--SELECT @LRFGrade=MMT.Grade from XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WMT WITH(NOLOCK)
			--Join XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl  MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.ID=WMT.ItemID
			--WHERE WMT.ID=@LRFWorkOrderid;
		
			--IF(@Grade!=@LRFGrade)
			--BEGIN
			--	SELECT  @LRFWorkOrderid=WMT.ID from XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WMT WITH(NOLOCK)
			--	Join XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.ID=WMT.ItemID AND MMT.IsDeleted=0
			--	WHERE MMT.Grade=@Grade AND WMT.Equipment='LRF' AND Status IN ('Running','OnHold');
		
			--	UPDATE [DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] SET Grade=@Grade, WorkOrder=@LRFWorkOrderid WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0;
			--END
			--ELSE IF (@Grade=@LRFGrade)
			--BEGIN
			--	UPDATE [DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] SET Grade=@Grade WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo;
			--END

			--IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE STATUS='Running' and ID=@WorkOrderid)
			--BEGIN
			--	UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Running', Source='T-SQL' WHERE ID=@WorkOrderid
			--END

			--IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE STATUS='Running' and ID=@LRFWorkOrderid)
			--BEGIN
			--	UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Running', Source='T-SQL' WHERE ID=@LRFWorkOrderid
			--END

			DECLARE @LRFWorkOrderid VARCHAR(36);
			DECLARE	@LRFMaterialID VARCHAR(36);

			SELECT @LRFMaterialID=GLSGrade from XMES_Billet_VS_GLS_Grade_Mapping BGM WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON BGM.BilletGrade=MST.ID AND MST.IsDeleted=0 AND MST.NAME=@Material
			WHERE BGM.IsDeleted=0
		
			SELECT  @LRFWorkOrderid=WMT.ID from XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WMT WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE WMT.ItemID=@LRFMaterialID AND WMT.Equipment='LRF' AND Status IN ('Running','OnHold');
			
			UPDATE [DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] SET Grade=@Grade, WorkOrder=@LRFWorkOrderid WHERE HeatID=@HeatNo AND IsDeleted=0;

			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE STATUS='Running' and ID=@WorkOrderid)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Running', Source='T-SQL' WHERE ID=@WorkOrderid
			END

			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ID FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE STATUS='Running' and ID=@LRFWorkOrderid)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Running', Source='T-SQL' WHERE ID=@LRFWorkOrderid
			END
	
			IF(@RemainingQtyinCount < ISNULL(@TotalPostedBilletCount,0))
			BEGIN
				SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;
				/*--RAise error when remaining billet less than total billet--*/
				DECLARE @ERROR NVARCHAR(MAX)=(
				Select Concat('The remaining billets to be posted (',@RemainingQtyinCount,') are less than the entered billets (',@TotalPostedBilletCount,')'));
				--SET @BIT=1
				RAISERROR(@ERROR,16,1);
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @PostingDate=(SELECT FORMAT([HeatReportDate],'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00') from [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @RecordIds AND [IsDeleted] = 0)
				/*---When Billet is selected--*/
				IF @Billet1QTyinCount > 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT @CutLen1 = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'CutLenght1' THEN [value] END)
					FROM @ParsedData;
					
					UPDATE [CCM_Per_Heat] SET [BilletType1]=@Billet1,[CalcBilletsWeight1]=@Billet1QTyinTon,[CutLenght1]=@CutLen1, [SAPPostingDate]=@PostingDate
					WHERE [ID] = @RecordIds AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

					/*---Set billet count and billet ton when posted--*/
					SET @PostedBillet = ISNULL(@PostedBillet, 0) + IIF(@SAP1 = 'Posted',  @Billet1QtyinCount, 0);
					SET @PostedBilletTon = ISNULL(@PostedBilletTon, 0) + IIF(@SAP1 = 'Posted',  @Billet1QtyinTon, 0);
					SET @Batch1 = Right('00' + cast(cast(round(@CutLen1,0) as INT) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
			
					/*--Store billet details in production--*/
					INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl](/*[Sampleid],*/SAPPostingStatus,Source,HeatNo,Grade,Material,Plant,StorageLocation,Batch,GoodsMovementType,EntryUnit,ManufacturingOrder,QuantityInEntryUnit,QuantityInCount,PostingMaterialType,Saptransactionid,PostingDate, IsAutoPost, Cutlength,[BilletNo])
					SELECT /*@SampleID,*/ 'Entered','T-SQL', @HeatNo, @Grade, @Material, @Plant, @StorageLocation, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch1 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), '101','TO', @ManufacturingOrder, @Billet1QTyinTon, @Billet1QTyinCount, @Billet1, '', @PostingDate, IIF(@SAP1 = 'Posted', 1, 0), @CutLen1, 1;
					
					
					IF(@Billet1 ='Hot Billet')
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO [DBO].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] (Material, Plant, StorageLocation, Batch, EntryUnit, QuantityInEntryUnit, ManufacturingOrder, GoodsMovementType, Supplier, Customer, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, IssgOrRcvgMaterial, IssgOrRcvgBatch, IssuingOrReceivingPlant, IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc, SAPPostingStatus, QuantityInCount, HeatNo, [PostingMaterialType], [CreatedOn], [Source])
						SELECT @Material, @Plant, @StorageLocation, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch1 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), 'TO', @Billet1QTyinTon, @ManufacturingOrder, '301', Null, '10001', @SalesOrder, @SalesOrderItem, @Material, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch1 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), @ProductionPlant, '3104', 'Entered', @Billet1QTyinCount, @HeatNo, @Billet1, GETDATE(), 'T-SQL'
					END
				END
				IF @Billet2QTyinCount > 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT  @CutLen2 = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'CutLenght2' THEN [value] END)
					FROM @ParsedData;

					UPDATE [CCM_Per_Heat] SET [BilletType2]=@Billet2,[CalcBilletsWeight2]=@Billet2QTyinTon,[CutLenght2]=@CutLen2
					WHERE [ID] = @RecordIds AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

					
					/*--set Billet count and billet ton when posted--*/
					SET @PostedBillet = ISNULL(@PostedBillet, 0)  +IIF(@SAP2 = 'Posted',  @Billet2QtyinCount, 0);
					SET @PostedBilletTon = ISNULL(@PostedBilletTon, 0) + IIF(@SAP2 = 'Posted',  @Billet2QtyinTon, 0);
					SET @Batch2 = Right('00' + cast(cast(round(@CutLen2,0) as INT) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)

					/*--Store Billet details in production--*/
					INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl](/*[Sampleid],*/SAPPostingStatus,Source,HeatNo,Grade,Material,Plant,StorageLocation,Batch,GoodsMovementType,EntryUnit,ManufacturingOrder,QuantityInEntryUnit,QuantityInCount,PostingMaterialType,Saptransactionid,PostingDate, IsAutoPost, Cutlength, [BilletNo])
					SELECT /*@SampleID,*/ 'Entered','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch2 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)),'101','TO',@ManufacturingOrder, @Billet2QTyinTon, @Billet2QTyinCount,@Billet2,'',@PostingDate,  IIF(@SAP2 = 'Posted', 1, 0), @CutLen2, 2;
					
					IF(@Billet2 ='Hot Billet')
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO [DBO].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] (Material, Plant, StorageLocation, Batch, EntryUnit, QuantityInEntryUnit, ManufacturingOrder, GoodsMovementType, Supplier, Customer, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, IssgOrRcvgMaterial, IssgOrRcvgBatch, IssuingOrReceivingPlant, IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc, SAPPostingStatus, QuantityInCount, HeatNo, [PostingMaterialType], [CreatedOn], [Source])
						SELECT @Material, @Plant, @StorageLocation, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch2 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), 'TO', @Billet2QTyinTon, @ManufacturingOrder, '301', Null, '10001', @SalesOrder, @SalesOrderItem, @Material, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch2 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), @ProductionPlant, '3104', 'Entered', @Billet2QTyinCount, @HeatNo, @Billet2, GETDATE(), 'T-SQL'
					END
					
				END
				IF @Billet3QTyinCount > 0
				BEGIN	
					SELECT @CutLen3 = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'CutLenght3' THEN [value] END)
					FROM @ParsedData;

					UPDATE [CCM_Per_Heat] SET [BilletType3]=@Billet3,[CalcBilletsWeight3]=@Billet3QTyinTon,[CutLenght3]=@CutLen3
					WHERE [ID] = @RecordIds AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

					
					/*--set billet count and billet ton when posted--*/
					SET @PostedBillet = ISNULL(@PostedBillet, 0) + IIF(@SAP3 = 'Posted',  @Billet3QtyinCount, 0);
					SET @PostedBilletTon = ISNULL(@PostedBilletTon, 0) + IIF(@SAP3 = 'Posted',  @Billet3QtyinTon, 0);
					SET @Batch3 = Right('00' + cast(cast(round(@CutLen3,0) as INT) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
					Select CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@CutLen4 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2))
					/*--Store billet details in production--*/
					INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl](/*[Sampleid],*/SAPPostingStatus,Source,HeatNo,Grade,Material,Plant,StorageLocation,Batch,GoodsMovementType,EntryUnit,ManufacturingOrder,QuantityInEntryUnit,QuantityInCount,PostingMaterialType,Saptransactionid,PostingDate, IsAutoPost, Cutlength, [BilletNo])
					SELECT /*@SampleID,*/ 'Entered','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch3 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)),'101','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,@Billet3QTyinTon,@Billet3QTyinCount,@Billet3,'',@PostingDate, IIF(@SAP3 = 'Posted', 1, 0), @CutLen3, 3;
					
					IF(@Billet3 ='Hot Billet')
					BEGIN
					INSERT INTO [DBO].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] (Material, Plant, StorageLocation, Batch, EntryUnit, QuantityInEntryUnit, ManufacturingOrder, GoodsMovementType, Supplier, Customer, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, IssgOrRcvgMaterial, IssgOrRcvgBatch, IssuingOrReceivingPlant, IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc, SAPPostingStatus, QuantityInCount, HeatNo, [PostingMaterialType], [CreatedOn], [Source])
					SELECT @Material, @Plant, @StorageLocation, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch3 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), 'TO', @Billet3QTyinTon, @ManufacturingOrder, '301', Null, '10001', @SalesOrder, @SalesOrderItem, @Material, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch3 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), @ProductionPlant, '3104', 'Entered', @Billet3QTyinCount, @HeatNo, @Billet3, GETDATE(), 'T-SQL'
					END
					
				END
				IF @Billet4QTyinCount > 0
				BEGIN	
					SELECT @CutLen4 = MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'CutLenght4' THEN [value] END)
					FROM @ParsedData;

					UPDATE [CCM_Per_Heat] SET [BilletType4]=@Billet4,[CalcBilletsWeight4]=@Billet4QTyinTon,[CutLenght4]=@CutLen4
					WHERE [ID] = @RecordIds AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

					
					/*--set billet count and billet ton when posted--*/
					SET @PostedBillet = ISNULL(@PostedBillet, 0) + IIF(@SAP4 = 'Posted',  @Billet4QtyinCount, 0);
					SET @PostedBilletTon = ISNULL(@PostedBilletTon, 0) + IIF(@SAP4 = 'Posted',  @Billet4QtyinTon, 0);
					SET @Batch4 = Right('00' + cast(cast(round(@CutLen4,0) as INT) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)

					/*--store billet details in production--*/
					INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl](/*Sampleid,*/SAPPostingStatus,Source,HeatNo,Grade,Material,Plant,StorageLocation,Batch,GoodsMovementType,EntryUnit,ManufacturingOrder,QuantityInEntryUnit,QuantityInCount,PostingMaterialType,Saptransactionid, PostingDate, IsAutoPost, Cutlength, [BilletNo])
					SELECT /*@SampleID,*/'Entered','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch4 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)),'101','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,@Billet4QTyinTon,@Billet4QTyinCount,@Billet4,'',@PostingDate, IIF(@SAP4 = 'Posted', 1, 0), @CutLen4, 4;

					IF(@Billet4 ='Hot Billet')
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO [DBO].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] (Material, Plant, StorageLocation, Batch, EntryUnit, QuantityInEntryUnit, ManufacturingOrder, GoodsMovementType, Supplier, Customer, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, IssgOrRcvgMaterial, IssgOrRcvgBatch, IssuingOrReceivingPlant, IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc, SAPPostingStatus, QuantityInCount, HeatNo, [PostingMaterialType], [CreatedOn], [Source])
						SELECT @Material, @Plant, @StorageLocation,CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch4 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), 'TO', @Billet4QTyinTon, @ManufacturingOrder, '301', Null, '10001', @SalesOrder, @SalesOrderItem, @Material, CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@Batch4 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), @ProductionPlant, '3104', 'Entered', @Billet4QTyinCount, @HeatNo, @Billet4, GETDATE(), 'T-SQL'
					END
					
				END

				INSERT INTO XMES_SAP_CreateBatch_Mst_Tbl (Material, Batch, HeatNo, SAPPostingStatus, Source, CreatedBy)
				SELECT @Material, Batch, @HeatNo, 'Entered', 'T-SQL', @UserId from [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo AND PostingMaterialType in ('Cold Billet','Hot Billet')   Group by Batch

				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl]([BatchNo], [HeatNo], [Product], [Length], [Thickness], [Width], [SectionalWeight], [ProductionSectionalWeight], [NoOfPieces],[TonsPerPiece],[ExternalGrade],[ProcessRoute],[InspectionAgency],[TDCRefNo],[ColourCode],[Pieces],[ActualGrade],[HeatSequenceNumber], [Createdby], [Material], [Plant], [ClassNumber], [ClassType], [SAPPostingStatus], [Source])
				Select Batch, max(HeatNo), 'BT', [Cutlength], @CrossSection, @CrossSection, @Setweight, @Setweight, Sum(QuantityInCount),Sum(QuantityInEntryUnit)/Sum(QuantityInCount), @Grade, 'NORM','BY JSIS', NULL,@ColorCode, Sum(QuantityInCount), @Grade,  @SEqunece, ISNULL(@userid, @defuserID), @Material, @Plant, 'BILLET', '023', 'Entered', 'T-SQL' from [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo  and PostingMaterialType in ('Cold Billet','Hot Billet')   Group by Batch,Cutlength;

				---------- Insert item production entry in live inventory table ----------
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl]
				([ID], [ParentID], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [Source], [LotNumber], [GradeID], [Quantity], [UOMID], [IsExpired], [ReceivedDate], [ItemSource], [MaterialGrade], [PlantName], [StorageLocation], [IsPlantToPlantTransfer], [PostingMaterialType], [QuantityInCount]
				)
				SELECT NEWID(), @MaterialID, ISNULL(@userid, @defuserID), GETDATE(), 'T-SQL', Batch, 'TBD', SUM([QuantityInEntryUnit]), @UOMID, 0, GETDATE(), 'Produce', @Grade, ISNULL(@Plant,'7502'), @StorageLocation, 0, [PostingMaterialType], SUM([QuantityInCount]) 
				FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Cold Billet','Hot Billet')  
				GROUP BY [Batch], [HeatNo], [PostingMaterialType];

				/*---Get ProcessStage AND StatePosition ID---*/
				DECLARE @ProcessStageID VARCHAR(36);
				DECLARE @StatePositionID VARCHAR(36);
				SELECT  @StatePositionID = SMT.[ID],  @ProcessStageID = PMT.[StageCode] 
				FROM [dbo].xmes_state_position_State_mst_tbl AS SMT WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN [dbo].[xmes_stage_position_mapping_mst_tbl] AS PMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON SMT.[ID] = PMT.[PositionType] 
				WHERE SMT.[Sequencenumber] = 2 AND SMT.[Isdeleted] = 0 AND PMT.[IsDeleted] = 0

				/*------------Insert Billet trasaction detail---------*/
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Billet_tracking_trn_tbl] ([CreatedOn], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [Heatno], [Batch], [BilletNo], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [StatePosition], [ProcessStage], [MaterialID], [QualityGradeID], [BilletWeight], [UOMID], [ManufacturingOrder], [BilletQuantity], [PostingMaterialType], [CutLength])
				SELECT GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], GETDATE() AS [Entrydatetime], CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AS [Reportdate], [HeatNo], [Batch]
					, CAST([HeatNo] AS VARCHAR(20)) + '_' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [billetno]) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) AS [BilletNo], [Plant]
					, [StorageLocation], @statepositionid AS [StatePosition], @processstageid AS [ProcessstageId], @MaterialID
					, (SELECT [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBATCH_Material_Grade_mst_tbl] AS GMT with(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND (([PostingMaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' AND GMT.[Name] = 'Okay') OR ([PostingMaterialType] = 'Cold Billet' AND GMT.[Name] = 'TBD'))) AS [QualityGradeID], [BilletWt], @UOMID
					, @ManufacturingOrder, 1 AS [BilletQty], [PostingMaterialType], [CutLength] FROM (
					SELECT [heatno], [grade], [material], [plant], [storagelocation], [batch], [manufacturingorder], [Quantityinentryunit], [Quantityinentryunit] / CAST([quantityincount] AS FLOAT) AS [Billetwt], [quantityincount], 1 AS [billetqty], [postingmaterialtype], [cutlength], [billetno] 
					FROM MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl as pt WITH(NOLOCK) 
					WHERE [isdeleted] = 0 AND [heatno] = @Heatno AND [billetno] IS NOT NULL --ORDER BY [heatNo] DESC 
				) AS t OUTER APPLY (SELECT DISTINCT [number] FROM master.dbo.spt_values WHERE [number] BETWEEN 1 AND [Quantityincount]) AS t1
				--INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Billet_Tracking_Trn_tbl]([Reportdate], [createdOn], [EntryDateTime], [HeatNo], [Batch], [BilletNo], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [StatePosition], [ProcessStage], [MaterialID], [QualityGradeID], [BilletWeight], [UOMID])
				--SELECT CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AS [Reportdate], GETDATE(), GETDATE()
				--	, LEFT(t.[LotNumber], CHARINDEX('_', t.[Lotnumber])-1) AS [HeatNo], t.[LotNumber] AS [Batch]
				--	, LEFT(LotNumber,CHARINDEX('_',LotNumber)) + RIGHT('00' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (order by rn) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) as [BilletNo], [PlantName]
				--	, [StorageLocation], @StatePositionID, @ProcessStageID, @MaterialID
				--	, (SELECT GMT.[ID] FROM [dbo].[Xbatch_material_grade_mst_tbl] AS GMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND (([PostingMaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' AND [Name] = 'Okay') OR ([PostingMaterialType] = 'Cold billet' AND [Name] = 'TBD'))) AS [Gradeid], CAST(@TotalPostedBilletTon /  CAST(@TotalPostedBilletCount AS FLOAT) AS FLOAT) AS [BilletWeight], @UOMID
				--FROM (
				--	SELECT [LotNumber], [PostingMaterialType], [Quantityincount] AS cnt
				--		, CASE WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS rn, MMT.[Name], MMT.[Grade], MIMT.[PlantName]
				--		, MIMT.[StorageLocation] ,MIMT.[GradeID] as grade1
				--	FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_mst_tbl] AS MIMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
				--	JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_material_mst_tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MIMT.[ParentID] = MMT.[ID]
				--	WHERE MIMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND [LotNumber] LIKE CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(20))+'_%'  AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Hot Billet','Cold Billet')
				--) AS t
				--OUTER APPLY (SELECT DISTINCT [number] FROM [master].dbo.spt_values WHERE [number] BETWEEN 1 AND cnt) as t1
				--ORDER BY rn;

				/*----Individual Billets entry in Material Item Prod table----*/
				INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Prod_Trn_Tbl]
					([ID], [HeatNo], [CreatedOn], [Source], [LotNumber], [SublotNumber], [Quantity], [UOMID], [MaterialID], [GradeID])
				SELECT NEWID() AS [ID], [HeatNo], GETDATE() AS [Createdon], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [Batch], NULL AS [SublotNumber]
					, SUM([QuantityInEntryUnit]) AS [Quantity], @UOMID, @MaterialID
					, (SELECT [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBATCH_Material_Grade_mst_tbl] AS GMT with(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND GMT.[Name] = 'TBD') AS [GradeID]
				FROM MES_SAP_Production_trn_tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE [isdeleted] = 0 AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Hot Billet','Cold Billet') 
				GROUP BY [Batch], [HeatNo];

				DECLARE @BatchID VARCHAR(36)
				DECLARE cur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
				SELECT ID FROM [XMES_SAP_CreateBatch_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered';
				OPEN cur;
				FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @BatchID;
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					UPDATE XMES_SAP_CreateBatch_Mst_Tbl SET SAPPostingStatus = 'Create', Source = 'T-SQL', ModifiedOn = GETDATE(), ModifiedBy=@UserId WHERE ID=@BatchID;
				FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @BatchID;
				END;
				CLOSE cur;
				DEALLOCATE cur;
				
	
				--SELECT CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',RIGHT('00' + CAST(@CutLen1 AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)), @HeatNo, 'BT', @CutLen1, @CrossSection, @CrossSection, @Setweight, @Setweight, @TotalPostedBilletCount, 2.1, @Grade,'NORM','BY JSIS',NULL, @ColorCode, @ActualBilletCount, @Grade, @SEqunece, ISNULL(@userid, @defuserID), @Material, @Plant, 'BILLET', '023', 'Entered', 'T-SQL';

			
				/*--update remaining billet count and ton.. ----other add columns*/
				UPDATE [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat]  SET RemainingPostedBilletCount= ISNULL(@RemainingQtyinCount,0)-ISNULL(@PostedBillet,0) ,RemainingPostedBilletWeightTon= ISNULL(@RemainingQtyinTon,0)-ISNULL(@PostedBilletTon,0)
				WHERE [ID] = @RecordIds;

				--SELECT @RemainingQtyinCount=RemainingPostedBilletCount,@RemainingQtyinTon=RemainingPostedBilletWeightTon FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK)
				--WHERE ID=@RecordIds AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
					
				/*--update workflow status--*/		
				UPDATE [DBO].[CCM_Per_Heat] SET SAPWorkflowStatus= CASE WHEN (ISNULL(@ActualBilletCount,0)-ISNULL(@TotalPostedBilletCount,0))=0 THEN @Status ELSE 'Entered' END,Source='T-SQL',ModifiedOn=GETDATE(), [TotalPostedBilletCount] = @TotalPostedBilletCount, [TotalPostedBilletWeightTon] = @TotalPostedBilletTon
				WHERE [ID] = @RecordIds;

				/*--when all billet s are posted--*/
				IF ISNULL(@ActualBilletCount,0) - ISNULL(@TotalPostedBilletCount,0) = 0 
				BEGIN	
					--When Posted billets
					--UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = [Quantity] - t.[QuantityInEntryUnit] FROM (
					--	SELECT * FROM [XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [Plant] = @Plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation
					--) AS t WHERE [PlantName] = t.[Plant] AND [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl].[StorageLocation] = t.[StorageLocation] AND [HeatNo] = t.[HeatNo] AND [Batch] = t.[Batch];

					--INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] ([ID], [ParentID], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [Source], [LotNumber], [GradeID], [Quantity], [UOMID], [IsExpired], [ReceivedDate], [ItemSource], [MaterialGrade], [PlantName], [StorageLocation])
					--SELECT NEWID(), @MaterialID, ISNULL(@userid, @defuserID), GETDATE(), 'T-SQL', [Batch], 'TBD', SUM([QuantityInEntryUnit]), @UOMID, 0, GETDATE(), 'Produce', @Grade, [Plant], [StorageLocation] FROM [dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [Plant] = @Plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation;

					/*--Back Calculation--*/
					EXEC XMES_BackCalculation_GLS_Usp @Heatno; 

				--	/*-------------Insert SAP Consumption For CCM----------*/
				--	INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl]([SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [Batch], [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [QuantityInCount], [PostingMaterialType], [Saptransactionid])
				--SELECT 'Posted','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,@HeatNo,'261','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,(SELECT ISNULL([CalcLiquidMetalWeight], 0) FROM [LRF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [HeatID] = @HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0),NULL,'GLS','';

					/*---Production store for LRF and EAF--*/
					EXEC [XMES_I_SAP_GLS_LS_Production_Trn_Usp] @HeatNo;

					/*--Consumtion store for CCM and LRF--*/
					EXEC [XMES_I_SAP_GLS_LS_Consumption_Trn_Usp] @HeatNo;

					/*---Store Byproduct---*/
					EXEC [dbo].[XMES_I_ByProduct_Trn_Usp] @heatNo
				END
			END
		END		
	END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_I_SAP_Billet_Production_Trn] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_Billet_Production_Trn]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		SET @ERROR_MSG = IIF(LEN(@ERROR) = 0, @ERROR_MSG, @ERROR)
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
		
	END CATCH

	
END
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @HeatNo | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql

    @HeatNo = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 22-Dec-2025
	Description : Insert entry for posted in LRF and EAF
------------------------------------*/

CREATE     PROC [dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_GLS_LS_Consumption_Trn_Usp]
(@HeatNo INT)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*----Variable Declaration---*/
	DECLARE @WorkOrderid VARCHAR(36),
			@Grade VARCHAR(20),
			@Material VARCHAR(40),
			@Plant VARCHAR(40),
			@StorageLocation VARCHAR(40),
			@ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(40),
			@GLSQtyinTon DECIMAL(18,2),
			@PostingDate DateTime
	DECLARE @MaterialID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @UOMID VARCHAR(36);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*---Get Workorder id and quantity for LRF---*/
		SELECT @WorkOrderid = [WorkOrder], @GLSQtyinTon = [CalcLiquidMetalWeight], @Grade = [Grade], @PostingDate = FORMAT([HeatReportDate],'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00') FROM [LRF_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo;

		SELECT @UOMID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'Ton';

		/*---Get Material using workorder id ----*/
		SELECT @Material = [Name], @MaterialID = [ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] IN (SELECT [ItemID] FROM [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @WorkOrderid);

		/*-----Get Plant and STorageLocation using workorder id ---*/
		SELECT @Plant = [ProductionPlant], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation]
		FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  
		WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*-----Get Manufacturingorder using workorder id of CCM---*/
		SELECT @ManufacturingOrder = [WorkOrderNumber]
		FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  
		WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT [WorkOrder] FROM [CCM_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo) AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
		
		/*-------------Insert SAP Consumption For CCM----------*/
		INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl]([SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [Batch], [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [QuantityInCount], [PostingMaterialType], [Saptransactionid], PostingDate)
		SELECT 'Entered','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,@HeatNo,'261','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,@GLSQtyinTon,1,'GLS','',@PostingDate;
		
		UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = [Quantity] - @GLSQtyinTon, [ItemSource] = 'Consume'
		WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND [PlantName] = @Plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation AND [LotNumber] = 'GLS_' + CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(20));
		
		---------------------FOR LRF-----------------
		SET @WorkOrderid = NULL;
		SET @GLSQtyinTon = NULL;
		SET @Material = NULL;
		SET @Plant = NULL;
		SET @StorageLocation = NULL;
		SET @ManufacturingOrder = NULL;
		SET @Grade = NULL;
		SET @PostingDate=NULL
		SET @MaterialID = NULL;
		/*---Get Workorder id and quantity for LRF---*/
		SELECT @WorkOrderid = [WorkOrder], @GLSQtyinTon = [CalcLiquidMetalWeight], @Grade = [SteelGrade], @PostingDate = FORMAT([HeatReportDate],'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00') FROM [EAF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo;

		/*---Get Material using workorder id ----*/
		SELECT @Material = [Name], @MaterialID = [ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] IN (SELECT [ItemID] FROM [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @WorkOrderid);

		/*-----Get Plant, STorageLocation and Manufacturingorder using workorder id ---*/
		SELECT @Plant = [Plant], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation]
		FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  
		WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
		
		/*-----Get Manufacturingorder using workorder id of CCM---*/
		SELECT @ManufacturingOrder = [WorkOrderNumber]
		FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  
		WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT [WorkOrder] FROM [LRF_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo) AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*-------------Insert SAP Consumption For CCM----------*/
		INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl]([SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [Batch], [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [QuantityInCount], [PostingMaterialType], [Saptransactionid], PostingDate)
		SELECT 'Entered','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,@HeatNo,'261','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,@GLSQtyinTon,1,'LS','',@PostingDate;

		UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = [Quantity] - @GLSQtyinTon, [ItemSource] = 'Consume'
		WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND [PlantName] = @Plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation AND [LotNumber] = 'LS_' + CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(20));
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_I_SAP_GLS_LS_Consumption_Trn_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_GLS_LS_Consumption_Trn_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	END CATCH 
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*------------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 22-Dec-2025
	Description : Insert entry for posted in LRF and EAF
------------------------------------*/

CREATE     PROC [dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_GLS_LS_Production_Trn_Usp]
(@HeatNo INT)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*----Variable Declaration---*/
	DECLARE @WorkOrderid VARCHAR(36),
			@Grade VARCHAR(20),
			@Material VARCHAR(40),
			@Plant VARCHAR(40),
			@StorageLocation VARCHAR(40),
			@ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(40),
			@GLSQtyinTon DECIMAL(18,3),
			@SampleID VARCHAR(36);
			DECLARE @PostingDATE DATETIME;
			DECLARE @MaterialID VARCHAR(36);
			DECLARE @UOMID VARCHAR(36);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*---Get Workorder id and quantity for LRF---*/
		SELECT @WorkOrderid = [WorkOrder], @GLSQtyinTon = [CalcLiquidMetalWeight], @Grade = [Grade], @PostingDATE = Format(HeatReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00') FROM [LRF_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo;

		/*---Get Material using workorder id ----*/
		SELECT @Material = [Name], @MaterialID = [ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] IN (SELECT [ItemID] FROM [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @WorkOrderid);

		SELECT @UOMID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'Ton';

		/*-----Get Plant, STorageLocation and Manufacturingorder using workorder id ---*/
		SELECT @Plant = [ProductionPlant], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation], @ManufacturingOrder = [WorkOrderNumber]
		FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  
		WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*--Get Sample ID as Per Material FOR LRF---*/
		--IF @Material LIKE 'BL_%'
		--BEGIN		
		--	SELECT @SampleID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ISDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS') AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX));		
		--END
		--ELSE
		IF @Material LIKE '%GLS%'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SampleID =  [ID] FROM (SELECT top 1 [ID] FROM (
				SELECT [ID], [sampletype], 1 AS [num], 1 AS [prt] 
				FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [ISDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS') AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
				UNION
				SELECT [ID], [sampletype]
					, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [heatno] ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE([sampletype], 'L', '') AS INT) DESC) AS [num], 2 AS [prt] 
				FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE 'L[0-9]%' AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
				UNION 
				SELECT [ID], [sampletype]
					, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [heatno] ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE([sampletype], 'F', '') AS INT) DESC) AS [num], 3 AS [prt] 
				FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE 'F[0-9]%' AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
			) AS t WHERE [num] = 1 
			ORDER BY [prt], [num]) as t
		END
		--ELSE IF @Material LIKE '%Liquid Metal%'
		--BEGIN
		--	SELECT @SampleID = [ID] FROM (
		--		SELECT [ID], [sampletype], ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [heatno] ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE([sampletype], 'F', '') AS INT) DESC) AS [num] 
		--		FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE 'F[0-9]%' AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
		--	) AS t WHERE [num] = 1;
		--END
		
		/*-------------Insert SAP Production For LRF----------*/
		INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl]([Sampleid], [SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [Batch], [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [QuantityInCount], [PostingMaterialType], [Saptransactionid], [PostingDate])
		SELECT @SampleID, 'Entered','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,@HeatNo,'101','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,@GLSQtyinTon,1,'GLS','', @PostingDATE;

		
		UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = @GLSQtyinTon, [ItemSource] = 'Produce'
		WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND [PlantName] = @Plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation AND [LotNumber] = 'GLS_' + CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(20));
		--/*-------------Insert SAP Consumption For LRF----------*/
		--INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl]([SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [Batch], [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [QuantityInCount], [PostingMaterialType], [Saptransactionid])
		--SELECT 'Posted','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,@HeatNo,'261','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,(SELECT ISNULL([CalcLiquidMetalWeight], 0) FROM [EAF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo),NULL,'LS','';
			
		/*----Update SAP STatus For LRF----*/
		UPDATE [DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] SET [SAPWorkflowStatus] =  'Posted', [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE() WHERE [HeatID] = @HeatNo;

		---------------------FOR EAF-----------------
		SET @WorkOrderid = NULL;
		SET @GLSQtyinTon = NULL;
		SET @Material = NULL;
		SET @Plant = NULL;
		SET @StorageLocation = NULL;
		SET @ManufacturingOrder = NULL;
		SET @Grade = NULL;
		SET @SampleID = NULL;
		SET @PostingDATE = NULL;
		SET @MaterialID = NULL;

		/*---Get Workorder id and quantity for LRF---*/
		SELECT @WorkOrderid = [WorkOrder], @GLSQtyinTon = [CalcLiquidMetalWeight], @Grade = [SteelGrade], @PostingDATE = Format(HeatReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd 00:00:00') FROM [EAF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo;

		/*---Get Material using workorder id ----*/
		SELECT @Material = [Name] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] IN (SELECT [ItemID] FROM [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @WorkOrderid);

		/*-----Get Plant, STorageLocation and Manufacturingorder using workorder id ---*/
		SELECT @Plant = [Plant], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation], @ManufacturingOrder = [WorkOrderNumber], @MaterialID = [ID]
		FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  
		WHERE [ID] = @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*--Get Sample ID as Per Material---*/
		--IF @Material LIKE 'BL_%'
		--BEGIN		
		--	SELECT @SampleID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ISDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS') AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX));		
		--END
		--ELSE 
		IF @Material LIKE '%GLS%'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SampleID = [ID] FROM (
				SELECT [ID], [sampletype], 1 AS [num], 1 AS [prt] 
				FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [ISDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS') AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
				UNION
				SELECT [ID], [sampletype]
					, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [heatno] ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE([sampletype], 'L', '') AS INT) DESC) AS [num], 2 AS [prt] 
				FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE 'L[0-9]%' AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
				UNION 
				SELECT [ID], [sampletype]
					, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [heatno] ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE([sampletype], 'F', '') AS INT) DESC) AS [num], 3 AS [prt] 
				FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE 'F[0-9]%' AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
			) AS t WHERE [num] = 1 
			ORDER BY [prt], [num]
		END
		--ELSE IF @Material LIKE '%Liquid Metal%'
		--BEGIN
		--	SELECT @SampleID = [ID] FROM (
		--		SELECT [ID], [sampletype], ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [heatno] ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE([sampletype], 'F', '') AS INT) DESC) AS [num] 
		--		FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE 'F[0-9]%' AND [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(MAX))
		--	) AS t WHERE [num] = 1;
		--END
		
		/*-------------Insert SAP Production For EAF----------*/
		INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl](/*[Sampleid],*/ [SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [Batch], [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [QuantityInCount], [PostingMaterialType], [Saptransactionid], [PostingDate])
			SELECT /*@SampleID,*/ 'Entered','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,@HeatNo,'101','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,@GLSQtyinTon,1,'LS','', @PostingDATE;
						
		UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = @GLSQtyinTon, [ItemSource] = 'Produce'
		WHERE [ParentID] = @MaterialID AND [PlantName] = @Plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation AND [LotNumber] = 'LS_' + CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(20));

		/*----Update SAP STatus For EAF----*/
		UPDATE [DBO].[EAF_PER_HEAT] SET [SAPWorkflowStatus] =  'Posted', [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE() WHERE [HeatID] = @HeatNo;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_I_SAP_GLS_LS_Production_Trn_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_GLS_LS_Production_Trn_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	END CATCH 
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana
-- Create date: 12-12-2025
-- Description:	Insert GLS Posting Data into Transaction Table
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_GLS_Production_Trn]
(
    @UserId VARCHAR(36),
    @SystemId VARCHAR(36),
    @RecordIds VARCHAR(36),
    @Status VARCHAR(36),
    @DataCollection NVARCHAR(MAX)	
)
AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY
	DECLARE @HeatNo INT,
			@WorkOrderid VARCHAR(40),
			@Grade VARCHAR(20),
			@Material VARCHAR(40),
			@Plant VARCHAR(40),
			@StorageLocation VARCHAR(40),
			@ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(40),
			@GLSQtyinTon DECIMAL(18,3)


	SET @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'[\','[{') set @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'\,\','},{') set @DataCollection= replace(@DataCollection,'\','}')



    DECLARE @ParsedData TABLE ([Key] NVARCHAR(100), [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX));

		IF ISJSON(@DataCollection) = 1
		BEGIN
		    INSERT INTO @ParsedData ([Key], [Value]) SELECT [Key], [Value] FROM OPENJSON(@DataCollection) WITH ( [Key] NVARCHAR(100) '$.Key', [Value] NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.Value' );
	
	
		IF (@Status='Posted')
		BEGIN 


		
		  SELECT 
		  @HeatNo=  MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'HeatID' THEN [Value] END),
		  @WorkOrderid=  MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'WorkOrder' THEN [Value] END),
		  @Grade=  MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'Grade' THEN [Value] END),
		  @GLSQtyinTon=  MAX(CASE WHEN [Key] = 'CalcLiquidMetalWeight' THEN CAST(IIF(LEN([Value])=0,NULL,[Value]) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) END) 
		  FROM @ParsedData;


		  SELECT @Material=Name FROM [DBO].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) where id in(select ItemID from [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK) where id= @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0) AND [IsDeleted] = 0;
		  SELECT @Plant=Plant,
				 @StorageLocation=StorageLocation,
				 @ManufacturingOrder=WorkOrderNumber from [DBO].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH (NOLOCK)  where id= @WorkOrderid AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

			INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl](SAPPostingStatus,Source,HeatNo,Grade,Material,Plant,StorageLocation,Batch,GoodsMovementType,EntryUnit,ManufacturingOrder,QuantityInEntryUnit,QuantityInCount,PostingMaterialType,Saptransactionid)
			SELECT 'Posted','T-SQL',@HeatNo,@Grade,@Material,@Plant,@StorageLocation,@HeatNo,'110','TO',@ManufacturingOrder,@GLSQtyinTon,NULL,'GLS','';
			
			UPDATE [DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] SET SAPWorkflowStatus=  @Status,Source='T-SQL',ModifiedOn=GETDATE()	where id= @RecordIds;
		END;
		
		END
		END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_I_SAP_GLS_Production_Trn] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_I_SAP_GLS_Production_Trn]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
		
	END CATCH

	
END
```

## dbo.XMES_LRF_I_Raw_Material_Cons_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_LRF_I_Raw_Material_Cons_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-01-17 10:59:28  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-25 10:51:00  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @HeatNo | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_LRF_I_Raw_Material_Cons_Usp]
    @HeatNo = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------*/
--Created by : Nidhi Rana
--Created On : 17-Jan-2026
--Description : Implement procedure to use in work flow of LRF for entered status to insert records of raw materials for lrf
/*--------------------*/
CREATE     PROC [dbo].[XMES_LRF_I_Raw_Material_Cons_Usp] --1600123
 @HeatNo int
 As
 BEGIN
    SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    /*----Variable Declaration---*/
    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @GradeID VARCHAR(36);
    DECLARE @userID VARCHAR(36);
    DECLARE @tbl AS table ([ParentID] VARCHAR(36), [RawMaterialName] VARCHAR(500), [MaterialID] VARCHAR(36), [UOMID] VARCHAR(36), [LotNumber] VARCHAR(200), [Price] float, [EntityName] VARCHAR(200), [AttributeName] VARCHAR(200), [Unit] VARCHAR(200), [Material] VARCHAR(200), [MaterialCode] VARCHAR(200));
	DECLARE @tbl1 AS TABLE ([Value] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Name] VARCHAR(500), [Price] FLOAT)
    BEGIN TRY
        /*---Set user ID of XMES--*/
        SET @userID = 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358';

        /*--Get Grade ID for TBD--*/
        SELECT @GradeID = [ID] FROM [XBatch_Material_Grade_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'TBD';

        /*--Set Query to get material ID and quantity--*/
        INSERT INTO @tbl 
		SELECT CMMt.[ID], CMMT.[RawMaterialName], [materialid], CMMT.[unitid], MIMT.[LotNumber], MIMT.[Price]/*, [entityids], [attributeids]*/, EMT.[Name] AS [entityName]
			, AMT.[Name] AS [AttributeName], MUMT.[Name] AS [UnitName], MMT.[Name] AS [MaterialName], MMT.[Number]
		FROM [dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Mapping_Mst_Tbl] AS CMMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
		LEFT JOIN [XStudio_configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Entities_Mst_tbl] AS EMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON EMT.[ID] IN (SELECT * FROM STRING_SPLIT(CMMT.[EntityIDs], ','))
		LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Attribute_mst_tbl] AS AMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON AMT.[ID] IN (SELECT * FROM STRING_SPLIT(CMMT.[AttributeIDs],',')) AND EMT.[ID] = AMT.[ParentID]
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] AS MUMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MUMT.[ID] = CMMT.[UnitID]
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[ID] = CMMT.[Materialid]
		LEFT JOIN (  SELECT [Lotnumber], [ParentID], [Price] FROM (
						SELECT [Lotnumber], [ParentID],[Quantity],[UOMID],[CreatedOn], ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ParentID] ORDER BY [createdOn]) AS num, [Price] 
						FROM [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] AS MIMT WITH(NOLOCK) 
						WHERE [isdeleted] = 0 AND [quantity] != 0
					) AS t WHERE [num] = 1) AS MIMT ON MIMT.[ParentID] = MMT.[ID]
		WHERE CMMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND CMMT.[Entityids] IS NOT NULL;
	
		SELECT @SQL = 'SELECT SUM([Value]), [Name], SUM([Price]) FROM ('+STUFF((SELECT ' UNION ALL SELECT SUM(CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING([Value], 0, CHARINDEX('':'', [Value])), 0) AS FLOAT)) AS [Value], [Name], SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX('':'',[value]) + 1, LEN([Value])) AS FLOAT)) AS [Price] FROM (SELECT '+STRING_AGG(CAST('CONCAT(['+[AttributeName] + '],'':'',(['+[AttributeName]+'] * ('+CAST(ISNULL([Price], 0) AS VARCHAR(MAX))+') * 1000)) AS ['+RawMaterialName+']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+' FROM '+[EntityName]+' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = '+ CAST(@heatNo AS VARCHAR(10))+') AS t UNPIVOT([Value] FOR [Name] IN ('+STRING_AGG(CAST('['+[RawMaterialName]+']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+')) AS unpvt GROUP BY [Name]' FROM @tbl AS t 
		WHERE [EntityName] IN ('LRF_Per_Heat','EAF_Per_Heat') AND [RawMaterialName] IN (SELECT [RawMaterialName] FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE [EntityName] IN ('LRF_Per_Heat','EAF_Per_Heat') GROUP BY [RawMaterialName] HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT [EntityName]) > 1 ) 
		GROUP BY [EntityName] FOR XML PATH('')),1,10,'')+') AS t GROUP BY [Name]' ;

		IF LEN(ISNULL(@SQL, '')) != 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SQL += ' UNION ALL SELECT SUM(CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING([Value], 0, CHARINDEX('':'', [Value])), 0) AS FLOAT)), [Name], SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX('':'',[value]) + 1, LEN([Value])) AS FLOAT)) FROM (SELECT CONCAT('+STRING_AGG(CAST('ISNULL('+AttributeName+', 0)' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'+')+','':'','+STRING_AGG(CAST('ISNULL('+AttributeName+', 0)' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'+')+' * 1000) AS ['+RawMaterialName+'] FROM '+EntityName+' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = '+ CAST(@heatNo AS VARCHAR(10))+') AS t UNPIVOT([Value] FOR [Name] IN ('+CAST('['+RawMaterialName+']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX))+')) AS unpvt GROUP BY [Name]'
			FROM @tbl AS t 
			WHERE [EntityName] IN ('LRF_Per_Heat') 
				AND [RawMaterialName] IN (SELECT [RawMaterialName] FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE [EntityName] IN ('LRF_Per_Heat') GROUP BY [RawMaterialName] HAVING COUNT([EntityName]) > 1 )  
				AND [RawMaterialName] NOT IN (SELECT [RawMaterialName] FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE [EntityName] IN ('EAF_Per_Heat','LRF_Per_Heat') GROUP BY [RawMaterialName] HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT [EntityName]) > 1 ) 
			GROUP BY [EntityName], [RawMaterialName]
		END

		IF LEN(ISNULL(@SQL,'')) != 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @SQL += ' UNION ALL SELECT SUM(CAST(ISNULL(SUBSTRING([Value], 0, CHARINDEX('':'', [Value])), 0) AS FLOAT)), [Name], SUM(CAST(SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX('':'',[value]) + 1, LEN([Value])) AS FLOAT)) FROM (SELECT '+STRING_AGG(CAST('CONCAT(ISNULL(['+[AttributeName] + '], 0),'':'','+CASE WHEN [AttributeName] = 'ArgonConsumption' THEN 'ISNULL(['+[AttributeName]+'], 0) * ('+CAST(ISNULL([Price], 0) AS VARCHAR(MAX))+')' ELSE '(['+[AttributeName]+'] * ('+CAST(ISNULL([Price], 0) AS VARCHAR(MAX))+') * 1000)' END+') AS ['+RawMaterialName+']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+' FROM '+EntityName+' WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = '+ CAST(@heatNo AS VARCHAR(10))+') AS t UNPIVOT([Value] FOR [Name] IN ('+STRING_AGG(CAST('['+RawMaterialName+']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')+')) AS unpvt GROUP BY [Name]' 
			FROM @tbl AS t
			WHERE [EntityName] IN ('LRF_Per_Heat') /*AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[RawMaterialName] AND t1.[EntityName] != t.[EntityName])*/ 
				AND [RawMaterialName] NOT IN (SELECT [RawMaterialName] FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE [EntityName] IN ('LRF_Per_Heat')  GROUP BY [RawMaterialName] HAVING COUNT([EntityName]) > 1 UNION SELECT [RawMaterialName] FROM @tbl as t1 WHERE [EntityName] IN ('EAF_PER_HEAT','LRF_PER_HEAT') GROUP BY [RawMaterialName] HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT [EntityName]) > 1)
			GROUP BY [EntityName]
		END
		--select @SQL
		INSERT INTO @tbl1 EXEC (@SQL)
  
        /*--Add Material ID wise quantity--*/
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl]
        ([ID], [ParentID], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [Source], [LotNumber], [SublotNumber], [Quantity], [UOMID], [MaterialID], [HeatNo], [GradeID], [DeclareQuantity], [Price])
        SELECT NEWID(), * FROM (
         SELECT DISTINCT [ParentID], @userID AS [CreatedBy], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [LotNumber], NULL AS [SubLotnumber], [Value] AS [Quantity1], [UOMID], [MaterialID], @HeatNo AS [HeatID], @GradeID AS [GradeID], [Value], t1.[Price]
		 FROM @tbl AS T JOIN @tbl1 AS t1 ON t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[Name]
		) AS t;
 
         /*----Update Material ID---*/
         IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_tbl] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT [ParentID], @userID AS [CreatedBy], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [LotNumber], NULL AS [SubLotnumber], [Value] AS [Quantity1], [UOMID], [MaterialID], @HeatNo AS [HeatID], @GradeID AS [GradeID], [Value], t1.[Price], t.[RawMaterialName]
		 FROM @tbl AS T JOIN @tbl1 AS t1 ON t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[Name]) AS t2 ON t1.[ParentID] = t2.[ParentID] AND t1.[isdeleted] = 0 AND t1.[heatNo] = @HeatNo AND t1.[MaterialID] != t2.[MaterialID] OR t1.[LotNumber] != t2.[LotNumber] OR t1.[Price] != t2.[Price] OR t1.[LotNumber] IS NULL)
         BEGIN
             UPDATE [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl] SET [MaterialID] = t1.[MaterialID], [LotNumber] = t1.[LotNumber], [Price] = t1.[Price] FROM (SELECT DISTINCT [ParentID], @userID AS [CreatedBy], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [LotNumber], NULL AS [SubLotnumber], [Value] AS [Quantity1], [UOMID], [MaterialID], @HeatNo AS [HeatID], @GradeID AS [GradeID], [Value], t1.[Price], t.[RawMaterialName]
		 FROM @tbl AS T JOIN @tbl1 AS t1 ON t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[Name]) AS t1
             WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[ParentID] = t1.[ParentID] AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo 
                 AND ([XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[MaterialID] != t1.[MaterialID] OR [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[LotNumber] != t1.[LotNumber] OR [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[Price] != t1.[Price] OR [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[LotNumber] IS NULL);
         END

        /*-----Material Inventory Quantity and Price-----*/
        UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = CASE WHEN [Quantity] < ISNULL(t1.[Value] , 0) THEN 0 ELSE [Quantity] - ISNULL(t1.[Value] , 0) END
            , [AvailableQuantityPrice] = dbo.[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl].[Price] * (CASE WHEN [Quantity] < ISNULL(t1.[Value] , 0) THEN 0 ELSE [Quantity] - ISNULL(t1.[Value] , 0) END)
            , [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE()
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT [ParentID], @userID AS [CreatedBy], GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], [LotNumber], NULL AS [SubLotnumber], [Value] AS [Quantity1], [UOMID], [MaterialID], @HeatNo AS [HeatID], @GradeID AS [GradeID], [Value], t1.[Price], t.[RawMaterialName]
		 FROM @tbl AS T JOIN @tbl1 AS t1 ON t.[RawMaterialName] = t1.[Name]) AS t1 
        WHERE t1.[LotNumber] = [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl].[LotNumber] AND [XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl].[ParentID] = 
        t1.[MaterialID]
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_LRF_I_Raw_Material_Cons_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
        DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_LRF_I_Raw_Material_Cons_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
    END CATCH
End

--XMES_LRF_I_Raw_Material_Cons_Usp 1601239
```
