## dbo.XMES_MaterialProcess_Cursor_usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_MaterialProcess_Cursor_usp  
**Created On:** 2026-04-21 14:47:02  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-24 17:16:19  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Campaignid | varchar(max) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_MaterialProcess_Cursor_usp]
    @Campaignid = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_MaterialProcess_Cursor_usp]
(
    @Campaignid as varchar(MAX) 
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

  
    DECLARE @MaterialID varchar(MAX);
    Declare @productname Varchar(MAX)
    DECLARE @MaterialName VARCHAR(MAX)
    DECLARE @newSize Decimal(10,2);
  

    Select @newSize=size,@productname=P.Name from
    Xmes_Campaign_plan_mst AS C
    inner join Product_Master as P ON C.productname=P.ID
    where C.isdeleted=0 and (campaignid=@Campaignid or C.id = @Campaignid);
   
    DECLARE Material_Cursor CURSOR FOR 
    SELECT ID, MaterialNo
    FROM XMES_RM_campaign_plan_trn
    WHERE isdeleted = 0 and (campaignid=@Campaignid or CampaignId = (select CampaignId from XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst where id=@Campaignid))

   
    OPEN Material_Cursor;

   
    FETCH NEXT FROM Material_Cursor INTO @MaterialID, @MaterialName;

   
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      select @productname,@MaterialName,cast(cast(@newSize as decimal(10,1)) as varchar(MAX))
        
        If @productname ='Round Bar' 
            Begin
                IF @MaterialName LIKE '%BR%' and  @MaterialName lIke '%'+cast(cast(@newSize as decimal(10,1)) as varchar(MAX))+'%'
                    BEGIN 
            
                        update XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_trn
                        set validation=1
                        where id=@MaterialID and isdeleted=0;
            
          
                    END
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        update XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_trn
                        set validation=0
                         where id=@MaterialID and isdeleted=0;
                 
                    END        
            END

      else if @productname ='WRM' 
            Begin
                IF @MaterialName LIKE '%WR%' and  @MaterialName lIke '%'+cast(cast(@newSize as decimal(10,1)) as varchar(MAX))+'%'
                    BEGIN 
            
                        update XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_trn
                        set validation=1
                        where id=@MaterialID and isdeleted=0;
            
          
                    END
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        update XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_trn
                        set validation=0
                         where id=@MaterialID and isdeleted=0;
                 
                    END        
            END

            else if @productname ='Rebar in Coil' 
            Begin
                IF @MaterialName LIKE '%RC%' and  @MaterialName lIke '%'+cast(cast(@newSize as decimal(10,1)) as varchar(MAX))+'%'
                    BEGIN 
            
                        update XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_trn
                        set validation=1
                        where id=@MaterialID and isdeleted=0;
            
          
                    END
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        update XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_trn
                        set validation=0
                         where id=@MaterialID and isdeleted=0;
                 
                    END        
            END

            else if @productname ='Rebar' 
            Begin
                IF @MaterialName LIKE '%RB%' and  @MaterialName lIke '%'+cast(cast(@newSize as decimal(10,1)) as varchar(MAX))+'%'
                    BEGIN 
            
                        update XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_trn
                        set validation=1
                        where id=@MaterialID and isdeleted=0;
            
          
                    END
                ELSE
                    BEGIN
                        update XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_trn
                        set validation=0
                         where id=@MaterialID and isdeleted=0;
                 
                    END        
            END





    FETCH NEXT FROM Material_Cursor INTO @MaterialID, @MaterialName;
    END

   
    CLOSE Material_Cursor;
    DEALLOCATE Material_Cursor;

END
```

## dbo.XMES_Missing_Heat_Entry_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Missing_Heat_Entry_USP  
**Created On:** 2026-04-10 15:41:28  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-24 15:53:27  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @HEATID | int | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Missing_Heat_Entry_USP]
    @HEATID = 0;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Missing_Heat_Entry_USP] --'1602617'
    @HEATID INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY

--IF HEAT IS MISSING IN CCM TABLE--
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CCM_Per_Heat WHERE HeatID=@HEATID)
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO ccm_per_heat(HeatID,StartTime,EndTime,Status,EquipmentID,source)
	SELECT @HEATID, StartTime,EndTime,(Case When Status='CCM Arm 1 Casting Position' then 'Arm 1 Cast Position' else 'Arm 2 Cast Position' end),'AF9C2004-2433-4481-B444-B6DB89F706EF', 'T-SQL' FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime WITH(NOLOCK) where ActualHeatID=@HEATID and StateSequence=13

DECLARE @WorkOrder VARCHAR(36), @SalesOrder VARCHAR(36), @Grade VARCHAR(100), @Material VARCHAR(36), @CustomerID VARCHAR(36) = 'C2D3E8B6-E5E4-4E49-9AAB-7CFD410615D3', @UserID VARCHAR(36) = 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358', @HeatReportDate DATE,@glsMAterial varchar(200),@glsWorkOrder varchar(36);;

	SELECT @WorkOrder = [ID], @SalesOrder = [SalesOrder], @Grade = [Grade], @Material = [MaterialName] FROM [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Status] = 'Running' AND [Equipment] = 'CCM' AND [IsDeleted] = 0;  

	UPDATE CCM_PER_HEAT SET WorkOrder=@WorkOrder, SalesOrder=@SalesOrder, Grade =@Grade, Material=@Material, WorkflowStatus='Completed', Source='T-SQL' WHERE HEATID=@HeatID
	DECLARE @LotNo VARCHAR(500), @liquidMetal DECIMAL(18,4);
	SELECT @glsWorkOrder=WorkOrder,@liquidMetal = [LiquidMetalWeight], @LotNo = [LotNo], @HeatReportDate = [HeatReportDate] FROM (SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL([LiquidMetalWeight], 0) AS [LiquidMetalWeight], CONCAT('GLS_', CAST(@HeatID AS INT)) AS [LotNo], [HeatReportDate],WorkOrder FROM LRF_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [HeatID] = @HeatID AND [IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC) AS t;
	IF(@liquidMetal > 0)
	BEGIN
 SELECT @glsMAterial = [Name] FROM [XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT [ItemID] FROM xstudio_Xbatch.dbo.xbatch_work_order_mst_tbl WHERE [id] = @glsWorkOrder );
  EXEC [XBatch_I_Material_Consume_NoBOM_USP] @Grade = 'TBD', @HeatNo = @HeatID, @ItemName = @glsMAterial, @LotNumber = @LotNo, @ProduceItem = 1, @Quantity = @liquidMetal, @SublotNumber = NULL, @UOMName = 'ton', @UserID = @UserId;
END

IF ((SELECT COUNT(HEATID) FROM BilletsCastCount WHERE HEATID=(@HEATID -1))>1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @CASTID VARCHAR(36)
		SELECT TOP 1 @CASTID=ID FROM BilletsCastCount WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE HeatID=@HEATID-1 ORDER BY StartTime DESC
		UPDATE BilletsCastCount SET HeatID=@HEATID, WorkFlowStatus='Completed', Source='T-SQL' WHERE ID=@CASTID
	END
END

--IF HEAT IS PRESENT IN CCM AND PRODUCTION >0 BUT NOT SHOWING IN CCM---
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CCM_Per_Heat WHERE HeatID=@HEATID AND TotalProduction>0)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE CCM SET CCM.HeatReportDate=EAF.HeatReportDate, CCM.ReportDate=EAF.ReportDate FROM CCM_PER_HEAT CCM
		JOIN EAF_PER_HEAT EAF WITH(NOLOCK) ON CCM.HeatID=EAF.HeatID AND EAF.IsDeleted=0
		WHERE CCM.HEATID=@HEATID AND CCM.IsDeleted=0
	END
--IF HEAT IS PRESENT IN CCM BUT PRODUCTION <=1 OR NULL AND NOT SHOWING IN CCM--
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CCM_Per_Heat WHERE HeatID=@HEATID AND (TotalProduction IS NULL OR TotalProduction<1))
	BEGIN
		--IF HEAT ENTRY IS PRESENT IN BILLETSCASTCOUNT--
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM BilletsCastCount WHERE HeatID=@HEATID)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE BCC SET BCC.StartTime=PET.StartTime, BCC.EndTime=PET.EndTime,BCC.Source='T-SQL', BCC.WorkFlowStatus='Completed' FROM BilletsCastCount BCC WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime PET WITH(NOLOCK) ON BCC.HeatID=PET.ActualHeatID AND PET.ActualHeatID=@HEATID AND PET.StateSequence=14
			END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			--IF HEAT ENTRY IS NO PRESENT IN BILLETSCASTCOUNT--
			INSERT INTO billetscastcount (heatid,starttime,endtime,EquipmentID,Status,WorkFlowStatus,source)
			SELECT ActualHeatID, StartTime, EndTime, 'AF9C2004-2433-4481-B444-B6DB89F706EF','Billets Produces Start','Completed','T-SQL' FROM SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime PET WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE PET.ActualHeatID=@heatid AND PET.ActualHeatID=@HEATID AND PET.StateSequence=14
		END
END
END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH

        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  
            'SP : XMES_Missing_Heat_Entry_USP | Message : ' 
            + ERROR_MESSAGE() + ' | Line : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());

        DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());

        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP]
            @Type = 'SQL-Error',
            @Action = '[dbo].[XMES_Missing_Heat_Entry_USP]',
            @Message = @ERROR_MSG,
            @StackTrace = @ERROR_LINE,
            @UserID = '',
            @HostAddress = '',
            @Info = '',
            @Source = 'T-SQL';

        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG, 16, 1);

    END CATCH
END
```

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Power_Consumption_Report_Per_Ton_Data_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-04-07 12:51:12  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-08 08:54:47  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @EntryDateTime | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Power_Consumption_Report_Per_Ton_Data_Usp]
    @EntryDateTime = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------------------*/
-- Created by : Priyanka Makwana
-- Created on : 07-Apr-2026
-- Description : Implement Per Ton Power consumption report data
/*--------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Power_Consumption_Report_Per_Ton_Data_Usp] (@EntryDateTime As Date)
AS
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT  EntryDateTime,
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(PlantTotal / NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Plant Total Per Ton], 
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(SMSTotal/ NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL (18,2)) AS [SMS Total Per Ton],
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(EAF / NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [EAF Per Ton],
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(LRF / NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [LRF Per Ton],
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(SMSAuxWithO2/ NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL (18,2)) AS [SMS Aux With O2 Per Ton], 
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(SMSAuxWithoutO2/ NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL (18,2)) AS [SMS Aux Without O2 Per Ton],
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(OxygenPlant4A / NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Oxygen Plant Per Ton],
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(NGConsumption / NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [NG Consumption Per Ton],
			CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(SMSConsumption / NULLIF(TotalProduction, 0), 0), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [SMS Consumption Per Ton]
		FROM Power_Consumption_Report 
			WHERE EntryDateTime >= 
    CASE 
        WHEN DAY(@EntryDateTime) = 1 
        THEN DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @EntryDateTime) - 1, 0)
        ELSE DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EntryDateTime), MONTH(@EntryDateTime), 1)
    END
AND EntryDateTime < 
    CASE 
        WHEN DAY(@EntryDateTime) = 1 
        THEN DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @EntryDateTime), 0)
        ELSE CAST(@EntryDateTime AS DATE)
    END
		--Order BY 1 desc

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : [XMES_Power_Consumption_Report_Per_Ton_Data_Usp] | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Power_Consumption_Report_Per_Ton_Data_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```

**Modified On:** 2026-04-15 09:17:02

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |


### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------------------*/
-- Created by : Nidhi Rana
-- Created on : 13-Feb-2026
-- Description : Implement Procedure to add/update power consumption report data
/*--------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Power_Consumption_report_Usp]  (@EntryDate DATE )
AS 
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRY
		DECLARE @tbl AS TABLE ([Entrydatetime] DATETIME, [ReportDate] DATE, [Transformer132KV1] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Transformer132KV2] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Transformer33KV1] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Transformer33KV2] DECIMAL(18, 4), [EAF] DECIMAL(18, 4), [LRF] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Transformer24MVA] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Transformer15MVA] DECIMAL(18, 4), [RollingMill] DECIMAL(18, 4), [WRM] DECIMAL(18, 4), [OxygenPlant4A] DECIMAL(18, 4), [NGConsumptionSm3] DECIMAL(18, 4), [TotalProduction] decimal(18,4), [RMNGConsumption] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Plant_Total] DECIMAL(18, 4), [SMS_Total] DECIMAL(18, 4), [SMSAuxWithO2] DECIMAL(18, 4), [SMSAuxWithoutO2] DECIMAL(18, 4), [TotalRollingMill] DECIMAL(18, 4), [63MVALosses] DECIMAL(18, 4), [125MVALosses] DECIMAL(18, 4), [SMSConsumption] DECIMAL(18, 4));

		INSERT INTO @tbl
		SELECT *, [Transformer132KV1] + [Transformer132kv2] AS [Plant_Total], [Transformer132KV1] + [Transformer132kv2] - [RollingMill] as [SMS_Total], [Transformer132KV1] + [Transformer132kv2] - [RollingMill] - [EAF] - [LRF] AS [SMSAuxWithO2], [Transformer132KV1] + [Transformer132kv2] - [RollingMill] - [EAF] - [LRF] - [OxygenPlant4A] AS [SMSAuxWithoutO2], [RollingMill] + [WRM] AS [TotalRollingMill], [Transformer132KV1] - [Transformer33KV1] AS [63MVALosses], [Transformer132KV2] - [Transformer33KV2] AS [125MVALosses], [NGConsumptionSm3] - [RMNGConsumption] AS [SMSConsumption] FROM (
			SELECT PCL.[EntryDateTime], PCL.[ReportDate]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer132kv1]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [transformer132KV1] AS [Transformer132KV1]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer132kv2]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer132kv2] AS [Transformer132KV2]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer33kv1]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer33kv1] AS [Transformer33KV1]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer33kv2]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer33kv2] AS [Transformer33KV2]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([EAF]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [EAF] AS [EAF]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([LRF]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [LRF] AS [LRF]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer24MVA]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer24MVA] AS [Transformer24MVA]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer15MVA]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer15MVA] AS [Transformer15MVA]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([RollingMill]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [RollingMill] AS [RollingMill]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([WRM]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [WRM] AS [WRM]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([OxygenPlant4A]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [OxygenPlant4A] AS [OxygenPlant4A]
				, /*ISNULL(LEAD([NGConsumptionSm3]) OVER (ORDER BY [Entrydatetime]), 0) - */ISNULL([NGconsumptionSM3], 0) AS [NGConsumptionSm3]
				, /*ISNULL(LEAD(COALESCE(CCM.[ActualBilletweightton], CCM.[TotalProduction], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[EntryDateTime]), 0) -*/ COALESCE(CCM.[ActualBilletweightton], CCM.[totalproduction], 0) AS [TotalProduction]
				, /*ISNULL(LEAD(RM.[NgCons]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[EntryDateTime]), 0) -*/ ISNULL(RM.[NGCons], 0) AS [RMNGConsumption]
			FROM [dbo].[Power_Consumption_LogSheet] AS PCL WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN [dbo].[CCM_Summary_Day] AS CCM WITH(NOLOCK) ON PCL.[EntryDateTime] = CCM.[ReportDate] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[RM_Consumption_Summary_Day] AS RM WITH(NOLOCK) ON PCL.[EntryDateTime] = RM.[ReportDate] AND RM.[IsDeleted] = 0
			WHERE PCL.[IsDeleted] = 0 
		) AS t --where ([Reportdate] = @Entrydate OR @Entrydate is null)
		
		UPDATE [dbo].[Power_Consumption_Report] SET [ReportDate] = t.[ReportDate], [Transformer132kv1] = t.[Transformer132Kv1], [Transformer132kv2] = t.[Transformer132Kv2], [Transformer33kv1] = t.[Transformer33kv1], [Transformer33kv2] = t.[transformer33Kv2], [EAF] = t.[EAF], [LRF] = t.[LRF], [Transformer24MVA] = t.[Transformer24MVA], [Transformer15MVA] = t.[Transformer15MVA], [RollingMill] = t.[RollingMill], [WRM] = t.[WRM], [OxygenPlant4A] = t.[OxygenPlant4A], [NGConsumption] = t.[NGConsumptionSm3], [PlantTotal] = t.[Plant_Total], [SMSTotal] = t.[SMS_Total], [TotalRollingMill] = t.[TotalRollingMill], [SMSAuxWithO2] = t.[SMSAuxwithO2], [SMSAuxWithoutO2] = t.[SMSAuxWithoutO2], [Transformer63MVALosses] = t.[63MVALosses], [Transformer125MVALosses] = t.[125MVALosses], [RMNGConsumption] = t.[RMNGConsumption], [TotalProduction] = t.[TotalProduction], [SMSConsumption] = t.[SMSConsumption], [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL'
		FROM @tbl AS t WHERE CAST([Power_Consumption_Report].[EntryDateTime] AS DATE) = CAST(t.[entrydatetime] AS DATE) AND [Power_Consumption_Report].[Reportdate] = DATEADD(dd,-1,@Entrydate)

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[Power_Consumption_Report]([EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [Transformer132kv1], [Transformer132kv2], [Transformer33kv1], [Transformer33kv2], [EAF], [LRF], [Transformer24MVA], [Transformer15MVA], [RollingMill], [WRM], [OxygenPlant4A], [NGConsumption], [PlantTotal], [SMSTotal], [TotalRollingMill], [SMSAuxWithO2], [SMSAuxWithoutO2], [Transformer63MVALosses], [Transformer125MVALosses], [TotalProduction], [RMNGConsumption], [SMSConsumption], [CreatedOn], [Source])
		SELECT *, GETDATE(), 'T-SQL' FROM (
			SELECT [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [Transformer132kv1], [Transformer132kv2], [Transformer33kv1], [transformer33kv2], [EAF], [LRF], [Transformer24MVA], [Transformer15MVA], [RollingMill], [WRM], [OxygenPlant4A], [NGConsumptionSm3], [Plant_total], [SMS_Total], [TotalRollingMill], [SMSAuxWithO2], [SMSAuxWithoutO2], [63MVALosses], [125MVALosses], [TotalProduction], [RMNGConsumption], [SMSConsumption]
			FROM @tbl
		) AS t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Power_Consumption_Report] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE t1.[EntryDateTime] = t.[EntryDateTime]);
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XMES_Power_Consumption_Report_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Power_Consumption_Report_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```


### Full Definition

```sql
/*--------------------*/
--Created by : Nidhi Rana
--Created on : 16-Jan-2026
--Description : day wise status count for raw material consumption
/*--------------------*/

CREATE   PROCEDURE [XMES_Raw_Material_cons_status_count_usp]
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Get status count for all days of raw material consumption--*/
		SELECT [ReportDate], SUM(ISNULL([Entered],0)) AS [Pending], SUM(ISNULL([Posted], 0)) AS [Completed], SUM(ISNULL([Error], 0)) AS [Error] FROM (
			SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Count], [SAPWorkflowStatus], [ReportDate] 
			FROM MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 
			GROUP BY [ReportDate], [SAPWorkflowStatus]
		) AS t PIVOT (SUM([Count]) FOR [SAPWorkflowstatus] IN ([Entered],[Posted],[Error])) AS pvt
		GROUP BY [ReportDate]
		ORDER BY [ReportDate] DESC;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) = 'SP : XMES_Raw_Material_cons_status_count_usp | LINE No : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()) + '| MESSAGE : '+ERROR_MESSAGE()+' | no :-'+CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_state());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) 
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].  [XMES_Raw_Material_cons_status_count_usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID=''
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------*/
--CREATED BY : Nidhi Rana
--CREATED ON : 26-Dec-2025
--DESCRIPTION : Recalculate backcalcuation of GLS
/*-----------------*/

---EXEC [Xstudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_BackCalculation_GLS_Usp] NULL, NULL, '23-Oct-2025'
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_BackCalculation_GLS_Usp] (
--DECLARE 
	@HeatReportdate DATE,
	@FromHeat INT = Null--= 1507067
	,@ToHeat INT = Null--= 1507772
	 --= '28-Nov-2025'
	)
	AS 
BEGIN 
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	/*--Variable declaration--*/
	DECLARE @Filter NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
	DECLARE @STr NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Cur CURSOR;
	DECLARE @HeatID INT;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Set Filter---*/
		IF @HeatReportdate IS NOT NULL 
		BEGIN 
			SET @Filter = '  ([HeatReportdate] >= '''+CAST(@HeatReportdate AS VARCHAR(30))+''')'
			
			IF @FromHeat IS NOT NULL AND @ToHeat IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = ' AND (' + @Filter + ' OR ([HeatID] BETWEEN '+CAST(@FromHeat AS VARCHAR(20))+' AND '+CAST(@ToHeat AS VARCHAR(20))+'))';
			END
			ELSE IF @FromHeat IS NULL AND @ToHeat IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = ' AND (' + @Filter + ' AND [HeatID] <= '+CAST(@ToHeat AS VARCHAR(20))+')';
			END
			ELSE IF @FromHeat IS NOT NULL AND @ToHeat IS NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = ' AND (' + @Filter + ' OR [HeatID] >= '+CAST(@FromHeat AS VARCHAR(20))+')';
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = ' AND '+@Filter
			END
			
		END
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			IF @FromHeat IS NOT NULL AND @ToHeat IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = ' AND ([HeatID] BETWEEN '+CAST(@FromHeat AS VARCHAR(20))+' AND '+CAST(@ToHeat AS VARCHAR(20))+')';
			END
			ELSE IF @FromHeat IS NULL AND @ToHeat IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = ' AND ([HeatID] <= '+CAST(@ToHeat AS VARCHAR(20))+')';
			END
			ELSE IF @FromHeat IS NOT NULL AND @ToHeat IS NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = ' AND ([HeatID] >= '+CAST(@FromHeat AS VARCHAR(20))+')';
			END
		END

		/*--Open Cursor For heatids--*/
		SET @STr = 'SET @Cur = Cursor FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT [HeatID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[LRF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 '+@Filter+'
		OPEN @Cur';
		--PRINT(@str)
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STr ,N'@Cur CURSOR OUTPUT', @Cur OUTPUT;
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM @Cur INTO @HeatID;
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				/*--Query for back calculation--*/
				SET @str = 'EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XMES_BackCalculation_GLS_Usp] '+CAST(@HeatId AS VARCHAR(20))+';';
				PRINT(@STR);
				EXEC (@STR);
				FETCH NEXT FROM @Cur INTO @HeatID;
			END
		CLOSE @Cur;
		DEALLOCATE @Cur;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		IF CURSOR_STATUS ('LOCAL','@Cur') >= -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE @Cur;
			DEALLOCATE @Cur;
		END
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_Recalculate_BackCalculation_GLS_USP | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_BackCalculation_GLS_USP]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_Recalculate_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Recalculate_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-03-20 15:04:00  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-26 10:51:18  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Reportdate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION_Usp]
    @Reportdate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------------------*/
	--Created By : Nidhi Rana
	--Created On : 20-Mar-2026
	--Description : store and update LRF and Tundish records having deviation in Quality deviation from heat of given reportdate
/*----------------------------*/
--XMES_Recalculate_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION_Usp '01-MAr-2026'
CREATE   PROCEDURE XMES_Recalculate_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION_Usp(@Reportdate DATE)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @startheat INT;
	DECLARE @EndHeat INT;
	DECLARE @ColLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @ColLst1 NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @tbl AS TABLE ([ReportDate] DATE, [ShiftInCharge] VARCHAR(200), [Shift] VARCHAR(100), [HeatNo] VARCHAR(200), [Grade] VARCHAR(200), [Elements] VARCHAR(200), [LRF] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Tundish] DECIMAL(18, 4));
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Get start heat and end heat as per passed date---*/
		SELECT @startheat = MIN(FirstHeatno), @endheat = MAX(LastHeatno) FROM heat_end_selection_trn_tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [reportdate] >= @reportdate

		/*----Set Column List for Chemistry----*/
		SELECT @ColLst =  STRING_AGG(CAST('[' + col +']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),','), @ColLst1 = STRING_AGG(cast(CONCAT('CONCAT([',col,'Min],''_'',[', col,'Max]) AS [',col,']') AS nvarchar(max)),',') FROM (
			SELECT DISTINCT LEFT(Column_name,LEN(COLUMN_NAME) - 3) AS col--, 'CONCAT('+STRING_AGG('['+ column_name+']',',''_'',') + ') AS [' + LEFT(Column_name,LEN(COLUMN_NAME) - 3)+']' AS Col1
			FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'XMES_SMS_Grade_Protocol_Chemistry_mst_tbl' AND (column_name LIKE '%Max' OR column_name LIKE '%min')
			GROUP BY LEFT(Column_name,LEN(COLUMN_NAME) - 3)
		) AS t

		/*----Get and store data of deviation whose sampletype of TS and TD are released----*/
		SET @SQL = 
		'		
		SELECT [ReportDate], [Chemist], [Shift], [Heatno], [Grade], [element], sum(ISNULL([LRF], 0)) AS [LRF], SUM(ISNULL([Tundish], 0)) AS [Tundish] FROM  (
			SELECT [ReportDate], CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,ReportedTime) BETWEEN 6 AND 18 THEN ''D'' ELSE ''N'' END AS [Shift], [Chemist], [HeatNo], [Grade] ,[Element], [LRF], [Tundish] FROM (
				SELECT t.* FROM (
					SELECT *, CASE WHEN [SampleType] IN (''TD'',''TS'') THEN ''Tundish'' WHEN [SampleType] LIKE ''L[0-9]'' THEN ''LRF'' END AS [SM] FROM (
						SELECT [ReportDate], [ReportedTime]
							, CASE WHEN [SampleName] NOT LIKE [HeatNo] + ''%''
								THEN LTRIM(RIGHT(SUBSTRING([SampleName], PATINDEX(''%[A-Z]%'', [SampleName]), LEN([SampleName])), LEN(SUBSTRING([SampleName], PATINDEX(''%[A-Z]%'', [SampleName]), LEN([SampleName]))) - 2))
								ELSE 
									CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), 0, 3) IN (''TD'',''TS'') OR LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''),'''')) LIKE ''%[A-Z][0-9]%'' 
										THEN LTRIM(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), 3, LEN([SampleName])))
										ELSE CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], '''')),1,LEN( SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+ '' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1) )) =  SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+'' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1) 
													AND SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], '''')),1,LEN([SampleType])) LIKE ''_% %'' 
												THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+ '' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1)  ,'''')) 
												ELSE LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), ''''))
											END				
									END 
							END AS [Chemist], [Heatno], [SampleType], [Grade], '+@Collst+'
						FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND  ([SampleType] IN (''TD'',''TS'')) AND [Heatno] LIKE ''%[0-9]%'' AND [Sampletype] NOT LIKE ''F[0-9]'' AND [HeatNo] IN (SELECT DISTINCT [HeatNo] FROM dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = ''Released'' AND TRY_CAST([HeatNo] AS INT) BETWEEN '''+CAST(@startheat AS VARCHAR(MAX))+''' AND '''+CAST(@endheat AS VARCHAR(MAX))+''' AND [SampleType] IN (''TD'',''TS''))
						UNION 
						SELECT [ReportDate], [ReportedTime]
							, CASE WHEN [SampleName] NOT LIKE [HeatNo] + ''%''
								THEN LTRIM(RIGHT(SUBSTRING([SampleName], PATINDEX(''%[A-Z]%'', [SampleName]), LEN([SampleName])), LEN(SUBSTRING([SampleName], PATINDEX(''%[A-Z]%'', [SampleName]), LEN([SampleName]))) - 2))
								ELSE 
									CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), 0, 3) IN (''TD'',''TS'') OR LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''),'''')) LIKE ''%[A-Z][0-9]%'' 
										THEN LTRIM(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), 3, LEN([SampleName])))
										ELSE CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], '''')),1,LEN( SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+ '' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1) )) =  SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+'' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1) 
													AND SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], '''')),1,LEN([SampleType])) LIKE ''_% %'' 
												THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+ '' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1)  ,'''')) 
												ELSE LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), ''''))
											END				
									END 
							END AS [Chemist], [Heatno], [SampleType], [Grade], '+@Collst+' FROM (
							SELECT * ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY [reportdate],heatno ORDER BY REPLACE(SAMPLETYPE,''L'','''') desc) as num
							FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE ''L[0-9]'' AND [Heatno] LIKE ''%[0-9]%'' AND [Sampletype] NOT LIKE ''F[0-9]'' AND [HeatNo] IN (SELECT DISTINCT [HeatNo] FROM dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = ''Released'' AND TRY_CAST([HeatNo] AS INT) BETWEEN '''+CAST(@startheat AS VARCHAR(MAX))+''' AND '''+CAST(@endheat AS VARCHAR(MAX))+''' AND [SampleType] IN (''TD'',''TS''))
						) AS t WHERE num= 1
					) AS T UNPIVOT ([ActualValue] FOR [Element] IN ('+@Collst+')) AS unpvt
				) AS t JOIN (
					SELECT GRADE, [Name],  IIF(LEN(LEFT([Value], CHARINDEX(''_'',[Value])-1)) = 0,NULL,LEFT([Value], CHARINDEX(''_'',[Value])-1)) AS [Minval],IIF(LEN(SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX(''_'',[Value])+1,LEN([Value])))=0,NULL,SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX(''_'',[Value])+1,LEN([Value]))) AS [MaxVal],[value] FROM (
						SELECT GRD.Name AS Grade, '+@ColLst1+'
						FROM XMES_SMS_Grade_Protocol_Mst_Tbl AS Grd WITH(NOLOCK) 
						JOIN [dbo].[XMES_SMS_Grade_Protocol_Chemistry_Mst_Tbl] AS CMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON GRD.[ID] = CMT.[ParentID]
					) AS t UNPIVOT ([Value] for [Name] IN ('+@ColLst+')) as unpvt
				) AS t1 ON t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[Element] = t1.[Name]
				WHERE ((t1.Minval IS NOT NULL AND t.[ActualValue] < [Minval]) OR (t1.[MaxVal] IS NOT NULL AND t.[ActualValue] > [MaxVal]))
			)AS t PIVOT (SUM([ActualValue]) FOR [SM] IN ([LRF],[tundish])) As pvt ) AS t
			GROUP BY [ReportDate], [Chemist], [Shift], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Element]'
		INSERT INTO @tbl EXEC(@SQL)
		--SELECT * FROM @tbl

		/*---Delete records not deviated from deviation quality---*/
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] WHERE [ID] IN ( SELECT [ID] FROM [dbo].[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] AS t WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE t.[elements] = t1.[Elements] AND t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[HeatNo] = t1.[HeatNo] AND t1.[Shift] = t.[Shift] AND t1.[ShiftIncharge] = t.[ShiftInCharge]) AND [heatno] IN (SELECT DISTINCT [HeatNo] FROM dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'Released' AND TRY_CAST([HeatNo] AS INT) BETWEEN @startheat AND @endheat AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS')));

		/*----Update LRF and tundish deviated records in deviation quality---*/
		UPDATE t1 SET [LRFAtActualPercentage] = t.[LRF], [TundishAtActualPercentage] = t.[Tundish], [Modifiedon] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL' 
		FROM @tbl AS t JOIN [dbo].[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] AS t1 ON t.[HeatNo] = t1.[HeatNo] AND t.[Elements] = t1.[Elements] AND t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[ReportDate] = t1.[ReportDate] AND t1.[Shift] = t.[Shift] AND t1.[ShiftIncharge] = t.[ShiftInCharge]
		WHERE t1.[HeatNo] IN (SELECT DISTINCT [HeatNo] FROM dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'Released' AND TRY_CAST([HeatNo] AS INT) BETWEEN @startheat AND @endheat AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS')) AND t1.[IsDeleted] = 0 

		/*----store deviated records for LRF and Tundish not exist in deviation quality---*/
		INSERT INTO Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data( [ReportDate], [ShiftIncharge], [Shift], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Elements], [LRFAtActualPercentage], [TundishAtActualPercentage], [Createdon], [Source])
		SELECT  [ReportDate], [ShiftIncharge], [Shift], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Elements], [LRF], [Tundish], GETDATE(), 'T-SQL' FROM @tbl AS t 
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE t.[HeatNo] = t1.[HeatNo] AND t.[Elements] = t1.[Elements] AND t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[ReportDate] = t1.[ReportDate] AND t1.[Shift] = t.[Shift] AND t1.[ShiftIncharge] = t.[ShiftInCharge] AND t1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND t1.[HeatNo] IN (SELECT DISTINCT [HeatNo] FROM dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'Released' AND TRY_CAST([HeatNo] AS INT) BETWEEN @startheat AND @endheat AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS')))
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XMES_Recalculate_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@SQL,@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------*/
-- Created By : Nidhi Rana
-- Created On : 19-Feb-2026
-- Description : Implement Procedure to recalculate per heat summary and sms production after manual entry
/*----------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_heat_Usp] @id VARCHAR(36), @type VARCHAR(5)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @reportdate DATE;
	DECLARE @HeatID INT;
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SystemID VARCHAR(36);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*----Get System ID of Current Database----*/
		SELECT @SystemID = [ID] FROM [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_System_mst_tbl] AS SMT WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE SMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND (SMT.[ConfigurationDatabase] = DB_NAME() OR SMT.[DataDatabase] = DB_NAME() )
		IF @type = 'EAF'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @reportdate = [HeatReportDate], @heatid = [HeatID] FROM (SELECT [HeatReportDate], [HeatID] FROM [dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @id) AS t;
			SET @SQL = 'EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[HeatChargeMixConsumption] '''''+CAST(@heatid AS VARCHAR(20))+'''''';
			EXEC XStudio_Configuration.dbo.XStudio_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp @SystemID,'Heat charge Mix consumption',@SQL;
			
			/*--------------------------*/
			--SET @SQL = 'EXEC [XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_EAF_Usp] '''''+FORMAT(@REportdate,'yyyy-MM-dd')+'''''';
			--EXEC XStudio_Configuration.dbo.XStudio_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp @SystemID,'Recalculate EAF Summary',@SQL;
		END
		IF @type = 'LRF'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @reportdate = [HeatReportDate], @heatid = [HeatID] FROM (SELECT [HeatReportDate], [HeatID] FROM [dbo].[LRF_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @id) AS t;
			SET @SQL = 'EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XMES_LRF_I_Raw_Material_Cons_Usp] '''''+CAST(@heatid AS VARCHAR(20))+'''''';
			EXEC XStudio_Configuration.dbo.XStudio_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp @SystemID,'LRF Raw Material Consumption',@SQL;
			/*--------------------------*/
			--SET @SQL = 'EXEC [XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_LRF_Usp] '''''+FORMAT(@REportdate,'yyyy-MM-dd')+'''''';
			--EXEC XStudio_Configuration.dbo.XStudio_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp @SystemID,'Recalculate LRF Summary',@SQL;
		END
		IF @type = 'CCM'
		BEGIN
			SET @reportdate = (SELECT [HeatReportDate] FROM [dbo].[CCM_PER_HEAT] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @id);
			/*--------------------------*/
			--SET @SQL = 'EXEC [XBatch_Recalculate_Summary_CCM_Usp] '''''+FORMAT(@REportdate,'yyyy-MM-dd')+'''''';
			--EXEC XStudio_Configuration.dbo.XStudio_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp @SystemID,'Recalculate CCM Summary',@SQL;
		END
		SET @SQL = 'EXEC [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_SMS_PRODUCTION_USP] '''''+FORMAT(@REportdate,'yyyy-MM-dd')+'''''';
		EXEC XStudio_Configuration.dbo.XStudio_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp @SystemID,'Recalculate SMS Production Summary',@SQL;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_Recalculate_heat_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Recalculate_heat_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@SQL,@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

| @StartDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-------------------------
    Created By : Nidhi Rana
    Created On : 29-Dec-2025
    Description : Implement Procedure to recalculate SMS Production Summary
--------------------------*/

CREATE PROCEDURE XMES_Recalculate_SMS_PRODUCTION_USP
@StartDate DATE
AS
BEGIN

					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    /*--Variable Declaration--*/
    DECLARE @EndDate DATE   = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);
    DECLARE @CurrentDate DATE = @StartDate;
    
    BEGIN TRY

WHILE @CurrentDate < @EndDate
BEGIN
    EXEC [dbo].[SP_SMS_Producation_Summary] @ReportDate = @CurrentDate;
```

## dbo.XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_WorkOrders_Creation

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_WorkOrders_Creation  
**Created On:** 2026-04-10 08:05:14  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-10 15:45:59  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @CampaignMasterid | varchar(max) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_WorkOrders_Creation]
    @CampaignMasterid = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_WorkOrders_Creation]
    @CampaignMasterid AS VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare 
    @CampaignID VARCHAR(MAX),
    @StartDate DATETIME,
    @EndDate DATETIME

    Select @CampaignID=CampaignId,@StartDate=StartDate,@EndDate=EndDate from XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst where id=@CampaignMasterid and IsDeleted=0;

    -- 1. Temp table for Work Order data
    DECLARE @WOTable TABLE (
        Quantity DECIMAL(18,2),
        MaterialName VARCHAR(MAX),
        Grade VARCHAR(500),
        SalesOrderName VARCHAR(MAX),
        SalesOrderID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
        CustomerName VARCHAR(MAX),
        ItemNo VARCHAR(100)
    );

    -- 2. Temp table for sales Order data
    DECLARE @SOMapping TABLE (SONumber VARCHAR(MAX));

    INSERT INTO @SOMapping (SONumber)
    SELECT DISTINCT SONumber
    FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn
    WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID --AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB'
    AND SONumber IS NOT NULL AND IsDeleted = 0;

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- STEP 1: Insert into Sales Order Master (Using the generated IDs)
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO XBATCH_SALES_ORDER_MST_TBL (Name, SalesOrderNumber, ParentID, ItemID, Quantity, UnitID, Status, PlannedStartDate, PlannedCompletionDate)
    SELECT 
        T.SONumber, 
        T.SONumber,
        (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM xbatch_customer_mst_tbl WHERE Name = MAX(T.Customer) AND IsDeleted = 0),
        (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WHERE Name = MAX(T.MaterialNo) AND IsDeleted = 0),
        SUM(T.MaxQtytoRollMT), 
        '2095DF88-C3E3-4184-BA44-BBBB0696FF14', 
        'New', 
        @StartDate, 
        @EndDate
    FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
    INNER JOIN @SOMapping M ON T.SONumber = M.SONumber
    WHERE T.CampaignId = @CampaignID AND T.IsDeleted = 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM XBATCH_SALES_ORDER_MST_TBL 
        WHERE SalesOrderNumber = T.SONumber AND IsDeleted = 0
    )
    GROUP BY T.SONumber;

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BRANCH 1: RB (Reinforced Bar) - Grouping by Length
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName, CustomerName, ItemNo)
    SELECT SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT), MAX(MaterialNo), MAX(Customer), MAX(M.id)
    FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
    LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON T.MaterialNo = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0
    WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) = 'RB' AND T.IsDeleted = 0
    GROUP BY [Length]; 

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BRANCH 2: Wire Rod/Coil with SO (Linked via @SOMapping)
    ------------------         ---------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName, SalesOrderName, CustomerName, ItemNo)
    SELECT 
        T.MaxQtytoRollMT, 
        T.MaterialNo, 
        T.SONumber,  
        T.Customer, 
        S.ID
    FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
    INNER JOIN @SOMapping M ON T.SONumber = M.SONumber
    LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl S ON T.MaterialNo = S.Name AND S.IsDeleted = 0
    WHERE T.CampaignId = @CampaignID AND LEFT(T.MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB' AND T.IsDeleted = 0;

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BRANCH 3: WSO (No SO) - Grouping by Length
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName, ItemNo, CustomerName)
    SELECT SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT), MAX(M.ID), MAX(M.ID), MAX(Customer)
    FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
    LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON T.MaterialNo = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0
    WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND SONumber IS NULL AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB' AND T.IsDeleted = 0
    GROUP BY [Length]; 

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- FINAL STEP: Insert into Work Order Master
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO XBATCH_WORK_ORDER_MST_TBL (
        Quantity, UnitID, ItemID, Status, Equipment, ManufacturingOrderCategory, 
        ManufacturingOrderType, ProductionPlant, StorageLocation, MaterialName, 
        SalesOrder, SalesOrderName, Grade, MfgOrderPlannedStartDate, MfgOrderPlannedEndDate, CustomerName, campaignid
    )
    SELECT 
        W.Quantity, '2095DF88-C3E3-4184-BA44-BBBB0696FF14', M.ID, 'RM ProductionOrder Created', 'RM', 
        W.ItemNo, 'BR02', '7503', '2104', W.MaterialName, 
        W.SalesOrderName, 
        W.SalesOrderName, W.Grade, @StartDate, @EndDate, W.CustomerName, @CampaignMasterid
    FROM @WOTable W
    LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON W.MaterialName = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0;

    SELECT * FROM @WOTable;
    SELECT * FROM @SOMapping;
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 2026-01-28
-- Description:	store API error response for batch characteristics
-- =============================================
CREATE        PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristics_API_Error_Usp] --@RecordID=, @TransactionID=, @APIPostingType=
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@RecordID VARCHAR(36),
	@TransactionID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Body VARCHAR(MAX) ;
	DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(MAX); 
	DECLARE @UserID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @Batch VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @SPName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @EXEC NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Subsrno INT = 0;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	BEGIN TRY
		; WITH cte AS (
			SELECT 1 AS sr, '@RecordID' AS [Name], @Recordid AS [Value] UNION SELECT 2 AS sr, '@transactionId' AS [name], @transactionid AS [value] )
		, cte1 AS (
			SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPname], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION] 
			FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
		)
		SELECT @SPNAME = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @EXEC = c.[SPname] + ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ')
		FROM cte1 AS c JOIN cte ON c.[ORDINAL_POSITION] = cte.[sr] GROUP BY c.[SPname]
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 2 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'BatchChar', 'Entered', @Subsrno;

		/*--Get data from Batch Characteristics--*/
		SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Batch = [BatchNo]
		FROM XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*---Get API Body Message---*/		
		SELECT TOP 1 @Body = (
			SELECT TOP 1 [Message] AS jsonv 
			FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [Message] LIKE '%Body: {%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID
		); 

		/*----Get API error message---*/
		SELECT @ErrorMessage = (SELECT TOP 1 SUBSTRING([Message], CHARINDEX('Error Message:', [Message]) + LEN('Error Message:'), LEN([Message])) FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch]..[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [Message] LIKE '%Error Message%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID);

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqno])
		SELECT 2 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'BatchChar', 'Store Errors In Batch Characteristics Error Table Process Start', @Subsrno;

		/*---Store Error Response data for Batch characteristics---*/
		INSERT INTO XMES_SAP_API_Batch_Characteristics_Error([EntryDateTime], [TransactionID], [Body], [RecordID], [Status], [ErrorMessage], [CreatedBy], [ModifiedBy], [Source], [ModifiedOn], [BatchNo])
		SELECT GETDATE(), @TransactionID, @Body, @RecordID, 'PopUp', @ErrorMessage, @UserID, @UserID, 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), @Batch;
		
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqno])
		SELECT 2 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'BatchChar', 'Store Errors In Batch Characteristics Error Table Process End', @Subsrno;
		
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqno])
		SELECT 2 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'BatchChar', 'Completed', @Subsrno;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqno])
		SELECT 2 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'BatchChar', 'Error', @Subsrno;
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristics_API_Error_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristics_API_Error_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);		
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_SAP_Create_Process_Order_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_SAP_Create_Process_Order_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-03-06 10:39:54  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-06 10:39:54  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Type | varchar(100) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_SAP_Create_Process_Order_Usp]
    @Type = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		MAHESH UDAR
-- Create date: 2026-03-06
-- Description:	CREATE PROCESS ORDER AT FRIST OF EACH MONTH AND COMPLETE PROCESS ORDER WHICH ARE ON HOLD
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_SAP_Create_Process_Order_Usp]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@Type VARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	DECLARE @EAFWorkOrder VARCHAR(36),@LRFWorkOrder  VARCHAR(36)
	SELECT @EAFWorkOrder = NEWID(), @LRFWorkOrder = NEWID()
	IF(@Type='NEW')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl ([ID], [Equipment], [ManufacturingOrderType], [ItemID], [MaterialName], [ProductionPlant], [MfgOrderPlannedStartDate], [MfgOrderPlannedEndDate], [Quantity], [UnitID], [SalesOrder], [SalesOrderItem], [CreatedOn], [CreatedBy], [Status], [Source])
		SELECT @EAFWorkOrder, MOC.[Equipment], [OrderType], [Itemid], MMT.[Name], '7502', FORMAT(Cast(GETDATE() AS DATE),'yyyy-MM-01'),  CAST(EOMONTH(GETDATE()) AS DATE), MOC.[Quantity], MOC.[Unitid], '', '', GETDATE(), 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358', 'New Process Order', 'T-SQL' FROM MES_Order_Configurator MOC WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[ID] = MOC.[Itemid] AND MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 WHERE [Equipment] = 'EAF';

		INSERT INTO XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl ([ID], [Equipment], [ManufacturingOrderType], [ItemID], [MaterialName], [ProductionPlant], [MfgOrderPlannedStartDate], [MfgOrderPlannedEndDate], [Quantity], [UnitID], [SalesOrder], [SalesOrderItem], [CreatedOn], [CreatedBy], [Status], [Source])
		SELECT @LRFWorkOrder, MOC.[Equipment], [OrderType], [Itemid], MMT.[Name], '7502', FORMAT(Cast(GETDATE() AS DATE),'yyyy-MM-01'), CAST(EOMONTH(GETDATE()) AS DATE), MOC.[Quantity], MOC.[Unitid], '', '', GETDATE(), 'A6E924D5-B2F0-4A5F-9717-3A63F6190358', 'New Process Order', 'T-SQL' FROM MES_Order_Configurator MOC WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[ID] = MOC.[Itemid] AND MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 WHERE [Equipment] = 'LRF';

	UPDATE [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] SET [Status] = 'Process Order Created', [Source]='T-SQL' WHERE [ID] = @EAFWorkOrder;
	UPDATE [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] SET [Status] = 'Process Order Created', [Source]='T-SQL' WHERE [ID] = @LRFWorkOrder;
	UPDATE [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] SET [Status] = 'Released', [ReleasedDate] = GETDATE(), [Source]='T-SQL' WHERE [ID] = @EAFWorkOrder;
	UPDATE [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] SET [Status] = 'Released', [ReleasedDate] = GETDATE(), [Source]='T-SQL' WHERE [ID] = @LRFWorkOrder;
	UPDATE [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] SET [Status] = 'Running', [StartTime] = GETDATE(), [Source]='T-SQL' WHERE [ID] = @EAFWorkOrder;
	UPDATE [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] SET [Status] = 'Running', [StartTime] = GETDATE(), [Source]='T-SQL' WHERE [ID] = @LRFWorkOrder;
	END

	IF(@Type='OLD')
	BEGIN
		UPDATE XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Completed', Source='T-SQL', EndTime=GETDATE() WHERE Equipment IN ('EAF','LRF') AND ManufacturingOrderType='LI01' AND Status='OnHold' AND CAST(MfgOrderPlannedEndDate AS DATE) < CAST(GETDATE()-15 AS DATE)
	END

END
```

## dbo.XMES_SAP_GoodsMovements_API_Error_Usp

**Schema:** dbo

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: 2025-12-25
-- Description:	For Posting Sequence
-- =============================================
CREATE      PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_SAP_GoodsMovements_API_Error_Usp] --@RecordID=, @TransactionID=, @APIPostingType=
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@RecordID VARCHAR(36),
	@TransactionID VARCHAR(36),
	@APIPostingType VARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Body VARCHAR(MAX) 
	DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(MAX) 
	DECLARE @UserID VARCHAR(36)
	DECLARE @Material VARCHAR(500)
	DECLARE @GoodsMovementType INT
	DECLARE @Batch VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @srNo INT;
	DECLARE @SPName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @EXEC NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Subsrno INT = 0;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT @APIPOSTINGType = IIF((Select COUNT(*) FROM MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Saptransactionid=@TransactionID AND ID=@RecordID) > 0, 'ByProduct',@APIPOstingType)
		SELECT @srno =  CASE WHEN @APIPostingType = 'Production' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Hot Billet','Cold Billet') THEN 3 WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 4 ELSE 6 END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid) 
		WHEN @APIPostingType = 'Consumption' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 5 WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'LS' THEN 7 ELSE NULL END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid) WHEN @APIPostingType = 'ByProduct' THEN 8 END;

		; WITH cte AS (
			SELECT 1 AS sr, '@RecordID' AS [Name], @Recordid AS [Value] UNION SELECT 2 AS sr, '@transactionId' AS [name], @transactionid AS [value] UNION SELECt 3 AS [sr], '@APIPostingType' AS [Name], @APIPostingType AS [Value] )
		, cte1 AS (
			SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPname], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION] 
			FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
		)
		SELECT @SPName = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @EXEC = c.[SPname] + ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ')
		FROM cte1 AS c JOIN cte ON c.[ORDINAL_POSITION] = cte.[sr] GROUP BY c.[SPname]

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, @ApipostingType, 'Entered', @subsrno

		IF (@APIPostingType='Consumption')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Material = [Material], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder] FROM MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
		END
		IF (@APIPostingType='Production')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Material = [Material], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder] FROM MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
		END
		IF (@APIPostingType='ByProduct')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Material = [Material], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder] FROM MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
		END
		IF (@APIPostingType = 'Reversal')
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Material = [Material], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder]
				FROM MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			END

			IF EXISTS  (SELECT 1 FROM MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Material = [Material], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder] FROM MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			END

			IF EXISTS  (SELECT 1 FROM MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Material = [Material], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder] FROM MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
			END
		END
		IF (@APIPostingType = 'PlantToPlantTransfer')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Material = [Material], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder] FROM [dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [SAPTransactionID] = @TransactionID AND [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0
		END

		SELECT @Body = REPLACE([Message],'    ','') FROM XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch..XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Message] LIKE 'Body%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID;
	
		SELECT TOP 1 @Body = (SELECT TOP 1 'Body:' + Replace(Replace([Value], '"IssgOrRcvgMaterial": "", "IssgOrRcvgBatch": "", "IssuingOrReceivingPlant": "", "IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc": ""',''),'    ','') FROM (
				SELECT REPLACE([Message],'Body: ','') AS jsonv 
				FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [Message] LIKE '%Body: {%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID
			) AS t CROSS APPLY (SELECT * FROM OPENJSON(t.[jsonv], '$.to_MaterialDocumentItem.results') AS t) AS t1)

		SELECT @ErrorMessage = (SELECT TOP 1 SUBSTRING([Message], CHARINDEX('Error Message:', [Message]) + LEN('Error Message:'), LEN([Message]))
	--Replace(REPLACE([Message], 'Error occurred in GetAPIResponse:',''), 'Http URL: https://jsis-cpi-account-bcp9lrkq.it-cpi012-rt.cfapps.ap21.hana.ondemand.com/http/s4/goodsMovement_QA Error Message: ','')
		FROM XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch..XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Message] LIKE '%Error Message%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID);
	
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, @ApipostingType, 'Store Errors In Goods Movement '+@APIPostingType+' Posting Error Table Process Start', @Subsrno

		INSERT INTO [XMES_SAP_API_GoodsMovement_Error] ([EntryDateTime], [TransactionID], [Body], [RecordID], [Status], [ErrorMessage], [Type], [CreatedBy], [ModifiedBy], [Source], [ModifiedOn], [Material], [MovementType], [Batch], [ManufacturingOrder])
		SELECT GETDATE(), @TransactionID, @Body, @RecordID, 'PopUp', @ErrorMessage, @APIPostingType, @UserID, @UserID, 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), @Material, @GoodsMovementType, @Batch, @ManufacturingOrder

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, @ApipostingType, 'Store Errors In Goods Movement '+@APIPostingType+' Posting Error Table Process End', @Subsrno;

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, @ApipostingType, 'Completed', @Subsrno
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, @ApipostingType, 'Error', @Subsrno

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_GoodsMovements_API_Error_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_GoodsMovements_API_Error_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);		
	END CATCH
END
```

**Modified On:** 2026-03-14 12:23:58  
**Parameter Count:** 3  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Type | varchar(200) | NO |  |
| @Plant | int | NO |  |
| @Storage | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_SAP_I_Inventory_Stock_Data_Usp]
    @Type = '',
    @Plant = 0,
    @Storage = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar
-- Create date: '2026-02-10'
-- Description:	To Get Inentory Latest Data
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_SAP_I_Inventory_Stock_Data_Usp] 
	@Type VARCHAR(200),
	@Plant INT=NULL,
	@Storage VARCHAR(36)=NULL
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY

	IF(@Type='INSERT')
	BEGIN
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Data_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(CreatedOn AS DATE)<=CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND Plant=@Plant AND StorageLocation=@Storage)
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Data_Tbl] WHERE Plant=@Plant AND StorageLocation=@Storage
		END
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Data_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(CreatedOn AS DATE)=CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND Plant=@Plant AND StorageLocation=@Storage)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Data_Tbl]([Supplier],[Material],[SDDocument],[InventoryStockType],[MatlWrhsStkQtyInMatlBaseUnit],[SDDocumentItem],[Customer],[MaterialBaseUnit],[Plant],[Batch],[InventorySpecialStockType],[WebElementInternalID],[StorageLocation],[MetaData],[UnrestrictedUseStock],[StockinQualityInspection],[Returns],[StockTransferStorageLocation],[StockTransferPlant],[StockinTransit],[BlockedStock],[RestrictedUseStock],[TiedEmpties],[ValuatedGoodsReceiptBlockedStock])
		SELECT Supplier, Material, SDDocument, InventoryStockType, [MatlWrhsStkQtyInMatlBaseUnit],[SDDocumentItem],[Customer],[MaterialBaseUnit],[Plant],[Batch],[InventorySpecialStockType],[WebElementInternalID],[StorageLocation],[MetaData], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=01 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [UnrestrictedUseStock], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=02 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [StockinQualityInspection], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=03 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [Returns], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=04 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [StockTransferStorageLocation], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=05 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [StockTransferPlant], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=06 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [StockinTransit], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=07 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [BlockedStock], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=08 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [RestrictedUseStock], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=09 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [TiedEmpties], (CASE WHEN InventoryStockType=10 THEN InventoryStockType ELSE NULL END) AS [ValuatedGoodsReceiptBlockedStock] FROM MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Tbl WHERE CAST(CreatedOn AS DATE)=CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND Plant=@Plant AND StorageLocation=@Storage
	END
	END

	IF(@Type='DELETE' AND @Plant IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(CreatedOn AS DATE)<=CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND Plant=@Plant)
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Tbl] WHERE Plant=@Plant
		END
	END

	IF(@Type='DELETE' AND @Plant IS NULL)
	BEGIN
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(CreatedOn AS DATE)<=CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
		BEGIN
			TRUNCATE TABLE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Tbl]
		END
	END

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_I_Inventory_Stock_Data_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_I_Inventory_Stock_Data_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
		
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_SAP_Inventory_API_Error_Usp

**Procedure Name:** XMES_SAP_Inventory_API_Error_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-01-30 15:22:58  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-02 14:40:23  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @TransactionID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_SAP_Inventory_API_Error_Usp]
    @TransactionID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 2026-01-28
-- Description:	store API error response for Inventory
-- =============================================
CREATE          PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_SAP_Inventory_API_Error_Usp] --@RecordID=, @TransactionID=, @APIPostingType=
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	--@RecordID VARCHAR(36),
	@TransactionID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Body VARCHAR(MAX) ;
	DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(MAX); 
	DECLARE @UserID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @Plant VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @StorageLocation VARCHAR(500);
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	BEGIN TRY
	
		/*---Get API Body Message, plant and storage Location---*/		
		SELECT TOP 1 @Body = [Jsonv], @Plant = [Plant], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation] FROM (SELECT TOP 1 [Jsonv], JSON_VALUE(REPLACE([Jsonv],'Body: ',''), '$.Plant') AS [Plant], JSON_VALUE(REPLACE([Jsonv],'Body: ',''), '$.StorageLocation') AS [StorageLocation] FROM (
			SELECT [Message] AS jsonv 
			FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [Message] LIKE '%Body: {%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID
		) AS t) AS t; 

		/*----Get API error message---*/
		SELECT @ErrorMessage = (SELECT TOP 1 SUBSTRING([Message], CHARINDEX('Error Message:', [Message]) + LEN('Error Message:'), LEN([Message])) FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch]..[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [Message] LIKE '%Error Message%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID);

		/*---Store Error Response data for Inventory---*/
		INSERT INTO XMES_SAP_API_Inventory_Error([EntryDateTime], [TransactionID], [Body], /*[RecordID],*/ [Status], [ErrorMessage], [CreatedBy], [ModifiedBy], [Source], [ModifiedOn], [PlantCode], [StorageLocation])
		SELECT GETDATE(), @TransactionID, @Body, /*@RecordID,*/ 'PopUp', @ErrorMessage, @UserID, @UserID, 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), @Plant, @StorageLocation;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_Inventory_API_Error_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_Inventory_API_Error_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);		
	END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 2026-03-16
-- Description:	store API error response for Plant To Plant transfer
-- =============================================
CREATE            PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_API_Error_Usp] --@RecordID=, @TransactionID=, @APIPostingType=
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@RecordID VARCHAR(36),
	@TransactionID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Body VARCHAR(MAX) ;
	DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(MAX); 
	DECLARE @UserID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @batch VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @SPName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @EXEC NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SubSrNo INT = 0;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	BEGIN TRY
		; WITH CTE AS (
			SELECT 1 AS sr, '@RecordID' AS [Name], @RecordID AS [Value] UNION SELECT 2 AS sr, '@TransactionID' AS [Name], @TransactionID AS [Value]
		), CTE1 AS (
			SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPName], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION]
			FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) 
		)
		SELECT @SPName = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @EXEC = c.[SPname] + ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ')
		FROM cte1 AS c JOIN cte ON c.[ORDINAL_POSITION] = cte.[sr] GROUP BY c.[SPname]
		
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 12 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'PlantToPlantTransfer', 'Entered', @SubSrNo

		/*--Get data from Batch Characteristics--*/
		SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @batch = [Batch]
		FROM [dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*---Get API Body Message---*/		
		SELECT TOP 1 @Body = (
			SELECT TOP 1 [Message] AS jsonv 
			FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [Message] LIKE '%Body: {%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC
		); 

		/*----Get API error message---*/
		SELECT @ErrorMessage = (SELECT TOP 1 SUBSTRING([Message], CHARINDEX('Error Message:', [Message]) + LEN('Error Message:'), LEN([Message])) FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch]..[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [Message] LIKE '%Error Message%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC);

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 12 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'PlantToPlantTransfer', 'Store Errors In Plant to Plant Transfer Posting Error Table Process Start', @SubSrNo

		/*---Store Error Response data for ResultRecording---*/
		INSERT INTO XMES_SAP_API_PlantToPlantTransfer_Error([EntryDateTime], [TransactionID], [Body], [RecordID], [Status], [ErrorMessage], [CreatedBy], [ModifiedBy], [Source], [ModifiedOn], [BatchNo])
		SELECT GETDATE(), @TransactionID, @Body, @RecordID, 'PopUp', @ErrorMessage, @UserID, @UserID, 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), @batch;

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 12 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'PlantToPlantTransfer', 'Store Errors In Plant to Plant Transfer Posting Error Table Process End', @SubSrNo

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 12 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'PlantToPlantTransfer', 'Completed', @SubSrNo
		
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 12 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'PlantToPlantTransfer', 'Error', @SubSrNo

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_API_Error_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_API_Error_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);		
	END CATCH
END
```
