### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Mahesh Udar, Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 2025-12-25
-- Description:	For Posting Sequence
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_SAP_Posting_Sequence_Usp] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@ID Varchar(36),
	@APIPostingType VARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	BEGIN TRY
		DECLARE @HeatNo int, @PostingMaterialType Varchar(100), @InspectionLot VARCHAR(100), @ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(100), @PostingDate Date, @MaterialDocument VARCHAR(100), @GoodsMovementType INT, @Batch VARCHAR(100), @CutLen DECIMAL(14,2),@StorageLocation INT, @QuantityInEntryUnit DECIMAL(18,4), @QuantityInCount INT, @WorkOrderID Varchar(36), @SHType VARCHAR(36), @Grade VARCHAR(500), @Material VARCHAR(500), @Plant INT, @EntryUnit VARCHAR(100), @SapTrnID VARCHAR(36), @movementid VARCHAR(36), @Message VARCHAR(200), @SAPPostingStatus VARCHAR(100), @RawMaterialRecordID Varchar(36), @BatchQuantityInCount INT, @BatchQuantityInEntryUnit DECIMAL(18,4), @toplant INT, @ToStorageLocation INT, @UOMID VARCHAR(36), @MaterialID VARCHAR(36), @UserID VARCHAR(36), @BatchCharUpdateID Varchar(36), @ProdID VARCHAR(36), @srno INT, @SPName VARCHAR(500), @EXEC NVARCHAR(MAX), @subsrno INT = 0, @BilletNo INT;
	
		; WITH cte AS (
			SELECT 1 AS sr, '@ID' AS [name], @ID AS [value] UNION SELECT 2 AS sr, '@APIPostingType' AS [name], @APIPostingType AS [Value])
		, cte1 AS (
			SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPname], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION] 
			FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
		)
		SELECT @SPName = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @Exec = c.[SPname] + ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ') FROM cte1 AS c JOIN cte ON c.[ORDINAL_POSITION] = cte.[sr] GROUP BY c.[SPname];
		SELECT @srno = 
		CASE WHEN @APiPostingType = 'CreateBatch' THEN 1 WHEN @APIPostingType = 'BatchChar' THEN 2
			WHEN @APIPostingType = 'Production' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Hot Billet','Cold Billet') THEN 3 WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 4 ELSE 6 END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID)
			WHEN @APIPostingType = 'Consumption' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 5 WHEN [PostingMaterialType] = 'LS' THEN 7 ELSE NULL END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID) 
			WHEN @APIPostingType = 'ByProduct' THEN 8 WHEN @APIPostingType = 'RR' THEN 9
			WHEN @APIPostingType = 'UD' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN [MaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 10 WHEN [MaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' THEN 11 ELSE NULL END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID) 
			WHEN @APIPostingType = 'PlantToPlantTransfer' THEN 12 END;
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Entered', @Subsrno;
		
		IF (@APIPostingType = 'CreateBatch')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Batch = [Batch], @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @SAPPostingStatus = [SAPPostingstatus] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XMES_SAP_CreateBatch_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID=@ID;

			IF EXISTS (SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Batch] = @Batch AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered'  AND [IsAutoPost] = 1 AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'Hot Billet')
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Post state for hot billet which are in Entered state in Production for Created Batch Process Start', @Subsrno;

				SELECT @ProdID = [ID], @BatchQuantityInCount = [QuantityInCount], @BatchQuantityInEntryUnit=QuantityInEntryUnit FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Batch=@Batch AND SAPPostingStatus='Entered' AND [IsAutoPost] = 1 AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'Hot Billet'
			
				UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Post', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [ID] = @ProdID;
				--UPDATE [DBO].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl] SET [NoOfPieces]=@BatchQuantityInCount,[TonsPerPiece]=@BatchQuantityInEntryUnit/@BatchQuantityInCount, [Pieces]=@BatchQuantityInCount, [SAPPostingStatus]='Posted', [ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(), Source='T-SQL' WHERE BatchNo=@Batch
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Post state for hot billet which are in Entered state in Production for created batch Process End', @Subsrno;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Post state for Cold billet which are in Entered state in Production for Created Batch Process Start', @Subsrno

				SELECT @ProdID = [ID], @BatchQuantityInCount = [QuantityInCount], @BatchQuantityInEntryUnit = [QuantityInEntryUnit] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Batch] = @Batch AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered' AND [IsAutoPost] = 1 AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'Cold Billet';

				UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Post', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [ID] = @ProdID;

				--UPDATE [DBO].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl] SET [NoOfPieces]=@BatchQuantityInCount,[TonsPerPiece]=@BatchQuantityInEntryUnit/@BatchQuantityInCount, [Pieces]=@BatchQuantityInCount, [SAPPostingStatus]='Posted', [ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(), Source='T-SQL' WHERE BatchNo=@Batch
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Post state for Cold billet which are in Entered state in Production for created batch Process End', @Subsrno ;
			END
		END

		IF (@APIPostingType = 'BatchChar')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @Batch = [BatchNo], @BatchQuantityInCount = [NoOfPieces], @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @SAPPostingStatus = [SapPostingStatus] FROM [DBO].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID;	
		
			IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Batch] = @Batch AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Post' AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet') AND [QuantityInCount] = @BatchQuantityInCount)
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state for Cold and hot billet which are in Post state in Production for Batch Characterstics Process Start', @Subsrno 
				SELECT @BatchCharUpdateID = [ID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Batch] = @Batch AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Post' AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet') AND [QuantityInCount] = @BatchQuantityInCount;
				UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] SET SAPPostingStatus='Posted', ModifiedOn=GETDATE(), Source='T-SQL', ModifiedBy=@UserID WHERE ID=@BatchCharUpdateID
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state for Cold and hot billet which are in Post state in Production for Batch Characterstics Process End', @Subsrno
			END
		END

	--BEGIN
	--	SELECT @Batch=BatchNo, FROM [DBO].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl] WHERE ID=@ID;
	--	IF Not Exists (Select 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Batch=@Batch AND SAPPostingStatus IN ('Entered', 'Reversal Failed') AND PostingMaterialType IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet'))
	--	BEGIN
	--		Select @BatchQuantityInEntryUnit=SUM(QuantityInEntryUnit), @BatchQuantityInCount=SUM(QuantityInCount) FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Batch=@Batch AND SAPPostingStatus='Posted' AND InspectionLot IS NOT NULL AND PostingMaterialType IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet')
	--		UPDATE [DBO].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl] SET [NoOfPieces]=@BatchQuantityInCount,[TonsPerPiece]=@BatchQuantityInEntryUnit/@BatchQuantityInCount, [Pieces]=@BatchQuantityInCount, [SAPPostingStatus]='Posted', [ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(), Source='T-SQL' WHERE BatchNo=@Batch
	--	END
	--END
	
		IF(@APIPostingType='Production')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @HeatNo = [HeatNo], @PostingMaterialType = [PostingMaterialType], @InspectionLot = [InspectionLot], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder], @PostingDate = [PostingDate], @MaterialDocument = [MaterialDocument], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation], @QuantityInEntryUnit = [QuantityInEntryUnit], @Plant = [Plant], @QuantityInCount = [QuantityInCount], @SHType = 'S', @SapTrnID = [Saptransactionid], @SAPPostingStatus = [SAPPostingStatus], @UserID = [ModifiedBy] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID;		

			IF EXISTS (SELECT ID FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Batch=@Batch AND SAPPostingStatus='Entered'  AND IsAutoPost=1 AND PostingMaterialType ='Cold Billet' AND ID!=@ID AND ManufacturingOrder IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @ProdID = [ID], @BatchQuantityInCount = [QuantityInCount], @BatchQuantityInEntryUnit = [QuantityInEntryUnit] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE [Batch] = @Batch AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered' AND [IsAutoPost] = 1 AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'Cold Billet';
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Post state In Production for Cold Billet process Start', @Subsrno 
				--Select @ProdID
				UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Post', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [ID] = @ProdID;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Post state In Production for Cold Billet process End', @Subsrno 
				--UPDATE [DBO].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl] SET [NoOfPieces]=@BatchQuantityInCount,[TonsPerPiece]=@BatchQuantityInEntryUnit/@BatchQuantityInCount, [Pieces]=@BatchQuantityInCount, [SAPPostingStatus]='Posted', [ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(), Source='T-SQL' WHERE BatchNo=@Batch
			END

			IF(@SAPPostingStatus='Posted' AND @PostingMaterialType IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet'))
			BEGIN	
				IF Not Exists (Select 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Batch=@Batch AND SAPPostingStatus IN ('Entered', 'Reversal Failed', 'Post') AND PostingMaterialType IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet'))
				BEGIN
					SELECT @BatchQuantityInEntryUnit = SUM([QuantityInEntryUnit]), @BatchQuantityInCount = SUM([QuantityInCount]) FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Batch] = @Batch AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted' AND [InspectionLot] IS NOT NULL AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet')
					SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
					SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted In Batch characteristics for Hot or Cold Billet which are Posted but not enetered, reversal failed or post in Production process Start', @Subsrno ;

					UPDATE [DBO].[XMES_SAP_Batch_Characteristic_Trn_Tbl] SET [NoOfPieces] = @BatchQuantityInCount, [TonsPerPiece] = @BatchQuantityInEntryUnit / @BatchQuantityInCount, [Pieces] = @BatchQuantityInCount, [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [BatchNo] = @Batch;
					SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
					SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted In Batch characteristics for Hot or Cold Billet which are Posted but not enetered, reversal failed or post in Production process End', @Subsrno ;
				END
			END
	
			IF(@PostingMaterialType IN ('Cold Billet','Hot Billet'))
			BEGIN	
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Total and remaining billet count and weight In ccm for hot or cold billet posted in production process Start', @Subsrno 

				UPDATE CCM_Per_Heat SET [TotalPostedBilletCount] = ISNULL(prd.[BilletCount], 0), [TotalPostedBilletWeightTon] = ISNULL(prd.[BilletWeight], 0), [RemainingPostedBilletCount] = CCM_Per_Heat.[ActualBilletCount] - ISNULL(prd.[BilletCount], 0), [RemainingPostedBilletWeightTon] = CCM_Per_Heat.[ActualBilletWeightTon] - ISNULL(prd.[BilletWeight], 0) 
				FROM (
					SELECT SUM([QuantityInCount]) AS [BilletCount], SUM([QuantityInEntryUnit]) AS [BilletWeight]
					FROM [MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted' AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet')
				) AS prd WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Total and remaining billet count and weight In ccm for hot or cold billet posted in production process End', @Subsrno 
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Quantity In Inventory for from plant and storageLocation Start', @Subsrno 
	
				UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = [QuantityInEntryUnit] FROM (
					SELECT SUM(CAST([QuantityInEntryUnit] AS FLOAT)) AS [QuantityInEntryUnit], [Batch] AS bt, [Plant] AS plnt, [StorageLocation] AS st FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
					WHERE [Batch] = @Batch AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted' AND [InspectionLot] IS NOT NULL AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet') AND [Plant] = @Plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation AND [IsDeleted] = 0 
					GROUP BY [Batch], [Plant], [StorageLocation]
				) As t WHERE t.[bt] = [LotNumber] AND t.[plnt] = [PlantName] and t.[st] = [StorageLocation] AND [LotNumber] = @Batch AND [PlantName] = @Plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Quantity In Inventory for from plant and storageLocation End', @Subsrno 
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted In Production for GLS which is enetered in Production process Start', @Subsrno ;

				UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS' AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered';
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS [Srno], @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted In Production for GLS which is enetered in Production process End', @Subsrno ;
			END

			IF(@PostingMaterialType='GLS')
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Inspection lot of Posted GLS for latest sample In Quality process Start', @Subsrno ;
				UPDATE [Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] SET [InspectionLot] = @InspectionLot WHERE [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(50)) AND [IsLatestSample] = 1;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Inspection lot of Posted GLS for latest sample In Quality process End', @Subsrno;

				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted' AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS')
				BEGIN 
					SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
					SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state for entered GLS in consumption Posted in Production process Start', @Subsrno;
					UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'GLS' AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered';
					SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
					SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state for entered GLS in consumption Posted in Production process End', @Subsrno;
				END
			END
			IF(@PostingMaterialType='LS')
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update response data in Production process Start', @Subsrno;
				UPDATE [MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] SET [MaterialDocumentYear] = t.[MaterialDocumentYear], [MaterialDocument] = t.[MaterialDocument], [InventoryTransactionType] = t.[InventoryTransactionType], [DocumentDate] = t.[DocumentDate], [PostingDate] = t.[PostingDate] , [CreationDate]= t.[CreationDate], [CreationTime] = t.[CreationTime], [CreatedByUser] = t.[CreatedByUser], [MaterialDocumentHeaderText] = t.[MaterialDocumentHeaderText], [ReferenceDocument] = t.[ReferenceDocument], [VersionForPrintingSlip] = t.[VersionForPrintingSlip], [ManualPrintLsTriggered] = t.[ManualPrintIsTriggered], [CtrlPostForWhseMgmtSyst] = t.[CtrlPostgForExtWhseMgmtSyst], [GoodsMovementCode] = t.[GoodsMovementCode]
				FROM (
					SELECT pvt.[MaterialDocumentYear], pvt.[MaterialDocument], pvt.[InventoryTransactionType], CAST(pvt.[DocumentDate] AS DATETIME) AS [DocumentDate], CAST(pvt.[PostingDate] AS DATETIME) AS [PostingDate], CAST(pvt.[CreationDate] AS DATETIME) AS [CreationDate], REPLACE(REPLACE(SUBSTRING(pvt.[CreationTime], 3, LEN(pvt.[CreationTime]) - 3),'H',':'),'M',':') AS [CreationTime], pvt.[CreatedByUser], pvt.[MaterialDocumentHeaderText], pvt.[ReferenceDocument], pvt.[VersionForPrintingSlip], pvt.[ManualPrintIsTriggered], pvt.[CtrlPostgForExtWhseMgmtSyst], pvt.[GoodsMovementCode] FROM (
						SELECT (REPLACE(SUBSTRING(REPLACE([Message], 'API Response Result:',''), 2, CHARINDEX('Header:',REPLACE([Message],'API Response Result:','')) - 3),' ','')) AS jsonv 
						FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
						WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [TransactionID] = @SapTrnID AND [Message] LIKE '%API Response Result:%'
					) AS t CROSS APPLY (SELECT * FROM OPENJSON(t.[jsonv], '$.properties') AS t) AS t1
					PIVOT(MAX([value]) FOR [key] IN ([MaterialDocumentYear], [MaterialDocument],[InventoryTransactionType],[DocumentDate],[PostingDate],[CreationDate],[CreationTime],[CreatedByUser],[MaterialDocumentHeaderText],[ReferenceDocument],[VersionForPrintingSlip],[ManualPrintIsTriggered],[CtrlPostgForExtWhseMgmtSyst],[GoodsMovementCode])) AS pvt
				) AS t WHERE [ID] = @ID AND [Saptransactionid] = @SapTrnID;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update response data in Production process End', @Subsrno;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Material Document get from response data in Workorder movement process Start', @Subsrno;

				UPDATE [MES_SAP_WorkOrder_Movements_Trn_Tbl] SET [MaterialDocument] = t.[MaterialDocument] FROM (SELECT [materialDocument] FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID) AS t WHERE [ID] = @movementid;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Material Document get from response data in Workorder movement process End', @Subsrno ;
		
				IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted' AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'LS')
				BEGIN
					SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
					SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state in Consumption for LS which is entered process Start', @Subsrno ;

					UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'LS' AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered';	
					SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
					SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state in Consumption for LS which is entered process End', @Subsrno ;
				END		
			END
			IF (@PostingMaterialType = 'Hot Billet' AND @InspectionLot is not Null)
			BEGIN	
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Store data of Hot Billet with Posted state in Usage Decision for Hot Billet process Start', @Subsrno;

				INSERT INTO MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl (InspectionLot, HeatNo, SAPPostingStatus,UsgDecCode, ModifiedOn, Source, MaterialType)
				SELECT @InspectionLot, @HeatNo, 'Posted', '01',  Getdate(), 'T-SQL', 'Hot Billet'
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Store data of Hot Billet with Posted state in Usage Decision for Hot Billet process End', @Subsrno;
			END
		END

		IF(@APIPostingType='Consumption')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @HeatNo = [HeatNo], @PostingMaterialType = [PostingMaterialType], @InspectionLot = [InspectionLot], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder], @PostingDate = [PostingDate], @MaterialDocument = [MaterialDocument], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation], @QuantityInEntryUnit = [QuantityInEntryUnit], @QuantityInCount = [QuantityInCount], @SHType = 'S',  @SAPPostingStatus = [SAPPostingStatus], @RawMaterialRecordID = [RawMaterialRecordID], @UserID = [ModifiedBy] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID;

			IF(@RawMaterialRecordID IS NOT NULL AND @SAPPostingStatus = 'Entered')
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Entered state for posted in Raw Material Consumption When Raw Material ID is entered in Consumption process Start', @Subsrno ;

				UPDATE [dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPWorkflowStatus] = 'Entered' WHERE [ID] = @RawMaterialRecordID AND [SAPWorkflowStatus] = 'Posted'

				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Entered state for posted in Raw Material Consumption When Raw Material ID is entered in Consumption process End', @Subsrno ;
			END

			IF(@PostingMaterialType = 'GLS')
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state of Entered LS in Production process Start', @Subsrno ;

				UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'LS' AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered';

				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state of Entered LS in Production process End', @Subsrno ;
			END

			IF(@PostingMaterialType='LS' AND @APIPostingType='Consumption')
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @ByProdID VARCHAR(36);
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Cursor byprodcur on By Product table to set Posted state of Entered By Products process Start', @Subsrno ;
				DECLARE ByProdcur CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
					SELECT [ID] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered'
				OPEN ByProdcur;
					FETCH NEXT FROM ByProdcur INTO @ByProdID;
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					BEGIN
						SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
						INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
						SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state of '''+@ByProdID+''' process Start', @Subsrno ;
						UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl] SET SAPPostingStatus='Posted', ModifiedOn=GETDATE(), Source='T-SQL', ModifiedBy=@UserID WHERE ID=@ByProdID;
						
						SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
						INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
						SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted state of '''+@ByProdID+''' process End', @Subsrno ;
						FETCH NEXT FROM ByProdcur INTO @ByProdID;
					END;
				CLOSE ByProdcur;
				DEALLOCATE ByProdcur;
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Cursor byprodcur on By Product table to set Posted state of Entered By Products process End', @Subsrno ;
			END
		END	

		IF(@APIPostingType='ByProduct')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @HeatNo = [HeatNo], @PostingMaterialType = [PostingMaterialType], @InspectionLot = [InspectionLot], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder], @PostingDate = [PostingDate], @MaterialDocument = [MaterialDocument], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation], @QuantityInEntryUnit = [QuantityInEntryUnit], @QuantityInCount = [QuantityInCount], @SHType = 'S', @SapTrnID = [Saptransactionid], @UserID = [ModifiedBy] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_By_Product_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID;

			IF (@PostingMaterialType = 'BYPRODUCT')
			BEGIN
				IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [PostingMaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted')
				BEGIN
					SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
					SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted Quality is entered and having inspection lot when hot billet already posted in production process Start', @Subsrno ;

					UPDATE [Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] SET [SAPStatus] = 'Posted', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL' WHERE [HeatNo] = CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(100)) AND [InspectionLot] IS NOT NULL AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SAPStatus] = 'Entered'

					SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
					INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
					SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted Quality is entered and having inspection lot when hot billet already posted in production process End', @Subsrno ;
				END
			END
		END

		IF (@APIPostingType='RR')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @HeatNo = [HeatNo], @InspectionLot = [InspectionLot], @Message = [Message], @UserID = [ModifiedBy] FROM [DBO].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID
			IF (@Message IS NOT NULL)
			BEGIN
				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted UD of GLS is entered after successfully RR of GLS process Start', @Subsrno ;

				UPDATE [DBO].[MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [InspectionLot] = @InspectionLot AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [MaterialType] = 'GLS' AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered';

				SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1;
				INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
				SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted UD of GLS is entered after successfully RR of GLS process End', @Subsrno ;
			END
			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted UD of Hot Billet is entered after RR of GLS process Start', @Subsrno ;

			UPDATE [DBO].[MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl] SET [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Posted', [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL', [ModifiedBy] = @UserID WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [MaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' AND [SAPPostingStatus] = 'Entered'

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted UD of Hot Billet is entered after RR of GLS process End', @Subsrno ;
		END
	
		IF (@APIPostingType='UD')
		BEGIN
			SELECT @HeatNo = [HeatNo], @InspectionLot = [InspectionLot], @UserID = [ModifiedBy] FROM [DBO].[MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @ID;
			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Enable UD status in quality Having inspection Lot process Start', @Subsrno ;

			UPDATE [Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] SET [IsUDStatus] = 1 WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [InspectionLot] =  @InspectionLot;

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Enable UD status in quality Having inspection Lot process End', @Subsrno ;

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted plant to plant transfer of Hot Billet is entered after UD Process Start', @Subsrno ;

			UPDATE [DBO].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] SET SAPPostingStatus='Posted', ModifiedOn=GETDATE(), Source='T-SQL', ModifiedBy=@UserID WHERE HeatNo=@HeatNo AND SAPPostingStatus='Entered'

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Set Posted plant to plant transfer of Hot Billet is entered after UD Process End', @Subsrno ;
		END

		IF @APIPostingType = 'PlantToPlantTransfer'
		BEGIN
			SELECT @UOMID = [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'Ton';

			SELECT @material = [Material], @plant = [Plant], @StorageLocation = [StorageLocation], @Batch = [Batch], @EntryUnit = [EntryUnit], @QuantityInEntryUnit = [QuantityInEntryUnit], @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType]/*, @Supplier = [Supplier], @customer = [Customer], @SalesOrder = [SalesOrder], @SalesOrderItem = [SalesOrderItem]*/, @Material = [IssgOrRcvgMaterial], @toplant  = [IssuingOrReceivingPlant], @ToStorageLocation = [IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc], @SAPPostingStatus = [SAPPostingStatus], @UserID = [CreatedBy], @PostingmaterialType = [PostingMaterialType]
			FROM [dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ID;

			SELECT @MaterialID = [ID], @Grade = [Grade] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = @Material;

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Quantity of billets from source plant and storage location in Inventory Process Start', @Subsrno ;

			UPDATE inv SET [Quantity] = inv.[Quantity] - t.qty, [QuantityInCount] = inv.[QuantityInCount] - t.[qtyincnt], [IsPlantToPlantTransfer] = IIF(inv.[Quantity] - t.qty = 0, 0, 1) FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] AS inv
			JOIN (SELECT  [Batch], (CAST([QuantityInEntryUnit] as float)) AS qty, [QuantityInCount] AS qtyincnt, [Plant], [StorageLocation], [PostingMaterialType] AS PMT FROM [dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] AS pt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Batch] = @Batch AND [Plant] = @plant AND [StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation ANd [PostingMaterialType] = @PostingMaterialType) AS t
			ON inv.[PlantName] = t.[Plant] AND inv.[StorageLocation] = t.[StorageLocation] AND inv.[LotNumber] = t.[Batch] AND inv.[PostingMaterialType] = t.[PMT]
			WHERE inv.[PlantName] = @Plant AND inv.[StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation AND inv.[LotNumber] = @batch AND inv.[postingMaterialType] = @PostingMaterialtype and inv.[IsDeleted] = 0;

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Quantity of billets from source plant and storage location Process End', @Subsrno ;

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Quantity of billets from destination plant and storage location in Inventory Process Start', @Subsrno ;

			UPDATE [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] SET [Quantity] = [Quantity] + (CAST([QuantityInEntryUnit] as float)), [QuantityInCount] = [QuantityInCount] + pt.[qtyincnt], [IsPlantToPlantTransfer] = 1 FROM 
				(SELECT PT.[QuantityInEntryUnit], [Plant] AS Plt, [Batch] AS Bt, [StorageLocation] AS st, [PostingMaterialType] AS PMT, [QuantityInCount] AS QtyInCnt FROM [dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] AS PT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE PT.[Batch] = @Batch AND Pt.[Plant] = @toplant AND PT.[StorageLocation] = @StorageLocation AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [PostingMaterialType] = @PostingMaterialType) AS pt 
				WHERE [PostingMaterialType] = pt.[PMT] AND [BT] = [Lotnumber] AND [PlantNAme] = @toplant AND [StorageLocation] = @ToStorageLocation and [LotNumber] = @Batch AND [PostingMaterialType] = @PostingMaterialType; 

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Quantity of billets from destination plant and storage location in Inventory Process End', @Subsrno ;

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Store data of Quantity of billets from destination plant and storage location in Inventory Process Start', @Subsrno ;

			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] ([ID], [ParentID], [CreatedBy], [CreatedOn], [Source], [LotNumber], [GradeID], [Quantity], [UOMID], [IsExpired], [ReceivedDate], [ItemSource], [MaterialGrade], [PlantName], [StorageLocation], [IsPlantToPlantTransfer], [PostingMaterialType], [QuantityinCount])
			SELECT NEWID(), @MaterialID, [CreatedBy], GETDATE(), 'T-SQL', [Batch], 'TBD', (CAST([QuantityInEntryUnit] as float)), @UOMID, 0, GETDATE(), 'Produce', @Grade, [IssuingOrReceivingPlant], [IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc], 1, [PostingMaterialType], [QuantityInCount] FROM [dbo].[XMES_SAP_PlantToPlantTransfer_Trn_Tbl] AS pt WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [IssgOrRcvgBatch] = @Batch AND [IssuingOrReceivingPlant] = @toplant AND [IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc] = @ToStorageLocation AND [PostingMaterialType] = @PostingMaterialType AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Inventory_Mst_Tbl] AS inv WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE inv.IsDeleted = 0 AND inv.LotNumber = pt.[Batch] AND inv.[PlantName] = pt.[IssuingOrReceivingPlant] AND inv.[StorageLocation] = pt.[IssuingOrReceivingStorageLoc] AND pt.[PostingMaterialType] = inv.[PostingMaterialType]);

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Store data of Quantity of billets from destination plant and storage location in Inventory Process End', @Subsrno ;
		END

		IF(@APIPostingType='ProductionReversed')
		BEGIN	
			SELECT @HeatNo = [HeatNo], @PostingMaterialType = [PostingMaterialType], @InspectionLot = NULL, @ManufacturingOrder = [ManufacturingOrder], @PostingDate = [PostingDate], @MaterialDocument = [MaterialDocument], @GoodsMovementType = [GoodsMovementType], @Batch = [Batch], @CutLen=Cutlength,@StorageLocation = [StorageLocation], @QuantityInEntryUnit = [QuantityInEntryUnit], @QuantityInCount = [QuantityInCount], @SHType = 'H', @Grade = [Grade], @Material = [Material], @Plant = [Plant], @EntryUnit = [EntryUnit], @PostingDate = [PostingDate], @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @BilletNo = [BilletNo] FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE ID=@ID;

			--SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			--INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			--SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Isdeleted 1 for billets which are reversed Start', @Subsrno ;

			--UPDATE BT SET [IsDeleted] = 1, [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL' 
			--FROM [dbo].[XMES_Billet_Tracking_Trn_Tbl] AS BT WITH(NOLOCK)
			--JOIN [dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] AS PT WITH(NOLOCK) 
			--ON BT.[HeatNo] = PT.[HeatNo] AND BT.[PostingMaterialType] = Pt.[PostingMaterialType] 
			--	AND Bt.[Batch] = PT.[Batch] AND BT.[ManufacturingOrder] = PT.[ManufacturingOrder]
			--WHERE BT.[HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND Bt.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND PT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND PT.[SAPPostingStatus] = 'Reversed' AND PT.[ID] = @ID;

			--SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			--INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			--SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Update Isdeleted 1 for billets which are reversed End', @Subsrno ;

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Store data with entered state in production Process Start', @Subsrno ;

			INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl]([SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [Batch],[Cutlength], [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [QuantityInCount], [PostingMaterialType],[IsReversal], [PostingDate], CreatedBy, [BilletNo])
			SELECT 'Entered', 'T-SQL', @HeatNo, @Grade, @Material, @Plant, @StorageLocation, @Batch,@CutLen, @GoodsMovementType, @EntryUnit, @ManufacturingOrder, @QuantityInEntryUnit, @QuantityInCount, @PostingMaterialType, 1, @PostingDate, @UserID, @BilletNo

			SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
			SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Store data with entered state in production Process End', @Subsrno ;
		END
		SET @WorkOrderID = (SELECT [ID] FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [WorkOrderNumber] = @ManufacturingOrder);
		SET @movementid = NEWID()
		
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Store data in WorkOrder movement Process Start', @Subsrno ;
		INSERT INTO MES_SAP_WorkOrder_Movements_Trn_Tbl 
			([ID], [ParentID], [CreatedOn], [Source], [PostingDate], [MaterialDocument], [MovementType], [Batch], [StorageLocation], [DebitCreditindication], [QuantityinCount], [Quantity], [NoOfItem])
		SELECT @movementid, @WorkOrderID, GETDATE(), 'T-SQL', @PostingDate, @MaterialDocument, @GoodsMovementType, @Batch, @StorageLocation, @SHType, @QuantityInCount, @QuantityInEntryUnit, 1

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Store data in WorkOrder movement Process End', @Subsrno ;
	
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Completed', @Subsrno 
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH	
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_trn_Tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srno AS Srno, @SPname AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @Exec, @APIPostingType, 'Error', @Subsrno 

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_Posting_Sequence_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_Posting_Sequence_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';	
	END CATCH
END
```

**Modified On:** 2026-03-18 16:00:33  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |

### EXEC Template

```sql
    @RecordID = '',
    @TransactionID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 2026-01-29
-- Description:	store API error response for Result Recording
-- =============================================
CREATE          PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_SAP_ResultRecording_API_Error_Usp] --@RecordID=, @TransactionID=, @APIPostingType=
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@RecordID VARCHAR(36),
	@TransactionID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Body VARCHAR(MAX) ;
	DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(MAX); 
	DECLARE @UserID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @HeatNo VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @InspectionLot VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @SPName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @EXEC NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Subsrno INT = 0; 
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	BEGIN TRY
		; WITH CTE AS (
			SELECT 1 AS sr, '@RecordID' AS [Name], @RecordID AS [Value] UNION SELECT 2 AS sr, '@TransactionID' AS [Name], @TransactionID AS [Value]
		), CTE1 AS (
			SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPName], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION]
			FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) 
		)
		SELECT @SPName = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @EXEC = c.[SPname] + ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ')
		FROM cte1 AS c JOIN cte ON c.[ORDINAL_POSITION] = cte.[sr] GROUP BY c.[SPname]
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 9 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'RR', 'Entered', @Subsrno

		/*--Get data from Batch Characteristics--*/
		SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @HeatNo = [HeatNo], @InspectionLot = [InspectionLot]
		FROM [Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*---Get API Body Message---*/		
		SELECT TOP 1 @Body = (
			SELECT TOP 1 [Message] AS jsonv 
			FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [Message] LIKE '%Body: {%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC
		); 

		/*----Get API error message---*/
		SELECT @ErrorMessage = (SELECT TOP 1 SUBSTRING([Message], CHARINDEX('Error Message:', [Message]) + LEN('Error Message:'), LEN([Message])) FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch]..[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [Message] LIKE '%Error Message%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC);
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 9 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'RR', 'Store Errors In Result Recording Posting Error Table Process Start', @Subsrno

		/*---Store Error Response data for ResultRecording---*/
		INSERT INTO XMES_SAP_API_ResultRecording_Error([EntryDateTime], [TransactionID], [Body], [RecordID], [Status], [ErrorMessage], [CreatedBy], [ModifiedBy], [Source], [ModifiedOn], [HeatNo], [InspectionLot])
		SELECT GETDATE(), @TransactionID, @Body, @RecordID, 'PopUp', @ErrorMessage, @UserID, @UserID, 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), @HeatNo, @InspectionLot;

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 9 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'RR', 'Store Errors In Result Recording Posting Error Table Process End', @Subsrno

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 9 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'RR', 'Completed', @Subsrno
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT 9 AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'RR', 'Error', @Subsrno

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_ResultRecording_API_Error_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_ResultRecording_API_Error_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);		
	END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 2026-01-29
-- Description:	store API error response for Usage decision
-- =============================================
CREATE              PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_SAP_Usage_Decision_API_Error_Usp] --@RecordID=, @TransactionID=, @APIPostingType=
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@RecordID VARCHAR(36),
	@TransactionID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Body VARCHAR(MAX) ;
	DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(MAX); 
	DECLARE @UserID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @LOTnumber VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @inspectionLOT VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @heatno VarChar(20);
	DECLARE @CreatedOn DATETIME;
	DECLARE @srNo INT;
	DECLARE @SPName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @EXEC NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @Subsrno INT = 0;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT @srNo = CASE WHEN [MaterialType] = 'GLS' THEN 10 WHEN [MaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' THEN 11 ELSE NULL END FROM [dbo].[MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [Saptransactionid] = @transactionid;
		; WITH CTE AS (
			SELECT 1 AS sr, '@RecordID' AS [Name], @RecordID AS [Value] UNION SELECT 2 AS sr, '@TransactionID' AS [Name], @TransactionID AS [Value]
		), CTE1 AS (
			SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPName], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION]
			FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) 
		)
		SELECT @SPName = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @EXEC = c.[SPname] + ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ')
		FROM cte1 AS c JOIN cte ON c.[ORDINAL_POSITION] = cte.[sr] GROUP BY c.[SPname]

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srNo AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'UD', 'Entered', @Subsrno

		/*--Get data from Batch Characteristics--*/
		SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @inspectionLOT = t.[InspectionLot], @heatno = [HeatNo], @CreatedOn = [CreatedOn]
		FROM [MES_SAP_UsageDecision_Trn_Tbl]AS t WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*---Get API Body Message---*/		
		SELECT TOP 1 @Body = (
			SELECT TOP 1 [Message] AS jsonv 
			FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [Message] LIKE '%Body: {%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC
		); 

		/*----Get API error message---*/
		SELECT @ErrorMessage = (SELECT TOP 1 SUBSTRING([Message], CHARINDEX('Error Message:', [Message]) + LEN('Error Message:'), LEN([Message])) FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch]..[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [Message] LIKE '%Error Message%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC);

		--UPDATE [Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] SET [IsUDStatus] = 1 where [HeatNo] = @heatno AND [InspectionLot]=  @inspectionLOT;
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srNo AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'UD', 'Store Errors In Usage Decision Posting Error Table Process Start', @Subsrno
		/*---Store Error Response data for WorkOrder Creation---*/
		INSERT INTO [XMES_SAP_API_UsageDecision_Error]([EntryDateTime], [TransactionID], [Body], [RecordID], [Status], [ErrorMessage], [CreatedBy], [ModifiedBy], [Source], [ModifiedOn], [InspectionLot], [CreatedOn], [HeatNo])
		SELECT GETDATE(), @TransactionID, @Body, @RecordID, 'PopUp', @ErrorMessage, @UserID, @UserID, 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), @inspectionLOT, @CreatedOn, @heatno;

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srNo AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'UD', 'Store Errors In Usage Decision Posting Error Table Process End', @Subsrno

		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srNo AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'UD', 'Completed', @Subsrno
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @subSrNo = @subSrNo + 1
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Log_TRN_tbl] ([SrNo], [Name], [SOurce], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [ExecutionQuery], [Type], [Status], [SubSeqNo])
		SELECT @srNo AS [SrNo], @SPName AS [Name], 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), @EXEC, 'UD', 'Error', @Subsrno

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_Usage_Decision_API_Error_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_Usage_Decision_API_Error_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);		
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_SAP_WorkOrder_Creation_API_Error_Usp

**Procedure Name:** XMES_SAP_WorkOrder_Creation_API_Error_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-01-30 13:53:18  
**Modified On:** 2026-01-30 13:53:18  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @RecordID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @TransactionID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_SAP_WorkOrder_Creation_API_Error_Usp]
    @RecordID = '',
    @TransactionID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nidhi Rana
-- Create date: 2026-01-29
-- Description:	store API error response for Work Order Movement
-- =============================================
CREATE            PROCEDURE  [dbo].[XMES_SAP_WorkOrder_Creation_API_Error_Usp] --@RecordID=, @TransactionID=, @APIPostingType=
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@RecordID VARCHAR(36),
	@TransactionID VARCHAR(36)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @Body VARCHAR(MAX) ;
	DECLARE @ErrorMessage VARCHAR(MAX); 
	DECLARE @UserID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @Material VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @Quantity DECIMAL(18,2);
	DECLARE @WorkOrderType VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @CustomerName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @CreatedOn DATETIME;
    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	BEGIN TRY
	
		/*--Get data from Batch Characteristics--*/
		SELECT @UserID = [ModifiedBy], @Material = [MaterialName], @Quantity = [Quantity], @WorkOrderType = [ManufacturingOrderType], @CustomerName = [Customername], @CreatedOn = [CreatedOn]
		FROM [XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [ID] = @RecordID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*---Get API Body Message---*/		
		SELECT TOP 1 @Body = (
			SELECT TOP 1 [Message] AS jsonv 
			FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
			WHERE [Isdeleted] = 0 AND [Message] LIKE '%Body: {%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC
		); 

		/*----Get API error message---*/
		SELECT @ErrorMessage = (SELECT TOP 1 SUBSTRING([Message], CHARINDEX('Error Message:', [Message]) + LEN('Error Message:'), LEN([Message])) FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch]..[XStudio_API_Error_Log_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE [Message] LIKE '%Error Message%' AND [TransactionID] = @TransactionID ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC);

		/*---Store Error Response data for WorkOrder Creation---*/
		INSERT INTO [XMES_SAP_API_WorkOrderCreation_Error]([EntryDateTime], [TransactionID], [Body], [RecordID], [Status], [ErrorMessage], [CreatedBy], [ModifiedBy], [Source], [ModifiedOn], [ItemName], [TotalQuantity], [WorkOrderType], [CustomerName], [CreatedOn])
		SELECT GETDATE(), @TransactionID, @Body, @RecordID, 'PopUp', @ErrorMessage, @UserID, @UserID, 'T-SQL', GETDATE(), @Material, @Quantity, @WorkOrderType, @CustomerName, @CreatedOn;

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SAP_WorkOrder_Creation_API_Error_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SAP_WorkOrder_Creation_API_Error_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);		
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_Schedule_SP_to_Refresh_Data_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Schedule_SP_to_Refresh_Data_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-01-01 10:32:56  
**Modified On:** 2026-01-01 10:37:41  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Schedule_SP_to_Refresh_Data_Usp]
    @ID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------*/
--Created By : Nidhi Rana
--Created On : 01-Jan-2026
--Description : Schedule Procedure to refresh data
/*-----------------------*/

CREATE     proc [dbo].[XMES_Schedule_SP_to_Refresh_Data_Usp]
(
	@ID varchar(36)
)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT OFF;
	/*-----Variable Declaration----*/
	DECLARE @StoreProcedureName VARCHAR(2000);
	DECLARE @Query NVARCHAR(2000);
	DECLARE @ReportDate DATE;
	DECLARE @ScheduleName VARCHAR(500);
	DECLARE @SystemID VARCHAR(36);
	DECLARE @datadatabase VARCHAR(400);
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*---Get Data for schedule---*/
		SELECT @StoreProcedureName = [StoreProcedure], @ReportDate = [ReportDate], @ScheduleName = [Name]
		FROM XMES_Recalculate_Data WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE [ID] = @ID AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

		/*----Get System ID of Current Database----*/
		SELECT @SystemID = [ID], @datadatabase = [DataDatabase] FROM [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_System_mst_tbl] AS SMT WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE SMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND (SMT.[ConfigurationDatabase] = DB_NAME() OR SMT.[DataDatabase] = DB_NAME() )
		/*---When Reportdate Not selected---*/
		SET @ReportDate = ISNULL(@ReportDate, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));

		/*------Set Execute query-----*/
		SET @query = 'EXEC ['+@datadatabase+'].[dbo].['+@StoreProcedureName+'] '''''+cast(@ReportDate as varchar(20))+''''''

		/*------Schedule SP Using Tsql query------*/
		EXEC XStudio_Configuration.dbo.XStudio_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp @SystemID,@Schedulename,@query;
		--exec(@StoreProcedureName + ' '''+@ReportDate+'''')
		--print(@StoreProcedureName + ' '''+cast(@ReportDate as varchar(10))+'''')
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_Schedule_SP_to_Refresh_Data_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Schedule_SP_to_Refresh_Data_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	END CATCH
END
```
