## dbo.XMES_SMS_Dashboard_Delay_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_SMS_Dashboard_Delay_USP  
**Created On:** 2026-04-27 16:34:03  
**Modified On:** 2026-05-14 09:04:42  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_SMS_Dashboard_Delay_USP];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_SMS_Dashboard_Delay_USP]
-- NO PARAMETERS – All filtering handled by JavaScript on the frontend
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    --  INTERNAL : MTD / YTD boundaries (used ONLY in RS1 KPI subqueries)
    --  These are NOT applied to any other result set.
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @MTD_Start  DATETIME = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1);
    DECLARE @YTD_Start  DATETIME = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1);
    DECLARE @PeriodEnd  DATETIME = GETDATE();


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 1 : KPI SUMMARY
    --  Single-row summary. TodayDate / MTD_Start / YTD_Start exposed
    --  so JS knows the currency of the snapshot.
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT

        /* ── Snapshot anchors for JS ────────────────────────────────── */
        CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)                                         AS TodayDate,
        @MTD_Start                                                      AS MTD_Start,
        @YTD_Start                                                      AS YTD_Start,

        /* ── Delay Hours : MTD ──────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL((
                SELECT SUM(DelayInSecond) / 3600.0
                FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
                WHERE  IsDeleted  = 0
                  AND  AreaName   = 'SMS'
                  AND  ReportDate BETWEEN @MTD_Start AND @PeriodEnd
            ), 0)
        , 2) AS MTD_DelayHours,

        /* ── Delay Hours : YTD ──────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL((
                SELECT SUM(DelayInSecond) / 3600.0
                FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
                WHERE  IsDeleted  = 0
                  AND  AreaName   = 'SMS'
                  AND  ReportDate BETWEEN @YTD_Start AND @PeriodEnd
            ), 0)
        , 2) AS YTD_DelayHours,

        /* ── Delay Hours : ALL DATA ─────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL((
                SELECT SUM(DelayInSecond) / 3600.0
                FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
                WHERE  IsDeleted = 0
                  AND  AreaName  = 'SMS'
            ), 0)
        , 2) AS Total_DelayHours,

        /* ── Cycle Time Actual ──────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL((
                SELECT AVG(FTDton)
                FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.SMS_Production_Summary
                WHERE  isdeleted   = 0
                  AND  particulars = 'Cycle Time'
            ), 0)
        , 0) AS CycleTime_Actual,

        /* ── Cycle Time Target (static) ─────────────────────────────── */
        52 AS CycleTime_Target,

        /* ── Delay Percent ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL((
                SELECT AVG(FTDPercentage)
                FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.SMS_Production_Summary
                WHERE  isdeleted     = 0
                  AND  FTDPercentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100
                  AND  particulars   = 'Total Delays + Std Delays'
            ), 0)
        , 2) AS DelayPercent,

        /* ── Avg Power ON Time ──────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL((
                SELECT AVG(FTDTOn)
                FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.SMS_Production_Summary
                WHERE  isdeleted   = 0
                  AND  particulars = 'Avg Power ON Time'
            ), 0)
        , 2) AS AvgPowerOnTime,

        /* ── TTT (Calendar Time / Heat) ─────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL((
                SELECT AVG(FTDTOn)
                FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.SMS_Production_Summary
                WHERE  isdeleted   = 0
                  AND  particulars = 'TTT (Calendar Time/Heat)'
            ), 0)
        , 2) AS TTT_CalendarTimePerHeat,

        /* ── Heats Per Day ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL((
                SELECT AVG(FTDTOn)
                FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.SMS_Production_Summary
                WHERE  isdeleted   = 0
                  AND  particulars = 'Total SMS Heats Tap'
            ), 0)
        , 2) AS HeatsPerDay,

        /* ── Total Delay Events ─────────────────────────────────────── */
        ISNULL((
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
        ), 0) AS DelayEvents,

        /* ── Heats WITH Delay ───────────────────────────────────────── */
        ISNULL((
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
            FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
            WHERE  IsDeleted = 0
        ), 0) AS HeatsWithDelay,

        /* ── Total Heats ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        ISNULL((
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
            FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw
        ), 0) AS TotalHeats,

        /* ── Heats WITHOUT Delay (floor at 0) ───────────────────────── */
        CASE
            WHEN
                ISNULL((
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw
                ), 0)
                -
                ISNULL((
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
                    WHERE  IsDeleted = 0
                ), 0) < 0
            THEN 0
            ELSE
                ISNULL((
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw
                ), 0)
                -
                ISNULL((
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
                    WHERE  IsDeleted = 0
                ), 0)
        END AS HeatsWithoutDelay,

        /* ── Delayed Heats % ────────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            CAST(
                100.0
                * ISNULL((
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
                    WHERE  IsDeleted = 0
                ), 0)
                / NULLIF((
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HeatNo)
                    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw
                ), 0)
            AS DECIMAL(5,2))
        , 2) AS DelayedHeatsPct;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 2 : DAILY TREND
    --  ReportDay → JS filters by date range on this column.
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)                                        AS ReportDay,

        /* ── DelayPercent ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL(
                AVG(CASE
                        WHEN particulars   = 'Total Delays + Std Delays'
                         AND FTDPercentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100
                        THEN FTDPercentage
                    END)
            , 0)
        , 2)                                                            AS DelayPercent,

        /* ── TapToTapTime ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL(
                AVG(CASE
                        WHEN particulars = 'TTT (Calendar Time/Heat)'
                        THEN FTDTon
                    END)
            , 0)
        , 2)                                                            AS TapToTapTime,

        /* ── HeatsPerDay ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL(
                AVG(CASE
                        WHEN particulars = 'Total SMS Heats Tap'
                        THEN FTDTon
                    END)
            , 0)
        , 2)                                                            AS HeatsPerDay,

        /* ── ProductionTons ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
        ROUND(
            ISNULL(
                SUM(CASE
                        WHEN particulars = 'Total Prime Production'
                        THEN FTDTon
                    END)
            , 0)
        , 2)                                                            AS ProductionTons

    FROM  XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.SMS_Production_Summary
    WHERE isdeleted = 0
    GROUP BY CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)
    ORDER BY ReportDay;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 3 : EAF STAGE TIMES
    --  FIX: HeatDate → ReportDate (confirmed column in eaf_per_heat)
    --  Grouped by date per stage so JS can filter by StageDate.
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        'Scrap Charging'                        AS Stage,
        CAST(p.StartTime AS DATE)               AS StageDate,       -- ← JS filter
        ROUND(AVG(p.Duration), 2)               AS AvgDurationSeconds
    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime  p
    WHERE  p.status = 'EAF Roof Open For Fill Bucket Charging'
    GROUP BY CAST(p.StartTime AS DATE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Power-On',
        CAST(ReportDate AS DATE),                                   -- ← JS filter
        ROUND(AVG(PoweronTimeTotalSeconds), 2)
    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.eaf_per_heat
    GROUP BY CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Power-Off',
        CAST(ReportDate AS DATE),                                   -- ← JS filter
        ROUND(AVG(PowerOffTimeTotalSeconds), 2)
    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.eaf_per_heat
    GROUP BY CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Tapping',
        CAST(ReportDate AS DATE),                                   -- ← JS filter
        ROUND(AVG(TapTimeMinute), 2)
    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.eaf_per_heat
    GROUP BY CAST(ReportDate AS DATE)

    ORDER BY Stage, StageDate;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 4 : DELAY BY TYPE
    --  FIX: EntryDateTime → DelayStartTime (confirmed column)
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)                                    AS EntryDate,  -- ← JS filter
        ISNULL(DelayType_DelayType, 'Uncategorized')                    AS Category,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 60.0  AS DECIMAL(10,1))   AS DelayMin,
        COUNT(*)                                                         AS DelayCount,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1))  AS DelayHours
    FROM  XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        ISNULL(DelayType_DelayType, 'Uncategorized')
    ORDER BY EntryDate, DelayMin DESC;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 5 : DELAY BY SUBTYPE
    --  FIX: EntryDateTime → DelayStartTime (confirmed column)
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)                                    AS EntryDate,  -- ← JS filter
        ISNULL(DelayType_DelayType, 'Uncategorized')                      AS Category,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 60.0  AS DECIMAL(10,1))   AS DelayMin,
        COUNT(*)                                                         AS DelayCount,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1))  AS DelayHours
    FROM  XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        ISNULL(DelayType_DelayType, 'Uncategorized')
    ORDER BY EntryDate, DelayMin DESC;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 6 : DELAY BY AGENCY
    --  FIX: EntryDateTime → DelayStartTime (confirmed column)
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)                                    AS EntryDate,  -- ← JS filter
        ISNULL(DelayAgency_Name, 'Uncategorized')                       AS Category,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 60.0  AS DECIMAL(10,1))   AS DelayMin,
        COUNT(*)                                                         AS DelayCount,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1))  AS DelayHours
    FROM  XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        ISNULL(DelayAgency_Name, 'Uncategorized')
    ORDER BY EntryDate, DelayMin DESC;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 7 : DELAY BY EQUIPMENT / SUB-EQUIPMENT
    --  FIX: EntryDateTime → DelayStartTime (confirmed column)
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)                                    AS EntryDate,  -- ← JS filter
        CASE
            WHEN (Equipment    IS NULL OR Equipment    = '')
             AND (SubEquipment IS NULL OR SubEquipment = '')
            THEN 'Uncategorized'
            WHEN (SubEquipment IS NULL OR SubEquipment = '')
            THEN Equipment
            ELSE Equipment + ' - ' + SubEquipment
        END                                                             AS Category,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 60.0  AS DECIMAL(10,1))  AS DelayMin,
        COUNT(*)                                                        AS DelayCount,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 3600.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1)) AS DelayHours
    FROM  XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        CASE
            WHEN (Equipment    IS NULL OR Equipment    = '')
             AND (SubEquipment IS NULL OR SubEquipment = '')
            THEN 'Uncategorized'
            WHEN (SubEquipment IS NULL OR SubEquipment = '')
            THEN Equipment
            ELSE Equipment + ' - ' + SubEquipment
        END
    ORDER BY EntryDate, DelayMin DESC;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 8 : HEAT-LEVEL CYCLE TIME vs DELAY
    --  FIX: HeatDate → ReportDate via MIN(StartTime) from process CTE
    --  XStudio_List_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_vw has: ReportDate, StartTime
    --  Using ReportDate directly as it is already a date-level column.
    -- ================================================================
    WITH process_sum AS
    (
        SELECT   HeatNo,
                 MIN(CAST(ReportDate AS DATE))                   AS HeatDate,   -- ← JS filter
                 CAST(SUM(DurationinMinutes) AS DECIMAL(18,2))  AS CycleTimeMin
        FROM     XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_vw
        GROUP BY HeatNo
    ),
    delay_sum AS
    (
        SELECT   HeatNo,
                 CAST(SUM(DATEDIFF(SECOND, DelayStartTime, DelayEndTime)) / 60.0
                      AS DECIMAL(18,2))                         AS DelayMin,
                 COUNT(*)                                       AS DelayCount
        FROM     XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_Vw
        GROUP BY HeatNo
    )
    SELECT
        p.HeatDate,                                                     -- ← JS filter
        p.HeatNo,
        p.CycleTimeMin,
        ISNULL(d.DelayMin,   0)                                 AS DelayMin,
        ISNULL(d.DelayCount, 0)                                 AS DelayCount,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN p.CycleTimeMin > 0
                THEN ISNULL(d.DelayMin, 0) * 100.0 / p.CycleTimeMin
                ELSE 0
            END
        AS DECIMAL(18,2))                                       AS DelayPctOfCycle
    FROM  process_sum p
    LEFT  JOIN delay_sum d ON p.HeatNo = d.HeatNo
    ORDER BY p.HeatDate DESC, p.HeatNo DESC;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 9 : ALL HEATS BY DELAY (TOP 5 done in JS)
    --  FIX: DelayStartTime confirmed → used as date anchor.
    --  TOP 5 removed so JS can apply date filter first, then rank.
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE)                                    AS EntryDate,  -- ← JS filter
        HeatNo,
        CAST(SUM(ISNULL(DelayInSecond, 0)) / 60.0 AS DECIMAL(10,1))   AS DelayMin,
        COUNT(*)                                                        AS DelayCount,
        ISNULL(MAX(Grade), '')                                          AS Grade
    FROM  XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw
    WHERE HeatNo IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        CAST(DelayStartTime AS DATE),
        HeatNo
    ORDER BY EntryDate DESC, DelayMin DESC;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 10 : GRADE vs DELAY
    --  FIX: CastingDate → ReportDate (confirmed column in CCM view)
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE)                                      AS ReportDate,  -- ← JS filter
        c.Grade,
        ROUND(
            ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(s.DelayInSecond, 0)) / 60.0, 0)
        , 2)                                                            AS DelayMin,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.HeatNo)                                        AS Heats
    FROM  XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw  c
    LEFT  JOIN XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_ShiftDelayEntry_vw s
           ON  s.HeatNo = c.HeatNo
    GROUP BY
        CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE),
        c.Grade
    ORDER BY ReportDate DESC, DelayMin DESC;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 11 : DELAYED vs NON-DELAYED HEAT QUALITY
    --  FIX: CastingDate → ReportDate (confirmed column in CCM view)
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE)                                      AS ReportDate,  -- ← JS filter
        CASE
            WHEN d.HeatNo IS NULL THEN 'No Delay'
            ELSE                       'Delayed'
        END                                                             AS HeatClass,
        ROUND(AVG(ISNULL(c.TotalPostedBilletWeightTon, 0)), 2)         AS AvgTon,
        COUNT(*)                                                        AS Heats
    FROM  XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_CCM_Per_Heat_vw c
    LEFT  JOIN
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT HeatNo
            FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.ShiftDelayEntry
            WHERE  IsDeleted = 0
        ) d ON c.HeatNo = d.HeatNo
    GROUP BY
        CAST(c.ReportDate AS DATE),
        CASE
            WHEN d.HeatNo IS NULL THEN 'No Delay'
            ELSE                       'Delayed'
        END
    ORDER BY ReportDate DESC;


    -- ================================================================
    --  RESULT SET 12 : PROCESS EVENT DETAIL – explicit column list
    --  FIX: removed SELECT * to eliminate ambiguous StartTime error.
    --  All confirmed columns from XStudio_List_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_vw
    --  listed explicitly with vw alias prefix.
    -- ================================================================
    SELECT
        vw.ID,
        vw.HeatNo,
        CAST(vw.ReportDate AS DATE)     AS EventDate,               -- ← JS filter
        vw.ReportDate,
        vw.StartTime,
        vw.EndTime,
        vw.EquipmentID,
        vw.Status,
        vw.IsProcessed,
        vw.DurationMMSS,
        vw.DurationinMinutes,
        vw.StateSequence,
        vw.Details
    FROM   XStudio_Xbatch.dbo.XStudio_List_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_vw  vw
    ORDER BY vw.StartTime;

END;
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana
-- Create date: 16-12-2025
-- Description:	View for Showing SO Transaction
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_SO_Trn_VW]

AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;


	SELECT
	  s.name [SalesOrder],
	  m.Name [Material],
	  st.Action [Status],
	  u.FullName [ActionBy],
	  ActionDate,
	  xs.Color [Statuscolourcode],
	  m.ColourCode [MaterialColourcode]
	FROM
	  XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl_TimeLine AS st WITH (NOLOCK)
	  JOIN XBatch_Sales_Order_Mst_Tbl AS s WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.ID = st.RecordID and s.IsDeleted=0
	  JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl AS m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.ID = s.ItemID and m.IsDeleted=0
	  JOIN XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch..XStudio_User_Mst_Tbl AS u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.ID = st.ActionBy and u.IsDeleted=0
	  JOIN XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl AS xs WITH (NOLOCK)  ON xs.Name=st.Action and xs.IsDeleted=0
	  Order by ActionDate desc ,s.Name
END
```

## dbo.XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION  
**Created On:** 2026-03-14 11:15:28  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-26 10:58:46  
**Parameter Count:** 4  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @SYSTEMID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @USERID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @RECORDID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @STATUS | varchar(50) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION]
    @SYSTEMID = '',
    @USERID = '',
    @RECORDID = '',
    @STATUS = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------------------*/
	--Modified By : Nidhi Rana
	--Modified On : 20-Mar-2026
	--Description : store and update LRF and Tundish records having deviation in Quality deviation for heat
/*----------------------------*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION]
(
	@SYSTEMID VARCHAR(36),     
	@USERID VARCHAR(36),     
	@RECORDID VARCHAR(36),   
	@STATUS VARCHAR(50)   
)
AS
BEGIN
	--DECLARE @recordid varchar(36) = '00259683-FE22-4139-987E-CADD89E649F3';
	DECLARE @HeatNo INT ;--= '1601278' ;
	DECLARE @ColLst NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @ColLst1 NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*---Check sample of TS or TD are released or not for record---*/
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Status] = 'Released' AND [ID] = @RECORDID AND [SampleType] IN ('TD','TS'))
		BEGIN 
			/*----Set Column List for Chemistry----*/
			SELECT @ColLst =  STRING_AGG(CAST('[' + col +']' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),','), @ColLst1 = STRING_AGG(cast(CONCAT('CONCAT([',col,'Min],''_'',[', col,'Max]) AS [',col,']') AS nvarchar(max)),',') FROM (
				SELECT DISTINCT LEFT(Column_name,LEN(COLUMN_NAME) - 3) AS col--, 'CONCAT('+STRING_AGG('['+ column_name+']',',''_'',') + ') AS [' + LEFT(Column_name,LEN(COLUMN_NAME) - 3)+']' AS Col1
				FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'XMES_SMS_Grade_Protocol_Chemistry_mst_tbl' AND (column_name LIKE '%Max' OR column_name LIKE '%min')
				GROUP BY LEFT(Column_name,LEN(COLUMN_NAME) - 3)
			) AS t

			/*----Get Heat no for released record---*/
			SELECT @HeatNo = [HeatNo] FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @RECORDID;

			DECLARE @tbl AS TABLE ([ReportDate] DATE, [ShiftInCharge] VARCHAR(200), [Shift] VARCHAR(100), [HeatNo] VARCHAR(200), [Grade] VARCHAR(200), [Elements] VARCHAR(200), [LRF] DECIMAL(18, 4), [Tundish] DECIMAL(18, 4));

			/*---------get and store data for deviation in LRF and Tundish------------*/
			SET @SQL = 
			'		
			SELECT [ReportDate], [Chemist], [Shift], [Heatno], [Grade], [element], sum([LRF]) AS [LRF], SUM([Tundish]) AS [Tundish] FROM  (
				SELECT [ReportDate], CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,ReportedTime) BETWEEN 6 AND 18 THEN ''D'' ELSE ''N'' END AS [Shift], [Chemist], [HeatNo], [Grade] ,[Element], [LRF], [Tundish] FROM (
					SELECT t.* FROM (
						SELECT *, CASE WHEN [SampleType] IN (''TD'',''TS'') THEN ''Tundish'' WHEN [SampleType] LIKE ''L[0-9]'' THEN ''LRF'' END AS [SM] FROM (
							SELECT [ReportDate], [ReportedTime]
								, CASE WHEN [SampleName] NOT LIKE [HeatNo] + ''%'' THEN LTRIM(RIGHT(SUBSTRING([SampleName], PATINDEX(''%[A-Z]%'', [SampleName]), LEN([SampleName])), LEN(SUBSTRING([SampleName], PATINDEX(''%[A-Z]%'', [SampleName]), LEN([SampleName]))) - 2))
								ELSE 
									CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), 0, 3) IN (''TD'',''TS'') OR LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''),'''')) LIKE ''%[A-Z][0-9]%'' 
										THEN LTRIM(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), 3, LEN([SampleName])))
										ELSE CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], '''')),1,LEN( SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+ '' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1) )) =  SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+'' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1) 
													AND SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], '''')),1,LEN([SampleType])) LIKE ''_% %'' 
												THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+ '' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1)  ,'''')) 
												ELSE LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), ''''))
											END				
									END 
							END AS [Chemist], [Heatno], [SampleType], [Grade], '+@Collst+'
							FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND  ([SampleType] IN (''TD'',''TS'')) AND [HeatNo] = '''+CAST(@HeatNo as varchar(max))+''' AND [Heatno] LIKE ''%[0-9]%'' AND [Sampletype] NOT LIKE ''F[0-9]''
							UNION 
							SELECT [ReportDate], [ReportedTime]
								, CASE WHEN [SampleName] NOT LIKE [HeatNo] + ''%'' THEN LTRIM(RIGHT(SUBSTRING([SampleName], PATINDEX(''%[A-Z]%'', [SampleName]), LEN([SampleName])), LEN(SUBSTRING([SampleName], PATINDEX(''%[A-Z]%'', [SampleName]), LEN([SampleName]))) - 2))
								ELSE 
									CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), 0, 3) IN (''TD'',''TS'') OR LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''),'''')) LIKE ''%[A-Z][0-9]%'' 
										THEN LTRIM(SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), 3, LEN([SampleName])))
										ELSE CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], '''')),1,LEN( SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+ '' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1) )) =  SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+'' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1) 
													AND SUBSTRING(LTRIM(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], '''')),1,LEN([SampleType])) LIKE ''_% %'' 
												THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), '''')), SUBSTRING(SampleType, 1, 1)+ '' ''+RIGHT(SampleType, LEN(sampletype) - 1)  ,'''')) 
												ELSE LTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE([SampleName], [HeatNo], ''''), ISNULL([SampleType], ''''), ''''))
											END				
									END 
							END AS [Chemist], [Heatno], [SampleType], [Grade], '+@Collst+' FROM (
								SELECT * ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY [reportdate],heatno ORDER BY REPLACE(SAMPLETYPE,''L'','''') desc) as num
								FROM [dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [SampleType] LIKE ''L[0-9]'' AND [HeatNo] = '''+CAST(@HeatNo as varchar(max))+'''  AND [Heatno] LIKE ''%[0-9]%'' AND [Sampletype] NOT LIKE ''F[0-9]''
							) AS t WHERE num= 1
						) AS T UNPIVOT ([ActualValue] FOR [Element] IN ('+@Collst+')) AS unpvt
					) AS t JOIN (
						SELECT GRADE, [Name],  IIF(LEN(LEFT([Value], CHARINDEX(''_'',[Value])-1)) = 0,NULL,LEFT([Value], CHARINDEX(''_'',[Value])-1)) AS [Minval],IIF(LEN(SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX(''_'',[Value])+1,LEN([Value])))=0,NULL,SUBSTRING([Value], CHARINDEX(''_'',[Value])+1,LEN([Value]))) AS [MaxVal],[value] FROM (
							SELECT GRD.Name AS Grade, '+@ColLst1+'
							FROM XMES_SMS_Grade_Protocol_Mst_Tbl AS Grd WITH(NOLOCK) 
							JOIN [dbo].[XMES_SMS_Grade_Protocol_Chemistry_Mst_Tbl] AS CMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON GRD.[ID] = CMT.[ParentID]
						) AS t UNPIVOT ([Value] for [Name] IN ('+@ColLst+')) as unpvt
					) AS t1 ON t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[Element] = t1.[Name]
					WHERE ((t1.Minval IS NOT NULL AND t.[ActualValue] < [Minval]) OR (t1.[MaxVal] IS NOT NULL AND t.[ActualValue] > [MaxVal]))
				)AS t PIVOT (SUM([ActualValue]) FOR [SM] IN ([LRF],[tundish])) As pvt ) AS t
				GROUP BY [ReportDate], [Chemist], [Shift], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Element]'
			INSERT INTO @tbl EXEC(@SQL)
	
		END

		/*---Delete not deviated record from deviation quality---*/
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] WHERE [ID] IN ( SELECT [ID] FROM [dbo].[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] AS t WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE t.[elements] = t1.[Elements] AND t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[HeatNo] = t1.[HeatNo] AND t.[ReportDate] = t1.[ReportDate] AND t1.[Shift] = t.[Shift] AND t1.[ShiftIncharge] = t.[ShiftInCharge]) AND [heatno] = @heatno)

		--	select * FROM [dbo].[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] where [ID] NOT IN (SELECT [ID] FROM [dbo].[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] AS t WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @tbl AS t1 WHERE t.[elements] = t1.[Elements] AND t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[HeatNo] = t1.[HeatNo]))
	
		/*-----Update LRF and Tundish for deviated records-----*/
		UPDATE t1 SET [LRFAtActualPercentage] = t.[LRF], [TundishAtActualPercentage] = t.[Tundish], [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), [Source] = 'T-SQL' FROM @tbl AS t
		JOIN [dbo].[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] AS t1 ON t.[HeatNo] = t1.[HeatNo] AND t.[Elements] = t1.[Elements] AND t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[ReportDate] = t1.[ReportDate] AND t1.[Shift] = t.[Shift] AND t1.[ShiftIncharge] = t.[ShiftInCharge] WHERE t1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND t1.[HeatNo] = @heatno;
		
		/*-----store deviated reocords of LRF and Tundish not in deviation quality-----*/
		INSERT INTO Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data( [ReportDate], [ShiftIncharge], [Shift], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Elements], [LRFAtActualPercentage], [TundishAtActualPercentage], [Createdon], [Source])
		SELECT  [ReportDate], [ShiftIncharge], [Shift], [HeatNo], [Grade], [Elements], [LRF], [Tundish], GETDATE(), 'T-SQL' FROM @tbl AS t
		WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.[Chemistry_Deviation_Quality_Data] AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE t.[HeatNo] = t1.[HeatNo] AND t.[Elements] = t1.[Elements] AND t.[Grade] = t1.[Grade] AND t.[ReportDate] = t1.[Reportdate] AND t1.[Shift] = t.[Shift] AND t1.[ShiftIncharge] = t.[ShiftInCharge] AND t1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND t1.[HeatNo] = @Heatno);
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_DEVIATION]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID=@UserId,@HostAddress='',@Info=@SQL,@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_REPORT_DATA

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_REPORT_DATA  
**Created On:** 2026-03-13 14:53:51  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-13 16:42:05  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_REPORT_DATA]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE XMES_SP_HEAT_CHEMISTRY_REPORT_DATA
(
    @ReportDate DATE
)
AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @FirstHeat VARCHAR(100)
    DECLARE @LastHeat VARCHAR(100)

    SELECT 
        @FirstHeat = FirstHeatNo,
        @LastHeat  = LastHeatNo
    FROM Heat_End_Selection_Trn_Tbl
    WHERE ReportDate = @ReportDate 
    AND IsDeleted = 0;


WITH CTE AS
(
SELECT 
       QD.ReportDate,
       QD.HeatNo,
       QD.Grade,
       QD.Section,
       QD.ReceivedTime,
       QD.ReportedTime,
       QD.SampleType,
       QD.C,QD.Mn,QD.Si,QD.S,QD.P,QD.Cr,QD.Ni,QD.Mo,QD.Cu,QD.V,QD.N2PPM,QD.Al,QD.Sn,QD.Pb,QD.Co,QD.Ceq,QD.[As],QD.B,QD.Ca,QD.Nb,QD.TI,QD.W,
       QD.Chemist,QD.Remarks,
       QD.MnPerS,QD.MnPerSi,

       CH.CMin ,CH.MnMin ,CH.SMin ,CH.PMin ,CH.SiMin ,CH.CuMin ,CH.CrMin ,CH.NiMin ,CH.MoMin ,CH.VMin ,CH.NbMin ,CH.TiMin ,CH.N2ppmMin ,CH.AlMin ,CH.CeMin ,CH.MnPerSMin ,CH.MnPerSiMin ,
       CH.CMax ,CH.MnMax ,CH.SMax ,CH.PMax ,CH.SiMax ,CH.CuMax ,CH.CrMax ,CH.NiMax ,CH.MoMax ,CH.VMax ,CH.NbMax ,CH.TiMax ,CH.N2ppmMax ,CH.AlMax ,CH.CeMax ,CH.MnPerSMax ,CH.MnPerSiMax ,

       ROW_NUMBER() OVER 
       (
           PARTITION BY HeatNo,
           CASE 
                WHEN SampleType LIKE 'L%' AND SampleType <> 'L1' 
                THEN 'L_LAST' 
                ELSE SampleType 
           END 
           ORDER BY ReceivedTime DESC
       ) AS RN

FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] QD 
JOIN [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XMES_SMS_Grade_Protocol_Mst_Tbl] GP 
     ON GP.Name = QD.Grade 
     AND GP.IsDeleted = 0

JOIN [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[XMES_SMS_Grade_Protocol_Chemistry_Mst_Tbl] CH 
     ON CH.ParentID = GP.ID 
     AND CH.IsDeleted = 0

CROSS JOIN Heat_End_Selection_Trn_Tbl HES

WHERE QD.IsDeleted = 0 
AND QD.SampleType IN ('F1','L1','L2','L3','L4','TS','TD') 
AND CAST(QD.HeatNo AS VARCHAR(100)) BETWEEN @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat
AND HES.ReportDate = @ReportDate
)

SELECT 
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(HeatNo AS BIGINT)) AS SrNo,

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HeatNo ORDER BY SampleType) AS HeatRow,
	ReportDate,
    HeatNo,
	Grade,
    --CASE 
    --    WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HeatNo ORDER BY SampleType) = 1 
    --    THEN Grade 
    --    ELSE '' 
    --END AS Grade,

    CASE 
        WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HeatNo ORDER BY SampleType) = 1 
        THEN Section 
        ELSE '' 
    END AS Section,

    ReceivedTime,
    ReportedTime,
    SampleType,

    C,Mn,Si,S,P,Cr,Ni,Mo,Cu,V,N2PPM,Al,Sn,Pb,Co,Ceq,[As],B,Ca,Nb,Ti,W,
    Chemist,Remarks,
    MnPerS,MnPerSi,

    CMin,MnMin,SMin,PMin,SiMin,CuMin,CrMin,NiMin,MoMin,VMin,NbMin,TiMin,N2ppmMin,AlMin,CeMin,MnPerSMin,MnPerSiMin,
    CMax,MnMax,SMax,PMax,SiMax,CuMax,CrMax,NiMax,MoMax,VMax,NbMax,TiMax,N2ppmMax,AlMax,CeMax,MnPerSMax,MnPerSiMax

FROM CTE
WHERE RN = 1
ORDER BY HeatNo, SampleType;

END
```

```sql
/*----------------------------------------*/
---Created By : Nidhi Rana
---Created On : 30-Apr-2026
---Description : Validation of Inventory billet current quantity count with entered quantity count
/*----------------------------------------*/

CREATE   PROC [XMES_SPValidation_Inv_BLT_Qty_Usp](@CurrentCount INT, @EnteredCount INT)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT OFF;
	BEGIN TRY
		IF ISNULL(@CurrentCount, 0) < ISNULL(@EnteredCount, 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 'Please Enter Valid Transfer Quantity which should be less than or equal to '+CAST(@CurrentCount AS VARCHAR(10))+' ';
		END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_SPValidation_Inv_BLT_Qty_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_SPValidation_Inv_BLT_Qty_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';	
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_U_Power_consumption_Report_Usp

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |

| @recordid | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### Full Definition

```sql
/*----------------------
	Created By : Nidhi Rana
	Created On : 10-Feb-2026
	Description : Implement procedure to update Power Consumption report data
-----------------------*/
--[XBatch_Power_Consumption_Usp] '11-jul-2025 00:00'
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_U_Power_consumption_Report_Usp](@recordid VARCHAR(36))
AS 
BEGIN
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
	SET ARITHABORT ON;
	SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
	SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
	SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	BEGIN TRY
		
		DECLARE @Entrydate DATE = (SELECT [ReportDate] FROM [dbo].[Power_Consumption_LogSheet] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [ID] = @recordid);
				
		UPDATE [dbo].[Power_Consumption_Report] SET [ReportDate] = t.[ReportDate], [Transformer132kv1] = t.[Transformer132Kv1], [Transformer132kv2] = t.[Transformer132Kv2], [Transformer33kv1] = t.[Transformer33kv1], [Transformer33kv2] = t.[transformer33Kv2], [EAF] = t.[EAF], [LRF] = t.[LRF], [Transformer24MVA] = t.[Transformer24MVA], [Transformer15MVA] = t.[Transformer15MVA], [RollingMill] = t.[RollingMill], [WRM] = t.[WRM], [OxygenPlant4A] = t.[OxygenPlant4A], [NGConsumption] = t.[NGConsumptionSm3], [PlantTotal] = t.[Plant_Total], [SMSTotal] = t.[SMS_Total], [TotalRollingMill] = t.[TotalRollingMill], [SMSAuxWithO2] = t.[SMSAuxwithO2], [SMSAuxWithoutO2] = t.[SMSAuxWithoutO2], [Transformer63MVALosses] = t.[63MVALosses], [Transformer125MVALosses] = t.[125MVALosses], [RMNGConsumption] = t.[RMNGConsumption], [TotalProduction] = t.[TotalProduction], [SMSConsumption] = t.[SMSConsumption]
		FROM (SELECT *, [Transformer132KV1] + [Transformer132kv2] AS [Plant_Total], [Transformer132KV1] + [Transformer132kv2] - [RollingMill] as [SMS_Total], [Transformer132KV1] + [Transformer132kv2] - [RollingMill] - [EAF] - [LRF] AS [SMSAuxWithO2], [Transformer132KV1] + [Transformer132kv2] - [RollingMill] - [EAF] - [LRF] - [OxygenPlant4A] AS [SMSAuxWithoutO2], [RollingMill] + [WRM] AS [TotalRollingMill], [Transformer132KV1] - [Transformer33KV1] AS [63MVALosses], [Transformer132KV2] - [Transformer33KV2] AS [125MVALosses], [NGConsumptionSm3] - [RMNGconsumption] AS [SMSConsumption] FROM (
			SELECT PCL.[EntryDateTime], PCL.[ReportDate]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer132kv1]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [transformer132KV1] AS [Transformer132KV1]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer132kv2]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer132kv2] AS [Transformer132KV2]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer33kv1]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer33kv1] AS [Transformer33KV1]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer33kv2]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer33kv2] AS [Transformer33KV2]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([EAF]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [EAF] AS [EAF]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([LRF]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [LRF] AS [LRF]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer24MVA]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer24MVA] AS [Transformer24MVA]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([Transformer15MVA]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [Transformer15MVA] AS [Transformer15MVA]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([RollingMill]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [RollingMill] AS [RollingMill]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([WRM]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [WRM] AS [WRM]
				, ISNULL(LEAD([OxygenPlant4A]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[Entrydatetime]), 0) - [OxygenPlant4A] AS [OxygenPlant4A]
				, /*ISNULL(LEAD([NGConsumptionSm3]) OVER (ORDER BY [Entrydatetime]), 0) - */ISNULL([NGconsumptionSM3], 0) AS [NGConsumptionSm3]
				, /*ISNULL(LEAD(COALESCE(CCM.[ActualBilletweightton], CCM.[TotalProduction], 0)) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[EntryDateTime]), 0) -*/ COALESCE(CCM.[ActualBilletweightton], CCM.[totalproduction], 0) AS [TotalProduction]
				, /*ISNULL(LEAD(RM.[NgCons]) OVER (ORDER BY PCL.[EntryDateTime]), 0) -*/ ISNULL(RM.[NGCons], 0) AS [RMNGConsumption]
			FROM [dbo].[Power_Consumption_LogSheet] AS PCL WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN [dbo].[CCM_Summary_Day] AS CCM WITH(NOLOCK) ON PCL.[EntryDateTime] = CCM.[ReportDate] LEFT JOIN [dbo].[RM_Consumption_Summary_Day] AS RM WITH(NOLOCK) ON PCL.[EntryDateTime] = RM.[ReportDate] AND RM.[IsDeleted] = 0
			WHERE PCL.[IsDeleted] = 0 
		) AS t) AS t WHERE CAST([Power_Consumption_Report].[EntryDateTime] AS DATE) = CAST(t.[entrydatetime] AS DATE) AND ([Power_Consumption_Report].[Reportdate] = DATEADD(dd,-1,@Entrydate) OR [Power_Consumption_Report].[Reportdate] = @Entrydate)

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XMES_U_Power_consumption_Report_Usp | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_U_Power_consumption_Report_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)	
	END CATCH
END
```

**Modified On:** 2026-02-19 10:05:55  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ProductionID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_U_SAP_Billet_Posting_Count_Usp]
    @ProductionID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*---------------------*/
--Created By : Mahesh Udar
--Created On : 19-02-2026
--Description : Update Remaining and Posted Billet Count, Billet Weight And status in CCM_Per_Heat
/*---------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_U_SAP_Billet_Posting_Count_Usp] --'E47A5DD2-EF92-4E2D-A6DD-CC9273BCBFDB'
(
	@ProductionID VARCHAR(36)
)
AS 
BEGIN

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	/*---Variable Declaration---*/
	--DECLARE @ProductionID VARCHAR(36)='E47A5DD2-EF92-4E2D-A6DD-CC9273BCBFDB';
	DECLARE @BilletCount INT;
	DECLARE @BilletWeight DECIMAL(18,2);
	DECLARE @HeatNo INT;
	
	BEGIN TRY
	--Select * from [MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatNo] ='1601163' '1601166'
		/*---Get Billet Type and Cutlegnth using Production ID---*/
		SELECT @HeatNo = [HeatNo]
		FROM [MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ProductionID;

		SELECT  @BilletCount=SUM(QuantityInCount), @BilletWeight=SUM(QuantityInEntryUnit)
		FROM [MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [SAPPostingStatus]='Posted' AND [PostingMaterialType] IN ('Cold Billet', 'Hot Billet') ;

		--SELECT ISNULL(@BilletCount,0), ISNULL(@BilletWeight,0), ActualBilletCount-ISNULL(@BilletCount,0), ActualBilletWeightTon-ISNULL(@BilletWeight,0) FROM CCM_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo
		UPDATE CCM_Per_Heat SET TotalPostedBilletCount=ISNULL(@BilletCount,0), TotalPostedBilletWeightTon=ISNULL(@BilletWeight,0), RemainingPostedBilletCount=ActualBilletCount-ISNULL(@BilletCount,0), RemainingPostedBilletWeightTon=ActualBilletWeightTon-ISNULL(@BilletWeight,0) FROM CCM_Per_Heat WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_U_SAP_Billet_Posting_Count_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_U_SAP_Billet_Posting_Count_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*---------------------*/
--Created By : Nidhi Rana
--Created On : 07-Jan-2026
--Description : Update Billet Count, Billet Weight And status in Production
/*---------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_U_SAP_Billet_Production_Trn_Usp] /*'53B5D12D-EAFA-46AA-97AA-84F71C047953'*/(
	--DECLARE
	@ProductionID VARCHAR(36)--- = 'B8B37875-BE97-43A4-9CF3-8CDEE6C5D7B1'
)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;
	/*---Variable Declaration---*/
	DECLARE @BilletType VARCHAR(50);
	DECLARE @Cutlen DECIMAL(14,2);
	DECLARE @HeatNo INT;
	DECLARE @BilletNo VARCHAR(3);
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @ManufacturingOrder VARCHAR(200);
	DECLARE @Material VARCHAR(300);
	DECLARE @Grade VARCHAR(100);
	DECLARE @MaterialID VARCHAR(36);
	BEGIN TRY
		/*---Get Billet Type and Cutlegnth using Production ID---*/
		SELECT /*[QuantityInCount], [QuantityInEntryUnit], [SAPPostingStatus],  [PostingMaterialType], */ @CutLen = Cutlength , @HeatNo =  [HeatNo], @BilletNo =  [BilletNo]
		FROM [MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ProductionID;
		
		SELECT @ManufacturingOrder = WOMT.[WorkOrderNumber], @Material = MMT.[Name], @Grade = MMT.[Grade], @MaterialID = MMt.[ID] 
		FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] AS WOMT WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON WOMT.[ItemID] = MMT.[ID]
		WHERE WOMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND WOMT.[ID] IN (SELECT [Workorder] FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] =0 and [HeatID] = @HeatNo)

		/*---Get Billet No to update billet count and weight of billet using cutlength----*/
		--SELECT @BilletNo = CASE WHEN CCM.[BilletType1] = @BilletType AND CCM.[CutLenght1] = @Cutlen THEN 1
		--			WHEN CCM.[BilletType2] = @BilletType AND CCM.[CutLenght2] = @Cutlen THEN 2
		--			WHEN CCM.[BilletType3] = @BilletType AND CCM.[CutLenght3] = @Cutlen THEN 3
		--			WHEN CCM.[BilletType4] = @BilletType AND CCM.[CutLenght4] = @Cutlen THEN 4
		--		END 
		--FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] AS CCM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = @HeatNo; 
		
		/*---Update Billet Count, Billet Quantity and sap status in Production---*/
		SET @SQL = 'UPDATE [dbo].[MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl] 
		SET [QuantityInCount] = ccm.[NoofBillets'+@BilletNo+'], [QuantityInEntryUnit] = CCM.[CalcBilletsWeight'+@BilletNo+'], [SAPPostingStatus] = ''Posted'',Cutlength = ccm.[CutLenght'+@BilletNo+']
			, Batch = '''+CONCAT(@HeatNo,'_',Right('00' + cast(cast(round(@CutLen,0) as INT) AS VARCHAR(2)),2))+''', [ManufacturingOrder] = '''+@ManufacturingOrder+''' , [Material] = '''+@Material+''' , [grade] = '''+@Grade+'''
		FROM (
			SELECT CCM.[HeatID], CCM.[CalcBilletsWeight'+@BilletNo+'], ccm.[NoofBillets'+@BilletNo+'], ccm.[CutLenght'+@BilletNo+']
			FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] AS CCM WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [HeatID] = '''+CAST(@HeatNo AS VARCHAR(10))+'''
		) AS CCM 
		WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = '''+@ProductionID+''' AND CCM.[HeatID] = [HeatNo] ;';
		--print (@BilletNo)
		--print (@sql)
		EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL

		--/*---Get ProcessStage AND StatePosition ID---*/
		--DECLARE @ProcessStageID VARCHAR(36);
		--DECLARE @StatePositionID VARCHAR(36);
		--SELECT  @StatePositionID = SMT.[ID],  @ProcessStageID = PMT.[StageCode] 
		--FROM [dbo].xmes_state_position_State_mst_tbl AS SMT WITH(NOLOCK)
		--JOIN [dbo].[xmes_stage_position_mapping_mst_tbl] AS PMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON SMT.[ID] = PMT.[PositionType] 
		--WHERE SMT.[Sequencenumber] = 2 AND SMT.[Isdeleted] = 0 AND PMT.[IsDeleted] = 0

		/*------------Insert Billet trasaction detail---------*/
		--INSERT INTO [dbo].[XMES_Billet_tracking_trn_tbl] ([CreatedOn], [Source], [EntryDateTime], [ReportDate], [Heatno], [Batch], [BilletNo], [Plant], [StorageLocation], [StatePosition], [ProcessStage], [MaterialID], [QualityGradeID], [BilletWeight], [UOMID], [ManufacturingOrder], [BilletQuantity], [PostingMaterialType], [CutLength])
		--SELECT GETDATE() AS [CreatedOn], 'T-SQL' AS [Source], GETDATE() AS [Entrydatetime], CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AS [Reportdate], [HeatNo], [Batch]
		--	, CAST([HeatNo] AS VARCHAR(20)) + '_' + RIGHT('00' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY [billetno]) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) AS [BilletNo], [Plant]
		--	, [StorageLocation], @statepositionid AS [StatePosition], @processstageid AS [ProcessstageId], @MaterialID
		--	, (SELECT [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBATCH_Material_Grade_mst_tbl] AS GMT with(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND (([PostingMaterialType] = 'Hot Billet' AND GMT.[Name] = 'Okay') OR ([PostingMaterialType] = 'Cold Billet' AND GMT.[Name] = 'TBD'))) AS [QualityGradeID], [BilletWt], (SELECT [ID] FROM [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [Name] = 'Ton')
		--	, @ManufacturingOrder, 1 AS [BilletQty], [PostingMaterialType], [CutLength] FROM (
		--	SELECT [heatno], [grade], [material], [plant], [storagelocation], [batch], [manufacturingorder], [Quantityinentryunit], [Quantityinentryunit] / CAST([quantityincount] AS FLOAT) AS [Billetwt], [quantityincount], 1 AS [billetqty], [postingmaterialtype], [cutlength], [billetno] 
		--	FROM MES_SAP_Production_Trn_Tbl as pt WITH(NOLOCK) 
		--	WHERE [isdeleted] = 0 AND [heatno] = @Heatno AND [billetno] IS NOT NULL AND [ID] = @ProductionID --ORDER BY [heatNo] DESC 
		--) AS t OUTER APPLY (SELECT DISTINCT [number] FROM master.dbo.spt_values WHERE [number] BETWEEN (SELECT MAX(CAST(LEFT([BilletNo], 2) AS INT)) + 1 FROM [dbo].[XMES_Billet_Tracking_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0) AND (SELECT MAX(CAST(LEFT([BilletNo], 2) AS INT)) + 1 FROM [dbo].[XMES_Billet_Tracking_Trn_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [HeatNo] = @HeatNo AND [IsDeleted] = 0) + [Quantityincount]) AS t1
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : [XMES_U_SAP_Billet_Production_Trn_Usp] | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '| Line No: ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error', @Action='[dbo].[XMES_U_SAP_Billet_Production_Trn_Usp]', @Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
		
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
	END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XMES_U_SMS_Production_Summary_BestData_Usp

**Schema:** dbo

**Modified On:** 2026-02-26 11:02:50

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |

| @BestMonthDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_U_SMS_Production_Summary_BestData_Usp]
    @BestDayDate = '2026-05-04',
    @BestMonthDate = '2026-05-04',
    @Particular = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*------------------------------*/
-- Created By : Nidhi Rana
-- Created On : 25-Feb-2026
-- Description : Implement Procedure to update SMS Production Summary best data
/*------------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [XMES_U_SMS_Production_Summary_BestData_Usp](@BestDayDate DATE, @BestMonthDate DATE, @Particular VARCHAR(MAX))
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		--PRINT @BestMonthDate
		--PRINT @BestDayDate
		--PRINT @PArticular
		IF @bestdaydate >= @bestmonthdate
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] 
				SET [BestDay] = t.[FTDTonBestday], [BestDayDate] = t.[Bestdaydate], [BestMonthdate] = t.[Bestmonthdate], [Bestmonth] = t.[MTDTonBestmonth], [FTDTon] = t.[FTDTonBestday], [FTDPercentage] = t.[FTDPercentageBestday], [MTDTon] = t.[MTDTonBestDay], [MTDPercentage] = t.[MTDPercentageBestDay] FROM (
					SELECT [Bestdaydate], [FTDTonbestday], [FTDPercentageBestday], [MTDTonBestDay], [MTDPercentageBestDay], [BestMonthdate], [MTDTonBestmonth], [Particulars] FROM [dbo].[SMS_Production_BestDay_BestMonth_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [BestDAyDate] = @BestDayDate) AS t WHERE t.[Particulars] =  [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary].[Particulars] AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary].[ReportDate] = @BestdayDate AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[IsDeleted] = 0
			UPDATE [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary]
				SET [BestMonthdate] = t.[Bestmonthdate], [Bestmonth] = t.[MTDTonBestmonth], [FTDTon] = t.[FTDTonBestMonth], [FTDPercentage] = t.[FTDPercentageBestMonth], [MTDTon] = t.[MTDTonBestMonth], [MTDPercentage] = t.[MTDPercentageBestMonth] FROM (
					SELECT [FTDTonbestMonth], [FTDPercentageBestmonth], [MTDTonBestMonth], [MTDPercentageBestMonth], [BestMonthdate], [Particulars]
					FROM [dbo].[SMS_Production_BestDay_BestMonth_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [BestMonthDate] = @BestMonthDate
				) AS t WHERE t.[Particulars] =  [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary].[Particulars] AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary].[ReportDate] = @BestMonthDate AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[IsDeleted] = 0

		END 
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] 
				SET [BestDay] = t.[FTDTonBestday], [BestDayDate] = t.[Bestdaydate], [BestMonthdate] = t.[Bestmonthdate], [Bestmonth] = t.[MTDTonBestmonth], [FTDTon] = t.[FTDTonBestMonth], [FTDPercentage] = t.[FTDPercentageBestMonth], [MTDTon] = t.[MTDTonBestMonth], [MTDPercentage] = t.[MTDPercentageBestMonth] FROM (
					SELECT [Bestdaydate], [FTDTonbestday], [FTDPercentageBestday], [BestMonthdate], [FTDTonBestMonth], [FTDPercentageBestMonth], [MTDPercentageBestMonth], [MTDTonBestmonth], [Particulars] FROM [dbo].[SMS_Production_BestDay_BestMonth_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [BestMonthDate] = @BestMonthDate) AS t WHERE t.[Particulars] =  [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary].[Particulars] AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary].[ReportDate] = @BestMonthDate AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[IsDeleted] = 0
			UPDATE [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary]
				SET [BestDaydate] = t.[BestDaydate], [BestDay] = t.[FTDTonBestDay], [FTDTon] = t.[FTDTonBestDay], [FTDPercentage] = t.[FTDPercentageBestDay], [MTDTon] = t.[MTDTonBestDay], [MTDPercentage] = t.[MTDPercentageBestDay] FROM (
					SELECT [FTDTonbestDay], [FTDPercentageBestDay], [MTDTonBestDay], [MTDPercentageBestDay], [BestDaydate], [Particulars]
					FROM [dbo].[SMS_Production_BestDay_BestMonth_Data] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [BestMonthDate] = @BestDayDate
				) AS t WHERE t.[Particulars] =  [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary].[Particulars] AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary].[ReportDate] = @BestDayDate AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[IsDeleted] = 0
		END

		UPDATE [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] 
			SET [BestDay] = t.[FTDTon], [BestDayDate] = t.[ReportDate]
		FROM (SELECT [FTDTon], [ReportDate], [Particulars] FROM [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] AS t WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE t.[ReportDate] = @BestDayDate AND t.[IsDeleted] = 0 ) AS T WHERE t.[Particulars] = [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[Particulars] AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[ReportDate] >= @BestDayDate AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[IsDeleted] = 0

		UPDATE [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] 
			SET [BestMonth] = t.[MTDTon], [BestMonthDate] = t.[ReportDate]
		FROM (SELECT [MTDTon], [ReportDate], [Particulars] FROM [dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary] AS t WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE t.[ReportDate] = @BestMonthDate AND t.[IsDeleted] = 0 ) AS T WHERE t.[Particulars] = [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[Particulars] AND [dbo].[SMS_Production_summary].[ReportDate] >= @BestMonthDate
	

		--IF @BestDayDate <= @BestMonthDate
		--BEGIN
		--	EXEC [XMES_Recalculate_SMS_PRODUCTION_USP] @BestDayDate;
		--END
		--ELSE
		--BEGIN
		--	EXEC [XMES_Recalculate_SMS_PRODUCTION_USP] @BestMonthDate;
		--END
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_U_SMS_Production_Summary_BestData_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() + '|' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
```

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Water_Reading_Recalculate_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-01-01 09:55:13  
**Modified On:** 2026-01-01 10:30:42  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Reportdate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Water_Reading_Recalculate_Usp]
    @Reportdate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*------------------------*/
--Created By : Nidhi Rana
--Created On : 01-Jan-2026
--Description : Update Reading For Water Logbook for all date from given date
/*------------------------*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE XMES_Water_Reading_Recalculate_Usp(@Reportdate DATE)
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET ANSI_WARNINGS OFF;
	BEGIN TRY
		/*--Update Water Reading For selected date--*/
		UPDATE [MES_Logbook_Water_Reading] SET [SMSReadingDifference] = ISNULL(SMSDiff, 0), [RMReadingDifference] = ISNULL(RMFMDiff, 0), [EntirePlantReadingDifference] = ISNULL(PlantDiff, 0) FROM (
			SELECT --[reportdate],
				CASE WHEN ISNULL(t.[SMSFMReading], 0) < ISNULL(t.Pre_SMSFM, 0) THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(t.[SMSFMReading], 0) - ISNULL(t.Pre_SMSFM, 0) END AS SMSDiff
				, CASE WHEN ISNULL(t.[RMFMReading], 0) < ISNULL(t.Pre_RMFM, 0) THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(t.[RMFMReading], 0) - ISNULL(t.Pre_RMFM, 0) END AS RMFMDiff
				, CASE WHEN ISNULL(t.[EntirePlantFMReading], 0) < ISNULL(t.Pre_PlantFM, 0) THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(t.[EntirePlantFMReading], 0) - ISNULL(t.Pre_PlantFM, 0) END AS PlantDiff FROM (
				SELECT MLWR.[ID], MLWR.[ReportDate], MLWR.[SMSFMReading], MLWR.[RMFMReading], MLWR.[EntirePlantFMReading]
					, LAG([SMSFMReading]) OVER (ORDER BY [ReportDate]) AS Pre_SMSFM
					, LAG([RMFMReading]) OVER (ORDER BY [ReportDate]) AS Pre_RMFM
					, LAG([EntirePlantFMReading]) OVER (ORDER BY [ReportDate]) AS Pre_PlantFM
			FROM [MES_Logbook_Water_Reading] AS MLWR WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
		) AS t WHERE t.[ReportDate] >= @Reportdate) AS t WHERE [Reportdate] >= @ReportDate;
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_Water_Reading_Recalculate_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Water_Reading_Recalculate_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	END CATCH
END

--XMES_Water_Reading_Recalculate_Usp '30-Nov-2025'
```

## dbo.XMES_Water_Reading_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_Water_Reading_Usp  
**Created On:** 2026-01-01 09:22:42  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-11 11:51:10  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_Water_Reading_Usp]
    @ID = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_Water_Reading_Usp](@ID VARCHAR(36))
AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Date DATE;
	BEGIN TRY
		SELECT @Date = [ReportDate] FROM [dbo].[MES_Logbook_Water_Reading] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ID] = @ID;
		UPDATE [MES_Logbook_Water_Reading] SET [SMSReadingDifference] = CASE WHEN ISNULL(SMSDiff, 0) < ISNULL(RMFMDiff, 0) THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(SMSDiff, 0) - ISNULL(RMFMDiff, 0) END, [RMReadingDifference] = ISNULL(RMFMDiff, 0), [EntirePlantReadingDifference] = ISNULL(PlantDiff, 0) FROM (
			SELECT [lagrp],
				(CASE WHEN ISNULL(t.[SMSFMReading], 0) < ISNULL(t.Pre_SMSFM, 0)  THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(t.[SMSFMReading], 0) - ISNULL(t.Pre_SMSFM, 0) END)
				+ (CASE WHEN ISNULL(t.[CommonFMReading], 0) < ISNULL(t.Pre_CFM, 0)  THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(t.[CommonFMReading], 0) - ISNULL(t.Pre_CFM, 0) END) AS SMSDiff
				, CASE WHEN ISNULL(t.[RMFMReading], 0) < ISNULL(t.Pre_RMFM, 0) THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(t.[RMFMReading], 0) - ISNULL(t.Pre_RMFM, 0) END AS RMFMDiff
				, CASE WHEN ISNULL(t.[EntirePlantFMReading], 0) < ISNULL(t.Pre_PlantFM, 0) THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(t.[EntirePlantFMReading], 0) - ISNULL(t.Pre_PlantFM, 0) END AS PlantDiff FROM (
				SELECT MLWR.[ID], MLWR.[ReportDate], MLWR.[SMSFMReading], MLWR.[RMFMReading], MLWR.[EntirePlantFMReading], MLWR.[CommonFMReading], LAG([Reportdate]) OVER (ORDER BY [Reportdate]) AS lagrp
					, LAG([SMSFMReading]) OVER (ORDER BY [ReportDate]) AS Pre_SMSFM
					, LAG([RMFMReading]) OVER (ORDER BY [ReportDate]) AS Pre_RMFM
					, LAG([EntirePlantFMReading]) OVER (ORDER BY [ReportDate]) AS Pre_PlantFM
					, LAG([CommonFMReading]) OVER (ORDER BY [ReportDate]) AS Pre_CFM
			FROM [MES_Logbook_Water_Reading] AS MLWR WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0
		) AS t WHERE t.[ReportDate] >= @Date AND [lagrp] = DATEADD(dd,-1,[ReportDate]) ) AS t WHERE [ReportDate] >= @Date AND t.[lagrp] = DATEADD(dd,-1,[ReportDate]);
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : XMES_Water_Reading_Usp | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
		EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[XMES_Water_Reading_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';
	END CATCH
END


--SELECT * FROM [MES_Logbook_Water_Reading] ORDER BY [Reportdate]

--XMES_Water_Reading_Usp '4C5E9A10-4ACE-4351-B8DA-2D693EC4A096'
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Sagar Rana
-- Create date: 16-12-2025
-- Description:	View for Showing WO Transaction
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XMES_WO_Trn_VW]

AS
BEGIN
	 
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT ManufacturingOrderType, WorkOrderNumber, MaterialName AS [Material], u.FullName [ActionBy], wt.Action [Status], ActionDate, SalesOrderName AS [Salesorder], xs.Color [Statuscolourcode], m.ColourCode [MaterialColourcode] 
	FROM XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl_TimeLine wt WITH (NOLOCK)
	JOIN XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl AS w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.ID = wt.RecordID and w.IsDeleted=0
	JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl AS m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.ID = w.ItemID and m.IsDeleted=0
	JOIN XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch..XStudio_User_Mst_Tbl AS u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.ID = wt.ActionBy and u.IsDeleted=0
	JOIN XBatch_Status_Mst_Tbl AS xs WITH (NOLOCK)  ON xs.Name=wt.Action and xs.IsDeleted=0
	ORDER BY ActionDate  DESC,WorkOrderNumber
	
END
```

## dbo.XMES_WorkOrders_Creation

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XMES_WorkOrders_Creation  
**Created On:** 2026-04-09 16:01:47  
**Modified On:** 2026-04-09 16:19:37  
**Parameter Count:** 3  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @CampaignID | varchar(max) | NO |  |
| @StartDate | datetime | NO |  |
| @EndDate | datetime | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XMES_WorkOrders_Creation]
    @CampaignID = '',
    @StartDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @EndDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [XMES_WorkOrders_Creation]
@CampaignID as varchar(MAX),
    @StartDate DATETIME,
    @EndDate DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- 1. Create temporary storage for Work Order data
    DECLARE @WOTable TABLE (
        Quantity DECIMAL(18,2),
        MaterialName VARCHAR(MAX),
        Grade VARCHAR(500),
        SalesOrderName VARCHAR(MAX),
        SalesOrderID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, -- Added to store the ID for Branch 2
        CustomerName VARCHAR(MAX),
        ItemNo VARCHAR(100)
    );

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BRANCH 1: RB (Reinforced Bar) - Grouping by Length
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName, CustomerName, ItemNo)
    SELECT SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT), MAX(MaterialNo),     -- Added this
    MAX(Customer),  -- Added this
    MAX(ItemNo)
    FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn
    WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) = 'RB' AND IsDeleted = 0
    GROUP BY [Length]; 

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BRANCH 2: Wire Rod/Coil with SO (1 SO = 1 WO)
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- First, we identify the records for Branch 2
    DECLARE @SOID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    
    -- We use a cursor or a loop here if there are multiple SOs in Branch 2 
    -- to generate unique IDs and insert into the SO Master Table
    DECLARE @CurrentSO VARCHAR(MAX), @MatName VARCHAR(MAX), @CustName VARCHAR(MAX), @Qty DECIMAL(18,2), @Grd VARCHAR(500);

    DECLARE branch2_cursor CURSOR FOR 
    SELECT SONumber, MaterialNo, Customer, MaxQtytoRollMT
    FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn
    WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB' AND SONumber IS NOT NULL AND IsDeleted = 0;

    OPEN branch2_cursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM branch2_cursor INTO @CurrentSO, @MatName, @CustName, @Qty;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        SET @SOID = NEWID();

        -- Logic for entering SO details in SO Master (Branch 2 Only)
        INSERT INTO XBATCH_SALES_ORDER_MST_TBL (ID, Name, SalesOrderNumber, ParentID, ItemID, Quantity, UnitID, Status, PlannedStartDate, PlannedCompletionDate)
        SELECT 
            @SOID, @CurrentSO, @CurrentSO,
            (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM xbatch_customer_mst_tbl WHERE Name = @CustName AND IsDeleted = 0),
            (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WHERE Name = @MatName AND IsDeleted = 0),
            @Qty, '2095DF88-C3E3-4184-BA44-BBBB0696FF14', 'New', @StartDate, @EndDate;

        -- Store in temp table to link to Work Order later
        INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName, SalesOrderName, SalesOrderID, CustomerName, ItemNo)
        VALUES (@Qty, @MatName, @CurrentSO, @SOID, @CustName, (SELECT TOP 1 ItemNo FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn WHERE SONumber = @CurrentSO));

        FETCH NEXT FROM branch2_cursor INTO @CurrentSO, @MatName, @CustName, @Qty;
    END;
    CLOSE branch2_cursor;
    DEALLOCATE branch2_cursor;

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- BRANCH 3: WSO (No SO) - Grouping by Length
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO @WOTable (Quantity, MaterialName, ItemNo, CustomerName)
    SELECT SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT), MAX(MaterialNo), MAX(ItemNo), MAX(Customer)
    FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn
    WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND SONumber IS NULL AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB' AND IsDeleted = 0
    GROUP BY [Length];

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- FINAL STEP: Insert into Work Order Master
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO XBATCH_WORK_ORDER_MST_TBL (
        Quantity, UnitID, ItemID, Status, Equipment, ManufacturingOrderCategory, 
        ManufacturingOrderType, ProductionPlant, StorageLocation, MaterialName, 
        SalesOrder, SalesOrderName, Grade, MfgOrderPlannedStartDate, MfgOrderPlannedEndDate, CustomerName
    )
    SELECT 
        W.Quantity, '2095DF88-C3E3-4184-BA44-BBBB0696FF14', M.ID, 'RM ProductionOrder Created', 'RM', 
        W.ItemNo, 'BR02', '7503', '2104', W.MaterialName, 
        W.SalesOrderID, -- Uses the ID we generated specifically for Branch 2
        W.SalesOrderName, W.Grade, @StartDate, @EndDate, W.CustomerName
    FROM @WOTable W
    LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON W.MaterialName = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0;

    select * from @WOTable

END
```

**Schema:** dbo

**Created On:** 2025-09-18 11:19:20  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-13 10:41:44  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @Mode | varchar(20) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql

    @ID = '',
    @Mode = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE                                                                        Procedure [dbo].[Xstudio_CCM_Data_USP]
    	(
			@ID VARCHAR(36),
			@Mode VARCHAR(20)
    	)
    	AS
    	BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

		BEGIN TRY
		
			--$##



			--##$
			
			----- Calculated Column Update 
			--$$#
  Update [CCM_Data] SET [CCM_Data].[RemainingCastingTime]=RIGHT('0' + CAST((CAST([CCM_Data].[RemainingCastingTimeActualTag] * 60 AS INT) / 60) AS VARCHAR),2)
+ ':' +
RIGHT('0' + CAST((CAST([CCM_Data].[RemainingCastingTimeActualTag] * 60 AS INT) % 60) AS VARCHAR),2) ,[CCM_Data].[TotalRunningStrands]=CASE WHEN [CCM_Data].[STD1CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Data].[STD2CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Data].[STD3CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Data].[STD4CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Data].[STD5CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Data].[STD6CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,[CCM_Data].[Productivity]=([CCM_Data].[TotalTPH]/89)*100,[CCM_Data].[RemainingWeight]=CASE 
    WHEN [CCM_Data].[Arm1Castposition] = 1 
        THEN CASE WHEN ([CCM_Data].[LiquidSteelWeight] - [CCM_Data].[TurretCastedWeightArm1]) < 0 
                  THEN 0 
                  ELSE ([CCM_Data].[LiquidSteelWeight] - [CCM_Data].[TurretCastedWeightArm1]) 
             END
    WHEN [CCM_Data].[Arm2Castposition] = 1 
        THEN CASE WHEN ([CCM_Data].[LiquidSteelWeight] - [CCM_Data].[TurretCastedWeight]) < 0 
                  THEN 0 
                  ELSE ([CCM_Data].[LiquidSteelWeight] - [CCM_Data].[TurretCastedWeight]) 
             END
END
,[CCM_Data].[Cuttinglength]=12,[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[CCM_Data] AS [CCM_Data] WHERE [CCM_Data].[ID]=@ID;   Update [CCM_Data] SET [CCM_Data].[RemainingCastingTimeMES]=RIGHT('0' + CAST((CAST(ROUND([CCM_Data].[RemainingWeight] / NULLIF(([CCM_Data].[TotalTPH] / 60.0),0) * 60, 0) AS INT) / 60) AS VARCHAR), 2) 
+ ':' +
```

```sql
CREATE                                                                                                            Procedure [dbo].[Xstudio_CCM_Per_Heat_USP]

  Update [CCM_Per_Heat] SET [CCM_Per_Heat].[CastingStartTimeHHmm]=CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), [CCM_Per_Heat].[StartTime], 108),[CCM_Per_Heat].[NoofStrands]=CASE WHEN [CCM_Per_Heat].[Strand1CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Per_Heat].[Strand2CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Per_Heat].[Strand3CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Per_Heat].[Strand4CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Per_Heat].[Strand5CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Per_Heat].[Strand6CastingSpeed] > 0.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ,[CCM_Per_Heat].[LadleSequenceText]=CONCAT('L + ',[CCM_Per_Heat].[LadleSequence]),[CCM_Per_Heat].[CastingStartTime]=CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), [CCM_Per_Heat].[StartTime], 108),[CCM_Per_Heat].[ScaleLossTon]=0.0025 * [CCM_Per_Heat].[TotalProduction],[CCM_Per_Heat].[CasterYield]=CAST((ISNULL(ISNULL([CCM_Per_Heat].[ActualBilletWeightTon],[CCM_Per_Heat].[TotalProduction]),0)/NULLIF([CCM_Per_Heat].[ActualLiquidMetalWeight],0))*100.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2)),[CCM_Per_Heat].[CastingDuration]=CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),
DATEADD(SECOND,
DATEDIFF(SECOND, [CCM_Per_Heat].[StartTime], [CCM_Per_Heat].[EndTime]),
0),108),[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] AS [CCM_Per_Heat] WHERE [CCM_Per_Heat].[ID]=@ID;   Update [CCM_Per_Heat] SET [CCM_Per_Heat].[TPH]=ROUND(
([CCM_Per_Heat].[ActualLiquidMetalWeight] * 3600.0) /
NULLIF(DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', [CastingDuration]),0)
,2),[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[CCM_Per_Heat] AS [CCM_Per_Heat] WHERE [CCM_Per_Heat].[ID]=@ID; 
--#$$
```

```sql
CREATE                                                               Procedure [dbo].[Xstudio_CCM_Section_Strands_USP]
    	(

    	)
    	AS
    	BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;

		BEGIN TRY

  Update [CCM_Section_Strands] SET [CCM_Section_Strands].[Shift]= CASE
        WHEN CAST([CCM_Section_Strands].[EntryDateTime] AS TIME) >= '06:00:00'
             AND CAST([CCM_Section_Strands].[EntryDateTime] AS TIME) < '18:00:00' THEN 'A'
        ELSE 'B'
    END ,[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[CCM_Section_Strands] AS [CCM_Section_Strands] WHERE [CCM_Section_Strands].[ID]=@ID;   Update [CCM_Section_Strands] SET [CCM_Section_Strands].[LaddleOnTurrentTime]=datediff(Minute,[CCM_Section_Strands].[LaddleOnTurrentStartTime],[CCM_Section_Strands].[LaddleOnTurrentEndTime]),[CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp1]=CASE 
WHEN ISNULL([CCM_Section_Strands].[TundishTemp1],0) = 0 THEN NULL
ELSE [CCM_Section_Strands].[TundishTemp1] - [CCM_Section_Strands].[LiquidusAsh1]
END,[CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp2]=CASE 
WHEN ISNULL([CCM_Section_Strands].[TundishTemp2],0) = 0 THEN NULL
ELSE [CCM_Section_Strands].[TundishTemp2] - [CCM_Section_Strands].[LiquidusAsh2]
END,[CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp3]=CASE 
WHEN ISNULL([CCM_Section_Strands].[TundishTemp3],0) = 0 THEN NULL
ELSE [CCM_Section_Strands].[TundishTemp3] - [CCM_Section_Strands].[LiquidusAsh3]
END,[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[CCM_Section_Strands] AS [CCM_Section_Strands] WHERE [CCM_Section_Strands].[ID]=@ID;   Update [CCM_Section_Strands] SET [CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeat]=ROUND(
(
ISNULL([CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp1],0) +
ISNULL([CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp2],0) +
ISNULL([CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp3],0)
)
/
NULLIF(
(
CASE WHEN [CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp1] IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp2] IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
CASE WHEN [CCM_Section_Strands].[SuperHeatTemp3] IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
),0
)
,0
),[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[CCM_Section_Strands] AS [CCM_Section_Strands] WHERE [CCM_Section_Strands].[ID]=@ID; 
--#$$

			----- Default Value Column Update 
			--$$##

			--##$$
				
		END TRY

		BEGIN CATCH
```

**Parameter Count:** 3  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
