| @DatabaseName | varchar(200) | NO |  |
| @EntityName | varchar(200) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Xstudio_Day_CCM_Usp]
    @ID = '',
    @DatabaseName = '',
    @EntityName = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Xstudio_Day_CCM_Usp]
					(
							@ID VARCHAR(36),@DatabaseName VARCHAR(200)=NULL,@EntityName  VARCHAR(200)=NULL
					)
					AS 
					BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_PADDING ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
						BEGIN TRY
							DECLARE @Reportdate DATE,@Sdate Datetime,@Edate DateTime
								DECLARE  @Entrydate DATETIME; SELECT @Entrydate = HeatReportDate FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Per_Heat] WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@ID ;	SELECT @Reportdate=CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydate)
						  SET @Sdate = Convert(datetime2,Concat(@Reportdate,' ','00:00:00'));
						  SET @Edate =DATEADD(DAY,1,@Sdate);
						  
					
						BEGIN
							UPDATE SFD
								SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',SFD.[ActualBilletCount] = TBL.[ActualBilletCount],SFD.[ActualBilletWeightTon] = TBL.[ActualBilletWeightTon],SFD.[HeatID] = TBL.[HeatID],SFD.[MonthlyTarget] = TBL.[MonthlyTarget],SFD.[MTDPlannedProduction] = TBL.[MTDPlannedProduction],SFD.[STD1OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD1OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD2OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD2OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD3OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD3OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD4OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD4OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD5OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD5OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD6OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD6OSCSpeed],SFD.[Strand1BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand1BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand1CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand1CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand2BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand2BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand2CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand2CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand3BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand3BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand3CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand3CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand4BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand4BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand4CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand4CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand5BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand5BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand5CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand5CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand6BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand6BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand6CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand6CastingSpeed],SFD.[TotalBilletsCount] = TBL.[TotalBilletsCount],SFD.[TotalProduction] = TBL.[TotalProduction]
							FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] AS SFD
							JOIN(SELECT @ReportDate AS [ReportDate],AVG(TRN.[STD1OSCSpeed]) AS [STD1OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD2OSCSpeed]) AS [STD2OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD3OSCSpeed]) AS [STD3OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD4OSCSpeed]) AS [STD4OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD5OSCSpeed]) AS [STD5OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD6OSCSpeed]) AS [STD6OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand1CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand1CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand2CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand2CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand3CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand3CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand4CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand4CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand5CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand5CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand6CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand6CastingSpeed],COUNT(TRN.[HeatID]) AS [HeatID],MAX(TRN.[MonthlyTarget]) AS [MonthlyTarget],MAX(TRN.[MTDPlannedProduction]) AS [MTDPlannedProduction],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ActualBilletCount])) AS [ActualBilletCount],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ActualBilletWeightTon])) AS [ActualBilletWeightTon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand1BilletCounter])) AS [Strand1BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand2BilletCounter])) AS [Strand2BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand3BilletCounter])) AS [Strand3BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand4BilletCounter])) AS [Strand4BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand5BilletCounter])) AS [Strand5BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand6BilletCounter])) AS [Strand6BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalBilletsCount])) AS [TotalBilletsCount],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalProduction])) AS [TotalProduction]
								FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Per_Heat] AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK) 
								WHERE TRN.[IsDeleted]=0 AND TRN.HeatReportDate >= @Sdate AND TRN.HeatReportDate < @Edate 
							) AS TBL ON TBL.[ReportDate] = SFD.[ReportDate] ;
						END	
						BEGIN						
								INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day]([ReportDate],[ActualBilletCount],[ActualBilletWeightTon],[HeatID],[MonthlyTarget],[MTDPlannedProduction],[STD1OSCSpeed],[STD2OSCSpeed],[STD3OSCSpeed],[STD4OSCSpeed],[STD5OSCSpeed],[STD6OSCSpeed],[Strand1BilletCounter],[Strand1CastingSpeed],[Strand2BilletCounter],[Strand2CastingSpeed],[Strand3BilletCounter],[Strand3CastingSpeed],[Strand4BilletCounter],[Strand4CastingSpeed],[Strand5BilletCounter],[Strand5CastingSpeed],[Strand6BilletCounter],[Strand6CastingSpeed],[TotalBilletsCount],[TotalProduction],[Source])
								SELECT *,'T-SQL' FROM (SELECT @ReportDate AS [ReportDate],AVG(TRN.[STD1OSCSpeed]) AS [STD1OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD2OSCSpeed]) AS [STD2OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD3OSCSpeed]) AS [STD3OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD4OSCSpeed]) AS [STD4OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD5OSCSpeed]) AS [STD5OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD6OSCSpeed]) AS [STD6OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand1CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand1CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand2CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand2CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand3CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand3CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand4CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand4CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand5CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand5CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand6CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand6CastingSpeed],COUNT(TRN.[HeatID]) AS [HeatID],MAX(TRN.[MonthlyTarget]) AS [MonthlyTarget],MAX(TRN.[MTDPlannedProduction]) AS [MTDPlannedProduction],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ActualBilletCount])) AS [ActualBilletCount],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ActualBilletWeightTon])) AS [ActualBilletWeightTon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand1BilletCounter])) AS [Strand1BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand2BilletCounter])) AS [Strand2BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand3BilletCounter])) AS [Strand3BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand4BilletCounter])) AS [Strand4BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand5BilletCounter])) AS [Strand5BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand6BilletCounter])) AS [Strand6BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalBilletsCount])) AS [TotalBilletsCount],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalProduction])) AS [TotalProduction]

								WHERE TRN.[IsDeleted]=0 AND TRN.HeatReportDate >= @Sdate AND TRN.HeatReportDate < @Edate
								) AS TBL WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] AS SFD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE SFD.[ReportDate] = TBL.[ReportDate]   );
						END

			BEGIN

				WHERE TRN.[Reportdate] = @Reportdate;
			END 
				  EXEC [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[XStudio_Update_Day_CCM_Usp] @Reportdate;
```

```sql
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
						BEGIN TRY
							DECLARE @Reportdate DATE,@Sdate Datetime,@Edate DateTime
								DECLARE  @Entrydate DATETIME; SELECT @Entrydate = HeatReportDate FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@ID ;	SELECT @Reportdate=CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydate)
						  SET @Sdate = Convert(datetime2,Concat(@Reportdate,' ','00:00:00'));
						  SET @Edate =DATEADD(DAY,1,@Sdate);
						  
					
						BEGIN
							UPDATE SFD
								SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',SFD.[Aluminium] = TBL.[Aluminium],SFD.[ArgonConsumption] = TBL.[ArgonConsumption],SFD.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight] = TBL.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight],SFD.[Carbon] = TBL.[Carbon],SFD.[Dolo] = TBL.[Dolo],SFD.[FeSi] = TBL.[FeSi],SFD.[FlourSpar] = TBL.[FlourSpar],SFD.[HeatID] = TBL.[HeatID],SFD.[Lime] = TBL.[Lime],SFD.[LiquidMetalWeight] = TBL.[LiquidMetalWeight],SFD.[PowerMWH] = TBL.[PowerMWH],SFD.[SiMn] = TBL.[SiMn],SFD.[SiMnn] = TBL.[SiMnn],SFD.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg] = TBL.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg]
							FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Summary_Day] AS SFD
							JOIN(SELECT @ReportDate AS [ReportDate],COUNT(TRN.[HeatID]) AS [HeatID],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Aluminium])) AS [Aluminium],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ArgonConsumption])) AS [ArgonConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight])) AS [CalcLiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Carbon])) AS [Carbon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Dolo])) AS [Dolo],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[FeSi])) AS [FeSi],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[FlourSpar])) AS [FlourSpar],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Lime])) AS [Lime],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LiquidMetalWeight])) AS [LiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[PowerMWH])) AS [PowerMWH],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[SiMn])) AS [SiMn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[SiMnn])) AS [SiMnn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg])) AS [TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg]
								FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK) 
								WHERE TRN.[IsDeleted]=0 AND TRN.HeatReportDate >= @Sdate AND TRN.HeatReportDate < @Edate 
							) AS TBL ON TBL.[ReportDate] = SFD.[ReportDate] ;
						END	
						BEGIN						
								INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Summary_Day]([ReportDate],[Aluminium],[ArgonConsumption],[CalcLiquidMetalWeight],[Carbon],[Dolo],[FeSi],[FlourSpar],[HeatID],[Lime],[LiquidMetalWeight],[PowerMWH],[SiMn],[SiMnn],[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg],[Source])
								SELECT *,'T-SQL' FROM (SELECT @ReportDate AS [ReportDate],COUNT(TRN.[HeatID]) AS [HeatID],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Aluminium])) AS [Aluminium],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ArgonConsumption])) AS [ArgonConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight])) AS [CalcLiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Carbon])) AS [Carbon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Dolo])) AS [Dolo],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[FeSi])) AS [FeSi],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[FlourSpar])) AS [FlourSpar],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Lime])) AS [Lime],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LiquidMetalWeight])) AS [LiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[PowerMWH])) AS [PowerMWH],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[SiMn])) AS [SiMn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[SiMnn])) AS [SiMnn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg])) AS [TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg]
								FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK) 
								WHERE TRN.[IsDeleted]=0 AND TRN.HeatReportDate >= @Sdate AND TRN.HeatReportDate < @Edate
								) AS TBL WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Summary_Day] AS SFD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE SFD.[ReportDate] = TBL.[ReportDate]   );
						END
					
			----------------------- Uni Formula -----------------------	
			BEGIN
				UPDATE TRN SET TRN.[Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight] =((SELECT AVG(LRF.CalcLiquidMetalWeight) from [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[LRF_PER_HEAT] AS LRF where LRF.ReportDate=TRN.Reportdate)) , TRN.[Avg_LiquidMetalWeight] =((SELECT AVG(LRF.LiquidMetalWeight) from [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[LRF_PER_HEAT] AS LRF where LRF.ReportDate=TRN.Reportdate)), TRN.[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), TRN.[Source] = 'T-SQL' FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[LRF_Summary_Day] AS TRN
				WHERE TRN.[Reportdate] = @Reportdate;
			END 
				  EXEC [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[XStudio_Update_Day_LRF_Usp] @Reportdate;
						IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL', 'DB_TBL_Day') >= -1
```

```sql
  Update [Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount] SET [Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[ActualBillAmount]=ISNULL([Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[CurrentMonthCharge],0) + ISNULL([Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[VAT],0),[Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[CalculatedBillAmount]=ISNULL([Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[CalculatedCurrentMonthCharge],0) + ISNULL([Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[CalculatedVAT],0),[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount] AS [Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount] WHERE [Electricity_Meter_Bill_Amount].[ID]=@ID; ## dbo.XStudio_Get_SMS_Monthly_Production_Summary
```

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XStudio_Get_SMS_Monthly_Production_Summary  
**Created On:** 2025-09-25 13:30:11  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 11:04:55  
**Parameter Count:** 0  

### Parameters

_No parameters_

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XStudio_Get_SMS_Monthly_Production_Summary];
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/*-----------------------------------
	Created By : Sagar Rana
	Modified On : 25-Sep-2025
	Description : Get all Month data from Day for SMS Monthly Summary		

--------------------------------------*/


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[XStudio_Get_SMS_Monthly_Production_Summary]
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        SELECT 
            YEAR(MAX(s.ReportDate)) AS [Year],
            MONTH(MAX(s.ReportDate)) AS [MonthNumber],
            UPPER(FORMAT(MAX(s.ReportDate), 'MMM-yyyy')) AS [Month],
            s.Type,
            s.Particulars,
            s.UOM,
            CASE 
                WHEN s.UOM = 'Nos' 
                    THEN CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.FTDTon),0) AS INT)
                WHEN s.UOM IN ('Time','HH:mm') 
                    THEN RIGHT('0' + CAST(FLOOR(AVG(s.FTDTon) / 60) AS VARCHAR(2)),2) 
                         + ':' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(CAST(AVG(s.FTDTon) % 60 AS INT) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
                ELSE CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.FTDTon),2) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            END AS [AverageData],
            CASE 
                WHEN s.UOM = 'Nos' 
                    THEN CAST(ROUND(SUM(s.FTDTon),0) AS INT)
                WHEN s.UOM IN ('Time','HH:mm') 
                    THEN RIGHT('0' + CAST(FLOOR(SUM(s.FTDTon) / 60) AS VARCHAR(2)),2) 
                         + ':' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(CAST(SUM(s.FTDTon) % 60 AS INT) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)
                ELSE CAST(ROUND(SUM(s.FTDTon),2) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            END AS [TotalData]
        FROM SMS_Production_Summary s
        LEFT JOIN Particulars_Masters p
            ON p.Particulars = s.Particulars
        WHERE s.IsDeleted = 0
        GROUP BY YEAR(s.ReportDate), MONTH(s.ReportDate), s.Type, s.Particulars, s.UOM, p.SrNo
        ORDER BY YEAR(MAX(s.ReportDate)) DESC, MONTH(MAX(s.ReportDate)) DESC, s.Type, p.SrNo;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  
            'SP : XStudio_Get_SMS_Monthly_Production_Summary | Line No : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE()) 
            + ' | Message : ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
        DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());

        -- Log the error using your existing error log stored procedure
        EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
            @Type = 'SQL-Error',
            @Action = '[dbo].[XStudio_Get_SMS_Monthly_Production_Summary]',
            @Message = @ERROR_MSG,
            @StackTrace = @ERROR_LINE,
            @UserID = '',
            @HostAddress = '',
            @Info = '',
            @Source = 'T-SQL';

        RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);  
    END CATCH
END
```

```sql
			----------------------- Uni Formula -------------	
			IF(@Attribute = 'All' OR @Attribute IN('CCMHeatID' ,'Month' ,'MonthlyTarget' ,'MTDAchievedpercentage' ,'MTDPlannedTon' ,'RunningRate' ,'STD1Production' ,'STD2Production' ,'STD3Production' ,'STD4Production' ,'STD5Production' ,'STD6Production' ,'TodayAchievedpercentage' ,'TodayPlannedProduction' ,'TotalProduction' ,'WeeklyAchievedpercentage' ,'WeeklyAchievedProduction' ,'WeeklyTarget' ,'Year' ,'YearlyTarget' ,'YesterdayAchievedpercentage'))
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY
					
					SET @STR='UPDATE Main SET [CCMHeatID] =(Select Cast(HeatID as int) from [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[BilletsCastCount] as BCC Where BCC.StartTime=Main.StartTime and BCC.Endtime=Main.EndTime) , [MonthlyTarget] =(SELECT PMT.TargetMT FROM ProductionMonthlyTargets PMT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(Main.Starttime AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(PMT.MonthStarttime AS DATE) AND CAST(PMT.MonthEndTime AS DATE) and PMT.isdeleted=0) , [MTDPlannedTon] =(select cast((PMT.TargetMT/DAY(EOMONTH(Main.Starttime)))*Day(Main.Starttime) as decimal(18,2)) from ProductionMonthlyTargets as PMT Where PMT.Monthnumber=MONTH(Main.Starttime)) , [STD1Production] =(isnull(Main.STD1BilletCount,0)*12*(select top 1 isnull(MSW.MaterialSpecificWeight,0) from [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_Cross_Section] as MSW Where MSW.CrossSection1=main.CrossSection order by Createdon desc)) , [STD2Production] =(isnull(Main.STD2BilletCount,0)*12*(select Top 1 isnull(MSW.MaterialSpecificWeight,0) from [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_Cross_Section] as MSW Where MSW.CrossSection1=main.CrossSection  order by Createdon desc)) , [STD3Production] =(isnull(Main.STD3BilletCount,0)*12*(select top 1 isnull(MSW.MaterialSpecificWeight,0) from [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_Cross_Section] as MSW Where MSW.CrossSection1=main.CrossSection order by Createdon desc)) , [STD4Production] =(isnull(Main.STD4BilletCount,0)*12*(select top 1 isnull(MSW.MaterialSpecificWeight,0) from [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_Cross_Section] as MSW Where MSW.CrossSection1=main.CrossSection  order by Createdon desc)) , [STD5Production] =(isnull(Main.STD5BilletCount,0)*12*(select top 1 isnull(MSW.MaterialSpecificWeight,0) from [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_Cross_Section] as MSW Where MSW.CrossSection1=main.CrossSection order by Createdon desc)) , [STD6Production] =(isnull(Main.STD6BilletCount,0)*12*(select top 1 isnull(MSW.MaterialSpecificWeight,0) from [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_Cross_Section] as MSW Where MSW.CrossSection1=main.CrossSection order by Createdon desc)) , [TotalProduction] =(isnull(main.TotalBilletsCount,0)*12*(select top 1 isnull(MSW.MaterialSpecificWeight,0) from [Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Billet_Cross_Section] as MSW Where MSW.CrossSection1=main.CrossSection order by Createdon desc)) , [WeeklyTarget] =(select PMT.TargetMT from xstudio_xbatch..ProductionWeeklyTargets as PMT with(nolock) Where cast(Main.Starttime as date) between cast(PMT.WeekStartTime as date) and cast(PMT.WeekEndTime as date)) , [YearlyTarget] =(Select FY.TargetMT from financialyears as FY with(nolock) Where Cast(FY.startdate as Date)<=Cast(Main.Starttime as Date) and Cast(FY.EndDate as Date)>=Cast(Main.Starttime as Date)) FROM ['+@Database+'].[dbo].['+@TableName+'] AS Main
					JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_SMS_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = Main.[EquipmentID]
					JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_SMS_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = TMT.[EquipmentID]
					JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TM.[Name]
					LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Group_Mst_Tbl] AS CGM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TM.[ParentID]=CGM.[ID]
					LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] AS CM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CGM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID] OR TM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID]
					JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Collector_Mst_Tbl] AS CMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON CM.[ParentID]=CMT.[ID]
					WHERE MST.[TemplateID] = ''29744244-AD1E-4304-8CE8-9C702ABD88C9'' AND  Main.[StartTime] = @StartDate AND CMT.IsConnected=1 AND (MST.[ID] = @Equipment OR @Equipment IS NULL) AND (CMT.[ID] = @CollectorID OR @CollectorID IS NULL) ;';
					EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STR, N'@StartDate DATETIME, @Equipment VARCHAR(36),@CollectorID VARCHAR(36)',@StartDate = @StartDate,@Equipment = @Equipment,@CollectorID=@CollectorID ;
					
				END TRY

						@type='SQL-Error',

						@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE_temp_1_29744,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID='';
				END CATCH
			END
				
					--------------------- Summary Schedule ---------------------
					
						EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Summary_Entity_Historian_Schedule_Task_Usp] 'A0E0934F-B370-4374-819B-A60CF61E71AF','0CD4A13A-DD4E-42BC-AEAB-813FF89E653A',@StartDate,@Database,@TableName;
```

### EXEC Template


### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XStudio_Historian_Day_SMS_Production_Usp]
					(
						@Entrydate DATETIME,@DatabaseName VARCHAR(200)=NULL,@EntityName  VARCHAR(200)=NULL
					)
					AS 
					BEGIN
										SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
					SET NOCOUNT ON;
					
					BEGIN TRY
						DECLARE @Reportdate DATE, @Sdate Datetime, @Edate DateTime, @HID VARCHAR(36);
						
						SELECT  @Reportdate=CONVERT(DATE, @Entrydate)
						SET @Sdate = CONVERT(datetime2,Concat(@Reportdate,' ','00:00:00'));
						SET @Edate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @Sdate);
						SET @Reportdate = convert(date, @sdate);
						 IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ReportData') IS NOT NULL
								BEGIN
									DROP TABLE #ReportData;
								END
								CREATE TABLE #ReportData([StartTime] DATETIME, [EquipmentID] VARCHAR(36) ,[AskingRate] decimal(18,4),[Month] varchar(100),[MonthlyTarget] decimal(18,4),[MTDAchievedpercentage] decimal(18,4),[MTDPlannedTon] decimal(18,4),[RunningRate] decimal(18,4),[TodayAchievedpercentage] decimal(18,4),[TodayPlannedProduction] decimal(18,4),[TotalProduction] decimal(18,4),[WeeklyAchievedpercentage] decimal(18,4),[WeeklyAchievedProduction] decimal(18,4),[WeeklyTarget] decimal(18,4),[Year] decimal(18,4),[YearlyTarget] decimal(18,4),[YesterdayAchievedpercentage] decimal(18,4));
								DECLARE  @DBName VARCHAR(200), @TblName VARCHAR(200), @STR NVARCHAR(MAX); 
								DECLARE DB_TBL_Day CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
									SELECT [DatabaseName], [Name] 
									FROM [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Entities_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
									WHERE [ParentID] = '0CD4A13A-DD4E-42BC-AEAB-813FF89E653A' AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [EndTime] > @Sdate AND [StartTime] <= @Edate 
									ORDER BY [StartTime];
							
								OPEN DB_TBL_Day;
								FETCH NEXT FROM DB_TBL_Day INTO @DBName,@TblName; 

								WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 
								BEGIN
									SET @STR = 'SELECT [StartTime], [EquipmentID] ,[AskingRate],[Month],[MonthlyTarget],[MTDAchievedpercentage],[MTDPlannedTon],[RunningRate],[TodayAchievedpercentage],[TodayPlannedProduction],[TotalProduction],[WeeklyAchievedpercentage],[WeeklyAchievedProduction],[WeeklyTarget],[Year],[YearlyTarget],[YesterdayAchievedpercentage] FROM ['+@DBName+'].[dbo].['+@TblName+'] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [StartTime] >= @Sdate AND [StartTime] < @Edate;';
									INSERT INTO #ReportData
									EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STR, N'@Sdate DATETIME, @Edate DATETIME', @Sdate = @Sdate, @Edate = @Edate;
									FETCH NEXT FROM DB_TBL_Day INTO @DBName, @TblName;
								END
								CLOSE DB_TBL_Day;
								DEALLOCATE DB_TBL_Day; 
						CREATE TABLE #Tag_condition ([TAGID] INT, [Condition] VARCHAR(500), [ID] VARCHAR(36));
		INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary_Day] ([ReportDate], [EquipmentID] , [Source])
							SELECT *, 'T-SQL' FROM (
								SELECT @Reportdate AS [ReportDate], MST.[ID] AS [Equipmentid]  
								FROM  [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_SMS_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK)
								
								WHERE MST.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MST.[TemplateID] IN ('29744244-AD1E-4304-8CE8-9C702ABD88C9')
								GROUP BY  MST.[ID]
							) AS TBL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary_Day] AS SFD WHERE TBL.[ReportDate] = SFD.[ReportDate]
							AND ISNULL(TBL.[Equipmentid], '') = ISNULL(SFD.[Equipmentid], ''))
					-------------Update for standard function type from block-------------
					BEGIN
						UPDATE SFD
							SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',SFD.[WeeklyAchievedProduction] = TBL.[WeeklyAchievedProduction],SFD.[YearlyTarget] = TBL.[YearlyTarget],SFD.[TotalProduction] = TBL.[TotalProduction],SFD.[MonthlyTarget] = TBL.[MonthlyTarget],SFD.[WeeklyTarget] = TBL.[WeeklyTarget],SFD.[MTDPlannedTon] = TBL.[MTDPlannedTon]
						FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[SMS_Production_Summary_Day] AS SFD
						JOIN(  SELECT @Reportdate AS [Reportdate], TRN.[Equipmentid],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2), TRN.[WeeklyAchievedProduction])) AS [WeeklyAchievedProduction],MAX(TRN.[YearlyTarget]) AS [YearlyTarget],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2), TRN.[TotalProduction])) AS [TotalProduction],MAX(TRN.[MonthlyTarget]) AS [MonthlyTarget],MAX(TRN.[WeeklyTarget]) AS [WeeklyTarget],MAX(TRN.[MTDPlannedTon]) AS [MTDPlannedTon] FROM #ReportData AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK)  JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_SMS_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = TRN.[EquipmentID]  WHERE MST.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MST.[TemplateID] = '29744244-AD1E-4304-8CE8-9C702ABD88C9' GROUP BY TRN.[Equipmentid] 
						) AS TBL ON TBL.[Reportdate] = SFD.[Reportdate] AND TBL.[Equipmentid] = SFD.[Equipmentid];
					END

				---------------------Weekly Production--------------------
				BEGIN
				Declare @WeeklyProduction Decimal(18,4)
				SELECT @WeeklyProduction=WeeklyProduction from (SELECT reportDate,
				SUM(trn.TotalProduction) OVER (PARTITION BY PMT.WeekStartTime ORDER BY trn.ReportDate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS WeeklyProduction FROM SMS_Production_Summary_Day trn  WITH (NOLOCK)
				JOIN ProductionWeeklyTargets PMT WITH (NOLOCK)
				ON trn.ReportDate >= PMT.WeekStartTime AND trn.ReportDate <= PMT.WeekEndTime
				WHERE trn.ReportDate >= PMT.WeekStartTime AND trn.ReportDate <= PMT.WeekEndTime ) AS t WHERE ReportDate=@Reportdate

				UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary_Day]  SET [WeeklyAchievedProduction]=@WeeklyProduction WHERE ReportDate=@Reportdate
				  End
				---------------------Weekly Production--------------------
					
				----------------------- Uni Formula -----------------------	
				BEGIN
					UPDATE TRN SET TRN.[AskingRate] =(Case When DAY(EOMONTH(TRN.[ReportDate]))-DAY(TRN.[ReportDate])=0 Then (TRN.[MonthlyTarget]-TRN.[TotalProduction_MTD]) Else (TRN.[MonthlyTarget]-TRN.[TotalProduction_MTD])/(DAY(EOMONTH(TRN.[ReportDate]))-DAY(TRN.[ReportDate])) End), TRN.[Month] =(DATENAME(Month, TRN.[ReportDate])), TRN.[MTDAchievedpercentage] =((TRN.[TotalProduction_MTD]/TRN.[MTDPlannedTon])*100), TRN.[RunningRate] =((TRN.[TotalProduction_MTD])/(DAY(TRN.[ReportDate]))), TRN.[TodayAchievedpercentage] =((TRN.[TotalProduction]/TRN.[TodayPlannedProduction])*100), TRN.[TodayPlannedProduction] =(CASE WHEN DAY(TRN.ReportDate)=1 THEN (TRN.MonthlyTarget/DAY(EOMONTH(TRN.ReportDate))) ELSE (TRN.MonthlyTarget-(SELECT ISNULL(TRB.TotalProduction_MTD,0) FROM SMS_Production_Summary_Day TRB WITH (NoLock) WHERE TRB.ReportDate=DATEADD(DAY, -1, TRN.ReportDate)))/( Case when DAY(EOMONTH(TRN.ReportDate))-Day(TRN.ReportDate)=0 Then 1 Else  DAY(EOMONTH(TRN.ReportDate))-Day(TRN.ReportDate) End) END), TRN.[WeeklyAchievedpercentage] =((TRN.[WeeklyAchievedProduction]/TRN.[WeeklyTarget])*100), TRN.[Year] =(YEAR(TRN.[ReportDate])), TRN.[YesterdayAchievedpercentage] =((TRN.[TotalProduction_YD]/TRN.[TodayPlannedProduction_YD])*100), TRN.[ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(), TRN.[Source] = 'T-SQL' FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary_Day] AS TRN
					JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_SMS_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = TRN.[EquipmentID]
					WHERE MST.[TemplateID] IN (SELECT * FROM STRING_SPLIT('29744244-AD1E-4304-8CE8-9C702ABD88C9',',')) AND TRN.[Reportdate] = @Reportdate;
				END 
				  
							EXEC [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[XStudio_Update_Day_SMS_Production_Usp] @REportdate ;
						END TRY
						BEGIN CATCH
							IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL', 'DB_TBL_Day') >= -1
							BEGIN
								CLOSE DB_TBL_Day;
								DEALLOCATE DB_TBL_Day;
							END	
							IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL', 'Equipment_Day_Cur') >= -1
							BEGIN
								CLOSE Equipment_Day_Cur;
								DEALLOCATE Equipment_Day_Cur;
							END	
							DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), ERROR_LINE());
							DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
							EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
								@type = 'SQL-Error', @Action = '[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_Day_SMS_Production_Usp]', @Message = @ERROR_MESSAGE, @StackTrace = @ERROR_LINE, @UserId= '', @HostAddress = '', @Info = '', @Source = 'T-SQL', @SystemID = '';
						END CATCH
						END
```


### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_EAF_SMS_Block_usp]
			(
					@CDateTime	DATETIME,
							  @Type		VARCHAR(50),
					@Attribute	VARCHAR(50)='All',
					@Equipment	VARCHAR(36)= NULL,
					@CollectorID	VARCHAR(36)= NULL
			)
			AS
			BEGIN
				SET NOCOUNT ON;
				SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
				SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
				SET ARITHABORT ON;
				SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
				SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
				SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
				BEGIN TRY
					DECLARE @StartDate DATETIME,@EndDate DATETIME,@STR NVARCHAR(MAX);
					DECLARE @TableName VARCHAR(200),@Database VARCHAR(200),@WHERE Nvarchar(MAX) ;
					
					IF(@Type= 'Normal')
					BEGIN
						SET @StartDate = CAST(DATEADD(MINUTE,- 0,DATEADD(MINUTE, ROUND(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, 0, @CDateTime) / 0, 0) * 0, 0)) AS DATETIME);
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @StartDate =@CDateTime ;
					END
					SET @EndDate = DATEADD(MINUTE,0,CAST( @StartDate AS DATETIME));
					SELECT TOP 1 @TableName= BEM.[Name],@Database=BDM.[Name] FROM [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Entities_Mst_Tbl] AS BEM WITH(NOLOCK)
					JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Databases_Mst_Tbl] AS BDM WITH(NOLOCK) ON BEM.[DatabaseName]=BDM.[Name]
					WHERE BEM.[IsDeleted]=0 AND BEM.[ParentID]='C5469F82-9493-4D1F-B54A-8478B3A3FFF4' AND BEM.[StartTime] <= @StartDate AND BEM.[EndTime] > @StartDate ;
					
					

					---------------------
					CREATE TABLE #Tag_condition ([TagName] VARCHAR(200),[TAGID] INT,[Condition] VARCHAR(500)); 
					
							----------------------- EAFHeatNo -------------
							IF(@Attribute= 'All' OR @Attribute = 'EAFHeatNo')
							BEGIN
								BEGIN TRY
								
									INSERT INTO #Tag_condition([TagName],[TAGID], [Condition])
									SELECT TM.[Name],CONVERT(VARCHAR, [TagNo]),NULL
										
										FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK) 
										JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[EAF_SMS_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TM.[Name]
										JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[EAF_SMS_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = TMT.[EquipmentID]
										LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Group_Mst_Tbl] AS CGM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TM.[ParentID]=CGM.[ID]
										LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] AS CM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CGM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID] OR TM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID]
										JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Collector_Mst_Tbl] AS CMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON CM.[ParentID]=CMT.[ID]
										WHERE MST.[TemplateID] IN (SELECT [VALUE] FROM STRING_SPLIT('232A34B5-AA22-43AD-8D3E-DFB85B9ECDB3',',')) AND TMT.[Attribute]='EAFHeatNo' and CMT.IsConnected=1 AND (MST.[ID] = @Equipment OR @Equipment IS NULL) AND (CMT.[ID] = @CollectorID OR @CollectorID IS NULL);

									IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#EAF_SMS_Block_1') IS NOT NULL
									BEGIN
										DROP TABLE #EAF_SMS_Block_1;
									END
									CREATE TABLE #EAF_SMS_Block_1([TAGID] INT,[VAL] DECIMAL(18,2));
									SET @Where= STUFF(( select ' OR '+ CONCAT( '( TagID = ', Convert(varchar,TAGID) ,case when Condition is not null then +' AND '+ Condition +' )'else ')' end) from #Tag_condition FOR XML PATH ('')),1,3,'');

									
									INSERT INTO #EAF_SMS_Block_1
									EXEC [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_First_Value_Usp] @StartDate,@EndDate,@Where;IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #EAF_SMS_Block_1)
									BEGIN
										SET @STR='UPDATE MT SET MT.[EAFHeatNo]=TBL.[VAL],MT.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),MT.[Source]=''T-SQL'' 
											FROM  ['+@Database+'].[dbo].['+@TableName+'] AS MT
											JOIN(SELECT @StartDate [Entrydatetime],TMT.[EquipmentID],TEM.* FROM #EAF_SMS_Block_1 AS TEM 
												JOIN #Tag_condition AS TC ON TEM.[TAGID] =TC.[TAGID]
												JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[EAF_SMS_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TC.[TagName]
											) AS TBL ON TBL.[Entrydatetime] = MT.[EntryDateTime] 
												AND TBL.[EquipmentID] = MT.[EquipmentID];';
										EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STR,N'@StartDate DATETIME ', @StartDate = @StartDate;
									END
									
								END TRY
								BEGIN CATCH
									DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE_1 VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE();
									DECLARE @ERROR_LINE_1 VARCHAR(max) =  CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()); 
									EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
										@type='SQL-Error',
										@Action='[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_EAF_SMS_Block_usp]',
										@Message=@ERROR_MESSAGE_1,
										@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE_1, @UserId='', @HostAddress='', @Info='', @Source='T-SQL', @SystemID='';
								END CATCH TRUNCATE TABLE #Tag_condition;
```

## dbo.Xstudio_Historian_Per_Billet_PVT_RM_Block_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** Xstudio_Historian_Per_Billet_PVT_RM_Block_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-11-13 07:58:17  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-13 13:47:04  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_Per_Billet_PVT_RM_Block_USP]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_Per_Billet_PVT_RM_Block_USP]
    @ReportDate DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    IF (@ReportDate IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        SET @ReportDate = CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(DAY, 0, GETDATE()));
    END;

    DECLARE 
        @StartDate   DATETIME,
        @EndDate     DATETIME,
        @TableName   VARCHAR(200),
        @Database    VARCHAR(200),
        @Query       NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @colsCurrent NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @colsTorque  NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @colsSpeed   NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @selectList  NVARCHAR(MAX);

    -- normalize start / end for the day
    SET @StartDate = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(CHAR(10), @ReportDate, 120) + ' 00:00:00.000');
    SET @EndDate   = DATEADD(MILLISECOND, -3, DATEADD(DAY, 1, @StartDate)); -- up to 23:59:59.997 for DATETIME

    -- find block table and database (same logic as you had)
    SELECT TOP 1 
        @TableName = BEM.[Name],
        @Database  = BDM.[Name]
    FROM [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Entities_Mst_Tbl] AS BEM WITH (NOLOCK)
    JOIN [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Databases_Mst_Tbl] AS BDM WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON BEM.[DatabaseName] = BDM.[Name] AND BDM.[IsDeleted] = 0
    WHERE BEM.[IsDeleted] = 0 
      AND BEM.[ParentID] = 'E6E720ED-6CF2-4277-AAE9-DD8E7AA0976B'
      AND BEM.[StartTime] <= @StartDate 
      AND BEM.[EndTime] > @StartDate;

    IF (@TableName IS NULL OR @Database IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('Block table/database not found for the given ReportDate.', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Build dynamic CASE expressions for each strand name (exclude Mill_Strands)
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    ;WITH Names AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT Name
        FROM RM_Mill_Mst_Tbl
        WHERE IsDeleted = 0
          AND Name <> 'Mill_Strands'
    )
    SELECT 
        @colsCurrent = STRING_AGG('MAX(CASE WHEN EQ.Name = ' + QUOTENAME(Name,'''') + 
                                  ' THEN RAW.AvgCurrent END) AS ' + QUOTENAME(Name + '_AvgCurrent'), ', '),
        @colsTorque  = STRING_AGG('MAX(CASE WHEN EQ.Name = ' + QUOTENAME(Name,'''') + 
                                  ' THEN RAW.AvgTorque END)  AS ' + QUOTENAME(Name + '_AvgTorque'),  ', '),
        @colsSpeed   = STRING_AGG('MAX(CASE WHEN EQ.Name = ' + QUOTENAME(Name,'''') + 
                                  ' THEN RAW.AvgSpeed END)   AS ' + QUOTENAME(Name + '_AvgSpeed'),   ', ')
    FROM Names;

    IF (@colsCurrent IS NULL OR @colsTorque IS NULL OR @colsSpeed IS NULL)
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('No strand names found in RM_Mill_Mst_Tbl (or all are Mill_Strands).', 16, 1);
        RETURN;
    END

    SET @selectList = 'RAW.BilletNo, ' + @colsCurrent + ', ' + @colsTorque + ', ' + @colsSpeed;

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Build main query using the discovered database & table
    -- qualify database/table using QUOTENAME to avoid issues
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @Query = N'
    SELECT ' + @selectList + '
    FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@Database) + N'.[dbo].' + QUOTENAME(@TableName) + N' AS RAW
    JOIN RM_Mill_Mst_Tbl AS EQ
        ON EQ.ID = RAW.EquipmentID
    WHERE EQ.IsDeleted = 0
      AND EQ.Name <> ''Mill_Strands''
      AND RAW.BilletNo NOT IN ( ''Heat Change Gap'')
      AND RAW.ReportDate >= @pStartDate
      AND RAW.ReportDate <= @pEndDate
    GROUP BY RAW.BilletNo
    ORDER BY RAW.BilletNo DESC
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);';
	
    -- Execute with parameters for dates (safer plan reuse and avoids concatenating date strings)
    EXEC sp_executesql 
        @Query,
        N'@pStartDate DATETIME, @pEndDate DATETIME',
        @pStartDate = @StartDate,
        @pEndDate   = @EndDate;

END
```

```sql
										SET @STR='UPDATE MT SET MT.[NGCONG]=TBL.[VAL],MT.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),MT.[Source]=''T-SQL'' FROM  ['+@Database+'].[dbo].['+@TableName+'] AS MT
										JOIN(SELECT @StartDate [Entrydatetime],TMT.[EquipmentID],TEM.* FROM #RM_NGConsumption_Report_6 AS TEM 
											JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TEM.TAGID=TM.[TagNo] 
											JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TM.[Name]
										) AS TBL ON TBL.[Entrydatetime] = MT.[StartTime] AND TBL.[EquipmentID] = MT.[EquipmentID];';

							----------------------- NGCONS -------------
							IF(@Attribute= 'All' OR @Attribute = 'NGCONS')
							BEGIN

									SET @HID = NEWID();

									SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, [TagNo]),NULL,@HID
									FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK) 
										JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TM.[Name]
										JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = TMT.[EquipmentID]
										LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Group_Mst_Tbl] AS CGM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TM.[ParentID]=CGM.[ID]
										LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] AS CM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CGM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID] OR TM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID]
										JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Collector_Mst_Tbl] AS CMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON CM.[ParentID]=CMT.[ID]
										WHERE MST.[TemplateID] IN (SELECT [VALUE] FROM STRING_SPLIT('8B31EC90-6F8B-4C62-95D3-54B982DAE1A8',',')) AND TMT.[Attribute]='NGCONS' and CMT.IsConnected=1 AND (MST.[ID] = @Equipment OR @Equipment IS NULL) AND (CMT.[ID] = @CollectorID OR @CollectorID IS NULL);

									IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#RM_NGConsumption_Report_7') IS NOT NULL
									BEGIN
										DROP TABLE #RM_NGConsumption_Report_7;
									END
									CREATE TABLE #RM_NGConsumption_Report_7([TAGID] INT,[VAL] DECIMAL(18,2));
						
									INSERT INTO #RM_NGConsumption_Report_7
									EXEC [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Last_Value_Usp] @StartDate,@EndDate,@HID;
									IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #RM_NGConsumption_Report_7)
									BEGIN
										SET @STR='UPDATE MT SET MT.[NGCONS]=TBL.[VAL],MT.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),MT.[Source]=''T-SQL'' FROM  ['+@Database+'].[dbo].['+@TableName+'] AS MT
										JOIN(SELECT @StartDate [Entrydatetime],TMT.[EquipmentID],TEM.* FROM #RM_NGConsumption_Report_7 AS TEM 
											JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TEM.TAGID=TM.[TagNo] 
											JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TM.[Name]
										) AS TBL ON TBL.[Entrydatetime] = MT.[StartTime] AND TBL.[EquipmentID] = MT.[EquipmentID];';
										EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STR,N'@StartDate DATETIME ', @StartDate = @StartDate;
									END

							END
							
							----------------------- TOTALNG -------------
							IF(@Attribute= 'All' OR @Attribute = 'TOTALNG')
							BEGIN
								BEGIN TRY
									SET @HID = NEWID();
									INSERT INTO #Tag_condition([TAGID], [Condition], [ID])
									SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, [TagNo]),NULL,@HID
									FROM [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK) 
										JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TM.[Name]
										JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = TMT.[EquipmentID]
										LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Group_Mst_Tbl] AS CGM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TM.[ParentID]=CGM.[ID]
										LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] AS CM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CGM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID] OR TM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID]
										JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Collector_Mst_Tbl] AS CMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON CM.[ParentID]=CMT.[ID]
										WHERE MST.[TemplateID] IN (SELECT [VALUE] FROM STRING_SPLIT('8B31EC90-6F8B-4C62-95D3-54B982DAE1A8',',')) AND TMT.[Attribute]='TOTALNG' and CMT.IsConnected=1 AND (MST.[ID] = @Equipment OR @Equipment IS NULL) AND (CMT.[ID] = @CollectorID OR @CollectorID IS NULL);

									IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#RM_NGConsumption_Report_8') IS NOT NULL
									BEGIN
										DROP TABLE #RM_NGConsumption_Report_8;
									END
									CREATE TABLE #RM_NGConsumption_Report_8([TAGID] INT,[VAL] DECIMAL(18,2));
						
									INSERT INTO #RM_NGConsumption_Report_8
									EXEC [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Last_Value_Usp] @StartDate,@EndDate,@HID;
									IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #RM_NGConsumption_Report_8)
									BEGIN
										SET @STR='UPDATE MT SET MT.[TOTALNG]=TBL.[VAL],MT.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),MT.[Source]=''T-SQL'' FROM  ['+@Database+'].[dbo].['+@TableName+'] AS MT
										JOIN(SELECT @StartDate [Entrydatetime],TMT.[EquipmentID],TEM.* FROM #RM_NGConsumption_Report_8 AS TEM 
											JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TEM.TAGID=TM.[TagNo] 
											JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TM.[Name]
										) AS TBL ON TBL.[Entrydatetime] = MT.[StartTime] AND TBL.[EquipmentID] = MT.[EquipmentID];';
										EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STR,N'@StartDate DATETIME ', @StartDate = @StartDate;
									END
								END TRY
								BEGIN CATCH
									DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE_8 VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE();
									DECLARE @ERROR_LINE_8 VARCHAR(max) =  CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE()); 
									EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
										@type='SQL-Error',
										@Action='[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_RM_NGConsumption_Report_usp]',
										@Message=@ERROR_MESSAGE_8,
										@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE_8, @UserId='', @HostAddress='', @Info='', @Source='T-SQL', @SystemID='';
								END CATCH TRUNCATE TABLE #Tag_condition;
							END
							
			----------------------- Uni Formula -------------	
			IF(@Attribute = 'All' OR @Attribute IN('TOTALBILLETMT'))
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY
					SET @STR='UPDATE Main SET [TOTALBILLETMT] =(isnull(main.[DISCHARGED],0)*(select top 1 isnull(BilletWeight,0) from Billet_Cross_Section with(nolock) where CrossSection1= IIF(main.CROSSSECTION=0,main.CrossSectionMax,main.CROSSSECTION) order by createdon desc)) FROM ['+@Database+'].[dbo].['+@TableName+'] AS Main
					JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = Main.[EquipmentID]
					JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[RM_Reheating_Furnace_Tag_Mapping_Tbl] AS TMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = TMT.[EquipmentID]
					JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Tag_Mst_Tbl] AS TM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TMT.[TagName] = TM.[Name]
					LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Group_Mst_Tbl] AS CGM WITH(NOLOCK) ON TM.[ParentID]=CGM.[ID]
					LEFT JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Channel_Mst_Tbl] AS CM WITH(NOLOCK) ON CGM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID] OR TM.[ParentID]=CM.[ID]
					JOIN [XStudio_Historian].[dbo].[XHS_Collector_Mst_Tbl] AS CMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON CM.[ParentID]=CMT.[ID]
					WHERE MST.[TemplateID] = ''8B31EC90-6F8B-4C62-95D3-54B982DAE1A8'' AND  Main.[StartTime] = @StartDate AND CMT.IsConnected=1 
					AND (MST.[ID] = @Equipment OR @Equipment IS NULL) AND (CMT.[ID] = @CollectorID OR @CollectorID IS NULL) ;';
					EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STR, N'@StartDate DATETIME, @Equipment VARCHAR(36),@CollectorID VARCHAR(36)',@StartDate = @StartDate,@Equipment = @Equipment,@CollectorID=@CollectorID ;
				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH
					DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE_temp_3_8B31E VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE();
					DECLARE @ERROR_LINE_temp_3_8B31E VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()); 
					EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
						@type='SQL-Error',
						@Action='[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_RM_NGConsumption_Report_usp]',
						@Message=@ERROR_MESSAGE_temp_3_8B31E,
						@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE_temp_3_8B31E,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@str,@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID='';
						
				END CATCH
			END
				Begin
            SET @STR='
              INSERT INTO [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[RM_NGConsumption] ([ReportDate],[Date],[FromTime],[ToTime],[Grade],[Billet130Hot],[Billet130Cold],[Billet140Hot],[Billet140Cold],[Billet150Hot],[Billet150Cold],[Discharged],[TotalBillet],[NGCong],[NGCons],[TotalNG],[CROSSSECTION],[Source],[CreatedOn])
              SELECT [ReportDate], [ReportDate],cast([StartTime] as time),cast([EndTime] as time),[GRADE]
              ,CASE WHEN src.HOTCold > 500 AND src.CROSSSECTION = 130 THEN src.DISCHARGED ELSE 0 END AS WillUpdate_Billet130Hot
              ,CASE WHEN src.HOTCold = 20 AND src.CROSSSECTION = 130 THEN src.DISCHARGED ELSE 0 END AS WillUpdate_Billet130Cold
              ,CASE WHEN src.HOTCold > 500 AND src.CROSSSECTION = 140 THEN src.DISCHARGED ELSE 0  END AS WillUpdate_Billet120Hot
              ,CASE WHEN src.HOTCold = 20 AND src.CROSSSECTION = 140 THEN src.DISCHARGED ELSE 0 END AS WillUpdate_Billet120Cold
              ,CASE WHEN src.HOTCold > 500 AND src.CROSSSECTION = 150 THEN src.DISCHARGED ELSE 0 END AS WillUpdate_Billet150Hot
              ,CASE WHEN src.HOTCold = 20 AND src.CROSSSECTION = 150 THEN src.DISCHARGED ELSE 0 END AS WillUpdate_Billet150Cold
              ,[DISCHARGED],[TOTALBILLETMT],[NGCONG],[NGCONS],[TotalNG],src.[CROSSSECTION]  ,''T-SQL'',GETDATE()   
              FROM ['+@Database+'].[dbo].['+@TableName+'] src  
              WHERE StartTime=@Startdate;'

            print (@STR)
            EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STR,N'@StartDate datetime',@StartDate=@StartDate
            End  
					--------------------- Summary Schedule 
					
						EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Summary_Entity_Historian_Schedule_Task_Usp] 'A0E0934F-B370-4374-819B-A60CF61E71AF','DB47C5C1-FF1C-412D-97F7-2FC5712712FD',@StartDate,@Database,@TableName;
										

				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH
					

					DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE());

						@type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_RM_NGConsumption_Report_Usp]',@Message=@ERROR_MESSAGE,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info=@str,@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID='';
					RAISERROR(@Error_message, 16,1)
				END CATCH
			END
```

## dbo.XStudio_Historian_Shift_SMS_Production_Usp

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XStudio_Historian_Shift_SMS_Production_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-08-30 09:46:38  
**Modified On:** 2025-11-07 15:43:16  
**Parameter Count:** 3  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Entrydatetime | datetime | NO |  |
| @DatabaseName | varchar(200) | NO |  |
| @EntityName | varchar(200) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XStudio_Historian_Shift_SMS_Production_Usp]
    @Entrydatetime = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @DatabaseName = '',
    @EntityName = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XStudio_Historian_Shift_SMS_Production_Usp]
					(@Entrydatetime DATETIME,@DatabaseName VARCHAR(200)=NULL,@EntityName  VARCHAR(200)=NULL
					)
					AS 
					BEGIN
										SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
					SET NOCOUNT ON;
					
					BEGIN TRY
						DECLARE @Startdate DATETIME, @Enddate DATETIME, @ShiftName VARCHAR(20), @HID VARCHAR(36);
						/*DECLARE @Entrydatetime DATETIME; SELECT  @Entrydatetime =  CONVERT(DATETIME,StartTime) FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_SMS_Block] WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@ID*/
						  
				SELECT @ShiftName = SDT.[Name],
				@Startdate = CASE WHEN ( [StartTime] > [EndTime] ) THEN 
								CASE WHEN CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) BETWEEN [StartTime] AND '23:59:59'
								THEN CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
								ELSE CAST(CONCAT(DATEADD(DD,-1,CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime)),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
								END
							ELSE CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
							END,
				@Enddate = CASE WHEN ([StartTime] > [EndTime]) THEN 
								CASE WHEN CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) BETWEEN '00:00:00' AND [EndTime]
								THEN CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2) 
								ELSE CAST(CONCAT(DATEADD(DD,1,CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime)),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2)
								END
							ELSE CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2)
							END
				FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Shift_Mst_Tbl] AS SMT WITH(NOLOCK)
				JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Shift_Dtl_Tbl] AS SDT WITH(NOLOCK) ON SMT.[ID]=SDT.[ParentID]
				CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) AS [CurrTime] ) AS ca
				WHERE SMT.ID='CA85B39F-7CD2-41C8-8674-93A4A421843E' AND
					(([EndTime] > [StartTime] AND [CurrTime] >= [StartTime] AND [CurrTime] < [EndTime]) OR 
					([EndTime] < [StartTime] AND ([CurrTime] < [EndTime] OR [CurrTime] >= [StartTime])))  AND SDT.IsDeleted = 0;
					
		IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ReportData') IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			DROP TABLE #ReportData;
		END
		CREATE TABLE #ReportData([StartTime] DATETIME, [EquipmentID] VARCHAR(36) ,[WeeklyTarget] decimal(18,4),[Year] decimal(18,4),[TodayAchievedpercentage] decimal(18,4),[WeeklyAchievedpercentage] decimal(18,4),[WeeklyAchievedProduction] decimal(18,4),[YearlyTarget] decimal(18,4),[YesterdayAchievedpercentage] decimal(18,4),[TodayPlannedProduction] decimal(18,4),[TotalProduction] decimal(18,4),[RunningRate] decimal(18,4),[AskingRate] decimal(18,4),[MTDAchievedpercentage] decimal(18,4),[MTDPlannedTon] decimal(18,4),[MonthlyTarget] decimal(18,4),[Month] varchar(100));
			DECLARE  @DBName VARCHAR(200), @TblName VARCHAR(200), @STR NVARCHAR(MAX); 
			DECLARE DB_TBL_Shift CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
				SELECT [DatabaseName], [Name] 
				FROM [XStudio_Configuration_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Block_Entities_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE [ParentID] = '0CD4A13A-DD4E-42BC-AEAB-813FF89E653A' AND [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [EndTime] > @StartDate AND [StartTime] <= @EndDate 
				ORDER BY [StartTime];

		OPEN Db_Tbl_Shift ;
		FETCH NEXT FROM Db_Tbl_Shift INTO @DBName, @TblName; 

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 
		BEGIN
			SET @STR = 'SELECT [StartTime], [EquipmentID] ,[AskingRate],[Month],[MonthlyTarget],[MTDAchievedpercentage],[MTDPlannedTon],[RunningRate],[TodayAchievedpercentage],[TodayPlannedProduction],[TotalProduction],[WeeklyAchievedpercentage],[WeeklyAchievedProduction],[WeeklyTarget],[Year],[YearlyTarget],[YesterdayAchievedpercentage] FROM ['+@DBName+'].[dbo].['+@TblName+'] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [StartTime] >= @StartDate AND [StartTime] < @EndDate;';
			INSERT INTO #ReportData
			EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @STR, N'@Startdate DATETIME, @EndDate DATETIME', @Startdate = @Startdate, @EndDate = @EndDate;
			FETCH NEXT FROM Db_Tbl_Shift INTO @DBName, @TblName;
		END
		CLOSE Db_Tbl_Shift;
		DEALLOCATE Db_Tbl_Shift;
		
						  CREATE TABLE #Tag_condition ([TAGID] INT, [Condition] VARCHAR(500), [ID] VARCHAR(36));
						  
		INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary_Shift] ([Entrydatetime], [ShiftName], [EquipmentID] , [Source])
							SELECT *, 'T-SQL' FROM (
								SELECT @StartDate AS [EntryDatetime], @ShiftName as [ShiftName], MST.[ID] AS [Equipmentid]  
								FROM  [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_SMS_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) 
								
								WHERE MST.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MST.[TemplateID] IN ('29744244-AD1E-4304-8CE8-9C702ABD88C9')
								GROUP BY  MST.[ID]
							) AS TBL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Production_Summary_Shift] AS SFD WHERE TBL.[Entrydatetime] = SFD.[Entrydatetime]
							AND ISNULL(TBL.[Equipmentid], '') = ISNULL(SFD.[Equipmentid], '') AND TBL.[ShiftName] = SFD.[ShiftName])
							
					BEGIN
						UPDATE SFD
							SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',SFD.[WeeklyTarget] = TBL.[WeeklyTarget],SFD.[Year] = TBL.[Year],SFD.[TodayAchievedpercentage] = TBL.[TodayAchievedpercentage],SFD.[WeeklyAchievedpercentage] = TBL.[WeeklyAchievedpercentage],SFD.[WeeklyAchievedProduction] = TBL.[WeeklyAchievedProduction],SFD.[YearlyTarget] = TBL.[YearlyTarget],SFD.[YesterdayAchievedpercentage] = TBL.[YesterdayAchievedpercentage],SFD.[TodayPlannedProduction] = TBL.[TodayPlannedProduction],SFD.[TotalProduction] = TBL.[TotalProduction],SFD.[RunningRate] = TBL.[RunningRate],SFD.[AskingRate] = TBL.[AskingRate],SFD.[MTDAchievedpercentage] = TBL.[MTDAchievedpercentage],SFD.[MTDPlannedTon] = TBL.[MTDPlannedTon],SFD.[MonthlyTarget] = TBL.[MonthlyTarget],SFD.[Month] = TBL.[Month]
						FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[SMS_Production_Summary_Shift] AS SFD
						JOIN(  SELECT @Startdate AS [EntryDateTime], TRN.[Equipmentid],MAX(TRN.[WeeklyTarget]) AS [WeeklyTarget],MAX(TRN.[Year]) AS [Year],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2), TRN.[TodayAchievedpercentage])) AS [TodayAchievedpercentage],AVG(TRN.[WeeklyAchievedpercentage]) AS [WeeklyAchievedpercentage],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2), TRN.[WeeklyAchievedProduction])) AS [WeeklyAchievedProduction],MAX(TRN.[YearlyTarget]) AS [YearlyTarget],MAX(TRN.[YesterdayAchievedpercentage]) AS [YesterdayAchievedpercentage],MAX(TRN.[TodayPlannedProduction]) AS [TodayPlannedProduction],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2), TRN.[TotalProduction])) AS [TotalProduction],MAX(TRN.[RunningRate]) AS [RunningRate],MAX(TRN.[AskingRate]) AS [AskingRate],MAX(TRN.[MTDAchievedpercentage]) AS [MTDAchievedpercentage],MAX(TRN.[MTDPlannedTon]) AS [MTDPlannedTon],MAX(TRN.[MonthlyTarget]) AS [MonthlyTarget],MAX(TRN.[Month]) AS [Month] FROM #ReportData AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK)  JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_SMS_MST_TBL] AS MST WITH(NOLOCK) ON MST.[ID] = TRN.[EquipmentID] WHERE MST.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND MST.[TemplateID] IN (SELECT * FROM STRING_SPLIT('29744244-AD1E-4304-8CE8-9C702ABD88C9' , ',')) GROUP BY TRN.[Equipmentid] 
						) AS TBL ON TBL.[EntryDateTime] = SFD.[EntryDateTime] AND TBL.[Equipmentid] = SFD.[Equipmentid];
					END
					 END TRY
						BEGIN CATCH
							IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL', 'DB_TBL_Shift') >= -1
							BEGIN
								CLOSE DB_TBL_Shift;
								DEALLOCATE DB_TBL_Shift;
							END	
							IF CURSOR_STATUS('GLOBAL', 'Equipment_Shift_Cur') >= -1
							BEGIN
								CLOSE Equipment_Shift_Cur;
								DEALLOCATE Equipment_Shift_Cur;
							END	
							DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) =  Convert(varchar(1000), ERROR_LINE());
							DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(MAX) =  ERROR_MESSAGE();
							EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
								@type = 'SQL-Error', @Action = '[dbo].[Xstudio_Historian_Shift_SMS_Production_Usp]',
								@Message = @ERROR_MESSAGE, @StackTrace = @ERROR_LINE, @UserId= '', @HostAddress = '', @Info = '', @Source = 'T-SQL', @SystemID = '';
						END CATCH
						END
```

## dbo.Xstudio_Historian_Summary_SMS_Production_Usp

**Created On:** 2026-03-14 10:41:09  
**Modified On:** 2026-03-14 12:05:08  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @Plant | nvarchar(20) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XStudio_Inventory_Pull_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp]
    @Plant = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:  Sagar Rana
-- Create date: 14-03-2026
-- Description: Manually Pull inventory Plantwise
-- =============================================
CREATE    PROCEDURE [dbo].[XStudio_Inventory_Pull_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp] --'cbv','39FA8990-EB43-4E08-B953-AD3E873DCB1F'
@Plant nvarchar(20)--='E:\Spectro\Scripts\RunSpectroProcess.bat'
AS
BEGIN
    SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  DECLARE @ConfigurationDatabase VARCHAR(MAX);
  DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
  DECLARE @tbl AS TABLE ([ID] VARCHAR(36), [Name] VARCHAR(200));
  BEGIN TRY

    --Get configuration database
    SELECT @ConfigurationDatabase = [ConfigurationDatabase] FROM [XStudio_Configuration]..[XStudio_GetDataSourceInfoFromSystemId_Fun]('A0E0934F-B370-4374-819B-A60CF61E71AF'); 

    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CAST(CreatedOn AS DATE)<=CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
    BEGIN
      DELETE FROM [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[MES_SAP_Inventory_Stock_Tbl] WHERE Plant=@Plant
    END

    --for SMS Plant
    IF (@Plant ='7502')
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO @tbl ([ID], [Name])  
      SELECT [ID], [Name] FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Request_Configuration_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)  
      WHERE [ID] IN ('8324ACB9-4B4D-4ED1-8E68-E38380784BC6','74B7C03B-B778-4FC2-824A-7A983E703463','4635BC2B-A9A2-4A78-93C6-0E4C03A2208B','F8463FC4-D858-4649-9DDE-CF7EF7387E75');
    END
    --for RM Plant
    IF (@Plant ='7501')
    BEGIN  
      INSERT INTO @tbl ([ID], [Name])
      SELECT [ID], [Name] FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Request_Configuration_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) 
      WHERE [ID] IN ('0B1A1E21-5C2D-4602-B671-D8750EF4B291','2CB14A22-ADD2-42C5-9AAF-816848400433','3B0DB68A-85EB-4DDB-A77A-974A99117069','5A4E0312-4376-47E6-A3DF-8B4D253F248E','6421FE41-ABC8-4D22-A4CA-DEA54378DCD9','6AB6630A-8364-4682-A878-1D0A9516024C','F0DD27E5-6923-4A65-8BBC-B32380E53260');
    END
    --for WRM Plant
    IF (@Plant ='7503')
    BEGIN 
      INSERT INTO @tbl ([ID], [Name])
      SELECT [ID], [Name] FROM [XStudio_Configuration_Xbatch].dbo.[XStudio_API_Request_Configuration_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK)
      WHERE [ID] IN ('1CE96FD9-7223-45D3-A90C-F774C2432643','2616503C-6AD7-4870-9BCA-2D1C3EC86F93','2D334635-7015-4F2D-9DB0-7F123B527F02','4BA235A1-72C5-42F4-833F-BFA7328363D2','6C22E073-9BD7-4591-85AA-FD982D4A019F','CBFC6BE8-47C1-446A-A655-499B73C93FA5');
    END

    ----Entry in Schedule transaction for selected plant---
    SET @SQL = (SELECT 'INSERT INTO ['+@ConfigurationDatabase+'].[dbo].[XStudio_ScheduleTask_Trn_Tbl] ([Name], [StepID], [StepName], [XMLParameter], [STATUS])
        VALUES'+STRING_AGG(CAST('('''+[Name]+''' , 
        ''7078B9DA-AFAA-4978-B7F7-DA0EC18CE2EC'', 
        ''API'', 
        ''<XMLControls xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
    <Controls>
    <XMLControl>
      <ControlName>Entity</ControlName>
      <ControlDisplayValue />
      <ControlValue />
    </XMLControl>
    <XMLControl>
      <ControlName>API</ControlName>
      <ControlDisplayValue>'+[ID]+'</ControlDisplayValue>
      <ControlValue>'+[ID]+'</ControlValue>
    </XMLControl>
    <XMLControl>
      <ControlName>Condition</ControlName>
      <ControlDisplayValue />
      <ControlValue />
    </XMLControl>
    </Controls>
  </XMLControls>'', ''waiting'')' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),',')  FROM @tbl AS t );
    EXEC(@SQL)
    print (@sql)        
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
  DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : [XStudio_Inventory_Pull_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp] | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
  RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
END CATCH
END
```

## dbo.XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_Bucket_Data_SP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_Bucket_Data_SP  
**Created On:** 2026-08-26 10:29:54  
**Modified On:** 2026-08-26 10:29:54  
**Parameter Count:** 3  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @FromDate | datetime | NO |  |
| @ToDate | datetime | NO |  |
| @Line | varchar(50) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_Bucket_Data_SP]
    @FromDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @ToDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @Line = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_Bucket_Data_SP] ******/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_Bucket_Data_SP]
    @FromDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @ToDate   DATETIME = NULL,
    @Line     VARCHAR(50) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH FilteredData AS
    (
        SELECT
            [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[YSMPa] AS [YS_MPa]
        FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Rebar_Daywise_Data] AS [Rebar_Daywise_Data] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[IsDeleted] = 0
            AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[Date] >= @FromDate)
            AND (@ToDate   IS NULL OR [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[Date] <  DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate))
            AND (@Line     IS NULL OR [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[Line] = @Line)
    ),
    Buckets AS
    (
        SELECT '500-520' AS [Range], 1 AS [SortOrder]
        UNION ALL SELECT '521-540', 2
        UNION ALL SELECT '541-560', 3
        UNION ALL SELECT '561-580', 4
        UNION ALL SELECT '581-600', 5
        UNION ALL SELECT '>600',    6
    ),
    Counted AS
    (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN [YS_MPa] BETWEEN 500 AND 520 THEN '500-520'
                WHEN [YS_MPa] BETWEEN 521 AND 540 THEN '521-540'
                WHEN [YS_MPa] BETWEEN 541 AND 560 THEN '541-560'
                WHEN [YS_MPa] BETWEEN 561 AND 580 THEN '561-580'
                WHEN [YS_MPa] BETWEEN 581 AND 600 THEN '581-600'
                WHEN [YS_MPa] > 600 THEN '>600'
                ELSE NULL
            END AS [Range]
        FROM FilteredData
    ),
    Agg AS
    (
        SELECT [Range], COUNT(*) AS [Cnt]
        FROM Counted
        WHERE [Range] IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY [Range]
    ),
    Final AS
    (
        SELECT
            b.[Range],
            b.[SortOrder],
            ISNULL(a.[Cnt], 0) AS [Count]
        FROM Buckets b
        LEFT JOIN Agg a ON a.[Range] = b.[Range]
    ),
    Total AS
    (
        SELECT SUM([Count]) AS [TotalCount] FROM Final
    )
    SELECT
        f.[Range],
        CAST(f.[Count] AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Count],
        CASE
            WHEN t.[TotalCount] = 0 OR t.[TotalCount] IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(5,2))
            ELSE CAST(ROUND((f.[Count] * 100.0) / t.[TotalCount], 2) AS DECIMAL(5,2))
        END AS [Percentage]
    FROM Final f
    CROSS JOIN Total t

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        '' AS [Range],
        CAST(SUM(f.[Count]) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Count],
        CAST(100.00 AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS [Percentage]
    FROM Final f;

END
```

## dbo.XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_StdDev_By_Line_SP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_StdDev_By_Line_SP  
**Created On:** 2026-08-26 11:28:28  
**Modified On:** 2026-08-26 11:28:28  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @FromDate | datetime | NO |  |
| @ToDate | datetime | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_StdDev_By_Line_SP]
    @FromDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00',
    @ToDate = '2026-05-04 00:00:00';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_StdDev_By_Line_SP] ******/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[XStudio_List_Rebar_YS_StdDev_By_Line_SP]
    @FromDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @ToDate   DATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH FilteredData AS
    (
        SELECT
            [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[Line]      AS [Line],
            [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[YSMPa]     AS [YS_MPa],
            [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[Tolerance] AS [Tolerance]
        FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Rebar_Daywise_Data] AS [Rebar_Daywise_Data] WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[IsDeleted] = 0
            AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[Date] >= @FromDate)
            AND (@ToDate   IS NULL OR [Rebar_Daywise_Data].[Date] <  DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ToDate))
    )
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN GROUPING(f.[Line]) = 1 THEN 'Grand Total'
            WHEN f.[Line] IS NULL THEN '(blank)'
            ELSE f.[Line]
        END AS [Row Labels],
        STDEV(f.[YS_MPa])      AS [StdDev of YS (MPa)],
        AVG(f.[Tolerance])     AS [Average of Tolerance],
        GROUPING(f.[Line])     AS [IsGrandTotal]
    FROM FilteredData f
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (f.[Line]), () )
    ORDER BY
        [IsGrandTotal] ASC,
        CASE WHEN f.[Line] IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
        f.[Line] ASC;

END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE     PROCEDURE [dbo].[XStudio_PowerShell_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp] --'cbv','39FA8990-EB43-4E08-B953-AD3E873DCB1F'
	@name varchar(500)= 'Quality Data Fetch Using Batch file',
	@Path nvarchar(max)--='E:\Spectro\Scripts\RunSpectroProcess.bat'
AS
BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	BEGIN TRY
		 
	 
		DECLARE @ConfigurationDatabase VARCHAR(MAX);
		DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
		SET @name = ISNULL(@name, 'Quality Data Fetch Using Batch file');
		--Get configuration database
        SELECT @ConfigurationDatabase = ConfigurationDatabase FROM [XStudio_Configuration]..[XStudio_GetDataSourceInfoFromSystemId_Fun]('A0E0934F-B370-4374-819B-A60CF61E71AF');


		SET @SQL='INSERT INTO ['+@ConfigurationDatabase+'].[dbo].[XStudio_ScheduleTask_Trn_Tbl]
				     (Name,StepID,StepName,XMLParameter,STATUS)
				     VALUES
				     ('''+@name+''' , 
				      ''A5B4C75F-68A1-4D91-B236-44D223F0E18A'', 
				      ''PowerShellScripts'', 
				      ''<XMLControls xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <Controls>
    <XMLControl>
      <ControlName>UserName</ControlName>
      <ControlDisplayValue />
      <ControlValue />
    </XMLControl>
    <XMLControl>
      <ControlName>PowerShellBatchFilePath</ControlName>
      <ControlDisplayValue>'+@Path+'</ControlDisplayValue>
      <ControlValue>'+@Path+'</ControlValue>
    </XMLControl>
    <XMLControl>
      <ControlName>Password</ControlName>
      <ControlDisplayValue />
      <ControlValue />
    </XMLControl>
    <XMLControl>
      <ControlName>DomainName</ControlName>
      <ControlDisplayValue />
      <ControlValue />
    </XMLControl>
  </Controls>
</XMLControls>'', ''waiting'')';
        EXEC(@SQL)
		--print (@sql)								
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : [XStudio_PowerShell_Schedule_TSQL_Task_Usp] | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
		RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1);
END CATCH
END
```

```sql
		select NEWID(),@Title,@body,@systemid,value,'Alarm',@TimeOut,GETDATE(),0,0,1,'HtmlPages\TorrentUOC\Configuration\Sound\mixkit-classic-alarm-995.wav',0 from  (

		SELECT value FROM String_Split (@userid, ',') )as tb;

 
	END TRY

	BEGIN CATCH

		DECLARE @ERROR_MSG_PR VARCHAR(MAX) = 'Query : Notification INSERT ';

    	  DECLARE @ERROR_LINE_PR VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());

   	  DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE_PR VARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE();

    	  EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[Xstudio_Schedule_Popup_Notification_USP]',@Message =    @ERROR_MESSAGE_PR,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE_PR,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL'
 
	END CATCH
 
 
ENd
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [DBO].[Xstudio_Shift_CCM_Usp]
				(
					@ID VARCHAR(36),@DatabaseName VARCHAR(200)=NULL,@EntityName  VARCHAR(200)=NULL
				)
				AS 
				BEGIN
				SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
				SET ANSI_PADDING ON;
				SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
				SET ARITHABORT ON;
				SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
				SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
				SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
					BEGIN TRY	
					DECLARE @Startdate DATETIME,@Enddate DATETIME,@ShiftName VARCHAR(20);
					DECLARE @Entrydatetime DATETIME 
						   SELECT  @Entrydatetime =  CONVERT(DATETIME,HeatReportDate) 
									 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Per_Heat] WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@ID
					SELECT @ShiftName = SDT.[Name],
					@Startdate=CASE WHEN ( [StartTime] > [EndTime] ) THEN 
								CASE WHEN CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) BETWEEN [StartTime] AND '23:59:59'
									THEN CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
									ELSE CAST(CONCAT(DATEADD(DD,-1,CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime)),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
								END
							ELSE CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
						END,
						@Enddate= CASE WHEN ([StartTime] > [EndTime]) THEN 
								CASE WHEN CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) BETWEEN '00:00:00' AND [EndTime]
									THEN CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2) 
									ELSE CAST(CONCAT(DATEADD(DD,1,CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime)),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2)
								END
							ELSE 
								CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2)
						END
							FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Shift_Mst_Tbl] AS SMT WITH(NOLOCK)
							JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Shift_Dtl_Tbl] AS SDT WITH(NOLOCK) ON SMT.[ID]=SDT.[ParentID]
							CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) AS [CurrTime] ) AS ca
							WHERE SMT.ID='CA85B39F-7CD2-41C8-8674-93A4A421843E' and
								(([EndTime] > [StartTime] AND [CurrTime] >= [StartTime] AND [CurrTime] < [EndTime]) OR 
								([EndTime] < [StartTime] AND ([CurrTime] < [EndTime] OR [CurrTime] >= [StartTime])))  AND SDT.IsDeleted = 0; 		
								
							BEGIN
								UPDATE SFD
									SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',SFD.[ActualBilletCount] = TBL.[ActualBilletCount],SFD.[ActualBilletWeightTon] = TBL.[ActualBilletWeightTon],SFD.[HeatID] = TBL.[HeatID],SFD.[MonthlyTarget] = TBL.[MonthlyTarget],SFD.[MTDPlannedProduction] = TBL.[MTDPlannedProduction],SFD.[STD1OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD1OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD2OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD2OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD3OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD3OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD4OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD4OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD5OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD5OSCSpeed],SFD.[STD6OSCSpeed] = TBL.[STD6OSCSpeed],SFD.[Strand1BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand1BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand1CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand1CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand2BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand2BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand2CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand2CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand3BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand3BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand3CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand3CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand4BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand4BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand4CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand4CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand5BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand5BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand5CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand5CastingSpeed],SFD.[Strand6BilletCounter] = TBL.[Strand6BilletCounter],SFD.[Strand6CastingSpeed] = TBL.[Strand6CastingSpeed],SFD.[TodayPlannedProduction] = TBL.[TodayPlannedProduction],SFD.[TotalBilletsCount] = TBL.[TotalBilletsCount],SFD.[TotalProduction] = TBL.[TotalProduction]
								FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Shift] AS SFD
								JOIN(SELECT @Startdate AS [EntryDatetime],AVG(TRN.[STD1OSCSpeed]) AS [STD1OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD2OSCSpeed]) AS [STD2OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD3OSCSpeed]) AS [STD3OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD4OSCSpeed]) AS [STD4OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD5OSCSpeed]) AS [STD5OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD6OSCSpeed]) AS [STD6OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand1CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand1CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand2CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand2CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand3CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand3CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand4CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand4CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand5CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand5CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand6CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand6CastingSpeed],COUNT(TRN.[HeatID]) AS [HeatID],MAX(TRN.[MonthlyTarget]) AS [MonthlyTarget],MAX(TRN.[MTDPlannedProduction]) AS [MTDPlannedProduction],MAX(TRN.[TodayPlannedProduction]) AS [TodayPlannedProduction],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ActualBilletCount])) AS [ActualBilletCount],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ActualBilletWeightTon])) AS [ActualBilletWeightTon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand1BilletCounter])) AS [Strand1BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand2BilletCounter])) AS [Strand2BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand3BilletCounter])) AS [Strand3BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand4BilletCounter])) AS [Strand4BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand5BilletCounter])) AS [Strand5BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand6BilletCounter])) AS [Strand6BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalBilletsCount])) AS [TotalBilletsCount],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalProduction])) AS [TotalProduction]
									FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Per_Heat] AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK) 
									WHERE TRN.[IsDeleted]=0 AND TRN.HeatReportDate >= @Startdate AND TRN.HeatReportDate < @EndDate 
								) AS TBL ON TBL.[EntryDatetime] = SFD.[EntryDatetime] ;
							END	
							BEGIN						
									INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Shift]([EntryDatetime],[ShiftName],[ActualBilletCount],[ActualBilletWeightTon],[HeatID],[MonthlyTarget],[MTDPlannedProduction],[STD1OSCSpeed],[STD2OSCSpeed],[STD3OSCSpeed],[STD4OSCSpeed],[STD5OSCSpeed],[STD6OSCSpeed],[Strand1BilletCounter],[Strand1CastingSpeed],[Strand2BilletCounter],[Strand2CastingSpeed],[Strand3BilletCounter],[Strand3CastingSpeed],[Strand4BilletCounter],[Strand4CastingSpeed],[Strand5BilletCounter],[Strand5CastingSpeed],[Strand6BilletCounter],[Strand6CastingSpeed],[TodayPlannedProduction],[TotalBilletsCount],[TotalProduction],[Source])
									SELECT *,'T-SQL' FROM (SELECT @Startdate AS [EntryDatetime],@Shiftname AS [ShiftName],AVG(TRN.[STD1OSCSpeed]) AS [STD1OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD2OSCSpeed]) AS [STD2OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD3OSCSpeed]) AS [STD3OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD4OSCSpeed]) AS [STD4OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD5OSCSpeed]) AS [STD5OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[STD6OSCSpeed]) AS [STD6OSCSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand1CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand1CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand2CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand2CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand3CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand3CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand4CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand4CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand5CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand5CastingSpeed],AVG(TRN.[Strand6CastingSpeed]) AS [Strand6CastingSpeed],COUNT(TRN.[HeatID]) AS [HeatID],MAX(TRN.[MonthlyTarget]) AS [MonthlyTarget],MAX(TRN.[MTDPlannedProduction]) AS [MTDPlannedProduction],MAX(TRN.[TodayPlannedProduction]) AS [TodayPlannedProduction],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ActualBilletCount])) AS [ActualBilletCount],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ActualBilletWeightTon])) AS [ActualBilletWeightTon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand1BilletCounter])) AS [Strand1BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand2BilletCounter])) AS [Strand2BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand3BilletCounter])) AS [Strand3BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand4BilletCounter])) AS [Strand4BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand5BilletCounter])) AS [Strand5BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Strand6BilletCounter])) AS [Strand6BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalBilletsCount])) AS [TotalBilletsCount],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalProduction])) AS [TotalProduction]
									FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Per_Heat] AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK) 
									WHERE TRN.[IsDeleted]=0 AND TRN.HeatReportDate >= @Startdate AND TRN.HeatReportDate < @EndDate
									) AS TBL WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Shift] AS SFD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE SFD.[EntryDatetime] = TBL.[EntryDatetime]   );
							END
						
				
					END TRY
					BEGIN CATCH
						DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE());
						DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE();
						EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
							@type='SQL-Error',
							@Action='[dbo].[XStudio_Shift_CCM_Usp]',
							@Message=@ERROR_MESSAGE,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID='';
					END CATCH
				END
```

TRN.[BIN1LimeConsumption])) AS [BIN1LimeConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[BIN2DoloConsumption])) AS [BIN2DoloConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[BIN3Consumption])) AS TRN.[BriquetteCH2])) AS [BriquetteCH2],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[BundleLMSCH1])) AS [BundleLMSCH1],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[BundleLMSCH2])) AS [BundleLMSCH2],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[CarbonConsumption])) AS [CarbonConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ChargeWeight])) AS [ChargeWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[CopexScrapCH1])) AS
