[EndCutsCH2],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[HBIDRICH1])) AS [HBIDRICH1],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[HBIDRICH2])) AS [HBIDRICH2],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[HMS12CH1])) AS [HMS12CH1],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[HMS12CH2])) AS [HMS12CH2],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[HMS1CH1])) AS [HMS1CH1],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[HMS1CH2])) AS [HMS1CH2],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LadleAdditionDolo])) AS [LadleAdditionDolo],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LadleAdditionFeSi])) AS [LadleAdditionFeSi],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LadleAdditionLime])) AS [LadleAdditionLime],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LadleAdditionSiMn])) AS [LadleAdditionSiMn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LadleAdditionSiMnn])) AS [LadleAdditionSiMnn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LiquidMetalWeight])) AS [LiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[NGConsumption])) AS [NGConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[NutCokeKgPerTon])) AS [NutCokeKgPerTon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[OxygenConsumption])) AS [OxygenConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[PowerMWH])) AS [PowerMWH],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[PowerOnTimeMinute])) AS [PowerOnTimeMinute],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ScullCH1])) AS [ScullCH1],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ScullCH2])) AS 									FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[EAF_PER_HEAT] AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK)

```sql
									) AS TBL WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[EAF_Summary_Shift] AS SFD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE SFD.[EntryDatetime] = TBL.[EntryDatetime]   );
							END
```

```sql
    @DatabaseName = '',

```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [DBO].[Xstudio_Shift_LRF_Usp]
				(
					@ID VARCHAR(36),@DatabaseName VARCHAR(200)=NULL,@EntityName  VARCHAR(200)=NULL
				)
				AS 
				BEGIN
				SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
				SET ANSI_PADDING ON;
				SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
				SET ARITHABORT ON;
				SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
				SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
				SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
					BEGIN TRY	
					DECLARE @Startdate DATETIME,@Enddate DATETIME,@ShiftName VARCHAR(20);
					DECLARE @Entrydatetime DATETIME 
						   SELECT  @Entrydatetime =  CONVERT(DATETIME,HeatReportDate) 
									 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] WHERE [IsDeleted]=0 AND [ID]=@ID
					SELECT @ShiftName = SDT.[Name],
					@Startdate=CASE WHEN ( [StartTime] > [EndTime] ) THEN 
								CASE WHEN CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) BETWEEN [StartTime] AND '23:59:59'
									THEN CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
									ELSE CAST(CONCAT(DATEADD(DD,-1,CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime)),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
								END
							ELSE CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[StartTime]) AS DATETIME2)
						END,
						@Enddate= CASE WHEN ([StartTime] > [EndTime]) THEN 
								CASE WHEN CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) BETWEEN '00:00:00' AND [EndTime]
									THEN CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2) 
									ELSE CAST(CONCAT(DATEADD(DD,1,CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime)),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2)
								END
							ELSE 
								CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(DATE,@Entrydatetime),' ',[EndTime]) AS DATETIME2)
						END
							FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Shift_Mst_Tbl] AS SMT WITH(NOLOCK)
							JOIN [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XStudio_Shift_Dtl_Tbl] AS SDT WITH(NOLOCK) ON SMT.[ID]=SDT.[ParentID]
							CROSS APPLY ( SELECT CONVERT(TIME,@Entrydatetime) AS [CurrTime] ) AS ca
							WHERE SMT.ID='CA85B39F-7CD2-41C8-8674-93A4A421843E' and
								(([EndTime] > [StartTime] AND [CurrTime] >= [StartTime] AND [CurrTime] < [EndTime]) OR 
								([EndTime] < [StartTime] AND ([CurrTime] < [EndTime] OR [CurrTime] >= [StartTime])))  AND SDT.IsDeleted = 0; 		
								
							BEGIN
								UPDATE SFD
									SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',SFD.[Aluminium] = TBL.[Aluminium],SFD.[ArgonConsumption] = TBL.[ArgonConsumption],SFD.[Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight] = TBL.[Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight],SFD.[Avg_LiquidMetalWeight] = TBL.[Avg_LiquidMetalWeight],SFD.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight] = TBL.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight],SFD.[Carbon] = TBL.[Carbon],SFD.[Dolo] = TBL.[Dolo],SFD.[FeSi] = TBL.[FeSi],SFD.[FlourSpar] = TBL.[FlourSpar],SFD.[HeatID] = TBL.[HeatID],SFD.[Lime] = TBL.[Lime],SFD.[LiquidMetalWeight] = TBL.[LiquidMetalWeight],SFD.[PowerMWH] = TBL.[PowerMWH],SFD.[SiMn] = TBL.[SiMn],SFD.[SiMnn] = TBL.[SiMnn],SFD.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg] = TBL.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg]
								FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Summary_Shift] AS SFD
								JOIN(SELECT @Startdate AS [EntryDatetime],AVG(TRN.[Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight]) AS [Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight],AVG(TRN.[Avg_LiquidMetalWeight]) AS [Avg_LiquidMetalWeight],COUNT(TRN.[HeatID]) AS [HeatID],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Aluminium])) AS [Aluminium],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ArgonConsumption])) AS [ArgonConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight])) AS [CalcLiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Carbon])) AS [Carbon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Dolo])) AS [Dolo],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[FeSi])) AS [FeSi],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[FlourSpar])) AS [FlourSpar],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Lime])) AS [Lime],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LiquidMetalWeight])) AS [LiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[PowerMWH])) AS [PowerMWH],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[SiMn])) AS [SiMn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[SiMnn])) AS [SiMnn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg])) AS [TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg]
									FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK) 
									WHERE TRN.[IsDeleted]=0 AND TRN.HeatReportDate >= @Startdate AND TRN.HeatReportDate < @EndDate 
								) AS TBL ON TBL.[EntryDatetime] = SFD.[EntryDatetime] ;
							END	
							BEGIN						
									INSERT INTO [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Summary_Shift]([EntryDatetime],[ShiftName],[Aluminium],[ArgonConsumption],[Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight],[Avg_LiquidMetalWeight],[CalcLiquidMetalWeight],[Carbon],[Dolo],[FeSi],[FlourSpar],[HeatID],[Lime],[LiquidMetalWeight],[PowerMWH],[SiMn],[SiMnn],[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg],[Source])
									SELECT *,'T-SQL' FROM (SELECT @Startdate AS [EntryDatetime],@Shiftname AS [ShiftName],AVG(TRN.[Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight]) AS [Avg_CalcLiquidMetalWeight],AVG(TRN.[Avg_LiquidMetalWeight]) AS [Avg_LiquidMetalWeight],COUNT(TRN.[HeatID]) AS [HeatID],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Aluminium])) AS [Aluminium],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[ArgonConsumption])) AS [ArgonConsumption],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[CalcLiquidMetalWeight])) AS [CalcLiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Carbon])) AS [Carbon],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Dolo])) AS [Dolo],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[FeSi])) AS [FeSi],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[FlourSpar])) AS [FlourSpar],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[Lime])) AS [Lime],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[LiquidMetalWeight])) AS [LiquidMetalWeight],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[PowerMWH])) AS [PowerMWH],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[SiMn])) AS [SiMn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[SiMnn])) AS [SiMnn],SUM(CONVERT(decimal(18,2), TRN.[TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg])) AS [TotalElectrodeConsumptionKg]
									FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Per_Heat] AS TRN WITH(NOLOCK) 
									WHERE TRN.[IsDeleted]=0 AND TRN.HeatReportDate >= @Startdate AND TRN.HeatReportDate < @EndDate
									) AS TBL WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[LRF_Summary_Shift] AS SFD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE SFD.[EntryDatetime] = TBL.[EntryDatetime]   );
							END
						
				
					END TRY
					BEGIN CATCH
						DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE());
						DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE();
						EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
							@type='SQL-Error',
							@Action='[dbo].[XStudio_Shift_LRF_Usp]',
							@Message=@ERROR_MESSAGE,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserId='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL',@SystemID='';
					END CATCH
				END
```

```sql
CREATE   Procedure [dbo].[Xstudio_ShiftDelayEntry_USP]
    		(
				@ID VARCHAR(36),
				@Mode VARCHAR(20)
    		)
    		AS
    		BEGIN
			BEGIN TRY
						
				----- Calculated Column Update 
				--$$#

					  Update [ShiftDelayEntry] SET [ShiftDelayEntry].[Shift]=[Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[FN_Get_ShiftName]([ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayStartTime]),[ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayInSecond]=DATEDIFF(second,[ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayStartTime],[ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayEndTime]),[ShiftDelayEntry].[SMSReportDate]=FORMAT([ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayStartTime],'yyyy-MM-dd'),[ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayInMinutes]=cast(cast(DATEDIFF(second,[ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayStartTime],[ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayEndTime]) as Decimal(18,2))/60 as decimal(18,2)),[ShiftDelayEntry].[ReportDate]=[Xstudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[FN_GET_ReportDate]([ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayStartTime]),[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[ShiftDelayEntry] AS [ShiftDelayEntry] WHERE [ShiftDelayEntry].[ID]=@ID;   Update [ShiftDelayEntry] SET [ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayDuration]=RIGHT('0' + CAST(FLOOR([ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayInMinutes]) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) + ':' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(CAST(ROUND(([ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayInMinutes]- FLOOR([ShiftDelayEntry].[DelayInMinutes])) * 60, 0) AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2),[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[ShiftDelayEntry] AS [ShiftDelayEntry] WHERE [ShiftDelayEntry].[ID]=@ID; 

				--#$$

			
			END TRY
			BEGIN CATCH
				DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Xstudio_ShiftDelayEntry_USP | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
				DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
```

## dbo.Xstudio_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_USP

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** Xstudio_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_USP  
**Created On:** 2025-08-22 14:27:52  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-18 15:59:29  
**Parameter Count:** 2  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ID | varchar(36) | NO |  |
| @Mode | varchar(20) | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[Xstudio_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_USP]
    @ID = '',
    @Mode = '';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE                                                                                 Procedure [dbo].[Xstudio_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_USP]
    	(
			@ID VARCHAR(36),
			@Mode VARCHAR(20)
    	)
    	AS
    	BEGIN
					SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
					SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
					SET ARITHABORT ON;
					SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
					SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
					SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
		BEGIN TRY
		
			--$##



			--##$
			
			----- Calculated Column Update 
			--$$#
  Update [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] SET [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[Duration]=cast(datediff(second,[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[StartTime],isnull([SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[EndTime],getdate())) as decimal(18,2))/60,[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[ActualHeatID]=(Case When [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[Status] in ('Ladle Car Reach At LRF','LRF Roof Close','LRF Arcing','LRF Roof Open','Ladle Move From LRF To CCM','Ladle At CCM Arm 2 Rest Position','Ladle At CCM Arm 1 Rest Position','Turret Rotation','CCM Arm 2 Casting Position','CCM Arm 1 Casting Position','Billets Production','CCM Turret Control Off') 
Then [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[HeatID]-1
Else [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[HeatID] 
End),[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[StateSequence]=case 
When Status='EAF Roof Open For Fill Bucket Charging' Then 1
When Status='EAF Power On' Then 2
When Status='Ladle Car At EAF' Then 3
When Status='EAF Tapping' Then 4
When Status='Ladle Car Move From EAF To LRF' Then 5
When Status='Ladle Car Reach At LRF' Then 6
When Status='LRF Roof Close' Then 7
When Status='LRF Arcing' Then 8
When Status='LRF Roof Open' Then 9
When Status='Ladle Move From LRF To CCM' Then 10
When Status in ('Ladle At CCM Arm 2 Rest Position','Ladle At CCM Arm 1 Rest Position') Then 11
When Status='Turret Rotation' Then 12
When Status in('CCM Arm 2 Casting Position','CCM Arm 1 Casting Position') Then 13
When Status='Billets Production' Then 14
When Status='CCM Turret Control Off' Then 18
End,[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[DurationinSeconds]=datediff(second,[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[StartTime],isnull([SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[EndTime],getdate())),[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] AS [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] WHERE [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[ID]=@ID;   Update [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] SET [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[DurationMMSS]=RIGHT('0' + CAST(FLOOR([SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[Duration]) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) + ':' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(CAST(ROUND(([SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[Duration]- FLOOR([SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[Duration])) * 60, 0) AS INT) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2),[source]='T-SQL' FROM [dbo].[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] AS [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] WHERE [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime].[ID]=@ID; 
--#$$

			----- Default Value Column Update 
			--$$##

			--##$$
				
		END TRY

		BEGIN CATCH

			DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(MAX) =  'SP : Xstudio_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_USP | Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
			DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(MAX) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),ERROR_LINE());
			EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] @Type='SQL-Error',@Action='[dbo].[Xstudio_SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime_USP]',@Message=@ERROR_MSG,@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,@UserID='',@HostAddress='',@Info='',@Source='T-SQL';

		END CATCH

		END
```

**Schema:** dbo  
**Procedure Name:** XStudio_Update_Day_CCM_Usp  
**Created On:** 2025-08-29 17:10:25  
**Modified On:** 2026-02-24 16:44:18  
**Parameter Count:** 1  

### Parameters

| Parameter | Data Type | Output | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @ReportDate | date | NO |  |

### EXEC Template

```sql
EXEC [dbo].[XStudio_Update_Day_CCM_Usp]
    @ReportDate = '2026-05-04';
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE    PROC [dbo].[XStudio_Update_Day_CCM_Usp] (
			@ReportDate DATE) 
		AS
		BEGIN
			SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
			SET ANSI_PADDING ON;
			SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
			SET ARITHABORT ON;
			SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
			SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
			SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
			DECLARE @TableName VARCHAR(200),@YrStartDate DATETIME,@HYrStartDate DATETIME,@QTRStartDate DATETIME,@MthStartDate DATETIME,@DayStartDate DATETIME,@ShiftStartDate DATETIME,@FYrStartDate DATETIME,@FHYrStartDate DATETIME,@FQTRStartDate DATETIME,@FMthStartDate DATETIME,@FDayStartDate DATETIME;
			BEGIN TRY
				DECLARE @Edatetime DATETIME,@RptDate DATE;
				DECLARE UpdateCur CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
				SELECT DISTINCT SFD.[ReportDate] FROM  [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] AS SFD WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE SFD.[Reportdate]>=@Reportdate;
						OPEN UpdateCur;
						FETCH NEXT FROM UpdateCur INTO @RptDate;
	
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
				BEGIN SET @YrStartDate =CONVERT(DATE, DATEADD(DD, 0, DATEDIFF(DD, 0, DATEADD(MM, -(((12 + DATEPART(M, CONVERT(DATETIME, @RptDate)))-1)%12),CONVERT(DATETIME,@RptDate))-DATEPART(D,DATEADD(MM,-(((12+DATEPART(M,CONVERT(DATETIME,@RptDate)))-1)%12),CONVERT(DATETIME,@RptDate)))+1))) SET @MthStartDate = CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(DD,1,EOMONTH(@RptDate,-1)))	UPDATE SFD SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',[Strand1BilletCounter_YTD]=TBL.[Strand1BilletCounter],[HeatID_YTD]=TBL.[HeatID],[TotalProduction_YTD]=TBL.[TotalProduction],[Strand4BilletCounter_YTD]=TBL.[Strand4BilletCounter],[Strand5BilletCounter_YTD]=TBL.[Strand5BilletCounter],[Strand2BilletCounter_YTD]=TBL.[Strand2BilletCounter],[Strand6BilletCounter_YTD]=TBL.[Strand6BilletCounter],[Strand3BilletCounter_YTD]=TBL.[Strand3BilletCounter],[ActualBilletCount_YTD]=TBL.[ActualBilletCount],[TotalBilletsCount_YTD]=TBL.[TotalBilletsCount],[ActualBilletWeightTon_YTD]=TBL.[ActualBilletWeightTon] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] AS SFD JOIN(SELECT @RptDate AS [Reportdate],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand1BilletCounter])) AS [Strand1BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[HeatID])) AS [HeatID],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[TotalProduction])) AS [TotalProduction],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand4BilletCounter])) AS [Strand4BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand5BilletCounter])) AS [Strand5BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand2BilletCounter])) AS [Strand2BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand6BilletCounter])) AS [Strand6BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand3BilletCounter])) AS [Strand3BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[ActualBilletCount])) AS [ActualBilletCount],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[TotalBilletsCount])) AS [TotalBilletsCount],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[ActualBilletWeightTon])) AS [ActualBilletWeightTon] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0  AND  [ReportDate] BETWEEN @YrStartDate AND @RptDate  ) AS TBL ON TBL.[Reportdate]=SFD.[Reportdate] 	UPDATE SFD SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',[Strand6BilletCounter_MTD]=TBL.[Strand6BilletCounter],[Strand5BilletCounter_MTD]=TBL.[Strand5BilletCounter],[TotalProduction_MTD]=TBL.[TotalProduction],[ActualBilletCount_MTD]=TBL.[ActualBilletCount],[ActualBilletWeightTon_MTD]=TBL.[ActualBilletWeightTon],[Strand1BilletCounter_MTD]=TBL.[Strand1BilletCounter],[Strand4BilletCounter_MTD]=TBL.[Strand4BilletCounter],[HeatID_MTD]=TBL.[HeatID],[TotalBilletsCount_MTD]=TBL.[TotalBilletsCount],[Strand2BilletCounter_MTD]=TBL.[Strand2BilletCounter],[Strand3BilletCounter_MTD]=TBL.[Strand3BilletCounter] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] AS SFD JOIN(SELECT @RptDate AS [Reportdate],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand6BilletCounter])) AS [Strand6BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand5BilletCounter])) AS [Strand5BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[TotalProduction])) AS [TotalProduction],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[ActualBilletCount])) AS [ActualBilletCount],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[ActualBilletWeightTon])) AS [ActualBilletWeightTon],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand1BilletCounter])) AS [Strand1BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand4BilletCounter])) AS [Strand4BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[HeatID])) AS [HeatID],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[TotalBilletsCount])) AS [TotalBilletsCount],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand2BilletCounter])) AS [Strand2BilletCounter],SUM(CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,2),[Strand3BilletCounter])) AS [Strand3BilletCounter] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0  AND  [ReportDate] BETWEEN @MthStartDate AND @RptDate  ) AS TBL ON TBL.[Reportdate]=SFD.[Reportdate] 	UPDATE SFD SET SFD.[ModifiedOn]=GETDATE(),[Source]='T-SQL',[ActualBilletCount_YD]=TBL.[ActualBilletCount],[Strand2BilletCounter_YD]=TBL.[Strand2BilletCounter],[Strand6BilletCounter_YD]=TBL.[Strand6BilletCounter],[Strand1CastingSpeed_YD]=TBL.[Strand1CastingSpeed],[STD2OSCSpeed_YD]=TBL.[STD2OSCSpeed],[STD6OSCSpeed_YD]=TBL.[STD6OSCSpeed],[TodayPlannedProduction_YD]=TBL.[TodayPlannedProduction],[Strand4CastingSpeed_YD]=TBL.[Strand4CastingSpeed],[STD1OSCSpeed_YD]=TBL.[STD1OSCSpeed],[STD4OSCSpeed_YD]=TBL.[STD4OSCSpeed],[ActualBilletWeightTon_YD]=TBL.[ActualBilletWeightTon],[Strand5BilletCounter_YD]=TBL.[Strand5BilletCounter],[TotalBilletsCount_YD]=TBL.[TotalBilletsCount],[STD5OSCSpeed_YD]=TBL.[STD5OSCSpeed],[Strand4BilletCounter_YD]=TBL.[Strand4BilletCounter],[Strand3CastingSpeed_YD]=TBL.[Strand3CastingSpeed],[Strand6CastingSpeed_YD]=TBL.[Strand6CastingSpeed],[Strand3BilletCounter_YD]=TBL.[Strand3BilletCounter],[Strand2CastingSpeed_YD]=TBL.[Strand2CastingSpeed],[Strand5CastingSpeed_YD]=TBL.[Strand5CastingSpeed],[TotalProduction_YD]=TBL.[TotalProduction],[Strand1BilletCounter_YD]=TBL.[Strand1BilletCounter],[STD3OSCSpeed_YD]=TBL.[STD3OSCSpeed],[HeatID_YD]=TBL.[HeatID] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] AS SFD JOIN(SELECT @RptDate AS [Reportdate], [ActualBilletCount], [Strand2BilletCounter], [Strand6BilletCounter], [Strand1CastingSpeed], [STD2OSCSpeed], [STD6OSCSpeed], [TodayPlannedProduction], [Strand4CastingSpeed], [STD1OSCSpeed], [STD4OSCSpeed], [ActualBilletWeightTon], [Strand5BilletCounter], [TotalBilletsCount], [STD5OSCSpeed], [Strand4BilletCounter], [Strand3CastingSpeed], [Strand6CastingSpeed], [Strand3BilletCounter], [Strand2CastingSpeed], [Strand5CastingSpeed], [TotalProduction], [Strand1BilletCounter], [STD3OSCSpeed], [HeatID] FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[DBO].[CCM_Summary_Day] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted]=0  AND  [ReportDate] =DATEADD(DD,-1,@RptDate) ) AS TBL ON TBL.[Reportdate]=SFD.[Reportdate] 
					FETCH NEXT FROM UpdateCur INTO  @RptDate ;
			END
			CLOSE UpdateCur;
			DEALLOCATE UpdateCur;
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [XSTUDIO_WORKFLOW_17E91BC0-FC67-4CB1-9699-1625D71488F2_SP]  
(
 @p_SystemId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_UserId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_StatusAttributeName VARCHAR(200),
 @p_Status VARCHAR(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.
 SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
 

 BEGIN TRY

 

  BEGIN
    
    
 -- =====================  Variable Declaration  =====================
 DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

 -- Variables for each attribute holds current value
 
 DECLARE @Activeinactiveflag bit; 
 DECLARE @ElementNameID varchar(MAX); 
 DECLARE @LastUsedBatch varchar(100);


 -- =====================  Get Current Value  =====================
 SELECT  @Activeinactiveflag=[Activeinactiveflag], @ElementNameID=[ElementNameID], @LastUsedBatch=[LastUsedBatch] 
 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XMES_ActiveLife_Element_Mst_Tbl]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
 WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

 -- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
 Update [dbo].[XMES_Element_Life_Counter_Trn_Tbl] SET CurrentLife=ISNULL(CurrentLife,0)+1, ConsumeLifepercentage=(ISNULL(CurrentLife,0)+1)/ISNULL(MaximumLife,0), LastUsedBatch=@LastUsedBatch, ModifiedON=getdate()  WHERE ElementNameID=@ElementNameID;

INSERT INTO [dbo].[Life_Tracking_Transaction_tbl] (Life, LifeType, CurrentLife, ConsumePercentage, HeatID, EntryDateTime)
SELECT LE.Name, LET.Name, CurrentLife, LEC.ConsumeLifepercentage, LEC.LastUsedBatch, LEC.ModifiedON  FROM [dbo].[XMES_Life_Element_Mst_Tbl] LE WITH(NOLOCK)
JOIN [dbo].[XMES_Element_Life_Counter_Trn_Tbl] LEC WITH(NOLOCK) ON LE.ID=LEC.ElementNameID
JOIN [dbo].[XMES_Life_Element_Type_Mst_Tbl] LET WITH(NOLOCK) ON LE.ParentID=LET.ID AND LET.IsDeleted=0
WHERE LE.ID=@ElementNameID;


 
 -- =======================  Check Status Logic  =======================

 IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STRING_SPLIT('Inactive',',') WHERE [VALUE]=@p_Status) = 0)
 BEGIN
   SET @p_Status='Inactive';
 END
 

 
 IF (@p_Status IS NULL)
 BEGIN
   SET @p_Status='Inactive';
 END
 

 -- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
 SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XMES_ActiveLife_Element_Mst_Tbl] 
 SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),
   [Activeinactiveflag]=@Activeinactiveflag, [ElementNameID]=@ElementNameID, [LastUsedBatch]=@LastUsedBatch,
  ['+@p_StatusAttributeName+']=@p_Status,
  [Source] = ''T-SQL'',
  [ModifiedBy] = @p_UserId
 WHERE 
  [ID] = @p_RecordId;';

 EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL,N'@Activeinactiveflag bit,@ElementNameID varchar(MAX),@LastUsedBatch varchar(100),@p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),@p_Status VARCHAR(100),@p_UserId VARCHAR(36)', @Activeinactiveflag=@Activeinactiveflag, @ElementNameID=@ElementNameID, @LastUsedBatch=@LastUsedBatch,@p_RecordId=@p_RecordId,@p_Status=@p_Status,@p_UserId=@p_UserId;


END   
    
  

 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
     
   

   DECLARE @SPname VARCHAR(MAX)=OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
   DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE())
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [XSTUDIO_WORKFLOW_18207AB4-8668-4F3C-B913-03CF7068BB96_SP]		
(
	@p_SystemId VARCHAR(36),
	@p_UserId VARCHAR(36),
	@p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),
	@p_StatusAttributeName VARCHAR(200),
	@p_Status VARCHAR(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	

	BEGIN TRY

	

		BEGIN
				
				
	-- =====================  Variable Declaration  =====================
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

	-- Variables for each attribute holds current value
 
	DECLARE @EndTime datetime; 
	DECLARE @HeatID decimal(18,4); 
	DECLARE @StartTime datetime; 
	DECLARE @Status varchar(100);


	-- =====================  Get Current Value  =====================
	SELECT  @EndTime=[EndTime], @HeatID=[HeatID], @StartTime=[StartTime], @Status=[Status] 
	FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

	-- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
	 if(@Status in ('Ladle Move From LRF To CCM','Ladle At CCM Arm 1 Rest Position','Ladle At CCM Arm 2 Rest Position','Turret Rotation'))
      BEGIN
      Select top 1 @HeatID=isnull(heatid,(Select top 1 A.HeatID From [Xstudio_xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] as A With(Nolock)
			Where A.[Status] in ('LRF Roof Open') and A.[StartTime]<b.[StartTime] Order by A.CreatedOn desc)) 
			From [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] b With(Nolock) 
			Where ID=@p_RecordId order by CreatedOn desc               
       End
       
     if(@Status in ('CCM Arm 2 Casting Position','CCM Arm 1 Casting Position','Billets Production','CCM Turret Control Off'))
     BEGIN
      Select top 1 @HeatID=isnull(heatid,(Select top 1 A.HeatID From [Xstudio_xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] as A With(Nolock)
			Where A.[Status] in ('Ladle At CCM Arm 1 Rest Position','Ladle At CCM Arm 2 Rest Position') and A.[StartTime]<b.[StartTime] Order by A.CreatedOn desc)) 
			From [SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] b With(Nolock) 
			Where ID=@p_RecordId order by CreatedOn desc                  
       End
       Declare @ActualHeatID INT
       SELECT @ActualHeatID=@HeatID-1
       Update [Xstudio_xbatch].[dbo].[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] set ActualHeatID=@ActualHeatID Where ID=@p_RecordId
       IF(@Status in ('CCM Arm 2 Casting Position','CCM Arm 1 Casting Position'))
       Begin
       Declare @LiquidMetalWeight Decimal(18,4)
        Select @LiquidMetalWeight=LiquidMetalWeight from LRF_Per_Heat Where HeatID=@ActualHeatID
        Update CCM_Data set LiquidSteelWeight=@LiquidMetalWeight
       END
       


	

	

	-- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
	SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Plant_Process_EventTime] 
	SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),
		 [EndTime]=@EndTime, [HeatID]=@HeatID, [StartTime]=@StartTime, [Status]=@Status,
		['+@p_StatusAttributeName+']=@p_Status,
		[Source] = ''T-SQL'',
		[ModifiedBy] = @p_UserId
	WHERE 
		[ID] = @p_RecordId;';

	EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL,N'@EndTime datetime,@HeatID decimal(18,4),@StartTime datetime,@Status varchar(100),@p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),@p_Status VARCHAR(100),@p_UserId VARCHAR(36)', @EndTime=@EndTime, @HeatID=@HeatID, @StartTime=@StartTime, @Status=@Status,@p_RecordId=@p_RecordId,@p_Status=@p_Status,@p_UserId=@p_UserId;


END			
				
		

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
					
			

			DECLARE @SPname VARCHAR(MAX)=OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
			DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) 
			DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE()

				@type='SQL-Error',
				@Action=@SPname,

				@StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,
				@UserId='',
				@HostAddress='',
				@Info='',

				@SystemID=@p_SystemId
```

```sql
	WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

	-- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
	DECLARE @PrevEquipmentID VARCHAR(36)
```

```sql
SELECT @TreatmentStart = P.[StartTime], @TreatmentStop = P.[EndTime] FROM [LRF_ProcessTime] P WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE P.[Status] = 'Treatment Start' AND P.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND P.[LRFHeatID] = @HeatID;	    
EXEC [XMES_AUTO_WO_AND_SO_CALCULATION] @Plant = 'LRF', @WorkOrder = @WorkOrder;    
SELECT @TapStart = P.[TapStart] FROM [EAF_PER_HEAT] AS P WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE P.[HeatID] = @HeatID AND P.[IsDeleted] = 0;
IF(@LiquidMetalWeight > 0)
BEGIN

	EXEC [XBatch_I_Material_Produce_NoBOM_USP] @Grade = 'TBD', @HeatNo = @HeatID, @ItemName = @Material, @LotNumber = @LotNo, @Quantity = @LiquidMetalWeight, @SublotNumber = NULL, @UOMName = 'ton', @UserID = @p_UserId;
END    
IF(@StartTime IS NOT NULL AND @EndTime IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN
```

```sql
; WITH cte AS (SELECT 1 AS sr, '@p_SystemId' AS [name], @p_SystemId AS [value] UNION SELECT 2 AS sr, '@p_UserId' AS [Name], @p_UserId AS [Value] UNION SELECT 3 AS sr, '@p_Status' AS [Name], @p_Status AS [Value] UNION SELECT 4 AS sr, '@p_RecordId' AS [Name], @p_RecordId AS [value] UNION SELECT 5 AS sr, '@p_StatusAttributeName' AS [Name], @p_StatusAttributeName AS [value])
, cte1 AS (
    SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPname], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION]

)
SELECT @SP_Name = OBJECT_NAME(@@ProcID), @EXEC = c.[SPname] + ' ' + STRING_AGG([PARAMETER_NAME] + '=' + CASE WHEN cte.[value] IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE '''' + cte.[value] + '''' END,', ')
```

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [XSTUDIO_WORKFLOW_2D29BB58-88E0-4211-B392-36920B94C0F7_SP]  
(
 @p_SystemId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_UserId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_StatusAttributeName VARCHAR(200),
 @p_Status VARCHAR(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.
 SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
 

 BEGIN TRY

 

  BEGIN
    
    
 -- =====================  Variable Declaration  =====================
 DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

 -- Variables for each attribute holds current value
 
 DECLARE @Consumption decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @EndDateTime datetime; 
 DECLARE @FeederName varchar(100); 
 DECLARE @Position int; 
 DECLARE @Price varchar(100); 
 DECLARE @Quality int; 
 DECLARE @Value decimal(18,4);


 -- =====================  Get Current Value  =====================
 SELECT  @Consumption=[Consumption], @EndDateTime=[EndDateTime], @FeederName=[FeederName], @Position=[Position], @Price=[Price], @Quality=[Quality], @Value=[Value] 
 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Reading]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
 WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

 -- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
 UPDATE EMR
SET 
    EMR.FeederName = 'Feeder' +
        REPLACE(LEFT(SUBSTRING(EMR.FeederName, CHARINDEX(' ', EMR.FeederName) + 1, LEN(EMR.FeederName)),
                CASE
                    WHEN EMR.FeederName LIKE '%MONTHLY%' THEN
                        CHARINDEX(
                            'MONTHLY',
                            SUBSTRING(EMR.FeederName, CHARINDEX(' ', EMR.FeederName) + 1, LEN(EMR.FeederName))
                        ) - 1
                    WHEN EMR.FeederName LIKE '%DAILY%' THEN
                        CHARINDEX(
                            'DAILY',
                            SUBSTRING(EMR.FeederName, CHARINDEX(' ', EMR.FeederName) + 1, LEN(EMR.FeederName))
                        ) - 1
                    ELSE
                        LEN(EMR.FeederName)
                END
            ),
            ' ',
            ''
        ),
    EMR.Source      = 'T-SQL',
    EMR.ModifiedBy = '3ADE6546-3C9A-49C4-A001-234025F2F901',
    EMR.CreatedBy  = '3ADE6546-3C9A-49C4-A001-234025F2F901'
FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Reading] EMR
WHERE EMR.ID = @p_RecordId
  AND EMR.IsDeleted = 0;



 

 
 IF (@p_Status IS NULL)
 BEGIN
   SET @p_Status='Entered';
 END
 

 -- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
 SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Electricity_Meter_Reading] 
 SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),
   [Consumption]=@Consumption, [EndDateTime]=@EndDateTime, [FeederName]=@FeederName, [Position]=@Position, [Price]=@Price, [Quality]=@Quality, [Value]=@Value,
  ['+@p_StatusAttributeName+']=@p_Status,
  [Source] = ''T-SQL'',
  [ModifiedBy] = @p_UserId
 WHERE 
  [ID] = @p_RecordId;';

 EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL,N'@Consumption decimal(18,4),@EndDateTime datetime,@FeederName varchar(100),@Position int,@Price varchar(100),@Quality int,@Value decimal(18,4),@p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),@p_Status VARCHAR(100),@p_UserId VARCHAR(36)', @Consumption=@Consumption, @EndDateTime=@EndDateTime, @FeederName=@FeederName, @Position=@Position, @Price=@Price, @Quality=@Quality, @Value=@Value,@p_RecordId=@p_RecordId,@p_Status=@p_Status,@p_UserId=@p_UserId;


END   
    
  

 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
     
   

   DECLARE @SPname VARCHAR(MAX)=OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
   DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) 
   DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE()
   EXEC [XStudio_Configuration].[dbo].[XStudio_Add_ErrorLog_USP] 
    @type='SQL-Error',
    @Action=@SPname,
    @Message=@ERROR_MESSAGE,
    @StackTrace=@ERROR_LINE,
    @UserId='',
    @HostAddress='',
    @Info='',
    @Source='T-SQL',
    @SystemID=@p_SystemId
    
   DECLARE @ERROR_MSG VARCHAR(max) =  'SP : XSTUDIO_WORKFLOW_2D29BB58-88E0-4211-B392-36920B94C0F7_SP | Line No : '+ Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) +'| Messge : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE() ;
   RAISERROR(@ERROR_MSG,16,1)
  END CATCH
  
  END
```

```sql
  , cte1 AS (
    SELECT 'EXEC ' + DB_NAME() + '.' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(@@PROCID) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) AS [SPname], [PARAMETER_NAME], [ORDINAL_POSITION] 
    FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS AS p WHERE p.[SPECIFIC_NAME] = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
)
```

```sql
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
 

 BEGIN TRY

 

  BEGIN
    
    
 -- =====================  Variable Declaration  =====================
 DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

 -- Variables for each attribute holds current value
 
 DECLARE @EndTime datetime; 
 DECLARE @EquipmentID varchar(36); 
 DECLARE @HeatNo int; 
 DECLARE @IsProcessed bit; 
 DECLARE @ReportDate date; 
 DECLARE @StartTime datetime; 
 DECLARE @Status varchar(100);


 -- =====================  Get Current Value  =====================
 SELECT  @EndTime=[EndTime], @EquipmentID=[EquipmentID], @HeatNo=[HeatNo], @IsProcessed=[IsProcessed], @ReportDate=[ReportDate], @StartTime=[StartTime], @Status=[Status] 
 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Billet_Track_Per_Strand]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
 WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

 -- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
 
 SELECT TOP 1 @HeatNo = CAST(CAST(HeatID AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR(100))  FROM BilletsCastCount
    WHERE WorkFlowStatus = 'Entered'  AND ISNULL(IsDeleted,0)=0   ORDER BY StartTime DESC
    
 IF(@HeatNo IS NULL)
 BEGIN
   SELECT Top 1 @HeatNo = CAST(CAST(HeatID +1 AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR(100))  FROM BilletsCastCount
    WHERE ISNULL(IsDeleted,0)=0   ORDER BY StartTime DESC 
 END
 
IF(@Status='Heat Change')
BEGIN
EXEC [XMES_RESET_BILLET_SEQUENCE_USP] ;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
  EXEC [XMES_CREATE_BILLETNO_USP] @EventID=@p_RecordId;
END

  [ModifiedBy] = @p_UserId
 WHERE 
  [ID] = @p_RecordId;';
```

```sql
order by ModifiedOn desc

  IF (@status = 'Billets Gap')
```

```sql
 -- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
 IF(@LadleSequence=0)
Begin
 UPDATE [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[CCM_Data] SET CCMCastingDate=Format(@StartTime,'dd-MMM-yyyy'),CCMCastingTime =Format(@StartTime,'HH:mm:ss')
End

EXEC [Quality_Spectro_IsLatestSample_Update_Usp] 

IF(@HeatReportDate IS NULL) AND EXISTS (select 1 FROM xstudio_xbatch.dbo.eaf_per_heat with(nolock) where heatid = @heatid and heatreportdate is not null)
BEGIN
 Select @HeatReportDate=HeatReportDate From Xstudio_Xbatch.dbo.EAF_Per_Heat with(nolock) Where HeatID=@HeatID;
END
 Select @ReportDate=Format(@HeatReportDate,'yyyy-MM-dd');
 
 UPDATE AEL SET AEL.LastUsedBatch=Cast(@HeatID as VARCHAR(36)) FROM [dbo].[XMES_ActiveLife_Element_Mst_Tbl] AEL
Join XMES_Life_Element_Mst_Tbl ELM ON ELM.ID=AEL.ElementNameID AND ELM.IsDeleted=0
Join XMES_Element_Life_Type_Mapping_Mst_Tbl LTM ON LTM.ElementType=ELM.ParentID AND LTM.IsDeleted=0 and ltm.DataCaptureType='Auto'
WHERE LTM.ParentID='8D0E1442-1B43-4281-AC79-F68EB569AF51' and AEL.IsDeleted=0;

UPDATE XMES_Life_Tracker_Register_Mst_Tbl SET Status='Active', Source='T-SQL', ModifiedBy=@p_UserId WHERE ID='8D0E1442-1B43-4281-AC79-F68EB569AF51'
```

```sql
	@p_UserId VARCHAR(36),
	@p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),
	@p_StatusAttributeName VARCHAR(200),
	@p_Status VARCHAR(100)
)
AS
BEGIN

EXEC [XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp] @heatNo=@HeatNo;


	

	

	-- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
	SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[Delay_Trn_Tbl] 
	SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),
```

```sql
    WHERE LTS.IsDeleted=0 and  LT.[Name] like 'Mould Tube Life Strand %'

    Insert into Life_Tracking_Transaction_tbl (EntryDateTime, HeatID, Life, LifeType, CurrentLife, ConsumePercentage,AlertPercentage)
  Select GETDATE(), HeatID, LTS.[Life], LTS.LifeType, LTS.CurrentLife, ConsumedLifePercentage, LTS.AlertPercentage FROM Life_Tracking_Status LTS
    JOIN  (select Distinct Name,MaximumLife FROM  [XStudio_Xbatch].[dbo].[Life_Tracking] AS LT WITH(NOLOCK) where [Name] like 'Mould Tube Life Strand %' and IsDeleted=0) AS LT ON LT.Name = LTs.LifeType
    WHERE LTS.IsDeleted=0 and  LT.[Name] like 'Mould Tube Life Strand %'
 
End

EXEC [Xstudio_Historian_CCM_SMS_Block_usp] @Attribute='All',@EndTime=@EndTime,@Equipment='BF740CF1-17FF-4579-BECE-342EA6A59D3D',@StartTime=@StartTime

 EXEC [Quality_Spectro_IsLatestSample_Update_Usp] 

 Declare @grade Varchar(100), @Crosssection varchar(100);
 select @grade=grade ,@Crosssection = IIF(Crosssection IS NULL,NULL,CONCAT(CrossSection,'X', CrossSection)) from [ccm_per_heat] WITH(NOLOCK) where Cast(heatid as int) = cast(@HeatID as int) and isdeleted=0;

 Update [Heat_Chemistry_Quality_Data] set Grade = @grade ,section=@Crosssection where HeatNo= cast(cast(@HeatID as int) as varchar(7)) and isdeleted=0;

update CCM
set CCM.HeatReportDate= EAF.HeatReportDate,CCM.ReportDate=  EAF.ReportDate
from [Xstudio_xbatch].[dbo].[CCM_PER_HEAT] as CCM JOIN [Xstudio_xbatch].[dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] as EAF on EAF.heatid= CCM.HeatID and EAF.isdeleted=0
where EAF.heatid=@HeatID and CCM.HeatReportDate is Null;

Declare  @ItemName varchar(max),@MaterialGrade varchar(max),@Qty int, @HeatNo int, @TotalProduction Decimal(18,4),@WorkOrder varchar(36),@Setweight Decimal(18,4), @CrossSection1 Int;
SET @HeatNo = CAST(@HeatID AS int);
select  @HeatNo=HeatID, @Qty=ISNULL(TotalBilletsCount,0), @TotalProduction=TotalProduction, @WorkOrder=WorkOrder,@CrossSection1=CrossSection from CCM_Per_Heat WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  HEATID=@HeatNo;

Select Top 1 @Setweight=MaterialSpecificWeight from Billet_Cross_Section a With(Nolock) Where a.CrossSection1=@CrossSection1 and isdeleted=0 order by Createdon Desc;

UPDATE CCM_Per_Heat Set Noof140mmbillets=@Qty, ActualBilletWeightTon=@TotalProduction, RemainingPostedBilletCount=ISNULL(RemainingPostedBilletCount,@Qty), RemainingPostedBilletWeightTon=ISNULL(RemainingPostedBilletWeightTon,@TotalProduction), ActualBilletCount=@Qty, SetWeightTon=@Setweight, SAPWorkflowStatus=ISNULL(SAPWorkflowStatus,'Entered'), NoofBillets1=@Qty, CalcBilletsWeight1=@TotalProduction Where HeatID=@HeatNo;

EXEC [XMES_BackCalculation_GLS_Usp] @HeatNo=@HeatNo;

EXEC [XBatch_SMS_Heat_Tracking_Daily_Production_Data] @HeatID=@HeatID

EXEC [XMES_I_Billets_Tracking_Usp] @HeatID;



 

 

 -- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
 SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[BilletsCastCount] 
 SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),

 WHERE
```

```sql
 SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
 

 BEGIN TRY

 

  BEGIN
    
    
 -- =====================  Variable Declaration  =====================
 DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

 -- Variables for each attribute holds current value
 
 DECLARE @CapturedQuantity decimal(18,2); 
 DECLARE @DeclaredQuantity decimal(18,2); 
 DECLARE @LotNumber varchar(MAX); 
 DECLARE @OrderType varchar(100); 
 DECLARE @Price decimal(18,2); 
 DECLARE @ReportDate date; 
 DECLARE @Unit varchar(36); 
 DECLARE @WorkOrder varchar(36); 
 DECLARE @WorkOrderNo varchar(100);


 -- =====================  Get Current Value  =====================
 SELECT  @CapturedQuantity=[CapturedQuantity], @DeclaredQuantity=[DeclaredQuantity], @LotNumber=[LotNumber], @OrderType=[OrderType], @Price=[Price], @ReportDate=[ReportDate], @Unit=[Unit], @WorkOrder=[WorkOrder], @WorkOrderNo=[WorkOrderNo] 
 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
 WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

 -- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
 DECLARE @FirstHeat INT, @LastHeat INT;
if (@DeclaredQuantity > 0.00)
BEGIN
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl  WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE RawMaterialRecordID=@p_RecordId)
BEGIN
INSERT INTO [DBO].[MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl]([SAPPostingStatus], [Source], [Material], [Plant], [StorageLocation],  [GoodsMovementType], [EntryUnit], [ManufacturingOrder], [QuantityInEntryUnit],  [PostingMaterialType],  PostingDate, InventorySpecialStockType, RawMaterialRecordID)
    SELECT 'Posted','T-SQL',MMT.[Number] AS [Material], PMT.[Plant], SLM.[StorageLocation], '261' AS [GoodsMovementType], MUMT.[Name] AS [UnitName] , WOMT.[WorkOrderNumber], RMCT.[DeclaredQuantity], 'RAW MATERIAL', RMCT.[ReportDate], MMT.[InventorySpecialStockType], @p_RecordId
    FROM [dbo].MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl AS RMCT WITH(NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT [ID], [MaterialID] FROM [dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Mapping_Mst_Tbl] WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0) AS RMCMMT ON RMCT.[ParentID] = RMCMMT.[ID]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl] AS MMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMCMMT.[Materialid] = MMT.[ID] AND MMT.[IsDeleted] = 0
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Measurement_Unit_Mst_Tbl] MUMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON RMCT.[Unit] = MUMT.[ID] AND MUMT.[IsDeleted] = 0
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Plant_Name_MST] AS PMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON MMT.[PlantID] = PMT.[ID] AND PMT.[IsDeleted] = 0
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Storage_Location_MST] AS SLM WITH(NOLOCK) ON SLM.[ID] = MMT.[StoragelocationID]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[XBatch_Work_Order_Mst_Tbl] AS WOMT WITH(NOLOCK) ON WOMT.[ID] = RMCT.[WorkOrder] AND WOMT.[IsDeleted] = 0
    WHERE RMCT.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND RMCT.[ID]=@p_RecordId;
END
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl  WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE RawMaterialRecordID=@p_RecordId AND SAPPostingStatus='Entered')
BEGIN
  UPDATE MES_SAP_Consumption_Trn_Tbl SET [SAPPostingStatus]='Posted', [QuantityInEntryUnit]=@DeclaredQuantity, Source='T-SQL' WHERE RawMaterialRecordID=@p_RecordId AND SAPPostingStatus='Entered'
END
END
SELECT @FirstHeat = [FirstHeatNo], @LastHeat = [LastHeatNo] FROM (SELECT TOP (1) [ReportDate], [FirstHeatNo], [LastHeatNo] FROM Heat_End_Selection_Trn_Tbl WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 AND [ReportDate] = @ReportDate ORDER BY [CreatedOn] DESC) AS t;
 IF EXISTS (select 1 from XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl AS t1 WITH(NOLOCK) 
JOIN MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Mapping_Mst_Tbl AS t2 WITH(NOLOCK) ON t1.[ParentID] = t2.[ID] AND t1.[MaterialID] != t2.[Materialid] AND t1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND t2.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND t1.[HeatNo] Between @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat)
 BEGIN
     UPDATE [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl] SET [MaterialID] = t1.[MaterialID] FROM MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Mapping_Mst_Tbl AS t1
     WHERE [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[IsDeleted] = 0 AND t1.[IsDeleted] = 0 AND [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[ParentID] = t1.[ID] AND [XBatch_Material_Item_Cons_Trn_Tbl].[MaterialID] != t1.[MaterialID] AND [HeatNo] Between @FirstHeat AND @LastHeat;
 END


 

 

 -- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
 SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[MES_Raw_Material_Consumptions_Trn_Tbl] 
 SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),
   [CapturedQuantity]=@CapturedQuantity, [DeclaredQuantity]=@DeclaredQuantity, [LotNumber]=@LotNumber, [OrderType]=@OrderType, [Price]=@Price, [ReportDate]=@ReportDate, [Unit]=@Unit, [WorkOrder]=@WorkOrder, [WorkOrderNo]=@WorkOrderNo,
  ['+@p_StatusAttributeName+']=@p_Status,
  [Source] = ''T-SQL'',
  [ModifiedBy] = @p_UserId
 WHERE 
  [ID] = @p_RecordId;';

 EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL,N'@CapturedQuantity decimal(18,2),@DeclaredQuantity decimal(18,2),@LotNumber varchar(MAX),@OrderType varchar(100),@Price decimal(18,2),@ReportDate date,@Unit varchar(36),@WorkOrder varchar(36),@WorkOrderNo varchar(100),@p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),@p_Status VARCHAR(100),@p_UserId VARCHAR(36)', @CapturedQuantity=@CapturedQuantity, @DeclaredQuantity=@DeclaredQuantity, @LotNumber=@LotNumber, @OrderType=@OrderType, @Price=@Price, @ReportDate=@ReportDate, @Unit=@Unit, @WorkOrder=@WorkOrder, @WorkOrderNo=@WorkOrderNo,@p_RecordId=@p_RecordId,@p_Status=@p_Status,@p_UserId=@p_UserId;


END   
    
  

 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
```

```sql
	END;

	END;

	DEALLOCATE Prodcur
END
```

```sql
 @p_Status VARCHAR(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from

 SET ANSI_NULLS ON;

    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;
```

```sql
 BEGIN TRY

 

  BEGIN
    
    
 -- =====================  Variable Declaration  =====================
 DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

 -- Variables for each attribute holds current value
 
 DECLARE @EndTime datetime; 
 DECLARE @EquipmentID varchar(36); 
 DECLARE @HeatNo int; 
 DECLARE @IsProcessed bit; 
 DECLARE @ReportDate date; 
 DECLARE @StartTime datetime; 
 DECLARE @Status varchar(100);


 -- =====================  Get Current Value  =====================
 SELECT  @EndTime=[EndTime], @EquipmentID=[EquipmentID], @HeatNo=[HeatNo], @IsProcessed=[IsProcessed], @ReportDate=[ReportDate], @StartTime=[StartTime], @Status=[Status] 
 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Delay_Trn_Tbl]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
 WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

 -- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
 Declare @Duration Int = (Select DATEDIFF(SECOND, @StartTime, @EndTime)), @DStartTime DateTime
IF(@Status='Tapping Delay' and @Duration > 180 )
BEGIN
SET @DStartTime= (Select DATEADD(SECOND, 180, @StartTime));
EXEC [ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp] @EndTime=@EndTime,@HeatNo=@HeatNo,@StartTime=@DStartTime,@Status=@Status ;
END                      
IF(@Status='Bucket Charging' and @Duration > 120 )
BEGIN
SET @DStartTime= (Select DATEADD(SECOND, 120, @StartTime));
EXEC [ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp] @EndTime=@EndTime,@HeatNo=@HeatNo,@StartTime=@DStartTime,@Status=@Status ;
END                       
--IF(@Status='Setup Delay' and @Duration > 120 )
--BEGIN
--SET @DStartTime= (Select DATEADD(SECOND, 120, @StartTime));
--EXEC [ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp] @EndTime=@EndTime,@HeatNo=@HeatNo,@StartTime=@DStartTime,@Status=@Status ;
--END
/*IF(@Status='Power On Delay' AND @Duration>2820)
BEGIN
 SET @Starttime = DATEADD(MINUTE, 47, @StartTime)
EXEC [ShiftDelayEntry_Update_usp] @EndTime=@EndTime,@HeatNo=@HeatNo,@StartTime=@Starttime,@Status=@Status ;
END*/
IF(@Status='Tapping Delay')--'Power On Delay')
BEGIN
  EXEC [XBatch_Get_Entry_for_ShiftDelay_Usp] @heatNo=@HeatNo;
  EXEC [DelayEntry_EBTFilling_USP] @HeatNo=@HeatNo;
END


 

 

 -- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
 SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[SMS_Delay_Trn_Tbl] 
 SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),
   [EndTime]=@EndTime, [EquipmentID]=@EquipmentID, [HeatNo]=@HeatNo, [IsProcessed]=@IsProcessed, [ReportDate]=@ReportDate, [StartTime]=@StartTime, [Status]=@Status,
  ['+@p_StatusAttributeName+']=@p_Status,
  [Source] = ''T-SQL'',
  [ModifiedBy] = @p_UserId
 WHERE 
  [ID] = @p_RecordId;';

 EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL,N'@EndTime datetime,@EquipmentID varchar(36),@HeatNo int,@IsProcessed bit,@ReportDate date,@StartTime datetime,@Status varchar(100),@p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),@p_Status VARCHAR(100),@p_UserId VARCHAR(36)', @EndTime=@EndTime, @EquipmentID=@EquipmentID, @HeatNo=@HeatNo, @IsProcessed=@IsProcessed, @ReportDate=@ReportDate, @StartTime=@StartTime, @Status=@Status,@p_RecordId=@p_RecordId,@p_Status=@p_Status,@p_UserId=@p_UserId;


END   
    
  

 END TRY
 BEGIN CATCH
     
   

   DECLARE @SPname VARCHAR(MAX)=OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
   DECLARE @ERROR_LINE VARCHAR(max) =  Convert(varchar(1000),ERROR_LINE()) 
   DECLARE @ERROR_MESSAGE VARCHAR(max) =  ERROR_MESSAGE()
```

```sql
 SELECT  @EndTime=[EndTime], @HeatID=[HeatID], @StartTime=[StartTime], @Status=[Status] 
 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[BilletsCastCount]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
 WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

 -- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
 
SELECT TOP 1 @HeatID=HeatID FROM [Xstudio_xbatch].[dbo].[CCM_PER_HEAT] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Starttime < @StartTime ORDER BY Createdon DESC;

update CCM
set CCM.HeatReportDate= EAF.HeatReportDate,CCM.ReportDate=  EAF.ReportDate
from [Xstudio_xbatch].[dbo].[CCM_PER_HEAT] as CCM JOIN [Xstudio_xbatch].[dbo].[EAF_PER_HEAT] as EAF on EAF.heatid= CCM.HeatID and EAF.isdeleted=0
where EAF.heatid=@HeatID and CCM.HeatReportDate is Null;

Declare  @ItemName varchar(max),@MaterialGrade varchar(max),@Grade varchar(max),@Qty int, @HeatNo int, @TotalProduction Decimal(18,4),@WorkOrder varchar(36),@CrossSection int,@Setweight Decimal(18,4);
SET @HeatNo = CAST(@HeatID AS int) - 1;
select  @HeatNo=HeatID,@ItemName=(case when CrossSection=130 then 'Billet_130X130'  else 'Billet_150X150' end),@MaterialGrade=isnull(Grade,'3SP/PS'), @Qty=isnull(TotalBilletsCount,0) from CCM_Per_Heat WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE  HEATID=@HeatNo;

 EXEC [Quality_Spectro_IsLatestSample_Update_Usp]

  ['+@p_StatusAttributeName+']=@p_Status,
  [Source] = ''T-SQL'',

 WHERE 
  [ID] = @p_RecordId;';

 EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SQL,N'@EndTime datetime,@HeatID decimal(18,4),@StartTime datetime,@Status varchar(100),@p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),@p_Status VARCHAR(100),@p_UserId VARCHAR(36)', @EndTime=@EndTime, @HeatID=@HeatID, @StartTime=@StartTime, @Status=@Status,@p_RecordId=@p_RecordId,@p_Status=@p_Status,@p_UserId=@p_UserId;
```

```sql
IF @Bin3Name = @Bin4Name
BEGIN
  IF ISNULL(@Bin3Name, '') != ''
  BEGIN
    SELECT @HBIConsumption = CASE WHEN @Bin3Name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL(@Bin3Consumption, 0) AS FLOAT) + CAST(ISNULL(@Bin4Consumption, 0) AS FLOAT) END
          , @CdriConsumption = CASE WHEN @Bin3Name = 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL(@Bin3Consumption, 0) AS FLOAT) + CAST(ISNULL(@Bin4Consumption, 0) AS FLOAT) END
  END
END
ELSE 
BEGIN
     IF ISNULL(@bin3Name, '') != ''
     BEGIN
         SELECT @HBIConsumption = CASE WHEN @Bin3Name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL(@Bin3Consumption, 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE @HBIConsumption END, @CdriConsumption = CASE WHEN @Bin3Name = 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL(@Bin3Consumption, 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE @CdriConsumption END;
     END
     IF ISNULL(@bin4Name, '') != ''
     BEGIN
         SELECT @HBIConsumption = CASE WHEN @Bin4Name != 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL(@Bin4Consumption, 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE @HBIConsumption END, @CdriConsumption = CASE WHEN @Bin4Name = 'cdri' THEN CAST(ISNULL(@Bin4Consumption, 0) AS FLOAT) ELSE @CdriConsumption END;
     END
 END
```

```sql
	@p_Status VARCHAR(100)
```

```sql
		BEGIN
				
				
	-- =====================  Variable Declaration  =====================
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

	-- Variables for each attribute holds current value
 
	DECLARE @CCMHeatNo int; 
	DECLARE @EndTime datetime; 
	DECLARE @StartTime datetime; 
	DECLARE @Status varchar(100);


	-- =====================  Get Current Value  =====================
	SELECT  @CCMHeatNo=[CCMHeatNo], @EndTime=[EndTime], @StartTime=[StartTime], @Status=[Status] 
	FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_ProcessTime]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
	WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

	-- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
	If(@Status in ('Ladle At CCM Arm 2 Rest Position','Ladle At CCM Arm 1 Rest Position'))
    Begin
      Select Top 1 @CCMHeatNo=LRFHeatID from LRF_ProcessTime where Status='LRF Roof Open' and starttime<@StartTime order by CreatedOn desc
    End
    ELSE
     Begin
       Select Top 1 @CCMHeatNo=CCMHeatNo from CCM_ProcessTime where CCMHeatNo Is NOT Null and starttime<@StartTime order by CreatedOn desc
     End


	

	

	-- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
	SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[CCM_ProcessTime] 
	SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),

		['+@p_StatusAttributeName+']=@p_Status,
		[Source] = ''T-SQL'',
		[ModifiedBy] = @p_UserId
	WHERE 
		[ID] = @p_RecordId;';

END			
				
		

	END TRY
```

### Full Definition

```sql
CREATE   PROCEDURE [XSTUDIO_WORKFLOW_FF0AE3BF-1A32-4635-B431-3BA6931332AA_SP]  
(
 @p_SystemId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_UserId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_RecordId VARCHAR(36),
 @p_StatusAttributeName VARCHAR(200),
 @p_Status VARCHAR(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
 -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
 -- interfering with SELECT statements.
 SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
    SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;
    SET ARITHABORT ON;
    SET CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON;
    SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
    SET NUMERIC_ROUNDABORT OFF;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
 
 

 BEGIN TRY

 

  BEGIN
    
    
 -- =====================  Variable Declaration  =====================
 DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

 -- Variables for each attribute holds current value
 
 DECLARE @AllFilesUpload varchar(8000); 
 DECLARE @CampaignEndDate date; 
 DECLARE @CampaignId varchar(100); 
 DECLARE @CampaignstartDate date; 
 DECLARE @EndDate date; 
 DECLARE @EntryDateTime datetime; 
 DECLARE @Grade varchar(100); 
 DECLARE @IsProcessed bit; 
 DECLARE @Length varchar(100); 
 DECLARE @Material varchar(100); 
 DECLARE @MaxNoOfBundles decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @MaxQtytoRollMT decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @MinNoOfBundles decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @MinQtytoRollMT decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @Productname varchar(36); 
 DECLARE @ProgressPercentage decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @ProgressTonnage decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @RemaningTonnage decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @ReportDate date; 
 DECLARE @Size decimal(10,2); 
 DECLARE @StartDate date; 
 DECLARE @TotalPieces int; 
 DECLARE @TotalQtyWt decimal(18,4); 
 DECLARE @Working varchar(100); 
 DECLARE @WRMExcelUpload varchar(8000);


 -- =====================  Get Current Value  =====================
 SELECT  @AllFilesUpload=[AllFilesUpload], @CampaignEndDate=[CampaignEndDate], @CampaignId=[CampaignId], @CampaignstartDate=[CampaignstartDate], @EndDate=[EndDate], @EntryDateTime=[EntryDateTime], @Grade=[Grade], @IsProcessed=[IsProcessed], @Length=[Length], @Material=[Material], @MaxNoOfBundles=[MaxNoOfBundles], @MaxQtytoRollMT=[MaxQtytoRollMT], @MinNoOfBundles=[MinNoOfBundles], @MinQtytoRollMT=[MinQtytoRollMT], @Productname=[Productname], @ProgressPercentage=[ProgressPercentage], @ProgressTonnage=[ProgressTonnage], @RemaningTonnage=[RemaningTonnage], @ReportDate=[ReportDate], @Size=[Size], @StartDate=[StartDate], @TotalPieces=[TotalPieces], @TotalQtyWt=[TotalQtyWt], @Working=[Working], @WRMExcelUpload=[WRMExcelUpload] 
 FROM [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst]  WITH(NOLOCK) 
 WHERE [ID] = @p_RecordId;

 -- =====================  Business Logic  =====================
 

Select @CampaignID=CampaignId,@StartDate=StartDate,@EndDate=EndDate,@size=size from XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst where id=@p_RecordId and IsDeleted=0;

-- 1. Temp table for Work Order data
DECLARE @WOTable TABLE (
    Name varchar(MAX),
    Quantity DECIMAL(18,2),
    MinQty DECIMAL(10,2),
    MaterialName VARCHAR(MAX),
    Grade VARCHAR(500),
    SalesOrderName VARCHAR(MAX),
    SalesOrderID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, 
    CustomerName VARCHAR(MAX),
    ItemNo VARCHAR(100),
    length  DECIMAL(10,2),
    minbundles decimal(10,2),
    maxbundles decimal(10,2),
    Pieces Int
 );

-- 2. Temp table for sales Order data
DECLARE @SOMapping TABLE (SONumber VARCHAR(MAX));

INSERT INTO @SOMapping (SONumber)
SELECT DISTINCT SONumber
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn
WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID --AND LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) <> 'RB'
AND SONumber IS NOT NULL AND IsDeleted = 0;


---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- STEP 1: Insert into Sales Order Master (Using the generated IDs)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Insert into XBatch_Customer_Mst_Tbl(CustomerCode,Name)
select Customer,Customer from XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn as t
where isdeleted=0 and campaignid=@CampaignID AND not Exists (
select 1 from XBatch_Customer_Mst_Tbl
where IsDeleted=0 and name=T.customer
)



INSERT INTO XBATCH_SALES_ORDER_MST_TBL (Name, SalesOrderNumber, ParentID, ItemID, Quantity, UnitID, Status,Area)
SELECT 
    T.SONumber, 
    T.SONumber,
    (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM xbatch_customer_mst_tbl WHERE Name = MAX(T.Customer) AND IsDeleted = 0),
    (SELECT TOP 1 ID FROM XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl WHERE Name = MAX(T.MaterialNo) AND IsDeleted = 0),
    SUM(T.MaxQtytoRollMT), 
    '2095DF88-C3E3-4184-BA44-BBBB0696FF14', 
    'New',
    'RM'
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
INNER JOIN @SOMapping M ON T.SONumber = M.SONumber
WHERE T.CampaignId = @CampaignID AND T.IsDeleted = 0
-- CRITICAL FIX: Only insert if SO Number does not exist in Master Table
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM XBATCH_SALES_ORDER_MST_TBL 
        WHERE SalesOrderNumber = T.SONumber AND IsDeleted = 0
    )
GROUP BY T.SONumber;

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BRANCH 1: RB (Reinforced Bar) - Grouping by Length
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

INSERT INTO @WOTable (Name,Quantity,MinQty, MaterialName,Length,MinBundles,MaxBundles,Pieces,ItemNo)
SELECT 'MES_WO_' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.Length) AS VARCHAR(MAX)),
      SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT),SUM(MinQtytoRollMT), MAX(MaterialNo),Length,SUM(MinNoOfBundles),SUM(MaxNoOfBundles),SUM(NumberOfPiecesInBundles),MAX(M.id)
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON T.MaterialNo = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0
WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND (LEFT(MaterialNo, 2) IN('RB','BR') )  AND T.IsDeleted = 0 and T.MaxQtytoRollMT>0
GROUP BY [Length]; 

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BRANCH 2: Wire Rod/Coil with SO (Linked via @SOMapping)
------------------         ---------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO @WOTable (name,Quantity, MaterialName, SalesOrderName, CustomerName, ItemNo,grade)
SELECT 
    'MES_WO_' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.Length) AS VARCHAR(MAX)),
    T.MaxQtytoRollMT, 
    T.MaterialNo, 
    T.SONumber,  
    T.Customer
    ,S.ID,
    T.Grade
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
INNER JOIN @SOMapping M ON T.SONumber = M.SONumber
LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl S ON T.MaterialNo = S.Name AND S.IsDeleted = 0
WHERE T.CampaignId = @CampaignID AND T.SONumber IS NOT NULL AND LEFT(T.MaterialNo, 2) NOT IN ('RB','BR') AND T.IsDeleted = 0 and T.MaxQtytoRollMT>0;

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- BRANCH 3: WSO (No SO) - Grouping by grade
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO @WOTable (name,Quantity,MinQty, MaterialName,MinBundles,MaxBundles,Pieces,ItemNo,Grade)
SELECT 'MES_WO_' + FORMAT(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.Grade), '00'), 
    SUM(MaxQtytoRollMT),SUM(MinQtytoRollMT), M.ID,
    SUM(MinNoOfBundles),SUM(MaxNoOfBundles),SUM(NumberOfPiecesInBundles),MAX(M.ID),T.Grade
FROM XMES_RM_Campaign_Plan_Trn T
LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON T.MaterialNo = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0
WHERE CampaignId = @CampaignID AND SONumber IS NULL AND LEFT(T.MaterialNo, 2) NOT IN ('RB','BR')  AND T.IsDeleted = 0 and T.MaxQtytoRollMT>0
group by M.ID,T.Grade


---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FINAL STEP: Insert into Work Order Master
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSERT INTO XBATCH_WORK_ORDER_MST_TBL ( Name,
    Quantity, UnitID, ItemID, Status, Equipment, ManufacturingOrderCategory, 
    ManufacturingOrderType, ProductionPlant, StorageLocation, MaterialName, 
    SalesOrder, SalesOrderName, Grade, MfgOrderPlannedStartDate, MfgOrderPlannedEndDate, CustomerName, campaignid,Size,Length,Minbundles,MaxBundles,MinQtyToRoll,NoOfPiecesInBundles
)
SELECT 
    W.name,W.Quantity, '2095DF88-C3E3-4184-BA44-BBBB0696FF14',W.itemNo,
    'RM ProductionOrder Created', 'RM', 
    W.ItemNo,'BR02', '7503', '2104', W.MaterialName, 
    W.SalesOrderName, 
    W.SalesOrderName, W.Grade, @StartDate, @EndDate, W.CustomerName, @p_RecordId,@size,W.length,W.Minbundles,W.MaxBundles,W.MinQty,W.Pieces
FROM @WOTable W
LEFT JOIN XBatch_Material_Mst_Tbl M ON W.MaterialName = M.Name AND M.IsDeleted = 0;

Update XMES_Production_Campaign_Tracking 
Set ReleasedDate=Getdate(),status='Released'
where isdeleted=0 and campaignid=@p_RecordId
  


 
 -- =======================  Check Status Logic  =======================

 IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STRING_SPLIT('Released',',') WHERE [VALUE]=@p_Status) = 0)
 BEGIN
   SET @p_Status='Released';
 END
 

 
 IF (@p_Status IS NULL)
 BEGIN
   SET @p_Status='Released';
 END
 

 -- =====================  Update value in Entity  =====================
 SET  @SQL='UPDATE [XStudio_XBatch].[dbo].[XMES_Campaign_Plan_Mst] 
 SET [ModifiedOn] = GETDATE(),
   [AllFilesUpload]=@AllFilesUpload, [CampaignEndDate]=@CampaignEndDate, [CampaignId]=@CampaignId, [CampaignstartDate]=@CampaignstartDate, [EndDate]=@EndDate, [EntryDateTime]=@EntryDateTime, [Grade]=@Grade, [IsProcessed]=@IsProcessed, [Length]=@Length, [Material]=@Material, [MaxNoOfBundles]=@MaxNoOfBundles, [MaxQtytoRollMT]=@MaxQtytoRollMT, [MinNoOfBundles]=@MinNoOfBundles, [MinQtytoRollMT]=@MinQtytoRollMT, [Productname]=@Productname, [ProgressPercentage]=@ProgressPercentage, [ProgressTonnage]=@ProgressTonnage, [RemaningTonnage]=@RemaningTonnage, [ReportDate]=@ReportDate, [Size]=@Size, [StartDate]=@StartDate, [TotalPieces]=@TotalPieces, [TotalQtyWt]=@TotalQtyWt, [Working]=@Working, [WRMExcelUpload]=@WRMExcelUpload,
  ['+@p_StatusAttributeName+']=@p_Status,
  [Source] = ''T-SQL'',
  [ModifiedBy] = @p_UserId
 WHERE 
  [ID] = @p_RecordId;';
```
